abstract.text: This paper offers an economic model of smoking and body weight and provides new empirical evidence on the extent to which the demand for cigarettes is derived from the demand for weight loss. In the model, smoking causes weight loss in addition to having direct utility benefits and direct health consequences. It predicts that some individuals smoke for weight loss and that the practice is more common among those who consider themselves overweight and those who experience greater disutility from excess weight. We test these hypotheses using nationally representative data in which adolescents are directly asked whether they smoke to control their weight. We find that, among teenagers who smoke frequently, 46% of girls and 30% of boys are smoking in part to control their weight. As predicted by the model, this practice is significantly more common among those who describe themselves as too fat and among groups that tend to experience greater disutility from obesity. We conclude by discussing the implications of these findings for tax policy; specifically, the demand for cigarettes is less price elastic among those who smoke for weight loss, all else being equal. Public health efforts to reduce smoking initiation and encourage cessation may wish to design campaigns to alter the derived nature of cigarette demand, especially among adolescent girls.

10.1002/hec.3118.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个关于吸烟与体重关系的经济模型，并提供了新的实证证据，表明对香烟的需求在一定程度上源于对减肥的需求。该模型指出，吸烟除了带来直接的效用收益和健康影响外，还会导致体重下降。模型预测，部分人吸烟是为了减肥，且这一行为在认为自己超重以及因肥胖而感受到更大不适的人群中更为常见。我们利用具有全国代表性的数据对这些假设进行了验证，其中直接询问了青少年是否通过吸烟来控制体重。研究发现，在经常吸烟的青少年中，46%的女孩和30%的男孩部分原因是为了控制体重而吸烟。正如模型所预测的那样，这一行为在认为自己过于肥胖的人群以及因肥胖而感受到更大不适的群体中更为普遍。最后，我们讨论了这些发现对税收政策的影响；具体来说，在其他条件相同的情况下，为了减肥而吸烟的人群对香烟的需求弹性较低。公共卫生部门在减少吸烟率和鼓励戒烟方面，可能需要设计一些活动来改变人们对香烟需求的本质，尤其是针对青少年女孩。

abstract.text: Cost-effectiveness analyses (CEAs) of behavioral interventions typically use physical outcome criteria. However, any progress in cognitive antecedents of behavior change may be seen as a beneficial outcome of an intervention. The aim of this study is to explore the feasibility and validity of incorporating cognitive parameters of behavior change in CEAs. The CEA from a randomized controlled trial on smoking cessation was reanalyzed. First, relevant cognitive antecedents of behavior change in this dataset were identified. Then, transition probabilities between combined states of smoking and cognitions at 6 weeks and corresponding 6 months smoking status were obtained from the dataset. These rates were extrapolated to the period from 6 to 12 months in a decision analytic model. Simulated results were compared with the 12 months' observed cost-effectiveness results. Self-efficacy was the strongest time-varying predictor of smoking cessation. Twelve months' observed CEA results for the multiple tailoring intervention versus usual care showed € 3188 had to be paid for each additional quitter versus € 10,600 in the simulated model. The simulated CEA showed largely similar but somewhat more conservative results. Using self-efficacy to enhance the estimation of the true behavioral outcome seems a feasible and valid way to estimate future cost-effectiveness.

10.1002/hec.3119.abstractZh: 行为干预的成本效益分析通常采用物理结果作为评价标准。然而，行为改变的认知前因的任何进展都可能被视为干预的一个有益结果。本研究的目的是探讨在成本效益分析中纳入行为改变的认知参数可行性和有效性。对一项关于戒烟的随机对照试验的成本效益分析进行了重新分析。首先，确定了该数据集中与行为改变相关的认知前因。然后，从数据集中获得了6周时吸烟状态与认知状态之间的转换概率，以及相应的6个月吸烟状态。这些比率被外推到6至12个月的决策分析模型中。模拟结果与12个月的观察成本效益结果进行了比较。自我效能感是吸烟停止时间变化的最强预测因素。与常规护理相比，12个月的观察结果显示，每增加一个戒烟者需要支付3188欧元，而在模拟模型中则需要10,600欧元。模拟的成本效益分析结果显示，虽然结果大致相似，但较为保守。利用自我效能感来估算真实的行为结果，似乎是一种可行且有效的未来成本效益估算方法。

abstract.text: Spillover effects in health service use may represent an important externality of individual treatment decisions and are important for understanding the consequences of interventions to improve access to health care. This study is the first to our knowledge to examine causal spillover effects for mental health service use. We exploit the natural experiment of first-year student housing assignments at two universities using survey data that we collected. When the peer group is defined at the roommate level, we do not find any spillover effects on service use. When the peer group is defined at the hall level, we find positive spillover effects--peers' service use increases one's own service use--and this effect is driven by individuals with prior experience with mental health services. We also find some evidence that the mechanism behind this effect is improved beliefs about treatment effectiveness.

10.1002/hec.3120.abstractZh: 医疗服务使用的溢出效应可能代表了个体治疗决策中的一个重要外部性，这对于理解改善医疗保健获取途径的干预措施所带来的后果至关重要。据我们所知，这是第一项研究精神健康服务使用方面的因果溢出效应。我们利用在两家大学一年级学生宿舍分配这一自然实验数据，并收集了相关调查数据。当同伴群体以宿舍为单位进行定义时，我们没有发现任何服务使用的溢出效应。而当同伴群体以宿舍楼为单位进行定义时，我们发现存在积极的溢出效应——同伴的服务使用会增加自身服务的使用量，而且这种效应是由有精神健康服务使用经验的个体所驱动的。我们还发现了一些证据表明，这种效应背后的机制是人们对治疗效果的信念有所改善。

abstract.text: In most activity-based financing systems, payers set prices reactively based on historical averages of hospital reported costs. If hospitals respond to prices, payers might set prices proactively to affect the volume of particular treatments or clinical practice. We evaluate the effects of a unique initiative in England in which the price offered to hospitals for discharging patients on the same day as a particular procedure was increased by 24%, while the price for inpatient treatment remained unchanged. Using national hospital records for 205,784 patients admitted for the incentivised procedure and 838,369 patients admitted for a range of non-incentivised procedures between 1 December 2007 and 31 March 2011, we consider whether this price change had the intended effect and/or produced unintended effects. We find that the price change led to an almost six percentage point increase in the daycase rate and an 11 percentage point increase in the planned daycase rate. Patients benefited from a lower proportion of procedures reverted to open surgery during a planned laparoscopic procedure and from a reduction in long stays. There was no evidence that readmission and death rates were affected. The results suggest that payers can set prices proactively to incentivise hospitals to improve quality.

10.1002/hec.3121.abstractZh: 在大多数基于活动的融资系统中，支付方会根据医院报告的成本的历史平均值来反应性地设定价格。如果医院对价格做出反应，支付方可能会主动设定价格，以影响特定治疗或临床实践的数量。我们评估了英格兰一项独特举措的效果，该举措将医院在当天为特定手术提供出院服务时的价格提高了24%，而住院治疗的费用保持不变。利用2007年12月1日至2011年3月31日期间，205,784名接受激励性手术的患者和838,369名接受一系列非激励性手术的患者全国医院记录，我们研究了这一价格变化是否达到了预期效果，以及是否产生了意外影响。我们发现，价格变化导致日间手术率增加了近六个百分点，计划中的日间手术率增加了11个百分点。患者受益于在计划中的腹腔镜手术中，需要重新进行开放手术的比例降低，以及住院时间缩短。没有证据表明再入院率和死亡率受到影响。结果表明，支付方可以主动设定价格，以激励医院提高质量。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the causal effect of perceived job insecurity - that is, the fear of involuntary job loss - on health in a sample of men from 22 European countries. We rely on an original instrumental variable approach on the basis of the idea that workers perceive greater job security in countries where employment is strongly protected by the law and more so if employed in industries where employment protection legislation is more binding; that is, in induastries with a higher natural rate of dismissals. Using cross-country data from the 2010 European Working Conditions Survey, we show that, when the potential endogeneity of job insecurity is not accounted for, the latter appears to deteriorate almost all health outcomes. When tackling the endogeneity issue by estimating an instrumental variable model and dealing with potential weak-instrument issues, the health-damaging effect of job insecurity is confirmed for a limited subgroup of health outcomes; namely, suffering from headaches or eyestrain and skin problems. As for other health variables, the impact of job insecurity appears to be insignificant at conventional levels.

10.1002/hec.3122.abstractZh: 本文估计了感知工作不安全感——即担心非自愿失业——对22个欧洲国家男性健康影响的因果效应。我们采用了一种原创的工具变量方法，该方法基于这样一个观点：工人认为在就业受到法律严格保护的国家的就业安全性更高，尤其是在那些就业保护法规更为严格的行业中，即自然解雇率较高的行业。通过利用2010年欧洲工作条件调查的数据，我们发现，如果不考虑工作不安全的潜在内生性，那么工作不安全感似乎会恶化几乎所有健康结果。通过估计工具变量模型并处理潜在的弱工具变量问题，我们确认了工作不安全感对部分健康结果的负面影响，具体来说，包括头痛、眼睛疲劳和皮肤问题。至于其他健康变量，工作不安全感的影响在常规水平下似乎并不显著。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes whether the opportunity for physicians to dispense drugs increases healthcare expenditures. We study the case of Switzerland, where dispensing physicians face financial incentives to overprescribe and sell more expensive pharmaceuticals. Using comprehensive physician-level data, we exploit the regional variation in the dispensing regime to estimate causal effects. The empirical strategy consists of a doubly-robust estimation that combines inverse probability weighting with regression. Our main finding suggests that dispensing leads to higher drug costs on the order of 34% per patient.

10.1002/hec.3124.abstractZh: 本文分析了医生开药的机会是否会增加医疗支出。我们以瑞士为例进行研究，在该国，开药医生面临过度开药和销售更昂贵药物的财务激励。我们利用全面的医生数据，并利用地区差异来估计因果效应。我们的实证策略结合了逆概率加权与回归方法，形成了一种双重稳健的估计方法。我们的主要发现表明，开药行为导致每位患者的药物成本增加了约34%。

abstract.text: Recently, the emphasis on health human resources (HHR) planning has shifted away from a utilization-based approach toward a needs-based one in which planning is based on the projected health needs of the population. However, needs-based models that are currently in use rely on a definition of 'needs' that include only the medical circumstances of individuals and not personal preferences or other socio-economic factors. We examine whether planning based on such a narrow definition will maximize social welfare. We show that, in a publicly funded healthcare system, if the planner seeks to meet the aggregate need without taking utilization into consideration, then oversupply of HHR is likely because 'needs' do not necessarily translate into 'usage.' Our result suggests that HHR planning should track the healthcare system as access gradually improves because, even if health care is fully accessible, individuals may not fully utilize it to the degree prescribed by their medical circumstances.

10.1002/hec.3125.abstractZh: 近年来，健康人力资源规划的重点已从基于利用的方法转向基于需求的方法，即规划基于人口预期的医疗需求。然而，目前使用的基于需求的模型仅将“需求”定义为个人的医疗状况，而没有考虑个人偏好或其他社会经济因素。我们探讨基于如此狭隘定义的规划是否能够最大化社会福祉。研究表明，在公共资金支持的医疗保健系统中，如果规划者试图满足总体需求而不考虑利用情况，那么健康人力资源的过剩很可能是因为“需求”并不一定转化为“使用”。我们的结果表明，健康人力资源规划应随着医疗服务的逐步改善而进行调整，因为即使医疗保健完全可获取，个人也可能不会完全按照其医疗状况来使用这些服务。

abstract.text: Endogenous targeting of alcohol advertisements presents a challenge for empirically identifying a causal effect of advertising on drinking. Drinkers prefer a particular media; firms recognize this and target alcohol advertising at these media. This paper overcomes this challenge by utilizing novel data with detailed individual measures of media viewing and alcohol consumption and three separate empirical techniques, which represent significant improvements over previous methods. First, controls for the average audience characteristics of the media an individual views account for attributes of magazines and television programs alcohol firms may consider when deciding where to target advertising. A second specification directly controls for each television program and magazine a person views. The third method exploits variation in advertising exposure due to a 2003 change in an industry-wide rule that governs where firms may advertise. Although the unconditional correlation between advertising and drinking by youth (ages 18-24) is strong, models that include simple controls for targeting imply, at most, a modest advertising effect. Although the coefficients are estimated less precisely, estimates with models including more rigorous controls for targeting indicate no significant effect of advertising on youth drinking.

10.1002/hec.3126.abstractZh: 对酒精广告进行内生性定位，为实证识别广告对饮酒的因果效应带来了挑战。饮酒者偏好特定的媒体，企业也意识到这一点，并将酒精广告定向投放到这些媒体上。本文通过利用新颖的数据，这些数据包含详细的个人媒体观看和酒精消费数据，并采用三种独立的实证技术，克服了这一挑战。这些技术相较于以往的方法具有显著改进。首先，控制了个人观看的媒体的平均受众特征，这有助于了解杂志和电视节目等媒体属性，这些是企业决定广告投放目标时需要考虑的因素。第二种方法直接控制了个人观看的每档电视节目和每本杂志。第三种方法则利用了由于2003年行业规则变更导致的广告曝光变化，该规则规定了企业可以广告投放的位置。尽管青少年（18-24岁）对广告与饮酒之间的无条件相关性很强，但包含简单定位控制的模型最多只能表明广告具有适度的效果。尽管这些系数的估计精度较低，但包含更严格定位控制的模型的估计结果显示，广告对青少年饮酒没有显著影响。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the notion of treatment threshold for preventive treatment with potential side effects in the context of changes in risk. Changes in risk are defined by the concept of nth-order stochastic dominance and concern the effectiveness of preventive treatment, side effects, severity of the potential disease, and comorbidity risk. The impact of a riskier environment on the probability of disease threshold above which the preferable decision is to undergo preventive treatment is shown to depend on both mixed risk averse individual preferences and the configuration of increase in risk considered. These results suggest that neglecting differences between risks when evaluating the treatment threshold is likely to lead to substantial errors in most cost-benefit applications for preventive treatment.

10.1002/hec.3127.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在风险变化背景下，具有潜在副作用的预防性治疗的处理阈值概念。风险变化通过n阶随机优势的概念来定义，涉及预防性治疗的有效性、副作用、潜在疾病的严重程度以及合并症风险。研究表明，风险较高的环境对疾病阈值的影响，即需要采取预防性治疗的临界值，取决于混合风险厌恶型个体偏好以及所考虑的风险增加情况。这些结果表明，在评估处理阈值时忽略不同风险之间的差异，很可能会导致大多数预防性治疗的成本效益分析出现重大错误。

abstract.text: The paper demonstrates differential effects of a prospective payment system with declining per diem rates, dependent on the percentiles of length of stay. The analysis uses dynamic panel data estimates and a recent nationwide administrative database for major diagnostic categories in 1068 Japanese hospitals in 2006-2012 to show that average length of stay significantly increases for hospitals in percentiles 0-25 of the pre-reform length of stay and significantly decreases for hospitals in percentiles 51-100. The decline of the average length of stay is larger for hospitals in higher percentiles of the length of stay. Hospitals in percentiles 51-100 significantly increase their rate of nonemergency/unanticipated readmissions within 42 days after discharge. The decline in the length of total episode of treatment is smaller for hospitals in percentiles 0-25. The findings are robust in terms of the choice of a cohort of hospitals joining the reform. The paper discusses applicability of 'best practice' rate-setting to help improve the performance of hospitals in the lowest quartile of average length of stay.

10.1002/hec.3128.abstractZh: 该论文探讨了预期付费制度在不同住院时长百分位下的差异效应，这些差异取决于住院时间的不同百分位。分析采用了动态面板数据估计方法，并参考了2006-2012年间日本1068家医院主要诊断类别的全国性行政数据库，发现改革前住院时间处于0-25百分位的医院，其平均住院时间显著增加；而处于51-100百分位的医院，平均住院时间则显著减少。住院时间较长的医院，其平均住院时间的下降幅度更大。在51-100百分位的医院中，出院后42天内非紧急/意外再住院率显著上升。对于住院时间处于0-25百分位的医院而言，整个治疗过程的住院时间下降幅度较小。这些研究结果在选取参与改革的医院群体时具有稳健性。论文还讨论了“最佳实践”费率设定方法在提升平均住院时间最低四分位医院绩效方面的适用性。

abstract.text: We tracked doctors who had previously participated in a randomized policy experiment in the Philippines. The original experiment involved 30 district hospitals divided equally into one control site and two intervention sites that increased insurance payments (full insurance support for children under 5 years old) or made bonus payments to hospital staff. During the 3 years of the intervention, quality-as measured by clinical performance and value vignettes-improved and was sustained in both intervention sites compared with controls. Five years after the interventions were discontinued, we remeasured the quality of care of the doctors. We found that the intervention sites continued to have significantly higher quality compared with the control sites. The previously documented quality improvement in intervention sites appears to be sustained; moreover, it was subject to a very low (less than 1% per year) rate of decay in quality scores.

10.1002/hec.3129.abstractZh: 我们追踪了之前参与菲律宾一项随机政策实验的医生。该实验涉及30家地区医院，这些医院被平均分为一个对照组和两个干预组。干预组增加了保险支付（为5岁以下儿童提供全额保险支持）或向医院工作人员发放奖金。在3年的干预期间，以临床表现和患者满意度为衡量标准，两个干预组的医疗质量都有所改善，并且这种改善在对照组中并未持续。在干预措施停止后的5年，我们再次对医生的医疗质量进行了测量。结果发现，干预组的医疗质量仍然显著高于对照组。先前记录的干预组的医疗质量改善似乎得到了维持；此外，质量评分的下降率非常低，每年不到1%。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the effect of an individual's number of friends on own health outcomes. The identification strategy exploits the panel structure of the friendship data from the National Longitudinal Study of Adolescent Health to estimate individual fixed effects in the likelihood of friendship formation and then uses the fixed effect estimates as a control function in a model relating health outcomes to number of friends. Empirical results show that having a larger number of friends improves physical and mental health and also lowers the frequency of smoking cigarettes. Specifically, making one more friend increases an individual's general health measure by 6.6% of a standard deviation. This suggests that accumulating social capital through friendship interactions is beneficial to health.

10.1002/hec.3131.abstractZh: 本文估计了个人朋友数量对自身健康结果的影响。研究采用了《全国青少年健康纵向研究》中友谊数据的面板结构，通过估计友谊形成概率中的个体固定效应，并将这些固定效应作为控制变量，构建了一个将健康结果与朋友数量相关联的模型。实证结果显示，拥有更多朋友能够改善身体和心理健康，同时降低吸烟的频率。具体而言，多一个朋友会使个人的整体健康水平提高6.6个标准差。这表明，通过友谊互动积累社会资本对健康是有益的。

abstract.text: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is the third most deadly cancer in the USA. CRC screening is the most effective way to prevent CRC death, but compliance with recommended screenings is very low. In this study, we investigate whether CRC screening behavior changed under state mandated private insurance coverage of CRC screening in a sample of insured adults from the 1997 to 2008 Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance Survey (BRFSS). We present difference-in-difference-in-differences (DDD) estimates that compare insured individuals age 51 to 64 to Medicare age-eligible individuals (ages 66 to 75) in mandate and non-mandate states over time. Our DDD estimates suggest endoscopic screening among men increased by 2 to 3 percentage points under mandated coverage among 51 to 64 year olds relative to their Medicare age-eligible counterparts. We find no clear evidence of changes in screening behavior among women. DD estimates suggest no evidence of a mandate effect on either type of CRC screening for men or women.

10.1002/hec.3132.abstractZh: 结直肠癌是美国第三大致命癌症。结直肠癌筛查是预防结直肠癌死亡的最有效方法，但遵循推荐的筛查方案的比例非常低。本研究调查了在1997至2008年的行为风险因素监测调查中，受州政府强制要求的私人保险覆盖下，结直肠癌筛查行为是否发生了变化。我们通过差异中的差异估计方法，比较了51至64岁受保险覆盖者与66至75岁的符合医疗保险年龄条件的个体在强制覆盖与非强制覆盖状态下的筛查情况。我们的估计结果显示，在51至64岁的男性中，强制覆盖下内镜筛查的比例比非强制覆盖下增加了2至3个百分点。而在女性中，并未发现筛查行为有明显的变化。差异估计结果显示，无论是男性还是女性的结直肠癌筛查行为，均未受到强制覆盖的影响。

abstract.text: This paper develops an extended specification of the two-part model, which controls for unobservable self-selection and heterogeneity of health insurance, and analyzes the impact of Medicare supplemental plans on the prescription drug expenditure of the elderly, using a linked data set based on the Medicare Current Beneficiary Survey data for 2003-2004. The econometric analysis is conducted using a Bayesian econometric framework. We estimate the treatment effects for different counterfactuals and find significant evidence of endogeneity in plan choice and the presence of both adverse and advantageous selections in the supplemental insurance market. The average incentive effect is estimated to be $757 (2004 value) or 41% increase per person per year for the elderly enrolled in supplemental plans with drug coverage against the Medicare fee-for-service counterfactual and is $350 or 21% against the supplemental plans without drug coverage counterfactual. The incentive effect varies by different sources of drug coverage: highest for employer-sponsored insurance plans, followed by Medigap and managed medicare plans.

10.1002/hec.3133.abstractZh: 本文对两部分模型进行了扩展性的描述，考虑了不可观测的自我选择因素以及健康保险市场的异质性，并利用基于2003-2004年医疗保险当前受益人调查数据的关联数据集，分析了医疗保险补充计划对老年人处方药支出的影响。计量分析采用了贝叶斯计量经济学框架。我们针对不同的反事实情景估计了处理效应，发现计划选择中存在显著的内生性，并且补充保险市场中存在不利和有利的选择。平均激励效应估计为：对于参加有药物覆盖的补充计划的老年人，每年每人增加757美元（2004年价值），即增加41%；而对于没有药物覆盖的补充计划，则增加350美元，即增加21%。激励效应因药物覆盖来源的不同而有所差异：雇主赞助的保险计划带来的激励效应最高，其次是Medigap计划和管理式医疗保险计划。

abstract.text: Not accounting for simplifying decision-making heuristics when modelling data from discrete choice experiments has been shown potentially to lead to biased inferences. This study considers two ways of exploring the presence of attribute non-attendance (that is, respondents considering only a subset of the attributes that define the choice options) in a health state valuation discrete choice experiment. The methods used include the latent class (LC) and endogenous attribute attendance (EAA) models, which both required adjustment to reflect the structure of the quality-adjusted life year (QALY) framework for valuing health outcomes. We find that explicit consideration of attendance patterns substantially improves model fit. The impact of allowing for non-attendance on the estimated QALY weights is dependent on the assumed source of non-attendance. If non-attendance is interpreted as a form of preference heterogeneity, then the inferences from the LC and EAA models are similar to those from standard models, while if respondents ignore attributes to simplify the choice task, the QALY weights differ from those using the standard approach. Because the cause of non-attendance is unknown in the absence of additional data, a policymaker may use the range of weights implied by the two approaches to conduct a sensitivity analysis.

10.1002/hec.3134.abstractZh: 在建模离散选择实验数据时，若不考虑简化决策过程的启发式方法，可能会导致有偏见的推断。本研究探讨了在健康状态评估的离散选择实验中，是否存在仅考虑部分属性选择的情况。所采用的方法包括潜在类别模型和内生属性参与模型，这两种模型都需要进行调整，以反映质量调整生命年框架在评估健康结果中的应用。研究发现，明确考虑属性参与情况可以显著改善模型的拟合度。允许非参与情况对估计的QALY权重的影响取决于所假设的非参与来源。如果非参与被解释为偏好异质性的一种形式，那么从潜在类别模型和内生属性参与模型中得出的结论与标准模型相似；而如果受访者为了简化选择任务而忽略某些属性，则QALY权重会与使用标准方法的权重有所不同。由于缺乏额外数据，无法明确非参与的原因，政策制定者可以利用这两种方法得出的权重范围进行敏感性分析。

abstract.text: There is promising recent evidence that poverty-targeted social cash transfers have potential to improve maternal health outcomes; however, questions remain surrounding design features responsible for impacts. In addition, virtually no evidence exists from the African region. This study explores the impact of Zambia's Child Grant Program on a range of maternal health utilization outcomes using a randomized design and difference-in-differences multivariate regression from data collected over 24 months from 2010 to 2012. Results indicate that while there are no measurable program impacts among the main sample, there are heterogeneous impacts on skilled attendance at birth among a sample of women residing in households having better access to maternal health services. The latter result is particularly interesting because of the overall low level of health care availability in program areas suggesting that dedicated program design or matching supply-side interventions may be necessary to leverage unconditional cash transfers in similar settings to impact maternal health.

10.1002/hec.3136.abstractZh: 最近有令人鼓舞的证据表明，针对贫困群体的社会现金转移有可能改善孕产妇健康状况；然而，关于这些影响的具体设计因素仍存在疑问。此外，非洲地区几乎没有相关研究。本研究利用随机设计和差异-差异多变量回归方法，分析了赞比亚儿童补助金计划对孕产妇健康相关指标的影响，数据收集时间为2010年至2012年的24个月。研究结果表明，虽然主要样本中没有可测量的项目影响，但在那些能够获得更好孕产妇健康服务资源的家庭中，女性在分娩时获得专业助产服务的情况有所不同。这一结果尤其值得关注，因为项目地区的医疗设施普遍不足，因此可能需要专门的项目设计或相应的供给侧干预措施，才能在无条件现金转移的情况下实现类似的效果，从而改善孕产妇健康。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the health dimension of the welfare cost of homicides in Brazil incorporating age, gender, educational, and regional heterogeneities. We use a marginal willingness to pay approach to assign monetary values to the welfare cost of increased mortality due to violence. Results indicate that the present discounted value of the welfare cost of homicides in Brazil corresponds to roughly 78% of the GDP or, in terms of yearly flow, 2.3%. The analysis also shows that reliance on aggregate data to perform such calculations can lead to biases of around 20% in the estimated social cost of violence.

10.1002/hec.3137.abstractZh: 本文通过纳入年龄、性别、教育水平和地区差异，估算了巴西谋杀行为带来的福利成本中的健康维度。我们采用边际支付意愿的方法，为因暴力导致的死亡率增加所带来的福利成本赋予货币价值。研究结果表明，巴西谋杀行为的福利成本现值约占GDP的78%，按年度流量计算，约为2.3%。分析还显示，使用汇总数据进行计算可能导致对暴力社会成本的估算出现约20%的偏差。

abstract.text: Life-saving medical technologies result in additional demand for health care due to increased life expectancy. However, most economic evaluations do not include all medical costs that may result from this additional demand in health care and include only future costs of related illnesses. Although there has been much debate regarding the question to which extent future costs should be included from a societal perspective, the appropriate role of future medical costs in the widely adopted but more narrow healthcare perspective has been neglected. Using a theoretical model, we demonstrate that optimal decision rules for cost-effectiveness analyses assuming fixed healthcare budgets dictate that future costs of both related and unrelated medical care should be included. Practical relevance of including the costs of future unrelated medical care is illustrated using the example of transcatheter aortic valve implantation. Our findings suggest that guidelines should prescribe inclusion of these costs.

10.1002/hec.3138.abstractZh: 救命医疗技术导致预期寿命延长，从而增加了对医疗保健的需求。然而，大多数经济评估并未涵盖由此带来的所有医疗成本，仅包括了相关疾病的未来成本。尽管关于从社会角度应涵盖未来成本的程度存在诸多争议，但在广泛采用但较为狭隘的医疗保健视角中，未来医疗成本的适当作用却被忽视了。通过理论模型分析，我们表明，在假设固定医疗预算的情况下，进行成本效益分析时，应同时考虑相关医疗护理和未来无关医疗护理的成本。以经导管主动脉瓣植入术为例，说明了包含未来无关医疗护理成本的实际意义。我们的研究结果表明，相关指南应规定将这些成本纳入考量。

abstract.text: This study investigates the effect of the Temporary Aid to Needy Families (TANF) program on children's health outcomes using data from the Survey of Income and Program Participation over the period 1994 to 2005. The TANF policies have been credited with increased employment for single mothers and a dramatic drop in welfare caseload. Our results show that these policies also had a significant effect on various measures of children's medical utilization among low-income families. These health measures include a rating of the child's health status reported by the parents, the number of times that parents consulted a doctor, and the number of nights that the child stayed in a hospital. We compare the overall changes of health status and medical utilization for children with working and nonworking mothers. We find that the child's health status as reported by the parents is affected by the maternal employment status.

10.1002/hec.3139.abstractZh: 本研究利用1994至2005年的收入与项目参与调查数据，探讨了临时援助贫困家庭计划对儿童健康结果的影响。TANF政策被认为提高了单身母亲的就业率，并显著减少了福利案件数量。研究结果显示，这些政策对低收入家庭儿童的医疗使用情况也产生了显著影响。这些健康指标包括父母报告的儿童健康状况、父母就医次数以及儿童住院夜数。我们对比了有工作和没有工作的母亲所抚养的儿童在健康状况和医疗使用方面的整体变化，发现父母报告的儿童健康状况受到母亲就业状况的影响。

abstract.text: Public health officials have cited methamphetamine control as a tool with which to decrease HIV and other sexually transmitted infections, based on previous research that finds a strong positive correlation between methamphetamine use and risky sexual behavior. However, the observed correlation may not be causal, as both methamphetamine use and risky sexual behavior could be driven by a third factor, such as a preference for risky behavior. We estimate the effect of methamphetamine use on risky sexual behavior using monthly data on syphilis diagnoses in California and quarterly data on syphilis, gonorrhea, and chlamydia diagnoses across all states. To circumvent possible endogeneity, we use a large exogenous supply shock in the US methamphetamine market that occurred in May 1995 and a later shock stemming from the Methamphetamine Control Act, which went into effect in October 1997. While the supply shocks had large negative effects on methamphetamine use, we find no evidence that they decreased syphilis, gonorrhea, or chlamydia rates. Our results have broad implications for public policies designed to decrease sexually transmitted infection rates.

10.1002/hec.3140.abstractZh: 公共卫生官员将甲基苯丙胺控制视为减少HIV和其他性传播感染的手段，这一结论基于先前的研究发现，甲基苯丙胺使用与危险性行为之间存在强烈的正相关关系。然而，这种相关性可能并非因果关系，因为甲基苯丙胺使用与危险性行为可能都由第三个因素驱动，比如对危险行为的偏好。我们利用加利福尼亚州的梅毒诊断月度数据以及全美各州的梅毒、淋病和衣原体诊断季度数据，来估算甲基苯丙胺使用对危险性行为的影响。为了规避可能的内生性影响，我们使用了1995年5月美国甲基苯丙胺市场发生的重大外部供应冲击，以及1997年10月生效的《甲基苯丙胺控制法》带来的后续冲击。尽管这些供应冲击对甲基苯丙胺使用产生了显著的负面影响，但我们并未发现它们会降低梅毒、淋病或衣原体感染率。我们的研究结果对旨在降低性传播感染率的公共政策具有广泛意义。

abstract.text: We investigate the causal effect of education on health and the part of it that is attributable to health behaviors by distinguishing between short-run and long-run mediating effects: whereas, in the former, only behaviors in the immediate past are taken into account, in the latter, we consider the entire history of behaviors. We use two identification strategies: instrumental variables based on compulsory schooling reforms and a combined aggregation, differencing, and selection on an observables technique to address the endogeneity of both education and behaviors in the health production function. Using panel data for European countries, we find that education has a protective effect for European men and women aged 50+. We find that the mediating effects of health behaviors-measured by smoking, drinking, exercising, and the body mass index-account in the short run for around a quarter and in the long run for around a third of the entire effect of education on health.

10.1002/hec.3141.abstractZh: 我们研究了教育对健康的因果效应，以及其中可归因于健康行为的部分。通过区分短期和长期的中介效应，我们发现：在短期内，只考虑即时行为的影响；而在长期内，则考虑行为的整个历史。我们采用了两种识别策略：基于义务教育改革的工具变量，以及结合聚合、差分和选择技术的方法，以解决教育和行为在健康产出函数中的内生性问题。利用欧洲国家的面板数据，我们发现教育对50岁以上的欧洲男性和女性具有保护作用。研究发现，健康行为（如吸烟、饮酒、锻炼和体重指数）在短期内对教育对健康的整体效应贡献约为四分之一，在长期内则约为三分之一。

abstract.text: Assuming symmetric information, we show that a high-deductible health plan (HDHP) combined with a tax-favored health savings account (HSA) induces more savings and less treatment compared with a full coverage plan under reasonable risk preferences. Furthermore, a higher tax subsidy increases savings in any case but decreases medical utilization if and only if treatment expenses are above the deductible. A larger deductible increases savings but does not necessarily decrease healthcare utilization. Whether an HDHP/HSA combination is preferred over a full coverage contract depends on absolute risk aversion. A higher tax advantage increases the attractiveness of an HDHP/HSA combination, whereas the effects of changes in the deductible are ambiguous. The paper shows that a potential regulator needs to carefully set the size of the deductible as only in a certain corridor of the probability of sickness, its effect on aggregate healthcare costs are unambiguously favorable.

10.1002/hec.3142.abstractZh: 在假设信息对称的情况下，我们表明，与全额覆盖计划相比，高免赔额健康计划结合税收优惠的健康储蓄账户能够促使人们进行更多的储蓄，并减少医疗支出，前提是风险偏好合理。此外，更高的税收补贴在任何情况下都会增加储蓄，但只有当治疗费用超过免赔额时，才会减少医疗使用。较高的免赔额会增加储蓄，但未必会减少医疗使用。是否更倾向于选择高免赔额健康计划结合健康储蓄账户，取决于绝对风险厌恶程度。更高的税收优势会增加高免赔额健康计划结合健康储蓄账户的吸引力，而免赔额变化的影响则不明确。本文指出，潜在的监管机构需要仔细设定免赔额的大小，因为只有在某些疾病发生概率的区间内，其对总体医疗成本的影响才是明确有利的。

abstract.text: We examine the influence of harmful alcohol use on mental health using a flexible two-step instrumental variables approach and household survey data from nine countries of the former Soviet Union. Using alcohol advertisements to instrument for alcohol, we show that problem drinking has a large detrimental effect on psychological distress, with problem drinkers exhibiting a 42% increase in the number of mental health problems reported and a 15% higher chance of reporting very poor mental health. Ignoring endogeneity leads to an underestimation of the damaging effect of excessive drinking. Findings suggest that more effective alcohol policies and treatment services in the former Soviet Union may have added benefits in terms of reducing poor mental health.

10.1002/hec.3143.abstractZh: 我们采用灵活的两步工具变量方法，利用前苏联九个国家的家庭调查数据，研究有害饮酒对心理健康的影响。通过以酒精广告作为工具变量，我们发现问题饮酒对心理困扰有显著的负面影响：问题饮酒者报告的心理健康问题数量增加了42%，同时出现非常严重的心理健康问题的概率也上升了15%。忽略内生性问题会导致对过度饮酒造成的损害效应的低估。研究结果表明，在前苏联，更有效的酒精政策和治疗服务可能在减少不良心理健康方面具有额外的益处。

abstract.text: While US infant immunization rates have been increasing in the last 20 years, the cost of fully immunizing a child with all recommended vaccines has almost tripled. This is partly not only due to new additions in the list of recommended vaccines but also due to the use of new, safer, but more expensive technologies in vaccine production and distribution. In recent years, many states have mandated that recommended childhood vaccines be covered by private health insurance companies. Currently, there are 33 states with such a mandate. In this paper, I examine whether the introduction of mandates on private insurers affected immunization rates. Using state and time variation, I find that mandates increased the immunization rate for three vaccines--the diphtheria-tetanus-pertussis, polio, and measles-mumps-rubella vaccines--by about 1.8 percentage points. These results may provide a lower bound for the expected effect of the Affordable Care Act, which mandates coverage of childhood vaccines for all private insurers in the USA. I also find evidence that the mandates shifted a significant portion of vaccinations from publicly funded sources to private ones, with a decline in public health clinic visits and an increase in vaccinations at hospitals and doctor's offices.

10.1002/hec.3153.abstractZh: 在过去20年里，美国的婴儿免疫接种率一直在上升，但为所有推荐疫苗为儿童提供免疫接种的成本却几乎增加了两倍。这一变化不仅是由于推荐疫苗清单中新增了疫苗，还因为疫苗生产和分发过程中使用了更先进、更安全的技术，但这些技术成本更高。近年来，许多州规定私人健康保险公司必须提供推荐的儿童疫苗。目前，有33个州有这样的规定。本文探讨了强制要求私人保险公司提供疫苗是否影响了免疫接种率。通过对比各州的数据和时间变化，我发现这些规定使三种疫苗的免疫接种率分别提高了约1.8个百分点——分别是白喉-破伤风-百日咳疫苗、脊髓灰质炎疫苗以及麻疹-腮腺炎-风疹疫苗。这些结果可能为《平价医疗法案》所预期的效果提供了一个下限，该法案要求美国所有私人保险公司都必须提供儿童疫苗。我还发现，这些规定导致大量疫苗接种从公共资金支持的来源转移到了私人机构，同时公共健康诊所的就诊次数减少，而医院和诊所的疫苗接种次数则有所增加。

abstract.text: Background and objectives The Dutch healthcare system is in transition towards managed competition. In theory, a system of managed competition involves incentives for quality and efficiency of provided care. This is mainly because health insurers contract on behalf of their clients with healthcare providers on, potentially, quality and costs. The paper develops a strategy to comprehensively analyse available multidimensional data on quality and costs to assess and report on the relative performance of healthcare providers within managed competition. Data and methods We had access to individual information on 2409 clients of 19 Dutch diabetes care groups on a broad range of (outcome and process related) quality and cost indicators. We carried out a cost-consequences analysis and corrected for differences in case mix to reduce incentives for risk selection by healthcare providers. Results and conclusion There is substantial heterogeneity between diabetes care groups' performances as measured using multidimensional indicators on quality and costs. Better quality diabetes care can be achieved with lower or higher costs. Routine monitoring using multidimensional data on quality and costs merged at the individual level would allow a systematic and comprehensive analysis of healthcare providers' performances within managed competition.

10.1002/hec.3158.abstractZh:
背景与目的  
荷兰的医疗保健体系正在向管理式竞争转型。理论上，管理式竞争机制通过激励措施来促进医疗服务在质量和效率方面的提升。这主要是因为健康保险公司代表其客户与医疗服务提供者进行合作，涉及质量和成本方面的考量。本文提出了一种策略，通过综合分析关于质量和成本的多维数据，来评估和管理式竞争环境下医疗服务提供者的表现。  

数据与方法  
我们获得了19个荷兰糖尿病护理团体中2409名客户的个人信息，这些信息涵盖了多种与质量和成本相关的指标。我们进行了成本-后果分析，并调整了病例组合的差异，以减少医疗服务提供者选择风险的动机。  

结果与结论  
使用多维指标衡量时，不同糖尿病护理团体的表现存在显著差异。通过降低或提高成本，可以实现更高质量的糖尿病护理服务。通过结合使用多维数据和个体层面的常规监测，可以系统且全面地分析管理式竞争环境下医疗服务提供者的表现。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the effect of expansion to near-universal health insurance coverage in Massachusetts on breast and cervical cancer screening. We use data from 2002 to 2010 to compare changes in receipt of mammograms and Pap tests in Massachusetts relative to other New England states. We also consider the effect specifically among low-income women. We find positive effects of Massachusetts health reform on cancer screening, suggesting a 4 to 5% increase in mammograms and 6 to 7% increase in Pap tests annually. Increases in both breast and cervical cancer screening are larger 3 years after the implementation of reform than in the year immediately following, suggesting that there may be an adjustment or learning period. Low-income women experience greater increases in breast and cervical cancer screening than the overall population; among women with household income less than 250% of the federal poverty level, mammograms increase by approximately 8% and Pap tests by 9%. Overall, Massachusetts health reform appears to have increased breast and cervical cancer screening, particularly among low-income women. Our results suggest that reform was successful in promoting preventive care among targeted populations.

10.1002/hec.3159.abstractZh: 本文研究了马萨诸塞州将医疗保险覆盖范围扩大到近乎全民水平对乳腺癌和宫颈癌筛查的影响。我们使用2002至2010年的数据，比较了马萨诸塞州与其他新英格兰州在乳腺X光检查和宫颈涂片检查接受率方面的变化。我们还特别考虑了低收入女性所受的影响。研究发现，马萨诸塞州的医疗改革对癌症筛查产生了积极影响，每年乳腺X光检查的数量增加了4%至5%，宫颈涂片检查的数量增加了6%至7%。改革实施三年后，乳腺癌和宫颈癌筛查的增加幅度比改革实施当年更大，这表明可能存在一个调整或学习期。低收入女性的乳腺癌和宫颈癌筛查接受率增加幅度大于整体人口；家庭收入低于联邦贫困线250%的女性，乳腺X光检查的数量增加了约8%，宫颈涂片检查的数量增加了9%。总体而言，马萨诸塞州的医疗改革似乎提高了乳腺癌和宫颈癌的筛查率，尤其是在低收入女性中。我们的研究结果表明，这项改革在促进目标人群的预防性护理方面是成功的。

abstract.text: Multiple parties influence the choice of facility for hospital-based inpatient and outpatient services. The patient is the central figure, but their choice of facility is guided by their physician and influenced by hospital characteristics. This study estimated changes in referral patterns for inpatient admissions and outpatient diagnostic imaging associated with changes in ownership of three multispecialty clinic systems headquartered in Minneapolis-St. Paul, MN. These clinic systems were acquired by two hospital-owned integrated delivery systems (IDSs) in 2007, increasing the probability that hospital preferences influenced physician guidance on facility choice. We used a longitudinal dataset that allowed us to predict changes in referral patterns, controlling for health plan enrollee, coverage, and clinic system characteristics. The results are an important empirical contribution to the literature examining the impact of hospital ownership on location of service. When this change in ownership forged new relationships, there was a significant reduction in the use of facilities historically selected for inpatient admissions and outpatient imaging and an increase in the use of the acquiring IDS's facilities. These changes were weaker in the IDS acquiring two clinic systems, suggesting that management of multiple acquisitions simultaneously may impact the ability of the IDS to build strong referral relationships.

10.1002/hec.3160.abstractZh: 多个因素影响着医院内住院和门诊服务的设施选择。患者是核心人物，但他们的设施选择受到医生的指导，并受到医院特性的影响。本研究通过估算 Minneapolis-St. Paul 地区三家多专科诊所系统所有权变更对住院治疗和门诊诊断影像服务转诊模式的影响，来探讨医院所有权变化对设施选择的影响。这些诊所系统在2007年被两家医院拥有的综合交付系统收购，这增加了医院偏好对医生设施选择指导的影响。我们使用了纵向数据集，能够预测转诊模式的变化，同时控制了健康计划参保者、覆盖范围以及诊所系统的特征。研究结果表明，医院所有权变化对服务地点选择具有重要影响。当所有权变更形成新的关系时，历史上用于住院治疗和门诊影像服务的设施使用量显著减少，而收购方综合交付系统的设施使用量则有所增加。在收购两家诊所系统的综合交付系统中，这种变化较为微弱，这表明同时处理多笔收购可能影响到综合交付系统建立稳固转诊关系的能力。

abstract.text: In this study, we use the Health and Retirement Study to test whether older adult smokers, defined as those 50 years and older, respond to cigarette tax increases. Our preferred specifications show that older adult smokers respond modestly to tax increases: a $1.00 (131.6%) tax increase leads to a 3.8-5.2% reduction in cigarettes smoked per day (implied tax elasticity = -0.03 to -0.04). We identify heterogeneity in tax elasticity across demographic groups as defined by sex, race/ethnicity, education, and marital status and by smoking intensity and level of addictive stock. These findings have implications for public health policy implementation in an aging population.

10.1002/hec.3161.abstractZh: 在本研究中，我们采用“健康与退休研究”数据来检验50岁及以上的老年吸烟者对香烟税增加的反应。我们的分析结果显示，老年吸烟者对税收增加的反应较为温和：香烟税增加1美元（131.6%）会导致每天吸烟量减少3.8%至5.2%（隐含税收弹性为-0.03至-0.04）。我们还发现，不同人口群体在税收弹性上存在差异，这些差异由性别、种族/民族、教育程度、婚姻状况以及吸烟强度和成瘾程度等因素决定。这些发现对老龄化人口公共卫生政策的实施具有参考价值。

abstract.text: There has been a debate on whether cost-effectiveness analysis should consider the cost of consumption and leisure time activities when using the quality-adjusted life year as a measure of health outcome under a societal perspective. The purpose of this study was to investigate whether the effects of ill health on consumptive activities are spontaneously considered in a health state valuation exercise and how much this matters. The survey enrolled patients with inflammatory bowel disease in Germany (n = 104). Patients were randomized to explicit and no explicit instruction for the consideration of consumption and leisure effects in a time trade-off (TTO) exercise. Explicit instruction to consider non-health-related utility in TTO exercises did not influence TTO scores. However, spontaneous consideration of non-health-related utility in patients without explicit instruction (60% of respondents) led to significantly lower TTO scores. Results suggest an inclusion of consumption costs in the numerator of the cost-effectiveness ratio, at least for those respondents who spontaneously consider non-health-related utility from treatment. Results also suggest that exercises eliciting health valuations from the general public may include a description of the impact of disease on consumptive activities.

10.1002/hec.3162.abstractZh: 关于在采用质量调整生命年作为健康结果衡量指标时，成本效益分析是否应考虑消费和休闲活动的成本，一直存在争议。本研究的目的是探讨在健康状态评估中，是否会自动考虑健康状况对消费活动的影响，以及这种考虑的重要性。研究招募了德国患有炎症性肠病的患者（共104名）。患者被随机分为两组，一组接受明确指导，另一组未接受明确指导，以评估他们在时间权衡中对消费和休闲活动的考虑。接受明确指导以在时间权衡中考虑非健康相关效用的患者，其时间权衡得分并未受到影响。然而，在没有明确指导的情况下，自发考虑非健康相关效用的患者（占受访者的60%）导致其时间权衡得分显著降低。研究结果表明，至少对于那些自发考虑治疗带来的非健康相关效用的受访者来说，将消费成本纳入成本效益比率的分子中是有意义的。研究结果还表明，从公众那里获取健康评估的练习中，可能会包含对疾病对消费活动影响的描述。

abstract.text: Half of all pregnancies in the USA are unintended, suggesting a high incidence of either improper or nonuse of contraceptives. Emergency birth control (EBC) provides individuals with additional insurance against unplanned pregnancy in the presence of contraception failure. This study is the first to estimate the impact of switching EBC from prescription to nonprescription status in the USA on abortions and risky sexual behavior as measured by STD rates. Utilizing state-level variation in access to EBC, we find that providing individuals with over-the-counter access to EBC leads to increase STD rates and has no effect on abortion rates. Moreover, individual-level analysis using the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth indicates that risky sexual behavior such as engaging in unprotected sex and number of sexual encounters increases as a result of over-the-counter access to EBC, which is consistent with the state-level STD findings.

10.1002/hec.3163.abstractZh: 在美国，一半的妊娠都是非计划性的，这表明避孕措施使用不当或未被使用的情况较为普遍。紧急避孕措施为在避孕失败的情况下避免意外妊娠提供了额外的保障。本研究首次估算了在美国将紧急避孕措施从处方药转为非处方药对堕胎率和危险性行为的影响，后者通过性传播疾病的发生率来衡量。通过利用各州在紧急避孕措施获取方面的差异，我们发现向个人提供非处方紧急避孕措施会导致性传播疾病发生率上升，但对堕胎率没有影响。此外，根据全国青年纵向调查的数据，使用非处方紧急避孕措施会导致危险性行为增加，如无保护性行为次数和性伴侣数量的增加，这与各州的性传播疾病调查结果一致。

abstract.text: A number of state Medicaid programs have recently proposed or implemented new or increased copayments for nonemergent emergency department (ED) visits. Evidence suggests that copayments generally reduce the level of healthcare utilization, although there is little specific evidence regarding the effectiveness of copayments in reducing nonurgent ED use among Medicaid enrollees or other low-income populations. Encouraging efficient and appropriate use of healthcare services will be of particular importance for Medicaid programs as they expand under the Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act. This analysis uses national data from 2001 to 2009 to examine the effect of copayments on nonurgent ED utilization among nonelderly adult enrollees. We find that visits among Medicaid enrollees in state-years where a copayment is in place are significantly less likely to be for nonurgent reasons. Our findings suggest that copayments may be an effective tool for reducing use of the ED for nonurgent care.

10.1002/hec.3164.abstractZh: 一些州级医疗补助计划最近提出了或实施了针对非紧急急诊就诊的新增或提高的共付额。有证据表明，共付额通常会降低医疗服务的利用程度，但关于共付额在减少医疗补助参保者或其他低收入人群的非紧急急诊就诊方面的效果，目前缺乏具体的研究数据。随着《患者保护与平价医疗法案》的实施，鼓励医疗服务的有效和合理使用对于医疗补助计划来说尤为重要。本研究利用2001至2009年的全国数据，考察了共付额对非老年成人参保者非紧急急诊就诊的影响。研究发现，在实行共付额的州年度中，参保者的非紧急就诊可能性显著降低。我们的研究结果表明，共付额可能是减少非紧急急诊就诊的有效手段。

abstract.text: The main objective of this study was to compare and contrast adolescent and adult values for the Child Health Utility-9D (CHU9D), a new generic preference-based measure of health-related quality of life designed for application in the economic evaluation of treatment and preventive programmes for children and adolescents. Previous studies have indicated that there may be systematic differences in adolescent and adult values for identical health states. An online survey including a series of best-worst scaling discrete choice experiment questions for health states defined by the CHU9D was administered to two general population samples comprising adults and adolescents, respectively. The results highlight potentially important age-related differences in the values attached to CHU9D dimensions. Adults, in general, placed less weight upon impairments in mental health (worried, sad, annoyed) and more weight upon moderate to severe levels of pain relative to adolescents. The source of values (adults or adolescents) has important implications for economic evaluation and may impact significantly upon healthcare policy.

10.1002/hec.3165.abstractZh: 本研究的主要目标是比较和对比青少年与成人在Child Health Utility-9D（CHU9D）价值观上的差异。CHU9D是一种新的基于偏好度的健康相关生活质量衡量指标，适用于儿童和青少年治疗和预防项目的经济评估。先前的研究表明，对于相同的健康状态，青少年与成人在价值观上可能存在系统性差异。本研究通过在线调查的方式，针对由CHU9D定义的多个健康状态，设计了系列最佳-最差离散选择实验问题，分别针对成人和青少年样本进行调研。研究结果表明，成人在对CHU9D各维度的价值观评估上，对心理健康方面的损害（如担忧、悲伤、烦躁等）的权重较低，而对中度至重度疼痛的权重则较高。价值观的来源（成人或青少年）对经济评估具有重要影响，并可能对医疗保健政策产生显著影响。

abstract.text: This paper investigates whether self-rated health (SRH) covaries with individual hospital records. By linking the Danish Longitudinal Survey on Ageing with individual hospital records covering all hospital admissions from 1995 to 2006, I show that SRH is correlated to historical, current, and future hospital records. I use both measures separately to control for health in a regression of mortality on wealth. Using only historical and current hospitalization controls for health yields the common result that SRH is a stronger predictor of mortality than objective health measures. The addition of future hospitalizations as controls shows that the estimated gradient on wealth is similar to one in which SRH is the control. The results suggest that with a sufficiently long time series of individual records, objective health measures can predict mortality to the same extent as global self-rated measures.

10.1002/hec.3167.abstractZh: 本文探讨了自我健康评估（SRH）是否与个人医院记录存在共变关系。通过结合丹麦老龄化纵向调查与1995至2006年间所有个人医院记录，我发现SRH与历史、当前及未来的医院记录存在相关性。在死亡率与财富关系的回归分析中，我们分别使用这两种指标来控制健康状况。仅使用历史与当前的住院记录作为控制变量时，结果表明SRH作为控制变量对死亡率的预测能力更强。而将未来住院情况也作为控制变量后，发现财富对死亡率的影响程度与SRH作为控制变量时相似。研究结果表明，在拥有足够长的个人记录时间序列的情况下，客观健康指标对死亡率的预测能力与全球自我健康评估指标相当。

abstract.text: This paper assesses the causal impact on child health of borrowing formal microcredit for Chinese rural households by exploiting a panel dataset (2000 and 2004) in a poor northwest province. Endogenous borrowing is controlled for in a dynamic regression-discontinuity design creating a quasi-experimental environment for causal inferences. There is causal relationship running from formal microcredit to improved child health in the short term, while past borrowing behaviour has no protracted impact on subsequent child health outcomes. Moreover, formal microcredit appears to be a complement to health insurance in improving child health through two mechanisms-it enhances affordability for out-of-pocket health care expenditure and helps buffer consumption against adverse health shocks and financial risk incurred by current health insurance arrangements. Government efforts in expanding health insurance for rural households would be more likely to achieve its optimal goals of improving child health outcomes if combined with sufficient access to formal microcredit.

10.1002/hec.3168.abstractZh: 本文通过利用一个贫困西北省份的面板数据集（2000年和2004年数据），评估了农村家庭借用正规微型信贷对儿童健康的因果影响。在动态回归-不连续设计中对内生借贷因素进行了控制，从而创造了一个适合进行因果推断的准实验环境。研究发现，正规微型信贷在短期内能够改善儿童健康，而过去的借贷行为对后续儿童健康结果没有长期影响。此外，正规微型信贷似乎通过两种机制补充了健康保险在改善儿童健康方面的作用：一是提高了个人医疗支出的可负担性，二是帮助缓冲因健康冲击和当前健康保险安排带来的财务风险。如果政府努力扩大农村家庭的健康保险覆盖，并同时提供充足的正规微型信贷，那么其改善儿童健康结果的目标更有可能实现。

abstract.text: Pay-for-performance (P4P) is a widely implemented quality improvement strategy in health care that has generated much enthusiasm, but only limited empirical evidence to support its effectiveness. Researchers have speculated that flawed program designs or weak financial incentives may be to blame, but the reason for P4P's limited success may be more fundamental. When P4P rewards multiple services, it creates a special case of the well-known multitasking problem, where incentives to increase some rewarded activities are blunted by countervailing incentives to focus on other rewarded activities: these incentives may cancel each other out with little net effect on quality. This paper analyzes the comparative statics of a P4P model to show that when P4P rewards multiple services in a setting of multitasking and joint production, the change in both rewarded and unrewarded services is generally ambiguous. This result contrasts with the commonly held intuition that P4P should increase rewarded activities.

10.1002/hec.3169.abstractZh: 绩效付费（P4P）是医疗保健领域广泛采用的一种质量改进策略，它引发了大量热情，但支持其有效性的实证证据却十分有限。研究人员推测，可能存在程序设计缺陷或财务激励不足的问题，但P4P成效有限的原因可能更为根本。当P4P对多种服务进行奖励时，就会出现众所周知的多任务处理问题：某些被奖励活动的激励作用会被其他被奖励活动的相反激励所抵消，这些因素可能会相互抵消，对服务质量几乎没有实际影响。本文通过分析P4P模型的比较静态结果，发现当在多任务处理和联合生产的背景下对多种服务进行奖励时，被奖励和未被奖励的服务变化通常是不明确的。这一结果与人们普遍认为的P4P应增加被奖励活动的观点相悖。

abstract.text: The sector wide approach (SWAp) emerged during the 1990s as a mechanism for managing aid from the multiplicity of development partners that operate in the recipient country's health, education or agricultural sectors. Health SWAps aim to give increased control to recipient governments, allowing greater domestic influence over how health aid is allocated and facilitating allocative efficiency gains. This paper assesses whether health SWAps have increased recipient control of health aid via increased general sector-support and have facilitated (re)allocations of health aid across disease areas. Using a uniquely compiled panel data set of countries receiving development assistance for health over the period 1990-2010, we employ fixed effects and dynamic panel models to assess the impact of introducing a health SWAp on levels of general sector-support for health and allocations of health-sector aid across key funding silos (including HIV, 'maternal and child health' and 'sector-support'). Our results suggest that health SWAps have influenced health-sector aid flows in a manner consistent with increased recipient control and improvements in allocative efficiency.

10.1002/hec.3170.abstractZh: 全行业方法（SWAp）在20世纪90年代出现，作为一种管理来自多个发展伙伴在受援国卫生、教育或农业领域提供的援助的机制。卫生领域的全行业方法旨在增强受援政府的控制能力，使它们在卫生援助的分配上拥有更大的国内影响力，从而提高分配效率。本文评估了卫生领域的全行业方法是否通过增加整体行业支持来增强受援国对卫生援助的控制能力，并是否促进了卫生援助在不同疾病领域的重新分配。我们利用1990年至2010年间接受卫生发展援助国家的独特面板数据集，采用固定效应和动态面板模型来评估引入卫生全行业方法对整体行业支持水平以及卫生部门援助在不同资金领域（包括艾滋病、母婴健康和行业支持）的分配情况的影响。我们的研究结果表明，卫生领域的全行业方法确实增强了受援国对卫生部门援助的控制能力，并提升了分配效率。

abstract.text: We investigate whether the modern management practices and publicly reported performance measures are associated with choice of hospital for patients with acute myocardial infarction (AMI). We define and measure management practices at approximately half of US cardiac care units using a novel survey approach. A patient's choice of a hospital is modeled as a function of the hospital's performance on publicly reported quality measures and the quality of its management. The estimates, based on a grouped conditional logit specification, reveal that higher management scores and better performance on publicly reported quality measures are positively associated with hospital choice. Management practices appear to have a direct correlation with admissions for AMI--potentially through reputational effects--and indirect association, through better performance on publicly reported measures. Overall, a one standard deviation change in management practice scores is associated with an 8% increase in AMI admissions.

10.1002/hec.3171.abstractZh: 我们研究了现代管理实践和公开报告的性能指标是否与急性心肌梗塞患者选择医院的行为有关。我们采用一种新的调查方法，对大约一半的美国心脏护理单位的管理实践进行了定义和测量。患者选择医院的行为被建模为医院在公开报告的质量指标上的表现以及其管理质量的函数。基于分组条件逻辑斯蒂模型的估计结果显示，较高的管理评分和更好的公开报告质量指标表现与医院选择呈正相关。管理实践似乎与急性心肌梗塞的入院率有直接关联——可能是通过声誉效应实现的——同时也通过更好的公开报告指标表现产生间接影响。总体而言，管理实践评分的标准差变化与急性心肌梗塞入院率增加8%相关。

abstract.text: Patient-reported outcome measures (PROMs) are now routinely collected in the English National Health Service and used to compare and reward hospital performance within a high-powered pay-for-performance scheme. However, PROMs are prone to missing data. For example, hospitals often fail to administer the pre-operative questionnaire at hospital admission, or patients may refuse to participate or fail to return their post-operative questionnaire. A key concern with missing PROMs is that the individuals with complete information tend to be an unrepresentative sample of patients within each provider and inferences based on the complete cases will be misleading. This study proposes a strategy for addressing missing data in the English PROM survey using multiple imputation techniques and investigates its impact on assessing provider performance. We find that inferences about relative provider performance are sensitive to the assumptions made about the reasons for the missing data.

10.1002/hec.3173.abstractZh: 患者报告的结局指标（PROMs）现在被常规收集于英国国家医疗服务体系，并用于比较和奖励医院的绩效表现，这是一项以绩效为奖励机制的制度。然而，PROMs存在数据缺失的问题。例如，医院往往未能在患者入院时完成术前问卷的填写，或者患者可能拒绝参与或未能返回术后问卷。数据缺失的一个主要问题是，那些拥有完整信息的个体往往不能代表所有患者，因此基于完整数据所做的推断可能会具有误导性。本研究提出了一种利用多重插补技术解决英国PROM调查数据缺失问题的策略，并探讨了其对评估医院绩效的影响。我们发现，关于医院绩效的相对评估结果会受到关于数据缺失原因假设的影响。

abstract.text: A soft budget constraint arises when a government is unable to commit to not 'bailout' a public hospital if the public hospital exhausts its budget before the end of the budget period. It is shown that if the political costs of a 'bailout' are relatively small, then the public hospital exhausts the welfare-maximising budget before the end of the budget period and a 'bailout' occurs. In anticipation, the government offers a budget to the public hospital that may be greater than or less than the welfare-maximising budget. In either case, the public hospital treats 'too many' elective patients before the 'bailout' and 'too few' after. The introduction of a private hospital reduces the size of any 'bailout' and increases welfare.

10.1002/hec.3174.abstractZh: 当政府无法承诺在公立医院在预算期结束前耗尽预算时，不对其进行“救助”的软性预算约束便会出现。研究表明，如果“救助”的政治成本相对较低，那么公立医院会在预算期结束前耗尽能够实现福利最大化的预算，从而导致“救助”的发生。为此，政府会向公立医院提供可能高于或低于实现福利最大化的预算。无论哪种情况，公立医院在“救助”前都会治疗“过多”的择期病人，而在“救助”后则会治疗“过少”的择期病人。引入私立医院可以减少“救助”的规模，并提高福利水平。

abstract.text: A majority of married couples in the USA take advantage of the fact that employers often provide health insurance coverage to spouses. When older spouses become eligible for Medicare, however, many of them can no longer provide their younger spouses with coverage. In this paper, we study how spousal eligibility for Medicare affects the health insurance and health care access of younger spouses. We find that spousal eligibility for Medicare results in younger spouses no longer having employers pay for their insurance and being less likely to have employer-sponsored coverage. Instead, younger spouses switch to privately purchased coverage, which tends to be worse than what they had before their spouses became eligible for Medicare. We also find suggestive evidence that younger spouses are less likely to use health care services after their older spouses become eligible for Medicare.

10.1002/hec.3175.abstractZh: 在美国，大多数已婚夫妇利用了雇主通常为配偶提供健康保险这一事实。然而，当年长的配偶有资格享受医疗保险时，许多年长的配偶就无法再为年轻的配偶提供保险。本文研究了配偶有资格享受医疗保险对年轻配偶的健康保险和医疗服务的获取有何影响。我们发现，配偶有资格享受医疗保险后，年轻配偶不再有雇主支付保险费用的情况，且获得雇主赞助的保险的可能性也降低。相反，年轻配偶转而选择私人购买的保险，而这类保险往往比他们在配偶有资格享受医疗保险之前的情况要差。我们还发现了一些有启发性的证据，表明在年长配偶有资格享受医疗保险后，年轻配偶使用医疗服务的可能性降低。

abstract.text: Prescription drugs are the third largest component of U.S. healthcare expenditures. The 2006 Medicare Part D and the 2010 Affordable Care Act are catalysts for further growths in utilization becuase of insurance expansion effects. This research investigating the determinants of prescription drug utilization is timely, methodologically novel, and policy relevant. Differences in population health status, access to care, socioeconomics, demographics, and variations in per capita number of scripts filled at retail pharmacies across the U.S.A. justify fitting separate econometric models to county data of the states partitioned into low, medium, and high prescription drug users. Given the skewed distribution of per capita number of filled prescriptions (response variable), we fit the variance stabilizing Box-Cox power transformation regression models to 2011 county level data for investigating the correlates of prescription drug utilization separately for low, medium, and high utilization states. Maximum likelihood regression parameter estimates, including the optimal Box-Cox λ power transformations, differ across high (λ = 0.214), medium (λ = 0.942), and low (λ = 0.302) prescription drug utilization models. The estimated income elasticities of -0.634, 0.031, and -0.532 in high, medium, and low utilization models suggest that the economic behavior of prescriptions is not invariant across different utilization levels.

10.1002/hec.3176.abstractZh: 处方药是美国医疗保健支出的第三大组成部分。2006年的《医疗保险部分D》和2010年的《平价医疗法案》由于保险覆盖范围的扩大，进一步促进了处方药的使用。本研究对处方药物使用的决定因素进行探讨，具有及时性、方法上的创新性，并且对政策具有相关性。美国各地人口健康状况、就医机会、社会经济状况、人口统计特征以及零售药店中人均处方数量的变化，都表明有必要为各州的县级数据分别构建计量经济模型，以区分低、中、高处方药物使用状态。鉴于人均处方数量分布的偏斜性，我们对2011年县级数据进行了方差稳定化的Box-Cox幂变换回归分析，以分别研究低、中、高处方药物使用状态的处方药物使用相关因素。最大似然回归参数估计值，包括最优的Box-Cox λ幂变换，在不同使用水平的模型中有所不同：高使用模型为λ=0.214，中等级为λ=0.942，低等级为λ=0.302。估计出的收入弹性分别为-0.634、0.031和-0.532，这表明处方药物使用的经济行为在不同使用水平下并不一致。

abstract.text: Financial relationships between physicians and industry are vital to biomedical innovation yet create the potential for conflicts of interest in medical practice. I consider an inducement model of the role of financial relationships in health care markets, where consulting payments induce physicians to use more devices of the firms that sponsor them. To test the model, I exploit a policy shock, whereby government monitoring of payments to joint replacement surgeons resulted in declines of over 60% in both total payments and in the number of physicians receiving payments from 2007 to 2008. Using hospital discharge data from three states, I find that the loss of payments leads physicians to switch 7 percentage points of their device utilization from their sponsoring firms' devices to other firms' devices, an effect which is concentrated among surgeons with low switching costs. These results offer support for the inducement model. I also find evidence of an increase in medical productivity following the policy intervention, which suggests conditions under which regulation of financial relationships would be socially beneficial.

10.1002/hec.3177.abstractZh: 医生与行业之间的财务关系对生物医学创新至关重要，但同时也可能引发医疗实践中的利益冲突。我提出了一个关于财务关系在医疗市场中作用的诱导模型，即咨询费用会促使医生更多地使用赞助公司的设备。为了验证这一模型，我利用了一个政策冲击作为实验条件：政府对关节置换手术医生的支付进行监管后，从2007年到2008年，总支付金额和接受支付费用的医生数量均下降了60%以上。通过三个州的医院出院数据，我发现支付费用的取消导致医生将其设备使用的比例从赞助公司的设备转向其他公司的设备，这一效应主要集中在转换成本较低的手术医生身上。这些结果支持了诱导模型。我还发现，政策干预后医疗生产力有所提高，这表明在何种情况下对财务关系进行监管会具有社会效益。

abstract.text: Many publicly funded health systems use activity-based financing to increase hospital production and efficiency. The aim of this study is to investigate whether price changes for different treatments affect the number of patients treated and the mix of activity provided by hospitals. We exploit the variations in prices created by the changes in the national average treatment cost per diagnosis-related group (DRG) offered to Norwegian hospitals over a period of 5 years (2003-2007). We use the data from Norwegian Patient Register, containing individual-level information on age, gender, type of treatment, diagnosis, number of co-morbidities and the national average treatment costs per DRG. We employ fixed-effect models to examine the changes in the number of patients treated within the DRGs over time. The results suggest that a 10% increase in price leads to about 0.8-1.3% increase in the number of patients treated for DRGs, which are medical (for both emergency and elective patients). In contrast, we find no price effect for DRGs that are surgical (for both emergency and elective patients). Moreover, we find evidence of upcoding. A 10% increase in the ratio of prices between patients with and without complications increases the proportion of patients coded with complications by 0.3-0.4 percentage points.

10.1002/hec.3179.abstractZh: 许多公共资助的卫生系统采用基于活动的融资方式来提高医院的生产效率和效益。本研究的目的是探讨不同治疗方法的价格变化是否会影响接受治疗的病人数量以及医院提供的服务种类。我们利用了5年（2003-2007年）期间挪威医院每个诊断相关组的平均治疗成本变化所导致的价格差异。我们参考了挪威患者登记数据，该数据包含了患者的年龄、性别、治疗类型、诊断结果、合并症数量以及每个诊断相关组的平均治疗成本等个体信息。我们使用固定效应模型来分析这些诊断相关组中接受治疗的病人数量随时间的变化情况。研究结果表明，价格上涨10%会导致医疗类诊断相关组接受治疗的病人数量增加约0.8-1.3%，无论是急诊还是择期手术的患者。相比之下，对于手术类诊断相关组，则未发现价格效应的影响。此外，我们还发现了编码过度的情况：患者是否有并发症，其价格比例每提高10%，被编码为有并发症的患者比例会相应增加0.3-0.4个百分点。

abstract.text: Reference pricing (RP) theories predict different outcomes when reference prices are fixed (exogenous) versus being a function of market prices (MPs) (endogenous). Exogenous RP results in MPs at both high-price and low-price firms converging towards the reference price from above and below, respectively. Endogenous RP results in MPs at both high-price and low-price firms decreasing, with low-price firms acting strategically to decrease the reference price in order to gain market share. We extend these models to a hospital context focusing on insurer and consumer payments. Under exogenous RP, insurer and consumer payments to low-price hospitals increase, and insurer payments to high-price hospitals decrease, but predictions regarding consumer payments are ambiguous for high-price hospitals. Under endogenous RP, insurer payments to high-price and low-price hospitals decrease, and consumer payments to low-price hospitals decrease, but predictions regarding consumer payments are ambiguous for high-price hospitals. We test these predictions with difference-in-differences specifications using 2008-2013 data on patients undergoing joint replacement. For 2 years following RP implementation, insurer payments to high-price and low-price hospitals moved downward, consistent with endogenous RP. However, when the reference price was not reset to account for changes in MPs, insurer payments to low-price hospitals reverted to pre-implementation levels, consistent with exogenous RP.

10.1002/hec.3181.abstractZh: 参考定价理论预测，当参考价格固定（外生）与作为市场价格的函数（内生）时，结果会有所不同。外生参考定价会导致高价和低价企业的市场价格分别向参考价格的上方和下方趋同。内生参考定价则会导致高价和低价企业的市场价格下降，其中低价企业会采取策略性行动来降低参考价格以争取市场份额。我们将这些模型扩展到医院领域，重点关注保险公司和消费者的支付情况。在外生参考定价下，保险公司和消费者对低价医院的支付增加，而对高价医院的支付减少；但对于高价医院来说，关于消费者支付的预测则不明确。在内生参考定价下，保险公司对高价和低价医院的支付都减少，消费者对低价医院的支付也减少，但对于高价医院来说，关于消费者支付的预测同样不明确。我们使用2008-2013年的关节置换患者数据，通过差异-差异模型检验了这些预测。在参考定价实施后的两年里，保险公司对高价和低价医院的支付都下降，这与内生参考定价相符。然而，当参考价格没有根据市场价格的变化进行重置时，保险公司对低价医院的支付又回到了实施前的水平，这与外生参考定价相符。

abstract.text: This paper examines the impact of coinsurance exemption for prescription medicines applied to elderly individuals in Spain after retirement. We use a rich administrative dataset that links pharmaceutical consumption and hospital discharge records for the full population aged 58 to 65 years in January 2004 covered by the public insurer in a Spanish region, and we follow them until December 2006. We use a difference-in-differences strategy and exploit the eligibility age for Social Security to control for the endogeneity of the retirement decision. Our results show that this uniform exemption increases the consumption of prescription medicines on average by 17.5%, total pharmaceutical expenditure by 25% and the costs borne by the insurer by 60.4%, without evidence of any offset effect in the form of lower short term probability of hospitalization. The impact is concentrated among consumers of medicines for acute and other non-chronic diseases whose previous coinsurance rate was 30% to 40%.

10.1002/hec.3182.abstractZh: 本文研究了西班牙老年人退休后处方药的共保豁免政策对其消费的影响。我们使用了丰富的行政数据集，该数据集记录了2004年1月西班牙某地区公共保险公司覆盖的58至65岁人群的药物消费和出院记录，并跟踪他们直至2006年12月。我们采用差异-差异策略，并利用社会保障的资格年龄来控制退休决策的内生性。研究结果表明，这种统一的豁免政策使处方药的消费平均增加了17.5%，总药物支出增加了25%，保险公司承担的成本增加了60.4%。此外，研究并未发现这种政策会带来住院概率降低等抵消效应。这种影响主要集中在那些之前共保率为30%至40%的急性及其他非慢性疾病患者身上。

abstract.text: Health care expenditure in Germany shows clear regional differences. Such geographic variations are often seen as an indicator for inefficiency. With its homogeneous health care system, low co-payments and uniform prices, Germany is a particularly suited example to analyse regional variations. We use data for the year 2011 on expenditure, utilization of health services and state of health in Germany's statutory health insurance system. This data, which originate from a variety of administrative sources and cover about 90% of the population, are enriched with a wealth of socio-economic variables, data on pollutants, prices and individual preferences. State of health and demography explains 55% of the differences as measured by the standard deviation while all control variables account for a total of 72% of the differences at county level. With other measures of variation, we can account for an even greater proportion. A higher proportion of variation than usually supposed can thus be explained. Whilst this study cannot quantify inefficiencies, our results contradict the thesis that regional variations reflect inefficiency.

10.1002/hec.3183.abstractZh: 德国的医疗保健支出表现出明显的地区差异。这种地理上的差异通常被视为效率不高的标志。由于德国的医疗保健体系具有同质性、较低的共同支付费用以及统一的价格，因此德国是一个非常适合分析地区差异的例子。我们使用了2011年的数据，这些数据涵盖了德国的法定医疗保险体系中的支出、医疗服务利用情况以及健康状况。这些数据来源于多种行政渠道，覆盖了约90%的人口，并包含了丰富的社会经济变量、污染物数据、价格和个人偏好等信息。健康状况和人口统计因素在差异中占55%的权重，而所有控制变量在县级层面上则占差异的72%。使用其他衡量变异的指标，我们可以解释更大比例的差异。因此，可以解释比通常认为的更多的变异。虽然这项研究无法量化效率不高的具体表现，但我们的研究结果与“地区差异反映了效率低下”的论点相矛盾。

abstract.text: Many economic analyses fail to incorporate evidence on child health-related quality of life because of a paucity of quality-adjusted life year (QALY) estimates. This health valuation study is the first to summarize the EQ-5D-Y on a QALY scale. Drawn from a nationally representative panel, 5207 adult respondents were asked to choose between two losses in child health-related quality of life. Based on their choices, a 1-year increase in child pain/discomfort from 'some' to 'a lot' equals a loss of 4 QALYs (95% CI, 3.8-4.4). Likewise, a 1-year increase in child anxiety/depression from 'a bit' to 'very worried, sad, or unhappy' equals a loss of 2 QALYs (95% CI, 1.9-2.2). These findings enable the integration of child-reported outcomes with adult preferences to inform economic analysis. Results inform both clinical practice and resource allocation decisions by enhancing understanding of difficult tradeoffs in child-reported outcomes.

10.1002/hec.3184.abstractZh: 许多经济分析未能纳入有关儿童健康相关生活质量的证据，原因在于缺乏质量调整生命年（QALY）的估算数据。这项健康价值评估研究首次将EQ-5D-Y结果以QALY尺度进行总结。来自全国代表性样本的调查中，5207名成年受访者被要求在两个儿童健康相关生活质量下降选项中做出选择。根据他们的选择，儿童疼痛/不适从“有些”增加到“非常”会导致4个QALY的损失（95%置信区间，3.8-4.4）。同样，儿童焦虑/抑郁情绪从“有点”增加到“非常担忧、悲伤或不快乐”也会导致2个QALY的损失（95%置信区间，1.9-2.2）。这些发现使得可以将儿童报告的结果与成人偏好结合起来，以用于经济分析。研究结果通过增强对儿童报告结果中复杂权衡的理解，为临床实践和资源分配决策提供了参考。

abstract.text: Using the Survey of Income and Program Participation, we examine the impact of formal employment on informal caregiving. We instrument for individual work hours with state unemployment rates. We find that, among women of prime caregiving ages (40-64 years), working 10% more hours per week reduces the probability of providing informal care by about 2 percentage points. The effects are stronger for more time-intensive caregiving and if care recipients are household members. Our results imply that work-promoting policies have the unintended consequence of reducing informal caregiving in an aging society.

10.1002/hec.3185.abstractZh: 通过《收入与计划参与调查》，我们研究了正式就业对非正式照顾行为的影响。我们用州失业率作为个体工作时间的工具变量。研究发现，在适合照顾工作的年龄段（40-64岁）内，每周增加10小时的工作时间可以将提供非正式照顾的概率降低约2个百分点。对于时间更密集的照顾工作，以及当照顾对象为家庭成员时，这种效应更为显著。我们的研究结果表明，促进工作的政策在老龄化社会中可能无意中减少了非正式照顾行为。

abstract.text: This paper presents a new empirical study of the effects of televised alcohol advertising and alcohol price on alcohol consumption. A novel feature of this study is that the empirical work is guided by insights from behavioral economic theory. Unlike the theory used in most prior studies, this theory predicts that restriction on alcohol advertising on TV would be more effective in reducing consumption for individuals with high consumption levels but less effective for individuals with low consumption levels. The estimation work employs data from the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth, and the empirical model is estimated with quantile regressions. The results show that advertising has a small positive effect on consumption and that this effect is relatively larger at high consumption levels. The continuing importance of alcohol taxes is also supported. Education is employed as a proxy for self-regulation, and the results are consistent with this assumption. The key conclusion is that restrictions on alcohol advertising on TV would have a small negative effect on drinking, and this effect would be larger for heavy drinkers.

10.1002/hec.3186.abstractZh: 本文提出了一项关于电视广告和酒精价格对酒精消费影响的新的实证研究。该研究的独特之处在于，其实证研究以行为经济理论的见解为指导。与大多数先前研究使用的理论不同，该理论预测，对电视上酒精广告的限制在降低高消费水平的个体的消费方面更为有效，而在降低低消费水平的个体的消费方面则效果较差。研究采用了《全国青年纵向调查》的数据，并使用分位数回归法对模型进行了估计。研究结果表明，广告对消费有较小的正面影响，且这种影响在高消费水平时更为显著。同时，酒精税的持续重要性也得到了支持。教育被用作自我调节的代理变量，研究结果与这一假设一致。主要结论是，对电视上酒精广告的限制对饮酒行为有较小的负面影响，且这种影响在重度饮酒者中更为显著。

abstract.text: The long-term relationship between the general economy and healthcare expenditures has been extensively researched, to explain differences in healthcare spending between countries, but the midterm (i.e., business cycle) perspective has been overlooked. This study explores business cycle sensitivity in both public and private parts of the healthcare sector across 32 countries. Responses to the business cycle vary notably, both across spending sources and across countries. Whereas in some countries, consumers and/or governments cut back, in others, private and/or public healthcare buyers tend to spend more. We also assess long-term consequences of business cycle sensitivity and show that public cost cutting during economic downturns deflates the mortality rates, whereas private cut backs increase the long-term growth in total healthcare expenditures. Finally, multiple factors help explain variability in cyclical sensitivity. Private cost cuts during economic downturns are smaller in countries with a predominantly publicly funded healthcare system and more preventive public activities. Public cut backs during contractions are smaller in countries that rely more on tax-based resources rather than social health insurances.

10.1002/hec.3187.abstractZh: 关于整体经济与医疗保健支出之间的长期关系，已有大量研究试图解释各国在医疗保健支出上的差异，但从中期视角（即商业周期视角）来看，这一关系却常被忽视。本研究探讨了32个国家公共和私人医疗保健领域对商业周期的敏感性。对商业周期的响应在不同支出来源和不同国家之间存在显著差异。在一些国家，消费者和/或政府会削减支出，而在另一些国家，私人或公共医疗保健支出者则倾向于增加支出。我们还评估了商业周期敏感性的长期后果，发现经济衰退期间公共部门的削减会降低死亡率，而私人部门的削减则会增加长期医疗保健支出的增长。最后，多种因素有助于解释周期性敏感性的差异。在经济衰退期间，以公共资金为主的医疗保健系统的私人成本削减幅度较小，且公共部门的预防性活动也较少。而在那些更依赖税收资源而非社会健康保险的国家，经济衰退期间的公共削减幅度也较小。

abstract.text: If cigarette design was exogenous, inefficiencies arising from smoking could be addressed either with a tax per packet or with an ad valorem tax. However, it is well known that the consequences of these two instruments differ when product characteristics are endogenous. We consider three such characteristics: nicotine, tar, and flavor. Implementation of the first-best social optimum typically requires the capacity to tax or regulate harmful ingredients. Without such a capacity, the next-best policy often combines a per-unit tax on cigarettes with an ad valorem subsidy.

10.1002/hec.3188.abstractZh: 如果香烟的设计是外生的，那么由吸烟引起的效率低下可以通过对每包香烟征税或对香烟征收从价税来解决。然而，众所周知，当产品特性是内生的时，这两种手段的效应是不同的。我们考虑了三种这样的特性：尼古丁、焦油和口味。实现最优的社会政策通常需要有能力对有害成分征税或加以监管。如果没有这样的能力，次优的政策通常会结合对香烟征收单位税和对香烟提供从价补贴。

abstract.text: Using cross-country data on gross domestic product and national expenditure on vaccines, we estimate and compare the income elasticity of vaccine expenditure and general curative healthcare expenditure. This study provides the first evidence on the national income elasticity of vaccination spending. Both fixed and random effects models are applied to data from 84 countries from 2010 to 2011. The income elasticities for healthcare expenditure and vaccine expenditure are 0.844 and 0.336, respectively. Despite vaccines' high cost-effectiveness, the national propensity to spend income on vaccines as income increases lags behind general health care. The low income elasticity of vaccine spending means that relying on economic growth alone will provide an unacceptably slow trajectory to achieving high vaccine coverage levels.

10.1002/hec.3190.abstractZh: 通过利用关于国内生产总值和疫苗国家支出的跨国数据，我们估算并比较了疫苗支出与普通医疗保健支出的收入弹性。本研究首次提供了关于疫苗接种支出对国民收入弹性的证据。我们对2010至2011年间84个国家的数据应用了固定效应和随机效应模型。结果显示，医疗保健支出和疫苗支出的收入弹性分别为0.844和0.336。尽管疫苗具有很高的成本效益，但随着收入的增加，国家将收入用于疫苗支出的倾向却落后于普通医疗保健支出。疫苗支出的低收入弹性意味着，仅依靠经济增长无法实现高疫苗覆盖率的快速提升。

abstract.text: Evidence suggests that the share of Medicare managed care enrollees in a region affects the costs of treating traditional fee-for-service (FFS) Medicare beneficiaries; however, little is known about the mechanisms through which these 'spillover effects' operate. This paper examines the relationship between Medicare managed care penetration and treatment intensity for FFS enrollees hospitalized with a primary diagnosis of AMI. I find that increased Medicare managed care penetration is associated with a reduction in both the costs and the treatment intensity of FFS AMI patients. Specifically, as Medicare managed care penetration increases, FFS AMI patients are less likely to receive surgical reperfusion and mechanical ventilation and to experience an overall reduction in the number of inpatient procedures.

10.1002/hec.3191.abstractZh: 有证据表明，某一地区医疗保险管理式护理的参保比例会影响对传统按服务收费的医疗保险受益人的治疗成本；然而，关于这些“溢出效应”的具体机制，目前了解甚少。本文研究了医疗保险管理式护理的普及程度与以急性心肌梗死为主要诊断的按服务收费医疗保险参保患者治疗强度之间的关系。研究发现，医疗保险管理式护理的普及程度提高，不仅会降低按服务收费的急性心肌梗死患者的治疗成本，还会减少其治疗强度。具体来说，随着医疗保险管理式护理的普及程度提高，按服务收费的急性心肌梗死患者接受手术再灌注治疗和机械通气的可能性降低，同时住院手术的数量也会减少。

abstract.text: An important avenue for smoking deterrence may be through familial ties if adult smokers respond to parental health shocks. In this paper, we merge the Original Cohort and the Offspring Cohort of the Framingham Heart Study to study how adult offspring smoking behavior and subjective health assessments vary with elder parent smoking behavior and health outcomes. These data allow us to model the smoking behavior of adult offspring over a 30-year period contemporaneously with parental behaviors and outcomes. We find strong 'like father, like son' and 'like mother, like daughter' correlations in smoking behavior. We find that adult offspring significantly curtail their own smoking following an own health shock; however, we find limited evidence that offspring smoking behavior is sensitive to parent health, with the notable exception that women significantly reduce both their smoking participation and intensity following a smoking-related cardiovascular event of a parent. We also model the subjective health assessment of adult offspring as a function of parent health, and we find that women report significantly worse health following the smoking-related death of a parent.

10.1002/hec.3194.abstractZh: 一个重要的戒烟途径可能是通过家庭关系来实现，特别是当成年吸烟者受到父母健康问题的冲击时。在本文中，我们将弗雷明汉心脏研究中的原始队列和后代队列结合起来，研究成年后代的吸烟行为以及主观健康评估如何随着年长父母的吸烟行为和健康状况而变化。这些数据使我们能够同时模拟父母的行为和结果，对成年后代的吸烟行为进行30年的建模。我们发现，在吸烟行为上存在强烈的“子代模仿父母”现象。我们还发现，成年后代在自身健康受到冲击后，会显著减少自己的吸烟行为；然而，我们发现后代的吸烟行为对父母的健康状况的敏感性有限，唯一的例外是，女性在父母发生与吸烟相关的心血管事件后，会显著减少吸烟的参与度和强度。我们还对成年后代的主观健康评估进行了建模，发现女性在父母因吸烟相关原因去世后，报告的健康状况明显恶化。

abstract.text: Reducing waiting times has been a major focus of the English National Health Service for many years, but little is known about the impact on health outcomes. The collection of data on patient-reported outcome measures for all patients undergoing four large-volume procedures facilitates analysis of the impact of waiting times on patient outcomes. The availability of patient-reported outcome measures before and after surgery allows us to estimate the impact of waiting times on the effectiveness of treatment, controlling for pre-surgery health and the endogeneity of waiting times caused by prioritisation with respect to pre-intervention health. We find that waiting time has a negative and statistically significant impact on the health gain from hip and knee replacement surgery and no impact on the effectiveness of varicose vein and hernia surgery. The magnitude of this effect at patient level is small, 0.1% of the outcome measure range for each additional week of waiting. However, the value of this effect is substantially larger than existing estimates of the disutility experienced during the waiting period. The health losses associated with an additional week of waiting for annual populations of hip and knee replacement patients are worth £11.1m and £11.5m, respectively.

10.1002/hec.3195.abstractZh: 减少等待时间一直是英国国家卫生服务系统多年的重点关注事项，但对其对健康结果的影响知之甚少。收集所有接受四项大手术患者的患者报告结果数据，有助于分析等待时间对患者结果的影响。手术前后患者报告的结果数据使我们能够估计等待时间对治疗效果的影响，同时控制手术前的健康状况以及因优先处理手术而导致的等待时间的内生性。我们发现，等待时间对髋关节和膝关节置换手术的健康收益有负面影响，且对静脉曲张和疝气手术的效果没有影响。这种影响的幅度很小，每增加一周等待时间，结果指标范围的变化仅为0.1%。然而，这种影响的价值远大于现有对等待期间不便利感的估计。对于每年接受髋关节和膝关节置换手术的患者群体来说，每多等待一周所带来的健康损失分别相当于111万英镑和115万英镑。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the economic impact of health shocks on working-age adults in Vietnam during 2004-2008, using a fixed effects specification. Health shocks cover disability and morbidity and are measured by 'days unable to carry out regular activity', 'days in bed due to illness/injury', and 'hospitalization'. Overall, Vietnamese households are able to smooth total non-health expenditures in the short run in the face of a significant rise in out-of-pocket health expenditures. However, this is accomplished through vulnerability-enhancing mechanisms, especially in rural areas, including increased loans and asset sales and decreased education expenditures. Female-headed and rural households are found to be the least able to protect consumption. Results highlight the need to extend and deepen social protection and universal health coverage.

10.1002/hec.3196.abstractZh: 本文采用固定效应模型，研究了2004至2008年间越南工作年龄成年人因健康冲击所遭受的经济影响。健康冲击包括残疾和发病率，具体指标包括“无法正常活动的时间”、“因病/伤卧床的时间”以及“住院时间”。总体而言，越南家庭能够在短期内通过增强脆弱性机制来平滑非健康支出，尤其是在农村地区，这些机制包括增加贷款和资产出售，以及减少教育支出。研究发现，以女性为户主的家庭和农村家庭在保护消费方面最为薄弱。研究结果强调了扩大和深化社会保护和全民健康覆盖的必要性。

abstract.text: A large literature has documented significant public health benefits associated with the minimum legal drinking age in the USA, particularly because of the resulting effects on motor vehicle accidents. These benefits form the primary basis for continued efforts to restrict youth access to alcohol. It is important to keep in mind that policymakers have a wide variety of alcohol-control options available to them, and understanding how these policies may complement or substitute for one another can improve policy making moving forward. Towards this end, we propose that investigating the causal effects of the minimum legal drinking age in New South Wales, Australia, provides a particularly informative case study, because Australian states are among the world leaders in their efforts against drunk driving. Using an age-based regression discontinuity design applied to restricted-use data from several sources, we find no evidence that legal access to alcohol has effects on motor vehicle accidents of any type in New South Wales, despite having large effects on drinking and on hospitalizations due to alcohol abuse.

10.1002/hec.3197.abstractZh: 大量文献记录了美国设定最低法定饮酒年龄对公共健康的显著益处，尤其是对机动车事故的影响。这些益处是持续限制青少年接触酒精政策的主要依据。需要注意的是，政策制定者拥有多种酒精控制方案可供选择，了解这些政策如何互补或替代可以有助于未来的政策制定。为此，我们建议研究澳大利亚新南威尔士州设定最低法定饮酒年龄的因果效应，因为该州在预防酒驾方面处于世界领先地位。通过采用基于年龄的回归断点设计，并利用来自多个来源的受限数据进行分析，我们发现，尽管法定饮酒年龄对饮酒量和因酒精滥用导致的住院率有显著影响，但在新南威尔士州，它并未对各类机动车事故产生任何影响。

abstract.text: I examine whether working hours have a causal effect on the health behaviors of workers.
