In assessing the causal relationship, I estimate fixed-effects instrumental variable models by using exogenous variation in adopting a reduced workweek in South Korea as an instrument for work hours. The estimation results reveal that shortening work hours induces individuals to exercise regularly and decreases the likelihood of smoking, with more pronounced effects for heavy smokers. While a work-hour reduction substantially increases the probability of drinking participation, it does not significantly affect the likelihood of frequent or daily drinking habits. In addition, the effect of a work-hour reduction on regular exercise is salient among women and older groups, and the effect on smoking behaviors is more pronounced among men and middle-aged groups.

10.1002/hec.3198.abstractZh: 我研究工作小时数是否对工人的健康行为有因果影响。在评估这种因果关系时，我采用韩国减少工作周时间的外部变化作为工作小时的工具变量模型。估计结果显示，缩短工作小时数会促使人们更频繁地锻炼，并降低吸烟的可能性，尤其是对重度吸烟者而言。虽然减少工作小时数会显著增加饮酒的可能性，但并不会显著影响频繁或日常饮酒的习惯。此外，减少工作小时数对女性和中年人群的定期锻炼有显著影响，而对男性和中年人群对吸烟行为的影響则更为明显。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes the relation between commuting time and health in the UK. I focus on four different types of health outcomes: subjective health measures, objective health measures, health behavior, and healthcare utilization. Fixed effect models are estimated with British Household Panel Survey data. I find that whereas objective health and health behavior are barely affected by commuting time, subjective health measures are clearly lower for people who commute longer. A longer commuting time is, moreover, related to more visits to the general practitioner. Effects turn out to be more pronounced for women and for commuters driving a car. For women, commuting time is also negatively related to regular exercise and positively to calling in sick.

10.1002/hec.3199.abstractZh: 本文分析了英国通勤时间与健康之间的关系。我重点关注四种不同的健康结果：主观健康指标、客观健康指标、健康行为以及医疗利用。使用英国家庭面板调查数据，我们建立了固定效应模型。研究发现，客观健康和健康行为受通勤时间的影响较小，而主观健康指标则明显低于通勤时间较长的群体。此外，较长的通勤时间与更频繁地拜访全科医生有关。对于女性以及驾驶汽车通勤的人来说，这种影响更为显著。对于女性而言，通勤时间还与定期锻炼呈负相关，而与请病假呈正相关。

abstract.text: In this study, aggregate-level panel data from 20 Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development countries over three decades (1980-2009) were used to investigate the impact of hospital payment reforms on healthcare output and mortality. Hospital payment schemes were classified as fixed-budget (i.e. not directly based on activities), fee-for-service (FFS) or patient-based payment (PBP) schemes. The data were analysed using a difference-in-difference model that allows for a structural change in outcomes due to payment reform. The results suggest that FFS schemes increase the growth rate of healthcare output, whereas PBP schemes positively affect life expectancy at age 65 years. However, these results should be interpreted with caution, as results are sensitive to model specification.

10.1002/hec.3205.abstractZh: 本研究采用了20个经济合作与发展组织国家在1980年至2009年间的汇总级面板数据，以探讨医院支付改革对医疗保健产出和死亡率的影响。医院支付方案被分为固定预算制（即不直接基于活动）、按服务收费制或基于患者的支付制。数据分析采用了差异中差异模型，该模型允许因支付改革而导致结果发生结构性变化。研究结果表明，按服务收费制提高了医疗保健产出的增长率，而基于患者的支付制则对65岁时的预期寿命有积极影响。然而，这些结果应谨慎解读，因为模型设定对研究结果有敏感影响。

abstract.text: This paper tests for the existence of nonlinearity and reference dependence in income preferences for general practitioners. Confirming the theory of reference dependent utility within the context of a discrete choice experiment, we find that losses loom larger than gains in income for Norwegian general practitioners, i.e. they value losses from their current income level around three times higher than the equivalent gains. Our results are validated by comparison with equivalent contingent valuation values for marginal willingness to pay and marginal willingness to accept compensation for changes in job characteristics. Physicians' income preferences determine the effectiveness of 'pay for performance' and other incentive schemes. Our results may explain the relative ineffectiveness of financial incentive schemes that rely on increasing physicians' incomes.

10.1002/hec.3208.abstractZh: 本文探讨了全科医生收入偏好中是否存在非线性和参考依赖性的现象。通过离散选择实验的验证，我们发现对于挪威的全科医生而言，收入损失的重要性高于收益。也就是说，他们对于当前收入水平的损失所赋予的价值大约是同等收益的三倍。我们的研究结果通过与边际支付意愿和边际接受补偿意愿的等价价值比较得到了验证。医生的收入偏好决定了“按绩效付费”及其他激励方案的有效性。我们的研究结果或许可以解释那些依赖于提高医生收入的财务激励方案相对无效的原因。

abstract.text: Korea's rapid population aging has been considered as a major factor in increase of healthcare expenditure (HCE). However, there were no clear empirical evidences in Korea that show if population aging has a significant impact on HCE. To examine the 'red herring' argument, this study used Heckman, two-part, and augmented model with Korean National Health Insurance claim data for the deceased and survivors of aged 20 years and over verified by Korean National Health Insurance Service between January 1 and December 31, 2010. Our results suggest that when time to death is controlled for as explanatory variable, HCE decreases as a function of age, and HCE during the terminal year increases as a function of time to death, and HCE in the last quarter of life decreases with age. Therefore, this study affirms that there is no age effect in Korea experiencing the most rapid population aging among Asian countries. An increase in the number of elderly, due to the aging of baby boomers, may not increase a share of HCE out of gross domestic product (GDP) in Korea.

10.1002/hec.3209.abstractZh: 韩国的人口快速老龄化被认为是增加医疗支出的重要因素。然而，在韩国并没有明确的实证证据表明人口老龄化对医疗支出有显著影响。为了检验这一“误导性”论点，本研究使用了Heckman的双部分增广模型，并基于韩国国民健康保险服务在2010年1月1日至12月31日期间收集到的20岁及以上老年人的索赔数据进行分析。研究结果表明，在控制死亡时间作为解释变量的情况下，医疗支出随年龄增长而减少；在死亡前的最后一年，医疗支出随死亡时间的延长而增加；而在生命最后季度的医疗支出则随年龄增长而减少。因此，本研究证实，在亚洲国家中，韩国并没有出现明显的年龄效应。由于婴儿潮一代的老化，老年人口数量的增加可能不会增加韩国医疗支出占国内生产总值的比例。

abstract.text: This paper provides new empirical evidence on the health consequences of rural-to-urban migration in China. We use a panel dataset from 2003 to 2006 constructed by the Research Center on the Rural Economy at the Ministry of Agriculture in China to investigate the effects of short-term and medium-term migration on health status. By combining propensity-score matching and the difference-in-difference model, we attempt to overcome the migration endogeneity issue and estimate the average treatment effect on the treated. We find that the effect of short-term migration on health in China is significantly positive mostly because of the income effect. However, the effect of longer-term continuous migration on health is insignificant and close to zero. Our results are robust to several alternative estimation techniques and a series of robustness checks.

10.1002/hec.3212.abstractZh: 本文提供了关于中国农村向城市迁移对健康影响的新实证证据。我们使用了中国农业部农村经济研究中心在2003至2006年间构建的面板数据集，来研究短期和中期迁移对健康状况的影响。通过结合倾向得分匹配和差异模型，我们试图克服迁移内生性问题，并估计对受干预者的平均处理效应。研究发现，短期迁移对中国健康的影响显著为正，主要归因于收入效应。然而，长期持续迁移对健康的影响并不显著，接近于零。我们的研究结果对多种替代估计方法和一系列稳健性检验均具有稳健性。

abstract.text: Successful supply-side interdictions into illegal drug markets are predicated on the responsiveness of drug prices to enforcement and the price elasticity of demand for addictive drugs. We present causal estimates that targeted interventions aimed at methamphetamine input markets ('precursor control') can temporarily increase retail street prices, but methamphetamine consumption is weakly responsive to higher drug prices. After the supply interventions, purity-adjusted prices increased then quickly returned to pre-treatment levels within 6-12 months, demonstrating the short-term effects of precursor control. The price elasticity of methamphetamine demand is -0.13 to -0.21 for self-admitted drug treatment admissions and between -0.24 and -0.28 for hospital inpatient admissions. We find some evidence of a positive cross-price effect for cocaine, but we do not find robust evidence that increases in methamphetamine prices increased heroin, alcohol, or marijuana drug use. This study can inform policy discussions regarding other synthesized drugs, including illicit use of pharmaceuticals.

10.1002/hec.3213.abstractZh: 成功地对非法毒品市场进行供给侧干预的前提是毒品价格对执法措施的响应性，以及成瘾性药物需求的弹性。我们的因果分析表明，针对甲基苯丙胺输入市场的针对性干预（“前体控制”）可以暂时提高零售价格，但甲基苯丙胺的消费对更高的价格反应较弱。在供应干预之后，经过纯度调整后的价格会迅速上升，并在6到12个月内恢复到干预前的水平，这证明了前体控制的短期效果。甲基苯丙胺需求的弹性为-0.13至-0.21，适用于自报的药物治疗患者；而对于住院患者，这一弹性介于-0.24至-0.28之间。我们发现可卡因存在正向的跨价格效应，但并未发现甲基苯丙胺价格上升会显著增加海洛因、酒精或大麻等毒品的使用。这项研究可以为关于其他合成药物的政策讨论提供参考，包括非法使用药品的情况。

abstract.text: The value of mortality risk reductions, conventionally expressed as the value per statistical life, is an important determinant of the net benefits of many government policies. US regulators currently rely primarily on studies of fatal injuries, raising questions about whether different values might be appropriate for risks associated with fatal illnesses. Our review suggests that, despite the substantial expansion of the research base in recent years, few US studies of illness-related risks meet criteria for quality, and those that do yield similar values to studies of injury-related risks. Given this result, combining the findings of these few studies with the findings of the more robust literature on injury-related risks appears to provide a reasonable range of estimates for application in regulatory analysis. Our review yields estimates ranging from about $4.2 million to $13.7 million with a mid-point of $9.0 million (2013 dollars). Although the studies we identify differ from those that underlie the values currently used by Federal agencies, the resulting estimates are remarkably similar, suggesting that there is substantial consensus emerging on the values applicable to the general US population.

10.1002/hec.3214.abstractZh: mortality风险降低的价值，通常以每统计生命期的价值来表示，是许多政府政策净效益的重要决定因素。美国监管机构目前主要依赖对致命伤害的研究，这引发了关于与致命疾病相关的风险是否应采用不同价值的问题。我们的回顾表明，尽管近年来关于疾病相关风险的研究基础有了显著扩展，但美国很少有研究达到高质量的标准，而那些达到标准的研究得出的价值与关于伤害相关风险的研究相当。鉴于这一结果，将这几项研究的发现与关于伤害相关风险更为可靠的研究结果结合起来，似乎可以为监管分析提供一个合理的估计范围。我们的回顾得出的估计值大约在420万至1370万美元之间，中间值为900万美元（以2013年美元计算）。虽然我们识别出的研究与联邦机构目前使用的价值基础的研究有所不同，但得出的估计值却非常相似，这表明对于美国普通人群适用的价值，已经形成了相当一致的共识。

abstract.text: This paper, for the first time, presents estimates of the causal impact of overweight and obesity on self-rated health (SRH) using instrumental variables (IV) econometric methods. While a number of previous studies have sought to better understand the determinants of SRH, there is no consensus in relation to the impact of overweight and obesity. Using data from a large nationally representative sample of Irish parents and their children, we estimate a range of ordered probit models to isolate the causal effect of overweight and obesity on SRH. Our data includes independently and objectively recorded weight and height measures for parents and their children and we instrument for parental body mass index (BMI) status using the BMI of a biological child. After controlling for a range of individual, socioeconomic, health and lifestyle related variables, we find that being overweight has a negligible impact on SRH, while being obese has a practically and statistically significant negative impact on SRH, with these effects most pronounced for those who are most obese. We find only minor differences in these effects across gender.

10.1002/hec.3215.abstractZh: 本文首次使用工具变量计量经济学方法，对超重和肥胖对自我健康评价的因果影响进行了估计。虽然之前的研究试图更好地理解自我健康评价的决定因素，但在超重和肥胖的影响方面尚未达成一致意见。我们利用大量具有全国代表性的爱尔兰父母及其子女的数据，通过一系列有序Probit模型来分离超重和肥胖对自我健康评价的因果效应。我们的数据包括父母及其子女的独立且客观记录的体重和身高数据，并使用生物学子女的BMI作为父母的BMI状态的工具变量。在控制了各种个体、社会经济、健康和生活方式相关变量后，我们发现超重对自我健康评价的影响微乎其微，而肥胖则对自我健康评价有显著且统计学上显著的负面影响，这种影响在肥胖程度最高的人群中最为明显。我们发现这些影响在性别之间只有微小的差异。

abstract.text: With its rapid economic growth and fast changing lifestyle, China witnessed expansionary prevalence of obesity and overweight during the recent decades. This paper provides the first nationally representative estimate of the medical cost attributable to obesity and overweight in China. We improve upon the traditional estimation methodology (two-part model) by jointly adopting the instrumental variable approach and the panel data methods in order to correct for the potential endogeneity of body size and the individual heterogeneity in medical expenditure. Using longitudinal data from 2000-2009 China Health and Nutrition Surveys, we find that body size has a significant impact on the individual expected medical expenditure and the per capita medical cost attributable to obesity and overweight in a single medical event is estimated to be 6.18 Yuan, or 5.29% of the total personal medical expenditure. This translates to 24.35 billion Yuan annual cost on the national scale, accounting for 2.46% of China's national health care expenditure. The subsample analyses also show that such cost is higher for the urban, women, and better educated people and increases over time. Our results contribute to the literature on the economic impact of obesity in developing countries and bear policy implications on controlling the rising health care costs in China.

10.1002/hec.3217.abstractZh: 随着经济的快速发展和生活方式的迅速变化，中国在过去几十年中出现了肥胖和超重现象的普遍化。本文首次提供了关于中国因肥胖和超重导致的医疗成本的全国代表性估计。我们通过结合使用工具变量方法和面板数据方法，改进了传统的估计方法（两部分模型），以纠正身体尺寸的可能内生性和个人医疗支出的异质性问题。利用2000-2009年中国健康和营养调查的长期数据，我们发现身体尺寸对个体预期医疗支出有显著影响，而单次医疗事件中的肥胖和超重导致的人均医疗成本估计为6.18元，占个人总医疗支出的5.29%。这一数字相当于每年全国性的成本为242.5亿元，占中国国家医疗支出的2.46%。子样本分析还显示，这种成本在城市地区、女性以及受教育程度较高的人群中更高，并且随着时间的推移而增加。我们的研究结果有助于了解发展中国家肥胖的经济影响，并对控制中国不断上升的医疗成本具有政策意义。

abstract.text: There has been little assessment of the role the Millennium Development Goals (MDGs) have had in progressing international development. There has been a 41% reduction in the under-five mortality rate worldwide from 1990 to 2011 and an acceleration in the rate of reduction since 2000. This paper explores why this has occurred, and results for all developing countries indicate that it is not due to more healthcare or public health interventions but is driven by a coincidental burst of economic growth. Although the MDGs are considered to have played an important part in securing progress against poverty, hunger and disease, there is very little evidence to back this viewpoint up. A thorough analysis of the successes and failures of the MDGs is therefore necessary before embarking on a new round of global goals.

10.1002/hec.3218.abstractZh: 关于千年发展目标在促进国际发展方面的作用，目前很少有评估。从1990年到2011年，全球五岁以下儿童死亡率下降了41%，且自2000年以来这一下降速度有所加快。本文探讨了这一现象发生的原因。对所有发展中国家的分析表明，这一变化并非由于更多的医疗保健或公共卫生干预措施所致，而是由于经济快速增长所带来的偶然效应。尽管千年发展目标被认为在减少贫困、饥饿和疾病方面发挥了重要作用，但支持这一观点的证据却非常有限。因此，在启动新一轮全球目标之前，有必要对千年发展目标的成功与失败进行全面分析。

abstract.text: This paper exploits the geographic expansion of performance-based financing (PBF) in Cambodia over a decade to estimate its effect on the utilization of maternal and child health services. PBF is estimated to raise the proportion of births occurring in incentivized public health facilities by 7.5 percentage points (25%). A substantial part of this effect arises from switching the location of institutional births from private to public facilities; there is no significant impact on deliveries supervised by a skilled birth attendant, nor is there any significant effect on neonatal mortality, antenatal care and vaccination rates. The impact on births in public facilities is much greater if PBF is accompanied by maternity vouchers that cover user fees, but there is no significant effect among the poorest women. Heterogeneous effects across schemes differing in design suggest that maintaining management authority within a health district while giving explicit service targets to facilities is more effective in raising utilization than contracting management to a non-governmental organization while denying it full autonomy and leaving financial penalties vague.

10.1002/hec.3219.abstractZh: 本文研究了基于绩效的融资在柬埔寨十多年来的地理扩展情况，以评估其对孕产妇和儿童健康服务利用的影响。研究表明，基于绩效的融资使在激励性公共卫生设施中分娩的比例提高了7.5个百分点（25%）。这一效果的主要来源是将机构分娩地点从私人设施转移到公共设施；但对于由熟练助产士监督的分娩过程，并未产生显著影响，新生儿死亡率、产前护理和疫苗接种率也没有明显变化。如果基于绩效的融资伴随有涵盖用户费用的生育券，那么对公共设施中分娩的影响会更大，但在最贫困的女性中并未产生显著效果。不同方案之间的效果差异表明，在保持卫生区管理权的同时为设施设定明确的服务目标，比将管理权交给非政府组织而剥夺其完全自主权并模糊财务处罚规定，更能有效提高服务利用率。

abstract.text: We develop a stylized principal-agent model with moral hazard and adverse selection to provide a unified framework for understanding some of the most salient features of the recent physician payment reform in Ontario and its impact on physician behavior. These features include the following: (i) physicians can choose a payment contract from a menu that includes an enhanced fee-for-service contract and a blended capitation contract; (ii) the capitation rate is higher, and the cost-reimbursement rate is lower in the blended capitation contract; (iii) physicians sort selectively into the contracts based on their preferences; and (iv) physicians in the blended capitation model provide fewer services than physicians in the enhanced fee-for-service model.

10.1002/hec.3220.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个具有道德风险和逆向选择问题的风格化主体模型，以提供一个统一的框架来理解安大略省最近的医生薪酬改革的一些最显著特征及其对医生行为的影响。这些特征包括： (i) 医生可以从一个包含增强型按服务收费合同和混合型按人头收费合同的菜单中选择一种薪酬合同； (ii) 混合型按人头收费合同的按人头收费率更高，而费用报销率更低； (iii) 医生根据自身的偏好选择性地选择合同； (iv) 在混合型按人头收费模型中，医生的服务量比在增强型按服务收费模型中的服务量要少。

abstract.text: We develop a theoretical model to study a policy that publicly reports hospital waiting times. We characterize two effects of such a policy: the 'competition effect' that drives hospitals to compete for patients by increasing service rates and reducing waiting times and the 'signaling effect' that allows patients to distinguish a high-quality hospital from a low-quality one. While for a low-quality hospital both effects help reduce waiting time, for a high-quality hospital, they act in opposite directions. We show that the competition effect will outweigh the signaling effect for the high-quality hospital, and consequently, both hospitals' waiting times will be reduced by the introduction of the policy. This result holds in a policy environment where maximum waiting time targets are not binding.

10.1002/hec.3222.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个理论模型，用于研究公开报告医院等待时间的政策。我们描述了该政策的两种效应：一种是“竞争效应”，它通过提高服务率和减少等待时间，促使医院之间竞争患者；另一种是“信号效应”，它使患者能够区分高质量的医院和低质量医院。对于低质量医院来说，这两种效应都有助于减少等待时间，但对于高质量医院来说，它们的作用方向相反。我们表明，对于高质量医院而言，竞争效应会超过信号效应，因此，引入该政策后，两家医院的等待时间都会减少。这一结果在最大等待时间目标不具约束性的政策环境下仍然成立。

abstract.text: Evidence on the impact of user costs on healthcare demand in 'universal' public National Health Services (NHS) is scarce. The changes in copayments and in the regulation of the provision of free patient transportation, introduced in early 2012 in Portugal, provide a natural experiment to evaluate that impact. However, those changes in user costs were accompanied with changes in the criteria that determine which patients are exempt from copayments, implying that simple comparisons of user rates would be biased. In this paper, we develop a new methodology to evaluate the impact of increases in direct and indirect user costs on the demand for emergency services (ES) in the presence of compositional changes in co-payment exempt and non-exempt populations. Our results show that the increase in copayments did not have an effect in moderating ES demand by paying users, but we find significant effects of the change in transport regulation. Thus, our results support the conclusion that indirect costs may be more important than direct costs in determining healthcare demand in NHS-countries where copayments are small and wide exemption schemes are in place, especially for older patients.

10.1002/hec.3223.abstractZh: 关于用户成本对“全民”公共国家卫生服务（NHS）中医疗需求影响的证据非常有限。2012年初葡萄牙实施的共付额调整以及免费患者交通服务的监管变化，为评估这一影响提供了一个自然实验。然而，这些用户成本的变化伴随着决定哪些患者可以免除共付额的标准变化，这意味着简单比较用户费用会存在偏差。在本文中，我们开发了一种新的方法，以评估直接和间接用户成本增加在共付额免除与非免除人群比例变化的情况下对紧急服务需求的影响。我们的结果显示，共付额的增加并没有通过向用户收费来抑制紧急服务需求，但交通监管的变化确实产生了显著影响。因此，我们的研究结果支持这样的结论：在共付额较低且免除范围广泛的NHS国家，间接成本可能比直接成本对医疗需求的影响更为重要，尤其是对于老年患者而言。

abstract.text: Whether health insurance matters for health has long been a central issue for debate when assessing the full value of health insurance coverage in both developed and developing countries. In 2007, the government-led Urban Resident Basic Medical Insurance (URBMI) program was piloted in China, followed by a nationwide implementation in 2009. Different premium subsidies by government across cities and groups provide a unique opportunity to employ the instrumental variables estimation approach to identify the causal effects of health insurance on health. Using a national panel survey of the URBMI, we find that URBMI beneficiaries experience statistically better health than the uninsured. Furthermore, the insurance health benefit appears to be stronger for groups with disadvantaged education and income than for their counterparts. In addition, the insured receive more and better inpatient care, without paying more for services.

10.1002/hec.3225.abstractZh: 在评估健康保险在发达国家和发展中国家的全部价值时，健康保险对健康的意义一直是一个核心议题。2007年，中国政府启动了城市居民基本医疗保险计划，并于2009年在全国范围内实施。不同城市和群体的政府补贴为使用工具变量估计方法来确定健康保险对健康的因果效应提供了独特的机会。通过对城市居民基本医疗保险的全国面板调查，我们发现，享受该保险的人健康状况比未参保者更为良好。此外，对于教育和收入条件较差的群体来说，保险带来的健康效益似乎更为显著。另外，参保者能够享受到更多且更好的住院治疗服务，而无需支付更高的费用。

abstract.text: Two recent studies have provided a comprehensive review/summary of a large number of estimates of the price elasticity of food consumption using a meta-regression approach. In this letter, we introduce a way of removing the income effect from these elasticities to recover the compensated elasticities. Although the income effect is small, the compensated elasticities vary by income group. Both types of elasticity should possibly be considered when assessing the impact of policy changes on food consumption.

10.1002/hec.3226.abstractZh: 两项近期研究通过元回归方法，对大量关于食品消费价格弹性的估计进行了全面回顾和总结。在本文中，我们提出了一种方法，用于消除这些弹性中的收入效应，以得到补偿后的弹性值。尽管收入效应较小，但补偿后的弹性值会因收入群体而异。在评估政策变化对食品消费的影响时，应同时考虑这两种弹性。

abstract.text: Is obesity the consequence of an optimally chosen lifestyle or do people consume too much relative to their long-term preferences? The latter perspective accepts that people might face self-control problems when exposed to the immediate gratification from food. We exploit unique survey data for Switzerland in multinomial logit and ordered probit regressions to study (i) the covariates of obesity including indicators of self-control and (ii) the consequences of obesity on the subjective well-being of people with limited willpower. Our main finding is that obesity decreases the well-being of individuals who report having limited self-control, but not otherwise.

10.1002/hec.3227.abstractZh: 肥胖是生活方式选择最优的结果，还是人们相对于其长期偏好消费了过多的食物？后一种观点认为，当人们面临食物带来的即时满足时，可能会面临自我控制问题。我们利用瑞士的独特调查数据，通过多项逻辑回归和有序Probit回归分析，研究：(i) 导致肥胖的协变量，包括自我控制的指标；(ii) 肥胖对意志力有限的人的主观幸福感的影响。我们的主要发现是，肥胖会降低那些报告自我控制能力有限的个体的幸福感，但在其他方面则没有这种影响。

abstract.text: An inequality measure is 'consistent' if it ranks distributions the same irrespective of whether health quantities are represented in terms of attainments or shortfalls. This consistency property severely restricts the set of admissible inequality measures. We show that, within a more general setting of separate measures for attainments and shortfalls, the consistency property is a combination of two conditions. The first is a compelling rationality condition that says that the attainment measure should rank attainment distributions as the shortfall measure ranks shortfall distributions. The second is an overly demanding condition that says that the attainment measure and the shortfall measure should be identical. By dropping the latter condition, the restrictions on the admissible inequality measures disappear.

10.1002/hec.3228.abstractZh: 如果一种不平等度量标准无论健康指标是以成就还是不足来表示，都能对分布进行相同的排序，那么这种度量标准就是“一致的”。这种一致性特性严重限制了可接受的不平等度量标准的范围。我们证明，在适用于成就和不足的独立度量标准这一更一般的背景下，一致性特性是由两个条件组合而成的。第一个条件是合理的理性条件，它要求成就度量标准应该按照不足度量标准对不足分布的排序来排序。第二个条件则要求成就度量标准和不足度量标准应该是相同的。通过放弃第二个条件，对可接受不平等度量标准的限制就消失了。

abstract.text: Using a 2004 Japanese natural experiment affecting physician supply, we study the physician labor market and its effects on hospital exits and health outcomes. Although physicians play a central role in determining the performance of a healthcare system, identifying their impacts are difficult because physician supply is endogenously determined. We circumvent the problem by exploiting an exogenous shock to physician supply created by the introduction of a new residency program - our natural experiment. Based on panel data covering all physicians in Japan, we find that the introduction of a new residency program substantially decreased the supply of physicians in some rural markets where local hospitals had relied on university hospitals for filling physician positions. We also find that physician market wages increased in the affected markets relative to less affected markets. Finally, we find that this change in physician market wages forced hospitals to exit affected markets and negatively affected patient health outcomes in those markets. These effects may be exacerbated by the fact that the healthcare market was rigidly price-regulated.

10.1002/hec.3229.abstractZh: 我们基于2004年日本的一项自然实验，该实验涉及医生供应情况的变化，研究了医生劳动力市场及其对医院退出和健康结果的影响。尽管医生在决定医疗系统的绩效中起着核心作用，但由于医生供应是由内生因素决定的，因此识别其影响较为困难。我们通过利用一项新的住院医师培训计划对医生供应造成的外部冲击来规避这一问题——这就是我们的自然实验。基于涵盖日本所有医生的面板数据，我们发现，在那些当地医院依赖大学医院来填补医生职位的农村市场，新住院医师培训计划的引入显著减少了医生供应。我们还发现，受影响市场的医生市场工资相对于受影响较少的市场有所上升。最后，我们发现这种医生市场工资的变化迫使医院退出受影响的市场，并对这些市场的患者健康结果产生了负面影响。由于医疗市场受到严格的价格管制，这些影响可能会进一步加剧。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the effect of physical violence and property crimes on subjective well-being in Australia. Our methodology improves on previous contributions by (i) controlling for the endogeneity of victimisation and (ii) analysing the heterogeneous effect of victimisation along the whole distribution of well-being. Using fixed effects panel estimation, we find that both types of crimes reduce reported well-being to a large extent, with physical violence exerting a larger average effect than property crimes. Furthermore, using recently developed panel data quantile regression model with fixed effects, we show that the negative effects of both crimes are highly heterogeneous, with a monotonic decrease over the distribution of subjective well-being.

10.1002/hec.3230.abstractZh: 本文估计了澳大利亚中身体暴力与财产犯罪对主观幸福感的影响。我们的研究方法改进了以往的研究，主要体现在：(i)控制了受害现象的内生性；(ii)分析了受害现象在整体幸福感分布上的异质性影响。通过固定效应面板估计，我们发现这两种犯罪都在很大程度上降低了人们的幸福感，其中身体暴力的平均影响大于财产犯罪。此外，利用最近开发的带有固定效应的面板数据分位数回归模型，我们发现这两种犯罪的负面影响具有高度异质性，且随着主观幸福感分布的变化而呈单调递减趋势。

abstract.text: The debate on tobacco and fat taxes often treats smoking and eating as independent behaviors. However, the available evidence shows that they are interdependent, which implies that policies against smoking or obesity may have larger scope than expected. To address this issue, we propose a dynamic rational model where eating, smoking, and physical exercise are simultaneous choices that jointly affect body weight and addiction to smoking. Focusing on direct and cross-price effects, we study the impact of tobacco and food taxes, and we show that in both cases a single policy tool can reduce both smoking and body weight.

10.1002/hec.3231.abstractZh: 关于烟草和食品税的讨论常常将吸烟和进食视为独立的行为。然而，现有证据表明这两者是相互依存的，这意味着针对吸烟或肥胖的政策可能具有比预期更大的影响范围。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一个动态理性模型，其中进食、吸烟和体育锻炼是同时发生的选择，它们共同影响体重和吸烟成瘾。通过研究直接和交叉价格效应，我们探讨了烟草和食品税的影响，并发现单一政策工具可以同时减少吸烟和体重问题。

abstract.text: This paper identifies a family of absolute consistent inequality indices using a weakly decomposable postulate suggested by Ebert. Because one member employs an Atkinson type aggregation we refer to it as the Atkinson index of consistent inequality. A second member of this family parallels the Kolm index of inequality. Two innovative features of these indices are that no specific structure is imposed on the form of the index at the outset and no transformation of any existing index is considered to ensure consistency. Each of them regards an achievement distribution as equally unequal as the corresponding shortfall distribution. We apply these indices to study inequality in grip strength among 50+ year-old Europeans.

10.1002/hec.3256.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种绝对一致不平等指数系列，该系列基于Ebert提出的弱可分解假设构建。由于其中一个指数采用Atkinson型聚合方法，我们将其称为Atkinson一致不平等指数。该系列中的第二个指数与Kolm不平等指数类似。这些指数的两个创新特点在于：在构建指数时并未对形式施加特定限制，且未考虑对现有指数进行任何转换以确保一致性。每个指数都将成就分布视为与相应的不足分布同样不平等。我们应用这些指数来研究50岁以上欧洲人在握力方面的不平等现象。

abstract.text: This paper examines the synthetic control method in contrast to commonly used difference-in-differences (DiD) estimation, in the context of a re-evaluation of a pay-for-performance (P4P) initiative, the Advancing Quality scheme. The synthetic control method aims to estimate treatment effects by constructing a weighted combination of control units, which represents what the treated group would have experienced in the absence of receiving the treatment. While DiD estimation assumes that the effects of unobserved confounders are constant over time, the synthetic control method allows for these effects to change over time, by re-weighting the control group so that it has similar pre-intervention characteristics to the treated group. We extend the synthetic control approach to a setting of evaluation of a health policy where there are multiple treated units. We re-analyse a recent study evaluating the effects of a hospital P4P scheme on risk-adjusted hospital mortality. In contrast to the original DiD analysis, the synthetic control method reports that, for the incentivised conditions, the P4P scheme did not significantly reduce mortality and that there is a statistically significant increase in mortality for non-incentivised conditions. This result was robust to alternative specifications of the synthetic control method.

10.1002/hec.3258.abstractZh: 本文探讨了合成控制方法与常用的差异差分估计方法之间的区别，在重新评估一种基于绩效的激励计划——质量提升计划背景下进行探讨。合成控制方法旨在通过构建控制单元的加权组合来估计处理效应，这代表了在未接受处理的情况下，处理组所经历的情况。虽然差异差分估计假设未观察到的混杂因素随时间保持不变，但合成控制方法允许这些效应随时间变化，通过重新加权控制组，使其在干预前的特征与处理组相似。我们将合成控制方法扩展到多个处理单元的卫生政策评估场景中。我们重新分析了最近一项研究，该研究评估了医院绩效激励计划对风险调整后医院死亡率的影响。与原始的差异差分分析相比，合成控制方法指出，在激励条件下，绩效激励计划并未显著降低死亡率；而在非激励条件下，死亡率出现了统计学上的显著增加。这一结果在采用不同合成控制方法的情况下仍然保持稳定。

abstract.text: The health of carers and others close to the patient will often be relevant to economic evaluation, but it is very rarely considered in practice. This may reflect a lack of understanding of how the spillover effect of illness can be appropriately quantified. In this study we used three different approaches to quantify health spillovers resulting from meningitis. We conducted a survey of 1218 family networks affected by meningitis and used regression modelling to estimate spillover effects. The findings show that meningitis had long-term effects on family members' health, particularly affecting the likelihood of family members reporting anxiety and depression. These effects extended beyond a single close family member. These findings suggest that vaccinating against meningitis will bring significant health benefits not just to those that might have contracted the illness but also to their family networks. In methodological terms, different approaches for quantifying health spillovers provided broadly consistent results. The choice of method will be influenced by the ease of collecting primary data from family members in intervention contexts.

10.1002/hec.3259.abstractZh: 护理人员及其他与患者关系密切的人们的健康状况往往与经济评估相关，但在实际工作中却很少被考虑。这可能是由于人们对疾病带来的溢出效应如何恰当量化缺乏了解。本研究采用了三种不同的方法来量化脑膜炎带来的健康溢出效应。我们对1218个受脑膜炎影响的家庭网络进行了调查，并采用回归模型来估算溢出效应。研究结果表明，脑膜炎对家庭成员的健康产生了长期影响，尤其是影响了家庭成员报告焦虑和抑郁的可能性。这些影响不仅限于某个近亲，而是涉及整个家庭网络。这些发现表明，接种脑膜炎疫苗不仅能为患病者带来显著的健康益处，也能为他们的家庭网络带来好处。从方法学角度来看，不同的量化健康溢出效应的方法得出了大致一致的结果。选择哪种方法将取决于在干预情境中收集家庭成员基本信息时的便利性。

abstract.text: We estimate the causal impact of having full health insurance on healthcare expenditures. We take advantage of a unique quasi-experimental setup in which deductibles and co-payments were zero in a managed care plan and nonzero in regular insurance, until a policy change forced all individuals with an active plan to cover a minimum amount of their expenses. Using panel data and a nonlinear difference-in-differences strategy, we find a demand elasticity of about -0.14 comparing full insurance with the cost-sharing model and a significant upward shift in the likelihood to generate costs.

10.1002/hec.3266.abstractZh: 我们估计了拥有全额医疗保险对医疗支出的因果影响。我们利用了一种独特的准实验设置，在这种设置中，管理式护理计划中的免赔额和共付额为零，而常规保险中的这些金额不为零，直到一项政策变更迫使所有拥有活跃保险计划的个体承担最低费用。通过面板数据和非线性差异-差异策略，我们发现与费用分摊模式相比，全额保险的需求弹性约为-0.14，并且产生费用的可能性显著上升。

abstract.text: Invoking Yaari's dual theory, we develop a model of individual vaccination decisions that incorporates quasi-hyperbolic discounting, risk aversion, and information. We test the resulting hypotheses for the flu season 2010/2011 using a representative German data set. We find a significant impact of time preferences on immunization decisions. The impact of the discount factor is significantly negative for exponential discounters. While present-biased individuals' demand for vaccination is not statistically different from the one of exponential discounters, future-biased individuals have a significantly higher probability to vaccinate. Stratification by gender reveals that these effects are entirely driven by men. That is, time preferences have no explanatory power for the vaccination decisions of women. This also applies to risk aversion, where more risk aversion implies a significantly higher probability to vaccinate for men but not women. All information measures turn out significant. Well-informed individuals have a much higher propensity to vaccinate than poorly informed individuals. If policy makers aim at improving immunization rates, then our results suggest that public policy should concentrate on providing easily accessible and concise information on the flu and the flu shot. Our results on time preferences and risk preferences imply a rather inactive role for public policy.

10.1002/hec.3268.abstractZh: 基于Yaari的双理论，我们开发了一个个体疫苗接种决策模型，该模型包含了准超线性折扣效应、风险厌恶和信息因素。我们使用一个代表性的德国数据集对2010/2011流感季节的假设进行了测试。我们发现时间偏好对疫苗接种决策有显著影响。对于指数折扣效应，折扣因子的负面影响显著。虽然当前偏好型个体对疫苗接种的需求与指数折扣型个体没有统计学上的差异，但未来偏好型个体接种疫苗的概率显著更高。性别分层分析显示，这些效应主要由男性驱动，即时间偏好对女性的疫苗接种决策没有解释力。风险厌恶效应也是如此，风险厌恶程度越高，男性接种疫苗的概率显著更高，而女性则不然。所有信息指标都显示出显著的影响。信息丰富的个体比信息贫乏的个体更倾向于接种疫苗。如果政策制定者旨在提高疫苗接种率，那么我们的研究结果表明，公共政策应侧重于提供易于获取且简洁的流感及流感疫苗相关信息。关于时间偏好和风险偏好的研究结果表明，公共政策在其中的作用相对较弱。

abstract.text: We analyze the existence and persistence of moral hazard over time to test the assumption of pent-up demand. We consider the effects of supplemental health insurance provided by a private insurer when added to compulsory public insurance that is already supplemented by private insurance. Using original panel data from a French mutuelle, we study the influence of insurance on all of the dimensions of healthcare expenditures: (1) the probability of using health care, (2) the number of uses conditional on use, and (3) the per unit cost of care. To conduct this study, we control, to the extent possible, for endogeneity because of adverse selection using the characteristics of our panel data. Our study allows us to confirm a positive and significant effect of the extra complementary health insurance on healthcare consumption, primarily in terms of the probability of using care. More interestingly, our results show that these effects are principally transitory mainly for the probability of using dental care and optical care and depend on income. Finally, we show that individuals did not postpone health care before enrollment.

10.1002/hec.3271.abstractZh: 我们分析了道德风险随时间存在的现象及其持续性，以验证“需求被压抑”的假设。我们研究了私人保险公司提供的补充健康保险对医疗支出的影响，这些保险与已经由私人保险补充的强制性公共保险相结合。利用来自法国互助保险组织的原始面板数据，我们研究了保险对医疗支出各个方面的影响：（1）使用医疗服务的概率；（2）使用服务时的次数；（3）每次服务的成本。为了进行这项研究，我们尽可能控制了因逆向选择问题导致的内生性问题，利用了我们的面板数据中的特征。我们的研究证实，额外的补充健康保险对医疗消费有积极且显著的影响，主要体现在使用医疗服务的概率上。更有趣的是，我们的研究结果表明，这些影响主要是暂时的，尤其是使用牙科和眼科服务的概率，并且这些影响取决于收入。最后，我们发现，在参保之前，个人并不会推迟医疗服务的需求。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes a randomized experiment that uses novel strategies to promote handwashing with soap at critical points in time in Peru. It evaluates a large-scale comprehensive initiative that involved both community and school activities in addition to communication campaigns. The analysis indicates that the initiative was successful in reaching the target audience and in increasing the treated population's knowledge about appropriate handwashing behavior. These improvements translated into higher self-reported and observed handwashing with soap at critical junctures. However, no significant improvements in the health of children under the age of 5 years were observed.

10.1002/hec.3273.abstractZh: 本文分析了一项随机实验，该实验采用创新策略在秘鲁的关键时刻推广使用肥皂洗手。研究评估了一项大规模的综合举措，该举措涉及社区和学校活动以及宣传 campaign。分析表明，该举措成功触达了目标受众，并提高了受干预人群对正确洗手行为的认知。这些改进体现在更高的自我报告和实际观察到的关键时刻使用肥皂洗手的情况上。然而，未观察到5岁以下儿童的健康状况有显著改善。

abstract.text: A cluster randomized experiment was undertaken testing two sets of interventions encouraging enrollment in the Individually Paying Program (IPP), the voluntary component of the Philippines' social health insurance program. In early 2011, 1037 unenrolled IPP-eligible families in 179 randomly selected intervention municipalities were given an information kit and offered a 50% premium subsidy valid until the end of 2011; 383 IPP-eligible families in 64 control municipalities were not. In February 2012, the 787 families in the intervention sites who were still IPP-eligible but had not enrolled had their vouchers extended, were resent the enrollment kits and received SMS reminders. Half the group also received a 'handholding' intervention: in the endline interview, the enumerator offered to help complete the enrollment form, deliver it to the insurer's office in the provincial capital, and mail the membership cards. The main intervention raised the enrollment rate by 3 percentage points (ppts) (p = 0.11), with an 8 ppt larger effect (p < 0.01) among city-dwellers, consistent with travel time to the insurance office affecting enrollment. The handholding intervention raised enrollment by 29 ppts (p < 0.01), with a smaller effect (p < 0.01) among city-dwellers, likely because of shorter travel times, and higher education levels facilitating unaided completion of the enrollment form. Copyright © The World Bank Health Economics

10.1002/hec.3291.abstractZh: 进行了一项群集随机实验，测试了两组干预措施对鼓励菲律宾社会健康保险计划中的个人支付计划（IPP）注册的影响。2011年初，在179个随机选定的干预市镇中，有1037个未注册IPP资格的家庭获得了信息手册，并获得了截至2011年底有效的50%保费补贴；而在64个对照市镇中，有383个符合IPP资格的家庭并未获得此类支持。2012年2月，在干预地区中，仍有资格注册但未注册的家庭获得了续期凭证、注册手册以及短信提醒。其中一半的家庭还接受了“协助注册”的干预措施：在最终访谈中，工作人员主动提出帮助填写注册表格、将其送到省级城市的保险公司办公室，并邮寄会员卡。主要干预措施使注册率提高了3个百分点（p = 0.11），在城市居住者中这一效果更为显著，达到了8个百分点（p < 0.01），这可能与前往保险公司办事的时间有关。协助注册措施使注册率提高了29个百分点（p < 0.01），但在城市居住者中这一效果较小，可能是因为他们的出行时间较短，且受教育程度较高，能够独立完成注册表格的填写。版权所有 © 世界银行健康经济学

abstract.text: Subsidized voluntary enrollment in government-run health insurance schemes is often proposed as a way of increasing coverage among informal sector workers and their families. We report the results of a cluster randomized experiment, in which 3000 households in 20 communes in Vietnam were randomly assigned at baseline to a control group or one of three treatments: an information leaflet about Vietnam's government-run scheme and the benefits of health insurance, a voucher entitling eligible household members to 25% off their annual premium, and both. At baseline, the four groups had similar enrollment rates (4%) and were balanced on plausible enrollment determinants. The interventions all had small and insignificant effects (around 1 percentage point or ppt). Among those reporting sickness in the 12 months prior to the baseline survey the subsidy-only intervention raised enrollment by 3.5 ppts (p = 0.08) while the combined intervention raised enrollment by 4.5 ppts (p = 0.02); however, the differences in the effect sizes between the sick and non-sick were just shy of being significant. Our results suggest that information campaigns and subsidies may have limited effects on voluntary health insurance enrollment in Vietnam and that such interventions might exacerbate adverse selection. Copyright © The World Bank Health Economics

10.1002/hec.3293.abstractZh: 政府运营的医疗保险计划中的补贴自愿参保通常被视为增加非正式部门工人及其家庭参保率的一种方式。我们报告了一项集群随机实验的结果，实验中，越南20个公社的3000户家庭在基线时被随机分配到对照组或三种干预措施之一：一份关于越南政府运营计划及医疗保险好处的宣传册；一种凭证，使符合条件的家庭成员每年保费享受25%的折扣；以及这两种措施的结合。在基线时，这四组的参保率相似（均为4%），并且在参保决定因素上处于平衡状态。所有干预措施的效果都很小且不显著（约1个百分点）。在基线调查前12个月内报告有疾病的人中，仅提供补贴的干预措施使参保率增加了3.5个百分点（p = 0.08），而综合干预措施使参保率增加了4.5个百分点（p = 0.02）；然而，患病者与未患病者之间的效果差异并不显著。我们的结果表明，信息宣传活动和补贴对越南自愿参保医疗保险的效果有限，而且这类干预措施可能会加剧逆向选择问题。版权所有 © 世界银行健康经济学

abstract.text: Purpose Estimating the incremental costs of scaling-up novel technologies in low-income and middle-income countries is a methodologically challenging and substantial empirical undertaking, in the absence of routine cost data collection. We demonstrate a best practice pragmatic approach to estimate the incremental costs of new technologies in low-income and middle-income countries, using the example of costing the scale-up of Xpert Mycobacterium tuberculosis (MTB)/resistance to riframpicin (RIF) in South Africa. Materials and methods We estimate costs, by applying two distinct approaches of bottom-up and top-down costing, together with an assessment of processes and capacity. Results The unit costs measured using the different methods of bottom-up and top-down costing, respectively, are $US16.9 and $US33.5 for Xpert MTB/RIF, and $US6.3 and $US8.5 for microscopy. The incremental cost of Xpert MTB/RIF is estimated to be between $US14.7 and $US17.7. While the average cost of Xpert MTB/RIF was higher than previous studies using standard methods, the incremental cost of Xpert MTB/RIF was found to be lower. Conclusion Costs estimates are highly dependent on the method used, so an approach, which clearly identifies resource-use data collected from a bottom-up or top-down perspective, together with capacity measurement, is recommended as a pragmatic approach to capture true incremental cost where routine cost data are scarce.

10.1002/hec.3295.abstractZh:
目的 在缺乏常规成本数据收集的情况下，估算低收入和中等收入国家新兴技术扩展的增量成本是一项方法上具有挑战性且需要大量实证研究的任务。我们采用一种最佳实践的方法，以南非Xpert Mycobacterium tuberculosis（MTB）/对riframpicin（RIF）耐药性的扩展为例，来估算这些技术的增量成本。  
材料与方法 我们通过采用自下而上和自上而下两种不同的成本估算方法，并结合对流程与能力的评估，来估算成本。  
结果 使用自下而上和自上而下两种方法分别估算出的Xpert MTB/RIF的单位成本分别为16.9美元和33.5美元，而显微镜检查的成本分别为6.3美元和8.5美元。Xpert MTB/RIF的增量成本估计在14.7美元到17.7美元之间。虽然Xpert MTB/RIF的平均成本高于使用标准方法的先前研究，但其增量成本却较低。  
结论 成本估算高度依赖于所使用的方法。因此，建议采用一种明确区分从自下而上或自上而下角度收集资源使用数据的方法，并结合能力评估，作为在常规成本数据稀缺情况下估算真实增量成本的实用方法。

abstract.text: Expanding essential health services through non-government organisations (NGOs) is a central strategy for achieving universal health coverage in many low-income and middle-income countries. Human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) prevention services for key populations are commonly delivered through NGOs and have been demonstrated to be cost-effective and of substantial global public health importance. However, funding for HIV prevention remains scarce, and there are growing calls internationally to improve the efficiency of HIV prevention programmes as a key strategy to reach global HIV targets. To date, there is limited evidence on the determinants of costs of HIV prevention delivered through NGOs; and thus, policymakers have little guidance in how best to design programmes that are both effective and efficient. We collected economic costs from the Indian Avahan initiative, the largest HIV prevention project conducted globally, during the first 4 years of its implementation. We use a fixed-effect panel estimator and a random-intercept model to investigate the determinants of average cost. We find that programme design choices such as NGO scale, the extent of community involvement, the way in which support is offered to NGOs and how clinical services are organised substantially impact average cost in a grant-based payment setting.

10.1002/hec.3296.abstractZh: 通过非政府组织扩大基本医疗服务是许多低收入和中等收入国家实现全民健康覆盖的核心策略。针对关键人群的人免疫缺陷病毒（HIV）预防服务通常由非政府组织提供，这些服务已被证明具有成本效益，并对全球公共卫生具有重要意义。然而，HIV预防的资金仍然匮乏，国际上也不断呼吁提高HIV预防项目的效率，以此作为实现全球HIV目标的关键策略。迄今为止，关于通过非政府组织提供HIV预防服务的成本决定因素的证据有限，因此，政策制定者在如何设计既有效又高效的计划方面缺乏指导。我们收集了印度Avahan计划在实施的前四年中的经济成本数据，该计划是全球最大的HIV预防项目。我们使用固定效应面板估计器和随机截距模型来研究平均成本的决定因素。研究发现，诸如非政府组织规模、社区参与程度、对非政府组织的支持方式以及临床服务的组织方式等计划设计选择，对基于拨款支付方式的成本有着显著的影响。

abstract.text: Model-based economic evaluations of new interventions have shown that user behaviour (uptake) is a critical driver of overall impact achieved. However, early economic evaluations, prior to introduction, often rely on assumed levels of uptake based on expert opinion or uptake of similar interventions. In addition to the likely uncertainty surrounding these uptake assumptions, they also do not allow for uptake to be a function of product, intervention, or user characteristics. This letter proposes using uptake projections from discrete choice experiments (DCE) to better parameterize uptake and substitution in cost-effectiveness models. A simple impact model is developed and illustrated using an example from the HIV prevention field in South Africa. Comparison between the conventional approach and the DCE-based approach shows that, in our example, DCE-based impact predictions varied by up to 50% from conventional estimates and provided far more nuanced projections. In the absence of observed uptake data and to model the effect of variations in intervention characteristics, DCE-based uptake predictions are likely to greatly improve models parameterizing uptake solely based on expert opinion. This is particularly important for global and national level decision making around introducing new and probably more expensive interventions, particularly where resources are most constrained.

10.1002/hec.3297.abstractZh: 基于模型的新型干预措施的经济评估表明，用户行为是影响整体效果的关键因素。然而，在引入这些干预措施之前的早期经济评估，往往依赖于基于专家意见或类似干预措施的用户接受情况的假设。除了这些假设可能存在的不确定性外，这些假设还无法将用户接受情况与产品、干预措施或用户特征联系起来。本文建议利用离散选择实验中的接受情况预测数据，以更好地在成本效益模型中参数化用户接受情况和替代情况。文中通过南非HIV预防领域的例子，阐述了一个简单的效果模型。比较传统方法与基于离散选择实验的方法后发现，在我们的例子中，基于离散选择实验的效果预测与传统估计值相差高达50%，并且提供了更为精细的预测结果。在缺乏实际接受数据的情况下，利用离散选择实验的预测数据可以显著改善仅基于专家意见进行模型参数化的效果。这一点对于在全球和国家层面决策时引入新型且可能更昂贵的干预措施尤为重要，尤其是在资源有限的背景下。

abstract.text: The opportunity cost of inappropriate health policy decisions is greater in Central and Eastern European (CEE) compared with Western European (WE) countries because of poorer population health and more limited healthcare resources. Application of health technology assessment (HTA) prior to healthcare financing decisions can improve the allocative efficiency of scarce resources. However, few CEE countries have a clear roadmap for HTA implementation. Examples from high-income countries may not be directly relevant, as CEE countries cannot allocate so much financial and human resources for substantiating policy decisions with evidence. Our objective was to describe the main HTA implementation scenarios in CEE countries and summarize the most important questions related to capacity building, financing HTA research, process and organizational structure for HTA, standardization of HTA methodology, use of local data, scope of mandatory HTA, decision criteria, and international collaboration in HTA. Although HTA implementation strategies from the region can be relevant examples for other CEE countries with similar cultural environment and economic status, HTA roadmaps are not still fully transferable without taking into account country-specific aspects, such as country size, gross domestic product per capita, major social values, public health priorities, and fragmentation of healthcare financing.

10.1002/hec.3298.abstractZh: 与西欧国家相比，中东欧国家因人口健康状况较差和医疗资源有限，不恰当的卫生政策决策所带来的机会成本更大。在医疗资金分配决策之前实施卫生技术评估（HTA）可以提高稀缺资源的配置效率。然而，中东欧国家中很少有国家拥有明确的HTA实施路线图。来自高收入国家的经验可能并不直接适用，因为中东欧国家无法投入如此多的财政和人力资源来用证据支持政策决策。我们的目标是描述中东欧国家主要的HTA实施场景，并总结与能力建设、HTA研究资金筹措、HTA的过程与组织结构、HTA方法的标准化、本地数据的使用、强制性HTA的范围、决策标准以及HTA领域的国际合作相关的重要问题。尽管该地区的HTA实施策略可以为具有类似文化环境和经济状况的其他中东欧国家提供借鉴，但HTA路线图在完全适用于其他国家的同时，仍需考虑各国特定的因素，如国家规模、人均国内生产总值、主要社会价值观、公共卫生优先事项以及医疗资金分配的碎片化等问题。

abstract.text: Policy makers in low-income and lower-middle-income countries (LMICs) are increasingly looking to develop 'evidence-based' frameworks for identifying priority health interventions. This paper synthesises and appraises the literature on methodological frameworks--which incorporate economic evaluation evidence--for the purpose of setting healthcare priorities in LMICs. A systematic search of Embase, MEDLINE, Econlit and PubMed identified 3968 articles with a further 21 articles identified through manual searching. A total of 36 papers were eligible for inclusion. These covered a wide range of health interventions with only two studies including health systems strengthening interventions related to financing, governance and human resources. A little under half of the studies (39%) included multiple criteria for priority setting, most commonly equity, feasibility and disease severity. Most studies (91%) specified a measure of 'efficiency' defined as cost per disability-adjusted life year averted. Ranking of health interventions using multi-criteria decision analysis and generalised cost-effectiveness were the most common frameworks for identifying priority health interventions. Approximately a third of studies discussed the affordability of priority interventions. Only one study identified priority areas for the release or redeployment of resources. The paper concludes by highlighting the need for local capacity to conduct evaluations (including economic analysis) and empowerment of local decision-makers to act on this evidence.

10.1002/hec.3299.abstractZh: 低收入和中低收入国家（LMICs）的政策制定者越来越倾向于采用“基于证据”的框架来确定优先的健康干预措施。本文综合并评估了有关方法论框架的文献，这些框架包含了经济评估证据，旨在为LMICs的医疗保健优先事项制定指导。通过对Embase、MEDLINE、Econlit和PubMed的系统性搜索，共识别出3968篇相关文章，并通过手动搜索又发现了21篇相关文章。共有36篇论文符合纳入标准，这些论文涵盖了广泛的健康干预措施，但只有两项研究涉及与融资、治理和人力资源相关的卫生系统强化措施。大约一半的研究（39%）采用了多种优先标准进行决策，最常见的是公平性、可行性和疾病严重程度。大多数研究（91%）都指定了“效率”的衡量标准，即每避免一个残疾调整生命年的成本。使用多标准决策分析和广义成本效益分析来识别优先健康干预措施是常见的做法。大约三分之一的研究讨论了优先干预措施的可负担性。只有一项研究确定了资源释放或重新部署的优先领域。本文最后强调了需要培养当地进行评估的能力（包括经济分析），并增强当地决策者依据这些证据做出决策的能力。

abstract.text: This study reports the systematic development of a population-based health screening package for all Thai people under the universal health coverage (UHC). To determine major disease areas and health problems for which health screening could mitigate health burden, a consultation process was conducted in a systematic, participatory, and evidence-based manner that involved 41 stakeholders in a half-day workshop. Twelve diseases/health problems were identified during the discussion. Subsequently, health technology assessments, including systematic review and meta-analysis of health benefits as well as economic evaluations and budget impact analyses of corresponding population-based screening interventions, were completed. The results led to advice against elements of current clinical practice, such as annual chest X-rays and particular blood tests (e.g. kidney function test), and indicated that the introduction of certain new population-based health screening programs, such as for chronic hepatitis B, would provide substantial health and economic benefits to the Thais. The final results were presented to a wide group of stakeholders, including decision-makers at the Ministry of Public Health and the public health insurance schemes, to verify and validate the findings and policy recommendations. The package has been endorsed by the Thai UHC Benefit Package Committee for implementation in fiscal year 2016.

10.1002/hec.3301.abstractZh: 本研究报告了为所有泰国人实施的基于人群的卫生筛查项目的系统性开发，该项目属于全民健康覆盖计划的一部分。为了确定可以通过卫生筛查减轻健康负担的主要疾病领域和健康问题，我们采用系统性、参与式且基于证据的方法，与41个利益相关方共同进行了为期半天的研讨会。在讨论过程中，确定了12种疾病/健康问题。随后，我们完成了包括系统回顾和荟萃分析在内的健康技术评估，以及相应基于人群的筛查干预措施的经济评估与预算影响分析。研究结果建议摒弃当前临床实践中的某些做法，例如每年进行胸部X光检查以及特定血液检测（如肾功能测试）。同时，研究指出，引入某些新的基于人群的卫生筛查项目，例如针对慢性乙型肝炎的筛查项目，将为泰国人带来显著的健康和经济效益。最终成果已向包括公共卫生部决策者以及公共卫生保险计划在内的众多利益相关方展示，以验证和确认研究结果及政策建议。该筛查项目已获得泰国全民健康覆盖计划委员会的认可，计划于2016财年实施。

abstract.text: Public health programmes tend to be complex and may combine social strategies with aspects of empowerment, capacity building and knowledge across sectors. The nature of the programmes means that some effects are likely to occur outside the healthcare sector; this breadth impacts on the choice of health and non-health outcomes to measure and value in an economic evaluation. Employing conventional outcome measures in evaluations of public health has been questioned. There are concerns that such measures are too narrow, overlook important dimensions of programme effect and, thus, lead to such interventions being undervalued. This issue is of particular importance for low-income and middle-income countries, which face considerable budget constraints, yet deliver a large proportion of health activities within public health programmes. The need to develop outcome measures, which include broader measures of quality of life, has given impetus to the development of a variety of new, holistic approaches, including Sen's capability framework and measures of subjective wellbeing. Despite their promise, these approaches have not yet been widely applied, perhaps because they present significant methodological challenges. This paper outlines the methodological challenges for the identification and measurement of broader outcomes of public health interventions in economic evaluation in low-income and middle-income countries.

10.1002/hec.3302.abstractZh: 公共卫生项目往往具有复杂性，可能结合社会策略与赋能、能力建设和知识方面的措施。这些项目的性质意味着某些效果可能发生在医疗保健领域之外；这种广度影响了在经济评估中衡量和评估健康与非健康成果的选择。在公共卫生评估中使用传统的结果衡量标准受到了质疑。人们担心这些衡量标准过于狭隘，忽视了项目效果的重要方面，从而导致这类干预措施被低估。这一问题对于低收入和中等收入国家尤为重要，这些国家面临巨大的预算限制， yet 在公共卫生项目中仍承担着大量健康活动的责任。需要开发包括生活质量在内的更广泛的结果衡量标准，这推动了各种新的、全面的方法的发展，包括Sen的能力框架以及主观福祉的衡量标准。尽管这些方法有潜力，但由于存在显著的方法论挑战，它们尚未得到广泛应用。本文概述了在低收入和中等收入国家进行经济评估时，识别和衡量公共卫生干预措施更广泛成果的方法论挑战。

abstract.text: Economic evaluation using dynamic transmission models is important for capturing the indirect effects of infectious disease interventions. We examine the use of these methods in low- and middle-income countries, where infectious diseases constitute a major burden. This review is comprised of two parts: (1) a summary of dynamic transmission economic evaluations across all disease areas published between 2011 and mid-2014 and (2) an in-depth review of mosquito-borne disease studies focusing on health economic methods and reporting. Studies were identified through a systematic search of the MEDLINE database and supplemented by reference list screening. Fifty-seven studies were eligible for inclusion in the all-disease review. The most common subject disease was HIV/AIDS, followed by malaria. A diverse range of modelling methods, outcome metrics and sensitivity analyses were used, indicating little standardisation. Seventeen studies were included in the mosquito-borne disease review. With notable exceptions, most studies did not employ economic evaluation methods beyond calculating a cost-effectiveness ratio or net benefit. Many did not adhere to health care economic evaluations reporting guidelines, particularly with respect to full model reporting and uncertainty analysis. We present a summary of the state-of-the-art and offer recommendations for improved implementation and reporting of health economic methods in this crossover discipline.

10.1002/hec.3303.abstractZh: 使用动态传播模型进行经济评估对于捕捉传染病干预措施的间接效应非常重要。我们研究了这些方法在低收入和中等收入国家中的应用，这些国家的传染病构成了主要的负担。本综述分为两部分：（1）2011年至2014年中期发表的所有疾病领域动态传播经济评估的总结；（2）针对蚊媒疾病研究的深入评估，重点探讨健康经济方法及其报告方式。研究通过系统检索MEDLINE数据库确定，并辅以参考文献筛选。共有57项研究符合纳入所有疾病领域的标准。最常见的研究主题是HIV/AIDS，其次是疟疾。研究采用了多种建模方法、结果指标和敏感性分析，表明缺乏标准化。在蚊媒疾病研究中，有17项研究被纳入。除了计算成本效益比或净效益外，大多数研究并未采用其他经济评估方法。许多研究没有遵循健康经济评估报告指南，特别是在完整模型报告和不确定性分析方面。我们总结了当前的最新技术，并提出了改进健康经济方法实施和报告的建议。

abstract.text: Out-of-pocket spending is increasingly recognized as an important barrier to accessing health care, particularly in low-income and middle-income countries (LMICs) where a large portion of health expenditure comes from out-of-pocket payments. Emerging universal healthcare policies prioritize reduction of poverty impact such as catastrophic and impoverishing healthcare expenditure. Poverty impact is therefore increasingly evaluated alongside and within economic evaluations to estimate the impact of specific health interventions on poverty. However, data collection for these metrics can be challenging in intervention-based contexts in LMICs because of study design and practical limitations. Using a set of case studies, this letter identifies methodological challenges in collecting patient cost data in LMIC contexts. These components are presented in a framework to encourage researchers to consider the implications of differing approaches in data collection and to report their approach in a standardized and transparent way.

10.1002/hec.3304.abstractZh: 在低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs），自付支出越来越被认为是获得医疗保健的重要障碍，因为这些国家的很大一部分医疗支出来自自付费用。新兴的全民医疗保健政策优先考虑减少贫困带来的影响，例如避免造成灾难性且使贫困加剧的医疗费用。因此，在评估特定医疗干预措施对贫困的影响时，贫困影响越来越被纳入经济评估之中。然而，在LMICs的干预性研究中，由于研究设计和实际限制，收集这些数据可能会面临挑战。本文通过一系列案例研究，指出了在LMIC环境中收集患者成本数据的方法学难题。这些难题被纳入一个框架中，以鼓励研究人员考虑不同数据收集方法的影响，并以标准化和透明的方式报告他们的研究方法。

abstract.text: We present a bibliometric analysis of recently published full economic evaluations of health interventions and reflect critically on the implications of our findings for this growing field. We created a database drawing on 14 health, economic, and/or general literature databases for articles published between 1 January 2012 and 3 May 2014 and identified 2844 economic evaluations meeting our criteria. We present findings regarding the sensitivity, specificity, and added value of searches in the different databases. We examine the distribution of publications between countries, regions, and health areas studied and compare the relative volume of research with disease burden. We analyse authors' country and institutional affiliations, journals and journal type, language, and type of economic evaluation conducted. More than 1200 economic evaluations were published annually, of which 4% addressed low-income countries, 4% lower-middle-income countries, 14% upper-middle-income countries, and 83% high-income countries. Across country income levels, 53, 54, 86, and 100% of articles, respectively, included an author based in a country within the income level studied. Biomedical journals published 74% of economic evaluations. The volume of research across health areas correlates more closely with disease burden in high-income than in low-income and middle-income countries. Our findings provide an empirical basis for further study on methods, research prioritization, and capacity development in health economic evaluation.

10.1002/hec.3305.abstractZh: 我们对该领域最近发表的完整健康干预措施的经济评估进行了文献计量分析，并批判性地探讨了研究结果对该领域发展的影响。我们创建了一个数据库，基于14个健康、经济及综合文献数据库，收集了2012年1月1日至2014年5月3日期间发表的文章，最终确定了2844项符合我们筛选标准的经济评估研究。我们分析了不同数据库中搜索结果的敏感性、特异性及附加价值。我们还研究了出版物在不同国家、地区及健康领域的分布，并比较了研究与疾病负担之间的相对关系。我们分析了作者的国籍、所属机构、发表期刊类型、语言以及所进行的经济评估类型。每年有超过1200项经济评估研究发表，其中4%针对低收入国家，4%针对中低收入国家，14%针对中高收入国家，而83%则针对高收入国家。在不同收入水平的国家中，分别有53%、54%、86%和100%的文章包含来自相应收入水平国家的作者。生物医学期刊发表了74%的经济评估研究。在高收入国家，不同健康领域的研究数量与疾病负担之间的相关性比在低收入和中收入国家更为密切。我们的研究结果为后续关于经济评估方法、研究优先级以及能力发展方面的研究提供了实证依据。

abstract.text: Global guidelines for new technologies are based on cost and efficacy data from a limited number of trial locations. Country-level decision makers need to consider whether cost-effectiveness analysis used to inform global guidelines are sufficient for their situation or whether to use models that adjust cost-effectiveness results taking into account setting-specific epidemiological and cost heterogeneity. However, demand and supply constraints will also impact cost-effectiveness by influencing the standard of care and the use and implementation of any new technology. These constraints may also vary substantially by setting. We present two case studies of economic evaluations of the introduction of new diagnostics for malaria and tuberculosis control. These case studies are used to analyse how the scope of economic evaluations of each technology expanded to account for and then address demand and supply constraints over time. We use these case studies to inform a conceptual framework that can be used to explore the characteristics of intervention complexity and the influence of demand and supply constraints. Finally, we describe a number of feasible steps that researchers who wish to apply our framework in cost-effectiveness analyses.

10.1002/hec.3306.abstractZh: 全球新技术的指导方针基于少数试验地点的成本和效果数据。国家层面的决策者需要考虑，用于制定全球指导方针的成本效果分析是否足够适用于他们的实际情况，或者是否需要使用能够考虑特定环境下的流行病学和成本异质性来调整成本效果结果的模型。然而，需求和供应限制也会通过影响护理标准以及任何新技术的使用和实施来影响成本效果。这些限制在不同环境下也可能存在显著差异。我们展示了两个关于引入新的疟疾和结核病诊断技术的经济评估案例研究。这些案例研究用于分析随着时间和需求与供应限制的变化，每项技术的经济评估范围是如何扩大的。我们利用这些案例研究来构建一个概念框架，以探讨干预复杂性的特征以及需求和供应限制的影响。最后，我们描述了一些可行的步骤，供希望在我们的框架下进行成本效果分析的研究人员参考。

abstract.text: Since the 1990s, community-based health insurance (CBHI) schemes have been proposed to reduce the financial consequences of illness and enhance access to healthcare in developing countries. Convincing evidence on the ability of such schemes to meet their objectives is scarce. This paper uses randomized control trials conducted in rural Uttar Pradesh and Bihar (India) to evaluate the effects of three CBHI schemes on healthcare utilization and expenditure. We find that the schemes have no effect on these outcomes. The results suggest that CBHI schemes of the type examined in this paper are unlikely to have a substantial impact on access and financial protection in developing countries.

10.1002/hec.3307.abstractZh: 自20世纪90年代以来，基于社区的医疗保险计划被提出，旨在减轻疾病的经济负担并提升发展中国家人们的医疗获取能力。然而，关于这些计划能否实现其目标的可靠证据却十分有限。本文利用在印度北方邦和比哈尔邦农村地区进行的随机对照试验，评估了三种基于社区的医疗保险计划对医疗利用和医疗支出的影响。研究发现，这些计划对这些结果并未产生显著影响。结果表明，本文所研究的这类基于社区的医疗保险计划，在发展中国家对医疗获取和经济保障的改善作用可能并不显著。

abstract.text: There are marked differences in methods used for undertaking economic evaluations across low-income, middle-income, and high-income countries. We outline the most apparent dissimilarities and reflect on their underlying reasons. We randomly sampled 50 studies from each of three country income groups from a comprehensive database of 2844 economic evaluations published between January 2012 and May 2014. Data were extracted on ten methodological areas: (i) availability of guidelines; (ii) research questions; (iii) perspective; (iv) cost data collection methods; (v) cost data analysis; (vi) outcome measures; (vii) modelling techniques; (viii) cost-effectiveness thresholds; (ix) uncertainty analysis; and (x) applicability. Comparisons were made across income groups and odds ratios calculated. Contextual heterogeneity rightly drives some of the differences identified. Other differences appear less warranted and may be attributed to variation in government health sector capacity, in health economics research capacity and in expectations of funders, journals and peer reviewers. By highlighting these differences, we seek to start a debate about the underlying reasons why they have occurred and to what extent the differences are conducive for methodological advancements. We suggest a number of specific areas in which researchers working in countries of differing environments could learn from one another.

10.1002/hec.3312.abstractZh: 在低收入、中等收入和高收入国家之间，进行经济评估的方法存在显著差异。我们概述了这些最明显的差异，并探讨了其背后的原因。我们从2012年1月至2014年5月期间发表的2844项经济评估的综合性数据库中，随机选取了来自每个收入组中的50项研究。数据在十个方法论领域进行了提取：(i) 指南的可用性；(ii) 研究问题；(iii) 视角；(iv) 成本数据收集方法；(v) 成本数据分析；(vi) 结果测量；(vii) 建模技术；(viii) 成本效益阈值；(ix) 不确定性分析；以及(x) 适用性。我们比较了不同收入组之间的数据，并计算了比值比。情境的异质性确实导致了部分差异的出现。其他差异则显得不太合理，可能归因于政府卫生部门能力的差异、卫生经济学研究能力的差异，以及资助者、期刊和同行评审者的期望差异。通过强调这些差异，我们试图引发关于这些差异发生的原因以及这些差异在多大程度上有助于方法论进步的讨论。我们建议，在不同环境下工作的研究人员可以在一些特定领域相互学习。

abstract.text: Healthcare expenditure growth is affected by important unobserved common shocks such as technological innovation, changes in sociological factors, shifts in preferences, and the epidemiology of diseases. While common factors impact in principle all countries, their effect is likely to differ across countries. To allow for unobserved heterogeneity in the effects of common shocks, we estimate a panel data model of healthcare expenditure growth in 34 OECD countries over the years 1980 to 2012, where the usual fixed or random effects are replaced by a multifactor error structure. We address model uncertainty with Bayesian model averaging, to identify a small set of robust expenditure drivers from 43 potential candidates. We establish 16 significant drivers of healthcare expenditure growth, including growth in GDP per capita and in insurance premiums, changes in financing arrangements and some institutional characteristics, expenditures on pharmaceuticals, population ageing, costs of health administration, and inpatient care. Our approach allows us to provide robust evidence to policy makers on the drivers that were most strongly associated with the growth in healthcare expenditures over the past 32 years.

10.1002/hec.3329.abstractZh: 医疗保健支出的增长受到诸如技术创新、社会因素的变化、偏好转变以及疾病流行病学等重要的未观测共同因素的影响。虽然这些共同因素原则上对所有国家都有影响，但它们在不同国家的影响可能会有所不同。为了考虑这些共同因素影响的未观测异质性，我们建立了一个包含34个经合组织国家1980至2012年数据的面板数据模型，用多因素误差结构替代了传统的固定效应或随机效应模型。我们通过贝叶斯模型平均法处理模型不确定性，从43个潜在候选因素中识别出一组具有代表性的支出驱动因素。我们确定了16个显著的医疗保健支出增长驱动因素，包括人均GDP的增长、保险保费的变化、融资安排的调整以及一些制度特征、药品支出、人口老龄化、医疗管理成本以及住院护理费用。我们的方法为政策制定者提供了关于过去32年间与医疗保健支出增长最相关的驱动因素的可靠证据。

abstract.text: In this prospective study, conducted in China where providers have traditionally been paid fee-for-service, and where drug spending is high and irrational drug prescribing common, township health centers in two counties were assigned to two groups: in one fee-for-service was replaced by a capitated global budget (CGB); in the other by a mix of CGB and pay-for-performance. In the latter, 20% of the CGB was withheld each quarter, with the amount returned depending on points deducted for failure to meet performance targets. Outcomes studied included indicators of rational drug prescribing and prescription cost. Impacts were assessed using differences-in-differences, because political interference led to non-random assignment across the two groups. The combination of capitated global budget and pay-for-performance reduced irrational prescribing substantially relative to capitated global budget but only in the county that started above the penalty targets. Endline rates were still appreciable, however, and no effects were found in either county on out-of-pocket spending.

10.1002/hec.3330.abstractZh: 在这项前瞻性研究中，研究对象位于中国，当地医疗服务提供者传统上按服务收费，药物支出较高，不合理用药现象较为普遍。研究将两个县的乡镇卫生中心分为两组：一组采用按服务收费的方式被总额预算制取代；另一组则同时采用总额预算制和绩效付费制度。在后者中，每季度会扣留20%的总额预算，返还金额取决于未能达到绩效目标而扣除的积分。研究关注的指标包括合理用药的程度和处方成本。由于政治干预导致两组之间的随机分配出现偏差，因此采用差异对差异的方法进行评估。结果表明，与仅采用总额预算制相比，总额预算制与绩效付费制度的结合显著减少了不合理用药现象，但这一效果仅在起始绩效目标较高的县中体现。不过，最终指标仍然存在明显差异，且两个县在自付费用方面均未发现明显影响。

abstract.text: In this paper, we investigate the relationship between cannabis use and attitudes to legalizing the use of cannabis. Predictions from theory provide a means of learning about the roles of information, self interest and regret in explaining differences in attitudes to legalization between those who currently use, those who have used in the past and those who have never used. Our empirical investigation suggests that users have a greater awareness of cannabis not being as harmful as abstainers think it is. This may explain why individuals are more inclined to be in favor of legalizing cannabis once they have used it themselves.

10.1002/hec.3340.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们探讨了大麻使用与对大麻合法化态度之间的关系。理论预测为我们提供了了解信息、自身利益与后悔在解释不同群体对大麻合法化态度差异中的作用的方式。我们的实证研究表明，使用者更清楚大麻并不像戒瘾者所认为的那样有害。这或许可以解释为什么那些曾经使用过大麻的人更倾向于支持大麻的合法化。

abstract.text: We evaluate the causal impact of an improvement in insurance coverage on patients' decisions to consult physicians who charge more than the regulated fee. We use a French panel data set of 43,111 individuals observed from 2010 to 2012. At the beginning of the period, none of them were covered for balance billing; by the end, 3819 had switched to supplementary insurance contracts that cover balance billing. Using instrumental variables to deal with possible non-exogeneity of the decision to switch, we find evidence that better coverage increases demand for specialists who charge high fees, thereby contributing to the rise in medical prices. People whose coverage improves increased their average amount of balance billing per consultation by 32%. However, the impact of the coverage shock depends on the supply of physicians. For people residing in areas where few specialists charge the regulated fee, better coverage increases not only prices but also the number of consultations, a finding that suggests that balance billing might limit access to care. Conversely, in areas where patients have a genuine choice between specialists who balance bill and those who do not, we find no evidence of a response to better coverage.

10.1002/hec.3347.abstractZh: 我们评估了保险覆盖范围的改善对患者选择收费高于规定标准的医生进行咨询的决策的因果影响。我们使用了2010至2012年间收集的43,111名个体的法国面板数据集。在这一时期开始时，没有人能够享受平衡计费服务；到结束时，有3819人转向了涵盖平衡计费的补充保险合同。通过使用工具变量来应对决策转换可能的不外生性，我们发现更好的保险覆盖增加了对高收费专家的需求，从而促进了医疗价格的上升。保险覆盖得到改善的人群，每次咨询的平均平衡计费金额增加了32%。然而，保险覆盖改善的影响取决于医生的供应情况。对于居住在少数专家按规定标准收费地区的居民来说，更好的保险覆盖不仅提高了价格，也增加了咨询次数，这一发现表明平衡计费可能会限制就医机会。相反，在患者能够在平衡计费专家和未进行平衡计费的专家之间做出选择的地区，我们没有发现对更好保险覆盖的响应。

abstract.text: The most significant pieces of the Affordable Care Act (exchanges, subsidies, Medicaid expansion, and individual mandate), implemented in 2014, were associated with sizable gains in coverage nationally that were divided equally between gains in Medicaid and private coverage. These national trends mask heterogeneity in gains by state Medicaid expansion status, age, income level, and source of coverage.

10.1002/hec.3349.abstractZh: 2014年实施的《平价医疗法案》中最重要的条款，包括医疗市场改革、补贴政策、医疗补助扩展以及个人健康保险强制规定，这些举措在全国范围内带来了显著的医疗覆盖率的提升，这一提升在医疗补助和私人保险覆盖率的提升之间实现了均衡。然而，这些全国性的趋势掩盖了不同州在医疗补助扩展状况、年龄、收入水平和保险来源方面的差异所带来的差异。

abstract.text: This paper studies risk selection between public and private health insurance when some, but not all, individuals can opt out of otherwise mandatory public insurance. Using a theoretical model, I show that public insurance is adversely selected when insurers and insureds are symmetrically informed about health-related risks, and that there can be adverse or advantageous selection when insureds are privately informed. Using data from the German Socio-Economic Panel, I find that (i) public insurance is, on balance, adversely selected under the German public health insurance with opt out scheme, (ii) individuals advantageously select public insurance based on risk aversion and residential location, and (iii) there is suggestive evidence of asymmetric information in the market for private health insurance.

10.1002/hec.3351.abstractZh: 本文研究了在部分而非所有个体可以选择退出强制性公共保险的情况下，公共保险与私人保险之间的风险选择问题。通过理论模型分析，我发现当保险公司和被保险人都对称地了解健康相关风险时，公共保险会被逆向选择；而当被保险人仅了解私人信息时，则可能出现逆向或正向的选择。基于德国社会经济面板数据的研究发现：(i)在德国具有退出机制的公共健康保险制度下，公共保险总体上被逆向选择；(ii)个体基于风险规避和居住位置选择公共保险时具有优势；(iii)在私人健康保险市场中，存在信息不对称的现象。

abstract.text: In this paper, we hypothesize that education is associated with a higher efficiency of health investment, yet that this efficiency advantage is solely driven by intelligence. We operationalize efficiency of health investment as the probability of dying conditional on a certain hospital diagnosis and estimate a multistate structural equation model with three states: (i) healthy, (ii) hospitalized, and (iii) death. We use data from a Dutch cohort born around 1940 that links intelligence tests at age 12 years to later-life hospitalization and mortality records. The results indicate that intelligent individuals have a clear survival advantage for most hospital diagnoses, while the remaining disparities across education groups are small and not statistically significant.

10.1002/hec.3356.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们假设教育与更高的健康投资效率相关，而这一效率优势完全由智力所驱动。我们将健康投资的效率定义为在特定医院诊断条件下死亡的概率，并构建了一个包含三个状态的多元结构方程模型：(i) 健康状态，(ii) 住院状态，以及(iii) 死亡状态。我们使用了来自荷兰一个1940年左右出生的队列的数据，该数据将12岁时的智力测试与后来的住院和死亡记录联系起来。研究结果表明，智力较高的个体在大多数医院诊断中具有明显的生存优势，而不同教育群体之间的其他差异较小，且不具有统计学意义。

abstract.text: Despite the claim that technology has been one of the most important drivers of healthcare spending growth over the past decades, technology variables are rarely introduced explicitly in cost equations. Furthermore, technology is often considered exogenous. Using 1996-2007 panel data on Swiss geographical areas, we assessed the impact of technology availability on per capita healthcare spending covered by basic health insurance whilst controlling for the endogeneity of health technology availability variables. Our results suggest that medical research, patent intensity and the density of employees working in the medical device industry are influential factors for the adoption of technology and can be used as instruments for technology availability variables in the cost equation. These results are similar to previous findings: CT and PET scanner adoption is associated with increased healthcare spending, whilst increased availability of percutaneous transluminal coronary angioplasty facilities is associated with reductions in per capita spending. However, our results suggest that the magnitude of these relationships is much greater in absolute value than that suggested by previous studies that did not control for the possible endogeneity of the availability of technologies.

10.1002/hec.3361.abstractZh: 尽管有观点认为技术是过去几十年医疗支出增长最重要的驱动因素之一，但技术变量在成本方程中很少被明确引入。此外，技术通常被视为外生变量。我们利用1996-2007年瑞士各地区的数据，评估了技术可用性对基本健康保险覆盖下的人均医疗支出的影响，同时控制了健康技术可用性的内生性。我们的研究结果表明，医学研究、专利强度以及从事医疗设备行业的员工密度是技术采用的重要影响因素，可以作为成本方程中技术可用性变量的工具变量。这些结果与先前的研究结果相似：CT和PET扫描仪的采用与医疗支出的增加相关，而经皮冠状动脉成形术设备的增加则与人均支出的减少相关。然而，我们的研究结果表明，这些关系的绝对值远大于那些未考虑技术可用性内生性的先前研究所提出的数值。

abstract.text: Neural tube defects are neurological conditions affecting one in 1000 fetuses in France each year. If a fetus is affected, there is a 90% chance that the pregnancy will be terminated. Increasing folic acid intake to 400μg per day 2months before and 2months after conception reduces prevalence rates by at least 40%. In 2005, France introduced a social marketing campaign seeking to increase the intake of folic acid by to-be-pregnant and pregnant women through information provision. This paper sets up a quasi-experimental setting to measure the impact of the French social marketing campaign on availability and preferences for folic acid. I combine detailed scanner data on grocery purchases with a dataset on macronutrients and micronutrients. The identification strategy exploits the variation in the usefulness of folic acid information between households: households that are pregnant or want to conceive a child use it, while those that are not pregnant do not. Results suggest evidence of a positive impact of the information campaign on folic acid household availability and preferences. A value per statistical neural tube defects case is found to be of at least 12 million.

10.1002/hec.3362.abstractZh: 神经管缺陷是一种神经系统疾病，每年在法国有千分之一的胎儿受到影响。如果胎儿患病，有90%的可能性需要终止妊娠。在受孕前2个月和受孕后2个月内，将叶酸摄入量增加到每天400微克，可以将患病率降低至少40%。2005年，法国开展了一项社会营销活动，通过提供信息来提高孕妇和计划怀孕女性的叶酸摄入量。本文采用准实验方法，测量法国社会营销活动对叶酸可获得性和使用意愿的影响。我们结合了详细的购物数据以及宏量营养素和微量营养素的数据集。研究策略利用了不同家庭对叶酸信息利用程度的差异：怀孕或计划怀孕的家庭会主动获取叶酸信息，而非怀孕的家庭则不会。研究结果表明，信息活动对叶酸在家庭中的可获得性和使用意愿产生了积极影响。每例神经管缺陷病例所需的叶酸量至少为1200万单位。

abstract.text: This analysis summarizes prior research and uses national, US state and county-level data from 1976 to 2013 to examine whether the mortality effects of economic crises differ in kind from those of the more typical fluctuations. The tentative conclusion is that economic crises affect mortality rates (and presumably other measures of health) in the same way as less severe downturns - leading to improvements in physical health. The effects of severe national recessions in the USA appear to have a beneficial effect on mortality that is roughly twice as strong as that predicted by the elevated unemployment rates alone, while the higher predicted rate of suicides during typical periods of economic weakness is approximately offset during severe recessions. No consistent pattern is obtained for more localized economic crises occurring at the state level - some estimates suggest larger protective mortality effects while others indicate offsetting deleterious consequences.

10.1002/hec.3373.abstractZh: 该分析总结了先前的研究，并使用了1976年至2013年的全国、美国州和县级数据，以探讨经济危机对死亡率的影响是否与较为典型的经济波动有所不同。初步结论是，经济危机对死亡率（以及其他健康指标）的影响方式与较轻微的经济衰退相同——即会导致身体健康的改善。在美国，严重的全国性经济衰退似乎对死亡率有积极的影响，其效果大约是单纯由高失业率所预测效果的两倍；而在经济疲软的典型时期，较高的自杀率在严重经济衰退期间被抵消了。对于发生在州一级的局部经济危机，并未发现一致的模式——一些估计表明其具有更大的保护性死亡率效应，而另一些则表明其具有相反的有害后果。

abstract.text: We investigate the health effects of short-term macroeconomic fluctuations as described by changes in unemployment rate, house, and stock market price indexes. The 'Great Recession' provides the opportunity to conduct this analysis as it involved contemporaneous shocks to the labor, housing, and stock markets. Using panel data from the Health and Retirement Study over the period 2004-2010, we relate changes in hypertension status to changes in state-level unemployment rate and house prices and to changes in stock market prices. We consider hypertension, a disease related to stress and of high prevalence among older adults, that has received little attention in the literature linking macroeconomic conditions to individual health. Our analysis exploits self-reports of hypertension diagnosis as well as directly measured blood pressure readings. Using both measures, we find that the likelihood of developing hypertension is negatively related to changes in house prices. Also, decreasing house prices lower the probability of stopping hypertension medication treatment for individuals previously diagnosed with the condition. We do not observe significant associations between hypertension and either changes in unemployment rate or stock market prices. We document heterogeneity in the estimated health effects of the recession by gender, education, asset ownership, and work status.

10.1002/hec.3374.abstractZh: 我们研究了短期宏观经济波动对健康的影响，这些波动表现为失业率、房价和股市指数的变化。“大衰退”为我们提供了进行此类分析的机会，因为它同时涉及了劳动力、房地产和股市的冲击。利用2004-2010年《健康与退休研究》的面板数据，我们将高血压状况的变化与州级失业率、房价以及股市价格的变化联系起来。高血压是一种与压力相关的疾病，在老年人群中发病率较高，但在将宏观经济状况与个人健康联系起来的文献中，这一疾病受到的关注较少。我们的分析利用了自我报告的高血压诊断结果以及直接测量的血压读数。通过这两种指标，我们发现房价的变化与高血压的发生概率呈负相关。此外，房价下降降低了先前被诊断出高血压的个体停止服用高血压药物的几率。我们没有观察到高血压与失业率或股市价格变化之间存在显著关联。我们还发现，不同性别、教育水平、资产拥有状况和工作状态的人群在受大衰退影响的健康状况方面存在差异。

abstract.text: Little is known about how health disparities by income change during times of economic crisis. We apply a decomposition method to unravel the contributions of income growth, income inequality and differential income mobility across socio-demographic groups to changes in health disparities by income in Spain using longitudinal data from the Survey of Income and Living Conditions for the period 2004-2012. We find a modest rise in health inequality by income in Spain in the 5 years of economic growth prior to the start of the crisis in 2008, but a sharp fall after 2008. The drop mainly derives from the fact that loss of employment and earnings has disproportionately affected the incomes of the younger and healthier groups rather than the (mainly stable pension) incomes of the groups over 65 years. This suggests that unequal distribution of income protection by age may reduce health inequality in the short run after an economic recession.

10.1002/hec.3375.abstractZh: 关于经济危机期间收入差异对健康状况的影响，目前了解甚少。我们采用分解方法，利用2004至2012年西班牙收入与生活条件调查的纵向数据，分析收入增长、收入不平等以及不同社会人口群体之间的收入流动性对西班牙收入差异变化的影响。研究发现，在2008年危机开始前的5年经济增长期间，西班牙的收入差异略有上升，但在2008年之后则出现了显著下降。这种下降主要源于失业和收入损失对年轻且健康的人群的影响更为严重，而非对65岁以上人群（其收入主要来自稳定的养老金）的影响。这表明，在经济衰退之后，按年龄分配的收入保障不平等可能会在短期内降低健康差异。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the causal impact of retirement on late-life mental health, a growing concern for public health, because major depressive disorders are the second leading cause of disability. We shed light on the role of economic conditions in shaping the effect of retirement on mental health by exploiting time and regional variation in the severity of the economic crisis across 10 European countries during 2004-2013. We use data from four waves of the Survey of Health, Ageing and Retirement in Europe and address the potential endogeneity of the retirement decision to mental health by applying a fixed-effects instrumental variables approach. The results indicate that retirement improves the mental health of men but not that of women. This effect is stronger for blue-collar men working in regions that have been severely hit by the economic crisis.
