These findings may be explained by the worsening of working conditions and the rise in job insecurity stemming from the economic downturn: under these circumstances, exit from the labour force is perceived as a relief.

10.1002/hec.3377.abstractZh: 本文探讨了退休对晚年心理健康的影响，这一议题日益受到公共卫生领域的关注，因为重度抑郁症是导致残疾的第二大原因。我们通过分析2004至2013年间10个欧洲国家经济危机的严重程度随时间及地区的变化，揭示了经济状况在影响退休对心理健康影响中的作用。我们采用了《欧洲健康、老龄化与退休调查》的四轮数据，并通过固定效应工具变量方法，探讨了退休决定与心理健康之间的潜在内生性关系。研究结果表明，退休有助于改善男性的心理健康，但对女性则没有这种效果。对于在受经济危机严重影响的地区工作的蓝领男性来说，这种效果更为明显。这些发现可能源于工作条件的恶化以及经济衰退导致的就业不稳定性增加：在这种情况下，退出劳动力市场被视为一种解脱。

abstract.text: This paper studies consumer learning in influenza vaccination decisions. We examine consumer learning in influenza vaccine demand within a reduced form instrumental variable framework that exploits differences in risk characteristics of different influenza viruses as a natural experiment to distinguish the effects of learning based on previous influenza vaccination experiences from unobserved heterogeneity. The emergence of a new virus strain (influenza A H1N1/09) during the 2009 'Swine flu' pandemic resulted in two different vaccines being recommended for distinct population subgroups with some people, who were not usually targeted by seasonal vaccination programs, being specifically recommended for the new Swine flu vaccine. We use these differences in vaccination targeting to construct instrumental variables for estimating the effect of past influenza vaccination experiences on the demand for pandemic vaccine. We find large causal effects of previous seasonal vaccination on pandemic vaccination. Causal effects of past influenza vaccination experiences on perceived vaccination safety are likely to be an important pathway linking past vaccination experiences with future vaccine uptake. Our results suggest a significant role of learning in vaccination decisions. Current efforts to expand seasonal vaccination may thus have potentially important long-term effects on future influenza vaccination levels and pandemic preparedness.

10.1002/hec.3379.abstractZh: 本文研究了消费者在流感疫苗接种决策中的学习行为。我们采用简化形式的工具变量框架来研究流感疫苗需求中的消费者学习行为，该框架利用不同流感病毒的风险特征差异作为自然实验，以区分基于先前流感疫苗接种经验的学习效应与未观察到的异质性效应。2009年“猪流感”大流行期间，一种新的病毒株（流感A H1N1/09）的出现导致两种不同的疫苗被推荐给不同的人群群体，其中一些通常不属于季节性疫苗接种目标的人群被特别推荐接种新的猪流感疫苗。我们利用这些疫苗接种目标差异来构建工具变量，以估计过去流感疫苗接种经验对大流行疫苗需求的影响。我们发现，过去的季节性疫苗接种对大流行疫苗接种具有显著的因果效应。过去流感疫苗接种经验对感知疫苗接种安全性的影响，可能是将过去疫苗接种经验与未来疫苗使用联系起来的重要途径。我们的研究结果表明，学习在疫苗接种决策中起着重要作用。因此，当前扩大季节性疫苗接种的努力可能对未来流感疫苗接种水平和大流行准备情况产生重要的长期影响。

abstract.text: Macroeconomic downturns can have an important impact on the receipt of informal and formal long-term care, because recessions increase the number of unemployed and affect net wealth. This paper investigates how the market for informal care changed during and after the Great Recession in Europe, with particular focus on the determinants of care receipt. We use data from the Survey of Health, Ageing and Retirement in Europe, which includes a rich set of variables covering waves before and after the Great Recession. We find evidence of an increase in the availability of informal care after the economic downturn when controlling for year and country fixed effects. This trend is mainly driven by changes in care provision of individuals not cohabiting with the care recipient. We also find evidence of several determinants of informal care receipt changing during the crisis - such as physical needs, personal wealth, and household structures.

10.1002/hec.3385.abstractZh: 宏观经济衰退对非正式和正式长期护理的接受程度有着重要影响，因为经济衰退会增加失业人数并影响净财富。本文研究了欧洲大衰退期间及之后非正式护理市场的变化，特别关注护理接受度的影响因素。我们使用了《欧洲健康、老龄化与退休调查》的数据，该数据包含丰富的变量，涵盖了大衰退前后各阶段的情况。研究发现，在控制年份和国家固定效应后，经济衰退后非正式护理的可用性有所增加。这一趋势主要由非与护理接受者同居的个体提供的护理服务变化所驱动。我们还发现，在危机期间，非正式护理接受度有几个变化因素，如身体需求、个人财富和家庭结构。

abstract.text: We use counterfactual analysis techniques to evaluate the impact of a $2 minimum unit price (MUP) on the distribution of Australian (Victorian) household off-trade alcohol purchases. Our estimates suggest that a $2 MUP significantly reduces the purchases of at-risk households by up to -0.92 [90% CI: -1.55, -0.28] standard drinks at the highest quantiles and has substantially less effect on households purchasing at light and moderate levels. A $2 MUP may reduce the proportions of male and female shoppers purchasing at the public health threshold of more than two standard drinks per household member per day by -3.03 [90% CI: -4.83, -1.22] percentage points (relative variation: -17%); and -1.85 [90% CI: -2.60, -1.10] percentage points (relative variation:-22%), respectively. Implementing an MUP on alcohol thus promises significant positive impacts on public health.

10.1002/hec.3388.abstractZh: 我们使用反事实分析技术来评估2美元最低单价对澳大利亚（维多利亚州）家庭非贸易性酒精饮料购买行为的影响。我们的估计表明，2美元的单价显著减少了高风险家庭在最高端购买量下的酒精饮料购买量，减少幅度高达-0.92[90%置信区间：-1.55, -0.28]标准饮品；而对购买量处于较低和中等水平的家庭的影响则相对较小。2美元的单价可能使男性与女性消费者在每户家庭成员每天超过两标准饮品的购买比例分别减少-3.03[90%置信区间：-4.83, -1.22]个百分点（相对变化：-17%）和-1.85[90%置信区间：-2.60, -1.10]个百分点（相对变化：-22%）。因此，实施2美元的酒精饮料最低单价政策有望对公共健康产生显著的积极影响。

abstract.text: This paper investigates whether leaving school in a bad economy deteriorates health in the long run. It focuses on low-educated individuals in England and Wales who entered the labour market immediately after the 1973 oil crisis. Our identification strategy relies on the comparison of individuals who left school at the compulsory age, were born in the same year and had a similar quantity of education - but whose school-leaving behaviour in different years (hence, different economic conditions) was exogenously implied by compulsory schooling laws. We provide evidence that, unlike school-leavers who did postpone their entry into the labour market during the recessions of the 1980s and 1990s, pupils' decisions to leave school at the compulsory age immediately after the 1973 oil crisis were not endogenous to the contemporaneous economic conditions at labour-market entry. We use a repeated cross section of individuals over the period 1983-2001 from the General Household Survey and adopt a lifecourse perspective, from 7 to 26 years after school-leaving. Our results show that poor economic conditions at labour-market entry are particularly damaging to women's health. For men, the health impact of poor economic conditions at labour-market entry is less obvious and not robust to all specifications.

10.1002/hec.3391.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在经济不景气时期辍学是否会在长期内损害健康。研究重点在于英格兰和威尔士那些在1973年石油危机后立即进入劳动力市场的低教育水平人群。我们的识别策略基于比较那些在法定年龄辍学、出生年份相同且受教育程度相近的人群——但他们在不同年份（即处于不同经济条件下）的辍学行为是由义务教育法外生决定的。我们的证据表明，与在1980年代和1990年代经济衰退期间推迟进入劳动力市场的辍学者不同，1973年石油危机后立即在法定年龄辍学的学生，其辍学决定并非由当时经济条件内生决定。我们利用了1983年至2001年间从综合家庭调查中获得的重复横截面数据，并采用生命历程视角，考察了从辍学后7年到26年的健康状况。研究结果表明，在劳动力市场进入时经济条件较差对女性的健康尤其有害。对于男性而言，经济条件较差对健康的负面影响则不那么明显，且在不同统计条件下结果并不稳定。

abstract.text: This paper studies in utero exposure to the 2008 financial crisis. Exploiting the sudden and unexpected collapse of the Icelandic economy, I find that first-trimester exposure to the crisis led to a sizable and significant reduction in birth weight, increased the probability of a low birth weight ( < 2500 g), and decreased the probability of a high birth weight ( > 4000 g). I also find evidence that the collapse reduced the sex ratio, indicating selection in utero due to maternal prenatal stress exposure. My results imply large welfare losses from financial distress that have hitherto been ignored - because children with worse health at birth can expect substantially lower lifetime earnings - and suggest that economic hardships may in general exacerbate income inequalities in the long run as low-income households are typically more exposed to financial distress.

10.1002/hec.3426.abstractZh: 本文研究了2008年金融危机在子宫内的影响。通过利用冰岛经济突然且出乎意料的崩溃这一事实，我发现妊娠早期暴露于危机中会导致出生体重显著下降，增加低出生体重（<2500克）的概率，并降低高出生体重（>4000克）的概率。我还发现，这场危机还改变了性别比例，表明由于母体在孕期所承受的压力，胎儿在子宫内就受到了选择性的影响。我的研究结果表明，由于出生时健康状况较差的儿童其终身收入可能会大幅降低，因此金融危机带来的福利损失是巨大的——而且，从长远来看，经济困难可能会加剧收入不平等，因为低收入家庭通常更容易受到金融危机的影响。

abstract.text: We exploit large exogenous changes in housing wealth to examine the impact of wealth gains and losses on individual health. In UK household, panel data house price increases, which endow owners with greater wealth, lower the likelihood of home owners exhibiting a range of non-chronic health conditions and improve their self-assessed health with no effect on their psychological health. These effects are not transitory and persist over a 10-year period. Using a range of fixed effects models, we provide robust evidence that these results are not biased by reverse causality or omitted factors. For owners' wealth gains affect labour supply and leisure choices indicating that house price increases allow individuals to reduce intensity of work with commensurate health benefits.

10.1002/hec.3431.abstractZh: 我们利用住房财富的巨大外部变化来研究财富增减对个人健康的影响。在英国家庭面板数据中，房价上涨使业主拥有更多的财富，这降低了业主出现一系列非慢性健康问题的可能性，并改善了他们的自我评估健康状况，而对他们的心理健康没有影响。这些效应并非短暂性的，在10年的时间内持续存在。通过一系列固定效应模型分析，我们提供了强有力的证据，表明这些结果并未受到反向因果关系或遗漏因素的干扰。对于业主而言，财富的增加会影响劳动力供给和休闲选择，这意味着房价上涨使得个人能够减少工作强度，同时获得相应的健康收益。

abstract.text: Although the majority of the literature has confirmed that recessions are beneficial for adults' health and babies' outcomes at delivery, this effect should not necessarily be the same for children. In this paper, we study the effect of business cycle conditions on infant underweight, overweight, and obesity. We exploit eight waves of repeated cross-sectional data (1987-2012) of the Spanish National Health Survey for children aged 2-15 and use the regional unemployment rate of the trimester of the interview as a proxy for the business cycle phase at the local level. We find that an increase in the unemployment rate is associated with lower obesity incidence, especially for children under 6 years old and over 12 years old. However, economic shocks also proof to have potentially negative consequences as they increase the prevalence of infant underweight for the same age groups. Moreover, we show that the possible mechanisms through which the cycle is impacting infant obesity is the nutritional composition of the children's diet, as well as, increases in the frequency of exercise. We provide some evidence that suggests that the impact of business cycle conditions on infant weight disorders have little objective health consequences in the short run. However, the potential long-term effects may become important as underweight during childhood is associated with worse outcomes later in life.

10.1002/hec.3434.abstractZh: 尽管大多数文献都证实经济衰退对成年人健康和婴儿出生结果有益，但这种影响并不一定适用于儿童。在本文中，我们研究了经济周期状况对婴儿体重过轻、过重和肥胖的影响。我们利用西班牙国家健康调查中的八波重复横断面数据（1987-2012年），这些数据涵盖了2-15岁的儿童，并将访谈时段的地区失业率作为经济周期阶段的代理指标。我们发现，失业率上升与肥胖发病率降低相关，尤其是在6岁以下和12岁以上的儿童中。然而，经济冲击也可能产生负面后果，因为它们增加了相同年龄组儿童体重过轻的患病率。此外，我们还发现，经济周期影响婴儿肥胖的可能机制包括儿童饮食的营养成分以及运动频率的增加。我们有一些证据表明，经济周期状况对婴儿体重障碍的影响在短期内对健康的客观影响较小。然而，潜在的长期影响可能会变得重要，因为儿童时期的体重过轻与日后较差的生活结果相关。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes the reasons for the scarce development of the private long-term care insurance market in Spain, and its relationship with health insurance. We are also interested in the effects the crisis has had both on the evolution of the demand for long-term care insurance and on the existence of regional disparities. We estimate bivariate probit models with endogenous variables using Spanish data from the Survey on Health and Retirement in Europe. Our results confirm that individuals wishing to purchase long-term care insurance are, in a sense, forced to subscribe a health insurance policy. In spite of this restriction in the supply of long-term care insurance contracts, we find its demand has grown in recent years, which we attribute to the budget cuts affecting the implementation of Spain's System of Autonomy and Attention to Dependent People. Regional differences in its implementation, as well as the varying effects the crisis has had across Spanish regions, lead to the existence of a crowding-in effect in the demand for long-term care insurance in those regions where co-payment is based on income and wealth, those that have a lower percentage of public long-term care beneficiaries, or those with a smaller share of cash benefits over total public benefits.

10.1002/hec.3440.abstractZh: 本文分析了西班牙私人长期护理保险市场发展滞缓的原因，以及其与健康保险之间的关系。我们还关注了危机对长期护理保险需求演变以及地区差异的影响。我们使用欧洲健康与退休调查中的西班牙数据，建立了包含内生变量的双变量Probit模型。研究结果表明，希望购买长期护理保险的个体在某种程度上被迫选择健康保险。尽管长期护理保险合同的供应存在限制，但我们发现近年来其需求有所增长，这归因于预算削减对西班牙自主照顾依赖者体系实施的影响。地区间在实施方面的差异，以及危机在不同西班牙地区产生的不同影响，导致在那些基于收入和财富进行共付的地区、公共长期护理受益人比例较低的地区，或现金福利在总公共福利中所占比例较小的地区，长期护理保险的需求出现了集聚效应。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes the impact of trans fat bans on cardiovascular disease (CVD) mortality rates. Several New York State jurisdictions have restricted the use of ingredients containing artificial trans fat in food service establishments. The resulting within-county variation over time and the differential timing of the policy's rollout is used in estimation. The results indicate that the policy caused a 4.5% reduction in CVD mortality rates, or 13 fewer CVD deaths per 100,000 persons per year. The averted deaths can be valued at about $3.9 million per 100,000 persons annually.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.09.005.abstractZh: 本文分析了反式脂肪禁令对心血管疾病死亡率的影响。纽约州的部分地区已限制食品服务场所使用含有人工反式脂肪的成分。通过分析各地区的随时间变化以及政策实施的时间差异，本文进行了估算。结果表明，该政策使心血管疾病死亡率降低了4.5%，即每年每10万人减少了13例心血管疾病死亡病例。这些避免的死亡病例每年可为地区带来约390万美元的经济效益。

abstract.text: During prime working years, women have higher expected healthcare expenses than men. However, employees' insurance rates are not gender-rated in the employer-sponsored health insurance (ESI) market. Thus, women may experience lower wages in equilibrium from employers who offer health insurance to their employees. We show that female employees suffer a larger wage gap relative to men when they hold ESI: our results suggest this accounts for roughly 10% of the overall gender wage gap. For a full-time worker, this pay gap due to ESI is on the order of the expected difference in healthcare expenses between women and men.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.09.008.abstractZh: 在职业生涯的黄金时期，女性的预期医疗保健支出高于男性。然而，在雇主提供的健康保险市场中，保险费率并不区分性别。因此，女性从提供健康保险的雇主那里获得的工资可能较低。我们的研究表明，持有健康保险的女性员工与男性相比，工资差距更大；我们的结果表明，这一差距约占整体性别工资差距的10%。对于全职员工来说，由于健康保险导致的工资差距与女性与男性之间的预期医疗保健支出差异相当。

abstract.text: Even though syphilis can be prevented effectively and treated inexpensively, it has remained a global public health problem. Untreated congenital syphilis results in neonatal death, stillbirth, preterm birth, or congenital deformities. Many developing countries have recently instituted syphilis prevention programs in antenatal care, but there has not been a systematic study of the effects of such programs. This paper is the first to study antenatal testing laws initiated in the U.S. in 1938-1947 which mandated physicians and other persons permitted by law to attend to a pregnant woman to test her for syphilis. We use the variation in the timing of state antenatal testing laws to estimate the laws' effect on neonatal mortality rates and deaths due to preterm birth. Using 1931-1947 Vital Statistics data, we find that these laws decreased neonatal mortality rates of nonwhites by 3.15 per 1000 live births (a 8.6% reduction) while having no discernible impact on whites. The laws contributed to an 18% narrowing of the white-nonwhite neonatal mortality gap by 1947. Using 1950 U.S. Census data, we find that mandatory antenatal testing led to a 7% increase in the cohort size of nonwhite poor, which is consistent with the neonatal mortality results. We find universal antenatal testing to be very cost-effective, with an estimated $7600 cost (in 2013 dollars) per life-year saved.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.09.011.abstractZh: 尽管梅毒可以有效预防且治疗费用低廉，但它仍然是一个全球性的公共卫生问题。未经治疗的先天性梅毒会导致新生儿死亡、死胎、早产或先天性畸形。许多发展中国家最近在产前护理中实施了梅毒预防计划，但关于这些计划效果的系统研究尚未进行。本文首次研究了美国于1938-1947年间实施的产前检测法律，该法律要求医生和其他依法被允许为孕妇进行梅毒检测的人员进行检测。我们通过分析各州产前检测法律实施时间的差异，来估算这些法律对新生儿死亡率和早产死亡率的影响。利用1931-1947年的生命统计数据，我们发现这些法律使非白人新生儿的死亡率降低了3.15例/1000例活产（即减少了8.6%），而对白人新生儿的影响则不明显。到1947年，这些法律使白人与非白人新生儿死亡率的差距缩小了18%。利用1950年美国人口普查数据，我们发现强制性的产前检测导致非白人贫困人群的数量增加了7%，这与新生儿死亡率的结果一致。我们认为，普及产前检测具有极高的成本效益，每挽救一个生命年，估计成本仅为7600美元（按2013年美元计算）。

abstract.text: In Volume 32, Issue 5 of this journal, Colman, Dee, and Joyce (CDJ) used data from the National Youth Risk Behavior Surveys (NYRBS) and found that parental involvement (PI) laws had no effect on the probability that minors abstain from sex or use contraception. We re-examine this question, augmenting the NYRBS with data from the State Youth Risk Behavior Surveys (SYRBS), and use a variety of identification strategies to control for state-level time-varying unmeasured heterogeneity. Consistent with CDJ, we find that PI laws have no effect on minor teen females' abstinence decisions. However, when we exploit additional state policy variation unavailable to CDJ and use non-minor teens as a within-state control group, we find evidence to suggest that PI laws are associated with an increase in the probability that sexually active minor teen females use birth control.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.10.002.abstractZh: 在本期刊第32卷第5期中，Colman、Dee和Joyce利用全国青少年风险行为调查的数据发现，家长参与法律对未成年人避免性行为或使用避孕措施的概率没有影响。我们重新研究了这个问题，补充了州级青少年风险行为调查的数据，并采用多种识别策略来控制州级时间变化的未测量异质性。与CDJ的研究结果一致，我们发现家长参与法律对未成年少女的性行为选择没有影响。然而，当我们利用CDJ未能提供的额外州政策差异，并将非未成年少女作为州内对照组时，我们发现家长参与法律与未成年少女使用避孕措施的概率增加有关。

abstract.text: We test for a causal role of social capital, as measured by self-reported trust, in determining access to basic health facilities in Sub-Saharan Africa. To skirt the reverse-causality problems between social capital and basic health, we rely on instrumental-variable (IV) estimates. A one standard-deviation increase in trust is predicted to lead to a 0.22 standard-deviation fall in doctor absenteeism, a 0.31 standard-deviation fall in waiting time and a 0.30 standard-deviation fall in bribes. As a robustness check, we also use a different database regarding a different health issue, access to clean water. We find that a one standard-deviation rise in trust leads to a 0.33 standard-deviation rise in access to clean water. The variety of public goods considered provides insights about the possible channels through which social capital is converted into health improvements.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.10.004.abstractZh: 我们研究了社会资本在决定撒哈拉以南非洲地区基本卫生设施获取方面的作用，社会资本是通过自我报告的信任度来衡量的。为了规避社会资本与基本卫生设施之间的关系中的反向因果关系问题，我们采用了工具变量估计方法。研究发现，信任度每提高一个标准差，医生缺勤率会下降0.22个标准差，等待时间会缩短0.31个标准差，贿赂行为也会减少0.30个标准差。作为稳健性检验，我们还使用了另一个关于清洁水获取问题的数据库。结果发现，信任度每提高一个标准差，清洁水的获取量会增加0.33个标准差。这些关于不同公共产品的研究结果为我们了解社会资本如何转化为健康改善提供了重要线索。

abstract.text: Despite the rapidly aging population, relatively little is known about how cost sharing affects the elderly's medical spending. Exploiting longitudinal claims data and the drastic reduction of coinsurance from 30% to 10% at age 70 in Japan, we find that the elderly's demand responses are heterogeneous in ways that have not been previously reported. Outpatient services by orthopedic and eye specialties, which will continue to increase in an aging society, are particularly price responsive and account for a large share of the spending increase. Lower cost sharing increases demand for brand-name drugs but not for generics. These high price elasticities may call for different cost-sharing rules for these services. Patient health status also matters: receiving medical services appears more discretionary for the healthy than the sick in the outpatient setting. Finally, we found no evidence that additional medical spending improved short-term health outcomes.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.10.005.abstractZh: 尽管人口迅速老龄化，但关于费用分担如何影响老年人的医疗支出，我们知之甚少。通过利用纵向索赔数据以及日本在70岁时将共付额从30%降至10%的变化，我们发现老年人的需求反应具有之前未报道的异质性。在老龄化社会中，骨科和眼科等门诊服务的需求对价格变化尤为敏感，这些服务占医疗支出增长的很大比例。较低的费用分担比例会增加对品牌药品的需求，而对仿制药的需求则不会增加。这些高度的价格弹性可能需要为这些服务制定不同的费用分担规则。患者的健康状况也起着重要作用：在门诊环境中，健康的人比病人更能够自主选择接受医疗服务。最后，我们没有发现额外的医疗支出能改善短期健康结果。

abstract.text: The use of genetic markers as instrumental variables (IV) is receiving increasing attention from economists, statisticians, epidemiologists and social scientists. Although IV is commonly used in economics, the appropriate conditions for the use of genetic variants as instruments have not been well defined. The increasing availability of biomedical data, however, makes understanding of these conditions crucial to the successful use of genotypes as instruments. We combine the econometric IV literature with that from genetic epidemiology, and discuss the biological conditions and IV assumptions within the statistical potential outcomes framework. We review this in the context of two illustrative applications.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.10.007.abstractZh: 将遗传标记作为工具变量在经济学、统计学、流行病学和社会科学领域得到了越来越多的关注。尽管工具变量在经济学中常被使用，但关于使用遗传变异作为工具变量的适当条件尚未得到明确界定。然而，随着生物医学数据的日益丰富，理解这些条件对于成功使用基因型作为工具变量至关重要。我们将计量经济学中的工具变量理论与遗传流行病学理论相结合，在统计潜在结果框架内讨论了生物学条件和工具变量假设。我们通过两个示例应用来进一步说明这一点。

abstract.text: While theoretical models on long-term care decisions assume that the health production function of dependent elderly depends positively on the care received, it has not received much attention in the empirical literature. We estimate the effects of both informal and formal home care on the mental health of elderly individuals in France needing help with daily activities. We adjust for the endogeneity of care with instrumental variables, using characteristics of adult children and geographical disparities in access to public long-term care coverage. The results show that informal care reduces the risk of depression of dependent elderly and that formal care increases their general mental health.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.10.008.abstractZh: 虽然关于长期护理决策的理论模型假设依赖的老年人在接受护理时，其健康产出功能会呈现正向依赖关系，但在实证文献中这一假设并未受到太多关注。我们研究了非正式和正式家庭护理对法国需要日常活动帮助的老人心理健康的影响。通过工具变量调整了护理的内生性，同时考虑了成年子女的特征以及公共长期护理覆盖范围的地理差异。研究结果表明，非正式护理可以降低依赖老年人群体患抑郁症的风险，而正式护理则能提升他们的整体心理健康水平。

abstract.text: This paper examines the long-term impact of exposure to Medicaid in early childhood on adult health and economic status. The staggered timing of Medicaid's adoption across the states created meaningful variation in cumulative exposure to Medicaid for birth cohorts that are now in adulthood. Analyses of the Panel Study of Income Dynamics suggest exposure to Medicaid in early childhood (age 0-5) is associated with statistically significant and meaningful improvements in adult health (age 25-54), and this effect is only seen in subgroups targeted by the program. Results for economic outcomes are imprecise and we are unable to come to definitive conclusions. Using separate data we find evidence of two mechanisms that could plausibly link Medicaid's introduction to long-term outcomes: contemporaneous increases in health services utilization for children and reductions in family medical debt.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.11.001.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在儿童早期接触医疗补助对成年人健康和经济状况的长期影响。由于各州采用医疗补助的时间不同，现在处于成年期的出生队列在累计接触医疗补助的时间上存在显著差异。对收入动态面板研究的分析表明，在儿童早期（0-5岁）接触医疗补助与成年人健康状况的显著改善有关，且这种效应仅在医疗补助计划所针对的亚群中显现。关于经济结果的研究结果并不明确，我们无法得出明确的结论。通过单独的数据分析，我们发现两种机制可能合理地将医疗补助的引入与长期结果联系起来：一是儿童健康服务的利用增加，二是家庭医疗债务减少。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the causal impact of retirement on the Body Mass Index (BMI) of adults aged 50-69 years old, on the probability of being either overweight or obese and on the probability of being obese. Based on the 2004, 2006 and 2010-2011 waves of the Survey of Health, Ageing and Retirement in Europe (SHARE), our identification strategy exploits variation in European Early Retirement Ages (ERAs) and stepwise increases in ERAs in Austria and Italy between 2004 and 2011 to examine an exogenous shock to retirement behavior. Our results show that retirement induced by discontinuous incentives in early retirement schemes causes a 12-percentage point increase in the probability of being obese among men within a two- to four-year period. We find that the impact of retirement is highly non-linear and mostly affects the right-hand side of the male BMI distribution. Additional results show that this pattern is driven by men retiring from strenuous jobs and by those who were already at risk of obesity. In contrast, no significant results are found among women.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.11.002.abstractZh: 本文估计了退休对50-69岁成年人体重指数（BMI）的因果影响，以及对超重或肥胖概率的影响，以及肥胖概率的影响。基于2004年、2006年和2010-2011年的欧洲健康、老龄化与退休调查数据，我们的研究策略利用欧洲提前退休年龄的变化，以及2004年至2011年间奥地利和意大利提前退休年龄的逐步增加，来考察退休行为的外部冲击。研究结果表明，由于提前退休计划中的不连续激励措施，退休导致男性在两年到四年内肥胖的概率增加了12个百分点。我们发现，退休的影响具有高度非线性，主要影响男性BMI分布的右侧部分。此外，研究还发现，这种模式主要由从繁重工作中退休的男性以及那些已经面临肥胖风险的男性所导致。相比之下，女性则没有显示出显著的影响。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the long-term health effects of Vietnam-era military service using Australia's National conscription lotteries for identification. Our primary contribution is the quality and breadth of our health outcomes. We use several administrative sources, containing a near-universe of records on mortality (1994-2011), cancer diagnoses (1982-2008), and emergency hospital presentations (2005-2010). We also analyse a range of self-reported morbidity indicators (2006-2009). We find no significant long-term effects on mortality, cancer or emergency hospital visits. In contrast, we find significant detrimental effects on a number of morbidity measures. Hearing and mental health appear to be particularly affected.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.11.003.abstractZh: 本文利用澳大利亚的国民征兵抽签制度，估算了越南时代兵役对长期健康的影响。我们的主要贡献在于所收集的健康数据质量和覆盖范围。我们参考了多个行政数据来源，涵盖了1994年至2011年的死亡记录、1982年至2008年的癌症诊断数据，以及2005年至2010年的急诊住院记录。我们还分析了2006年至2009年间的一些自我报告的发病率指标。研究发现，兵役对死亡率、癌症发病率或急诊住院次数没有显著的长期影响。相反，我们发现一些发病率指标受到了显著的负面影响，其中听力健康和心理健康似乎受到了特别大的影响。

abstract.text: We present findings from a field experiment conducted at 40 elementary schools involving 8000 children and 400,000 child-day observations, which tested whether providing short-run incentives can create habit formation in children. Over a 3- or 5-week period, students received an incentive for eating a serving of fruits or vegetables during lunch. Relative to an average baseline rate of 39%, providing small incentives doubled the fraction of children eating at least one serving of fruits or vegetables. Two months after the end of the intervention, the consumption rate at schools remained 21% above baseline for the 3-week treatment and 44% above baseline for the 5-week treatment. These findings indicate that short-run incentives can produce changes in behavior that persist after incentives are removed.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.11.004.abstractZh: 我们展示了在40所小学进行的实地实验的结果，该实验涉及8000名儿童以及40万天的观察记录，旨在研究短期激励措施是否能够促使儿童养成饮食习惯。在3周或5周的时间内，学生因午餐时食用一份水果或蔬菜而获得激励。与平均基线水平39%相比，提供小额激励使至少食用一份水果或蔬菜的儿童比例翻了一番。干预结束后两个月，这些学校的消费率分别比基线水平高出21%（针对3周干预）和44%（针对5周干预）。这些结果表明，短期激励措施能够引发持久的行为改变，即使激励措施被取消后，这种改变仍然持续。

abstract.text: Measuring the total impact of health insurance receipt on household labor supply is important in an era of increased access to publicly provided and subsidized insurance. Although government expansion of health insurance to older workers leads to direct labor supply reductions for recipients, there may be spillover effects on the labor supply of uncovered spouses. While the most basic model predicts a decrease in overall household work hours, financial incentives such as credit constraints, target income levels, and the need for own health insurance suggest that spousal labor supply might increase. In contrast, complementarities of spousal leisure would predict a decrease in labor supply for both spouses. Utilizing a mid-1990s expansion of health insurance for U.S. veterans, we provide evidence on the effects of public insurance availability on the labor supply of spouses. Using data from the Current Population Survey and Health and Retirement Study, we employ a difference-in-differences strategy to compare the labor market behavior of the wives of older male veterans and non-veterans before and after the VA health benefits expansion. Although husbands' labor supply decreases, wives' labor supply increases, suggesting that financial incentives dominate complementarities of spousal leisure. This effect is strongest for wives with lower education levels and lower levels of household wealth and those who were not previously employed full-time. These findings have implications for government programs such as Medicare and Social Security and the Affordable Care Act.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.11.005.abstractZh: 在公共保险和补贴保险日益普及的时代，衡量健康保险领取对家庭劳动力供应总影响的重要性不言而喻。尽管政府向老年工人扩展健康保险会导致受惠者的劳动力供应减少，但这一政策可能对未覆盖的配偶的劳动力供应产生溢出效应。虽然最基本的模型预测整体家庭工作时间会减少，但诸如信贷限制、目标收入水平以及自身健康保险需求等经济激励因素表明，配偶的劳动力供应可能会增加。相反，如果配偶的休闲时间具有互补性，则可能会减少双方的劳动力供应。以20世纪90年代中期美国退伍军人的健康保险扩展为例，我们提供了关于公共保险可用性对配偶劳动力供应影响的证据。通过《当前人口调查》和《健康与退休研究》的数据，我们采用差异-差异策略来比较老年男性退伍军人及其非退伍军人配偶在VA健康福利扩展前后的劳动力市场行为。尽管丈夫的劳动力供应减少，但妻子的劳动力供应却增加了，这表明经济激励因素比配偶休闲时间的互补性更为重要。这种效应在受教育程度较低、家庭财富水平较低以及之前未从事全职工作的妻子身上最为明显。这些发现对政府项目如医疗保险、社会保障以及《平价医疗法案》具有启示意义。

abstract.text: Physical activity is crucial for maintaining and improving health, especially at advanced ages. While retirement increases the amount of time available for physical activity, there is only limited evidence regarding the causal effect of retirement on recommended levels of physical activity. Addressing this gap in the literature, we use data from the U.S. Health and Retirement Study to estimate the causal impact of retirement on meeting the federal government's 2008 Physical Activity Guidelines for Americans. Using official early and normal retirement ages as instruments for retirement, our causal IV analyses suggest significant positive effects of retirement on meeting the Guidelines. These effects are robust with regard to the treatment of unobserved individual-specific heterogeneity, the measurement of guideline compliance, the definition of retirement and respondents' health insurance status. We also show that the effects of retirement on physical activity are larger for persons with higher levels of education and wealth.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.12.001.abstractZh: 体育活动对于维持和改善健康至关重要，尤其是在高龄阶段。虽然退休增加了用于体育活动的時間，但关于退休对推荐体育活动水平的影响的因果效应，目前仅有有限的证据。为了填补这一文献空白，我们利用了美国健康与退休研究的数据，来估算退休对实现联邦政府2008年《美国人体育活动指南》目标的影响。通过将官方规定的提前退休年龄和正常退休年龄作为退休的衡量指标，我们的因果分析表明，退休对实现这些指南目标有显著的积极影响。这些影响在考虑未观察到的个体异质性、指南遵守情况的测量、退休的定义以及受访者健康状况等因素后仍然保持稳定。我们还发现，对于教育水平和财富较高的个体来说，退休对体育活动的积极影响更为显著。

abstract.text: We develop a flexible test for changes in the SES-mortality gradient that accounts for changes in the distribution of education, the most commonly used marker of SES. We implement the test for the period between 1984 and 2006 in the United States using microdata from the Census and other surveys linked to death records. Using our flexible test, we find that the evidence for a change in the SES-mortality gradient is not as strong as previous research has suggested. Our results indicate that the gradient increased for females during this time period, but we cannot rule out that the gradient among males has not changed. Informally, the results suggest that the changes for females are mainly driven by the bottom of the education distribution.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.12.002.abstractZh: 我们开发了一种灵活的测试方法，用于评估社会经济地位与死亡率之间关系的变化，该测试考虑了教育分布的变化——而教育分布通常是衡量社会经济地位的最常用指标。我们运用该测试方法，以1984年至2006年期间美国的微观数据为基础，结合人口普查及其他与死亡记录相关的调查数据进行了分析。通过我们的灵活测试，我们发现社会经济地位与死亡率之间关系的变化并不像先前研究所认为的那样显著。我们的研究结果表明，在这段时间里，女性的社会经济地位与死亡率之间的关系有所恶化，但我们无法排除男性之间这种关系没有变化的可能性。从非正式的角度来看，这些结果表明，女性社会经济地位与死亡率之间关系的变化主要受到教育分布较低端因素的影响。

abstract.text: We provide a theoretical framework to contribute to the current debate regarding the tendency of pharmaceutical companies to direct their R&D toward marketing products that are "follow-on" drugs of already existing drugs, rather than toward the development of breakthrough drugs. We construct a model with a population of patients who can be treated with drugs that are horizontally and vertically differentiated. In addition to a pioneering drug, a new drug can be marketed as the result of an innovative process. We analyze physician prescription choices and the optimal pricing decision of an innovative firm. We also characterize the incentives of the innovative firm to conduct R&D activities, disentangling the quest for breakthrough drugs from the firm effort to develop follow-on drugs. Our results offer theoretical support for the conventional wisdom that pharmaceutical firms devote too many resources to conducting R&D activities that lead to incremental innovations.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.12.003.abstractZh: 我们提供了一个理论框架，以参与当前关于制药公司倾向于将研发资源投入到开发“后续药物”上的讨论，而不是开发突破性药物的辩论。我们构建了一个模型，其中患者群体可以通过横向和纵向差异化的药物得到治疗。除了开创性药物外，新药物也可以作为创新过程的结果而上市。我们分析了医生处方选择以及创新企业的最优定价决策。我们还描述了创新企业进行研发活动的动机，区分了追求突破性药物与企业开发后续药物之间的努力。我们的研究结果为传统观点提供了理论支持，即制药公司投入了过多的资源在导致渐进性创新的研发活动上。

abstract.text: "Consumer-Directed" Health Plans (CDHPs), those with high deductibles and personal medical accounts, are intended to reduce health care spending through greater patient cost exposure. Prior research agrees that in the first year, CDHPs reduce spending. There is little research and in it results are mixed regarding the impact of CDHPs over the longer term. We add to this literature with an intent-to-treat, difference-in-differences analysis of health care spending over up to three years post CDHP offer among 13 million person-years of data from 54 large US firms, half of which offered CDHPs. To strengthen the identification, we balance observables over time within firm, by developing weights through a machine learning algorithm, generalized boosted regression. We find that spending is reduced for those in firms offering CDHPs in all three years post offer relative to firms continuing to offer lower-deductible plans. The reductions are driven by spending decreases in outpatient care and pharmaceuticals, with no evidence of increases in emergency department or inpatient care over the three-year window.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.01.001.abstractZh: “以消费者为导向”的健康计划（CDHPs），即那些具有较高免赔额和个人医疗账户的计划，旨在通过增加患者的成本负担来减少医疗保健支出。先前的研究一致认为，在最初的一年里，CDHPs能够减少支出。然而，关于CDHPs长期影响的研究很少，且研究结果不一。我们通过对来自54家美国大型企业的1300万个人年的数据进行了意向性、差异比较分析，以进一步研究CDHPs实施后的三年间医疗保健支出变化。为了加强研究的可识别性，我们通过机器学习算法——广义提升回归法，在企业内部随时间推移对可观测变量进行了加权处理。研究发现，与继续提供低免赔额计划的企业相比，提供CDHPs的企业在计划实施后的所有三年时间里，医疗保健支出均有所减少。这种减少主要源于门诊护理和药品支出的下降，而在三年时间内，急诊科或住院护理的支出并未出现增加。

abstract.text: This paper provides empirical evidence on the role of public health insurance in mitigating adverse outcomes associated with health shocks. Exploiting the rollout of a universal health insurance program in rural China, I find that total household income and consumption are fully insured against health shocks even without access to health insurance. Household labor supply is an important insurance mechanism against health shocks. Access to health insurance helps households to maintain investment in children's human capital during negative health shocks, which suggests that one benefit of health insurance could arise from reducing the use of costly smoothing mechanisms.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.01.002.abstractZh: 本文提供了关于公共健康保险在减轻健康冲击相关不良后果中的作用方面的实证证据。通过研究中国农村地区普及健康保险计划的实施情况，我发现即使没有健康保险，家庭总收入和消费也能得到充分保障，以抵御健康冲击。家庭劳动力供应是抵御健康冲击的重要保险机制。获得健康保险有助于家庭在健康冲击期间继续投资于儿童人力资本，这表明健康保险的一个好处可能是减少昂贵的平滑机制的使用。

abstract.text: We determine the optimal health policy mix when the average utility of patients increases with the supply of drugs available in a therapeutic class. Health risk coverage relies on two instruments, copayment and reference pricing, both of which affect the risk associated with health expenses and diversity of treatment. For a fixed supply of drugs, the reference pricing policy aims at minimizing expenses, in which case the equilibrium price of drugs is independent of the copayment rate. However, with an endogenous supply of drugs, diversity of treatment may susbtitute for insurance so that the reference pricing may depart from maximal cost-containment in order to promote entry. We next analyze the determinants of the optimal policy. While an increase in risk aversion, or in the side effect loss, increases diversity and decreases the copayment rate, an increase in entry cost decreases both diversity and the copayment rate.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.01.003.abstractZh: 我们确定了在治疗效果类别中，随着可用药物供应增加，患者平均效用提升时的最优健康政策组合。健康风险覆盖依赖于两种手段：共付额和参考定价，这两种手段都会影响与医疗支出相关的风险以及治疗方式的多样性。在药物供应固定的情况下，参考定价政策旨在最小化支出，此时药物的均衡价格与共付率无关。然而，在药物供应具有内生性的情况下，治疗方式的多样性可能会替代保险功能，使得参考定价可能会偏离最大成本控制的目标，以促进新进入者的参与。接下来，我们分析了决定最优政策的因素。风险厌恶程度的增加或副作用损失的减少会增加治疗方式的多样性并降低共付率，而进入成本的增加则会同时降低治疗方式的多样性和共付率。

abstract.text: We propose a measure of household exposure to particularly onerous medical expenses. The measure can be decomposed into the probability that medical expenditure exceeds a threshold, the loss due to predictably low consumption of other goods if it does and the further loss arising from the volatility of medical expenses above the threshold. Depending on the choice of threshold, the measure is consistent with a model of reference-dependent utility with loss aversion. Unlike the risk premium, the measure is only sensitive to particularly high expenses, and can identify households that expect to incur such expenses and would benefit from subsidised, but not actuarially fair, insurance. An empirical illustration using data from seven Asian countries demonstrates the importance of taking account of informal insurance and reveals clear differences in catastrophic medical expenditure risk across and within countries. In general, risk is higher among poorer, rural and chronically ill populations.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.01.004.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种衡量家庭面临特别高医疗开支风险的指标。该指标可以分解为三个部分：医疗开支超过某一阈值的概率、因其他商品消费不足而导致的损失，以及超过阈值后医疗开支的波动性所带来的额外损失。根据阈值的选择，该指标与一种基于参考依赖效用和损失厌恶的模型相一致。与风险溢价不同，该指标仅对特别高的开支敏感，能够识别出那些预期会面临此类开支的家庭，这些家庭可以从补贴性保险中受益，但这种保险并不符合精算公平原则。通过对七个亚洲国家数据的实证分析，我们验证了考虑非正规保险的重要性，并发现不同国家之间以及同一国家内部，灾难性医疗开支风险存在明显差异。总体而言，贫困、农村地区和慢性病患者面临的风险更高。

abstract.text: A critique of cash assistance programs is that beneficiaries may spend the money on "temptation goods" such as alcohol and tobacco. We exploit a change in the payment schedule of Peru's conditional cash transfer program to identify the impact of benefit receipt frequency on the purchase of temptation goods. We use annual household data among cross-sectional and panel samples to analyze the effect of the policy change on the share of the household budget devoted to four categories of temptation goods. Using a difference-in-differences estimation approach, we find that larger, less frequent payments increased the expenditure share of alcohol by 55-80% and sweets by 10-40%, although the absolute magnitudes of these effects are small. Our study suggests that less frequent benefits scheduling may lead cash recipients to make certain types of temptation purchases.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.01.005.abstractZh: 对现金援助计划的批评在于，受助者可能会将资金用于购买“诱惑性商品”，如酒精和烟草。我们利用秘鲁有条件现金转移计划支付安排的变化，来研究受益者领取福利的频率对购买诱惑性商品的影响。我们通过年度家庭数据，在横截面和面板样本中分析政策变化对家庭预算中四类诱惑性商品支出比例的影响。采用差异-差异估计方法，我们发现，更频繁但金额较小的支付会使酒精的支出比例增加55-80%，而糖果的支出比例增加10-40%，尽管这些影响的绝对数值较小。我们的研究表明，较少频率的福利发放可能会导致现金受助者进行某些类型的诱惑性购买。

abstract.text: We investigate an underexplored externality of crime: the impact of violent crime on individuals' participation in walking. For many adults walking is the only regular physical activity. We use a sample of nearly 1 million people in 323 small areas in England between 2005 and 2011 matched to quarterly crime data at the small area level. Within area variation identifies the causal effect of local violent crime on walking and a difference-in-difference analysis of two high-profile crimes corroborates our results. We find a significant deterrent effect of violent crime on walking that translates into a drop in overall physical activity.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.01.006.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个鲜被探讨的犯罪外部性：暴力犯罪对个人参与步行活动的影响。对于许多成年人来说，步行是唯一的常规体育活动。我们使用了2005年至2011年间英格兰323个小型区域的近100万人的样本数据，这些数据与这些小型区域的季度犯罪数据进行了匹配。区域差异分析揭示了当地暴力犯罪对步行活动的影响，而通过对两起备受关注的犯罪事件的差分差异分析进一步证实了我们的研究结果。我们发现，暴力犯罪对步行活动的抑制作用显著，这导致整体体育活动量下降。

abstract.text: In many markets, including the new U.S. Marketplaces, health insurance plans are paid by risk-adjusted capitation, sometimes combined with reinsurance and other payment mechanisms. This paper proposes a framework for evaluating the de facto insurer incentives embedded in these complex payment systems. We discuss fit, power and balance, each of which addresses a distinct market failure in health insurance. We implement empirical metrics of fit, power, and balance in a study of Marketplace payment systems. Using data similar to that used to develop the Marketplace risk adjustment scheme, we quantify tradeoffs among the three classes of incentives. We show that an essential tradeoff arises between the goals of limiting costs and limiting cream skimming because risk adjustment, which is aimed at discouraging cream-skimming, weakens cost control incentives in practice. A simple reinsurance system scores better on our measures of fit, power and balance than the risk adjustment scheme in use in the Marketplaces.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.01.007.abstractZh: 在许多市场中，包括新的美国市场，健康保险计划的支付方式是基于风险调整后的按人头付费模式，有时会结合再保险和其他支付机制。本文提出了一个框架，用于评估这些复杂支付体系中隐含的保险公司激励因素。我们讨论了适应性、权力和平衡性三个方面的因素，每个因素都针对健康保险领域存在的不同市场失灵问题。我们在对市场支付体系的研究中，采用了实证指标来衡量适应性、权力和平衡性。使用与开发市场风险调整机制类似的数据，我们量化了三类激励因素之间的权衡关系。我们发现，在限制成本和防止保费抽成之间存在着重要的权衡关系，因为风险调整机制旨在抑制保费抽成，但实际上却削弱了成本控制的激励作用。与市场上使用的风险调整机制相比，一个简单的再保险系统在适应性、权力和平衡性方面的表现更为优越。

abstract.text: In recent decades, most states' Medicaid programs have introduced disease management programs for chronically ill beneficiaries. Interventions assist beneficiaries and their health care providers to appropriately manage chronic health condition(s) according to established clinical guidelines. Cost containment has been a key justification for the creation of these programs despite mixed evidence they actually save money. This study evaluates the effects of a disease management program in Georgia by exploiting a natural experiment that delayed the introduction of high-intensity services for several thousand beneficiaries. Expenditures for medical claims decreased an average of $89 per person per month for the high- and moderate-risk groups, but those savings were not large enough to offset the total costs of the program. Impacts varied by the intensity of interventions, over time, and across disease groups. Heterogeneous treatment effect analysis indicates that decreases in medical expenditures were largest at the most expensive tail of the distribution.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.01.008.abstractZh: 近几十年来，大多数州的医疗补助计划为慢性病患者引入了疾病管理项目。这些干预措施帮助患者及其医疗保健提供者根据既定的临床指南妥善管理慢性健康状况。尽管有证据表明这些计划实际上能够节省费用，但成本控制一直是设立这些计划的主要理由。本研究通过利用一个自然实验来评估乔治亚州疾病管理项目的效果，该实验推迟了几千名受益人的高强度服务引入时间。对于高风险和中风险群体而言，医疗费用的月平均支出减少了89美元，但这些节省下来的费用不足以抵消整个项目的总成本。项目效果因干预强度的不同、时间推移以及疾病类型的差异而有所差异。异质性治疗效果分析表明，医疗费用减少幅度在分布最昂贵的群体中最明显。

abstract.text: We study the effects of labor intensive health care within a research and development (R&D) driven growth model with overlapping generations. Health care increases longevity, labor participation, and productivity, while it also diverts labor away from production and R&D. We examine under which conditions expanding health care enhances growth and welfare and establish mild conditions under which the provision of health care beyond the growth-maximizing level is Pareto superior.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.01.009.abstractZh: 我们研究在研发驱动的增长模型中，劳动密集型医疗保健对经济增长的影响，该模型涉及重叠世代。医疗保健能够延长寿命、提高劳动力参与率和生产率，但同时也使劳动力从生产和研发领域转移出去。我们探讨了在何种条件下，扩大医疗保健供给能够提升经济增长和福利水平，并确定了在何种温和条件下，超出经济增长最大化水平的医疗保健供给具有帕累托优势。

abstract.text: We model the labor market impact of the key provisions of the national and Massachusetts "mandate-based" health reforms: individual mandates, employer mandates, and subsidies. We characterize the compensating differential for employer-sponsored health insurance (ESHI) and the welfare impact of reform in terms of "sufficient statistics." We compare welfare under mandate-based reform to welfare in a counterfactual world where individuals do not value ESHI. Relying on the Massachusetts reform, we find that jobs with ESHI pay $2812 less annually, somewhat less than the cost of ESHI to employers. Accordingly, the deadweight loss of mandate-based health reform was approximately 8 percent of its potential size.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.01.010.abstractZh: 我们模拟了国家和马萨诸塞州“强制性规定”健康改革中关键条款对劳动力市场的影响：个人强制规定、雇主强制规定以及补贴措施。我们从“充分统计量”的角度描述了雇主赞助的健康保险（ESHI）的补偿差异，以及改革对福利的影响。我们将强制性规定的改革下的福利状况与个体不重视ESHI的替代情况下的福利状况进行了比较。基于马萨诸塞州的改革措施，我们发现实施ESHI的工作岗位每年少支付2812美元，这一数值略低于雇主因实施ESHI而承担的成本。因此，强制性规定的健康改革带来的无谓损失大约占其潜在规模的8%。

abstract.text: The fatality risk-money tradeoff that is the value of a statistical life (VSL) may vary with the nature of the fatality event. While all fatalities involve loss of future life expectancy, the morbidity effects and their duration may differ. This article analyzes fatality risks accompanied by morbidity effects of different duration to disentangle the mortality and morbidity components of VSL using data from the Census of Fatal Occupational Injuries (CFOI). The VSL is comprised of the sum of the value of the fatality risk and the value of the morbidity risk. Labor market valuations of morbidity risks are positive, even for fatalities that are caused by traumatic injuries. The value of the fatality risk is the dominant component of VSL, rather than the value of the morbidity risk.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.01.011.abstractZh: 统计生命价值（VSL）所代表的致命风险与金钱之间的权衡可能随致命事件的性质而变化。虽然所有致命事件都涉及未来预期寿命的丧失，但疾病的影响及其持续时间可能会有所不同。本文通过分析不同持续时间的致命风险与疾病影响，利用《致命职业伤害普查》的数据，来分离VSL中的死亡与疾病成分。VSL由致命风险的价值与疾病风险的价值之和构成。即使是由创伤性伤害导致的致命事件，对疾病风险的市场估值也是正的。在VSL中，致命风险的价值是主导成分，而非疾病风险的价值。

abstract.text: The research and development costs of 106 randomly selected new drugs were obtained from a survey of 10 pharmaceutical firms. These data were used to estimate the average pre-tax cost of new drug and biologics development. The costs of compounds abandoned during testing were linked to the costs of compounds that obtained marketing approval. The estimated average out-of-pocket cost per approved new compound is $1395 million (2013 dollars). Capitalizing out-of-pocket costs to the point of marketing approval at a real discount rate of 10.5% yields a total pre-approval cost estimate of $2558 million (2013 dollars). When compared to the results of the previous study in this series, total capitalized costs were shown to have increased at an annual rate of 8.5% above general price inflation. Adding an estimate of post-approval R&D costs increases the cost estimate to $2870 million (2013 dollars).

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.01.012.abstractZh: 通过对10家制药公司的调查，获得了106种随机选取的新药的研发成本数据。这些数据被用来估算新药和生物制剂开发的平均税前成本。在测试过程中被放弃的化合物的成本与获得市场批准的化合物的成本有关。据估计，每个获得批准的新化合物的平均自付成本约为13.95亿美元（2013年美元）。以10.5%的实际折现率将自付成本资本化至市场批准阶段，总的批准前成本估计为25.58亿美元（2013年美元）。与之前的研究结果相比，总资本化成本以每年8.5%的速度增长，高于一般价格通胀率。加上批准后研发成本的估算，总成本估计为28.7亿美元（2013年美元）。

abstract.text: When a patient arrives at the Emergency Room with acute myocardial infarction (AMI), the provider on duty must quickly decide how aggressively the patient should be treated. Using Florida data on all such patients from 1992 to 2014, we decompose practice style into two components: The provider's probability of conducting invasive procedures on the average patient (which we characterize as aggressiveness), and the responsiveness of the choice of procedure to the patient's characteristics. We show that within hospitals and years, patients with more aggressive providers have consistently higher costs and better outcomes. Since all patients benefit from higher utilization of invasive procedures, targeting procedure use to the most appropriate patients benefits these patients at the expense of the less appropriate patients. We also find that the most aggressive and responsive physicians are young, male, and trained in top 20 schools.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.01.013.abstractZh: 当一名患者因急性心肌梗死被送往急诊室时，值班医生必须迅速决定应以何种程度积极治疗该患者。利用1992年至2014年佛罗里达州的相关数据，我们将医疗实践风格分解为两个组成部分：医生对普通患者进行侵入性手术的概率（我们将其称为“治疗强度”），以及手术选择对患者特征的响应程度。研究表明，在同一家医院和不同年份中，由治疗强度较高的医生诊治的患者，其治疗成本始终更高，但治疗效果更好。由于所有患者都能从更频繁地使用侵入性手术中受益，因此针对最合适的患者进行手术选择，既能让这些患者受益，又能减少那些不太适合接受此类手术的患者所受的困扰。我们还发现，那些治疗强度最高且响应能力最强的医生，通常都是年轻男性，并且毕业于排名前20的医学院校。

abstract.text: We use a 1993 policy change in Israel's public healthcare system that lowered the eligibility age for amniocentesis to 35 to study the effects of financing of screening tests. Financing is found to have increased amniocentesis testing by about 35%. At ages above the eligibility threshold, utilization rates rose to roughly 33%, reflection nearly full takeup among prospective users of amniocentesis. Additionally, whereas below the age-35 threshold amniocentesis utilization rates increase with maternal age, this relation is muted above this age. Finally, no evidence is found that financing affects outcomes such as pregnancy terminations and births of children with Down syndrome. These results support the view that women above the eligibility threshold tend to refrain from acquiring inexpensive information about their degree of risk that absent the financing they would acquire, and instead, undergo the accurate and costly test regardless of additional information that noninvasive screening would provide.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.02.001.abstractZh: 我们研究了以色列公共医疗保健系统在1993年进行的政策调整对筛查测试融资影响的研究。调整后，羊膜穿刺术的资格年龄降低至35岁。研究发现，融资措施使羊膜穿刺术的测试率增加了约35%。在资格年龄门槛以上的人群中，使用率上升至约33%，这反映出潜在用户几乎完全接受了这项检查。此外，虽然低于35岁门槛时，羊膜穿刺术的使用率随母亲年龄的增加而上升，但在这一年龄以上，这种关系则有所减弱。最后，没有证据表明融资会影响诸如妊娠终止或出生唐氏综合征儿童等结果。这些结果支持了这样一种观点：在资格年龄门槛以上的人群，他们倾向于不获取关于自身风险程度的廉价信息，而是选择进行准确且昂贵的检查，而不考虑非侵入性筛查所能提供的额外信息。

abstract.text: Recent health care consolidation trends raise the important policy question whether improved emergency medical services and enhanced productivity can offset adverse quality effects from decreased access. This paper empirically analyzes how geographical distance from an emergency hospital affects the probability of surviving an acute myocardial infarction (AMI), accounting for health-based spatial sorting and data limitations on out-of-hospital mortality. Exploiting policy-induced variation in hospital distance derived from emergency hospital closures and detailed Swedish mortality data over two decades, results show a drastically decreasing probability of surviving an AMI as residential distance from a hospital increases one year after a closure occurred. The effect disappears in subsequent years, however, suggesting that involved agents quickly adapted to the new environment.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.02.002.abstractZh: 近期医疗服务的整合趋势引发了一个重要的政策问题：改善的紧急医疗服务和更高的生产效率是否能够抵消因就医渠道减少而带来的服务质量下降的影响。本文通过实证分析，探讨了与急诊医院的距离对急性心肌梗塞患者存活概率的影响，同时考虑了基于健康的空间排序以及医院外死亡率数据方面的限制。利用政策导致的医院距离变化，以及瑞典二十年的详细死亡数据，研究结果显示：在急诊医院关闭后一年内，随着居民距离医院的距离增加，急性心肌梗塞患者的存活概率会急剧下降。然而，这种影响在随后几年逐渐消失，这表明相关机构能够迅速适应新的环境。

abstract.text: For-profit hospitals in California contract out services much more intensely than either private nonprofit or public hospitals. To explain why, we build a model in which the outsourcing decision is a trade-off between cost and control. Since nonprofit firms are more restricted in how they consume net revenues, they experience more rapidly diminishing value of a dollar saved, and they are less attracted to a low-cost but low-control outsourcing opportunity than a for-profit firm is. This difference is exaggerated in services where the benefits of controlling the details of production are particularly important but minimized when a fixed-cost shock raises the marginal value of a dollar of cost savings. We test these predictions in a panel of California hospitals, finding evidence for each and that the set of services that private non-profits are particularly interested in controlling (physician-intensive services) is very different from those than public hospitals are particularly interested in (labor-intensive services). These results suggest that a model of public or nonprofit make-or-buy decisions should be more than a simple relabeling of a model derived in the for-profit context.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.02.003.abstractZh: 加利福尼亚州的营利性医院在服务外包方面的程度远高于私人非营利医院和公立医院。为了解释这一现象，我们构建了一个模型，其中外包决策是成本与控制之间的权衡。由于非营利企业在如何分配净收入方面受到更多限制，它们所节省的每一美元所带来的价值下降速度更快，因此它们对低成本但控制性较低的外包机会的吸引力低于营利性企业。在那些对控制生产细节至关重要的服务领域，这种差异更为明显；而当固定成本冲击提高每一美元成本节省的边际价值时，这种差异则被最小化。我们在加利福尼亚州的多家医院中进行了实证测试，发现这些预测得到了支持，并且私人非营利机构特别关注的那些服务领域（如需要大量医生的服务）与公立医院特别关注的领域（如劳动密集型服务）有很大不同。这些结果表明，关于公共或非营利机构采购决策的模型不应仅仅是对营利性背景下的模型进行简单的重新命名。

abstract.text: This paper takes a different approach to estimating demand for medical care that uses the negotiated prices between insurers and providers as an instrument. The instrument is viewed as a textbook "cost shifting" instrument that impacts plan offerings, but is unobserved by consumers. The paper finds a price elasticity of demand of around -0.20, matching the elasticity found in the RAND Health Insurance Experiment. The paper also studies within-market variation in demand for prescription drugs and other medical care services and obtains comparable price elasticity estimates.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.03.001.abstractZh: 本文采用不同的方法估算医疗服务的需求，以保险公司与医疗服务提供者之间的协商价格作为衡量指标。该指标被视为一种典型的“成本转移”指标，它会影响医疗计划的提供，但消费者无法观察到这一影响。研究发现，需求的弹性约为-0.20，这一数值与RAND健康保险实验中的结果相符。此外，本文还研究了市场上不同区域对处方药及其他医疗服务的需求差异，并得出了相似的价格弹性估计值。

abstract.text: Controlling for socioeconomic and geographic factors, under-5 mortality (5q0) in developing countries has been declining at about 2.7% per year, a high rate of 'technical progress'. This paper adduces theoretical and empirical reasons for rejecting the usual specification of homogeneous technical progress across countries and uses a panel of 95 developing countries for the period 1970-2000 to explore the consequences of heterogeneity. Allowing country-specific rates of technical progress sharply reduces the estimated income elasticity of 5q0 and points to country variation in technical progress as the principal source of the (large) cross-country variation in 5q0 decline. Education levels and physician coverage also contribute and are less affected than income of allowing country variation in technical progress. The paper concludes by decomposing 1970-2000 5q0 decline into its different sources for each country.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.03.002.abstractZh: 在控制社会经济和地理因素后，发展中国家的5岁以下儿童死亡率（5q0）年均下降约2.7%，这一速度属于“技术进展”的高水平。本文从理论和实证角度阐述了为何需要摒弃通常认为各国技术进展均质的假设，并利用1970至2000年间95个发展中国家的面板数据来探讨异质性的影响。允许各国技术进展存在差异显著降低了5q0的估计收入弹性，并表明技术进展的地域差异是5q0下降幅度存在较大跨国差异的主要原因。教育水平和医生覆盖率也对此有所贡献，且受影响的程度小于收入。文章最后将1970至2000年间5q0的下降幅度分解为各个国家的不同成因。

abstract.text: Over a billion people worldwide defecate in the open, with important consequences for early-life health and human capital accumulation in developing countries. We report a cluster randomized controlled trial of a village sanitation intervention conducted in rural Maharashtra, India designed to identify an effect of village sanitation on average child height, an outcome of increasing importance to economists. We find an effect of approximately 0.3 height-for-age standard deviations, which is consistent with observations and hypotheses in economic and health literatures. We further exploit details of the planning and implementation of the experiment to study treatment heterogeneity and external validity.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.03.003.abstractZh: 全球有超过十亿人露天排便，这对发展中国家的儿童早期健康以及人力资本积累产生了重要影响。我们报道了一项在印度马哈拉施特拉邦农村进行的村庄卫生干预的群组随机对照试验，旨在研究村庄卫生对儿童平均身高的影响，这一结果对经济学家来说非常重要。我们发现，村庄卫生对儿童身高的影响约为0.3个身高-年龄标准差，这一结果与经济和卫生领域的观察结果及假设一致。我们进一步利用实验的规划和实施细节，研究了处理异质性和外部效度。

abstract.text: We examine the effects of the 2010 Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act's (ACA) prohibition of preexisting conditions exclusions for children on job mobility among parents. We use a difference-in-difference approach, comparing pre-post policy changes in job mobility among privately-insured parents of children with chronic health conditions vs. privately-insured parents of healthy children. Data come from the 2004 and 2008 Survey of Income and Program Participation (SIPP). Among married fathers, the policy change is associated with about a 0.7 percentage point, or 35 percent increase, in the likelihood of leaving an employer voluntarily. We find no evidence that the policy change affected job mobility among married and unmarried mothers.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.03.004.abstractZh: 我们研究了2010年《患者保护与平价医疗法案》中禁止对患有慢性疾病的儿童排除其原有健康状况这一条款对父母就业流动性的影响。我们采用差异分解法，比较了在政策实施前后，患有慢性疾病的儿童的父母与患有健康儿童的父母的就业流动性变化。数据来源于2004年和2008年的收入与项目参与调查。在已婚父亲中，政策变化使得他们自愿离职的可能性增加了约0.7个百分点，即35%。我们没有发现政策变化对已婚和未婚母亲的就业流动性产生了影响。

abstract.text: An unhealthy good causes health issues in the long run. It creates a misperceived utility loss and increases health care costs. Conversely, a healthy good provides misperceived utility gains and reduces health care costs. Individuals differ in income and in their degree of misperception; they vote over a fat tax according to their misperceived utility. A fraction of the tax proceeds is "earmarked" to reduce health insurance premiums; the remainder finances a subsidy on the healthy good. This earmarking rule is determined to maximize welfare, anticipating the induced political equilibrium. The equilibrium fat tax is always lower than the utilitarian level. This is not necessarily true with a Rawlsian objective. The determination of the earmarking rule is complex. Even in the utilitarian case, it is not just used to boost political support for the fat tax. Instead, it may involve a tradeoff between fat tax and healthy good subsidy.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.03.005.abstractZh: 长期来看，不健康的商品会导致健康问题。它会导致人们对效用的误判，并增加医疗保健成本。相反，健康的商品则能带来对效用的误判，并降低医疗保健成本。个人在收入和对效用的误判程度上存在差异；他们会根据对效用的误判来选择是否支持高税收。税收收入的一部分被“专项用于”降低健康保险费用；其余部分则用于补贴健康商品。这种专项分配规则是为了最大化福利而确定的，同时也会考虑到由此产生的政治均衡。这种均衡下的高税收水平总是低于功利主义水平。不过，这一结论并不一定适用于罗尔斯主义的目标。专项分配规则的确定过程相当复杂。即使在功利主义的情况下，它也不只是为了增强对高税收的政治支持，还可能涉及高税收与健康商品补贴之间的权衡。

abstract.text: We introduce a general decomposition method applicable to all forms of bivariate rank dependent indices of socioeconomic inequality in health, including the concentration index. The technique is based on recentered influence function regression and requires only the application of OLS to a transformed variable with similar interpretation. Our method requires few identifying assumptions to yield valid estimates in most common empirical applications, unlike current methods favoured in the literature. Using the Swedish Twin Registry and a within twin pair fixed effects identification strategy, our new method finds no evidence of a causal effect of education on income-related health inequality.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.03.006.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种适用于所有形式的双变量排名依赖型社会经济不平等指数的一般分解方法，包括浓度指数。该技术基于重新中心化的影响函数回归，只需对经过转换的变量应用普通最小二乘法，其解释性相似。与文献中常用的方法不同，我们的方法在多数常见的实证应用中仅需较少的识别假设即可获得有效的估计结果。通过利用瑞典双胞胎登记数据以及双胞胎对内的固定效应识别策略，我们的新方法并未发现教育对与收入相关的健康不平等存在因果效应。

abstract.text: Despite condoms being cheap and effective in preventing HIV, there remains an 8billion shortfall in condom use in risky sex-acts. Social marketing organisations apply private sector marketing approaches to sell public health products. This paper investigates the impact of marketing tools, including promotion and pricing, on demand for male and female condoms in 52 countries between 1997 and 2009. A static model differentiates drivers of demand between products, while a dynamic panel data estimator estimates their short- and long-run impacts. Products are not equally affected: female condoms are not affected by advertising, but highly affected by interpersonal communication and HIV prevalence. Price and promotion have significant short- and long-run effects, with female condoms far more sensitive to price than male condoms. The design of optimal distribution strategies for new and existing HIV prevention technologies must consider both product and target population characteristics.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.04.001.abstractZh: 尽管避孕套价格低廉且能有效预防艾滋病病毒，但在高风险性行为中，避孕套的使用量仍存在80亿个的缺口。社会营销组织采用私营部门的营销手段来推广公共卫生产品。本文研究了1997年至2009年间，包括促销和定价在内的营销工具对52个国家男用和女用避孕套需求的影响。静态模型区分了不同产品之间的需求驱动因素，而动态面板数据估计方法则用于评估它们的短期和长期影响。不同产品受到的影响并不相同：女用避孕套不受广告的影响，但受人际沟通和艾滋病病毒流行率的影响较大。价格和促销对避孕套的需求有显著的短期和长期影响，女用避孕套对价格的变化更为敏感。对于新型和现有艾滋病病毒预防技术的最优分配策略设计，必须同时考虑产品特性和目标人群特征。

abstract.text: This paper performs several tests of decision analysis applied to the health domain. First, we conduct a test of the normative expected utility theory. Second, we investigate the possibility to elicit the more general prospect theory. We observe risk aversion for gains and losses and violations of expected utility. These results imply that mechanisms governing decisions in the health domain are similar to those in the monetary domain. However, we also report one important deviation: utility is universally concave for the health outcomes used in this study, in contrast to the commonly found S-shaped utility for monetary outcomes, with concave utility for gains and convex utility for losses.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.04.002.abstractZh: 本文对决策分析在健康领域的应用进行了多项测试。首先，我们对规范预期效用理论进行了检验。其次，我们探讨了引入更通用的前景理论的可能性。我们发现，无论是收益还是损失，都存在风险厌恶现象，且预期效用理论在某些情况下被违反。这些结果表明，健康领域中的决策机制与货币领域的机制类似。然而，我们也发现了一个重要的差异：在本研究中使用的健康结果中，效用普遍呈凹形，而货币结果通常呈现S形效用，即收益时效用为凹形，损失时效用为凸形。

abstract.text: Reference pricing intends to reduce pharmaceutical expenditures by increasing demand elasticity and stimulating generic competition. We develop a novel model where a brand-name producer competes in prices with several generics producers in a market with brand-biased and brand-neutral consumers. Comparing with coinsurance, we show that reference pricing, contrary to policy makers' intentions, discourages generic entry, as it induces the brand-name producer to price more aggressively. Thus, the net effect of reference pricing on drug prices is ambiguous, implying that reference pricing can be counterproductive in reducing expenditures. However, under price regulation, we show that reference pricing may stimulate generic entry, since a binding price cap weakens the aggressive price response by the brand-name producer. This may explain mixed empirical results on the competitive effects of reference pricing. Finally, we show that reference pricing may be welfare improving when accounting for brand preferences despite its adverse effects on entry and prices.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.04.003.abstractZh: 参考定价旨在通过提高需求弹性和刺激仿制药竞争来减少药品支出。我们开发了一个新模型，其中品牌生产商在具有品牌偏好和品牌中立消费者的市场中与多个仿制药生产商进行价格竞争。与共同保险相比，我们发现参考定价与政策制定者的意图相反，因为它会促使品牌生产商采取更激进的价格策略，从而抑制了仿制药的进入。因此，参考定价对药品价格的净影响是模糊的，这意味着参考定价在减少支出方面可能是适得其反的。然而，在价格管制下，我们发现参考定价可能会刺激仿制药的进入，因为价格上限可以削弱品牌生产商激进的价格反应。这或许可以解释关于参考定价竞争效果的混合性实证结果。最后，我们表明，在考虑品牌偏好的情况下，参考定价可能会提高福利，尽管它对仿制药进入和价格有负面影响。

abstract.text: Shortage is common in many markets, such as those for human organs or blood, but the problem is often difficult to solve through price adjustment, given safety and ethical concerns. In this paper, we study two non-price methods that are often used to alleviate shortage for human blood. The first method is informing existing donors of a current shortage via a mobile message and encouraging them to donate voluntarily. The second method is asking the patient's family or friends to donate in a family replacement (FR) program at the time of shortage. Using 447,357 individual donation records across 8 years from a large Chinese blood bank, we show that both methods are effective in addressing blood shortage in the short run but have different implications for total blood supply in the long run. We compare the efficacy of these methods and discuss their applications under different scenarios to alleviate shortage.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.05.001.abstractZh: 在许多市场中存在短缺现象，例如人体器官或血液市场。然而，考虑到安全和伦理方面的考虑，通过价格调整来解决这一问题往往较为困难。本文研究了两种常用于缓解血液短缺的非价格方法。第一种方法是通过移动短信通知现有献血者当前存在的短缺情况，并鼓励他们自愿献血。第二种方法是在短缺时，请求患者的家人或朋友参与家庭替代献血计划。我们基于一个大型中国血库在8年内的447,357条个人献血记录进行分析，发现这两种方法在短期内都能有效缓解血液短缺问题，但从长期来看，它们对总血液供应的影响有所不同。我们比较了这两种方法的有效性，并讨论了在不同情况下应用它们以缓解短缺问题的方法。

abstract.text: Restricted access to primary care can lead to avoidable, excessive use of expensive emergency care. Since 2013, partly to alleviate overcrowding at the Accident & Emergency (A&E) units of hospitals, the UK has been piloting 7-day opening of General Practitioner (GP) practices to improve primary care access for patients. We evaluate the impact of these pilots on patient attendances at A&E. We estimate that 7-day GP opening has reduced A&E attendances by patients of pilot practices by 9.9% with most of the impact on weekends which see A&E attendances fall by 17.9%. The effect is non-monotonic in case severity with most of the fall occurring in cases of moderate severity. An additional finding is that there is also a 9.9% fall in weekend hospital admissions (from A&E) which is entirely driven by a fall in admissions of elderly patients. The impact on A&E attendances appears to be bigger among wealthier patients. We present evidence in support of a causal interpretation of our results and discuss policy implications.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.05.002.abstractZh: 对初级医疗的限制可能导致不必要的、过度使用昂贵的急诊服务。自2013年以来，为了缓解医院急诊部门的过度拥挤，英国开始试点全科医生诊所的7天开放政策，以改善患者的初级医疗获取。我们评估了这些试点政策对患者急诊就诊的影响。研究表明，7天开放政策使试点诊所的患者急诊就诊次数减少了9.9%，其中周末的减少幅度最大，达到了17.9%。这种影响在病例严重程度上呈非单调分布，大多数减少发生在中度病例中。另一个发现是，周末的急诊入院人数也减少了9.9%，这主要是由于老年患者的入院人数减少所致。对较富裕患者的急诊就诊影响更为显著。我们提供了支持这些结果因果解释的证据，并讨论了政策含义。

abstract.text: We study the effects of cross-border patient mobility on health care quality and welfare when income varies across and within regions. We use a Salop model with a high-, middle-, and low-income region. In each region, a policy maker chooses health care quality to maximise the utility of its residents when health care costs are financed by general income taxation. In equilibrium, regions with higher income offer better quality, which creates an incentive for patient mobility from lower- to higher-income regions. Assuming a prospective payment scheme based on DRG-pricing, we find that lower non-monetary (administrative) mobility costs have (i) no effect on quality or welfare in the high-income region; (ii) a negative effect on quality but a positive effect on welfare for the middle-income region; and (iii) ambiguous effects on quality and welfare for the low-income region. Lower monetary mobility costs (copayments) might reduce welfare in both the middle- and low-income region. Thus, health policies that stimulate cross-border patient mobility can be counterproductive when regions differ in income.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.05.003.abstractZh: 我们研究了在地区间和地区内部收入存在差异的情况下，跨境患者流动对医疗保健质量和福利的影响。我们采用了一个包含高、中、低收入地区的Salop模型。在每个地区，政策制定者选择医疗保健质量以最大化居民效用，而医疗保健成本则由一般所得税来支付。在均衡状态下，收入较高的地区提供更好的医疗服务，这促使患者从低收入地区流向高收入地区。假设采用基于DRG定价的预付支付制度，我们发现较低的非货币性（行政性）流动成本对高收入地区的医疗服务质量和福利没有影响；对中等收入地区而言，虽然对服务质量有负面影响，但对福利有正面影响；而对低收入地区而言，对医疗服务质量和福利的影响则较为模糊。较低的货币性流动成本（支付额）可能会降低中等收入地区和低收入地区的福利水平。因此，当地区间收入存在差异时，鼓励跨境患者流动的卫生政策可能会产生反效果。

abstract.text: Economic theory suggests that competition and information can both be important for product quality, and yet evidence on how they may interact to affect quality is sparse. This paper estimates the impact of competition between nursing homes on their quality, and how this impact varies when consumers have better access to information. The effect of competition is identified using exogenous variation in the geographical proximity of nursing homes to their potential consumers. The change in information transparency is captured by the launch of the Five-Star Quality Rating System in 2009, which improved access to the quality information of nursing homes. We find that while the effect of competition on nursing home quality is generally rather limited, this effect becomes significantly stronger with increased information transparency. The results suggest that regulations on public quality reporting and on market structure are policy complements, and should be considered jointly to best improve quality.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.05.004.abstractZh: 经济理论表明，竞争和信息对产品质量都具有重要意义，但关于它们如何相互作用影响产品质量的实证研究却相对较少。本文旨在评估养老院之间的竞争对其产品质量的影响，以及这种影响在消费者获得更多信息时如何变化。通过模拟养老院与潜在消费者之间的地理距离变化，本文确定了竞争的影响。2009年推出的五星质量评级系统提高了人们对养老院质量信息的获取能力，从而改变了信息透明度。研究发现，尽管竞争对养老院质量的影响通常较为有限，但在信息透明度增加的情况下，这种影响会显著增强。结果表明，关于公共质量报告和市场结构的法规是政策上的互补因素，应综合考虑以最佳提升产品质量。

abstract.text: Pollen is known to cause allergic reactions and affect cognitive performance in around 20% of the population. Although pollen season peaks when students take high-stakes exams, the effect of pollen allergies on school performance has received nearly no attention from economists. Using a student fixed effects model and administrative Norwegian data, this paper finds that increasing the ambient pollen levels by one standard deviation at the mean leads to a 2.5% standard deviation decrease in test scores, with potentially larger effects for allergic students. There also appear to be longer-run effects. The findings imply that random increases in pollen counts reduce test scores for allergic students relative to their peers, who consequently will be at a disadvantage when competing for jobs or higher education. This paper contributes to the literature by illuminating the interplay between individual health and human capital accumulation, which in turn can impact long-run economic growth.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.05.005.abstractZh: 已知花粉会导致过敏反应，并影响约20%人群的认知表现。虽然花粉季节在学生们参加高风险考试时达到高峰，但花粉过敏对学业表现的影响却几乎未受到经济学家的关注。本文利用学生固定效应模型和挪威的行政数据发现，环境花粉浓度每升高一个标准差，测试成绩就会下降2.5%的标准差，对于过敏学生来说，这种影响可能更为显著。此外，还出现了长期效应。研究结果表明，花粉浓度的随机增加会降低过敏学生的测试成绩，从而使他们在求职或接受高等教育时处于劣势。本文通过揭示个人健康与人力资本积累之间的相互作用，为相关文献做出了贡献，而这两者又可能影响长期经济增长。

abstract.text: A key dilemma in global health is how to allocate funds between disease-specific "vertical projects" on the one hand and "horizontal programmes" which aim to strengthen the entire health system on the other. While economic evaluation provides a way of approaching the prioritisation of vertical projects, it provides less guidance on how to prioritise between horizontal and vertical spending. We approach this problem by formulating a mathematical program which captures the complementary benefits of funding both vertical projects and horizontal programmes. We show that our solution to this math program has an appealing intuitive structure. We illustrate our model by computationally solving two specialised versions of this problem, with illustrations based on the problem of allocating funding for infectious diseases in sub-Saharan Africa. We conclude by reflecting on how such a model may be developed in the future and used to guide empirical data collection and theory development.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.06.001.abstractZh: 全球健康领域的一个关键难题是如何在针对特定疾病的“纵向项目”和旨在加强整个卫生系统的“横向项目”之间分配资金。虽然经济评估为纵向项目的优先级排序提供了方法，但它在如何平衡横向和纵向支出方面提供的指导较少。我们通过构建一个数学规划模型来解决这个问题，该模型能够捕捉资助纵向项目和横向项目的互补效益。我们发现，该数学规划模型的解决方案具有直观且吸引人的结构。我们通过计算解决这个问题的两个专门版本来演示我们的模型，这些示例基于撒哈拉以南非洲地区传染病资金分配的问题。最后，我们思考了未来如何开发这样的模型，并将其用于指导实证数据收集和理论发展。

abstract.text: We present a model combining the two regulatory stages relevant to the approval of a new health technology: the authorisation of its commercialisation and the insurer's decision about whether to reimburse its cost. We show that the degree of uncertainty concerning the true value of the insurer's maximum willingness to pay for a unit increase in effectiveness has a non-monotonic impact on the optimal price of the innovation, the firm's expected profit and the optimal sample size of the clinical trial. A key result is that there exists a range of values of the uncertainty parameter over which a reduction in uncertainty benefits the firm, the insurer and patients. We consider how different policy parameters may be used as incentive mechanisms, and the incentives to invest in R&D for marginal projects such as those targeting rare diseases. The model is calibrated using data on a new treatment for cystic fibrosis.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.06.002.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个模型，该模型结合了批准新健康技术所需的两个监管阶段：其商业化的授权以及保险公司是否愿意报销其成本的决策。我们指出，关于保险公司愿意支付的最大补偿金额的不确定性程度，会对创新产品的最优价格、企业的预期利润以及临床试验的最佳样本规模产生非单调的影响。一个关键结论是，存在一个不确定性参数的取值范围，在这个范围内，降低不确定性会有利于企业、保险公司和患者。我们还考虑了如何将不同的政策参数用作激励机制，以及对于针对罕见疾病的边缘性项目而言，投资研发的动力。该模型是根据囊性纤维化治疗的新疗法数据进行校准的。

abstract.text: Two hospitals compete for the exclusive services of health professionals, who are privately informed about their ability and motivation. Hospitals differ in their ownership structure and in the mission they pursue. The non-profit hospital sacrifices some profits to follow its mission but becomes attractive for motivated workers. In equilibrium, when both hospitals are active, the sorting of workers to hospitals is efficient and ability-neutral. Allocative distortions are decreasing in the degree of competition and disappear when hospitals are similar. The non-profit hospital tends to provide a higher amount of care and offer lower salaries than the for-profit one.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.06.003.abstractZh: 两家医院竞争着健康专业人员的独家服务，这些专业人员通过私人渠道了解他们的能力和动机。两家医院在所有权结构和所追求的使命上存在差异。非营利性医院为了履行其使命而牺牲了一些利润，但这使得它们对有动力的员工具有吸引力。在两种医院都活跃的情况下，员工向医院的选择是高效且能力中立的。随着竞争程度的降低，分配扭曲现象会消失，当两家医院相似时，这种扭曲现象甚至会完全消失。非营利性医院往往能提供更多的护理服务，并且提供的薪资也相对较低。

abstract.text: While health care policies are frequently signed into law well before they are implemented, such lags are ignored in most empirical work. This paper demonstrates the importance of implementation lags in the context of Medicare Part D, the prescription drug benefit that took effect two years after it was signed into law. Exploiting the differential responses of chronic and acute drugs to anticipated future prices, I show that individuals reduced drug utilization for chronic but not acute drugs in anticipation of Part D's implementation. Accounting for this anticipatory response substantially reduces the estimated total treatment effect of Part D.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.06.004.abstractZh: 虽然医疗保健政策通常在实施前很久就已签署成为法律，但大多数实证研究都忽略了这种滞后现象。本文通过以Medicare Part D为例，说明了实施滞后的重要性。Part D是处方药福利计划，其实施时间比政策签署时间晚了两年。通过研究慢性病和急性病药物对预期未来价格的差异反应，我们发现人们在预期Part D实施时，减少了慢性病药物的用药量，但并未减少急性病药物的用药量。考虑到这种预期反应，Part D的总治疗效果被大幅降低了。

abstract.text: Studies on health effects of job loss mostly estimate mean effects. We argue that the effects might differ over the distribution of the health status and use quantile regression methods to provide a more complete picture. To take the potential endogeneity of job loss into account, we estimate quantile treatment effects where we rely on job loss due to plant closures. We find that the effect of job loss indeed varies across the mental and physical health distribution. Job loss due to plant closures affects physical health adversely for individuals in the middle and lower part of the health distribution while those in best physical condition do not seem to be affected. The results for mental health, though less distinct, point in the same direction. We find no effects on BMI.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.06.005.abstractZh: 关于失业对健康影响的研究大多只关注平均效应。我们认为，这些效应在不同健康状况的人群中可能有所不同，因此采用分位数回归方法可以提供更全面的图景。为了考虑失业的潜在内生性，我们基于工厂关闭导致的失业情况来估计分位数处理效应。研究发现，失业对心理健康和身体健康的影响存在差异：对于处于健康分布中低端的个体来说，工厂关闭会导致其身体健康状况恶化，而身体状况较好的个体则似乎不会受到显著影响。心理健康方面的结果虽然不那么明显，但方向是一致的。我们发现失业对体重指数没有影响。

abstract.text: Evidence is mixed on whether society-wide economic conditions affect cardiovascular health and the reasons for the suggested relationship are largely untested. We explore whether a short-term increase in labor supply affects the probability of acute myocardial infarctions, using a natural experiment in Iceland. In 1987 personal income taxes were temporarily reduced to zero, resulting in an overall increase in labor supply. We merge and analyze individual-level, registry-based data on earnings and AMIs including all Icelandic men and women aged 45-74 during the period 1982-1992. The results support the prominent hypothesis of increased work as a mechanism explaining worsening heart health in upswings, for men aged 45-64 who were self-employed. We furthermore find a larger increase in probability of AMIs during the tax-free year in men aged 45-54 than men aged 55-64.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.06.006.abstractZh: 关于社会整体经济状况是否会影响心血管健康，目前的研究结果并不一致，而关于这种关联的原因，也大多未经充分验证。我们通过冰岛的一个自然实验，探讨了短期内劳动力供应增加是否会影响急性心肌梗死的发生概率。1987年，冰岛的个人所得税暂时降至零，导致劳动力供应整体增加。我们整合并分析了1982年至1992年间所有45-74岁冰岛男性女性的收入数据和急性心肌梗死数据。研究结果表明，对于45-64岁的自雇男性来说，工作时间的增加可能是导致心脏健康状况恶化的一个重要因素。此外，我们还发现，在免税期间，45-54岁的男性急性心肌梗死的发生概率比55-64岁的男性更高。

abstract.text: This paper studies the lifetime effects of exogenous changes in health insurance coverage (e.g. Medicare, PPACA, termination of employer-provided plans) on the dynamic optimal allocation (consumption, leisure, health expenditures), status (health and wealth), and welfare. We solve, simulate, and structurally estimate a parsimonious life cycle model with endogenous exposure to morbidity and mortality risks, and exogenous health insurance. By varying coverage, we identify the marginal effects of insurance when young and/or when old on allocations, statuses, and welfare. Our results highlight positive effects of insurance on health, wealth and welfare, as well as mid-life substitution away from healthy leisure in favor of more health expenses, caused by peaking wages, and accelerating health issues.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.06.007.abstractZh: 本文研究了健康保险覆盖范围的外部变化（如医疗保险、平价医疗法案、雇主提供的计划终止）对动态最优分配（消费、休闲、健康支出）、状态（健康与财富）以及福利的终身影响。我们解决、模拟并结构估计了一个包含内生发病率和死亡率风险以及外部健康保险影响的简约生命周期模型。通过改变保险覆盖范围，我们确定了保险对年轻和/或年老人群在分配、状态和福利方面的边际影响。我们的研究结果表明，保险对健康、财富和福利具有积极影响，同时会导致中年时期从健康的休闲活动转向更多的健康支出，这是由于工资达到峰值以及健康问题的加速出现所导致的。

abstract.text: Medicaid reimburses healthcare providers for services at a lower rate than any other type of insurance coverage. To account for the burden of treating Medicaid patients, providers claim that they must cost-shift by raising the rates of individuals covered by private insurance. Previous investigations of cost-shifting has produced mixed results. In this paper, I exploit a disabled Medicaid expansion where crowd-out was complete to investigate cost-shifting. I find that hospitals reduce the charge rates of the privately insured. Given that Medicaid is expanding in several states under the Affordable Care Act, these results may alleviate cost-shifting concerns of the reform.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.06.008.abstractZh: 医疗补助为医疗服务提供者提供的费用低于其他任何类型的保险覆盖。为了应对治疗医疗补助患者的负担，医疗服务提供者声称必须通过提高私人保险覆盖范围内的个人费用来转移成本。之前关于成本转移的研究结果不一。在本文中，我利用一个医疗补助扩展地区的案例来研究成本转移现象。我发现医院确实降低了私人保险客户的收费率。鉴于根据《平价医疗法案》，医疗补助正在多个州扩大覆盖范围，这些结果可能会缓解改革带来的成本转移问题。

abstract.text: In this paper, we exploit the varied timing in state adoption of organ donor registries and first-person consent (FPC) legislation to examine corresponding changes in the supply of deceased organ donors. Results indicate that the establishment of a state organ donor registry leads to an increase in donation rates of approximately 8%, while the adoption of FPC legislation has no effect on the supply of organ donors. These results reinforce the need to encourage individuals to communicate their donation preferences, either explicitly via a registry or by discussing them with family.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.06.009.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们利用了州级器官捐赠登记制度和个人同意立法的不同实施时机，来研究相应情况下死亡器官捐赠者的供应变化。研究结果表明，建立州级器官捐赠登记制度可使捐赠率增加约8%，而采用个人同意立法则对器官捐赠者的供应没有影响。这些结果进一步强调了鼓励个人明确表达捐赠意愿的必要性，无论是通过登记制度还是与家人讨论。

abstract.text: Non-contractible quality dimensions are at risk of degradation when the provision of public services is privatized. However, privatization may increase quality by fostering performance-improving innovation, particularly if combined with increased competition. We assemble a large data set on elderly care services in Sweden between 1990 and 2009 and estimate how opening to private provision affected mortality rates - an important and not easily contractible quality dimension - using a difference-in-difference-in-difference approach. The results indicate that privatization and the associated increase in competition significantly improved non-contractible quality as measured by mortality rates.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.06.010.abstractZh: 当公共服务被私有化时，非契约性质量维度面临退化的风险。然而，私有化可以通过促进提升绩效的创新来提高质量，尤其是当与增加竞争相结合时。我们收集了1990年至2009年间瑞典老年护理服务的相关数据，并使用差异-差异-差异方法，评估了向私人提供服务的开放对死亡率的影响——这是一个重要且难以契约化的质量维度。研究结果表明，私有化以及随之而来的竞争加剧显著提升了以死亡率衡量的非契约性质量。

abstract.text: Early intervention is considered the optimal response to developmental disorders in children. We evaluate a nationwide developmental screening program for preschoolers in Austria and the resulting interventions. Identification of treatment effects is determined by a birthday cutoff-based discontinuity in the eligibility for a financial incentive to participate in the screening. Assigned preschoolers are 14.5 percentage points more likely to participate in the program.
