For participants with high socio-economic status (SES), we find little evidence for interventions and consistently no effect on healthcare costs in the long run. For low SES preschoolers, we find evidence for substantial interventions, but only weak evidence for cost savings in the long run.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.06.011.abstractZh: 早期干预被认为是应对儿童发育障碍的最佳方式。我们评估了奥地利一项针对学龄前儿童的全国性发育筛查计划及其带来的干预效果。通过基于出生日期的不连续标准来确定是否有资格获得参与筛查的财政激励。结果显示，被纳入该计划的学龄前儿童参与的可能性高出14.5个百分点。对于社会经济地位较高的儿童，我们发现干预效果不明显，且长期来看对医疗成本几乎没有影响。而对于社会经济地位较低的儿童，我们发现干预措施确实有效，但长期节省成本的证据较为薄弱。

abstract.text: Conventional wisdom suggests that if private health insurance plans compete alongside a public option, they may endanger the latter's financial stability by cream-skimming good risks. This paper argues that two factors may contribute to the extent of cream-skimming: (i) degree of horizontal differentiation between public and private options when preferences are heterogeneous; (ii) whether contract design encourages choice of private insurance before information about risk is revealed. I explore the role of these factors empirically within the unique institutional setting of the German health insurance system. Using a fuzzy regression discontinuity design to disentangle adverse selection and moral hazard, I find no compelling support for extensive cream-skimming of public option by private insurers despite their ability to fully underwrite risk. A model of demand for private insurance supports the idea that heterogeneity in non-pecuniary preferences and long-term structure of private insurance contracts may be muting cream-skimming in this setting.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.06.012.abstractZh: 传统观点认为，如果私人健康保险计划与公共保险计划竞争，它们可能会通过抽取优质风险来危及公共保险计划的财务稳定性。本文认为，导致这种抽取行为的原因可能有两点：(i) 当偏好存在异质性时，公共保险计划和私人保险计划之间的水平差异化程度；(ii) 合同设计是否鼓励在风险信息披露之前选择私人保险。我在德国健康保险系统的独特制度背景下，通过实证研究这些因素的作用。采用模糊回归不连续设计来分离逆向选择和道德风险的影响，我发现尽管私人保险公司有能力完全承担风险，但并没有充分证据表明它们会大规模抽取公共保险计划的风险。对私人保险需求模型的分析表明，非金钱性偏好的异质性和私人保险合同的长期结构可能有助于减弱这种抽取行为的影响。

abstract.text: We present results from an extensive discrete choice experiment, which was conducted in three countries (Norway, Scotland, and England) with the aim of disclosing stated prescription behaviour in different decision making contexts and across different cost containment cultures. We show that GPs in all countries respond to information about societal costs, benefits and effectiveness, and that they make trade-offs between them. The UK GPs have higher willingness to accept costs when they can prescribe medicines that are cheaper or more preferred by the patient, while Norwegian GPs tend to have higher willingness to accept costs for attributes regarding effectiveness or the doctors' experience. In general, there is a substantial amount of heterogeneity also within each country. We discuss the results from the DCE in the light of the GPs' two conflicting agency roles and what we know about the incentive structures and cultures in the different countries.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.07.001.abstractZh: 我们展示了在三个国家（挪威、苏格兰和英格兰）进行的广泛离散选择实验的结果，旨在揭示在不同决策情境和不同成本控制文化背景下，医生的处方行为。研究发现，所有国家的全科医生都会对关于社会成本、效益和效果的信息作出反应，并且会在这些因素之间进行权衡。英国的全科医生在能够开出更便宜或更受患者青睐的药物时，更愿意接受更高的成本；而挪威的全科医生则更倾向于接受与效果或医生经验相关的更高成本。总体而言，每个国家内部也存在显著的异质性。我们结合全科医生两种相互冲突的代理角色，以及我们对不同国家激励结构和文化的了解，对实验结果进行了讨论。

abstract.text: This paper examines public valuations of mortality risk reductions. We set up a theoretical framework that allows for altruistic preferences, and subsequently test theoretical predictions through the design of a discrete choice experiment. By varying the tax scenario (uniform versus individual tax), the experimental design allows us to verify whether pure altruistic preferences are present and the underlying causes. We find evidence of negative pure altruism. Under a coercive uniform tax system respondents lower their willingness to pay possibly to ensure that they are not forcing others to pay at a level that corresponds to their own - higher - valuations. This hypothesis is supported by the observation that respondents perceive other individuals' valuations to be lower than their own. Our results suggest that public valuations of mortality risk reductions may underestimate the true societal value because respondents are considering other individuals' welfare, and wrongfully perceive other people's valuations to be low.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.07.002.abstractZh: 本文探讨了公众对死亡风险降低的评估。我们建立了一个理论框架，该框架允许存在利他主义偏好，并通过设计离散选择实验来验证理论预测。通过改变税收方案（统一税与个体税），实验设计使我们能够验证是否存在纯粹的利他主义偏好以及其背后的原因。我们发现存在消极的利他主义现象。在强制性的统一税制度下，受访者降低支付意愿，可能是为了避免迫使他人支付与其自身估值相一致的金额。这一假设得到了观察结果的支持，即受访者认为其他个体的估值低于自己的估值。我们的研究结果表明，公众对死亡风险降低的评估可能低估了真正的社会价值，因为受访者在考虑其他个体的福利，并错误地认为其他人的估值较低。

abstract.text: We conduct a field experiment in 31 primary schools in England to test the effectiveness of different temporary incentives on increasing choice and consumption of fruit and vegetables at lunchtime. In each treatment, pupils received a sticker for choosing a fruit or vegetable at lunch. They were eligible for an additional reward at the end of the week depending on the number of stickers accumulated, either individually (individual scheme) or in comparison to others (competition). Overall, we find no significant effect of the individual scheme, but positive effects of competition. For children who had margin to increase their consumption, competition increases choice of fruit and vegetables by 33% and consumption by 48%. These positive effects generally carry over to the week immediately following the treatment, but are not sustained effects six months later. We also find large differences in effectiveness across demographic characteristics such as age and gender.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.07.003.abstractZh: 我们在英格兰的31所小学进行了一项实地实验，以测试不同临时激励措施对增加午餐时水果和蔬菜选择及消费量的效果。在每项实验中，学生因选择水果或蔬菜而获得一张贴纸。根据累积的贴纸数量，学生可以在周末获得额外的奖励，这种奖励可以是个人获得的，也可以是与他人比较的结果。总体而言，我们发现个人激励计划没有显著效果，而竞争机制则产生了积极效果。对于那些有增加消费意愿的学生来说，竞争机制使水果和蔬菜的选择增加了33%，消费量增加了48%。这些积极效果通常会在实验后的周内持续，但在六个月后不再持续。我们还发现，不同人口特征如年龄和性别对效果的影响存在很大差异。

abstract.text: The implications of hospital quality competition depend on what type of quality affects choice of hospital. Previous studies of quality and choice of hospitals have used crude measures of quality such as mortality and readmission rates rather than measures of the health gain from specific treatments. We estimate multinomial logit models of hospital choice by patients undergoing hip replacement surgery in the English NHS to test whether hospital demand responds to quality as measured by detailed patient reports of health before and after hip replacement. We find that a one standard deviation increase in average health gain increases demand by up to 10%. The more traditional measures of hospital quality are less important in determining hospital choice.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.08.001.abstractZh: 医院质量竞争的影响取决于哪种质量因素会影响患者的选择。以往关于医院质量和选择的研究使用的是诸如死亡率和再入院率等粗略的质量指标，而不是针对特定治疗带来的健康收益指标。我们通过估计多项逻辑模型来研究接受髋关节置换手术的患者在英格兰国家医疗服务体系中的医院选择行为，以检验医院需求是否会受到以患者术后健康报告为衡量标准的质量因素的影响。研究发现，平均健康收益每增加一个标准差，需求就会增加高达10%。相比之下，那些更为传统的医院质量指标在决定患者选择方面的重要性较低。

abstract.text: We exploit exogenous variation in years of completed college induced by draft-avoidance behavior during the Vietnam War to examine the impact of college on adult mortality. Our estimates imply that increasing college attainment from the level of the state at the 25th percentile of the education distribution to that of the state at the 75th percentile would decrease cumulative mortality for cohorts in our sample by 8 to 10 percent relative to the mean. Most of the reduction in mortality is from deaths due to cancer and heart disease. We also explore potential mechanisms, including differential earnings and health insurance.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.08.002.abstractZh: 我们利用越南战争期间为避免征兵而采取的行为所引发的大学完成年份的外生变化，来研究大学教育对成人死亡率的影响。我们的估计表明，将大学教育水平从教育分布中处于第25百分位的州提升到处于第75百分位的州，会使样本中的 cohort 的累计死亡率相对平均值降低8%到10%。死亡率降低的主要原因是由于癌症和心脏病导致的死亡。我们还探讨了潜在的机制，包括收入差异和健康保险的影响。

abstract.text: A number of behaviours influence health in a non-monotonic way. Physical activity and alcohol consumption, for instance, may be beneficial to one's health in moderate but detrimental in large quantities. We develop a demand-for-health framework that incorporates the feature of a physiologically optimal level. An individual may still choose a physiologically non-optimal level, because of the trade-off in his or her preferences for health versus other utility-affecting commodities. However, any deviation above or below the physiologically optimal level will be punished with respect to health. Distinguishing between two individual types we study (a) the qualitative properties of optimal time-paths of health capital and health-related behaviour, (b) the perturbations of the optimal time-paths that result from changes in exogenous parameters, and (c) steady state properties. Predictions of the model and the implications for empirical analysis are discussed at length. Some comments on potential future extensions conclude the paper.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.08.003.abstractZh: 许多行为以非单调的方式影响健康。例如，体育活动和酒精消费在适量时可能对健康有益，但在大量摄入时则会对健康产生负面影响。我们提出了一个需求-健康框架，该框架包含了生理最优水平这一特征。个体仍可能选择低于生理最优水平的水平，因为他们在健康与其他影响效用的商品之间的偏好存在权衡。然而，任何高于或低于生理最优水平的偏差都会对健康产生负面影响。我们研究了两种个体类型：(a) 健康资本和健康相关行为的优化时间路径的定性特征；(b) 由于外部参数变化而导致的优化时间路径的扰动；(c) 稳态特性。对模型的预测及其对实证分析的意义进行了详细讨论。最后，对潜在未来扩展方向提出了一些评论。

abstract.text: As hospitals are increasingly held accountable for patients' post-discharge outcomes under new payment models, hospitals may choose to acquire skilled nursing facilities (SNFs) to better manage these outcomes. This raises the question of whether patients discharged to hospital-based SNFs have better outcomes. In unadjusted comparisons, hospital-based SNF patients have much lower Medicare utilization in the 180 days following discharge relative to freestanding SNF patients. We solved the problem of differential selection into hospital-based and freestanding SNFs by using differential distance from home to the nearest hospital with a SNF relative to the distance from home to the nearest hospital without a SNF as an instrument. We found that hospital-based SNF patients spent roughly 5 more days in the community and 6 fewer days in the SNF in the 180 days following their original hospital discharge with no significant effect on mortality or hospital readmission.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.08.004.abstractZh: 随着新的支付模式要求医院对患者的出院后结果负责，医院可能会选择收购专业护理机构，以更好地管理这些结果。这引发了这样一个问题：被转至医院专业护理机构的患者是否会有更好的康复效果？在未经调整的对比中，与独立专业护理机构的患者相比，转至医院专业护理机构的患者在出院后的180天内，Medicare的医疗费用要低得多。我们通过使用患者从家中到最近有护理机构的距离与没有护理机构时到最近医院的距离的差异作为指标，解决了患者选择医院专业护理机构与独立护理机构的问题。研究发现，转至医院专业护理机构的患者在出院后的180天内，在社区中度过的天数大约多了5天，而在专业护理机构中的天数减少了6天，但这对死亡率或再次住院率没有显著影响。

abstract.text: We present an integrated valuation model for diseases that are life-threatening. The model extends the standard one-period value-per-statistical-life model to three health prospects: healthy, ill, and dead. We derive willingness-to-pay values for prevention efforts that reduce a disease's incidence rate as well as for treatments that lower the corresponding health deterioration and mortality rates. We find that the demand value of prevention always exceeds that of treatment. People often overweight small risks and underweight large ones. We use the rank dependent utility framework to explore how the demand for prevention and treatment alters when people evaluate probabilities in a non-linear manner. For incidence and mortality rates associated with common types of cancers, the inverse-S shaped probability weighting found in experimental studies leads to a significant increase in the demand values of both treatment and prevention.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.08.005.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个针对致命疾病的综合估值模型。该模型将标准的一期价值模型扩展为三个健康状态：健康、患病和死亡。我们推导出了用于减少疾病发病率的预防措施以及降低相应健康恶化和死亡率的治疗措施的支付意愿值。研究发现，预防的需求价值始终高于治疗的需求价值。人们往往高估小风险而低估大风险。我们采用基于排名的效用框架来探讨，当人们以非线性方式评估概率时，对预防和治疗的需求如何变化。对于与常见癌症相关的发病率和死亡率，实验研究中发现的逆S形概率加权方法显著提高了治疗和预防的需求价值。

abstract.text: In this paper, we estimate how hospital ownership of physicians' practices affects their patients' hospital choices. We match data on the hospital admissions of Medicare beneficiaries, including the identity of their physician, with data on the identity of the owner of their physician's practice. We find that a hospital's ownership of a physician dramatically increases the probability that the physician's patients will choose the owning hospital. We also find that patients are more likely to choose a high-cost, low-quality hospital when their physician is owned by that hospital.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.08.006.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们研究了医院对医生执业权的拥有如何影响患者选择医院的行为。我们将医疗保险受益人住院的数据与医生执业权的所有者信息进行了匹配。研究发现，医院对医生执业权的拥有显著增加了该医生的患者选择该医院的可能性。此外，我们还发现，当医生的执业权由该医院拥有时，患者更有可能选择费用高但质量低的医院。

abstract.text: We use the rollout of the five-star rating of nursing homes to study how private-pay prices respond to quality rating. We find that star rating increases the price differential between top- and bottom-ranked facilities. On average, prices of top-ranked facilities increased by 4.8 to 6.0 percent more than the prices of bottom-ranked facilities. We find stronger price effects in markets that are less concentrated where consumers may have more choices of alternative nursing homes. Our results suggest that with simplified design and when markets are less concentrated, consumers are more responsive to quality reporting.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.08.007.abstractZh: 我们通过研究五星级养老院评级的推出，来探讨私人支付价格如何响应质量评级的变化。我们发现，星级评级使得排名最高的养老院与排名最低的养老院之间的价格差异增大。平均而言，排名最高的养老院的价格比排名最低的养老院高出4.8%到6.0%。在消费者有更多选择、市场较为分散的情况下，价格变化更为明显。我们的研究结果表明，在设计较为简单且市场较为分散的情况下，消费者对质量评级的反应更为敏感。

abstract.text: This paper studies the design of long term care (LTC) insurance contracts in the presence of ex post moral hazard. While this problem bears some similarity with the study of health insurance (Blomqvist, 1997) the significance of informal LTC affects the problem in several crucial ways. It introduces the potential crowding out of informal care by market care financed through insurance coverage. Furthermore, the information structure becomes more intricate. Informal care is not publicly observable and, unlike the insurer, caregivers know the true needs of their relatives. We determine the optimal second-best contract and show that the optimal reimbursement rate can be written as an A-B-C expression à la Diamond (1998). These terms respectively reflect the efficiency loss as measured by the inverse of the demand elasticity, the distribution of needs and the preferences for risk sharing. Interestingly, informal care directly affects only the first term. More precisely the first term decreases with the presence and significance of informal care. Roughly speaking this means that an efficient LTC insurance contract should offer lower (marginal) reimbursement rates than its counterpart in a health insurance context.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.08.008.abstractZh: 本文研究了在事后道德风险存在的情况下，长期护理保险合同的设计问题。虽然这一问题与医疗保险的研究有一些相似之处（Blomqvist, 1997），但非正式长期护理的重要性在多个方面对问题产生了重要影响。它揭示了市场护理通过保险覆盖所引发的非正式护理的潜在挤出效应。此外，信息结构变得更加复杂。非正式护理并不容易被公众观察到，与保险公司不同，护理人员了解亲属的真实需求。我们确定了最优的次优合同，并表明最优报销率可以用Diamond（1998）提出的A-B-C表达式来表示。这些术语分别反映了效率损失、需求分布以及风险共享偏好等因素。有趣的是，非正式护理仅直接影响第一项。更确切地说，随着非正式护理的存在和重要性增加，第一项会下降。粗略地说，这意味着一个有效的长期护理保险合同应该提供比医疗保险环境更低（边际）的报销率。

abstract.text: Due to the aging process, the provision of long-term care (LTC) to the dependent elderly has become a major challenge of our epoch. But our societies are also characterized, since the 1970s, by a postponement of births, which, by raising the intergenerational age gap, can affect the provision of LTC by children. In order to examine the impact of those demographic trends on the optimal policy, we develop a four-period OLG model where individuals, who receive children's informal LTC at the old age, must choose, when being young, how to allocate births along their life cycle. It is shown that, in line with empirical evidence, early children provide more LTC to their elderly parents than do late children, because they face a lower opportunity cost of providing LTC. When comparing the laissez-faire with the long-run social optimum, it appears that individuals have, at the laissez-faire, too few early births, and too many late births. We then study, in first-best and second-best settings, how the social optimum can be decentralized by encouraging early births, in such a way as to reduce the social burden of LTC provision.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.08.009.abstractZh: 由于老龄化进程的影响，为依赖的老年人提供长期护理服务已成为当今社会面临的主要挑战。然而，自20世纪70年代以来，我们的社会还呈现出生育推迟的现象，这导致代际年龄差距扩大，进而影响到子女提供的长期护理服务。为了研究这些人口趋势对最优政策的影响，我们建立了一个四期OLG模型。在这个模型中，那些在老年时接受子女非正式长期护理服务的个体，必须在年轻时选择如何安排生育。研究表明，与实证数据一致的是，早育的子女为年迈的父母提供的长期护理服务更多，因为他们提供护理服务的机会成本更低。与放任自流的情况相比，社会最优状态表明，在放任自流的情况下，个体过早生育和过晚生育的情况都过于普遍。因此，我们进一步研究了在最优和次优条件下，如何通过鼓励早育来分散社会最优决策的责任，从而减轻长期护理服务的社会负担。

abstract.text: This study investigates causal effects of economic insecurity on subjective anxiety, food intake, and weight outcomes. A review of psychological and nutrition studies highlights the complexity of processes at work on each stage of this causal chain. Econometric analyses trace the effects along the hypothesized pathway using detailed household panel data from the Russia Longitudinal Monitoring Survey from 1994 to 2005. Economic insecurity measures serve as key explanatory variables in regressions and are instrumented by exogenous regional indicators. Results support a causal chain from economic insecurity to weight outcomes for some population subgroups. In contrast to the leading hypothesis that economic insecurity increases body weight, I find strong evidence of a decreasing effect among women. Results suggest further that consumption of foods rich in sugar responds strongly to higher levels of economic insecurity. Heterogeneous impacts of economic insecurity on body weight call for individual-level interventions rather than large-scale action.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.09.001.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了经济不安全对主观焦虑、食物摄入和体重结果的影响。对心理学和营养学研究的回顾表明，这一因果链中的各个阶段都存在复杂的过程。通过1994至2005年俄罗斯纵向监测调查中的详细家庭面板数据，采用计量经济学分析方法追踪这一假设路径下的影响。经济不安全的衡量指标在回归分析中作为关键解释变量，并通过外部区域指标作为工具变量。研究结果支持经济不安全对某些人口亚群体的体重结果产生因果影响。与主流假设相反，经济不安全会增加体重，但我发现女性在经济不安全的情况下体重会下降。研究还表明，富含糖的食物消费对经济不安全程度的增加反应强烈。经济不安全对体重的异质影响表明，需要采取个体层面的干预措施，而非大规模的行动。

abstract.text: We develop and implement what we believe is the first conceptually valid health-inclusive poverty measure (HIPM) - a measure that includes health care or insurance in the poverty needs threshold and health insurance benefits in family resources - and we discuss its limitations. Building on the Census Bureau's Supplemental Poverty Measure, we construct a pilot HIPM for the under-65 population under ACA-like health reform in Massachusetts. This pilot demonstrates the practicality, face validity and value of a HIPM. Results suggest that public health insurance benefits and premium subsidies accounted for a substantial, one-third reduction in the health inclusive poverty rate.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.09.002.abstractZh: 我们开发并实施了我们认为首个概念上有效的健康包容型贫困衡量指标——该指标将医疗保健或保险纳入贫困需求阈值中，并将健康保险福利纳入家庭资源中。同时，我们讨论了该指标的局限性。基于人口普查局的补充贫困衡量指标，我们为马萨诸塞州类似《平价医疗法案》改革下的65岁以下人群构建了一个试点健康包容型贫困衡量指标。该试点表明，该指标具有实用性、表面效力和价值。研究结果表明，公共健康保险福利和保费补贴使健康包容型贫困率降低了三分之一。

abstract.text: The goal of this paper is to better understand firms' strategic reactions to nutritional policies targeting food quality improvements and to derive optimal policies. We propose a model of product differentiation, taking into account the taste and health characteristics of products. We study how two firms react to alternative policies: an MQS policy, linear taxation of the two goods on the market, and taxation of the low-quality good. The MQS and the taxation of the low-quality product are the preferred options by a social planner. If taste is moderately important, the MQS policy is chosen by a populist and a paternalist social planner. If taste is a major component of choice, the populist planner chooses to tax the low-quality product whereas the paternalist planner prefers the MQS policy. Finally, for a paternalist social planner, an MQS-based policy always allows for higher levels of welfare than an information policy alone.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.09.003.abstractZh: 本文旨在更好地理解企业对于旨在提升食品质量的营养政策的战略反应，并推导出最优政策。我们提出了一个产品差异化模型，考虑了产品的口味和健康特性。我们研究了两家企业对不同政策的反应：MQS政策、对市场上两种商品进行线性征税，以及对低质量商品征税。MQS政策和对低质量商品征税是社会规划者所青睐的选择。如果口味因素较为重要，那么民粹主义型和社会家长式型的社会规划者会选择MQS政策。如果口味是选择的主要因素，那么民粹主义型规划者会选择对低质量商品征税，而家长式型规划者则更倾向于选择MQS政策。最后，对于家长式型的社会规划者来说，基于MQS的政策总是比单独的信息政策能带来更高的福利水平。

abstract.text: Researchers are often interested in composite measures such as overall ratings, indices of physical or mental health, or health-related quality-of-life (HRQoL) outcomes. Such measures are typically composed of two or more underlying discrete variables. In this paper, I investigate conditions where the estimated treatment effect based solely on the composite outcome is biased under non-random treatment assignment, which I refer to as composite bias. I then compare the magnitude of this bias across a variety of estimators, including ordinary least squares, propensity score estimators, and an alternative two-stage approach that first estimates treatment effects on the underlying outcomes and then combines these effects into an overall effect on the composite outcome of interest. The results highlight the presence of composite bias, identify general conditions under which such bias exists, and offer guidance as to how best to minimize this bias in practice.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.09.004.abstractZh: 研究人员通常对复合指标感兴趣，例如总体评分、身体或心理健康指数，或与健康相关的生活质量（HRQoL）指标。这些指标通常由两个或更多独立的变量组成。在本文中，我研究了在非随机处理分配情况下，仅基于复合指标估计的处理效应存在偏差的情况，我将其称为复合偏差。然后，我比较了不同估计方法对这种偏差的影响程度，包括普通最小二乘法、倾向得分估计方法，以及一种替代的两阶段方法：首先估计对基础变量的处理效应，然后将这些效应合并为对感兴趣的复合指标的整体效应。研究结果揭示了复合偏差的存在，确定了这种偏差普遍存在的条件，并提供了如何在实践中最佳减少这种偏差的指导。

abstract.text: This paper examines the effect of choice architecture on Massachusetts' Health Insurance Exchange. A policy change standardized cost-sharing parameters of plans across insurers and altered information presentation. Post-change, consumers chose more generous plans and different brands, but were not more price-sensitive. We use a discrete choice model that allows the policy to affect how attributes are valued to decompose the policy's effects into a valuation effect and a product availability effect. The brand shifts are largely explained by the availability effect and the generosity shift by the valuation effect. A hypothetical choice experiment replicates our results and explores alternative counterfactuals.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.09.005.abstractZh: 本文探讨了选择架构对马萨诸塞州健康保险交易所的影响。政策变更使得各保险公司的计划成本分摊参数标准化，并改变了信息的呈现方式。政策实施后，消费者选择了更慷慨的计划和不同的品牌，但他们对价格的敏感度并未增加。我们采用离散选择模型，该模型允许政策影响属性的估值，从而将政策效果分解为估值效应和产品可获得性效应。品牌选择的转变主要由可获得性效应解释，而选择更慷慨计划的转变则由估值效应解释。通过假设的选择实验，我们复现了我们的研究结果，并探讨了其他替代性反事实情况。

abstract.text: We empirically assess whether a health shock influences individual risk aversion. We use grip strength data to obtain an objective health shock indicator. In order to account for the non-random nature of our data regression-adjusted matching is employed. Risk preferences are traditionally assumed to be constant. However, we find that a health shock increases individual risk aversion. The finding is robust to a series of sensitivity analyses and persists for at least four years after the shock. Income changes do not seem to be the driving mechanism.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.09.006.abstractZh: 我们通过实证分析来研究健康冲击是否会影响个体的风险厌恶行为。我们采用握力数据作为健康冲击的客观指标。为了考虑数据的非随机性，我们采用了回归调整后的匹配方法。传统上认为风险偏好是恒定的，但我们发现健康冲击确实会增加个体的风险厌恶。这一发现经过一系列敏感性分析后得到验证，并且在冲击发生后的至少四年内仍然持续存在。收入变化似乎并非导致这一效应的主要因素。

abstract.text: Network design is an often overlooked aspect of health insurance contracts. Recent policy factors have resulted in narrower provider networks. We provide plausibly causal evidence on the effect of narrow network plans offered by a large national health insurance carrier in a major metropolitan market. Our econometric design exploits the fact that some firms offer a narrow network plan to their employees and some do not. Our results show that narrow network health plans lead to reductions in health care utilization and spending. We find evidence that narrow networks save money by selecting lower cost providers into the network.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.09.007.abstractZh: 网络设计是健康保险合同中常被忽视的一个方面。最近的政策变化导致医疗服务提供者的网络变得更加狭窄。我们提供了关于大型全国性健康保险公司在主要都市市场提供的狭窄网络计划影响的合理因果证据。我们的计量经济学设计利用了这样一个事实：一些公司为其员工提供狭窄网络计划，而另一些则没有。我们的研究结果表明，狭窄网络的健康计划会导致医疗服务的利用和支出减少。我们发现，狭窄网络计划通过选择成本较低的医疗服务提供者来节省资金。

abstract.text: This study uses a best-worst scaling experiment to test whether general practitioners (GPs) act as perfect agents for the patients in the consultation; and if not, whether this is due to asymmetric information and/or other motivations than user orientation. Survey data were collected from 775 GPs and 1379 Danish citizens eliciting preferences for a consultation. Sequential models allowing for within-person preference heterogeneity and heteroskedasticity between best and worst choices were estimated. We show that GPs do not always act as perfect agents and that this non-alignment stems from GPs being both unable and unwilling to do so. Unable since GPs have imperfect information about patients' preferences, and unwilling since they are also motivated by other factors than user orientation. Our findings highlight the need for multi-pronged strategies targeting different motivational factors to ensure that GPs act in correspondence with patients' preferences in areas where alignment is warranted.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.09.008.abstractZh: 本研究采用最佳-最差排序实验来检验全科医生是否始终能作为患者的完美代理人；如果并非如此，那么这种不一致是否源于信息不对称以及/或除用户导向之外的其他动机。研究收集了775名全科医生和1379名丹麦公民的调查数据，以了解他们对咨询的偏好。通过序列模型，考虑了个体偏好异质性以及最佳选择和最差选择之间的异方差性。我们发现，全科医生并非总是能作为完美代理人，这种不一致性源于他们既无法也不愿意这样做。无法作为完美代理人是因为全科医生对患者的偏好信息并不完善，而不愿意作为代理人则是因为他们受到除用户导向之外的其他因素的驱动。我们的研究结果强调了需要采取多管齐下的策略，针对不同的动机因素，以确保在需要协调的情况下，全科医生能够按照患者的偏好行事。

abstract.text: Interrupted time series with and without controls was used to evaluate whether the federal Mental Health Parity and Addiction Equity Act (MHPAEA) and its Interim Final Rule increased the probability of specialty behavioral health treatment and levels of utilization and expenditures among patients receiving treatment. Linked insurance claims, eligibility, plan and employer data from 2008 to 2013 were used to estimate segmented regression analyses, allowing for level and slope changes during the transition (2010) and post-MHPAEA (2011-2013) periods. The sample included 1,812,541 individuals ages 27-64 (49,968,367 person-months) in 10,010 Optum "carve-out" plans. Two-part regression models with Generalized Estimating Equations were used to estimate expenditures by payer and outpatient, intermediate and inpatient service use. We found little evidence that MHPAEA increased utilization significantly, but somewhat more robust evidence that costs shifted from patients to plans. Thus the primary impact of MHPAEA among carve-out enrollees may have been a reduction in patient financial burden.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.09.009.abstractZh: 本研究使用有控制组和无控制组的中断时间序列数据，来评估《联邦心理健康平等与成瘾权益法》及其临时最终规则是否增加了接受专业行为健康治疗的患者接受治疗的概率、使用率及支出水平。研究利用2008至2013年的关联保险索赔、资格信息、计划及雇主数据，通过分段回归分析来估计变化期间（2010年）及《心理健康平等与成瘾权益法》实施后的时期（2011-2013年）的水平和斜率变化。样本包括10,010个Optum“分割”计划中的1,812,541名27-64岁的人群，总时间为49,968,367人月。采用两部分回归模型与广义估计方程，分别估算了不同支付方以及门诊、中级和住院服务使用的支出情况。研究发现，《心理健康平等与成瘾权益法》并未显著增加使用率，但成本从患者转移到了计划方的证据更为充分。因此，《心理健康平等与成瘾权益法》对分割计划中的参保者的主要影响可能是减轻了患者的经济负担。

abstract.text: Overcrowding in emergency departments generates potential inefficiencies. Using regional administrative data, we investigate the impact that an increase in the accessibility of primary care has on emergency visits in Italy. We consider two measures of avoidable emergency visits recorded at list level for each General Practitioner. We test whether extending practices' opening hours to up to 12 hours/day reduces the inappropriate utilization of emergency services. Since subscribing to the extension program is voluntary, we account for the potential endogeneity of participation in a count model for emergency admissions in two ways: first, we use a two-stage residual inclusion approach. Then we exploit panel methods on data covering a three-year period, thus accounting directly for individual heterogeneity. Our results show that increasing primary care accessibility acts as a restraint on the inappropriate use of emergency departments. The estimated effect is in the range of a 10-15% reduction in inappropriate admissions.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.09.011.abstractZh: 急诊科室的过度拥挤会导致潜在效率低下。我们利用区域行政数据，研究初级保健服务的可及性提高对意大利急诊就诊的影响。我们考虑了每位全科医生在列表级别上记录的两种可避免的急诊就诊情况。我们测试了将诊所的营业时间延长至每天12小时是否可以减少急诊服务的不当使用。由于参加这一延长计划是自愿的，我们通过两种方法来考虑参与情况的潜在内生性：首先，我们采用两阶段残差纳入法。然后，我们利用覆盖三年期间的数据，采用面板方法，直接考虑个体异质性。我们的结果显示，提高初级保健服务的可及性可以抑制急诊科室的不当使用。估计的效应为减少10-15%的不当就诊。

abstract.text: We conduct a framed field experiment among patients and doctors to test whether the two groups have similar risk and time preferences. We elicit risk and time preferences using multiple price list tests and their adaptations to the healthcare context. Risk and time preferences are compared in terms of switching points in the tests and the structurally estimated behavioural parameters. We find that doctors and patients significantly differ in their time preferences: doctors discount future outcomes less heavily than patients. We find no evidence that doctors and patients systematically differ in their risk preferences in the healthcare domain.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.10.001.abstractZh: 我们在患者和医生中进行了一项框架性实地实验，以测试这两组人在风险偏好和时间偏好方面是否存在差异。我们通过多种价格列表测试及其在医疗领域的适应性来收集风险偏好和时间偏好信息。在测试中的转换点以及通过结构估计的行为参数方面，我们对风险偏好和时间偏好进行了比较。我们发现，医生与患者在时间偏好上存在显著差异：医生对未来结果的折现程度低于患者。我们没有发现医生与患者在医疗领域的风险偏好上存在系统性差异的证据。

abstract.text: This study examines whether working conditions at the end of workers' careers impact health and contribute to health disparities across occupations. A dynamic panel correlated random effects model is used in conjunction with a rich data set that combines information from the Health and Retirement Study (HRS), expert ratings of job demands from the Occupational Information Network (O*NET), and mid-career earnings records from the Social Security Administration's (SSA) Master Earnings File (MEF). Results reveal a strong relationship between positive aspects of the psychosocial work environment and improved self-reported health status, blood pressure, and cognitive function. However, there is little evidence to suggest that working conditions shape observed health disparities between occupations in the years leading up to retirement.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2016.10.002.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了劳动者职业生涯结束时的工作条件是否会影响健康，并是否会导致不同职业之间的健康差异。研究采用了动态面板相关随机效应模型，并结合了来自“健康与退休研究”的数据集、职业信息网络的职业需求评级数据，以及社会保障管理局的职业生涯收入记录。研究结果表明，心理社会工作环境中的积极因素与改善的自我报告健康状况、血压和认知功能之间存在密切关系。然而，几乎没有证据表明工作条件能够影响退休前几年不同职业之间观察到的健康差异。

abstract.text: We analyze participation in international environmental agreements in a dynamic game in which countries pollute and invest in green technologies. If complete contracts are feasible, participants eliminate the holdup problem associated with their investments; however, most countries prefer to free ride rather than participate. If investments are noncontractible, countries face a holdup problem every time they negotiate; but the free-rider problem can be mitigated and significant participation is feasible. Participation becomes attractive because only large coalitions commit to long-term agreements that circumvent the holdup problem. Under well-specified conditions even the first-best outcome is possible when the contract is incomplete.

10.1086/684478.abstractZh: 我们分析了在国际环境协议中的参与情况，该协议基于一个动态博弈模型，其中各国在污染行为与绿色技术投资之间做出选择。如果合同能够完全履行，参与者可以避免投资过程中的拖延问题；然而，大多数国家更倾向于搭便车而非积极参与。如果投资不具备可契约性，各国在谈判过程中会面临拖延问题；但搭便车的问题可以通过一定措施得到缓解，从而实现显著的参与效果。参与变得有吸引力，因为只有大型联盟才会承诺达成能够规避拖延问题的长期协议。在条件明确的情况下，即使合同不完全，也能实现最优结果。

abstract.text: We assess the static and dynamic implications of alternative market-based policies limiting greenhouse gas emissions in the US cement industry. Our results highlight two countervailing market distortions. First, emissions regulation exacerbates distortions associated with the exercise of market power in the domestic cement market. Second, emissions "leakage" in trade-exposed markets offsets domestic emissions reductions. Taken together, these forces can result in social welfare losses under policy regimes that fully internalize the emissions externality. Market-based policies that incorporate design features to mitigate the exercise of market power and emissions leakage deliver welfare gains when damages from carbon emissions are high.

10.1086/684484.abstractZh: 我们评估了美国水泥行业限制温室气体排放的替代性市场政策在静态和动态层面的影响。我们的研究结果揭示了两种相互矛盾的市场扭曲现象。首先，排放管制加剧了国内水泥市场中市场力量行使所带来的扭曲。其次，在受贸易影响的市场中，排放“泄漏”现象抵消了国内排放减少的效果。综合来看，这些力量可能导致在完全内部化排放外部性的政策框架下，社会福利损失。而那些包含设计特征的基于市场的政策，能够缓解市场力量的行使和排放泄漏问题，并在碳排放造成的损害较高时带来社会福利收益。

abstract.text: We develop an endogenous growth model in which clean and dirty technologies compete in production. Research can be directed to either technology. If dirty technologies are more advanced, the transition to clean technology can be difficult. Carbon taxes and research subsidies may encourage production and innovation in clean technologies, though the transition will typically be slow. We estimate the model using microdata from the US energy sector. We then characterize the optimal policy path that heavily relies on both subsidies and taxes. Finally, we evaluate various alternative policies. Relying only on carbon taxes or delaying intervention has significant welfare costs.

10.1086/684511.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个内生增长模型，在该模型中，清洁技术和污染技术在生产领域相互竞争。研究可以针对任一技术进行。如果污染技术更为先进，那么向清洁技术的转型可能会比较困难。碳税和研究补贴可能会促进清洁技术的生产和创新，尽管这种转型通常会比较缓慢。我们使用美国能源部门的微观数据来估算该模型。然后，我们描述了一种依赖补贴和税收的最优政策路径。最后，我们评估了各种替代政策。仅依赖碳税或推迟干预措施都会带来显著的福利成本。

abstract.text: Can directed technical change be used to combat climate change? We construct new firm-level panel data on auto industry innovation distinguishing between "dirty" (internal combustion engine) and "clean" (e.g., electric, hybrid, and hydrogen) patents across 80 countries over several decades. We show that firms tend to innovate more in clean (and less in dirty) technologies when they face higher tax-inclusive fuel prices. Furthermore, there is path dependence in the type of innovation (clean/dirty) both from aggregate spillovers and from the firm's own innovation history. We simulate the increases in carbon taxes needed to allow clean technologies to overtake dirty technologies.

10.1086/684581.abstractZh: 能否利用定向的技术变革来应对气候变化？我们构建了关于汽车行业创新的新的企业级面板数据，这些数据区分了“污染型”（内燃机）和“清洁型”（如电动、混合动力和氢动力）技术，涵盖了80个国家在数十年间的创新情况。我们发现，当企业面临更高的含税燃料价格时，它们更倾向于在清洁型技术上进行创新，而在污染型技术上的创新则相对较少。此外，创新类型的选择存在路径依赖性，这种依赖性既源于整体溢出效应，也源于企业自身的创新历史。我们模拟了为使清洁技术超越污染型技术而所需的碳税增加幅度。

abstract.text: This paper examines the temperature-mortality relationship over the course of the twentieth-century United States both for its own interest and to identify potentially useful adaptations for coming decades. There are three primary findings. First, the mortality impact of days with mean temperature exceeding 80°F declined by 75 percent. Almost the entire decline occurred after 1960. Second, the diffusion of residential air conditioning explains essentially the entire decline in hot day-related fatalities. Third, using Dubin and McFadden's discrete-continuous model, the present value of US consumer surplus from the introduction of residential air conditioning is estimated to be $85-$185 billion (2012 dollars).

10.1086/684582.abstractZh: 本文研究了20世纪美国气温与死亡率之间的关系，既是为了自身的研究目的，也是为了为未来几十年寻找可能的适应措施。主要发现有以下三点：首先，平均气温超过80华氏度的天气对死亡率的影响下降了75%。这一下降几乎完全发生在1960年之后。其次，住宅空调的普及几乎完全解释了与炎热天气相关的死亡人数的减少。第三，根据Dubin和McFadden的离散-连续模型，引入住宅空调后，美国消费者剩余的价值估计为850亿至1850亿美元（以2012年美元计算）。

abstract.text: Many macroeconomists argue that productivity is low in developing countries because of frictions that impede the adoption of modern technologies. I argue that in the retail trade sector, developing countries rationally choose technologies with low measured labor productivity. My theory is that the adoption of modern retail technologies is optimal only when household ownership of complementary durable goods, such as cars, is widespread. Because income is low in the developing world, households own few such durables. The theory implies that policies that increase measured retail productivity do not necessarily increase welfare.

10.1086/684718.abstractZh: 许多宏观经济学家认为，发展中国家的生产力低下是因为存在阻碍现代技术采纳的摩擦。我认为，在零售业领域，发展中国家理性地选择了劳动生产力较低的现代技术。我的理论指出，只有当家庭普遍拥有诸如汽车这样的互补型耐用商品时，采用现代零售技术才是最优选择。由于发展中国家的收入较低，家庭拥有的此类耐用商品数量很少。这一理论表明，提高零售生产力的政策并不一定能提升福利水平。

abstract.text: A large agronomic literature models the implications of climate change for a variety of crops and locations around the world. The goal of the present paper is to quantify the macro-level consequences of these micro-level shocks. Using an extremely rich micro-level data set that contains information about the productivity--both before and after climate change--of each of 10 crops for each of 1.7 million fields covering the surface of the earth, we find that the impact of climate change on these agricultural markets would amount to a 0.26 percent reduction in global GDP when trade and production patterns are allowed to adjust. Since the value of output in our 10 crops is equal to 1.8 percent of world GDP, this corresponds to about one-sixth of total crop value.

10.1086/684719.abstractZh: 大量农学文献对气候变化对全球各种作物和地区的影響进行了建模。本文的目的是量化这些微观层面冲击在宏观层面的后果。我们使用了极其丰富的微观层面数据集，该数据集包含了关于10种作物在地球上170万块田地中，在气候变化前后的生产情况的信息。研究发现，当贸易和生产模式进行调整时，气候变化对这些农业市场的影响将导致全球GDP减少0.26%。由于这10种作物的产出价值占全球GDP的1.8%，这相当于总作物价值的六分之一左右。

abstract.text: Some technologies save lives—new vaccines, new surgical techniques, safer highways. Others threaten lives—pollution, nuclear accidents, global warming, and the rapid global transmission of disease. How is growth theory altered when technologies involve life and death instead of just higher consumption? This paper shows that taking life into account has first-order consequences. Under standard preferences, the value of life may rise faster than consumption, leading society to value safety over consumption growth. As a result, the optimal rate of consumption growth may be substantially lower than what is feasible, in some cases falling all the way to zero.

10.1086/684750.abstractZh: 一些技术能够拯救生命——新的疫苗、新的外科手术技术、更安全的公路。另一些技术则威胁着生命——污染、核事故、全球变暖以及疾病的快速全球传播。当技术涉及生死问题时，增长理论该如何改变？本文表明，将生命因素纳入考量会产生重要的影响。在标准的偏好条件下，生命的价值可能上升速度比消费更快，这使得社会更倾向于重视安全而非消费增长。因此，最优的消费增长速率可能会远低于实际可行的水平，在某些情况下甚至可能降至零。

abstract.text: To analyze the impact of labor market competition on the structure of compensation, we embed multitasking and screening within a Hotelling framework. Competition for talent leads to an escalation of performance pay, shifting effort away from long-term investments, risk management, and cooperation. Efficiency losses can exceed those from a single principal, who dulls incentives to extract rents. As competition intensifies, monopsonistic underincentivization of low-skill agents first decreases and then gives way to growing overincentivization of high-skill ones. Aggregate welfare is thus hill-shaped, while inequality tends to rise monotonically. Bonus caps can help restore balance in incentives but may generate other distortions.

10.1086/684853.abstractZh: 为了分析劳动力市场竞争对薪酬结构的影响，我们将多任务处理与筛选机制纳入霍特林框架中进行研究。人才竞争导致绩效薪酬的上升，使得人们将努力转向长期投资、风险管理和合作之外。效率损失可能超过单一主体带来的损失，因为单一主体会削弱激励以榨取租金。随着竞争加剧，低技能劳动者的激励水平首先下降，随后高技能劳动者的激励水平则逐渐上升。因此，总体福利呈现丘陵状分布，而不平等程度则呈单调上升趋势。奖金上限有助于恢复激励的平衡，但也可能产生其他扭曲效应。

abstract.text: This paper shows that adding a small application cost to a transfer program can substantially improve targeting through self-selection. Our village-level experiment in Indonesia finds that requiring beneficiaries to apply for benefits results in substantially poorer beneficiaries than automatic enrollment using the same asset test. Marginally increasing application costs on an experimental basis does not further improve targeting. Estimating a model of the application decision implies that the results are largely driven by the nonpoor, who make up the bulk of the population, forecasting that they are unlikely to pass the asset test and therefore not bothering to apply.

10.1086/685299.abstractZh: 本文指出，在转移计划中增加少量的申请成本可以显著改善通过自我选择来实现的目标定位效果。我们在印度尼西亚进行的村级实验发现，要求受益人申请福利会导致受益人的条件明显恶化，而使用相同的资产测试进行自动登记则不会产生同样的后果。在实验基础上略微增加申请成本并不会进一步改善目标定位效果。对申请决策模型进行估算表明，结果主要由非贫困人口驱动，他们构成了人口的大多数，因此他们不太可能通过资产测试，因此也不会去申请。

abstract.text: This study explores the consequences and origins of between-ethnicity economic inequality across countries. First, combining satellite images of nighttime luminosity with the historical homelands of ethnolinguistic groups we construct measures of ethnic inequality for a large sample of countries. We also compile proxies of overall spatial inequality and regional inequality across administrative units. Second, we uncover a strong negative association between ethnic inequality and contemporary comparative development; the correlation is also present when we condition on regional inequality, which is itself related to under-development. Third, we investigate the roots of ethnic inequality and establish that differences in geographic endowments across ethnic homelands explain a sizable fraction of the observed variation in economic disparities across groups. Fourth, we show that ethnic-specific inequality in geographic endowments is also linked to under-development.

10.1086/685300.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了不同国家间种族间经济不平等的成因与后果。首先，通过结合夜间亮度卫星图像与各民族语言群体的历史聚居地，我们为大量国家构建了种族不平等的衡量指标。同时，我们还汇总了整体空间不平等以及各行政单位之间的区域不平等的代理指标。其次，我们发现种族不平等与当代比较发展之间存在强烈的负相关关系；当考虑到区域不平等时，这种相关性依然存在，而区域不平等本身又与发展不足有关。第三，我们探究了种族不平等的根源，并发现不同种族聚居地之间的地理禀赋差异解释了经济差异中相当一部分的变异。第四，我们指出，特定种族在地理禀赋上的不平等也与发展不足有关。

abstract.text: Banking crises are rare events that break out in the midst of credit-intensive booms and bring about deep and long-lasting recessions. This paper presents a textbook dynamic stochastic general equilibrium model to explain these phenomena. The model features a nontrivial banking sector, where bank heterogeneity gives rise to an interbank market. Moral hazard and asymmetric information in this market may lead to sudden market freezes, banking crises, credit crunches, and severe "financial" recessions. Those recessions follow credit booms and are not necessarily triggered by large exogenous adverse shocks.

10.1086/685475.abstractZh: 银行危机是发生在信贷繁荣之中的罕见事件，它们会引发深刻而持久的经济衰退。本文提出了一个教科书式的动态随机一般均衡模型来解释这种现象。该模型包含一个非平凡的银行部门，银行之间的异质性导致了银行间市场的形成。市场中的道德风险和不对称信息可能导致市场突然冻结、银行危机、信贷紧缩以及严重的“金融”衰退。这些衰退发生在信贷繁荣之后，并不一定是由重大的外部负面冲击引发的。

abstract.text: We propose a theory of self-fulfilling unemployment fluctuations. When a firm increases its workforce, it raises demand and weakens competition facing other firms, as employed workers spend more and have less time to search for low prices than unemployed workers. These effects induce other firms to hire more labor in order to scale up their presence in the product market. The feedback between employment and product market conditions generates multiple equilibria—and the possibility of self-fulfilling fluctuations—if differences in shopping behavior between employed and unemployed are large enough. Evidence on spending, shopping, and prices suggests that this is the case.

10.1086/685909.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种关于自我实现性失业波动的理论。当一家企业增加员工数量时，它会提高需求并削弱其他企业的竞争压力，因为在职员工会花费更多的时间来寻找低价商品，而失业员工则没有这样的时间。这些效应促使其他企业增加劳动力以扩大在产品市场中的存在感。就业状况与产品市场条件之间的相互作用会产生多种均衡状态——如果在职员工和失业员工在购物行为上的差异足够大，就可能出现自我实现性波动。关于消费、购物和价格的证据表明，情况确实如此。

abstract.text: I investigate how teamwork may reduce moral hazard by joint monitoring and management. I study two organizational systems differing in the extent to which physicians may mutually manage work: Physicians are assigned patients in a “nurse-managed” system but divide patients between themselves in a “self-managed” system. The self-managed system increases throughput productivity by reducing a “foot-dragging” moral hazard, in which physicians prolong patient stays as expected future work increases. I find evidence that physicians in the same location have better information about each other and that, in the self-managed system, they use this information to assign patients.

10.1086/685910.abstractZh: 我研究团队合作如何通过联合监控和管理来减少道德风险。我研究了两种不同的组织系统，这两种系统在医生相互管理工作的程度上有所不同：“护士管理”系统中，医生被分配患者，而在“自我管理”系统中，医生则自行分配患者。自我管理系统通过减少“拖沓”的道德风险来提高生产效率，即医生延长患者住院时间，因为预期未来的工作会增加。我发现，同一地点的医生之间拥有更充分的信息，而在自我管理系统中，他们利用这些信息来分配患者。

abstract.text: Relying on diversity measures computed at the apartment block level under conditions of exogenous allocation of public housing in France, this paper identifies the effects of ethnic diversity on social relationships and housing quality. Housing Survey data reveal that diversity induces social anomie. Through the channel of anomie, diversity accounts for the inability of residents to sanction others for vandalism and to act collectively to demand proper building maintenance. However, anomie also lowers opportunities for violent confrontations, which are not related to diversity.

10.1086/686010.abstractZh: 本文基于法国公共住房分配制度下公寓楼级多样性指标的研究，探讨了种族多样性对社会关系与住房质量的影响。住房调查数据显示，多样性会导致社会失范。通过失范这一渠道，多样性解释了居民无法制裁他人破坏行为以及无法集体要求 proper 建筑维护的原因。然而，失范也降低了发生暴力冲突的可能性，而这与多样性并无关联。

abstract.text: We explore the relation between a country's income and the mix of products it exports. Both are simultaneously determined by countries' capabilities, that is, by countries' productivity and quality levels for each good. Our theoretical setup has two features. (1) Some goods have fewer high-quality producers/countries than others, meaning that there is comparative advantage. (2) Imperfect competition allows high- and low-quality producers to coexist. These two features generate an inverted-U, general equilibrium relationship between a country's export mix and its GDP per capita. We show that this inverted-U permeates the international data on trade and GDP per capita.

10.1086/686034.abstractZh: 我们探讨了一个国家收入与其出口产品组合之间的关系。这两者同时受到各国能力的制约，即各国每种商品的生产效率和质量水平。我们的理论模型具有两个特点：(1)某些商品的高品质生产者/国家数量少于其他商品，这意味着存在比较优势。(2)不完全竞争使得高质量和低质量的生产者能够共存。这两个特点导致了一个倒U形的总体均衡关系，即一个国家的出口产品组合与其人均GDP之间存在这种关系。我们证明，这种倒U形关系在国际贸易和人均GDP的数据中得到了体现。

abstract.text: Maternal mortality was the second-largest cause of death for women in childbearing years until the mid-1930s in the United States. For each death, 20 times as many mothers suffered pregnancy-related conditions, which made it hard for them to engage in market work. Between 1930 and 1960 there was a remarkable improvement in maternal health. We argue that this development, by enabling women to reconcile work and motherhood, was essential for the joint rise in women’s labor force participation and fertility over this period. We also show that the diffusion of infant formula played an important auxiliary role.

10.1086/686035.abstractZh: 在20世纪30年代中期之前，孕产妇死亡是美国育龄妇女的第二大死因。每有一名妇女因孕产妇疾病死亡，就有20名妇女因怀孕相关疾病而遭受痛苦，这使得她们难以参与市场劳动。从1930年到1960年，孕产妇健康状况取得了显著改善。我们认为，这一发展使得妇女能够兼顾工作和母职，从而促进了这一时期妇女劳动力参与率和生育率的共同提升。我们还指出，婴儿配方奶粉的普及也起到了重要的辅助作用。

abstract.text: We evaluate returns to General Educational Development (GED) certification for high school dropouts using state administrative data. We apply a fuzzy regression discontinuity method to account for test takers retaking the test. For women we find that GED certification has no statistically significant effect on either employment or earnings. For men we find a significant increase in earnings in the second year after taking the test but no impact in subsequent years. GED certification increases postsecondary school enrollment by 4-8 percentage points. Our results differ from regression discontinuity approaches that fail to account for test retaking.

10.1086/686245.abstractZh: 我们使用州行政数据评估高中辍学者获得普通教育发展证书所带来的回报。我们采用模糊回归断点方法来处理考生重新参加考试的情况。对于女性来说，我们发现获得普通教育发展证书对就业或收入没有统计学上的显著影响。对于男性而言，我们发现参加考试后的第二年收入有显著增长，但在后续年份则没有影响。获得普通教育发展证书使高等教育入学率增加了4-8个百分点。我们的结果与那些未能考虑考试重考情况的回归断点方法有所不同。

abstract.text: A seller wishes to sell multiple goods by a deadline, for example, the end of a season. Potential buyers enter over time and can strategically time their purchases. Each period, the profit-maximizing mechanism awards units to the buyers with the highest valuations exceeding a sequence of cutoffs. We show that these cutoffs are deterministic, depending only on the inventory and time remaining; in the continuous-time limit, the optimal mechanism can be implemented by posting anonymous prices. When incoming demand decreases over time, the optimal cutoffs satisfy a one-period-look-ahead property and prices are defined by an intuitive differential equation.

10.1086/686713.abstractZh: 一位销售商希望在某个截止日期前售出多件商品，例如某个季节的结束时间。潜在买家会随着时间的推移进入市场，并可以策略性地安排购买时间。在每个时期，以利润最大化的机制会向估值最高的买家分配单位，这些估值超过了一定的阈值序列。我们发现这些阈值是确定性的，仅取决于库存和剩余时间；在连续时间范围内，最优机制可以通过发布匿名价格来实施。当需求随时间减少时，最优阈值满足了一期预测的特性，而价格则由直观的微分方程定义。

abstract.text: Some booms in housing prices are followed by busts. Others are not. It is generally difficult to find observable fundamentals that are useful for predicting whether a boom will turn into a bust or not. We develop a model consistent with these observations. Agents have heterogeneous expectations about long-run fundamentals but change their views because of “social dynamics.” Agents with tighter priors are more likely to convert others to their beliefs. Boom-bust episodes typically occur when skeptical agents happen to be correct. The booms that are not followed by busts typically occur when optimistic agents happen to be correct.

10.1086/686732.abstractZh: 一些房价上涨之后会伴随着下跌，而另一些则不会。通常很难找到一些可观察的基本面因素来预测房价上涨是否会转为下跌。我们开发了一个与这些观察结果一致的模型。代理人对长期基本面因素有着不同的预期，但由于“社会动态”的影响，他们的看法会发生变化。持有更严格先验假设的代理人更有可能说服其他人接受他们的观点。当持怀疑态度的代理人认为情况正确时，就会出现房价上涨后下跌的情况；而当持乐观态度的代理人认为情况正确时，就会出现房价上涨但未伴随下跌的情况。

abstract.text: A key problem with solar energy is intermittency: solar generators produce only when the sun is shining, adding to social costs and requiring electricity system operators to reoptimize key decisions. We develop a method to quantify the economic value of large-scale renewable energy. We estimate the model for southeastern Arizona. Not accounting for offset carbon dioxide, we find social costs of $138.40 per megawatt hour for 20 percent solar generation, of which unforecastable intermittency accounts for $6.10 and intermittency overall for $46.00. With solar installation costs of $1.52 per watt and carbon dioxide social costs of $39.00 per ton, 20 percent solar would be welfare neutral.

10.1086/686733.abstractZh: 太阳能的一个关键问题是间歇性：太阳能发电机只有在阳光充足时才会发电，这增加了社会成本，并需要电力系统运营商重新优化关键决策。我们开发了一种方法来量化大规模可再生能源的经济价值。我们对亚利桑那州东南部的模型进行了估算。如果不考虑二氧化碳的抵消，20%的太阳能发电会带来每兆瓦时138.40美元的社会成本，其中不可预测的间歇性因素占6.10美元，整体间歇性因素占46.00美元。考虑到太阳能设备的安装成本为每瓦1.52美元，以及每吨二氧化碳的社会成本为39.00美元，20%的太阳能发电将不会对社会福利产生负面影响。

abstract.text: This paper examines the macroeconomic implications of sovereign risk in a model in which banks hold domestic government debt. News of a future sovereign default hampers financial intermediation. First, it tightens the funding constraints of banks, reducing their resources to finance firms (liquidity channel). Second, it generates a precautionary motive to deleverage (risk channel). I estimate the model using Italian data, finding that sovereign risk was recessionary and that the risk channel was sizable. I also use the model to measure the effects of subsidized long-term loans to banks. Precautionary motives at the height of the crisis imply that bank lending to firms responds little to these interventions.

10.1086/686734.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在银行持有国内政府债务模型中，主权风险对宏观经济的影响。未来主权违约的消息会阻碍金融中介活动。首先，它会加剧银行的资金紧张状况，减少其用于为企业融资的资源（流动性渠道）。其次，这会引发减少杠杆的预防性动机（风险渠道）。我使用意大利数据对模型进行了估计，发现主权风险会导致经济衰退，且风险渠道的影响相当显著。我还利用该模型来衡量对银行提供补贴性长期贷款的影响。在危机最严重的时候，预防性动机意味着银行对企业的贷款对这类干预措施的反应很小。

abstract.text: Exploiting regression discontinuity designs in Brazilian, Indian, and Canadian first-past-the-post elections, we document that second-place candidates are substantially more likely than close third-place candidates to run in, and win, subsequent elections. Since both candidates lost the election and had similar electoral performance, this is the effect of being labeled the runner-up. Selection into candidacy is unlikely to explain the effect on winning subsequent elections, and we find no effect of finishing in third place versus fourth place. We develop a simple model of strategic coordination by voters that rationalizes the results and provides further predictions that are supported by the data.

10.1086/686746.abstractZh: 在巴西、印度和加拿大的简单多数选举中，我们利用回归不连续设计发现，排名第二的候选人比排名第三的候选人更有可能参加并赢得后续的选举。由于两位候选人都未能赢得选举且选举表现相似，这种现象可以被解释为被标记为亚军所带来的影响。候选人资格的选择不太可能解释其赢得后续选举的能力，同时我们也没有发现排名第三与第四之间的差异。我们提出了一个简单的选民策略协调模型，以解释这些结果，并提供了进一步的数据支持预测。

abstract.text: We analyze a bargaining situation in which preferences evolve over time and the previous agreement becomes the next status quo. The endogeneity of the status quo exacerbates the players' conflict of interest: Players disagree more often than under exogenous status quo. This leads to inefficiencies and status quo inertia. Under certain conditions, the negotiations can come to a complete gridlock: Players never reach an agreement. Gridlock can occur between players with arbitrarily similar preferences, provided they are sufficiently patient. In legislative settings, our model predicts polarization and explains why legislators may fail to react promptly to economic shocks.

10.1086/686747.abstractZh: 我们分析了一种讨价还价情境，其中偏好随时间演变，之前的协议成为下一个现状。现状的内生性加剧了参与者的利益冲突：参与者之间的分歧比在外部给定的现状下更为频繁。这导致了效率低下和现状的惯性。在某些条件下，谈判可能会陷入完全僵局：参与者永远无法达成协议。只要参与者有足够的耐心，即使他们的偏好非常相似，也可能出现僵局。在立法环境中，我们的模型预测了两极分化现象，并解释了为什么立法者可能无法及时应对经济冲击。

abstract.text: We study the efficiency of premarital investments when parents care about their child’s marriage prospects, in a large frictionless marriage market with nontransferable utility. Stochastic returns to investment ensure that equilibrium is unique. We find that, generically, investments exceed the Pareto-efficient level, unless the sexes are symmetric in all respects. Girls will invest more than boys if their quality shocks are less variable than shocks for boys or if they are the abundant sex. The unique equilibrium in our continuum agent model is the limit of the equilibria of finite models, as the number of agents tends to infinity.

10.1086/686748.abstractZh: 我们研究了在父母关心孩子婚姻前景的情况下，婚前投资的效率问题，研究背景是一个没有摩擦的大型婚姻市场，且效用是不可转移的。投资的随机回报确保了均衡的唯一性。我们发现，通常情况下，投资水平超过了帕累托效率水平，除非性别在所有方面都是对称的。如果女孩的质量冲击比男孩的冲击变化小，或者如果女孩是数量较多的性别，那么她们的投资会多于男孩。在我们的连续代理人模型中，唯一均衡是有限模型均衡的极限，随着代理人数量趋于无穷大。

abstract.text: This paper develops a price-theoretic framework for matching markets with heterogeneous preferences. The model departs from the Gale and Shapley model by assuming that a finite number of agents on one side (colleges) are matched to a continuum of agents on the other side (students). We show that stable matchings correspond to solutions of supply and demand equations, with the selectivity of each college playing a role similar to that of prices. We apply the model to an analysis of how competition induced by school choice gives schools incentives to invest in quality and to asymptotics of school choice mechanisms.

10.1086/687476.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个价格理论框架，用于描述具有异质偏好的匹配市场。该模型基于Gale和Shapley模型，假设一方（大学）的有限数量代理人与另一方（学生）的连续代理人进行匹配。我们证明，稳定的匹配对应于供需方程的解决方案，而每所大学的选择性则类似于价格的作用。我们还将该模型应用于分析学校选择引发的竞争如何激励学校投资于质量，以及学校选择机制的渐近行为。

abstract.text: Expert performance is often evaluated assuming that good experts have good outcomes. We examine expertise in medicine and develop a model that allows for two dimensions of physician performance: decision making and procedural skill. Better procedural skill increases the use of intensive procedures for everyone, while better decision making results in a reallocation of procedures from fewer low-risk to high-risk cases. We show that poor diagnosticians can be identified using administrative data and that improving decision making improves birth outcomes by reducing C-section rates at the bottom of the risk distribution and increasing them at the top of the distribution.

10.1086/687848.abstractZh: 专家的表现通常基于这样的假设来评估：优秀的专家会带来良好的结果。我们研究了医学领域的专业知识，并开发了一个模型，该模型能够区分医生表现的两个维度：决策能力和操作技巧。更好的操作技巧会促使更多人采用更为复杂的手术方式，而更好的决策能力则会导致手术方式的重新分配，即从风险较低的病例转向风险较高的病例。我们证明，可以通过行政数据识别出诊断能力较差的医生，而提高决策能力可以通过降低风险较低的病例的剖宫产率，同时提高风险较高的病例的剖宫产率，从而改善出生结果。

abstract.text: We measure the effects of debt dilution on sovereign default risk and study debt covenants that could mitigate these effects. We calibrate a baseline model with endogenous debt duration and default risk (in which debt can be diluted) using data from Spain. We find that debt dilution accounts for 78 percent of the default risk in the baseline economy and that eliminating dilution increases the optimal duration of sovereign debt by almost 2 years. Eliminating dilution also increases consumption volatility but still produces welfare gains. The debt covenants we study could help enforcing fiscal rules.

10.1086/688081.abstractZh: 我们研究了债务稀释对主权违约风险的影响，并研究了能够缓解这些影响的债务契约。我们使用西班牙的数据，对包含内生债务期限和违约风险（其中债务可以被稀释）的基线模型进行了校准。我们发现，在基线经济中，债务稀释占违约风险的78%，而消除稀释效应可以使主权债务的最优期限增加近2年。消除稀释效应还会增加消费波动性，但依然能带来福利收益。我们研究的债务契约有助于执行财政规则。

abstract.text: We study decentralized college admissions with uncertain student preferences. Colleges strategically admit students likely to be overlooked by competitors. Highly ranked students may receive fewer admissions or have a higher chance of receiving no admissions than those ranked below. When students’ attributes are multidimensional, colleges avoid head-on competition by placing excessive weight on school-specific attributes such as essays. Restricting the number of applications or wait-listing alleviates enrollment uncertainty, but the outcomes are inefficient and unfair. A centralized matching via Gale and Shapley’s deferred acceptance algorithm attains efficiency and fairness but may make some colleges worse off than under decentralized matching.

10.1086/688082.abstractZh: 我们研究了学生偏好不确定的去中心化大学招生问题。大学会策略性地录取那些可能被竞争对手忽视的学生。排名较高的学生可能获得的录取机会较少，或者没有被录取的概率较高。当学生的属性是多维的时，大学通过给予学校特定属性（如论文）过多的权重来避免正面竞争。限制申请数量或采用等待名单制度可以降低招生的不确定性，但这种方式效率低下且不公平。通过Gale和Shapley的延迟接受算法进行集中式匹配可以达到效率和公平性的平衡，但可能会让一些大学的处境比去中心化匹配时更糟。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes the inefficiencies arising from the combination of fixed exchange rates, nominal rigidity, and free capital mobility. We document that nominal wages are downwardly rigid in emerging countries. We develop an open-economy model that incorporates this friction. The model predicts that the combination of a currency peg and free capital mobility creates a negative externality that causes overborrowing during booms and high unemployment during contractions. Optimal capital controls are shown to be prudential. For plausible calibrations, they reduce unemployment by around 5 percentage points. The optimal exchange rate policy eliminates unemployment and calls for large devaluations during crises.

10.1086/688175.abstractZh: 本文分析了固定汇率、名义刚性以及自由资本流动相结合所带来的效率低下问题。我们发现，新兴国家的名义工资存在向下刚性。我们建立了一个包含这种摩擦的开放经济模型。该模型预测，货币挂钩与自由资本流动的结合会产生负面外部性，导致经济繁荣时期过度借贷，而在经济衰退时期出现高失业率。最优的资本管制被证明是审慎的。在合理的参数设定下，这种管制可以将失业率降低约5个百分点。最优的汇率政策能够消除失业问题，并在危机期间实施大规模贬值。

abstract.text: We study how firms differ from their competitors using new time-varying measures of product similarity based on text-based analysis of firm 10-K product descriptions. This year-by-year set of product similarity measures allows us to generate a new set of industries in which firms can have their own distinct set of competitors. Our new sets of competitors explain specific discussion of high competition, rivals identified by managers as peer firms, and changes to industry competitors following exogenous industry shocks. We also find evidence that firm R&D and advertising are associated with subsequent differentiation from competitors, consistent with theories of endogenous product differentiation.

10.1086/688176.abstractZh: 我们研究了企业与其竞争对手之间的差异，通过基于文本分析的企业10-K产品描述，采用新的随时间变化的产品相似性度量方法。这种逐年更新的产品相似性度量方法使我们能够识别出企业拥有自己独特竞争对手的新行业。我们的新竞争对手分类解释了高竞争性的具体原因、管理者认定的同行竞争对手，以及行业冲击后行业竞争对手的变化。我们还发现，企业的研发和广告活动与从竞争对手中脱颖而出有关，这与内生性产品差异化理论是一致的。

abstract.text: We exploit the randomness of weather and the relationship between weather and moviegoing to quantify social spillovers in movie consumption. Instrumenting for early viewership with plausibly exogenous weather shocks captured in LASSO-chosen instruments, we find that shocks to opening weekend viewership are doubled over the following five weekends. Our estimated momentum arises almost exclusively at the local level, and we find no evidence that it varies with either ex post movie quality or the precision of ex ante information about movie quality, suggesting that the observed momentum is driven in part by a preference for shared experience, and not only by social learning.

10.1086/688177.abstractZh: 我们利用天气的随机性以及天气与电影观看之间的关系，来量化电影消费的社会溢出效应。通过使用LASSO算法选择的工具变量来捕捉早期观众观看情况所受的随机天气冲击，我们发现开幕周末观众观看情况受到的影响在接下来的五个周末会翻倍。我们估计的观看动量几乎完全发生在地方层面，并且我们没有发现这种动量随着电影质量或关于电影质量的先验信息的准确性而变化，这表明观察到的观看动量部分是由对共享体验的偏好所驱动的，而不仅仅是社会学习的结果。

abstract.text: Incumbent politicians tend to receive more votes when economic conditions are good. In this paper we explore the source of this correlation, exploiting the exceptional evidence provided by the Spanish Christmas Lottery. Because winning tickets are typically sold by one lottery outlet, winners tend to be geographically clustered. This allows us to study the impact of exogenous good economic conditions on voting behavior. We find that incumbents receive significantly more votes in winning provinces. The evidence is consistent with a temporary increase in happiness making voters more lenient toward the incumbent, or with a stronger preference for the status quo.

10.1086/688178.abstractZh: 在经济状况良好的情况下，现任政治家往往能够获得更多的选票。本文通过西班牙圣诞彩票这一特殊案例来探讨这种关联的来源。由于中奖彩票通常由同一家彩票销售点出售，中奖者往往集中在特定的地理区域。这使我们能够研究良好的经济状况对投票行为的影响。我们发现，现任政治家在获胜省份获得的选票明显更多。这一结果可能与选民因经济状况良好而暂时感到更幸福，从而对现任政治家更加宽容有关，或者与选民对现状的偏好更强有关。

abstract.text: We investigate how cognitive ability and character skills influence the evolution of play toward Nash equilibrium in repeated strategic interactions. We find that more cognitively able subjects choose numbers closer to equilibrium, earn more, and converge more frequently to equilibrium play. We estimate a structural model of learning based on level k reasoning and find a positive relationship between cognitive ability and levels. Furthermore, the average level of more cognitively able subjects responds positively to the cognitive ability of their opponents. More agreeable and emotionally stable subjects also learn faster, although the effect of cognitive ability is stronger than that of personality.

10.1086/688849.abstractZh: 我们研究了认知能力与性格特质如何影响重复策略互动中游戏向纳什均衡的演变。研究发现，认知能力更强的参与者会选择更接近均衡的数字，获得更多的收益，并且更频繁地趋向于均衡博弈。我们基于层次k推理构建了一个学习结构模型，并发现认知能力与层次之间存在正相关关系。此外，认知能力更强的参与者的平均层次水平对对手的认知能力表现出积极反应。更友善且情绪稳定的参与者学习速度也更快，尽管认知能力的影响比性格特质的影响更为显著。

abstract.text: Referred workers are more likely than nonreferred workers to be hired, all else equal. In three field experiments in an online labor market, we examine why. We find that referrals contain positive information about worker performance and persistence that is not contained in workers' observable characteristics. We also find that referrals perform particularly well when working directly with their referrers. However, we do not find evidence that referrals exert more effort because they believe their performance will affect their relationship with their referrer or their referrer's position at the firm.

10.1086/688850.abstractZh: 在其他条件相同的情况下，被推荐的员工比未被推荐的员工更有可能被录用。我们在三个在线劳动力市场的实地实验中研究了这一现象的原因。我们发现，推荐信息包含了关于员工表现和持续性的积极信息，而这些信息并不包含在员工可观察到的特征中。我们还发现，当推荐员工直接与推荐者合作时，他们的表现尤为出色。然而，我们没有发现证据表明推荐员工会付出更多的努力，因为他们相信自己的表现会影响与推荐者之间的关系，或者影响推荐者在公司中的职位。

abstract.text: A firm considers hiring an agent who may be competent for a potential project or not. The agent can prove her competence but faces a holdup problem. We propose a model of persuasion and show how gradualism helps mitigate the holdup problem. We show when it is optimal to give away part of the information at the beginning of the bargaining and sell the remainder in dribs and drabs. The agent can appropriate only part of the value of information. Introducing a third party allows her to extract the maximum surplus.

10.1086/688874.abstractZh: 一家公司正在考虑是否雇佣一名可能具备胜任能力的代理人来参与某个项目。该代理人可以证明自己的能力，但面临着拖延问题。我们提出了一个说服模型，并展示了渐进式策略如何有助于缓解这一拖延问题。我们说明了在谈判初期透露部分信息，然后逐步透露其余信息的策略是否是最优的。代理人只能占有部分信息价值。引入第三方可以让她获得最大的收益。

abstract.text: We study how an improvement in market transparency affects seller exit and continuing sellers' behavior in a market setting that involves informational asymmetries. The improvement was achieved by reducing strategic bias in buyer ratings. It led to a significant increase in buyer satisfaction with seller performance, but not to an increase in seller exit. When sellers had the choice between exiting--a reduction in adverse selection--and staying but improving behavior--a reduction in moral hazard--they preferred the latter. Increasing market transparency led to better market outcomes.

10.1086/688875.abstractZh: 我们研究了市场透明度提高如何影响在存在信息不对称的市场环境中卖家的退出行为以及持续经营者的行为。这种透明度的提高是通过减少买家评价中的策略性偏差来实现的。这导致买家对卖家表现满意度显著提高，但并未增加卖家的退出意愿。当卖家面临两种选择时——一种是减少逆向选择，另一种是保持经营但改善行为——减少道德风险——他们更倾向于选择后者。市场透明度的提高带来了更好的市场结果。

abstract.text: The flow opportunity cost of moving from unemployment to employment consists of forgone public benefits and the forgone consumption value of nonworking time. We construct a time series of the opportunity cost of employment using detailed microdata and administrative or national accounts data to estimate benefits levels, eligibility, take-up, consumption by labor force status, hours, taxes, and preference parameters. The opportunity cost is procyclical and volatile over the business cycle. The estimated cyclicality implies far less unemployment volatility in leading models of the labor market than that observed in the data, irrespective of the level of the opportunity cost.

10.1086/688876.abstractZh: 从失业状态转变为就业状态的流动机会成本包括被放弃的公共福利以及非工作时间中被放弃的消费价值。我们利用详细的微观数据以及行政或国民账户数据，构建了一个关于就业机会成本的时间序列，以估算福利水平、资格要求、接受程度、不同劳动力状态的消费情况、工作时间、税收以及偏好参数。这种机会成本具有顺周期性，并且在商业周期中波动较大。根据估算结果，与数据所观察到的相比，主要劳动力市场模型中的失业波动要小得多，无论机会成本的水平如何。

abstract.text: By exploiting a reform in the United Arab Emirates that relaxed restrictions on employer transitions, we provide new estimates of the monopsony power of firms over migrant workers. Our results show that the reform increased incumbent migrants' earnings and firm retention. This occurs despite an increase in employer transitions and is driven by a fall in country exits. While the outcomes of incumbents improved, the reform decreased demand for new migrants and lowered their earnings. These results are consistent with a model of monopsony in which firms face upward-sloping labor supply curves for both new recruits in source countries and incumbent migrants.

10.1086/688877.abstractZh: 通过利用阿拉伯联合酋长国的一项改革，该改革放宽了雇主更换的限制，我们得出了关于企业相对于移民工人的垄断力量的新估计。研究结果表明，这项改革增加了现有移民的收入和企业对移民的保留能力。这一现象的出现尽管伴随着雇主更换次数的增加，但企业保留移民的情况却有所改善，这主要是由于国家移民出境人数的减少。虽然现有移民的处境有所改善，但改革也降低了对新移民的需求，并降低了他们的收入。这些结果与一个垄断力量模型相符，该模型认为企业面临的是向上倾斜的劳动力供应曲线，无论是来自来源国的新招聘人员还是现有的移民。

abstract.text: The year 1946 has been seen as a pivotal year of transition by historians of the Chicago Economics Department, in large part as a result of the arrival of Milton Friedman that year. This essay examines new evidence on department deliberations on faculty hiring in February of 1946. It argues that Friedman's recruitment reflected a compromise between Frank Knight and his followers on the one hand and those associated with the Cowles Commission on the other.

10.1086/688878.abstractZh: 历史学家认为，1946年对芝加哥经济系来说是一个重要的转折点，这很大程度上是因为米尔顿·弗里德曼在那一年加入了该系。本文探讨了关于1946年2月经济系在师资招聘方面的讨论的新证据。文章认为，弗里德曼的招聘行为反映了弗兰克·奈特及其追随者与与考尔斯委员会相关的人士之间的一种妥协。

abstract.text: Private equity firms are often criticized for laying off workers, but the evidence on who loses their jobs and why is scarce. This paper argues that explanations for job polarization also explain layoffs after private equity buyouts. Buyouts reduce agency problems, which triggers automation and offshoring. Using rich employer-employee data, we show that buyouts generally do not affect unemployment incidence. However, unemployment incidence doubles for workers in less productive firms who perform routine or offshorable job tasks. Job polarization is also much more marked among workers affected by buyouts than for the economy at large.

10.1086/690712.abstractZh: 私募股权公司经常因裁员而受到批评，但关于谁会失去工作以及为何失去工作的具体证据却很少。本文认为，对就业两极分化的解释同样适用于私募股权收购后的裁员现象。收购行为减少了代理问题，从而引发了自动化和离岸外包。通过丰富的雇主与员工数据，我们发现收购行为通常不会影响失业率的分布。然而，对于那些在生产力较低的公司中从事常规或可离岸外包工作的员工来说，失业率会翻倍。受收购影响的员工之间的就业分化现象，比对整个经济体的影响更为显著。

abstract.text: Recent research suggests that much of the cross-firm variation in measured productivity is due to differences in use of advanced management practices.Many of these practices -including monitoring, goal setting, and the use of incentives -are mediated through employee decisionmaking and effort.To the extent that these practices are complementary with workers' skills, better-managed firms will tend to recruit higher-ability workers and adopt pay practices to retain these employees.We use a unique data set that combines detailed survey data on the management practices of German manufacturing firms with longitudinal earnings records for their employees to study the relationship between productivity, management, worker ability, and pay.As documented by Bloom and Van Reenen (2007) there is a strong partial correlation between management practice scores and firm-level productivity in Germany.In our preferred TFP estimates only a small fraction of this correlation is explained by the higher human capital of the average employee at better-managed firms.A larger share (about 13%) is attributable to the human capital of the highest-paid workers, a group we interpret as representing the managers of the firm.And a similar amount is mediated through the pay premiums offered by better-managed firms.Looking at employee inflows and outflows, we confirm that better-managed firms systematically recruit and retain workers with higher average human capital.Overall, we conclude that workforce selection and positive pay premiums explain just under 30% of the measured impact of management practices on productivity in German manufacturing.

10.1086/694107.abstractZh: 近期研究表明，企业间在生产力上的差异很大程度上源于先进管理实践的应用差异。这些实践包括监控、目标设定以及激励措施的使用，它们都是通过员工的决策和努力来实施的。如果这些实践与员工的技能相辅相成，那么管理较好的企业往往会招聘能力更强的员工，并采用薪酬政策来留住这些员工。我们使用了一种独特的数据集，该数据集结合了德国制造企业的管理实践的详细调查数据以及员工的纵向收入记录，以研究生产力、管理、员工能力和薪酬之间的关系。正如Bloom和Van Reenen（2007）所记录的，德国的管理实践得分与企业层面的生产力之间存在较强的部分相关性。在我们的全要素生产率估计中，这种相关性中只有一小部分可以通过管理较好的企业中员工较高的人力资本来解释。更大的一部分（约13%）则归因于薪酬最高的员工的人力资本，我们认为这部分员工代表了企业的管理者。同样，较好的企业提供的薪酬优势也起到了一定的作用。通过观察员工的流入和流出情况，我们确认管理较好的企业系统性地招聘并留住具有较高平均人力资本的员工。总体而言，我们得出结论，劳动力选择以及积极的薪酬优势解释了德国制造企业中管理实践对生产力影响的近30%。

abstract.text: This article develops an idea flows theory of trade and growth with heterogeneous firms. Entrants learn from incumbent firms, and the diffusion technology is such that learning depends not on the frontier technology, but on the entire distribution of productivity. By shifting the productivity distribution upward, selection causes technology diffusion, and in equilibrium this dynamic selection process leads to endogenous growth without scale effects. On the balanced growth path, the productivity distribution is a traveling wave with a lower bound that increases over time. The free entry condition implies trade liberalization must increase the dynamic selection rate to offset the profits from new export opportunities. Consequently, trade integration raises long-run growth. Dynamic selection is a new source of gains from trade not found when firms are homogeneous. Calibrating the model implies dynamic selection approximately triples the gains from trade compared to heterogeneous firm economies with static steady states.

10.1093/qje/qjv032.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种关于贸易与增长中异质企业动态选择的理论。新进入者从现有企业那里学习，而技术扩散的方式使得学习过程不依赖于前沿技术，而是依赖于整个生产率分布。通过提升生产率分布，动态选择促进了技术扩散，在均衡状态下，这种动态选择过程导致了内生增长，而无需依赖规模效应。在平衡增长路径上，生产率分布呈现一种具有时间递增下限的波动趋势。自由进入条件意味着贸易自由化必须提高动态选择率，以抵消新出口机会带来的利润。因此，贸易一体化能够提升长期增长水平。动态选择是贸易带来的新收益来源，这种收益在企业同质的情况下并不存在。通过模型校准发现，与静态稳态的异质企业经济相比，动态选择带来的贸易收益大约增加了三倍。

abstract.text: We study political competition in an environment in which voters have private information about their preferences. Our framework covers models of income taxation, public-goods provision, or publicly provided private goods. Politicians are vote-share maximizers. They can propose any policy that is resource-feasible and incentive-compatible. They can also offer special favors to subsets of the electorate. We prove two main results. First, the unique symmetric equilibrium is such that policies are surplus-maximizing and hence first-best Pareto-efficient. Second, there is a surplus-maximizing policy that wins a majority against any welfare-maximizing policy. Thus, in our model, policies that trade off equity and efficiency considerations are politically infeasible.

10.1093/qje/qjv033.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个选民拥有关于自身偏好私人信息的环境中的政治竞争。我们的框架涵盖了所得税制、公共物品供给或公共提供的私人物品的模型。政治家是投票份额最大化者，他们可以提出任何资源可行且激励相容的政策。他们还可以向选民的某些子集提供特殊优惠。我们证明了两个主要结果：首先，唯一的对称均衡使得政策能够最大化剩余，因此是最优的帕累托有效政策；其次，存在一种最大化剩余的政策，它能够以多数优势胜过任何最大化福利的政策。因此，在我们的模型中，那些在公平与效率之间做出权衡的政策在政治上是不可行的。

abstract.text: Programs to encourage labor market activity among youth, including public employment programs and wage subsidies like the Work Opportunity Tax Credit, can be supported by three broad rationales. They may (i) provide contemporaneous income support to participants; (ii) encourage work experience that improves future employment and/or educational outcomes of participants; and/or (iii) keep participants “out of trouble.” We study randomized lotteries for access to the New York City (NYC) Summer Youth Employment Program (SYEP), the largest summer youth employment program in the United States, by merging SYEP administrative data on 294,100 lottery participants to IRS data on the universe of U.S. tax records; to New York State administrative incarceration data; and to NYC administrative cause of death data. In assessing the three rationales, we find that (i) SYEP participation causes average earnings and the probability of employment to increase in the year of program participation, with modest contemporaneous crowdout of other earnings and employment; (ii) SYEP participation causes a modest decrease in average earnings for three years following the program and has no impact on college enrollment; and (iii) SYEP participation decreases the probability of incarceration and decreases the probability of mortality, which has important and potentially pivotal implications for analyzing the net benefits of the program.

10.1093/qje/qjv034.abstractZh: 旨在促进青年劳动力市场活动的计划，包括公共就业计划和如工作机会税收抵免这样的工资补贴，可以基于三个广泛的理由得到支持。这些计划可能：(i) 为参与者提供同时期的收入支持；(ii) 鼓励能够提升未来就业和/或教育成果的工作经验；(iii) 使参与者“避免陷入困境”。我们研究了纽约市夏季青年就业计划（SYEP）的随机抽签机制，该计划是美国最大的夏季青年就业计划。我们通过将SYEP的行政数据（涉及294,100名抽签参与者）与IRS的美国税务记录数据、纽约州的监禁数据以及纽约市的死亡数据相结合来进行研究。在评估这三个理由时，我们发现：(i) 参与SYEP会使平均收入和在参与计划当年的就业概率增加，同时会适度抑制其他收入和就业机会；(ii) 参与SYEP会在计划后的三年内使平均收入略有下降，但对大学入学率没有影响；(iii) 参与SYEP会降低监禁概率和死亡概率，这对分析该计划的净收益具有重要意义，甚至可能是关键性的。

abstract.text: This article explains why decentralization can undermine accountability and answers three questions: what determines if power should be centralized or decentralized when regions are heterogeneous? How many levels of government should there be? How should state borders be drawn? We develop a model of political agency in which voters differ in their ability to monitor rent-seeking politicians. We find that rent extraction is a decreasing and convex function of the share of informed voters, because voter information improves monitoring but also reduces the appeal of holding office. As a result, information heterogeneity pushes toward centralization to reduce rent extraction. Taste heterogeneity pulls instead toward decentralization to match local preferences. Our model thus implies that optimal borders should cluster by tastes but ensure diversity of information. We also find economies of scope in accountability that explain why multiplying government tiers harms efficiency. A single government in charge of many policies has better incentives than many special-purpose governments splitting its budget and responsibilities. Hence, a federal system is desirable only if information varies enough across regions.

10.1093/qje/qjv035.abstractZh: 本文探讨了为何去中心化会削弱问责制，并回答了三个问题：在地区差异较大的情况下，什么因素决定权力应集中还是分散？政府应设立多少层级？国家边界应如何划定？我们构建了一个政治代理模型，其中选民在监督寻租政客的能力上存在差异。研究发现，寻租行为是知情选民比例的函数，且这一函数呈递减且凸函数关系，因为选民信息的增加既提升了监督效果，也降低了担任公职的吸引力。因此，信息差异促使权力集中以减少寻租行为；而偏好差异则促使权力分散以匹配地方偏好。我们的模型表明，最优的边界应基于偏好进行划分，同时确保信息的多样性。我们还发现，问责制中的范围经济解释了为何政府层级增多会损害效率。一个负责多项政策的单一政府，其激励机制优于多个专门负责特定职能的政府，后者需要分配更多的预算和责任。因此，联邦制度只有在各地区的信息差异足够大时才具有吸引力。

abstract.text: Since the Coleman Report, many have questioned whether public school spending affects student outcomes. The school finance reforms that began in the early 1970s and accelerated in the 1980s caused dramatic changes to the structure of K–12 education spending in the United States. To study the effect of these school finance reform–induced changes in public school spending on long-run adult outcomes, we link school spending and school finance reform data to detailed, nationally representative data on children born between 1955 and 1985 and followed through 2011. We use the timing of the passage of court-mandated reforms and their associated type of funding formula change as exogenous shifters of school spending, and we compare the adult outcomes of cohorts that were differentially exposed to school finance reforms, depending on place and year of birth. Event study and instrumental variable models reveal that a 10% increase in per pupil spending each year for all 12 years of public school leads to 0.31 more completed years of education, about 7% higher wages, and a 3.2 percentage point reduction in the annual incidence of adult poverty; effects are much more pronounced for children from low-income families. Exogenous spending increases were associated with notable improvements in measured school inputs, including reductions in student-to-teacher ratios, increases in teacher salaries, and longer school years.

10.1093/qje/qjv036.abstractZh: 自科尔曼报告以来，许多人质疑公立学校支出是否会影响学生的学业成果。始于20世纪70年代初、并在80年代加速的学校财政改革，对美国K-12教育支出的结构产生了巨大变化。为了研究这些学校财政改革所导致的公立学校支出变化对长期成人成果的影响，我们将学校支出和学校财政改革的数据与1955年至1985年间出生的儿童的数据进行了关联，这些儿童在2011年之前一直被跟踪调查。我们将法院强制实施的改革通过的时间及其相关的资金分配方式变化作为学校支出的外生变量，并比较了不同出生地和出生年份的儿童在经历学校财政改革后的成人成果。事件研究和工具变量模型显示，在12年的公立学校教育期间，每名学生每年的支出增加10%，会导致教育年限增加0.31年，工资水平提高约7%，以及成人贫困发生率降低3.2个百分点；对于来自低收入家庭的儿童来说，这些影响更为显著。外生支出的增加与学校投入的显著改善相关，包括学生与教师比例的增加、教师工资的提高以及学校学年的延长。

abstract.text: How do individuals form expectations about future inflation? We propose that individuals overweight inflation experienced during their lifetimes. This approach modifies existing adaptive learning models to allow for age-dependent updating of expectations in response to inflation surprises. Young individuals update their expectations more strongly than older individuals since recent experiences account for a greater share of their accumulated lifetime history. We find support for these predictions using 57 years of microdata on inflation expectations from the Reuters/Michigan Survey of Consumers. Differences in experiences strongly predict differences in expectations, including the substantial disagreement between young and old individuals in periods of highly volatile inflation, such as the 1970s. It also explains household borrowing and lending behavior, including the choice of mortgages.

10.1093/qje/qjv037.abstractZh: 个体如何形成对未来通货膨胀的预期？我们认为，个体会高估其一生中经历的通货膨胀情况。这种方法修改了现有的自适应学习模型，使其能够根据通货膨胀的意外情况对预期进行年龄依赖性的更新。由于近期经历在个体累积的历史中所占的比例更大，因此年轻个体比年长个体更强烈地更新其预期。我们使用来自Reuters/Michigan消费者调查中的57年通货膨胀预期微观数据来支持这些预测。经历的差异强烈预示着预期的差异，包括在1970年代等通货膨胀波动较大的时期，年轻个体与年长个体之间的预期存在巨大分歧。这一理论还解释了家庭借贷行为，包括抵押贷款的选择。

abstract.text: There is growing evidence that firm-specific pay premiums are an important source of wage inequality.
