These premiums will contribute to the gender wage gap if women are less likely to work at high-paying firms or if women negotiate (or are offered) worse wage bargains with their employers than men. Using longitudinal data on the hourly wages of Portuguese workers matched with income statement information for firms, we show that the wages of both men and women contain firm-specific premiums that are strongly correlated with simple measures of the potential bargaining surplus at each firm. We then show how the impact of these firm-specific pay differentials on the gender wage gap can be decomposed into a combination of sorting and bargaining effects. We find that women are less likely to work at firms that pay higher premiums to either gender, with sorting effects being most important for low- and middle-skilled workers. We also find that women receive only 90% of the firm-specific pay premiums earned by men. Importantly, we find the same gender gap in the responses of wages to changes in potential surplus over time. Taken together, the combination of sorting and bargaining effects explain about one-fifth of the cross-sectional gender wage gap in Portugal.

10.1093/qje/qjv038.abstractZh: 越来越多的证据表明，企业特定的薪酬差异是工资不平等的一个重要来源。如果这些女性不太可能在高薪企业工作，或者与雇主谈判时获得的工资条件不如男性，那么这些薪酬差异就会加剧性别工资差距。我们利用葡萄牙工人的小时工资数据以及企业损益表信息，发现男女的工资中都包含企业特定的薪酬差异，这些差异与每个企业的潜在谈判盈余有显著相关性。我们进一步分析了这些企业特定薪酬差异对性别工资差距的影响，发现这种影响可以分解为排序效应和谈判效应。研究发现，女性不太可能在高薪企业工作，而排序效应对低技能和中技能工人尤为重要。此外，女性仅获得了男性所赚取的企业特定薪酬差异的90%。重要的是，我们发现随着时间推移，工资对潜在盈余变化的反应也表现出相同的性别差异。综合来看，排序效应和谈判效应的结合解释了葡萄牙性别工资差距的约五分之一。

abstract.text: This article develops an analytical framework to study firm and exporter growth and provides a dynamic foundation for a standard general equilibrium trade model. Firm-level growth is the result of idiosyncratic productivity improvements with a continuous arrival of new potential producers. A firm enters a market if it is profitable to incur the marginal cost to reach the first consumer and pays an increasing marketing cost to reach additional consumers. I calibrate the model using data on the cross section of firm sales and bilateral trade, as well as the rate of incumbent firm exit. The calibrated model predicts that a firm’s growth is inversely related to its initial size, and that the distribution of growth rates of small firms is heavily skewed to the right. These predictions are confirmed by looking at the growth of sales of U.S. firms and Brazilian exporters to the United States. I use this model to study the impact of cross-firm reallocations on economic activity and measured productivity.

10.1093/qje/qjv039.abstractZh: 本文构建了一个分析框架，用于研究企业和出口商的增长情况，并为标准的一般均衡贸易模型提供了动态基础。企业层面的增长是独特生产力提升的结果，同时还有新的潜在生产者的不断加入。如果企业通过承担边际成本来接触第一批消费者是有利可图的，那么企业就会进入市场，并且为了接触更多的消费者，企业会支付不断增加的营销成本。我利用企业销售和双边贸易的数据，以及现有企业退出率的数据来校准模型。校准后的模型预测，企业的增长与其初始规模成反比，而且小型企业的增长率分布严重偏向右侧。这些预测通过研究美国企业和巴西出口商对美国市场的销售增长得到了验证。我利用这个模型来研究企业间资源重新分配对经济活动和衡量生产率的影响。

abstract.text: We propose a new model of exchange rates, based on the hypothesis that the possibility of rare but extreme disasters is an important determinant of risk premia in asset markets. The probability of world disasters as well as each country’s exposure to these events is time-varying. This creates joint fluctuations in exchange rates, interest rates, options, and stock markets. The model accounts for a series of major puzzles in exchange rates: excess volatility and exchange rate disconnect, forward premium puzzle and large excess returns of the carry trade, and comovements between stocks and exchange rates. It also makes empirically successful signature predictions regarding the link between exchange rates and telltale signs of disaster risk in currency options.

10.1093/qje/qjv040.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个新的汇率模型，该模型基于这样一个假设：罕见但极端的灾难事件是资产市场风险溢价的重要决定因素。全球灾难发生的概率以及每个国家面临这些事件的风险都是随时间变化的。这导致了汇率、利率、期权和股市之间的共同波动。该模型解释了一系列关于汇率的重大谜题：过度波动与汇率脱钩现象、远期溢价之谜以及套息交易带来的巨大超额回报，还有股票与汇率之间的同步变动。该模型还做出了一些在实证上成功的预测，涉及汇率与货币期权中灾难风险迹象之间的联系。

abstract.text: The incentives of political agents to enforce tax collection are key determinants of the levels of compliance. We study the electoral response to the Ghost Buildings program, a nationwide anti tax evasion policy in Italy that used innovative monitoring technologies to target buildings hidden from tax authorities. The program induced monetary and non-monetary benefits for non-evaders and an increase in local government expenditures. A one standard deviation increase in town-level program intensity leads to a 4.8% increase in local incumbent reelection rates. In addition, these political returns are higher in areas with lower tax evasion tolerance and with higher efficiency of public good provision, implying complementarity among enforcement policies, the underlying tax culture, and the quality of the government.

10.1093/qje/qjv041.abstractZh: 政治代理人执行税收征收的动机是决定合规水平的关键因素。我们研究了意大利一项全国性反逃税政策的“幽灵建筑计划”对选举的响应。该计划利用创新的监控技术针对税务部门难以触及的建筑。该计划为非逃税者带来了货币和非货币利益，并增加了地方政府的支出。在城镇层面，计划实施强度增加一个标准差，会导致地方现任官员的连任率增加4.8%。此外，在逃税容忍度较低且公共物品提供效率较高的地区，这些政治回报更高，这表明执法政策、潜在的税收文化和政府质量之间存在互补性。

abstract.text: Performance pay for tax collectors has the potential to raise revenues, but might come at a cost if it increases the bargaining power of tax collectors vis-à-vis taxpayers. We report the first large-scale field experiment on these issues, where we experimentally allocated 482 property tax units in Punjab, Pakistan, into one of three performance pay schemes or a control. After two years, incentivized units had 9.4 log points higher revenue than controls, which translates to a 46% higher growth rate. The scheme that rewarded purely on revenue did best, increasing revenue by 12.9 log points (64% higher growth rate), with little penalty for customer satisfaction and assessment accuracy compared to the two other schemes that explicitly also rewarded these dimensions. The revenue gains accrue from a small number of properties becoming taxed at their true value, which is substantially more than they had been taxed at previously. The majority of properties in incentivized areas in fact pay no more taxes, but instead report higher bribes. The results are consistent with a collusive setting in which performance pay increases collectors’ bargaining power over taxpayers, who have to either pay higher bribes to avoid being reassessed or pay substantially higher taxes if collusion breaks down.

10.1093/qje/qjv042.abstractZh: 对税务人员实施绩效奖励有可能增加税收收入，但这样做可能会增加税务人员相对于纳税人的议价能力，从而带来代价。我们报道了关于这一问题的首次大规模实地实验。在巴基斯坦旁遮普省，我们将482个财产税单位随机分配到三种绩效奖励方案中的一种或对照组。两年后，实施奖励方案的地区的税收收入比对照组高出9.4个对数点，即增长率高出46%。其中，仅以税收收入作为奖励标准的方案效果最佳，税收收入增加了12.9个对数点（增长率高出64%），且客户满意度和评估准确性几乎没有受到负面影响，而其他两个方案虽然也明确奖励这些指标，但效果较差。税收收入的增加源于少数财产以真实价值征税，这比之前征税的税额要高得多。在实施奖励方案的地区，大多数财产实际上缴纳的税款并没有增加，反而报告了更高的贿赂金额。这些结果表明，绩效奖励会增加税务人员的议价能力，使纳税人不得不支付更高的贿赂以避免重新评估，或者在勾结行为被揭露时支付更高的税款。

abstract.text: We use administrative data on Swedish lottery players to estimate the causal impact of substantial wealth shocks on players’ own health and their children’s health and developmental outcomes. Our estimation sample is large, virtually free of attrition, and allows us to control for the factors conditional on which the prizes were randomly assigned. In adults, we find no evidence that wealth impacts mortality or health care utilization, with the possible exception of a small reduction in the consumption of mental health drugs. Our estimates allow us to rule out effects on 10-year mortality one sixth as large as the cross-sectional wealth-mortality gradient. In our intergenerational analyses, we find that wealth increases children’s health care utilization in the years following the lottery and may also reduce obesity risk. The effects on most other child outcomes, including drug consumption, scholastic performance, and skills, can usually be bounded to a tight interval around zero. Overall, our findings suggest that in affluent countries with extensive social safety nets, causal effects of wealth are not a major source of the wealth-mortality gradients, nor of the observed relationships between child developmental outcomes and household income.

10.1093/qje/qjw001.abstractZh: 我们利用瑞典彩票玩家的行政数据，来估算巨额财富冲击对彩票玩家自身健康以及子女健康和发展结果的影响。我们的样本量较大，几乎没有流失现象，并且能够控制奖品随机分配的条件。在成年人中，我们没有发现财富对死亡率或医疗利用产生影响的证据，可能唯一的例外是精神健康药物的消费有所减少。我们的估计结果表明，财富对十年死亡率的影响仅为横截面财富-死亡率梯度的一半。在代际分析中，我们发现财富增加了彩票发放后子女的医疗利用，并且可能降低了肥胖风险。对于大多数其他儿童结果，包括药物消费、学业表现和技能等方面的影响，通常可以限定在接近零的狭小范围内。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，在拥有广泛社会保障网络的富裕国家，财富的因果效应并不是财富-死亡率梯度的主要来源，也不是儿童发展结果与家庭收入之间观察到的关系的根本原因。

abstract.text: This article examines the historical impact of railroads on the U.S. economy, with a focus on quantifying the aggregate impact on the agricultural sector in 1890. Expansion of the railroad network may have affected all counties directly or indirectly—an econometric challenge that arises in many empirical settings. However, the total impact on each county is captured by changes in that county’s “market access,” a reduced-form expression derived from general equilibrium trade theory. We measure counties’ market access by constructing a network database of railroads and waterways and calculating lowest-cost county-to-county freight routes. We estimate that county agricultural land values increased substantially with increases in county market access, as the railroad network expanded from 1870 to 1890. Removing all railroads in 1890 is estimated to decrease the total value of U.S. agricultural land by 60%, with limited potential for mitigating these losses through feasible extensions to the canal network or improvements to country roads.

10.1093/qje/qjw002.abstractZh: 本文探讨了铁路对美国经济的历史影响，重点在于量化1890年铁路网络扩展对农业部门的总体影响。铁路网络的扩展可能直接或间接影响到所有县，这在实际研究中是一个计量经济学难题。然而，每个县所受的总影响可以通过该县的“市场接入度”变化来体现，而“市场接入度”是一种从一般均衡贸易理论推导出的简化指标。我们通过构建铁路和水道网络数据库，并计算各县之间最低成本的货运路线，来衡量各县的市场接入度。研究估计，随着铁路网络从1870年扩展到1890年，各县的农业用地价值随着市场接入度的提高而显著上升。如果1890年取消所有铁路，美国农业用地的总价值将减少60%，而通过扩展运河网络或改善乡村道路来减轻这些损失的效果有限。

abstract.text: GDP per capita and household survey means present conflicting pictures of the rate of economic development in emerging countries. One of the areas in which the national accounts–household surveys debate is key is the measurement of developing world poverty. We propose a data-driven method to assess the relative quality of GDP per capita and survey means by comparing them to the evolution of satellite-recorded nighttime lights. Our main assumption, which is robust to a variety of specification checks, is that the measurement error in nighttime lights is unrelated to the measurement errors in either national accounts or survey means. We obtain estimates of weights on national accounts and survey means in an optimal proxy for true income; these weights are very large for national accounts and very modest for survey means. We conclusively reject the null hypothesis that the optimal weight on surveys is greater than the optimal weight on national accounts, and we generally fail to reject the null hypothesis that the optimal weight on surveys is zero. Additionally, we provide evidence that national accounts are good indicators of desirable outcomes for the poor (such as longer life expectancy, better education and access to safe water), and we show that surveys appear to perform worse in developing countries that are richer and that are growing faster. Therefore, we interpret our results as providing support for estimates of world poverty that are based on national accounts.

10.1093/qje/qjw003.abstractZh: 人均GDP与家庭调查数据所呈现的经济发展速度情况存在矛盾。在国民账户与家庭调查之间的争论中，衡量发展中国家贫困状况是一个关键问题。我们提出了一种基于数据的评估方法，通过比较人均GDP与调查数据的相对质量，以及夜间灯光卫星记录的演变情况来进行评估。我们的主要假设是，夜间灯光测量误差与国民账户或调查数据的测量误差无关。我们获得了关于国民账户和调查数据的最优权重估计，其中国民账户的权重较大，而调查数据的权重则较为适中。我们明确拒绝了“调查数据的优化权重大于国民账户权重”的零假设，并且通常也不认为调查数据的优化权重为零。此外，我们还发现国民账户是反映贫困人口期望成果的良好指标（如更长的预期寿命、更好的教育和安全饮用水获取），而在较富裕且增长较快的发展中国家，调查数据的表现似乎更差。因此，我们认为我们的研究结果支持了基于国民账户来估算世界贫困状况的方法。

abstract.text: This paper combines income tax returns with macroeconomic household balance sheets to estimate the distribution of wealth in the United States since 1913. We estimate wealth by capitalizing the incomes reported by individual taxpayers, accounting for assets that do not generate taxable income. We successfully test our capitalization method in three micro datasets where we can observe both income and wealth: the Survey of Consumer Finance, linked estate and income tax returns, and foundations’ tax records. We find that wealth concentration was high in the beginning of the twentieth century, fell from 1929 to 1978, and has continuously increased since then. The top 0.1% wealth share has risen from 7% in 1978 to 22% in 2012, a level almost as high as in 1929. Top wealth-holders are younger today than in the 1960s and earn a higher fraction of the economy’s labor income. The bottom 90% wealth share first increased up to the mid-1980s and then steadily declined. The increase in wealth inequality in recent decades is due to the upsurge of top incomes combined with an increase in saving rate inequality. We explain how our findings can be reconciled with Survey of Consumer Finances and estate tax data.

10.1093/qje/qjw004.abstractZh: 本文将所得税申报数据与宏观经济家庭资产负债表相结合，以估算自1913年以来美国的财富分布。我们通过将个人纳税人报告的收入资本化来估算财富，并考虑到那些不产生应税收入的资产。我们在三个能够同时观察收入和财富的数据集中成功测试了我们的资本化方法：消费者金融调查、遗产税和所得税申报数据，以及基金会税务记录。研究发现，20世纪初财富集中度很高，从1929年到1978年有所下降，此后则持续上升。最富有的0.1%人群所占的财富份额从1978年的7%上升到2012年的22%，这一比例几乎与1929年相当。如今，最富有的人群比1960年代更年轻，并且他们赚取的经济劳动收入比例更高。最贫困的90%人群所占的财富份额在1980年代中期首次增加，之后则持续下降。近几十年来财富不平等加剧的原因，是顶级收入的增加与储蓄率不平等的加剧。我们解释了如何将这些发现与消费者金融调查和遗产税数据相协调。

abstract.text: Viruses are a major threat to human health, and—given that they spread through social interactions—represent a costly externality. This article addresses three main questions: (i) what are the unintended consequences of economic activity on the spread of infections; (ii) how efficient are measures that limit interpersonal contacts; (iii) how do we allocate our scarce resources to limit the spread of infections? To answer these questions, we use novel high frequency data from France on the incidence of a number of viral diseases across space, for different age groups, over a quarter of a century. We use quasi-experimental variation to evaluate the importance of policies reducing interpersonal contacts such as school closures or the closure of public transportation networks. While these policies significantly reduce disease prevalence, we find that they are not cost-effective. We find that expansions of transportation networks have significant health costs in increasing the spread of viruses, and that propagation rates are pro-cyclically sensitive to economic conditions and increase with inter-regional trade.

10.1093/qje/qjw005.abstractZh: 病毒对人类健康构成了重大威胁，而且由于它们通过社交互动传播，因此也是一种代价高昂的外部性。本文探讨了三个主要问题：(i) 经济活动对感染传播的非预期影响是什么；(ii) 限制人际接触的措施效率如何；(iii) 我们如何分配稀缺资源以限制感染的传播？为了回答这些问题，我们利用了法国关于多种病毒性疾病发病率的高频数据，这些数据涵盖了不同年龄组，时间跨度超过四分之一世纪。我们通过准实验方法评估了减少人际接触的政策的重要性，例如学校关闭或公共交通网络关闭。虽然这些政策显著降低了疾病发病率，但我们发现它们的成本效益并不高。我们发现，扩大交通网络会带来显著的健康成本，增加病毒的传播，而且传播速率对经济状况具有周期性敏感性，并且随着区域间贸易的增加而上升。

abstract.text: We propose a theory linking imperfect information to resource misallocation and hence to aggregate productivity and output. In our setup, firms look to a variety of noisy information sources when making input decisions. We devise a novel empirical strategy that uses a combination of firm-level production and stock market data to pin down the information structure in the economy. Even when only capital is chosen under imperfect information, applying this methodology to data from the United States, China, and India reveals substantial losses in productivity and output due to the informational friction. Our estimates for these losses range from 7% to 10% for productivity and 10% to 14% for output in China and India, and are smaller, though still significant, in the United States. Losses are substantially higher when labor decisions are also made under imperfect information. We find that firms turn primarily to internal sources for information; learning from financial markets contributes little, even in the United States.

10.1093/qje/qjw006.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个理论，将信息不完美与资源分配不当联系起来，进而影响到总体生产力和产出。在我们的模型中，企业在做出投入决策时会参考多种噪声信息来源。我们设计了一种新的实证策略，利用企业层面的生产和股票市场数据来明确经济中的信息结构。即使在不完美信息的情况下仅选择资本投入，将这种方法应用于美国、中国和印度的数据后，我们发现由于信息摩擦，生产力和产出出现了显著损失。我们估算的这些损失在中国和印度分别为7%至10%的生产力损失和10%至14%的产出损失，而在美国则较小，但仍相当显著。当劳动决策也处于信息不完美的情况下，损失会更大。我们发现，企业主要依赖内部信息来源；即使在美国，从金融市场获取的信息也贡献不大。

abstract.text: In selection markets, where the cost of serving consumers is heterogeneous and noncontractible, nonprice product features allow a firm to sort profitable from unprofitable consumers. An example of this “sorting by quality” is the use of down payments to dissuade borrowers who are unlikely to repay. We study a model in which consumers have multidimensional types and a firm offers a single product of endogenous quality, as in Spence (1975) . These two ingredients generate a novel sorting incentive in a firm’s first-order condition for quality, which is a simple ratio. The denominator is marginal consumer surplus, a measure of market power. The numerator is the covariance, among marginal consumers, between marginal willingness to pay for quality and cost to the firm. We provide conditions under which this term is signed and contrast the sorting incentives of a profit-maximizer and a social planner. We then use this characterization to quantify the importance of sorting empirically in subprime auto lending, analytically sign its impact in a model of add-on pricing, and calibrate optimal competition policy in health insurance markets.

10.1093/qje/qjw007.abstractZh: 在选择性市场中，服务消费者的成本具有异质性且不可契约，非价格产品特征使得企业能够区分盈利消费者和亏损消费者。这种“按质量排序”的一个例子是使用首付款来阻止那些不太可能还款的借款人。我们研究了一个模型，其中消费者具有多维类型，企业提供一种具有内生质量的产品，类似于Spence（1975）所描述的模型。这两个因素在企业质量的一阶条件中产生了一种新的排序激励，该条件是一个简单的比率。分母是边际消费者剩余，即市场力量的衡量指标。分子是边际消费者之间对质量的支付意愿与企业的成本之间的协方差。我们提供了这一项有符号的条件，并对比了利润最大化者和社会规划者的排序激励。然后，我们利用这一特征来实证量化排序在次级汽车贷款中的重要性，在附加定价模型中分析其影响，并校准健康保险市场的最优竞争政策。

abstract.text: A new typology of players is proposed based on the classification of actions as either instinctive or contemplative. A person’s type is the probability of him choosing a contemplative action. To test the typology, results of 10 games are analyzed. Actions in each game were classified depending on whether their response time was more or less, respectively, than the median response time of all subjects who played the game. It is argued that fast actions are more instinctive and slow actions are more contemplative. A subject’s contemplative index (CI) is defined as the proportion of games in which he chose a contemplative action. It is found that for 8 of the 10 games, the CI in the other 9 games is positively correlated with a player’s choice of a contemplative action in that game (average Spearman correlation of 9%). The CI is used to shed light on the nature of choice in five additional games.

10.1093/qje/qjw008.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种新的玩家类型分类方法，依据行为是否属于本能性或沉思性来划分。一个人的类型指的是他选择沉思性行为的概率。为了验证这一分类方法，研究人员分析了10场游戏的结果。每场游戏中的行为根据其反应时间是否长于或短于所有参与者的中位反应时间来分类。研究发现，快速的行为更倾向于本能性，而缓慢的行为则更倾向于沉思性。定义了一个“沉思指数”，即一个人在游戏中选择沉思性行为的比例。研究发现，在10场游戏中的8场中，其他9场游戏中的沉思指数与该游戏中选择沉思性行为的玩家选择之间存在正相关关系（平均斯皮尔曼相关性为9%）。该指数还被用来揭示另外5场游戏中的选择行为本质。

abstract.text: We document that in semiformal economies, banks lend to tax-evading individuals based on the bank’s assessment of the individual’s true income. This observation leads to a novel approach to estimate tax evasion. We use microdata on household credit from a Greek bank and replicate the bank underwriting model to infer the banks estimate of individuals’ true income. We estimate that 43–45% of self-employed income goes unreported and thus untaxed. For 2009, this implies €28.2 billion of unreported income, implying forgone tax revenues of over €11 billion or 30% of the deficit. Our method innovation allows for estimating the industry distribution of tax evasion in settings where uncovering the incidence of hidden cash transactions is difficult using other methods. Primary tax-evading industries are professional services—medicine, law, engineering, education, and media. We conclude with evidence that contemplates the importance of institutions, paper trail, and political willpower for the persistence of tax evasion.

10.1093/qje/qjw009.abstractZh: 我们证实，在半正式的经济体系中，银行会根据对个体真实收入的评估来向逃税者提供贷款。这一发现促使我们提出了一种估算逃税的新方法。我们利用一家希腊银行的家庭信贷微观数据，并复制了银行的承保模型，以推断银行对个体真实收入的评估。我们估计，有43%至45%的自营收入未被申报，因此未被征税。对于2009年而言，这意味着有282亿欧元未申报的收入，相当于超过110亿欧元的税收被遗漏，占财政赤字的30%。我们的方法创新使得在难以通过其他方法揭露隐藏现金交易的情况下，能够估算出逃税的行业分布。逃税的主要行业包括专业服务领域——医学、法律、工程、教育和媒体。我们的结论表明，制度、书面记录和政治意愿对于逃税的持续存在至关重要。

abstract.text: During the past three decades, many countries have lifted restrictions on cross-border financial transactions. We present a simple model that can account for the observed effects of financial globalization. The model emphasizes the role of imperfect enforcement of domestic debts and the interactions between domestic and foreign debts. Financial globalization can lead to a variety of outcomes: (i) domestic capital flight and ambiguous effects on net capital flows, investment, and growth; (ii) capital inflows and higher investment and growth; or (iii) volatile capital flows and unstable domestic financial markets. The model shows how the effects of financial globalization depend on the level of development, productivity, domestic savings, and the quality of institutions.

10.1093/qje/qjw010.abstractZh: 在过去三十年中，许多国家已经取消了跨境金融交易的限制。我们提出了一个简单的模型，可以解释金融全球化的各种效应。该模型强调了国内债务执行不完美的情况以及国内债务与国外债务之间的相互作用。金融全球化可能导致多种结果：(i) 国内资本外流，对净资本流动、投资和增长产生不确定的影响；(ii) 资本流入，促进投资与增长；或者 (iii) 资本流动不稳定，导致国内金融市场不稳定。该模型表明，金融全球化的效应取决于发展水平、生产力、国内储蓄以及制度质量。

abstract.text: I present a framework for analyzing decision making under imperfect understanding of correlation structures and causal relations. A decision maker (DM) faces an objective long-run probability distribution p over several variables (including the action taken by previous DMs). The DM is characterized by a subjective causal model, represented by a directed acyclic graph over the set of variable labels. The DM attempts to fit this model to p , resulting in a subjective belief that distorts p by factorizing it according to the graph via the standard Bayesian network formula. As a result of this belief distortion, the DM’s evaluation of actions can vary with their long-run frequencies. Accordingly, I define a ”personal equilibrium” notion of individual behavior. The framework enables simple graphical representations of causal-attribution errors (such as coarseness or reverse causation), and provides tools for checking rationality properties of the DM’s behavior. I demonstrate the framework’s scope of applications with examples covering diverse areas, from demand for education to public policy.

10.1093/qje/qjw011.abstractZh: 我提出了一个分析在相关结构和因果关系不完全了解情况下的决策制定的框架。决策者面临一个关于多个变量的客观长期概率分布p（包括之前决策者所采取的行动）。决策者的特征是一个主观的因果模型，该模型由一个有向无环图表示，该图基于变量标签的集合。决策者试图将这个模型拟合到p上，从而形成一个主观信念，这个信念通过标准贝叶斯网络公式将p根据图进行分解，从而扭曲了p。由于这种信念的扭曲，决策者对行动的评估会随其长期频率而变化。因此，我定义了一个“个人均衡”的概念来描述个体行为。该框架能够简单地用图形表示因果归因错误（如粗略性或反向因果关系），并提供了工具来检查决策者行为的合理性。我通过涵盖从教育需求到公共政策等多个领域的例子，展示了该框架的应用范围。

abstract.text: We develop and structurally estimate a model of heterogeneous multiproduct firms that can be used to decompose the firm-size distribution into the contributions of costs, “appeal” (quality or taste), markups, and product scope. Using Nielsen barcode data on prices and sales, we find that variation in firm appeal and product scope explains at least four fifths of the variation in firm sales. We show that the imperfect substitutability of products within firms, and the fact that larger firms supply more products than smaller firms, implies that standard productivity measures are highly dependent on implicit demand system assumptions and probably dramatically understate the relative productivity of the largest firms. Although most firms are well approximated by the monopolistic competition benchmark of constant markups, we find that the largest firms that account for most of aggregate sales depart substantially from this benchmark, and exhibit both variable markups and substantial cannibalization effects.

10.1093/qje/qjw012.abstractZh: 我们开发并结构性地估计了一个异质多产品企业的模型，该模型可用于将企业规模分布分解为成本、产品吸引力（质量或品味）、加价以及产品范围等因素的贡献。利用Nielsen提供的价格和销售数据，我们发现企业吸引力的差异以及产品范围的差异至少可以解释企业销售差异的四分之三。我们指出，企业内部产品之间的不完全可替代性，以及大型企业提供的产品数量多于小型企业这一事实，意味着标准生产率衡量标准高度依赖于隐含需求系统的假设，并可能严重低估了最大型企业的相对生产率。尽管大多数企业都可以用垄断竞争模型中的恒定加价来近似描述，但我们发现，在总销售额中占较大比例的最大型企业与这一模型存在显著差异，它们既表现出可变的加价，又表现出显著的吞噬效应。

abstract.text: Individuals that consume different baskets of goods are differentially affected by relative price changes caused by international trade. We develop a methodology to measure the unequal gains from trade across consumers within countries. The approach requires data on aggregate expenditures and parameters estimated from a nonhomothetic gravity equation. We find that trade typically favors the poor, who concentrate spending in more traded sectors.

10.1093/qje/qjw013.abstractZh: 消费不同商品篮子的个体会受到国际贸易导致的相对价格变化的不同影响。我们开发了一种方法来衡量国内消费者之间因贸易而获得的不平等收益。该方法需要有关总支出的数据以及从非齐次引力方程估算出的参数。我们发现，贸易通常有利于穷人，因为穷人的支出集中在更多被贸易影响的领域。

abstract.text: Does the lack of wealth constrain parents' investments in the human capital of their descendants? We conduct a nearly fifty-year followup of an episode in which such constraints would have been plausibly relaxed by a random allocation of substantial wealth to families. We track descendants of participants in Georgia's Cherokee Land Lottery of 1832, in which nearly every adult white male in Georgia took part. Winners received close to the median level of wealth - a large financial windfall orthogonal to participants' underlying characteristics that might have also affected their children's human capital. Although winners had slightly more children than non-winners, they did not send them to school more. Sons of winners have no better adult outcomes (wealth, income, literacy) than the sons of non-winners, and winners' grandchildren do not have higher literacy or school attendance than non-winners' grandchildren. This suggests only a limited role for family financial resources in the formation of human capital in the next generations in this environment and a potentially more important role for other factors that persist through family lines.

10.1093/qje/qjw014.abstractZh: 财富的缺乏是否限制了父母对其后代人力资本的投资？我们对1832年乔治亚州切罗基土地彩票事件进行了近五十年的追踪研究，该彩票通过随机分配大量财富给家庭，本应合理地放宽这种限制。我们追踪了参与该彩票的人的后代，当时几乎每个白人成年男性都参与了这项活动。中奖者获得的财富接近中位数水平——这是一种与参与者基本特征无关的巨大财务收益，也可能影响了他们子女的人力资本。尽管中奖者的子女数量略多于非中奖者，但他们并没有让子女接受更多的教育。中奖者的儿子在成年后的财富、收入、识字率等方面并不优于非中奖者的儿子，而且中奖者的孙辈在识字率或学校出勤率方面也不高于非中奖者的孙辈。这表明，在这种环境下，家庭财务资源在下一代人力资本形成中的作用有限，而其他能够贯穿家族的因素可能发挥着更为重要的作用。

abstract.text: We exploit variation in the congestion of civil courts across Brazilian municipalities, together with a bankruptcy reform increasing secured creditors’ protection, to estimate the effect of enforcement on firm access to finance, investment, and size. We find that firms operating in municipalities with less congested courts experienced a larger increase in the use of secured loans, as well as a larger increase in investment and value of output in the years after the reform. To establish the direction of causality, we use an instrumental variable strategy that exploits Brazilian state laws on judicial organization, and focus on differences in court congestion across otherwise similar neighboring municipalities located across judicial district borders within the same state. The evidence indicates that differences in court enforcement affect the impact of financial reform on firm access to finance, investment, and size.

10.1093/qje/qjw015.abstractZh: 我们利用巴西各市镇民事法庭的拥堵程度差异，以及旨在增强有担保债权人保护的破产改革，来估算执行措施对企业融资、投资和规模的影响。研究发现，在法庭拥堵程度较低的市镇运营的企业，在改革后的几年里，有担保贷款的使用率有所提高，同时投资和产出价值也有所增加。为了确定因果关系的方向，我们采用了一种工具变量策略，该策略利用了巴西关于司法组织的法律，并重点关注同一司法区边界内其他相似邻近市镇之间法庭拥堵程度的差异。证据表明，法庭执行效率的差异影响了金融改革对企业融资、投资和规模的影响。

abstract.text: We assigned two cohorts of kindergarten students, totaling more than 24,000 children, to teachers within schools with a rule that is as good as random. We collected data on children at the beginning of the school year and applied 12 tests of math, language, and executive function (EF) at the end of the year. All teachers were filmed teaching for a full day, and the videos were coded using the Classroom Assessment Scoring System (or CLASS). We find substantial classroom effects: A 1 standard deviation increase in classroom quality results in 0.11, 0.11, and 0.07 standard deviation higher test scores in language, math, and EF, respectively. Teacher behaviors, as measured by the CLASS, are associated with higher test scores. Parents recognize better teachers, but do not change their behaviors appreciably to take account of differences in teacher quality.

10.1093/qje/qjw016.abstractZh: 我们选取了两组幼儿园学生，共计超过24,000名儿童，并将他们分配给学校内的教师，这种分配方式具有与随机分配相当的效果。我们在学年开始时收集了这些儿童的数据，并在学年末进行了12项数学、语言和执行功能测试。所有教师的教学过程都被录像记录了一整天，这些视频通过课堂评估评分系统（Classroom Assessment Scoring System，简称CLASS）进行编码分析。我们的研究发现，课堂质量存在显著的效应：课堂质量提高1个标准差，语言、数学和执行功能的测试分数分别相应提高0.11、0.11和0.07个标准差。通过CLASS评估的教师行为与较高的测试分数相关。家长能够识别出更优秀的教师，但并不会显著改变他们的行为，以反映教师质量的差异。

abstract.text: We find consistent evidence of negative autocorrelation in decision making that is unrelated to the merits of the cases considered in three separate high-stakes field settings: refugee asylum court decisions, loan application reviews, and Major League Baseball umpire pitch calls. The evidence is most consistent with the law of small numbers and the gambler’s fallacy—people underestimating the likelihood of sequential streaks occurring by chance—leading to negatively autocorrelated decisions that result in errors. The negative autocorrelation is stronger among more moderate and less experienced decision makers, following longer streaks of decisions in one direction, when the current and previous cases share similar characteristics or occur close in time, and when decision makers face weaker incentives for accuracy. Other explanations for negatively autocorrelated decisions such as quotas, learning, or preferences to treat all parties fairly are less consistent with the evidence, though we cannot completely rule out sequential contrast effects as an alternative explanation.

10.1093/qje/qjw017.abstractZh: 我们发现，在三个不同的高风险领域场景中，决策过程中存在一致的负自相关现象，这一现象与所考虑案例的优劣无关：包括难民庇护法庭的裁决、贷款申请审查以及美国职业棒球大联盟裁判的判罚。这些证据最有可能与“小概率事件法则”和“赌徒谬误”有关——人们低估了连续事件偶然发生的可能性，从而导致负自相关的决策，进而引发错误。在较为温和且经验较少的决策者中，负自相关现象更为明显，尤其是在当前案例与之前案例具有相似特征或时间相近的情况下，以及决策者面临较低的准确性激励时。对于负自相关决策的其他解释，如配额制度、学习过程或倾向于公平对待所有当事人的偏好，与现有证据不太一致，不过我们也不能完全排除“序列对比效应”作为另一种解释的可能性。

abstract.text: This article examines whether firm-level idiosyncratic shocks propagate in production networks. We identify idiosyncratic shocks with the occurrence of natural disasters. We find that affected suppliers impose substantial output losses on their customers, especially when they produce specific inputs. These output losses translate into significant market value losses, and they spill over to other suppliers. Our point estimates are economically large, suggesting that input specificity is an important determinant of the propagation of idiosyncratic shocks in the economy.

10.1093/qje/qjw018.abstractZh: 本文探讨了企业层面的特异性冲击是否会在生产网络中传播。我们通过自然灾害的发生来识别这些特异性冲击。我们发现，受影响的供应商对其客户造成了严重的产出损失，尤其是在他们生产特定投入品时。这些产出损失转化为显著的市场价值损失，并会波及其他供应商。我们的点估计值具有较大的经济意义，这表明投入品的特异性是经济中特异性冲击传播的重要决定因素。

abstract.text: This article examines the labor market payoffs to different types of postsecondary education, including field and institution of study. Instrumental variables (IV) estimation of the payoff to choosing one type of education compared to another is made particularly challenging by individuals choosing between several types of education. Not only does identification require one instrument per alternative, but it is also necessary to deal with the issue that individuals who choose the same education may have different next-best alternatives. We address these difficulties using rich administrative data for Norway’s postsecondary education system. A centralized admission process creates credible instruments from discontinuities that effectively randomize applicants near unpredictable admission cutoffs into different institutions and fields of study. The admission process also provides information on preferred and next-best alternatives from strategy-proof measures of individuals’ ranking of institutions and fields. The results from our IV approach may be summarized with three broad conclusions. First, different fields of study have substantially different labor market payoffs, even after accounting for institution and peer quality. Second, the effect on earnings from attending a more selective institution tends to be relatively small compared to payoffs to field of study. Third, the estimated payoffs to field of study are consistent with individuals choosing fields in which they have a comparative advantage. Comparing our estimates to those obtained from other approaches highlights the importance of using instruments to correct for selection bias and information on individuals’ ranking of institutions and fields to measure their preferred and next-best alternatives.

10.1093/qje/qjw019.abstractZh: 本文探讨了不同类型的高等教育在劳动力市场中的收益，包括学习领域和教育机构。对于个体在多种教育类型之间做出选择的情况，使用工具变量进行收益估计尤其具有挑战性。不仅需要对每个教育类型分别使用工具变量，还需要处理这样一个问题：选择相同教育类型的个体可能拥有不同的次优选择。我们利用挪威高等教育系统的丰富行政数据来解决这些困难。集中的录取过程使得从不连续的录取分数线将接近这些阈值的申请者随机分配到不同的教育机构和学习领域，从而产生了可信的工具变量。录取过程还提供了关于个体对机构和学习领域的偏好及次优选择的信息，这些信息可以通过策略性指标来量化。我们的工具变量方法得出的结果可以概括为三个主要结论：首先，即使考虑到机构质量和同行质量的影响，不同学习领域的劳动力市场收益也存在显著差异；其次，就读于更具选择性的教育机构对收入的影响相对较小，相对于学习领域的收益而言；第三，对学习领域的估计收益与个体选择具有比较优势的领域相一致。将我们的估计结果与其他方法得出的结果进行比较，凸显了使用工具变量来纠正选择偏差的重要性，以及利用个体对机构和学习领域的排名信息来衡量其偏好及次优选择的重要性。

abstract.text: This article presents a unique historical experiment to explore the dynamics of institutional change in the Middle Ages. We have assembled a novel data set, where information on political institutions for northern central Italian cities between 1000 and 1300 is matched with detailed information on the earthquakes that occurred in the area and period of interest. Exploiting the panel structure of the data, we document that the occurrence of an earthquake retarded institutional transition from autocratic regimes to self-government (the commune) in cities where the political and the religious leaders were the same person (episcopal see cities), but not in cities where political and religious powers were distinct (non–episcopal see cities). Such differential effect holds for destructive seismic episodes and for events that were felt by the population but did not cause any material damage to persons or objects. Ancillary results show that seismic events provoked a positive and statistically significant differential effect on the construction and further ornamentation of religious buildings between episcopal and non–episcopal see cities. Our findings are consistent with the idea that earthquakes, interpreted in the Middle Ages as manifestation of the will and outrage of God, represented a shock to people’s religious beliefs and, as a consequence, enhanced the ability of political-religious leaders to restore social order after a crisis relative to the emerging communal institutions. This interpretation is supported by historical evidence.

10.1093/qje/qjw020.abstractZh: 本文通过一项独特的历史实验，探讨了中世纪制度变迁的动力学。我们构建了一个新颖的数据集，其中包含了1000至1300年间意大利北部中心城市的政治制度信息，以及该时期该地区发生的地震的详细信息。通过利用数据的面板结构，我们发现地震的发生会延缓从专制政权向自治政府（公社）的制度转型，在政治和宗教领袖为同一人的城市（主教城）中尤为明显，而在政治和宗教权力分离的城市中则不明显。这种差异效应不仅适用于破坏性地震事件，也适用于那些虽影响居民生活但未造成物质损失的地震事件。此外，研究还发现，地震事件对主教城与非主教城之间宗教建筑的建造和装饰风格产生了积极且统计学上显著的差异效应。我们的研究结果与以下观点一致：在中世纪，地震被视为上帝意志和愤怒的显现，它会对人们的宗教信仰产生冲击，从而增强政治-宗教领袖在危机后恢复社会秩序的能力，相对于新兴的公社制度而言。这一解释得到了历史证据的支持。

abstract.text: Most projects, in most walks of life, require the participation of multiple parties. While it is difficult to unite individuals in a common endeavor, some people, who we call “movers and shakers,” seem able to do it. The article specifically examines moving and shaking of an investment project, whose return depends on its quality and the total capital invested in it. We analyze a model with two types of agents: managers and investors. Managers and investors initially form social connections. Managers then bid to buy control of the project, and the winning bidder puts effort into making investors aware of it. Finally, a subset of aware investors are given the chance to invest and they decide whether to do so after receiving private signals of the project’s quality. We first show that connections are valuable since they make it easier for a manager to “move and shake” the project (i.e., obtain capital from investors). When we endogenize the network, we find that while managers are identical ex ante, a single manager emerges as most connected; he consequently earns a rent. In extensions, we move away from the assumption of ex ante identical managers to highlight forces that lead one manager or another to become a mover and shaker. Our theory sheds light on a range of topics, including entrepreneurship, venture capital, and anchor investments.

10.1093/qje/qjw021.abstractZh: 在大多数行业中，大多数项目都需要多方参与。虽然让个人团结起来共同致力于一项事业是困难的，但有些被称为“推动者”和“影响者”的人似乎能够做到这一点。本文特别研究了投资项目的推动与影响过程，其回报取决于项目的质量以及投入的总资本。我们分析了一个包含两种类型代理人的模型：管理者和投资者。管理者和投资者最初会形成社会联系。随后，管理者会竞标以取得项目的控制权，中标者会努力让投资者意识到这一点。最后，一部分意识到的投资者有机会进行投资，他们在收到关于项目质量的私人信息后决定是否投资。我们首先证明了这些联系是有价值的，因为它们有助于管理者“推动和影响”项目（即从投资者那里获得资本）。当我们对网络进行内生化处理时，我们发现尽管管理者在事前是相同的，但只有一个管理者会成为最活跃的联系者，从而获得收益。在扩展研究中，我们不再假设管理者在事前是相同的，而是重点研究导致某个管理者成为推动者或影响者的因素。我们的理论为一系列主题提供了见解，包括创业、风险投资和锚定投资。

abstract.text: This study estimates long-run impacts of a child health investment, exploiting community-wide experimental variation in school-based deworming. The program increased labor supply among men and education among women, with accompanying shifts in labor market specialization. Ten years after deworming treatment, men who were eligible as boys stay enrolled for more years of primary school, work 17% more hours each week, spend more time in nonagricultural self-employment, are more likely to hold manufacturing jobs, and miss one fewer meal per week. Women who were in treatment schools as girls are approximately one quarter more likely to have attended secondary school, halving the gender gap. They reallocate time from traditional agriculture into cash crops and nonagricultural self-employment. We estimate a conservative annualized financial internal rate of return to deworming of 32%, and show that mass deworming may generate more in future government revenue than it costs in subsidies.

10.1093/qje/qjw022.abstractZh: 本研究通过利用社区范围内学校驱虫项目的实验性差异，估算了儿童健康投资对长期的影响。该项目增加了男性的劳动力供应和女性的教育水平，并伴随着劳动力市场专业化的变化。在驱虫治疗十年后，符合条件的男性男孩继续就读小学，每周工作时间增加17%，从事非农业自雇工作的时间增多，更有可能从事制造业工作，每周错过的一餐也减少了一顿。接受治疗的女性女孩则更有可能完成中学教育，性别差距缩小了一半。她们将时间从传统农业转向经济作物种植和非农业自雇工作。我们估计，驱虫治疗的年度财务内部回报率为32%，并表明大规模驱虫治疗可能带来的未来政府收入收益超过其补贴成本。

abstract.text: We study the drivers of geographic variation in US health care utilization, using an empirical strategy that exploits migration of Medicare patients to separate the role of demand and supply factors. Our approach allows us to account for demand differences driven by both observable and unobservable patient characteristics. Within our sample of over-65 Medicare beneficiaries, we find that 40-50 percent of geographic variation in utilization is attributable to demand-side factors, including health and preferences, with the remainder due to place-specific supply factors. JEL: H51, I1, I11.

10.1093/qje/qjw023.abstractZh: 我们研究了美国医疗保健利用地理差异的驱动因素，采用了一种实证策略，通过分析医疗保险患者的迁移情况，区分了需求和供应因素的作用。我们的方法能够解释由可观测和不可观测患者特征引起的需求差异。在我们研究的65岁以上医疗保险受益人样本中，我们发现40-50%的利用地理差异是由需求侧因素造成的，包括健康和偏好因素，其余部分则是由特定地点的供应因素造成的。JEL: H51, I1, I11。

abstract.text: We develop a new index of economic policy uncertainty (EPU) based on newspaper coverage frequency. Several types of evidence—including human readings of 12,000 newspaper articles—indicate that our index proxies for movements in policy-related economic uncertainty. Our U.S. index spikes near tight presidential elections, Gulf Wars I and II, the 9/11 attacks, the failure of Lehman Brothers, the 2011 debt ceiling dispute, and other major battles over fiscal policy. Using firm-level data, we find that policy uncertainty is associated with greater stock price volatility and reduced investment and employment in policy-sensitive sectors like defense, health care, finance, and infrastructure construction. At the macro level, innovations in policy uncertainty foreshadow declines in investment, output, and employment in the United States and, in a panel vector autoregressive setting, for 12 major economies. Extending our U.S. index back to 1900, EPU rose dramatically in the 1930s (from late 1931) and has drifted upward since the 1960s.

10.1093/qje/qjw024.abstractZh: 我们基于报纸报道频率开发了一个新的经济政策不确定性指数。包括对人类阅读了12,000篇报纸文章在内的多种证据表明，我们的指数能够反映与政策相关的经济不确定性的变化。在美国，该指数在总统选举临近、海湾战争一、二阶段、9/11袭击事件、雷曼兄弟破产、2011年债务上限争议以及其他重大财政政策冲突期间出现显著上升。通过企业层面的数据分析，我们发现政策不确定性与股市波动加剧以及国防、医疗保健、金融和基础设施建设等受政策影响的行业的投资和就业减少有关。在宏观层面，政策不确定性的变化预示着美国以及12个主要经济体的投资、产出和就业的下降。将我们的美国指数追溯到1900年，发现该指数在1930年代（从1931年末开始）急剧上升，并自1960年代以来持续上升。

abstract.text: We use a randomized controlled trial to study the response of poor households in rural Kenya to unconditional cash transfers from the NGO GiveDirectly. The transfers differ from other programs in that they are explicitly unconditional, large, and concentrated in time. We randomized at both the village and household levels; furthermore, within the treatment group, we randomized recipient gender (wife versus husband), transfer timing (lump-sum transfer versus monthly installments), and transfer magnitude (US$404 PPP versus US$1,525 PPP). We find a strong consumption response to transfers, with an increase in household monthly consumption from $158 PPP to $193 PPP nine months after the transfer began. Transfer recipients experience large increases in psychological well-being. We find no overall effect on levels of the stress hormone cortisol, although there are differences across some subgroups. Monthly transfers are more likely than lump-sum transfers to improve food security, whereas lump-sum transfers are more likely to be spent on durables, suggesting that households face savings and credit constraints. Together, these results suggest that unconditional cash transfers have significant impacts on economic outcomes and psychological well-being.

10.1093/qje/qjw025.abstractZh: 我们采用随机对照试验来研究肯尼亚农村贫困家庭对非政府组织GiveDirectly提供的无条件现金转移的反应。这些转移与其他项目的不同之处在于，它们是明确的无条件性、金额较大且时间集中。我们在村庄和家庭层面进行了随机化处理；此外，在实验组中，我们还随机化了接受者的性别（妻子与丈夫）、转移时间（一次性支付与按月分期支付）以及转移金额（404美元PPP与1,525美元PPP）。我们发现，家庭月度消费在转移开始九个月后从158 PPP增加到了193 PPP。转移接受者心理幸福感也有显著提升。我们没有发现对应激激素皮质醇水平的整体影响，不过在某些子群体中存在差异。与一次性支付相比，按月支付更有可能改善粮食安全状况，而一次性支付则更可能用于购买耐用品，这表明家庭面临储蓄和信贷限制。综上所述，这些结果表明，无条件现金转移对经济成果和心理幸福感都有显著影响。

abstract.text: Although largely absent from modern accounts of the Industrial Revolution, watches were the first mass-produced consumer durable and were Adam Smith’s preeminent example of technological progress. In fact, Smith makes the notable claim that watch prices may have fallen by up to 95% over the preceding century, a claim that this article attempts to evaluate. We look at changes in the reported value of over 3,200 stolen watches from criminal trials in the Old Bailey in London from 1685 to 1810. Before allowing for quality improvements, we find that the real price of watches in nearly all categories falls steadily by 1.3% a year, equivalent to a fall of 75% over a century, showing that sustained innovation in the production of a highly complex artifact had already appeared in one important sector of the British economy by the early eighteenth century.

10.1093/qje/qjw026.abstractZh: 尽管在关于工业革命的现代文献中，手表几乎没有被提及，但它们却是最早实现大规模生产的消费型耐用产品，也是亚当·斯密所强调的技术进步的典型例子。事实上，斯密指出，在之前的世纪里，手表的价格可能下降了高达95%。本文试图对这一观点进行评估。我们研究了1685年至1810年间，在伦敦老贝利法庭的刑事审判中被盗的手表的价值变化。在考虑质量改进因素之前，我们发现几乎所有类别的手表实际价格年均下降1.3%，即在一个世纪内下降了75%。这表明，在18世纪初，英国经济的一个重要领域已经出现了对高度复杂产品生产的持续创新。

abstract.text: We use data from the Head Start Impact Study (HSIS) to evaluate the cost-effectiveness of Head Start, the largest early childhood education program in the United States. Head Start draws roughly a third of its participants from competing preschool programs, many of which receive public funds. We show that accounting for the fiscal impacts of such program substitution pushes estimates of Head Start’s benefit-cost ratio well above one under a wide range of assumptions on the structure of the market for preschool services and the dollar value of test score gains. To parse the program’s test score impacts relative to home care and competing preschools, we selection-correct test scores in each care environment using excluded interactions between experimental assignments and household characteristics. We find that Head Start generates larger test score gains for children who would not otherwise attend preschool and for children who are less likely to participate in the program.

10.1093/qje/qjw027.abstractZh: 我们利用“Head Start影响研究”（HSIS）的数据来评估“Head Start”项目的成本效益。该计划是美国规模最大的早期儿童教育项目。大约三分之一的参与者来自其他竞争性学前教育项目，而这些项目中的许多都获得了公共资金支持。我们的研究表明，在考虑这些项目替代所带来的财政影响后，“Head Start”项目的效益成本比在多种市场结构和测试成绩提升的美元价值假设下均远高于1。为了将“Head Start”项目的测试成绩提升效果与家庭护理和其他竞争性学前教育项目进行比较，我们采用了排除实验分配与家庭特征之间交互作用的方法，对每种护理环境中的测试成绩进行了筛选校正。我们发现，“Head Start”项目为那些原本不会参加学前教育项目的儿童，以及那些不太可能参与该项目的儿童带来了更大的测试成绩提升。

abstract.text: This article examines the link between the opportunity cost of money and time-varying liquidity premia of near-money assets. Higher interest rates imply higher opportunity costs of holding money and hence a higher premium for the liquidity service benefits of assets that are close substitutes for money. Consistent with this theory, short-term interest rates in the United States, United Kingdom, and Canada have a strong positive relationship with the liquidity premium of Treasury bills and other near-money assets over periods going back to the 1920s. Once the opportunity cost of money is taken into account, Treasury security supply variables lose their explanatory power for the liquidity premium, except for transitory short-run effects. These findings indicate a high elasticity of substitution between money and near-money assets. As a consequence, a central bank that follows an interest rate operating target not only elastically accommodates and neutralizes shocks to money demand, but effectively also shocks to near-money asset supply and demand.

10.1093/qje/qjw028.abstractZh: 本文探讨了货币的机会成本与近货币资产随时间变化的流动性溢价之间的联系。较高的利率意味着持有货币的机会成本较高，因此对于与货币近似替代的资产的流动性服务收益而言，其溢价也较高。与这一理论一致的是，自20世纪20年代以来，美国、英国和加拿大的短期利率与国库券及其他近货币资产的流动性溢价之间存在强烈的正相关关系。一旦考虑了货币的机会成本，国库券供应变量对流动性溢价的解释力就减弱了，除了短期的过渡性影响之外。这些发现表明，货币与近货币资产之间存在较高的替代弹性。因此，遵循利率操作目标的中央银行不仅能够弹性地应对货币需求的冲击，还能有效影响近货币资产的供需。

abstract.text: We present a model of stereotypes based on Kahneman and Tversky’s representativeness heuristic. A decision maker assesses a target group by overweighting its representative types, defined as the types that occur more frequently in that group than in a baseline reference group. Stereotypes formed this way contain a “kernel of truth”: they are rooted in true differences between groups. Because stereotypes focus on differences, they cause belief distortions, particularly when groups are similar. Stereotypes are also context dependent: beliefs about a group depend on the characteristics of the reference group. In line with our predictions, beliefs in the lab about abstract groups and beliefs in the field about political groups are context dependent and distorted in the direction of representative types.

10.1093/qje/qjw029.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个基于卡尼曼和特沃斯基代表性启发式的刻板印象模型。决策者通过高估目标群体中的代表性类型来评估该群体，这些代表性类型是指在目标群体中比在基准参考群体中更常见的类型。以这种方式形成的刻板印象包含“真理内核”：它们基于群体间的真实差异。由于刻板印象关注差异，它们会导致信念的扭曲，尤其是在群体相似的情况下。刻板印象还取决于具体情境：对某个群体的信念取决于参考群体的特征。与我们的预测一致，实验室中对抽象群体的信念以及实地中对政治群体的信念都取决于具体情境，并且会朝着代表性类型的方向扭曲。

abstract.text: Using micro-data from 48 developing countries, this article studies changes in cross-sectional patterns of fertility and child investment over the demographic transition. Before 1960, children from larger families obtained more education, in large part because they had richer and more educated parents. By century's end, these patterns had reversed. Consequently, fertility differentials by income and education historically raised the average education of the next generation, but they now reduce it. Relative to the level of average education, the positive effect of differential fertility in the past exceeded its negative effect in the present. While the reversal of differential fertility is unrelated to changes in GDP per capita, women's work, sectoral composition, or health, roughly half is attributable to rising aggregate education in the parents' generation. The data are consistent with a model in which fertility has a hump-shaped relationship with parental skill, due to a corner solution in which low-skill parents forgo investment in their children. As the returns to child investment rise, the peak of the relationship shifts to the left, reversing the associations under study.

10.1093/restud/rdv026.abstractZh: 本文利用48个发展中国家的微观数据，研究了人口转型过程中生育率和儿童投资模式的变化。在1960年之前，来自大家庭的孩子受教育程度更高，这主要是因为他们的父母拥有更丰富的资源和更高的教育水平。到了世纪末，这种模式发生了逆转。因此，历史上收入和教育水平差异导致的生育率差异提升了下一代的平均教育水平，但现在这种差异却降低了这一水平。相对于平均教育水平而言，过去生育率差异带来的积极影响超过了当前负面影响的影响。虽然生育率差异的逆转与人均GDP、女性工作、行业结构或健康状况的变化无关，但大约一半的原因可以归因于父母一代整体教育水平的提高。这些数据与一种模型相符，该模型认为生育率与父母技能之间存在驼峰型关系，这是由于低技能父母选择不投资子女所导致的。随着儿童投资回报的增加，这种关系的峰值会向左移动，从而逆转了之前的研究结果。

abstract.text: We use probabilistic expectations data elicited from survey respondents in rural Malawi to investigate how risky sexual behaviour may be influenced by individuals' expectations about survival, and future HIV status, which in turn depend on the perceived impact of HIV/AIDS on survival, expectations about own and partner's current HIV status, and expectations about HIV transmission rates. Subjective expectations, in particular about mortality risk but not the risk of living with HIV, play an important role in determining the decision to have multiple sexual partners. Using our estimated parameters, we simulate the impact of various policies that would influence expectations. An information campaign on mortality risk would decrease risky sexual behaviour on average, whereas an information campaign on HIV transmission risks, which tend to be overestimated by respondents, would actually increase risky behaviour. Also, the expansion of anti-retroviral therapy (ART) treatments to all individuals infected with HIV would increase risky sexual behaviour for a quarter of the HIV-negative individuals or those who have not been tested because they are aware that ART increases life expectancy, and thus reduces the cost of becoming HIV positive.

10.1093/restud/rdv028.abstractZh: 我们利用来自马拉维农村地区的调查受访者提供的概率期望数据，研究风险性行为如何受到个体对生存和未来HIV状况的期望的影响。这些期望又取决于人们对HIV/AIDS对生存影响的感知、对自己和伴侣当前HIV状况的期望，以及对HIV传播率的预期。主观期望，尤其是关于死亡风险而非与HIV共存的风险的期望，在决定是否拥有多个性伴侣方面起着重要作用。通过我们估算的参数，我们模拟了各种政策对期望的影响。关于死亡风险的信息宣传活动平均会降低风险性行为，而关于HIV传播风险的信息宣传活动——由于受访者往往高估了风险——实际上会增加风险行为。此外，将抗逆转录病毒疗法扩展到所有HIV感染者，会导致四分之一的HIV阴性者或那些未接受检测的人出现风险性行为，因为他们意识到抗逆转录病毒疗法能延长寿命，从而降低成为HIV阳性者的成本。

abstract.text: In this article, I quantify the extent to which lobbying expenditures by firms affect policy enactment. To achieve this end, I construct a novel dataset containing all federal energy legislation and lobbying activities by the energy sector during the 110th Congress. I then develop and estimate a game-theoretic model where heterogeneous players choose lobbying expenditures to affect the probability that a policy is enacted. I find that the effect of lobbying expenditures on a policy's equilibrium enactment probability to be statistically significant but very small. Nonetheless, the average returns from lobbying expenditures are estimated to be over 130%.

10.1093/restud/rdv029.abstractZh: 在本文中，我量化了企业游说支出对政策制定影响的程度。为此，我构建了一个包含110届国会期间所有联邦能源立法及能源行业游说活动的新数据集。随后，我开发并估计了一个博弈论模型，其中不同类型的参与者通过选择游说支出来影响政策被制定的概率。研究发现，游说支出对政策被制定的均衡概率的影响在统计上显著，但幅度非常小。尽管如此，游说支出的平均回报率估计超过130%。

abstract.text: This article studies optimal patents with respect to the timing of innovation disclosure. In a simple model, we identify forces that lead firms to either suboptimally patent too early or too late in equilibrium, and we determine conditions so that stronger patents induce earlier or later equilibrium disclosure. Then, by solving an infinite multistage patent game with a more explicit structure, we describe innovation growth, and derive detailed predictions that can be used for policy experiments. As an application, we calibrate our multistage game using summary statistics from the seeds breeding industry. We find that weaker patent rights may result in welfare gains of 46% relative to the status quo. The gains are achieved because weaker patents reduce competition, thus leading firms to postpone patenting.

10.1093/restud/rdv030.abstractZh: 本文研究了与创新披露时机相关的最优专利策略。在一个简单的模型中，我们识别出导致企业过早或过晚申请专利的驱动因素，并确定了能够促使更强效的专利在更早或更晚时间披露的条件。随后，通过求解一个结构更为明确的无限多阶段专利博弈，我们描述了创新增长的过程，并得出了可用于政策实验的详细预测结果。作为应用案例，我们使用种子培育行业的统计数据对多阶段博弈进行了校准。研究发现，较弱的专利权利可能会带来相对于现状而言46%的福利增益。这种增益的实现是因为较弱的专利减少了竞争，从而促使企业推迟专利申请的时间。

abstract.text: This article studies a market game under uncertainty in which agents may submit multiple limit and market orders. When agents know their preferences at all states, the competitive equilibrium can be supported as a Nash equilibrium of the market game, that is, agents behave as if they were price takers. Therefore, if the associated competitive economy has a fully revealing rational expectations equilibrium, then so does the market game. This resolves the puzzle that agents behave as if prices were given, even though prices aggregate private information, at least for this "private values" case. Necessary conditions for Nash equilibrium show that the resulting allocation cannot deviate too far from a competitive equilibrium. When agents do not know their preferences at some states, though, a characterization result shows that the Nash equilibria of the market game tend to be far from competitive.

10.1093/restud/rdv031.abstractZh: 本文研究了一个在不确定性下的市场博弈，其中参与者可以提交多个限价和市价订单。当参与者在所有状态下都清楚自己的偏好时，竞争均衡可以被视为市场博弈的纳什均衡，即参与者的行为类似于价格接受者。因此，如果相关的竞争经济具有完全揭示的理性预期均衡，那么市场博弈也必然具有这样的均衡。这一结论解决了这样一个难题：尽管价格汇总了私人信息，但参与者的行为却仿佛价格已经确定了一样。纳什均衡的必要条件表明，由此产生的分配不会偏离竞争均衡太远。然而，当参与者在某些状态下不清楚自己的偏好时，相关的结果表明，市场博弈的纳什均衡往往与竞争均衡相去甚远。

abstract.text: The increase in the information that firms can collect or purchase about network effects across consumers motivates two important questions: how does a firm's pricing strategy react to detailed information on network effects? Are the availability and use of such information beneficial or detrimental to consumer surplus? We develop a model in which a monopoly sells a network good and price discriminates based on information about consumers' influence and consumers' susceptibility to influence. The monopoly optimally offers consumers price discounts for their influence and charges price premia for their susceptibility; the price premia and the price discounts are simple functions of the pattern of network effects. We determine under which conditions, relative to uniform price, consumer surplus increases, and we characterize the value of information on network effects for the monopoly.

10.1093/restud/rdv032.abstractZh: 企业能够收集或获取关于消费者之间网络效应的信息的增加，引发了两个重要问题：企业的定价策略如何对关于网络效应的详细信息作出反应？此类信息的可获得性和使用对消费者剩余是有利还是有害？我们建立了一个模型，其中垄断企业销售一种网络商品，并根据消费者对影响力的信息以及对影响的敏感性的信息来实行价格歧视。垄断企业会最优地为消费者提供基于其影响力的价格折扣，并为他们的敏感性收取价格溢价；这些价格溢价和折扣是网络效应模式的简单函数。我们确定了在何种条件下，相对于统一价格，消费者剩余会增加，并描述了垄断企业对网络效应信息的价值。

abstract.text: This article measures the economic impacts of social pressure to share income with kin and neighbours in rural Kenyan villages. We conduct a lab experiment in which we randomly vary the observability of investment returns to test whether subjects reduce their income in order to keep it hidden. We find that women adopt an investment strategy that conceals the size of their initial endowment in the experiment, though that strategy reduces their expected earnings. This effect is largest among women with relatives attending the experiment. Parameter estimates suggest that women anticipate that observable income will be “taxed” at a rate above 4%; this effective tax rate nearly doubles when kin can observe income directly. At the village level, we find an association between the willingness to forgo expected return to keep income hidden in the laboratory experiment and worse economic outcomes outside the laboratory.

10.1093/restud/rdv033.abstractZh: 本文研究了在肯尼亚农村村庄中，社会压力促使人们与亲属和邻居分享收入所带来的经济影响。我们通过实验室实验来测试这一现象，随机改变投资回报的可观察性，以检验参与者是否会为了隐藏收入而减少收入。研究发现，女性在实验中采取了隐瞒初始资金规模的投资策略，尽管这一策略降低了她们的预期收益。这种效应在有亲属参与实验的女性中更为明显。参数估计表明，女性预期可观察到的收入将被征税，税率超过4%；当亲属能够直接观察到收入时，这一有效税率几乎翻倍。在村庄层面，我们发现实验室实验中愿意放弃预期收益以隐藏收入的女性，在实验室外的经济结果更为糟糕。

abstract.text: This article studies an economy with both centralized and decentralized monetary exchanges under search frictions. A degenerate asset distribution is featured under a broad class of preferences including, for example, constant return to scale, constant elasticity of substitution, CARA and others from a range of macroeconomic literatures. Some novel applications impossible under quasi-linear preferences, for example endogenous growth, are illustrated under this class of preferences. This article finds that the welfare cost and growth loss of inflation can be much higher in these applications than previous estimates.

10.1093/restud/rdv034.abstractZh: 本文研究了一个在搜索摩擦下同时存在集中式与分散式货币交换的经济体系。在包括规模报酬不变、替代弹性不变、CARA等多种偏好条件下，呈现出一种退化资产分配模式。在这类偏好下，一些在准线性偏好条件下无法实现的新应用得以体现，例如内生增长理论。本文发现，在这些应用中，通货膨胀带来的福利成本与增长损失可能比以往估计的要高得多。

abstract.text: While vertical integration is traditionally seen as a solution to the hold-up problem, this article highlights instead that it can generate hold-up problems—for rivals. We consider a successive duopoly where downstream firms invest and then secure support from an upstream supplier. We first show that vertical integration generates ex ante incentives to create hold-up problems: an integrated supplier is willing to pre-commit itself to appropriating or dissipating part of its customer's profits, to expose the independent rival to being held-up by the other supplier, and discourage in this way the rival's investment. We then show that, even in the absence of any pre-commitment, vertical integration also creates hold-up problems ex post when degrading the quality of the support provided to one downstream firm benefits its rival. We also provide illustrations in terms of standard industrial organization models and of antitrust cases, and discuss the robustness of the insights.

10.1093/restud/rdv035.abstractZh: 虽然垂直整合传统上被视为解决垄断问题的方案，但本文指出，它反而可能引发对竞争对手的垄断问题。我们研究了一个连续双头垄断的情况，其中下游企业投资后获得了上游供应商的支持。我们首先证明了垂直整合会产生事前激励，导致垄断问题的出现：整合后的供应商愿意预先承诺占有或消耗部分客户利润，从而使独立竞争对手面临被另一供应商垄断的风险，从而抑制竞争对手的投资。接着，我们表明，即使在没有预先承诺的情况下，垂直整合也会在事后产生垄断问题，因为降低对某一下游企业的支持质量会对其竞争对手产生不利影响。我们还通过标准产业组织模型和反垄断案例进行了说明，并讨论了这些观点的稳健性。

abstract.text: We study sales techniques which discourage consumer search by making it harder or more expensive to return to buy after a search for alternatives. It is unilaterally profitable for a seller to deter search under mild conditions, but sellers can suffer when all do so. When a seller cannot commit to its policy, it exploits the inference that those consumers who try to buy later have no good alternative, and in many cases the outcome is as if the seller must make an exploding offer. Search deterrence results in sub-optimal matching of products to consumers and often raises the price consumers pay.

10.1093/restud/rdv036.abstractZh: 我们研究了那些通过增加寻找替代品后的回购难度或成本来阻止消费者搜索的销售策略。在温和的条件下，单方面地阻止消费者搜索对卖方是有利的，但当所有卖方都这样做时，卖方可能会遭受损失。当卖方无法坚持其政策时，就会利用这样一种推论：那些试图在之后购买的消费者没有更好的选择，而在许多情况下，结果就像卖方必须提出一个极具诱惑力的价格一样。搜索阻止会导致产品与消费者的匹配效果不佳，并且通常会提高消费者支付的价格。

abstract.text: This article theoretically and empirically analyses behaviour in penny auctions, a relatively new auction mechanism. As in the US dollars or war-of-attrition, players in penny auctions commit higher non-refundable costs as the auction continues and only win if all other players stop bidding. I first show that, in any equilibria that does not end immediately, players bid probabilistically such that the expected profit from every bid is zero. Then, using two large data sets covering 166,000 auctions, I calculate that average profit margins actually exceed 50%. To explain this deviation, I incorporate a sunk-cost fallacy into the theoretical model to generate a set of predictions about hazard rates and player behaviour, which I confirm empirically. While players do (slowly) learn to correct this bias and there are few obvious barriers to competition, activity in the market is rising and concentration remains relatively high.

10.1093/restud/rdv037.abstractZh: 本文从理论和实证角度分析了便士拍卖的行为，这是一种相对较新的拍卖机制。与美元交易或资源争夺战类似，便士拍卖中的参与者在拍卖持续进行时会承担更高的不可退还成本，并且只有在所有其他参与者停止出价时才能获胜。首先，我证明了在任何不会立即结束的均衡状态下，参与者的出价都是概率性的，使得每次出价的预期利润为零。然后，利用包含两个大型数据集的数据，该数据集涵盖了166,000次拍卖，我计算出平均利润率实际上超过了50%。为了解释这一偏差，我在理论模型中引入了沉没成本谬误，从而得出关于风险率和参与者行为的预测，这些预测通过实证得到了验证。虽然参与者确实（缓慢地）学会了纠正这种偏差，并且竞争障碍很少，但市场活动正在增加，集中度仍然相对较高。

abstract.text: We develop an asymptotic theory for static discrete-action games with a large number of players, and propose a novel inference approach based on stochastic expansions around the limit of the finite-player game. Our analysis focuses on anonymous games in which payoffs are a function of the agent's own action and the empirical distribution of her opponents' play. We establish a law of large numbers and central limit theorem which can be used to establish consistency of point or set estimators and asymptotic validity for inference on structural parameters as the number of players increases. The proposed methods as well as the limit theory are conditional on the realized equilibrium in the observed sample and therefore do not require any assumptions regarding selection among multiple equilibria.

10.1093/restud/rdv038.abstractZh: 我们为具有大量参与者的静态离散行动博弈发展了一个渐近理论，并提出了一种基于有限玩家博弈极限附近的随机展开的新型推断方法。我们的分析重点在于匿名博弈，其中收益是代理人自身行动以及对手行为经验分布的函数。我们建立了一个大数定律和中心极限定理，这些定理可用于确保点估计或集合估计的一致性，并随着参与者数量的增加，确保对结构参数进行推断的渐近有效性。所提出的方法以及极限理论都是基于观测样本中的实际均衡条件，因此不需要对多个均衡中的选择进行任何假设。

abstract.text: We examine the impact of Chinese import competition on broad measures of technical change—patenting, IT, and TFP—using new panel data across twelve European countries from 1996 to 2007. In particular, we establish that the absolute volume of innovation increases within the firms most affected by Chinese imports in their output markets. We correct for endogeneity using the removal of product-specific quotas following China's entry into the World Trade Organization in 2001. Chinese import competition led to increased technical change within firms and reallocated employment between firms towards more technologically advanced firms. These within and between effects were about equal in magnitude, and account for 14% of European technology upgrading over 2000–7 (and even more when we allow for offshoring to China). Rising Chinese import competition also led to falls in employment and the share of unskilled workers. In contrast to low-wage nations like China, developed countries had no significant effect on innovation.

10.1093/restud/rdv039.abstractZh: 我们研究了中国进口竞争对技术变革的广泛影响，包括专利、信息技术和全要素生产率等方面。研究采用了1996至2007年间12个欧洲国家的新型面板数据。研究发现，受中国进口影响最大的企业在自身市场的创新活动显著增加。我们通过取消产品特定配额这一措施来消除内生性影响，这一措施是在中国于2001年加入世界贸易组织后实施的。中国进口竞争导致企业内部的技术变革增加，同时就业分配也向技术更先进的企业转移。这两种效应在规模上大致相当，并且占2000至2007年间欧洲技术升级的14%（如果考虑到向中国外包生产的话，这一比例还会更高）。与像中国这样的低工资国家相比，发达国家对技术创新的影响并不显著。

abstract.text: Existing experimental research on behavior in weakest-link games shows overwhelmingly theinability of people to coordinate on the efficient equilibrium, especially in larger groups. Wehypothesize that people will be able to coordinate on efficient outcomes, provided they havesufficient freedom to choose their interaction neighborhood. We conduct experiments with mediumsized and large groups and show that neighborhood choice indeed leads to coordination on the fullyefficient equilibrium, irrespective of group size. This leads to substantial welfare effects.Achieved welfare is between 40 and 60 percent higher in games with neighborhood choice thanwithout neighborhood choice. We identify exclusion as the simple but very effective mechanismunderlying this result. In early rounds, high performers exclude low performers who in consequence ‘learn’ to become high performers.

10.1093/restud/rdv040.abstractZh: 现有的关于最弱者博弈行为的实验研究表明，人们无法在更大的群体中协调达成有效均衡。我们假设，只要人们有足够的自由来选择自己的互动邻域，他们就能够协调达成有效的结果。我们对中等规模和大规模的群体进行了实验，发现无论群体规模如何，选择邻域确实能够导致在完全有效的均衡上实现协调。这带来了显著的福利效应。在具有邻域选择的博弈中，实现的福利比没有邻域选择的情况高出40%到60%。我们发现，排斥行为是这一结果背后的简单但非常有效的机制。在初期阶段，表现优异的人会排斥表现较差的人，结果这些表现较差的人“学会”成为表现优异的人。

abstract.text: This article presents a dynamic general equilibrium model to investigate how different contracting modes based on formal and relational enforcements emerge endogenously and are linked dynamically with the process of economic development. Formal contracts are enforced by third-party institutions (courts), whereas relational contracts are self-enforcing agreements without third-party involvement. The novel feature of our model is that it demonstrates the co-evolution of these different enforcement modes and market equilibrium conditions, all of which are jointly determined. We then characterize the equilibrium paths of such dynamic processes and show the time structure of relational contracting in the process of development. In particular, we show that relational contracting fosters the emergence of a market-based economy in the growth phase of development; however, its role declines as the economy enters a mature phase.

10.1093/restud/rdv041.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个动态一般均衡模型，用于研究基于正式和关系性强制的不同契约模式如何内生性地出现，并如何与经济发展过程动态关联。正式契约由第三方机构（法院）强制执行，而关系性契约则是无需第三方介入的自强制约协议。我们模型的新颖之处在于，它展示了这些不同强制模式与市场均衡条件的共同演化，所有这些因素都是共同决定的。我们进一步描述了这种动态过程中的均衡路径，并展示了关系性契约在经济发展过程中的时间结构。特别地，我们发现关系性契约在经济发展的增长阶段促进了市场经济的形成；然而，当经济进入成熟阶段时，其作用则会减弱。

abstract.text: Online markets for remote labour services allow workers and firms to contract with each other directly. Despite this, intermediaries—called outsourcing agencies—have emerged in these markets. This article shows that agencies signal to employers that inexperienced workers are high quality. Workers affiliated with an agency have substantially higher job-finding probabilities and wages at the beginning of their careers compared to similar workers without an agency affiliation. This advantage declines after high-quality non-affiliated workers receive good public feedback scores. The results indicate that intermediaries have arisen endogenously to permit a more efficient allocation of workers to jobs.

10.1093/restud/rdv042.abstractZh: 远程劳动力服务的在线市场允许工人和企业直接进行合作。尽管如此，这些市场中出现了被称为外包机构的中介组织。本文表明，这些机构向雇主传递了信息，即没有经验的工人具有较高的质量。与没有机构关联的类似工人相比，隶属于外包机构的工人在职业生涯初期拥有更高的就业机会和更高的工资。然而，当高质量的非关联工人获得了良好的公众反馈评分后，这种优势就会下降。研究结果表明，中介机构的出现是出于对劳动力更高效分配的需求而自然产生的。

abstract.text: We link daily air pollution exposure to measures of contemporaneous health for communities surrounding the twelve largest airports in California. These airports are some of the largest sources of air pollution in the US, and they experience large changes in daily air pollution emissions depending on the amount of time planes spend idling on the tarmac. Excess airplane idling, measured as residual daily taxi time, is due to network delays originating in the Eastern US. This idiosyncratic variation in daily airplane taxi time significantly impacts the health of local residents, largely driven by increased levels of carbon monoxide (CO) exposure. We use this variation in daily airport congestion to estimate the population dose-response of health outcomes to daily CO exposure, examining hospitalization rates for asthma, respiratory, and heart-related emergency room admissions. A one standard deviation increase in daily pollution levels leads to an additional $540 thousand in hospitalization costs for respiratory and heart-related admissions for the 6 million individuals living within 10 km (6.2 miles) of the airports in California. These health effects occur at levels of CO exposure far below existing Environmental Protection Agency mandates, and our results suggest there may be sizable morbidity benefits from lowering the existing CO standard.

10.1093/restud/rdv043.abstractZh: 我们将加州十二个最大机场周围的社区日常空气污染暴露与同期健康指标联系起来研究。这些机场是美国最大的空气污染来源之一，其日常空气污染排放量会因飞机在停机坪上闲置的时间长短而发生重大变化。飞机闲置时间的增加，表现为每日剩余滑行时间，这一现象是由美国东部地区的网络延误引起的。这种每日飞机滑行时间的独特变化对当地居民的健康产生了显著影响，其主要原因是一氧化碳（CO）暴露水平的上升。我们利用这种机场拥堵的日变化情况，来估算人群对每日一氧化碳暴露的健康影响，具体研究哮喘、呼吸系统及心脏相关急诊住院率的变化。在加州，距离机场10公里（6.2英里）范围内的600万居民，如果每日污染水平增加一个标准差，将导致呼吸系统及心脏相关急诊住院费用额外增加54万美元。这些健康影响发生在远低于美国环境保护署现行标准的一氧化碳暴露水平下，我们的研究结果表明，降低当前的一氧化碳标准可能会带来显著的健康效益。

abstract.text: Should policy makers be prevented from bailing out investors in the event of a crisis? I study this question in a model of financial intermediation with limited commitment. When a crisis occurs, the policy maker will respond with fiscal transfers that partially cover intermediaries' losses. The anticipation of this bailout distorts ex ante incentives, leading intermediaries to become excessively illiquid and increasing financial fragility. Prohibiting bailouts is not necessarily desirable, however: while it induces intermediaries to become more liquid, it may nevertheless lower welfare and leave the economy more susceptible to a crisis. A policy of taxing short-term liabilities, in contrast, can both improve the allocation of resources and promote financial stability.

10.1093/restud/rdv044.abstractZh: 在危机发生时，是否应该阻止政策制定者救助投资者？我在一个有限承诺的金融中介模型中研究了这个问题。当危机发生时，政策制定者会通过财政转移支付来部分弥补中介机构的损失。这种救助行为的预期会扭曲事前激励，导致中介机构变得过度缺乏流动性，从而增加金融脆弱性。然而，禁止救助行为并不一定是有益的：虽然它能使中介机构变得更加流动，但可能会降低福利，并使经济更容易受到危机的影响。相比之下，对短期负债征税的政策既能改善资源分配，又能促进金融稳定。

abstract.text: This article derives novel testable implications of referral-based job search networks in which employees provide employers with information about potential new hires that they otherwise would not have. Using comprehensive matched employer–employee data covering the entire workforce in one large metropolitan labour market combined with unique survey data linked to administrative records, we provide evidence that workers earn higher wages and are less inclined to leave their firms if they have obtained their job through a referral. These effects are particularly strong at the beginning of the employment relationship and decline with tenure in the firm, suggesting that firms and workers learn about workers' productivity over time. Overall, our findings imply that job search networks help to reduce informational deficiencies in the labour market and lead to productivity gains for workers and firms.

10.1093/restud/rdv045.abstractZh: 本文提出了基于推荐的工作搜索网络的新颖可验证的推论。在这种网络中，员工能够向雇主提供关于潜在新员工的信息，而这些信息在常规情况下是难以获得的。通过整合涵盖整个大都市劳动力市场的大量匹配雇主-员工数据，并结合与行政记录相关联的独特调查数据，我们发现，通过推荐获得工作的员工能够获得更高的工资，并且离职的可能性也较低。这些效应在雇佣关系初期尤为明显，随着在公司的任职时间延长，这种效应逐渐减弱，这表明公司和员工会随着时间的推移了解员工的生产力情况。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，工作搜索网络有助于减少劳动力市场中的信息不足，并带来员工和公司的生产力提升。

abstract.text: We define a class of dynamic Markovian games, directional dynamic games (DDG), where directionality is represented by a strategy-independent partial order on the state space. We show that many games are DDGs, yet none of the existing algorithms are guaranteed to find any Markov perfect equilibrium (MPE) of these games, much less all of them. We propose a fast and robust generalization of backward induction we call state recursion that operates on a decomposition of the overall DDG into a finite number of more tractable stage games , which can be solved recursively. We provide conditions under which state recursion finds at least one MPE of the overall DDG and introduce a recursive lexicographic search (RLS) algorithm that systematically and efficiently uses state recursion to find all MPE of the overall game in a finite number of steps. We apply RLS to find all MPE of a dynamic model of Bertrand price competition with cost-reducing investments which we show is a DDG. We provide an exact non-iterative algorithm that finds all MPE of every stage game, and prove there can be only 1, 3, or 5 of them. Using the stage games as building blocks, RLS rapidly finds and enumerates all MPE of the overall game. RLS finds a unique MPE for an alternating move version of the leapfrogging game when technology improves with probability 1, but in other cases, and in any simultaneous move version of the game, it finds a huge multiplicity of MPE that explode exponentially as the number of possible cost states increases.

10.1093/restud/rdv046.abstractZh: 我们定义了一类动态马尔可夫博弈，即方向性动态博弈（DDG），其中方向性通过状态空间上的策略无关部分顺序来表示。我们证明许多博弈属于DDG类型，但现有的算法无法保证找到这些博弈的马尔可夫完美均衡，更不用说全部博弈的均衡了。我们提出了一种快速且稳健的逆向归纳方法，称为状态递归，该方法将整体DDG分解为有限数量的更易处理的阶段博弈，这些阶段博弈可以递归求解。我们提出了状态递归能够找到整体DDG至少一种MPE的条件，并引入了一种递归字典序搜索算法（RLS），该算法能够系统地、高效地利用状态递归在有限步骤内找到整体博弈的所有MPE。我们将RLS应用于一个动态模型中的伯特兰价格竞争博弈，该模型包含降低成本的投入，我们证明这是一个DDG。我们提供了一种精确的、非迭代算法，能够找到每个阶段博弈的所有MPE，并证明这些MPE最多只有1、3或5个。利用这些阶段博弈作为构建块，RLS能够快速找到并枚举整体博弈的所有MPE。对于以概率1改进技术的交替移动版本的跳跃博弈，RLS能够找到唯一的MPE，但在其他情况下，以及在任何同时移动版本的博弈中，它可能会找到大量的MPE，这些MPE的数量会随着可能成本状态的数量增加而呈指数级增长。

abstract.text: In this article, we examine the effect of “choice fatigue” on decision making. We exploit a natural experiment in which voters face the same contest at different ballot positions due to differences in the number of local issues on their ballot. Facing more decisions before a given contest significantly increases the tendency to abstain or rely on decision shortcuts, such as voting for the status quo or the first-listed candidate. We estimate that, without choice fatigue, abstentions would decrease by 8%, and 6% of the propositions in our data set would have passed rather than failed.

10.1093/restud/rdv047.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们探讨了“选择疲劳”对决策过程的影响。我们通过一项自然实验来研究这一现象，实验中选民在相同的竞选活动中面临不同的投票位置，这主要是由于他们投票表上的地方议题数量不同所导致的。在某一竞选活动前面临更多决策时，人们倾向于选择弃权或依赖决策捷径，比如投票支持现状或首轮当选的候选人。我们的估计表明，如果没有选择疲劳，弃权率将下降8%，并且我们数据集中的提案中有6%会成功通过而非失败。

abstract.text: We present a model of market competition in which consumers' attention is drawn to the products' most salient attributes.Firms compete for consumer attention via their choices of quality and price.Strategic positioning of a product affects how all other products are perceived.With this attention externality, depending on the cost of producing quality some markets exhibit "commoditized" price salient equilibria, while others exhibit "de-commoditized" quality salient equilibria.When the costs of quality change, innovation can lead to radical shifts in markets, as in the case of decommoditization of the coffee market by Starbucks.In the context of financial innovation, the model generates the phenomenon of "reaching for yield".

10.1093/restud/rdv048.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个市场竞争模型，其中消费者的注意力被吸引到产品最显著的属性上。企业通过选择质量和价格来争夺消费者的注意力。产品的战略定位会影响其他产品的感知方式。由于这种注意力外部性，取决于生产高质量的成本，一些市场呈现出“商品化”的价格显著均衡，而另一些市场则呈现出“非商品化”的质量显著均衡。当质量成本发生变化时，创新可以导致市场的根本性变化，正如星巴克使咖啡市场非商品化的情况。在金融创新的背景下，该模型揭示了“追求收益”的现象。

abstract.text: Prices tend to remain constant for a period of time and then jump. In the literature, this “rigidity” is usually interpreted to reflect a cost of adjusting prices. This article shows that price rigidity can alternatively reflect optimal price setting when there are no adjustment costs, namely, if the seller is rationally inattentive. The model generates non-trivial pricing patterns that are consistent with the data and that are hard to explain with the traditional adjustment-cost model. In particular, prices are adjusted frequently but move back and forth between a few given values, hazard functions are downward sloping, and responses to persistent shocks are sluggish. These results are obtained in a model that implements rational inattention without simplifying assumptions on the functional forms of the processed signals.

10.1093/restud/rdv049.abstractZh: 价格往往会在一段时间内保持稳定，然后突然上涨或下跌。在相关文献中，这种“刚性”通常被解释为调整价格的成本。本文指出，当调整成本为零时，即卖方具有理性忽视行为时，价格刚性可以反映最优的价格设定。该模型产生了与数据一致的非平凡定价模式，这些模式难以用传统的调整成本模型来解释。具体而言，价格会频繁调整，但会在几个固定值之间来回波动；风险函数呈下降趋势；对持续冲击的响应较为迟缓。这些结果是在一个模型中获得的，该模型实现了理性忽视行为，同时没有对处理信号的函数形式进行简化假设。

abstract.text: We study models where prices respond slowly to shocks because firms are rationally inattentive. Producers must pay a cost to observe the determinants of the current profit maximizing price, and hence observe them infrequently. To generate large real effects of monetary shocks in such a model the time between observations must be long and/or highly volatile. Previous work on rational inattentiveness has allowed for observation intervals that are either constant-but-long ( e.g . Caballero, 1989 or Reis, 2006) or volatile-but-short ( e.g . Reis's, 2006 example where observation costs are negligible), but not both. In these models, the real effects of monetary policy are small for realistic values of the duration between observations. We show that non-negligible observation costs produce both of these effects: intervals between observations are infrequent and volatile. This generates large real effects of monetary policy for realistic values of the average time between observations.

10.1093/restud/rdv050.abstractZh: 我们研究的是那些价格对冲击反应缓慢的模型，因为企业存在理性上的疏忽。生产者必须付出成本来观察当前利润最大化价格的决定因素，因此他们很少进行这样的观察。要在这样的模型中产生显著的货币冲击实际效果，观察之间的时间间隔必须很长且/或波动很大。之前关于理性疏忽的研究已经允许观察间隔可以是恒定的但时间较长（例如Caballero, 1989或Reis, 2006），或者波动但时间较短（例如Reis的2006年例子，其中观察成本可以忽略不计），但两者兼有的情况尚未得到研究。在这些模型中，对于实际的观察间隔时间，货币政策的实际效果很小。我们证明，不可忽视的观察成本会产生这两种效果：观察间隔既少又波动。这会在实际的观察平均时间间隔下，产生显著的货币政策实际效果。

abstract.text: Decisions involving charitable giving often occur under the shadow of risk. A common finding is that potential donors give less when there is greater risk that their donation will have less impact. While this behaviour could be fully rationalized by standard economic models, this article shows that an additional mechanism is relevant: the use of risk as an excuse not to give. In a laboratory study, participants evaluate risky payoffs for themselves and risky payoffs for a charity. When their decisions do not involve tradeoffs between money for themselves and the charity, they respond very similarly to self risk and charity risk. By contrast, when their decisions force tradeoffs between money for themselves and the charity, participants act more averse to charity risk and less averse to self risk. These altered responses to risk bias participants towards choosing payoffs for themselves more often, consistent with excuse-driven responses to risk. Additional results support the existence of excuse-driven types.

10.1093/restud/rdv051.abstractZh: 涉及慈善捐赠的决策往往是在风险阴影下做出的。一个常见的发现是，当捐赠者担心自己的捐款影响较小时，他们通常会减少捐赠。虽然这种行为可以通过标准经济模型完全解释，但本文表明，还有一个额外的机制起着作用：利用风险作为不捐赠的借口。在一项实验室研究中，参与者评估了自身风险与慈善机构风险下的收益情况。当他们的决策不涉及自身利益与慈善机构利益之间的权衡时，他们的反应与自身风险及慈善风险下的反应非常相似。相反，当决策迫使他们必须在自身利益与慈善机构利益之间进行权衡时，参与者对慈善风险的态度更为消极，而对自身风险的态度则较为积极。这些对风险的不同反应使得参与者更倾向于选择对自身有利的收益，这与以借口为驱动的风险反应一致。其他研究结果也支持了这种以借口为驱动的决策类型的存在。

abstract.text: We introduce a model of strategic thinking in games of initial response. Unlike standard models of strategic thinking, in this framework the player's “depth of reasoning” is endogenously determined, and it can be disentangled from his beliefs over his opponent's cognitive bound. In our approach, individuals act as if they follow a cost–benefit analysis. The depth of reasoning is a function of the player's cognitive abilities and his payoffs. The costs are exogenous and represent the game-theoretical sophistication of the player; the benefit instead is related to the game payoffs. Behaviour is in turn determined by the individual's depth of reasoning and his beliefs about the reasoning process of the opponent. Thus, in our framework, payoffs not only affect individual choices in the traditional sense, but they also shape the cognitive process itself. Our model delivers testable implications on players' chosen actions as incentives and opponents change. We then test the model's predictions with an experiment. We administer different treatments that vary beliefs over payoffs and opponents, as well as beliefs over opponents' beliefs.
