The results of this experiment, which are not accounted for by current models of reasoning in games, strongly support our theory. We also show that the predictions of our model are highly consistent, both qualitatively and quantitatively, with well-known unresolved empirical puzzles. Our approach therefore serves as a novel, unifying framework of strategic thinking that allows for predictions across games.

10.1093/restud/rdv052.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个关于初始反应游戏中战略思维的模型。与传统的战略思维模型不同，在这个框架中，玩家的“推理深度”是由内生因素决定的，并且可以与玩家对对手认知能力的信念分离开来。在我们的模型中，个体行为仿佛遵循成本-收益分析。推理深度是玩家的认知能力及其收益的函数。成本是由外部因素决定的，代表了玩家的博弈理论素养；而收益则与游戏收益相关。行为反过来又受到个体推理深度以及其对对手推理过程的信念的影响。因此，在我们的框架中，收益不仅影响个体在传统意义上的选择，还塑造了认知过程本身。我们的模型提出了关于玩家选择行为以及对手变化时的激励因素的可验证性结论。随后，我们通过实验来验证模型的预测。我们设计了不同的实验条件，这些条件涉及对收益和对手的信念，以及对对手信念的信念。实验结果并不符合当前关于博弈中推理模型的解释，但强烈支持我们的理论。此外，我们的模型预测结果与一些众所周知的未解决的实证难题在质量和数量上高度一致。因此，我们的方法提供了一种新的、统一的战略思维框架，能够跨游戏进行预测。

abstract.text: We propose a dynamic framework to study the value of medical innovation in the context of infectious disease. We apply our framework to evaluate an HIV treatment breakthrough known as HAART. The model captures how, in lowering both the expected cost and likelihood of HIV infection, HAART reduced the implicit price of risky sex. Forward-looking agents responded by optimally shifting their behaviour. The model also imposes equilibrium constraints, explicitly capturing how optimal shifts in behaviour affect equilibrium choices by changing both infection probabilities and the ease of finding partners willing to engage in risky sex. Using the estimated model, we conduct counterfactual simulations to compute the value of HAART from the perspective of uninfected agents. This includes the option value of the innovation along with value accruing from changes in sex behaviour in response to HAART introduction. We also calculate the added value of a fully functional vaccine from the perspective of both infected and uninfected agents, where infected agents benefit from a vaccine due to resulting shifts in market equilibrium.

10.1093/restud/rdv053.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个动态框架，用于研究在传染病背景下医疗创新的价值。我们将该框架应用于评估一种名为HAART的HIV治疗突破。该模型揭示了HAART如何通过降低HIV感染的预期成本和可能性，从而降低风险性性行为的隐性价格。具有前瞻性行为的个体会优化调整其行为。该模型还施加了均衡约束，明确描述了行为优化如何通过改变感染概率以及寻找愿意进行风险性性行为伴侣的难易程度来影响均衡选择。利用估算出的模型，我们进行了反事实模拟，以计算从未感染个体的视角来看HAART的价值。这包括创新的价值以及由于HAART的引入而导致的性行为变化所带来的价值。我们还计算了从感染者和未感染者的视角来看，一种完全有效的疫苗所带来的附加价值，其中感染者因市场均衡的变化而受益于疫苗。

abstract.text: This article develops an empirical framework for analysing the timing of international treaties. A treaty is modelled as a dynamic game among governments that decide on participation in every period. The net benefit of treaty membership increases over time. Spillovers among members and non-members accelerate or delay treaty formation by transforming participation into a strategic complement or substitute, respectively. The predictions of the model inform the estimation of the structural parameters, based on a cross section of treaty ratification dates. With this approach, I estimate the sign and magnitude of strategic interaction in the ratification of the Montreal Protocol, in the formation of Europe's preferential trade agreements, and in the growth of Germany's network of bilateral investment treaties. Through a series of counterfactual experiments, I explore different mechanisms that give rise to strategic interaction in the formation of these treaties.

10.1093/restud/rdv054.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个用于分析国际条约签订时机的实证框架。将条约模型化为政府之间在每一个时期做出参与决定的动态博弈。随着时间推移，条约成员身份带来的净收益会逐渐增加。成员国与非成员国之间的溢出效应会加速或延迟条约的签订，具体表现为参与行为转化为战略上的互补或替代关系。该模型的预测为基于条约批准日期的横截面数据来估计结构参数提供了依据。通过这一方法，我估算了《蒙特利尔议定书》批准过程中、欧洲优惠贸易协定形成过程中以及德国双边投资条约网络发展过程中的战略互动的强度和方向。通过一系列反事实实验，我探讨了导致这些条约形成过程中出现战略互动的不同机制。

abstract.text: In elections with three or more candidates, coordination among like-minded voters is an important problem. We analyse the trade-off between coordination and learning about candidate quality under different temporal election systems in the context of the U.S. presidential primary system. In our model, candidates with different policy positions and qualities compete for the nomination, and voters are uncertain about the candidates' valence. This setup generates two effects: vote splitting ( i.e . several candidates in the same policy position compete for the same voter pool) and voter learning (as the results in earlier elections help voters to update their beliefs on candidate quality). Sequential voting minimizes vote splitting in late districts, but voters may coordinate on a low-quality candidate. Using the parameter estimates obtained from all the Democratic and Republican presidential primaries during 2000–12, we conduct policy experiments such as replacing the current system with a simultaneous system, adopting the reform proposal of the National Association of Secretaries of State, or imposing party rules that lead to candidate withdrawal when prespecified conditions are met.

10.1093/restud/rdv055.abstractZh: 在有三名或更多候选人的选举中，志同道合的选民之间的协调是一个重要问题。我们分析了在不同时间制度下，协调与了解候选人质量之间的权衡，以美国总统初选制度为背景。在我们的模型中，持有不同政策立场和品质的候选人竞争提名，而选民对候选人的价值持不确定态度。这种设置产生了两种效应：投票分割（即同一政策立场下的多个候选人争夺同一选民群体）和选民学习（因为早期选举的结果有助于选民更新对候选人质量的看法）。顺序投票可以在后期选区中最小化投票分割，但选民可能会选择支持低质量的候选人。利用2000年至2012年间所有民主党和共和党总统初选获得的参数估计值，我们进行了政策实验，例如用同时投票制度替代现有制度，采纳国家国务卿协会的改革建议，或者实施导致候选人退出规则的政党规则。

abstract.text: We study torture as a mechanism for extracting information from a suspect who may or may not be informed. We show that a standard rationale for torture generates two commitment problems. First, the principal would benefit from a commitment to torture a suspect he knows to be innocent. Secondly, the principal would benefit from a commitment to limit the amount of torture faced by the guilty. We analyse a dynamic model of torture in which the credibility of these threats and promises is endogenous. We show that these commitment problems dramatically reduce the value of torture and can even render it completely ineffective. We use our model to address questions such as the effect of enhanced interrogation techniques, rights against indefinite detention, and delegation of torture to specialists.

10.1093/restud/rdv057.abstractZh: 我们研究利用酷刑作为从可能知情或不知情的嫌疑人中获取信息的手段。我们发现，对酷刑的标准解释会引发两个承诺问题。首先，委托人会从对已知无罪的嫌疑人实施酷刑中获益。其次，委托人也会从限制有罪嫌疑人所遭受的酷刑程度上获益。我们分析了一个动态酷刑模型，其中这些威胁和承诺的可信度是内生性的。结果表明，这些承诺问题显著降低了酷刑的价值，甚至可能导致酷刑完全无效。我们利用我们的模型来探讨诸如加强审讯技术、反对无限期拘留的权利，以及将酷刑任务委托给专家等问题。

abstract.text: This article shows that equilibrium unemployment dynamics can significantly increase the efficacy of fiscal policy. In response to a shock that brings the economy into a liquidity trap, an expansion in government spending increases output and causes a fall in the unemployment rate. Since movements in unemployment are persistent, the effects of current spending prevail into the future, leading to an enduring rise in income. As an enduring rise in income boosts private demand, an increase in government spending sets in motion a virtuous employment-spending spiral with large effects on macroeconomic aggregates.

10.1093/restud/rdv058.abstractZh: 本文指出，均衡失业动态可以显著提高财政政策的有效性。面对使经济陷入流动性陷阱的冲击，政府支出的增加会提升产出，并降低失业率。由于失业率的变动是持续的，当前支出的效果会延续到未来，从而导致收入的持续上升。随着收入的持续增加刺激私人需求，政府支出的增加会引发一个良性循环——就业与支出的螺旋上升，对宏观经济总量产生重大影响。

abstract.text: What is the relationship between product prices and vertical integration? While the literature has focused on how integration affects prices, this paper provides evidence that prices can affect integration. Many theories in organizational economics and industrial organization posit that integration, while costly, increases productivity. It follows from firms' maximizing behavior that higher prices induce more integration. The reason is that at low prices, increases in revenue resulting from enhanced productivity are too small to justify the cost, whereas at high prices the revenue benefit exceeds the cost. Trade policy provides a source of exogenous price variation to assess the validity of this prediction: higher tariffs should lead to higher prices and therefore to more integration. We construct firm-level indices of vertical integration for a large set of countries and industries and exploit cross-section and time-series variation in import tariffs to examine their impact on firm boundaries. Our empirical results provide strong support for the view that output prices are a key determinant of vertical integration.

10.1093/restud/rdv059.abstractZh: 产品价格与垂直整合之间有什么关系？虽然现有研究主要关注整合如何影响价格，但本文提供了证据，表明价格可以影响整合程度。许多组织经济学和工业组织的理论认为，尽管整合成本高昂，但确实能提升生产效率。从企业的最大化行为来看，较高的价格会促使企业进行更多的整合。原因在于，在较低价格下，由于生产效率的提高而带来的收入增长不足以抵消整合成本，而在较高价格下，收入收益则足以弥补成本。贸易政策作为外部价格变动的源泉，可以用来验证这一预测：较高的关税应导致更高的价格，从而促使更多的整合。我们为大量国家和行业构建了企业层面的垂直整合指标，并利用进口关税的截面和时间序列变化来研究其对企业边界的影响。我们的实证结果强烈支持这样的观点：产品价格是决定垂直整合的关键因素。

abstract.text: If individuals own the right to take any action that they please, and are free to contract about behaviour, will outcomes be efficient in all situations? That is, does the Coase theorem hold? We study this classic question through the lens of a non-cooperative model of contract negotiations, considering both compulsory and voluntary participation in negotiations. In either case, we find that all consistent equilibria of the contracting game are efficient in the case of two players. But if participation is voluntary, and there are more than two players, there are situations in which all consistent equilibria are inefficient. Specifically, the provision of public goods tends to be inefficiently low due to strategic abstention from contracting. Free-riding on others' agreements can be avoided if individuals do not own all their actions. When actions involve the use of assets, efficient action ownership may correspond to collective rather than individual asset ownership.

10.1093/restud/rdw001.abstractZh: 如果个体拥有自由采取任何行动的权利，并且能够自由地就行为达成协议，那么在所有情况下结果是否都是高效的呢？也就是说，科斯定理是否成立？我们通过一个非合作模型来研究这个经典问题，考虑谈判中的强制参与和自愿参与两种情况。无论哪种情况，我们发现对于两个参与者来说，所有一致的契约均衡都是高效的。但是，如果参与是自愿的，并且参与者数量超过两个，那么有些情况下所有一致的均衡都是低效的。具体来说，由于战略性的不参与契约，公共物品的提供往往效率低下。如果个体并不拥有所有行动的权利，就可以避免利用他人的协议。当行动涉及使用资产时，有效的行动所有权可能对应于集体而非个体的资产所有权。

abstract.text: Long-run forecasts of economic variables play an important role in policy, planning, and portfolio decisions. We consider forecasts of the long-horizon average of a scalar variable, typically the growth rate of an economic variable. The main contribution is the construction of prediction sets with asymptotic coverage over a wide range of data generating processes, allowing for stochastically trending mean growth, slow mean reversion, and other types of long-run dependencies. We illustrate the method by computing prediction sets for 10- to 75-year average growth rates of U.S. real per capita GDP and consumption, productivity, price level, stock prices, and population.

10.1093/restud/rdw003.abstractZh: 长期经济变量预测在政策、规划和投资组合决策中发挥着重要作用。我们考虑对标量变量长期平均值的预测，通常是经济变量的增长率。我们的主要贡献在于构建具有广泛数据生成过程覆盖范围的预测集，从而能够适应随机趋势性均值增长、缓慢的均值回归以及其他类型的长期依赖性。我们通过计算美国人均实际GDP、消费、生产率、价格水平、股价和人口在10至75年间的平均增长率来预测集来说明该方法的应用。

abstract.text: We provide an experimental and theoretical evaluation of a cost-reducing innovation in the delivery of “self-help group” microfinance services, in which privatized agents earn payments through membership fees for providing services. Under the status quo, agents are paid by an outside donor and offer members free services. In our multi-country randomized control trial, we evaluate the change in this incentive scheme on agent behaviour and performance, and on overall village-level outcomes. We find that privatized agents start groups, attract members, mobilize savings, and intermediate loans at similar levels after a year but at much lower costs to the NGO. At the village level, we find higher levels of borrowing, business-related savings, and investment in business. Examining mechanisms, we find that self-help groups serve more business-oriented clientele when facilitated by agents who face strong financial incentives.

10.1093/restud/rdw004.abstractZh: 我们对一种降低成本的“自助小组”小额信贷服务创新进行了实验性和理论性评估。在这种模式下，私营机构通过收取会员费来收取服务费用。在现状下，这些机构由外部捐助者支付报酬，并免费为会员提供服务。在我们的多国随机对照试验中，我们评估了这种激励机制的变化对机构行为、绩效以及整个村庄层面的影响。研究发现，私营机构在一年后开始组建小组、吸引会员、动员储蓄，并开展贷款业务，但成本远低于非政府组织。在村庄层面，我们发现借款、与商业相关的储蓄以及商业投资都有所增加。通过机制分析，我们发现，当由面临强大财务激励的机构来推动时，自助小组能够服务更多以商业为导向的客户。

abstract.text: In large-scale panel data models with latent factors the number of factors and their loadings may change over time. Treating the break date as unknown, this article proposes an adaptive group-LASSO estimator that consistently determines the numbers of pre- and post-break factors and the stability of factor loadings if the number of factors is constant. We develop a cross-validation procedure to fine-tune the data-dependent LASSO penalties and show that after the number of factors has been determined, a conventional least-squares approach can be used to estimate the break date consistently. The method performs well in Monte Carlo simulations. In an empirical application, we study the change in factor loadings and the emergence of new factors in a panel of U.S. macroeconomic and financial time series during the Great Recession.

10.1093/restud/rdw005.abstractZh: 在具有潜在因素的大规模面板数据模型中，因素的数量及其载荷可能会随时间发生变化。本文将断裂日期视为未知，提出了一种自适应组LASSO估计器，该估计器能够一致地确定断裂前后的因素数量以及因素载荷的稳定性，前提是因素数量保持不变。我们开发了一种交叉验证程序来微调数据依赖的LASSO惩罚项，并证明在确定了因素数量之后，可以使用传统的最小二乘法来一致地估计断裂日期。该方法在蒙特卡洛模拟中表现良好。在一个实证应用中，我们研究了美国宏观经济和金融时间序列在大衰退期间因素载荷的变化以及新因素的出现情况。

abstract.text: The latitude gradient in comparative development is a striking fact: as one moves away from the equator, economic activity rises. While this regularity is well known, it is not well understood. Perhaps the strongest correlate of (absolute) latitude is the intensity of ultraviolet radiation (UV-R), which epidemiological research has shown to be a cause of a wide range of diseases. We establish that UV-R is strongly and negatively correlated with economic activity, both across and within countries. We propose and test a mechanism that links UV-R to current income differences via the impact of disease ecology on the timing of the take-off to sustained growth.

10.1093/restud/rdw006.abstractZh: 在比较发展过程中，纬度梯度是一个显著的现象：随着距离赤道的距离增加，经济活动也随之上升。虽然这种规律性已经广为人知，但对其本质的理解仍然不够深入。或许，（绝对）纬度最强的相关因素是紫外线辐射的强度，流行病学研究已经表明，紫外线辐射是多种疾病的原因。我们发现，紫外线辐射强度与经济活动之间存在强烈的负相关关系，无论是在国家之间还是国家内部。我们提出并测试了一种机制，该机制通过疾病生态对经济增长时机的影响，将紫外线辐射强度与当前收入差异联系起来。

abstract.text: We provide the first direct empirical support for the importance of signalling in monetary policy by testing two key predictions from a novel structural model. First, all policymaker types should become less tough on inflation over time and secondly, types that weigh output more should have a more pronounced shift. Voting data from the Bank of England's Monetary Policy Committee strongly support both predictions. Counterfactual results indicate signalling has a substantial impact on interest rates over the business cycle, and improves the committee designer's welfare. Implications for committee design include allowing regular member turnover and transparency regarding publishing individual votes.

10.1093/restud/rdw007.abstractZh: 我们通过测试一个新颖结构模型的两个关键预测，首次直接提供了货币政策中信号传递重要性的实证支持。首先，所有类型的政策制定者随着时间的推移应该对通胀的管控力度减弱；其次，那些更重视产出的政策制定者应该会有更明显的转变。英格兰银行货币政策委员会的投票数据强烈支持这两个预测。反事实结果表明，信号传递对商业周期中的利率有显著影响，并且提升了委员会设计者的福利。对于委员会设计而言，这意味着允许定期更换成员，并提高个人投票结果的透明度。

abstract.text: How do successive, forward-looking agents experiment with interdependent and endogenous technologies? In this article, trying a radically new technology not only is informative of the value of similar technologies, but also reduces the cost of experimenting with them, in effect expanding the space of affordable technologies. Successful radical experimentation has mixed effects: it improves the immediate outlook for further experimentation but decreases the value and the marginal value of experimentation in a longer term, resulting in less ambitious “incremental” experimentation and in a reduced size of radical experimentation. Incremental experimentation lowers the option value of similar technologies, which may spur a new wave of radical experimentation. However, experimentation eventually stagnates for all parameters of the model.

10.1093/restud/rdw008.abstractZh: 连续的、具有前瞻性的创新者是如何尝试相互依赖且具有内生性的技术的呢？在本文中，尝试一种全新的技术不仅有助于了解类似技术的价值，还能降低实验成本，从而扩大可负担技术的选择范围。成功的激进实验会产生双重效应：它提升了后续实验的潜力，但从长远来看，却降低了实验的价值和边际价值，导致“渐进式”实验的雄心减少，激进实验的规模也相应缩小。渐进式实验会降低类似技术的选择价值，这可能会激发新一轮的激进实验。然而，最终实验对于所有模型参数而言都会陷入停滞。

abstract.text: We study how the marginal welfare gain from increasing the unemployment insurance (UI) benefit level varies over the business cycle. We do this by estimating how the moral hazard cost and the consumption smoothing benefit of UI vary with labour market conditions, which we identify using variation in the interaction of UI benefit levels with the unemployment rate within U.S. states over time. We find that the moral hazard cost is procyclical, greater when the unemployment rate is relatively low. By contrast, we do not find evidence that the consumption smoothing benefit varies with the unemployment rate. We use these empirical results to estimate the marginal welfare gain, and we find that it is modest on average, but varies positively with the unemployment rate.

10.1093/restud/rdw009.abstractZh: 我们研究了在商业周期中，提高失业保险福利水平所带来的边际福利增益如何变化。我们通过估计失业保险福利水平与失业率之间的互动变化，来研究道德风险成本以及消费平滑效益如何随劳动力市场状况而变化。研究发现，道德风险成本具有顺周期性，在失业率相对较低时更为显著。相比之下，我们没有发现消费平滑效益随失业率变化的证据。利用这些实证结果，我们估算了边际福利增益，发现其平均水平较为适中，但随失业率的上升而呈正相关。

abstract.text: We build a heterogeneous agents life cycle model that captures a large number of salient features of individual male labour supply over the life cycle, by education, both along the intensive and extensive margins. The model provides an aggregation theory of individual labour supply, firmly grounded on individual-level micro-evidence, and is used to study the aggregate labour supply responses to changes in the economic environment. We find that the aggregate labour supply elasticity to a transitory wage shock is 1.75, with the extensive margin accounting for 62% of the response. Furthermore, we find that the aggregate labour supply elasticity to a permanent-compensated wage change is 0.44.

10.1093/restud/rdw010.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个异质代理人生命周期模型，该模型能够捕捉到个体男性劳动力供应在生命周期内的大量特征，这些特征涉及教育水平，包括密集型和扩展型两个维度。该模型提供了一种基于个体层面微观证据的个人劳动力供应聚合理论，并用于研究整体劳动力供应对经济环境变化的响应。研究发现，整体劳动力供应对暂时性工资变化的弹性为1.75，其中扩展型因素占响应的62%。此外，我们还发现，整体劳动力供应对永久性工资变化的弹性为0.44。

abstract.text: Financial innovations are a common explanation for the rise in credit card debt and bankruptcies. To evaluate this story, we develop a simple model that incorporates two key frictions: asymmetric information about borrowers' risk of default and a fixed cost of developing each contract lenders offer. Innovations that ameliorate asymmetric information or reduce this fixed cost have large extensive margin effects via the entry of new lending contracts targeted at riskier borrowers. This results in more defaults and borrowing, and increased dispersion of interest rates. Using the Survey of Consumer Finances and Federal Reserve Board interest rate data, we find evidence supporting these predictions. Specifically, the dispersion of credit card interest rates nearly tripled while the “new” cardholders of the late 1980s and 1990s had riskier observable characteristics than existing cardholders. Our calculations suggest that these new cardholders accounted for over 20% of the rise in bank credit card debt and delinquencies between 1989 and 1998.

10.1093/restud/rdw011.abstractZh: 金融创新是信用卡债务和破产现象增多的常见解释。为了评估这一现象，我们开发了一个简单的模型，该模型包含了两个关键摩擦：关于借款人违约风险的不对称信息，以及制定每份贷款合同所涉及的固定成本。能够缓解信息不对称或降低固定成本的创新措施，会通过引入针对风险更高的借款人的新贷款合同而带来巨大的扩展边际效应。这导致更多的违约和借款行为，同时使得利率的分散性增加。利用消费者金融调查数据和联邦储备委员会利率数据，我们发现这些预测得到了支持。具体来说，信用卡利率的分散性几乎增加了两倍，而20世纪80年代末和90年代的“新”持卡人具有比现有持卡人更危险的特征。我们的计算表明，在1989年至1998年间，这些新持卡人占银行信用卡债务和违约行为的增长比例的超过20%。

abstract.text: This article develops a dynamic model of retail competition and uses it to study the impact of the expansion of a new national competitor on the structure of urban markets. In order to accommodate substantial heterogeneity (both observed and unobserved) across agents and markets, the article first develops a general framework for estimating and solving dynamic discrete choice models in continuous time that is computationally light and readily applicable to dynamic games. In the proposed framework, players face a standard dynamic discrete choice problem at decision times that occur stochastically. The resulting stochastic-sequential structure naturally admits the use of conditional choice probability methods for estimation and makes it possible to compute counterfactual simulations for relatively high-dimensional games. The model and method are applied to the retail grocery industry, into which Walmart began rapidly expanding in the early 1990s, eventually attaining a dominant position. We find that Walmart's expansion into groceries came mostly at the expense of the large incumbent supermarket chains, rather than the single-store outlets that bore the brunt of its earlier conquest of the broader general merchandise sector. Instead, we find that independent grocers actually thrive when Walmart enters, leading to an overall reduction in market concentration. These competitive effects are strongest in larger markets and those into which Walmart expanded most rapidly, suggesting a diminishing role of scale and a greater emphasis on differentiation in this previously mature industry.

10.1093/restud/rdw012.abstractZh: 本文构建了一个动态零售竞争模型，用以研究新国家竞争对手的扩张对城市市场结构的影响。为了应对不同企业和市场的显著异质性（包括可观测和不可观测的异质性），文章首先提出了一个通用框架，用于估计和求解连续时间下的动态离散选择模型，该框架计算效率较高，且易于应用于动态博弈分析。在提出的框架中，决策时刻的玩家面临一个标准的动态离散选择问题，这些时刻是随机发生的。由此产生的随机序列结构自然允许使用条件选择概率方法进行估计，并使得对于高维博弈进行反事实模拟成为可能。该模型和方法被应用于零售杂货行业，沃尔玛在20世纪90年代初开始迅速扩张，最终占据了主导地位。我们发现，沃尔玛在杂货领域的扩张主要是以牺牲大型现有超市连锁企业的利益为代价的，而不是以那些在初期占据主导地位的单一店铺为代价。相反，我们发现当沃尔玛进入该行业时，独立经营的杂货店反而能够蓬勃发展，从而整体降低了市场集中度。这些竞争效应在规模较大的市场以及沃尔玛扩张最快的市场最为明显，这表明在这个已经成熟的行业中，规模的作用正在减弱，差异化的重要性正在上升。

abstract.text: This paper studies a model of long-term contracting for experimentation. We consider a principal–agent relationship with adverse selection on the agent’s ability, dynamic moral hazard, and private learning about project quality. We find that each of these elements plays an essential role in structuring dynamic incentives, and it is only their interaction that generally precludes efficiency. Our model permits an explicit characterization of optimal contracts.

10.1093/restud/rdw013.abstractZh: 本文研究了一个长期契约的模型。我们考虑了一种主体-代理关系，其中代理人的能力存在逆向选择问题，存在动态的道德风险，且代理人需要学习项目质量相关信息。我们发现，这些要素在构建动态激励机制中各自发挥着重要作用，而它们的相互作用才是通常导致效率低下的主要原因。我们的模型允许对最优契约进行明确描述。

abstract.text: We study trading dynamics in an asset market where the quality of assets is private information and finding a counterparty takes time. When trading ceases in equilibrium as a response to an adverse shock to asset quality, a government can resurrect trading by buying up lemons which involves a financial loss. The optimal policy is centred around an announcement effect where trading starts already before the intervention for two reasons. First, delaying the intervention allows selling pressure to build up thereby improving the average quality of assets for sale. Secondly, intervening at a higher price increases the return from buying an asset of unknown quality. It is optimal to intervene immediately at the lowest price when the market is sufficiently important. For less important markets, when the shock to quality and search frictions are small, it is optimal to rely on the announcement effect. Here delaying the intervention and fostering the effect by intervening at the highest price tend to be complements.

10.1093/restud/rdw014.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个资产市场的交易动态，其中资产的质量是私人信息，寻找交易对手需要时间。当市场因资产质量的负面冲击而停止交易时，政府可以通过收购劣质资产来恢复交易，但这会导致财务损失。最优政策围绕公告效应展开，因为干预在之前就开始了，原因有二：首先，延迟干预可以促使卖压加剧，从而提高待售资产的平均质量；其次，以更高的价格进行干预可以增加购买未知质量资产所带来的收益。对于重要性较低的市场，当质量冲击和搜索摩擦较小时，依靠公告效应是最优选择。在这里，延迟干预并以最高价格进行干预往往可以互补。

abstract.text: We study the relation between mechanism design and voting in public good provision. If incentive mechanisms must satisfy conditions of robust coalition-proofness as well as robust incentive compatibility, the participants' contributions to public good provision can only depend on the level of the public good that is provided and that level can only depend on the population shares of people favouring one level over another. For a public good that comes as a single indivisible unit the outcome depends on whether or not the share of votes in favour of provision exceeds a specified threshold. With more provision levels for the public good, more complicated mechanisms can be used but they still involve the counting of votes rather than any measurement of the participants' willingness to pay. The article thus provides a foundation for the use of voting mechanisms.

10.1093/restud/rdw015.abstractZh: 我们研究了机制设计与公共物品供给中的投票之间的关系。如果激励机制必须满足鲁棒联盟证明能力和鲁棒激励相容性的条件，那么参与者对公共物品供给的贡献只能取决于所提供的公共物品的水平，而这一水平又取决于支持某一水平的人占总人口的比例。对于以不可分割的单一单位形式存在的公共物品，结果取决于支持供给的投票份额是否超过一个特定的阈值。对于具有多个供给水平的公共物品，可以使用更复杂的机制，但这些机制仍然涉及投票的计数，而不是对参与者支付意愿的任何测量。因此，本文为投票机制的使用提供了基础。

abstract.text: Recent policy proposals have suggested taxing top incomes at very high rates on the grounds that some or all of the highest wage earners are engaged in socially unproductive or counterproductive activities, such as externality imposing speculation in the financial sector.To address this, we provide a model in which agents can choose between working in a traditional sector, where private and social products coincide, and a crowdable rent-seeking sector, where some or all of earned income reflects the capture of pre-existing output rather than increased production.We characterize Pareto optimal linear and non-linear income tax systems under the assumption that the social planner cannot or does not observe whether any given individual is a traditional worker or a rent-seeker.We find that optimal marginal taxes on the highest wage earners can remain remarkably modest even if all high earners are socially unproductive rent-seekers and the government has a strong intrinsic desire for progressive redistribution.Intuitively, taxing their effort at a lower rate stimulates their rent-seeking efforts, thereby keeping private returns for other potential rent-seekers low and discouraging further entry.

10.1093/restud/rdw017.abstractZh: 近期的一些政策建议提出对最高收入者征收非常高的税率，理由是一些或所有高收入者从事的是社会效率低下或反productive的活动，例如金融领域的投机行为。为了应对这一问题，我们提出了一个模型，其中个体可以在传统行业工作（该行业中的私人和社会产品是重合的）和一种可雇佣的寻租行业之间选择。在寻租行业中，部分或全部收入反映了对已有产出的占有，而非生产的增加。我们假设社会规划者无法或不会观察到任何个体是传统工人还是寻租者，从而描述了帕累托最优的线性和非线性所得税制度。我们发现，即使所有高收入者都是社会效率低的寻租者，且政府有强烈的进行渐进式再分配的意愿，对最高收入者的最优边际税率仍然可以保持相当低的水平。直观地说，以较低的税率对他们的努力征税可以刺激他们的寻租行为，从而保持其他潜在寻租者的私人回报较低，并抑制进一步的进入行为。

abstract.text: Voters commonly face a choice between competent candidates and those with policy preferences similar to their own. This article explores how electoral rules, such as district magnitude, mediate this trade-off and affect the composition of representative bodies and the quality of policy outcomes. We show formally that anticipation of bargaining over policy causes voters in elections with multiple single-member districts to prefer candidates with polarized policy positions over more competent candidates. Results from a unique field experiment in Afghanistan are consistent with these predictions. Specifically, representatives selected by elections with a single multi-member district are better educated and exhibit less extreme policy preferences.

10.1093/restud/rdw018.abstractZh: 选民通常需要在能力出众的候选人与政策偏好与自己相似的候选人之间做出选择。本文探讨了诸如选区规模等选举规则如何调节这种权衡，并影响代表机构的构成以及政策成果的质量。我们正式证明了，在多个单议席选区的选举中，由于预期存在政策上的讨价还价，选民更倾向于选择政策立场两极分化的候选人，而非能力更强的候选人。在阿富汗进行的一项独特实地实验的结果与这些预测一致。具体而言，在单多议席选区选举中当选的代表通常受教育程度更高，且政策偏好较为温和。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the role of inter-city transport costs in determining the income of sub-Saharan African cities. In particular, focusing on fifteen countries whose largest city is a port, I find that an oil price increase of the magnitude experienced between 2002 and 2008 induces the income of cities near that port to increase by 7 percent relative to otherwise identical cities 500 kilometers farther away. Combined with external estimates, this implies an elasticity of city economic activity with respect to transport costs of -0.28 at 500 kilometers from the port. Moreover, the effect differs by the surface of roads between cities. Cities connected to the port by paved roads are chiefly affected by transport costs to the port, while cities connected to the port by unpaved roads are more affected by connections to secondary centers.

10.1093/restud/rdw020.abstractZh: 本文探讨了城市间运输成本在决定撒哈拉以南非洲城市收入中的作用。具体而言，本文以十五个最大城市为港口的城市为例，发现2002至2008年间石油价格的上涨使得这些城市相对于距离港口500公里以外的其他城市，其收入增加了7%。结合外部估计数据，这一结果表明，城市经济活动对运输成本的弹性为-0.28，且这一弹性在距离港口500公里的范围内更为显著。此外，这种影响因城市间道路状况的不同而有所差异。通过铺设道路与港口相连的城市主要受到前往港口的运输成本的影响，而通过未铺设道路与港口相连的城市则更受与次级中心连接的影響。

abstract.text: Angus Deaton delivered his Prize Lecture on Tuesday 8 December 2015, at the Aula Magna, Stockholm University. These are the lecture slides.

10.1257/aer.106.6.1221.abstractZh: 安格斯·迪顿于2015年12月8日星期二在斯德哥尔摩大学的Aula Magna大厅发表了他的获奖演讲。以下是演讲的幻灯片内容。

abstract.text: We develop a dynamic multicountry general equilibrium model to investigate forces acting on the global economy during the Great Recession and ensuing recovery. Our multisector framework accounts completely for countries' trade, investment, production, and GDPs in terms of different sets of shocks. Applying the model to 21 countries, we investigate the 29 percent drop in world trade in manufactures during the period 2008–2009. A shift in final spending away from tradable sectors, largely caused by declines in durables investment efficiency, accounts for most of the collapse in trade relative to GDP. Shocks to trade frictions, productivity, and demand play minor roles. (JEL E3, F1, F4)

10.1257/aer.20101557.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个动态的多国一般均衡模型，以研究大衰退期间及随后的复苏过程中对全球经济的各种影响。我们的多部门框架能够全面考虑各国在贸易、投资、生产和GDP方面的表现，这些表现受到不同冲击的影响。将该模型应用于21个国家，我们研究了2008-2009年间全球制造业贸易下降29%的现象。最终支出的转移，主要是由于可贸易部门投资效率的下降，是导致贸易相对于GDP大幅下滑的主要原因。贸易摩擦、生产效率和需求方面的冲击则作用较小。（JEL E3, F1, F4）

abstract.text: We propose a summary statistic for the economic well-being of people in a country. Our measure incorporates consumption, leisure, mortality, and inequality, first for a narrow set of countries using detailed micro data, and then more broadly using multi-country datasets. While welfare is highly correlated with GDP per capita, deviations are often large. Western Europe looks considerably closer to the United States, emerging Asia has not caught up as much, and many developing countries are further behind. Each component we introduce plays a significant role in accounting for these differences, with mortality being most important. (JEL D63, E21, E23, E24, I12, O57)

10.1257/aer.20110236.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种用于衡量一个国家人民经济福祉的汇总指标。我们的指标涵盖了消费、休闲、死亡率和不平等性等因素，首先针对少数使用详细微观数据的国家进行了分析，随后则利用多国数据集进行了更广泛的评估。虽然福利与人均GDP高度相关，但两者之间的差距往往较大。西欧的福利水平与美国更为接近，而新兴亚洲国家的福利水平则尚未达到美国水平，许多发展中国家则远远落后。我们引入的每个组成部分都在解释这些差异中发挥着重要作用，其中死亡率最为关键。（JEL D63, E21, E23, E24, I12, O57）

abstract.text: This paper explores the combined effects of reductions in trade frictions, tariffs, and firing costs on firm dynamics, job turnover, and wage distributions. It uses establishment-level data from Colombia to estimate an open economy dynamic model that links trade to job flows and wages. Counterfactual experiments imply that Colombia's integration with global product markets increased its national income at the expense of higher unemployment, greater wage inequality, and increased firm-level volatility. In contrast, contemporaneous labor market reforms dampened the increase in unemployment and aggregate job turnover. The results speak more generally to the effects of globalization on labor markets. (JEL F13, F16, F66, J31, J63, O15, O19)

10.1257/aer.20110457.abstractZh: 本文探讨了贸易摩擦、关税和劳动力成本降低对企业动态、就业流动和工资分布的综合影响。通过利用哥伦比亚的企事业单位数据，本文构建了一个开放经济动态模型，将贸易与就业流动和工资联系起来。反事实实验表明，哥伦比亚融入全球产品市场虽然增加了国民收入，但代价是更高的失业率、更大的工资不平等以及企业层面的波动性增加。相比之下，同时进行的劳动力市场改革则抑制了失业率的上升和总体就业流动的增加。这些结果更普遍地反映了全球化对劳动力市场的影响。（JEL F13, F16, F66, J31, J63, O15, O19）

abstract.text: Does welfare improve when firms are better informed about the state of the economy and can thus better coordinate their production and pricing decisions? We address this question in an elementary business-cycle model that highlights how the dispersion of information can impede both kinds of decisions and, in this sense, be the source of both real and nominal rigidity. Within this context we develop a taxonomy for how the social value of information depends on the two rigidities, on the sources of the business cycle, and on the conduct of monetary policy. (JEL D21, D82, D83, E32, E52)

10.1257/aer.20110865.abstractZh: 当企业更了解经济状况，并能更好地协调生产和定价决策时，福利是否会改善？我们在一个简单的商业周期模型中探讨了这个问题，该模型强调了信息分散如何阻碍这两种决策，并因此成为实际和名义僵化的来源。在此背景下，我们提出了一种分类方法，用于说明信息的社会价值如何取决于这两种僵化、商业周期的来源以及货币政策的实施方式。（JEL D21, D82, D83, E32, E52）

abstract.text: This paper exploits deregulation in the 1990s to estimate viewership and revenue effects of consolidation in broadcast television, then finds cost effects that explain the ownership structure given viewership and revenue effects. Results suggest that consolidation greatly increased profitability in an industry with otherwise declining profitability. Groups with broader national coverage attract more advertising per station. Joint ownership of two stations within a market and network ownership both allow for significant cost savings. There is some evidence that within-market consolidation allows stations to achieve local market power. However, both within-market and across-market consolidation appear to have boosted viewership, on net. (JEL G32, L13, L25, L51, L82, L88)

10.1257/aer.20110948.abstractZh: 本文利用1990年代的去监管政策，估算了广播电视行业合并对观众数量和收入的影响。随后，通过成本分析解释了这些影响背后的原因。研究结果表明，在盈利能力普遍下降的行业中，合并显著提升了企业的盈利能力。拥有更广泛全国覆盖范围的集团能够吸引更多广告投放。在一个市场中同时拥有两家电台，以及网络所有权，都能带来显著的成本节约。有证据表明，市场内的合并有助于电台获得地方市场影响力。不过，无论是市场内的合并还是跨市场的合并，总体上都增加了观众数量。（JEL G32, L13, L25, L51, L82, L88）

abstract.text: We study optimal redistribution and insurance in a life-cycle economy with private idiosyncratic shocks. We characterize Pareto optima, show the forces determining optimal labor distortions, and derive closed form expressions for their limiting behavior. The labor distortions for high-productivity shocks are determined by the labor elasticity and the higher moments of the shock process; the labor distortions for low-productivity shocks are determined by the autocorrelation of the shock process, redistributive objectives, and past distortions. In a model calibrated using newly available estimates of idiosyncratic shocks, the labor distortions are U-shaped and the savings distortions generally increase in current earnings. (JEL D82, D91, H21, H23, I38, J22, J24)

10.1257/aer.20111550.abstractZh: 我们研究了在存在私人特异性冲击的生命周期经济中，最优再分配和保险问题。我们描述了帕累托最优解，阐明了决定最优劳动扭曲的因素，并推导出了这些扭曲的极限行为封闭形式表达式。对于高生产力冲击，劳动扭曲由劳动弹性以及冲击过程的更高阶矩决定；对于低生产力冲击，劳动扭曲则由冲击过程的自相关、再分配目标以及过去的扭曲决定。在一个使用新获得的特异性冲击估计值进行校准的模型中，劳动扭曲呈现U形分布，而储蓄扭曲通常随着当前收入的增加而增大。（JEL D82, D91, H21, H23, I38, J22, J24）

abstract.text: I use micro data to quantify key features of US firm financing. In particular, I establish that a substantial 35 percent of firms' investment is funded using financial markets. I then construct a dynamic equilibrium model that matches these features and fit the model to business cycle data using Bayesian methods. In the model, financial intermediaries enable trades of financial assets, directing funds toward investment opportunities, and charge an intermediation spread to cover their costs. According to the model estimation, exogenous shocks to the intermediation spread explain 25 percent of GDP and 30 percent of investment volatility. (JEL D22, D92, E32, G21, G31, G32)

10.1257/aer.20120079.abstractZh: 我使用微观数据来量化美国企业融资的关键特征。具体而言，我发现有高达35%的企业投资是通过金融市场获得的资金。随后，我构建了一个动态均衡模型，将这些特征与商业周期数据相结合，并使用贝叶斯方法对模型进行拟合。在模型中，金融中介机构负责金融资产的交易，将资金引导至投资机会，并收取中介费以覆盖其成本。根据模型估计，中介费的外生冲击可以解释25%的GDP和30%的投资波动。（JEL D22, D92, E32, G21, G31, G32）

abstract.text: We examine the pricing of financial crash insurance during the 2007–2009 financial crisis in US option markets, and we show that a large amount of aggregate tail risk is missing from the cost of financial sector crash insurance during the crisis. The difference in costs between out-of-the-money put options for individual banks and puts on the financial sector index increases four-fold from its precrisis 2003–2007 level. We provide evidence that a collective government guarantee for the financial sector lowers index put prices far more than those of individual banks and explains the increase in the basket-index put spread. (JEL E44, G01, G13, G21, G28, H81)

10.1257/aer.20120389.abstractZh: 我们研究了2007-2009年金融危机期间美国期权市场中金融崩溃保险的定价情况，发现金融危机期间金融部门崩溃保险的成本中缺失了大量的总体尾部风险。个别银行的虚值看跌期权与金融部门指数看跌期权的成本差异从2003-2007年危机前的水平增加了四倍。我们有证据表明，政府对金融部门的集体担保对金融部门指数看跌期权的定价影响远大于对个别银行的影响，这也解释了篮子指数看跌期权价差的增加。（JEL E44, G01, G13, G21, G28, H81）

abstract.text: I study the implications of two major debt-relief policies in the United States: the Bankruptcy Abuse Prevention and Consumer Protection Act (BAPCPA) and the Home Affordable Refinance Program (HARP). To do so, I develop a model of housing and default that includes relevant dimensions of credit-market policy and captures rich heterogeneity in household balance sheets. The model also explains the observed cross-state variation in consumer default rates. I find that BAPCPA significantly reduced bankruptcy rates, but increased foreclosure rates when house prices fell. HARP reduced foreclosures by 1 percentage point and provided substantial welfare gains to households with high loan-to-value mortgages. (JEL D14, K35, R31)

10.1257/aer.20120512.abstractZh: 我研究了美国两项主要债务缓解政策的影响：破产滥用预防与消费者保护法案（BAPCPA）和居家可负担融资计划（HARP）。为此，我建立了一个包含信贷市场政策相关维度的住房与违约模型，并捕捉了家庭资产负债表中的丰富异质性。该模型还解释了各州之间消费者违约率的差异。我发现，BAPCPA显著降低了破产率，但在房价下跌时增加了止赎率。HARP将止赎率降低了1个百分点，并为高贷款价值比抵押贷款的家庭带来了显著的福利收益。（JEL D14, K35, R31）

abstract.text: We propose a measure of systemic risk, Δ CoVaR, defined as the change in the value at risk of the financial system conditional on an institution being under distress relative to its median state. Our estimates show that characteristics such as leverage, size, maturity mismatch, and asset price booms significantly predict Δ CoVaR. We also provide out-of-sample forecasts of a countercyclical, forward-looking measure of systemic risk, and show that the 2006:IV value of this measure would have predicted more than one-third of realized Δ CoVaR during the 2007–2009 financial crisis. (JEL C58, E32, G01, G12, G17, G20, G32)

10.1257/aer.20120555.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种系统性风险的衡量指标，称为Δ CoVaR，其定义为在机构处于困境状态下，金融系统风险价值的变化，相对于其中位数状态而言。我们的估计显示，杠杆率、规模、期限错配以及资产价格泡沫等特征对Δ CoVaR有显著的预测作用。我们还提供了该系统性风险的反周期、前瞻性衡量指标的样本外预测，并表明在2007-2009年金融危机期间，该衡量指标的2006:IV值能够预测超过三分之一的实际Δ CoVaR值。（JEL C58, E32, G01, G12, G17, G20, G32）

abstract.text: This paper presents empirical evidence that the growth of export manufacturing in Mexico during a period of major trade reforms (the years 1986 to 2000) altered the distribution of education. I use variation in the timing of factory openings across commuting zones to show that school drop-out increased with local expansions in export-manufacturing industries. The magnitudes I find suggest that for every 25 jobs created, one student dropped out of school at grade 9 rather than continuing through to grade 12. These effects are driven by less-skilled export-manufacturing jobs which raised the opportunity cost of schooling for students at the margin. (JEL F14, F16, J24, L60, O14, O19)

10.1257/aer.20120901.abstractZh: 本文提供了实证证据，表明在重大贸易改革时期（1986年至2000年），墨西哥出口制造业的增长改变了教育分布。通过研究不同通勤区域工厂开业时间的差异，我们发现当地出口制造业扩张导致辍学率上升。我的研究发现表明，每创造25个就业岗位，就有1名学生从九年级辍学，而不是继续读到十二年级。这些效应主要由低技能出口制造业岗位引起，这提高了边际学生的教育机会成本。（JEL F14, F16, J24, L60, O14, O19）

abstract.text: The analysis of lab data entails a joint test of the underlying theory and of subjects' conjectures regarding the experimental design itself, how subjects frame the experiment. We provide a theoretical framework for analyzing such conjectures. We use experiments of decision making under uncertainty as a case study. Absent restrictions on subjects' framing of the experiment, we show that any behavior is consistent with standard updating (“anything goes”), including those suggestive of anomalies such as overconfidence, excess belief stickiness, etc. When the experimental protocol restricts subjects' conjectures (plausibly, by generating information during the experiment), standard updating has nontrivial testable implications. (JEL C91, D11, D81, D83)

10.1257/aer.20120978.abstractZh: 对实验室数据的分析需要对基础理论以及受试者对实验设计本身的假设进行联合检验，即受试者如何构建实验。我们为分析这些假设提供了一个理论框架。我们以不确定性下的决策实验作为案例研究。在没有限制受试者构建实验框架的情况下，我们表明任何行为都与标准更新机制一致（“任何结果均可”），包括那些表现出异常行为的现象，如过度自信、过度信念粘性等。当实验方案限制受试者的假设时（通过在实验过程中生成信息，这种限制是合理的），标准更新机制具有非平凡的可检验性。（JEL C91, D11, D81, D83）

abstract.text: The uncovered interest parity puzzle concerns the empirical regularity that high interest rate countries tend to have high expected returns on short term deposits. A separate puzzle is that high real interest rate countries tend to have currencies that are stronger than can be accounted for by the path of expected real interest differentials under uncovered interest parity. These two findings have apparently contradictory implications for the relationship of the foreign-exchange risk premium and interest-rate differentials. We document these puzzles, and show that existing models appear unable to account for both. A model that might reconcile the findings is discussed. (JEL E43, F31, G15)

10.1257/aer.20121365.abstractZh: 未覆盖的利率平价悖论涉及一个经验规律：高利率国家往往拥有较高的短期存款预期回报。另一个悖论是，高实际利率国家往往拥有比未覆盖利率平价下的预期实际利率差异路径所预期的更强的货币。这两个发现对外汇风险溢价与利率差异之间的关系有着看似矛盾的含义。我们记录了这些悖论，并表明现有模型似乎无法同时解释这两个现象。文中还讨论了一个可能调和这些发现的模型。（JEL E43, F31, G15）

abstract.text: We develop a quantitative equilibrium model of financial crises to assess the interaction between ex post interventions in credit markets and the buildup of risk ex ante. During a systemic crisis, bailouts relax balance sheet constraints and mitigate the severity of the recession. Ex ante, the anticipation of such bailouts leads to an increase in risk-taking, making the economy more vulnerable to a financial crisis. We find that moral hazard effects are limited if bailouts are systemic and broad-based. If bailouts are idiosyncratic and targeted, however, this makes the economy significantly more exposed to financial crises. (JEL E23, E32, E44, E63, G01, G21, G28)

10.1257/aer.20121524.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个量化均衡模型来研究金融危机，以评估信用市场中的事后干预与风险事前积累之间的相互作用。在系统性危机期间，救助措施会放松资产负债表约束，从而减轻经济衰退的严重程度。事前来看，对这类救助措施的预期会增加风险承担，使经济更容易受到金融危机的影响。我们发现，如果救助措施是系统性且广泛的，道德风险效应是有限的。然而，如果救助措施是特定且有针对性的，那么经济就会显著更容易受到金融危机的影响。（JEL E23, E32, E44, E63, G01, G21, G28）

abstract.text: Choice in public services is controversial. We exploit a reform in the English National Health Service to assess the effect of removing constraints on patient choice. We estimate a demand model that explicitly captures the removal of the choice constraints imposed on patients. We find that, post-removal, patients became more responsive to clinical quality. This led to a modest reduction in mortality and a substantial increase in patient welfare. The elasticity of demand faced by hospitals increased substantially post- reform and we find evidence that hospitals responded to the enhanced incentives by improving quality. This suggests greater choice can raise quality.

10.1257/aer.20121532.abstractZh: 公共服务中的选择问题颇具争议。我们以英国国民健康服务体系的一次改革为例，来评估取消对患者选择限制的影响。我们建立了一个需求模型，明确反映了取消对患者选择限制所带来的影响。研究发现，在限制取消后，患者对临床质量的响应度显著提高。这导致死亡率有所降低，同时患者的福利也得到了显著提升。改革后，医院面临的需求弹性显著增强，我们有证据表明，医院通过改善质量来应对这些增强的激励措施。这表明，更多的选择确实可以提高服务质量。

abstract.text: We examine the link between wage and consumption inequality using a life-cycle model incorporating consumption and family labor supply decisions. We derive analytical expressions for the dynamics of consumption, hours, and earnings of two earners in the presence of correlated wage shocks, nonseparability, progressive taxation, and asset accumulation. The model is estimated using panel data for hours, earnings, assets, and consumption. We focus on family labor supply as an insurance mechanism and find strong evidence of smoothing of permanent wage shocks. Once family labor supply, assets, and taxes are properly accounted for there is little evidence of additional insurance. (JEL D12, D14, D91, J22, J31)

10.1257/aer.20121549.abstractZh: 我们运用包含消费和家庭劳动力供给决策的生命周期模型，研究工资与消费不平等之间的联系。在存在相关工资冲击、非分离性、累进税制以及资产积累的情况下，我们推导出了消费、劳动时间和收入动态的分析表达式。该模型采用面板数据对劳动时间、收入、资产和消费进行了估计。我们将家庭劳动力供给视为一种保险机制，并发现其对永久性工资冲击具有显著的平滑作用。一旦家庭劳动力供给、资产和税收得到充分考虑，则几乎没有额外的保险作用。（JEL D12, D14, D91, J22, J31）

abstract.text: We show how size-contingent laws can be used to identify the equilibrium and welfare effects of labor regulation. Our framework incorporates such regulations into the Lucas (1978) model and applies it to France where many labor laws start to bind on firms with 50 or more employees. Using population data on firms between 1995 and 2007, we structurally estimate the key parameters of our model to construct counterfactual size, productivity, and welfare distributions. We find that the cost of these regulations is equivalent to that of a 2.3 percent variable tax on labor. In our baseline case with French levels of partial real wage inflexibility, welfare costs of the regulations are 3.4 percent of GDP ( falling to 1.3 percent if real wages were perfectly flexible downward). The main losers from the regulation are workers—and to a lesser extent, large firms—and the main winners are small firms. (JEL L11, L51, J8)

10.1257/aer.20130232.abstractZh: 我们展示了如何利用规模相关的法律来识别劳动监管的均衡效应和福利影响。我们的框架将此类监管纳入Lucas（1978）模型中，并应用于法国，那里许多劳动法规开始对拥有50名或以上员工的公司产生约束。利用1995年至2007年间关于公司的统计数据，我们结构性地估计了模型的关键参数，以构建反事实条件下的规模、生产率和福利分布。我们发现，这些监管的成本相当于2.3%的劳动力可变税。在法国部分实际工资刚性水平的基准情况下，监管带来的福利成本占GDP的3.4%（如果实际工资完全向下弹性，这一比例降至1.3%）。监管的主要受害者是工人——以及在较小程度上，大型公司——而主要受益者是小型公司。（JEL L11, L51, J8）

abstract.text: We examine the impact of a positive and policy-driven change in economic resources available in utero and during childhood. We focus on the introduction of the Food Stamp Program, which was rolled out across counties between 1961 and 1975. We use the Panel Study of Income Dynamics to assemble unique data linking family background and county of residence in early childhood to adult health and economic outcomes. Our findings indicate access to food stamps in childhood leads to a significant reduction in the incidence of metabolic syndrome and, for women, an increase in economic self-sufficiency. (JEL I12, I38, J24)

10.1257/aer.20130375.abstractZh: 我们研究了在胎儿期和儿童期可获得的经济资源发生积极且由政策驱动的变化所带来的影响。我们重点关注1961年至1975年间在全国范围内实施的食品券计划。我们利用收入动态面板研究数据，收集了将家庭背景与儿童时期的居住县与成年后的健康和经济成果联系起来的独特数据。我们的研究发现，儿童时期能够获取食品券显著降低了代谢综合征的发生率，并且对于女性而言，还提高了经济自给能力。（JEL I12, I38, J24）

abstract.text: Parameter learning strongly amplifies the impact of macroeconomic shocks on marginal utility when the representative agent has a preference for early resolution of uncertainty. This occurs as rational belief updating generates subjective long-run consumption risks. We consider general equilibrium models with unknown parameters governing either long-run economic growth, rare events, or model selection. Overall, parameter learning generates long-lasting, quantitatively significant additional macroeconomic risks that help explain standard asset pricing puzzles. (JEL C52, D83, E13, E32, G12)

10.1257/aer.20130392.abstractZh: 当代表性代理人倾向于尽早解决不确定性时，参数学习会显著增强宏观经济冲击对边际效用的影响。这是因为理性的信念更新产生了主观的长期消费风险。我们考虑了具有未知参数的一般均衡模型，这些参数可能控制长期经济增长、罕见事件或模型选择。总体而言，参数学习产生了持久且数量上显著的额外宏观经济风险，这些风险有助于解释标准的资产定价难题。（JEL C52, D83, E13, E32, G12）

abstract.text: We study the profit-maximizing price path of a monopolist selling a durable good to buyers who arrive over time and whose values for the good evolve stochastically. The setting is completely stationary with an infinite horizon. Contrary to the case with constant values, optimal prices fluctuate with time. We argue that consumers’ randomly changing values offer an explanation for temporary price reductions that are often observed in practice. (JEL D82)

10.1257/aer.20130564.abstractZh: 我们研究了垄断者对耐用商品进行销售时的利润最大化定价路径，这些商品由随时间到达的买家购买，其价值呈随机变化。该情境是完全静态的，且时间范围无限。与价值恒定的情况不同，最优价格会随时间波动。我们认为，消费者价值的随机变化可以解释实践中经常观察到的临时降价现象。（JEL D82）

abstract.text: We examine differences in minority science graduation rates among University of California campuses when racial preferences were in place. Less prepared minorities at higher ranked campuses had lower persistence rates in science and took longer to graduate. We estimate a model of students' college major choice where net returns of a science major differ across campuses and student preparation. We find less prepared minority students at top ranked campuses would have higher science graduation rates had they attended lower ranked campuses. Better matching of science students to universities by preparation and providing information about students' prospects in different major-university combinations could increase minority science graduation.

10.1257/aer.20130626.abstractZh: 我们研究了在种族偏好存在的情况下，加州大学各校区内少数族裔在科学专业毕业率上的差异。在排名较高的校区，准备不足的少数族裔在科学专业的持续学习率较低，毕业时间也较长。我们建立了一个学生专业选择模型，该模型考虑了不同校区和学生准备程度对科学专业净收益的影响。研究发现，如果准备不足的少数族裔学生就读于排名较低的校区，他们的科学专业毕业率可能会更高。通过根据学生的准备程度更好地匹配科学专业学生与大学，并提供关于不同专业与大学组合下学生前景的信息，可以提高少数族裔在科学专业的毕业率。

abstract.text: Many communities rely upon ostracism to enforce cooperation: if an individual shirks in one relationship, her innocent neighbors share information about her guilt in order to shun her, while continuing to cooperate among themselves. However, a strategic victim may herself prefer to shirk, rather than report her victimization truthfully. If guilty players are to be permanently ostracized, then such deviations are so tempting that cooperation in any relationship is bounded by what the partners could obtain through bilateral enforcement. Ostracism can improve upon bilateral enforcement if tempered by forgiveness, through which guilty players are eventually readmitted to cooperative society. (JEL C73, D83, D85, O17, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20130768.abstractZh: 许多社区依靠排斥制度来强制合作：如果一个个体在某一种关系中逃避责任，她的无辜邻居会分享有关她有罪的情報，以便排斥她，同时他们之间仍然能够继续合作。然而，有策略的受害者可能更愿意逃避责任，而不是如实报告自己的受害情况。如果有罪的参与者需要被永久排斥，那么这种偏差是如此诱人，以至于任何关系中的合作都受到双方通过双边强制所能获得的利益的限制。如果以宽容作为约束，排斥制度可以改进双边强制的效果，因为通过宽容，有罪的参与者最终可以被重新接纳到合作社会中。（JEL C73, D83, D85, O17, Z13）

abstract.text: We study choice over prescription insurance plans by the elderly using government administrative data to evaluate how these choices evolve over time. We find large "foregone savings" from not choosing the lowest cost plan that has grown over time. We develop a structural framework to decompose the changes in "foregone welfare" from inconsistent choices into choice set changes and choice function changes from a fixed choice set. We find that foregone welfare increases over time due primarily to changes in plan characteristics such as premiums and out-of-pocket costs; we estimate little learning at either the individual or cohort level.

10.1257/aer.20130778.abstractZh: 我们研究了老年人对处方药保险计划的选择，利用政府行政数据来评估这些选择随时间的变化情况。我们发现，不选择成本最低的保险计划所带来的“节省福利”随着时间的推移而显著增加。我们构建了一个结构框架，以分解由于选择不一致而导致的“节省福利”变化，将其分解为选择集的变化和固定选择集下的选择函数变化。我们发现，随着时间的推移，“节省福利”的增加主要源于保险计划特性如保费和自付费用的变化；在个体或群体层面，我们几乎没有观察到学习效应。

abstract.text: We study the short-term impact of Connecticut's Jobs First welfare reform experiment on women's labor supply and welfare participation decisions. A nonparametric optimizing model is shown to restrict the set of counterfactual choices compatible with each woman's actual choice. These revealed preference restrictions yield informative bounds on the frequency of several intensive and extensive margin responses to the experiment. We find that welfare reform induced many women to work but led some others to reduce their earnings in order to receive assistance. The bounds on this latter “ opt-in” effect imply that intensive margin labor supply responses are nontrivial. (JEL H23, H75, I38, J16, J22)

10.1257/aer.20130824.abstractZh: 我们研究了康涅狄格州“就业优先”福利改革实验对女性劳动力供给和福利参与决策的短期影响。一个非参数优化模型被证明能够限制与每位女性实际选择相兼容的反事实选择集合。这些揭示性偏好限制为实验中的几种密集型及粗放型边际响应频率提供了信息性界限。我们发现，福利改革促使许多女性开始工作，但也使一些女性为了获得援助而减少收入。这种“自愿参与”效应的界限表明，密集型边际劳动力供给响应并非微不足道。（JEL H23, H75, I38, J16, J22）

abstract.text: Does monitoring corrupt activities induce a sustained reduction in corruption? Using longitudinal data on audits of municipal governments in Puerto Rico, we show corruption is considerably lower in municipalities with timely audits—before elections. However, these municipalities do not exhibit decreased levels of corruption in subsequent audits, even while mayors in these benefit from higher reelection rates. Our results suggest that audits enable voters to select responsive but corruptible politicians to office. Audit programs must disseminate results when they are most relevant for voters—shortly before an election—and ensure that these programs are sustained, long-term commitments. (JEL D72, H83, K42, O17)

10.1257/aer.20130874.abstractZh: 监控腐败行为是否会导致腐败水平的持续下降？通过研究波多黎各市政政府审计的纵向数据，我们发现，在选举前及时进行审计的市政当局，腐败程度明显较低。然而，这些市政当局在后续的审计中腐败水平并未下降，尽管这些市政当局的市长能够因更高的连任率而受益。我们的研究结果表明，审计使选民能够选出反应迅速但可能腐败的政客。审计计划必须在对选民最相关的时刻——即选举前不久——公布结果，并确保这些计划能够长期持续实施。（JEL D72, H83, K42, O17）

abstract.text: We develop a tractable general equilibrium model that captures the interplay between nominal long-term corporate debt, inflation, and real aggregates. We show that unanticipated inflation changes the real burden of debt and, more significantly, leads to a debt overhang that distorts future investment and production decisions. For these effects to be both large and very persistent, it is essential that debt maturity exceeds one period. We also show that interest rate rules can help stabilize our economy. (JEL E12, E31, E44, E52, G01, G32, G35)

10.1257/aer.20130952.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个可行的通用均衡模型，该模型能够捕捉名义长期企业债务、通货膨胀和实际总量之间的相互作用。我们指出，未预期的通货膨胀变化会改变债务的实际负担，更重要的是，这会导致债务过剩，从而扭曲未来的投资和生产决策。为了使这些效应既显著又持久，债务到期时间必须超过一个周期。我们还表明，利率规则有助于稳定经济。（JEL E12, E31, E44, E52, G01, G32, G35）

abstract.text: Conventional wisdom has it that in the 1930s fiscal policy did not work because it was not tried. This paper shows that fiscal policy was tried in 1936. The veterans' bonus of 1936 paid 2 percent of GDP to 3.2 million veterans; the typical veteran received a payment equal to per capita income. Multiple sources, including a household consumption survey, show that veterans spent the majority of their bonus. Point estimates of the MPC are between 0.6 and 0.75. Spending was concentrated on cars and housing in particular. (JEL E21, E32, E62, N32, N42)

10.1257/aer.20130957.abstractZh: 传统观点认为，在20世纪30年代，财政政策并未发挥作用，因为当时并未尝试使用这一政策。本文表明，1936年确实尝试过财政政策。1936年的退伍军人奖金占GDP的2%，惠及320万退伍军人；每位退伍军人的奖金相当于人均收入。包括家庭消费调查在内的多个来源表明，退伍军人将大部分奖金用于消费。边际消费倾向的估计值在0.6到0.75之间。消费主要集中在汽车和住房上。（JEL E21, E32, E62, N32, N42）

abstract.text: We compare single round versus runoff elections under plurality rule, allowing for partly endogenous party formation. Under runoff elections, the number of political candidates is larger, but the influence of extremist voters on equilibrium policy, and hence policy volatility, is smaller because the bargaining power of the political extremes is reduced compared to single round elections. The predictions on the number of candidates and on policy volatility are confirmed by evidence from a regression discontinuity design in Italy, where cities above 15,000 inhabitants elect the mayor with a runoff system, while those below hold single round elections. (JEL C78, D72)

10.1257/aer.20131024.abstractZh: 我们比较了多数选举和决选选举在多数制规则下的情形，同时考虑了部分内生性的政党形成过程。在决选选举中，政治候选人的数量更多，但由于政治极端派别的议价能力相对减弱，极端选民对均衡政策的影响，以及政策波动性的影响也较小。关于候选人数和政策波动性的预测，通过意大利的回归不连续设计得到的证据得到了证实。在意大利，人口超过15,000的城市采用决选制来选举市长，而人口较少的城市则采用单一选举制。（JEL C78, D72）

abstract.text: Marijuana is the most common illicit drug with vocal advocates for legalization. Among other things, legalization would increase access and remove the stigma of illegality. Our model disentangles the role of access from preferences and shows that selection into access is not random. We find that traditional demand estimates are biased resulting in incorrect policy conclusions. If marijuana were legalized, those under 30 would see modest increases in use of 28 percent, while on average use would increase by 48 percent (to 19.4 percent). Tax policies are effective at curbing use, where Australia could raise AU$1 billion (and the United States US$12 billion). (JEL D12, H25, K14, K42)

10.1257/aer.20131032.abstractZh: 大麻是最常见的非法毒品，也有许多支持合法化的声音。合法化将增加获取途径，并消除非法性的负面标签。我们的模型区分了获取途径与偏好的关系，并表明获取途径的选择并非随机。我们发现，传统的需求估计存在偏差，导致政策结论不准确。如果大麻合法化，30岁以下人群的使用量将增加28%，而平均使用量将增加48%（至19.4%）。税收政策在遏制使用方面是有效的，澳大利亚可以通过税收获得10亿澳元，美国则可达120亿美元。（JEL D12, H25, K14, K42）

abstract.text: We study the effects of the adoption of new agricultural technologies on structural transformation. To guide empirical work, we present a simple model where the effect of agricultural productivity on industrial development depends on the factor-bias of technical change. We test the predictions of the model by studying the introduction of genetically engineered soybean seeds in Brazil, which had heterogeneous effects on agricultural productivity across areas with different soil and weather characteristics. We find that technical change in soy production was strongly labor-saving and led to industrial growth, as predicted by the model. (JEL J43, O13, O14, O33, Q15, Q16)

10.1257/aer.20131061.abstractZh: 我们研究了采用新的农业技术对结构转型的影响。为了指导实证研究，我们提出了一个简单模型，该模型表明农业生产力对工业发展的影响取决于技术变革的要素偏差。我们通过研究巴西引入转基因大豆种子的情况来测试该模型的预测结果，这一举措在不同土壤和天气条件的地区对农业生产力产生了不同的影响。我们发现，大豆生产的技术变革具有显著的劳动节约性，并促进了工业增长，这与模型的预测一致。（JEL J43, O13, O14, O33, Q15, Q16）

abstract.text: We consider how a firm dynamically allocates business among several suppliers to motivate them in a relational contract. The firm chooses one supplier who exerts private effort. Output is non-contractible, and each supplier observes only his own relationship with the principal. In this setting, allocation decisions constrain the transfers that can be promised to suppliers in equilibrium. Consequently, optimal allocation decisions condition on payoff-irrelevant past performance to make strong incentives credible. We construct a dynamic allocation rule that attains first-best whenever any allocation rule does. This allocation rule performs strictly better than any rule that depends only on payoff-relevant information. (JEL D21, D82, L14, L24)

10.1257/aer.20131082.abstractZh: 我们研究了企业如何动态地分配业务给多个供应商，以在关系合同中激励他们。企业选择一名投入私人努力的供应商。产出是非契约性的，每个供应商仅关注与委托人的关系。在这种环境下，分配决策限制了均衡状态下可以承诺给供应商的转让金额。因此，最优分配决策需要依赖于与收益无关的历史表现，才能确保激励机制的有效性。我们构建了一个动态分配规则，该规则在任何分配规则中都能达到最优效果。该分配规则的性能明显优于仅依赖于收益相关信息的规定规则。（JEL D21, D82, L14, L24）

abstract.text: We develop an empirical test for whether households understand or misperceive their marginal tax rate. Our identifying variation comes from the loss of the Child Tax Credit when a child turns 17. Using this age discontinuity, we find that despite this tax liability increase being lump-sum and predictable, households reduce their reported wage income upon discovering they have lost the credit. This finding suggests that households misinterpret at least part of this tax liability change as an increase in their marginal tax rate. This evidence supports the hypothesis that tax complexity can cause confusion and leads to unintended behavioral responses. (JEL D12, D14, H24, H31)

10.1257/aer.20131189.abstractZh: 我们开展了一项实证测试，以探讨家庭是否理解或误解了自身的边际税率。我们的识别差异源于当孩子年满17岁时儿童税收抵免的丧失。利用这一年龄不连续性，我们发现尽管这种税收责任的增加是固定且可预测的，但家庭在发现自己失去了税收抵免后，会减少其报告的工资收入。这一发现表明，家庭至少将这种税收责任的变化误解为边际税率的增加。这些证据支持了这样一个假设：税收的复杂性可能导致混乱，并引发非预期的行为反应。（JEL D12, D14, H24, H31）

abstract.text: We explore the consequences of ethnic partitioning, a neglected aspect of the Scramble for Africa, and uncover the following. First, apart from the land mass and water bodies, split and non-split groups are similar across several dimensions. Second, the incidence, severity, and duration of political violence are all higher for partitioned homelands which also experience frequent military interventions from neighboring countries. Third, split groups are often entangled in a vicious circle of government-led discrimination and ethnic wars. Fourth, respondents from survey data identifying with split ethnicities are economically disadvantaged. The evidence highlights the detrimental repercussions of the colonial border design. (JEL D72, D74, F51, J15, O15, O17, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20131311.abstractZh: 我们探讨了种族划分的后果，这一因素在争夺非洲的进程中被忽视了。研究发现，除了陆地面积和水域外，分裂与未分裂的群体在多个维度上具有相似性。其次，政治暴力的发生频率、严重程度和持续时间在那些被划分的家园中更为严重，而且这些地区还经常受到邻国的军事干预。第三，分裂的群体往往陷入政府主导的歧视与种族战争之间的恶性循环。第四，从调查数据中可以看出，认同分裂种族的受访者在经济上处于劣势。这些证据凸显了殖民时期边界设计带来的负面后果。（JEL D72, D74, F51, J15, O15, O17, Z13）

abstract.text: We provide an explanation for the large spatial wage disparities and low male migration in India based on the trade-off between consumption smoothing, provided by caste-based rural insurance networks, and the income gains from migration. Our theory generates two key empirically verified predictions: (i) males in relatively wealthy households within a caste who benefit less from the redistributive (surplus-maximizing) network will be more likely to migrate, and (ii) males in households facing greater rural income risk (who benefit more from the insurance network) migrate less. Structural estimates show that small improvements in formal insurance decrease the spatial misallocation of labor by substantially increasing migration. (JEL G22, J31, J61, O15, O18, R23, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20131365.abstractZh: 我们基于消费平滑与迁移带来的收入收益之间的权衡，对印度巨大的空间工资差异和男性迁移率低的现象进行了解释。我们的理论提出了两个经实证验证的关键预测：(i) 在相对富裕的家族中，那些从再分配网络中获得较少利益的男性更有可能迁移；(ii) 面临更大农村收入风险的家庭中的男性（从保险网络中获得更多利益）迁移的可能性较小。结构估计表明，小型正式保险制度的改进可以通过大幅增加迁移量来减少劳动力的空间分配不均。(JEL G22, J31, J61, O15, O18, R23, Z13)

abstract.text: We study household decisions to acquire energy-using assets in the presence of rising incomes. We develop a theoretical framework to characterize the effect of income growth on asset purchases when consumers face credit constraints. We use large and plausibly exogenous shocks to household income generated by the conditional-cash-transfer program in Mexico, Oportunidades, to show that asset acquisition is nonlinear, depends, as predicted in the presence of credit constraints, on the pace of income growth, and both effects are economically large among beneficiaries. Our results may help explain important worldwide trends in the relationship between energy use and income growth. (JEL D12, I32, I38, O12, O13, Q47)

10.1257/aer.20131455.abstractZh: 我们研究了在收入增长的情况下，家庭对能源使用资产购置的决策。我们建立了一个理论框架，以描述在消费者面临信贷约束的情况下，收入增长对资产购买的影响。我们通过墨西哥的“Oportunidades”条件性现金转移计划所产生的大规模且看似外生的家庭收入冲击，表明资产购置是非线性的，并且如信贷约束存在时预测的那样，取决于收入增长的速度。这两种效应在受益者中都具有较大的经济影响。我们的研究结果可能有助于解释全球范围内能源使用与收入增长关系的重要趋势。（JEL D12, I32, I38, O12, O13, Q47）

abstract.text: Lincoln's election produced Southern secession, war, and abolition. Using a new dataset on slave sales, we examine connections between news and slave prices for the period 1856–1861. By August 1861, slave prices had declined by roughly one-third from their 1860 peak. That decline was similar for all age and sex cohorts and thus did not reflect expected emancipation without compensation. The decision to secede reflected beliefs that the North would not invade and that emancipation without compensation was unlikely. Both were encouraged by Lincoln's conciliatory tone before the attack on Fort Sumter, and subsequently dashed by Lincoln's willingness to wage all-out war. (JEL D72, D74, D83, G14, H77, N31, N41)

10.1257/aer.20131483.abstractZh: 林肯的当选导致了南方的分离、战争以及废奴运动。通过一个新的关于奴隶买卖的数据集，我们研究了1856年至1861年期间新闻与奴隶价格之间的关系。到1861年8月，奴隶价格较1860年的峰值下降了大约三分之一。这一下降在所有年龄和性别的奴隶群体中都存在，因此并不反映预期中的无补偿解放。南方决定分离是基于这样的信念：北方不会发动入侵，而且无补偿的解放是不太可能的。林肯在攻击萨姆特堡之前表现出的和解态度，以及随后他愿意发动全面战争的态度，都进一步强化了这些信念。（JEL D72, D74, D83, G14, H77, N31, N41）

abstract.text: We show that after monetary policy announcements, the conditional volatility of stock market returns rises more for firms with stickier prices than for firms with more flexible prices. This differential reaction is economically large and strikingly robust to a broad array of checks. These results suggest that menu costs—broadly defined to include physical costs of price adjustment, informational frictions, etc.—are an important factor for nominal price rigidity at the micro level. We also show that our empirical results are qualitatively and, under plausible calibrations, quantitatively consistent with New Keynesian macroeconomic models in which firms have heterogeneous price stickiness. (JEL E12, E31, E43, E44, E52, G12, L11)

10.1257/aer.20131513.abstractZh: 我们指出，在货币政策公告发布后，价格刚性较高的企业，其股市回报的条件波动性比价格弹性较大的企业更为显著上升。这种差异在经济学上具有重要意义，并且能够经受住多种检验的验证。这些结果表明，菜单成本——广义上包括价格调整的物理成本、信息摩擦等——是微观层面名义价格刚性的重要因素。此外，我们的实证结果在定性上以及与新凯恩斯主义宏观经济模型在定量上都是一致的，该模型认为企业的价格刚性存在异质性。（JEL E12, E31, E43, E44, E52, G12, L11）

abstract.text: This paper links the sharp drop in US manufacturing employment after 2000 to a change in US trade policy that eliminated potential tariff increases on Chinese imports. Industries more exposed to the change experience greater employment loss, increased imports from China, and higher entry by US importers and foreign-owned Chinese exporters. At the plant level, shifts toward less labor-intensive production and exposure to the policy via input-output linkages also contribute to the decline in employment. Results are robust to other potential explanations of employment loss, and there is no similar reaction in the European Union, where policy did not change. (JEL D72, E24, F13, F16, L24, L60, P33)

10.1257/aer.20131578.abstractZh: 本文将2000年后美国制造业就业的急剧下降与美国贸易政策的变化联系起来，该政策取消了对中国进口商品的潜在关税增加。那些更容易受到这一政策影响的行业，经历了更大的就业损失，从中国进口的商品数量增加，以及美国进口商和外国拥有的中国出口商进入该行业的规模扩大。在工厂层面，转向劳动密集型程度较低的生产方式，以及通过投入产出关系受到该政策的影响，也导致了就业数量的下降。研究结果对其他可能的就业损失原因具有稳健性，而在政策没有变化的欧盟地区，并未出现类似的反应。（JEL D72, E24, F13, F16, L24, L60, P33）

abstract.text: We study the gains from increased wage flexibility using a small open economy model with staggered price and wage setting. Two results stand out: (i) the effectiveness of labor cost reductions as a means to stimulate employment is much smaller in a currency union, and (ii) an increase in wage flexibility often reduces welfare, more likely so in an economy that is part of a currency union or with an exchange-rate-focused monetary policy. Our findings call into question the common view that wage flexibility is particularly desirable in a currency union. (JEL E12, E24, E52, E63, F31, F33, F41)

10.1257/aer.20131658.abstractZh: 我们研究通过增加工资灵活性所带来的收益，采用了一个小型开放经济模型，该模型具有错开的价格和工资设定。有两个结果非常突出：(i)在货币联盟中，降低劳动力成本作为刺激就业的手段的效果要小得多；(ii)增加工资灵活性通常会降低福利，在属于货币联盟的经济体或采用汇率导向的货币政策的经济体中，这种情况更为常见。我们的发现对“在货币联盟中，工资灵活性特别值得追求”这一普遍观点提出了质疑。(JEL E12, E24, E52, E63, F31, F33, F41)

abstract.text: China has defied the declining trend in domestic content in exports in many countries. This paper studies China's rising domestic content in exports using firm- and customs transaction-level data. The approach embraces firm heterogeneity and hence reduces aggregation bias. The study finds that the substitution of domestic for imported materials by individual processing exporters caused China's domestic content in exports to increase from 65 to 70 percent in the period 2000–2007. Such substitution was induced by the country's trade and investment liberalization, which deepened its engagement in global value chains and led to a greater variety of domestic materials becoming available at lower prices. (JEL F13, F14, L14, O19, O24, P31, P33)

10.1257/aer.20131687.abstractZh: 中国在出口产品中国内成分占比下降的趋势中取得了逆袭。本文利用企业及海关交易层面的数据，研究了中国出口产品中国内成分占比的上升情况。该方法考虑了企业的异质性，从而减少了汇总偏差。研究发现，从2000年到2007年期间，由于个别加工出口商对进口材料的替代，中国的出口产品中国内成分占比从65%上升到了70%。这种替代现象是由国家的贸易和投资自由化政策引发的，这些政策加深了中国的全球价值链参与程度，使得更多种类的国内材料能够以更低的价格获得。（JEL F13, F14, L14, O19, O24, P31, P33）

abstract.text: From 1980 to 2000, the rise in the US college/high school graduate wage gap coincided with increased geographic sorting as college graduates concentrated in high wage, high rent cities. This paper estimates a structural spatial equilibrium model to determine causes and welfare consequences of this increased skill sorting. While local labor demand changes fundamentally caused the increased skill sorting, it was further fueled by endogenous increases in amenities within higher skill cities. Changes in cities' wages, rents, and endogenous amenities increased inequality between high school and college graduates by more than suggested by the increase in the college wage gap alone. (JEL D31, I26, J24, J31, J61, R23)

10.1257/aer.20131706.abstractZh: 从1980年到2000年，美国大学/高中毕业生工资差距的扩大与地理分布的变化同步发生，因为大学毕业生更多地集中在高工资、高租金的城市。本文通过构建一个结构性空间均衡模型，来探讨这种技能分布变化的原因及其对社会的福利影响。虽然局部劳动力需求的根本变化是导致技能分布变化的主要原因，但更高技能城市内部生活便利性的内生性增加也进一步推动了这一变化。城市工资、租金以及生活便利性的变化，使得高中毕业生与大学毕业生之间的不平等程度超过了单纯大学毕业生工资差距扩大的影响。（JEL D31, I26, J24, J31, J61, R23）

abstract.text: The old age provisions of the Medicaid program were designed to insure retirees against medical expenses. We estimate a structural model of savings and medical spending and use it to compute the distribution of lifetime Medicaid transfers and Medicaid valuations across currently single retirees. Compensating variation calculations indicate that current retirees value Medicaid insurance at more than its actuarial cost, but that most would value an expansion of the current Medicaid program at less than its cost. These findings suggest that for current single retirees, the Medicaid program may be of the approximately right size.

10.1257/aer.20140015.abstractZh: Medicaid计划中的老年保障条款旨在为退休人员提供医疗费用的保险。我们建立了一个储蓄与医疗支出的结构模型，并利用该模型来计算当前单身退休人员一生中获得的Medicaid补助以及Medicaid资产的价值分配。补偿变化的计算表明，当前的退休人员认为Medicaid保险的价值高于其精算成本，但大多数人认为扩大当前的Medicaid计划所带来的收益低于其成本。这些发现表明，对于当前的单身退休人员来说，Medicaid计划的规模可能较为合适。

abstract.text: Credit record panel data from 1999–2010 indicates that the likelihood of home equity extraction (borrowing, on average, about $40,000 against one's home) peaked in 2003 when mortgage rates reached historic lows. We estimate a 27 percent rise in extraction in response to a 100 basis point rate decline, and that house price growth amplifies this relationship. Differential responses to interest rates and home price appreciation by borrower age and credit score provide new evidence of financial frictions. Finally, equity extractions are associated with higher default risk, consistent with the use of borrowed funds for consumption or illiquid investment. (JEL D14, E43, E52, G12, R31)

10.1257/aer.20140040.abstractZh: 1999至2010年的信用记录面板数据表明，家庭房产抵押借款（平均约40,000美元）的可能性在2003年达到顶峰，当时抵押贷款利率降至历史最低水平。我们估计，利率下降100个基点会导致提取房产抵押款的可能性增加27%，而房价上涨会进一步加剧这种关系。不同年龄和信用评分的借款人对利率和房价上涨的反应差异，为金融摩擦提供了新的证据。最后，提取房产抵押款与更高的违约风险相关，这与将借款资金用于消费或非流动性投资的行为一致。（JEL D14, E43, E52, G12, R31）

abstract.text: This paper investigates the evolutionary foundation for our ability to attribute preferences to others, an ability that is central to conventional game theory. We argue here that learning others' preferences allows individuals to efficiently modify their behavior in strategic environments with a persistent element of novelty. Agents with the ability to learn have a sharp, unambiguous advantage over those who are less sophisticated because the former agents extrapolate to novel circumstances information about opponents' preferences that was learned previously. This advantage holds even with a suitably small cost to reflect the additional cognitive complexity involved. (JEL C73, D11, D83)

10.1257/aer.20140105.abstractZh: 本文探讨了我们能够将偏好归因于他人的能力背后的进化基础，这一能力是传统博弈论的核心。我们认为，了解他人的偏好使得个体能够在具有持续新颖性的战略环境中有效调整自己的行为。具有学习能力的个体比那些能力较弱的个体拥有明显的优势，因为前者能够将之前学到的关于对手偏好的信息应用到新的情境中。这种优势即使伴随着一定的认知复杂性成本，仍然具有重要意义。（JEL C73, D11, D83）

abstract.text: To what extent can an incumbent manufacturer use discount contracts to foreclose efficient entry? We show that off-list-price rebates that do not commit buyers to unconditional transfers—like the rebates in EU Commission v. Michelin II, for instance—cannot be anticompetitive. This is true even in the presence of cost uncertainty, scale economies, or intense downstream competition, all three market settings where exclusion has been shown to emerge with exclusive dealing contracts. The difference stems from the fact that, unlike exclusive dealing provisions, rebates do not contractually commit retailers to exclusivity when signing the contract. (JEL D43, D86, K21, L13, L14, L42, L60)

10.1257/aer.20140131.abstractZh: 在多大程度上，现有制造商可以利用折扣合同来阻止有效的新进入者？我们指出，那些不要求买家无条件转让的场外价格回扣——例如欧盟委员会诉米其林案中的回扣——并不具有反竞争性质。即使在成本不确定、规模经济或激烈的下游竞争的情况下，这种情况仍然成立。在这三种市场环境中，排他性交易合同确实会导致排他性行为的出现。这种差异源于一个事实：与排他性交易条款不同，回扣并不通过合同约束零售商在签署合同时承诺排他性。（JEL D43, D86, K21, L13, L14, L42, L60）

abstract.text: What determines risk-bearing capacity and the amount of leverage in financial markets? Using unique archival data on collateralized lending, we show that personal experience can affect individual risk-taking and aggregate leverage. When an investor syndicate speculating in Amsterdam in 1772 went bankrupt, many lenders were exposed. In the end, none of them actually lost money. Nonetheless, only those at risk of losing money changed their behavior markedly; they lent with much higher haircuts. The rest continued largely as before. The differential change is remarkable since the distress was public knowledge. Overall leverage in the Amsterdam stock market declined as a result. (JEL D12, D14, D83, G11, G21)

10.1257/aer.20140259.abstractZh: 什么决定了金融市场的风险承担能力和杠杆率？通过独特的抵押借贷档案数据，我们发现个人经验会影响个体的风险承担行为以及整体杠杆率。1772年，在阿姆斯特丹进行投机活动的投资者财团破产时，许多贷款机构都受到了影响。最终，没有一家贷款机构真正损失了资金。然而，只有那些面临资金损失风险的人改变了行为，他们要求的贷款利息率大幅上升。其余的贷款机构则基本保持原状。这种差异性的变化非常显著，因为这场危机是公开已知的。结果，阿姆斯特丹股市的整体杠杆率有所下降。（JEL D12, D14, D83, G11, G21）

abstract.text: A large body of research has investigated whether physicians overuse care. There is less evidence on whether, for a fixed level of spending, doctors allocate resources to patients with the highest expected returns. We assess both sources of inefficiency, exploiting variation in rates of negative imaging tests for pulmonary embolism. We document enormous across-doctor heterogeneity in testing conditional on patient population, which explains the negative relationship between physicians' testing rates and test yields. Furthermore, doctors do not target testing to the highest risk patients, reducing test yields by one-third. Our calibration suggests misallocation is more costly than overuse.

10.1257/aer.20140260.abstractZh: 大量研究探讨了医生是否过度使用医疗服务。关于在固定支出水平下，医生是否会将资源分配给预期回报最高的患者，目前的证据较少。我们通过分析肺栓塞阴性影像检查率的差异，来评估这两种低效现象。我们发现，在不同患者群体中，医生进行检查的方式存在巨大差异，这解释了医生检查率与检查效果之间的负相关关系。此外，医生并未将检查重点放在风险最高的患者身上，导致检查效果降低了三分之一。我们的分析表明，资源分配不当造成的损失比过度使用医疗服务更为严重。

abstract.text: We investigate the role of macroprudential policies in mitigating liquidity traps. When constrained households engage in deleveraging, the interest rate needs to fall to induce unconstrained households to pick up the decline in aggregate demand. If the fall in the interest rate is limited by the zero lower bound, aggregate demand is insufficient and the economy enters a liquidity trap. In this environment, households' ex ante leverage and insurance decisions are associated with aggregate demand externalities. Welfare can be improved with macroprudential policies targeted toward reducing leverage. Interest rate policy is inferior to macroprudential policies in dealing with excessive leverage. (JEL D14, E23, E32, E43, E52, E61, E62)

10.1257/aer.20140289.abstractZh: 我们研究了宏观审慎政策在缓解流动性陷阱中的作用。当受限家庭进行去杠杆化时，利率需要下降以促使不受限家庭吸收整体需求的下降。如果利率的下降受到零下限的约束，整体需求就会不足，经济就会陷入流动性陷阱。在这种情况下，家庭的先验杠杆率和保险决策与整体需求的外部性相关。通过针对减少杠杆的宏观审慎政策，可以改善福利状况。在处理过度杠杆问题时，利率政策不如宏观审慎政策有效。（JEL D14, E23, E32, E43, E52, E61, E62）

abstract.text: Anthropologists have documented substantial and persistent differences in food preferences across social groups. My paper asks whether such food cultures can constrain caloric intake? I first document that interstate migrants within India consume fewer calories per rupee of food expenditure compared to their neighbors. Second, I show that migrants bring their origin-state food preferences with them. Third, I link these findings by showing that the gap in caloric intake between locals and migrants depends on the suitability and intensity of the migrants' origin-state preferences. The most affected migrants would consume seven percent more calories if they possessed their neighbors' preferences. (JEL D12, I12, O15, R23, Z12, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20140297.abstractZh: 人类学家已经记录了不同社会群体在食物偏好上的显著且持续性的差异。我的论文探讨了这样的食物文化是否会对热量摄入产生限制。首先，我指出印度境内的跨州移民在每卢比食物支出下所消耗的热量比他们的邻国移民要少。其次，我证明了移民会带着他们原籍地的食物偏好一同迁移。第三，我通过研究发现，当地人与移民之间在热量摄入上的差异取决于移民原籍地食物偏好的适宜性和强度。受影响最严重的移民，如果拥有与邻国移民相同的食物偏好，其热量摄入将增加7%。（JEL D12, I12, O15, R23, Z12, Z13）

abstract.text: This paper uses data from the American Mathematics Competitions to examine the rates at which different high schools produce high-achieving math students. There are large differences in the frequency with which students from seemingly similar schools reach high achievement levels. The distribution of unexplained school effects includes a thick tail of schools that produce many more high-achieving students than is typical. Several additional analyses suggest that the differences are not primarily due to unobserved differences in student characteristics. The differences are persistent across time, suggesting that differences in the effectiveness of educational programs are not primarily due to direct peer effects. (JEL H75, I21, I24, I28, R23)

10.1257/aer.20140308.abstractZh: 本文利用美国数学竞赛的数据，研究了不同高中培养高成就数学学生的效率。来自看似相似学校的学生在达到高成就水平方面的频率存在巨大差异。未解释的学校效应分布中，有一些学校培养出高成就学生的数量远超平均水平。进一步的分析表明，这些差异并非主要源于学生特征的未观测差异。这些差异在时间上持续存在，说明教育项目的有效性差异并非主要由直接的同伴效应造成。（JEL H75, I21, I24, I28, R23）

abstract.text: An organization must select among competing projects that differ in their payoff consequences for its members. Each agent chooses a project and exerts effort affecting its completion time. When one or more projects are complete, the agents select which one to adopt. The selection rule for multiple projects that maximizes ex post welfare leads to inefficiently high polarization; rules that favor later proposals improve upon ex post optimal selections. The optimal degree of favoritism increases in the cost of effort and discount rate. This trade-off informs the design of process rules in standard-setting organizations and helps explain their performance. (JEL C78, D23, D71, D72, D83, L15)

10.1257/aer.20140316.abstractZh: 一个组织必须在不同项目之间做出选择，这些项目对成员来说有着不同的收益后果。每个成员都会选择一个项目并付出相应的努力以影响项目的完成时间。当一个或多个项目完成之后，成员们会选择要采纳哪个项目。对于多个项目而言，最大化事后福利的选择规则会导致效率低下且极端的极化现象；而倾向于较晚提出的提案的规则则能改善事后最优选择。随着努力成本的增加和折现率的提高，最优的偏袒程度也会上升。这种权衡有助于设计标准制定组织中的流程规则，并有助于解释这些组织的表现。（JEL C78, D23, D71, D72, D83, L15）

abstract.text: Understanding how prior outcomes affect risk attitudes is critical for the study of choice under uncertainty. A large literature documents the significant influence of prior losses on risk attitudes. The findings appear contradictory: some studies find greater risk-taking after a loss, whereas others show the opposite—that people take on less risk. I reconcile these seemingly inconsistent findings by distinguishing between realized versus paper losses. Using new and existing data, I replicate prior findings and demonstrate that following a realized loss, individuals avoid risk; if the same loss is not realized, a paper loss, individuals take on greater risk. (JEL D11, D14, D81, G11)

10.1257/aer.20140386.abstractZh: 理解先前的结果如何影响风险态度，对于在不确定性下的选择研究至关重要。大量文献表明，之前的损失对风险态度有着显著的影响。研究结果似乎存在矛盾：一些研究发现在遭受损失后，人们更倾向于冒险；而另一些研究则表明人们会减少风险。我通过区分实际损失和虚拟损失来调和这些看似矛盾的研究结果。利用新的和现有的数据，我重新验证了先前的研究结果，并发现：在遭受实际损失后，人们会避免风险；如果同样的损失没有发生，即只是虚拟损失，人们则会承担更大的风险。（JEL D11, D14, D81, G11）

abstract.text: We estimate the effects of electricity shortages on Indian manufacturers, instrumenting with supply shifts from hydroelectric power availability.
