We estimate that India's average reported level of shortages reduces the average plant's revenues and producer surplus by 5 to 10 percent, but average productivity losses are significantly smaller because most inputs can be stored during outages. Shortages distort the plant size distribution, as there are significant economies of scale in generator costs and shortages more severely affect plants without generators. Simulations show that offering interruptible retail electricity contracts could substantially reduce the impacts of shortages. (JEL D24, L60, L94, O13, O14, Q41)

10.1257/aer.20140389.abstractZh: 我们估算了电力短缺对印度制造商的影响，通过水电供应变化的指标来量化这些影响。我们估计，印度平均报告的电力短缺情况会使平均工厂的收入和生产者剩余减少5%到10%，但由于大多数投入可以在停电期间储存，平均生产力损失要小得多。电力短缺还会扭曲工厂规模分布，因为发电机的成本存在显著的规模经济效应，而缺乏发电机的工厂受到的影响更为严重。模拟结果显示，提供可中断的零售电力合同可以显著减少电力短缺带来的负面影响。（JEL D24, L60, L94, O13, O14, Q41）

abstract.text: We study the effect of financial resources on decision-making. Low-income U.S. households are randomly assigned to receive an online survey before or after payday. The survey collects measures of cognitive function and administers risk and intertemporal choice tasks. The study design generates variation in cash, checking and savings balances, and expenditures. Before-payday participants behave as if they are more present-biased when making intertemporal choices about monetary rewards but not when making intertemporal choices about non-monetary real-effort tasks. Nor do we find before-after differences in risk-taking, the quality of decision-making, the performance in cognitive function tasks, or in heuristic judgments.

10.1257/aer.20140481.abstractZh: 我们研究了财务资源对决策的影响。美国低收入家庭被随机分配在发薪日前或发薪日后进行在线调查。调查收集了认知功能的测量数据，并进行了风险和跨时选择任务。研究设计使得现金、支票和储蓄余额以及支出存在差异。发薪日前参与者的跨时选择行为似乎更倾向于考虑当前的收益，但在非货币性实际任务中则没有这种倾向。此外，我们也没有发现发薪日前与发薪日后在风险承担、决策质量、认知功能任务表现以及启发式判断方面存在显著差异。

abstract.text: We prove that the ratio of kurtosis to the frequency of price changes is a sufficient statistic for the real effects of monetary shocks, measured by the cumulated output response following the shock. The sufficient statistic result holds in a large class of models which includes Taylor (1980); Calvo (1983); Reis (2006 ); Golosov and Lucas (2007 ); Nakamura and Steinsson (2010); Midrigan (2011); and Alvarez and Lippi (2014). Several models in this class are able to account for the positive excess kurtosis of the size distribution of price changes that appears in the data. We review empirical measures of kurtosis and frequency and conclude that a model that successfully matches the microevidence on kurtosis and frequency produces real effects that are about four times larger than in the Golosov-Lucas model, and about 30 percent below those of the Calvo model. We discuss the robustness of our results to changes in the setup, including small inflation and leptokurtic cost shocks. (JEL, E23, E31)

10.1257/aer.20140500.abstractZh: 我们证明了，峰度与价格变化频率之比是一个充分统计量，可以用来衡量货币冲击的真实影响，这一影响通过冲击后累计产出反应来衡量。这一充分统计量结果适用于包括Taylor（1980）、Calvo（1983）、Reis（2006）、Golosov和Lucas（2007）、Nakamura和Steinsson（2010）、Midrigan（2011）以及Alvarez和Lippi（2014）在内的许多模型。这些模型能够解释数据中价格变化大小分布的积极超额峰度现象。我们回顾了峰度和频率的实证测量方法，并得出结论：能够成功匹配峰度和频率微观证据的模型所呈现的真实影响，比Golosov-Lucas模型中的影响大约高出四倍，且比Calvo模型中的影响低约30%。我们还讨论了我们的结果在参数设置变化时的稳健性，包括小幅通货膨胀和尖峰厚尾的成本冲击。（JEL, E23, E31）

abstract.text: We estimate the long-run impact of cash transfers to poor families on children's longevity, educational attainment, nutritional status, and income in adulthood. To do so, we collected individual-level administrative records of applicants to the Mothers' Pension program-the first government-sponsored welfare program in the United States (1911-1935)-and matched them to census, WWII, and death records. Male children of accepted applicants lived one year longer than those of rejected mothers. They also obtained one-third more years of schooling, were less likely to be underweight, and had higher income in adulthood than children of rejected mothers.

10.1257/aer.20140529.abstractZh: 我们估算了向贫困家庭提供现金转移对儿童寿命、教育水平、营养状况以及成年后的收入的长远影响。为此，我们收集了美国首个政府资助的福利项目——母亲养老金计划的个人级行政记录，并将其与人口普查、二战及死亡记录进行匹配。被批准的申请者所生的男孩比被拒绝的母亲所生的男孩多活一年。这些男孩还接受了三分之一更多的教育年限，体重过轻的可能性更低，并且成年后的收入也高于被拒绝的母亲所生的男孩。

abstract.text: We integrate tools to monitor information acquisition in field experiments on discrimination and examine whether gaps arise already when decision makers choose the effort level for reading an application. In both countries we study, negatively stereotyped minority names reduce employers' effort to inspect resumes. In contrast, minority names increase information acquisition in the rental housing market. Both results are consistent with a model of endogenous allocation of costly attention, which magnifies the role of prior beliefs and preferences beyond the one considered in standard models of discrimination. The findings have implications for magnitude of discrimination, returns to human capital and policy. (JEL C93, D83, J15, J16, J24, J71, R31)

10.1257/aer.20140571.abstractZh: 我们整合了工具来监测在歧视领域实验中的信息获取情况，并探讨在决策者选择阅读申请材料的努力程度时是否会出现信息差距。在我们对两个国家的研究中，我们发现，带有负面刻板印象的少数族裔名字会降低雇主检查简历的努力程度。相反，少数族裔名字则增加了租赁市场中的信息获取。这两个结果都与一个关于昂贵注意力分配的内生模型相一致，该模型强调了先前信念和偏好在歧视中的作用，超出了标准歧视模型所考虑的范围。这些发现对歧视的严重程度、人力资本回报以及政策制定具有启示意义。（JEL C93, D83, J15, J16, J24, J71, R31）

abstract.text: We propose a parsimonious model of bilateral trade under asymmetric information to shed light on the prevalence of intermediation chains that stand between buyers and sellers in many decentralized markets. Our model features a classic problem in economics where an agent uses his market power to inefficiently screen a privately informed counterparty. Paradoxically, involving moderately informed intermediaries also endowed with market power can improve trade efficiency. Long intermediation chains in which each trader's information set is similar to those of his direct counterparties limit traders' incentives to post prices that reduce trade volume and jeopardize gains to trade. (JEL D42, D82, D85, L12, L14)

10.1257/aer.20140662.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个在信息不对称条件下对双边贸易进行简约建模的模型，以揭示在许多去中心化市场中，买卖双方之间普遍存在的中介链条现象。我们的模型涉及经济学中的一个经典问题：一个代理人利用其市场力量来低效地筛选私人信息提供者。矛盾的是，涉及具有市场力量的中等信息中介也可以提高贸易效率。在长中介链条中，每个交易者的信息集与其直接交易对手的信息集相似，这限制了交易者的动机，使其发布的报价会降低交易量并危及贸易收益。（JEL D42, D82, D85, L12, L14）

abstract.text: We study daily money market mutual fund flows at the individual share class level during September 2008. This fine granularity of data allows new insights into investor and portfolio holding characteristics conducive to run risk in cash-like asset pools. We find that cross-sectional flow data observed during the week of the Lehman failure are consistent with key implications of a simple model of coordination with incomplete information and strategic complementarities. Similar conclusions follow from daily models fitted to capture dynamic interactions between investors with differing levels of sophistication within the same money fund, holding constant the underlying portfolio. (JEL D14, G11, G23)

10.1257/aer.20140678.abstractZh: 我们研究了2008年9月期间每日货币市场共同基金的资金流动情况，具体到了每个股票类别的层面。这种精细的数据粒度有助于我们更深入地了解投资者和投资组合持有者的特征，这些特征可能导致现金类资产池中的风险。我们发现，在雷曼破产事件发生的那一周观察到的跨时资金流动数据，与一个简单的协调模型的关键结论一致，该模型考虑了信息不完全和战略互补性等因素。在保持底层投资组合不变的情况下，对每日数据进行建模后，也得到了类似的结论。（JEL D14, G11, G23）

abstract.text: We use unique data from over 600 Indonesian communities on what individuals know about the poverty status of others to study how network structure influences information aggregation. We develop a model of semi-Bayesian learning on networks, which we structurally estimate using within-village data. The model generates qualitative predictions about how cross-village patterns of learning relate to network structure, which we show are borne out in the data. We apply our findings to a community-based targeting program, where citizens chose households to receive aid, and show that the networks that the model predicts to be more diffusive differentially benefit from community targeting. (JEL D14, D83, D85, I32, O12, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20140705.abstractZh: 我们利用来自600多个印度尼西亚社区的独特数据，研究个人对其他人的贫困状况的了解情况，以探讨网络结构如何影响信息聚合。我们开发了一个基于网络的半贝叶斯学习模型，并使用村内数据对其进行结构化估计。该模型能够生成关于跨村庄学习模式与网络结构关系的定性预测，这些预测在数据中得到了验证。我们将这些发现应用于一个基于社区的定向计划，其中公民选择家庭接受援助，结果显示，模型预测的更具扩散性的网络在社区定向中获得了不同的利益。（JEL D14, D83, D85, I32, O12, Z13）

abstract.text: In a symmetric information voting model, an individual (politician) can influence voters' choices by strategically designing a policy experiment (public signal). We characterize the politician's optimal experiment. With a nonunanimous voting rule, she exploits voters' heterogeneity by designing an experiment with realizations targeting different winning coalitions. Consequently, under a simple-majority rule, a majority of voters might be strictly worse off due to the politician's influence. We characterize voters' preferences over electoral rules and provide conditions for a majority of voters to prefer a supermajority (or unanimity) voting rule, in order to induce the politician to supply a more informative experiment. (JEL D72, D83)

10.1257/aer.20140737.abstractZh: 在对称信息投票模型中，个人（政治家）可以通过策略性地设计政策实验（公开信号）来影响选民的选择。我们描述了政治家最优实验的设计方案。在非一致同意投票规则下，政治家通过设计针对不同获胜联盟的实现方案，利用选民的异质性。因此，在简单多数规则下，由于政治家的干预，大多数选民可能会遭受更大的损失。我们描述了选民对选举规则的偏好，并提出了条件，使得大多数选民更倾向于采用超级多数（或一致同意）投票规则，从而促使政治家提供更具有信息含量的实验。（JEL D72, D83）

abstract.text: This paper studies optimal communication flows in organizations. A production process can be coordinated ex ante, by letting agents stick to a prespecified plan of action. Alternatively, agents may adapt to task-specific shocks, in which case tasks must be coordinated ex post, using communication. When attention is scarce, an optimal organization coordinates only a few tasks ex post. Those tasks are higher performing, more adaptive to the environment, and influential. Hence, scarce attention requires setting priorities, not just local optimization. Our results provide microfoundations for a central idea in the management literature that firms should focus on a limited set of core competencies. (JEL D23, D83, D85, L23, M11, M54)

10.1257/aer.20140741.abstractZh: 本文研究了组织中的最优沟通流程。生产过程可以通过让代理人遵循预先指定的行动计划来预先协调。或者，代理人可以适应特定任务中的冲击，在这种情况下，任务必须通过沟通在事后进行协调。当注意力稀缺时，最优的组织只会在事后协调少数任务。这些任务具有更高的性能、更强的环境适应能力，并且更具影响力。因此，稀缺的注意力要求设定优先级，而不仅仅是局部优化。我们的研究结果为管理文献中的一个核心观点提供了微观基础，即企业应该专注于有限的几项核心能力。（JEL D23, D83, D85, L23, M11, M54）

abstract.text: We present a novel theory of the employment relationship. A manager can invest in attention technology to recognize good worker performance. The technology may break and is costly to replace. We show that as time passes without recognition, the worker's belief about the manager's technology worsens and his effort declines. The manager responds by investing, but this investment is insufficient to stop the decline in effort and eventually becomes decreasing. The relationship therefore continues deteriorating, and a return to high performance becomes increasingly unlikely. These deteriorating dynamics do not arise when recognition is of bad performance or independent of effort. (JEL D21, D82, J24, M54)

10.1257/aer.20140772.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种关于雇佣关系的新理论。管理者可以投资注意力技术来识别优秀员工的表现。这种技术可能会损坏，并且更换成本很高。我们发现，如果长时间没有给予认可，员工对管理者技术的评价会恶化，其工作努力也会下降。管理者会做出回应，进行投资，但这种投资不足以阻止努力的下降，最终投资也会逐渐减少。因此，雇佣关系会继续恶化，恢复到高绩效的状态变得越来越不可能。当认可与不良表现无关时，这种恶化的动态就不会出现。（JEL D21, D82, J24, M54）

abstract.text: Public policy in modern India features affirmative action programs intended to reduce inequality that stems from a centuries-old caste structure and history of disparate treatment by gender. We study the effects of one such affirmative action program: an admissions policy that fixes percentage quotas, common across more than 200 engineering colleges, for disadvantaged castes and for women. We show that the program increases college attendance of targeted students, particularly at relatively higher-quality institutions. An important concern is that affirmative action might harm intended beneficiaries by placing them in academic programs for which they are ill-prepared. We find no evidence of such adverse impacts. (JEL O15, O17, I23, I28, J15, J16, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20140783.abstractZh: 在现代印度，公共政策中包含一些平权行动计划，旨在减少由数世纪以来的种姓结构和性别不平等历史所导致的不平等现象。我们研究了一项此类平权行动计划的效果：一项针对弱势种姓和女性的招生政策，该政策规定了百分比配额，这一政策在200多所工程学院中普遍实施。我们发现，该计划提高了目标学生的入学率，尤其是在质量相对较高的院校中。一个重要的担忧是，平权行动可能会让受益者进入他们并不适应的学术课程，从而对他们产生不利影响。然而，我们没有发现这种负面影响的证据。（JEL O15, O17, I23, I28, J15, J16, Z13）

abstract.text: Citation indices are regularly used to inform critical decisions about promotion, tenure, and the allocation of billions of research dollars. Nevertheless, most indices (e.g., the h-index) are motivated by intuition and rules of thumb, resulting in undesirable conclusions. In contrast, five natural properties lead us to a unique new index, the Euclidean index, that avoids several shortcomings of the h-index and its successors. The Euclidean index is simply the Euclidean length of an individual's citation list. Two empirical tests suggest that the Euclidean index outperforms the h-index in practice. (JEL A14, C43)

10.1257/aer.20140850.abstractZh: 引用指数常被用于指导关于晋升、终身职位以及数十亿美元研究资金分配的决策。然而，大多数指数（如h指数）都是基于直觉和经验法则来制定的，这往往会导致不理想的结论。相比之下，有五个自然属性促使我们提出了一种独特的新型指数——欧几里得指数。该指数避免了h指数及其后续版本存在的诸多缺陷。欧几里得指数实际上就是一个个体引用列表的欧几里得长度。两项实证测试表明，欧几里得指数在实际应用中的表现优于h指数。（JEL A14, C43）

abstract.text: The US economy has performed better when the president of the United States is a Democrat rather than a Republican, almost regardless of how one measures performance. For many measures, including real GDP growth (our focus), the performance gap is large and significant. This paper asks why. The answer is not found in technical time series matters nor in systematically more expansionary monetary or fiscal policy under Democrats. Rather, it appears that the Democratic edge stems mainly from more benign oil shocks, superior total factor productivity (TFP) performance, a more favorable international environment, and perhaps more optimistic consumer expectations about the near-term future. (JEL D72, E23, E32, E65, N12, N42)

10.1257/aer.20140913.abstractZh: 当美国总统是民主党人时，美国经济的表现通常更好，几乎不受衡量方式的影响。对于许多指标来说，包括我们关注的实际GDP增长，这种表现差距是巨大且显著的。本文试图解释这一现象。答案并不在于技术性的时间序列分析，也不在于民主党政府实施的系统性更扩张性的货币政策或财政政策。相反，民主党在应对石油危机、全要素生产率表现、国际环境以及消费者对未来前景的乐观预期方面似乎具有优势。（JEL D72, E23, E32, E65, N12, N42）

abstract.text: We examine the reference-dependent risk preferences of Kőszegi and Rabin (2007), focusing on their choice-acclimating personal equilibria. Although their model has only a trivial intersection (expected utility) with other reference-dependent models, it has very strong connections with models that rely on different psychological intuitions. We prove that the intersection of rank-dependent utility and quadratic utility, two well-known generalizations of expected utility, is exactly monotone linear gain-loss choice-acclimating personal equilibria. We use these relationships to identify parameters of the model, discuss loss and risk aversion, and demonstrate new applications. (JEL D11, D81)

10.1257/aer.20140973.abstractZh: 我们研究了Kőszegi和Rabin（2007）基于参考的风险偏好，重点关注他们的选择适应型个人均衡。尽管他们的模型与其他基于参考的模型只有微不足道的交集（期望效用），但它与那些依赖不同心理直觉的模型有着非常紧密的联系。我们证明了基于等级效用和二次效用的交集，作为期望效用的两个著名推广，正是单调线性收益-损失选择适应型个人均衡。我们利用这些关系来识别模型的参数，讨论损失和风险厌恶问题，并展示了新的应用前景。（JEL D11, D81）

abstract.text: This paper studies optimal dynamic tax policy under the threat of political reform. A policy will be reformed ex post if a large enough coalition of citizens supports reform; thus, sustainable policies are those that will continue to attract enough political support in the future. We find that optimal marginal capital taxes are either progressive or U-shaped, so that savings are subsidized for the poor and/or the middle class but are taxed for the rich. U-shaped capital taxes always emerge when individuals' political behavior is purely determined by economic motives. (JEL D12, D14, D31, D72, H21, H25)

10.1257/aer.20141081.abstractZh: 本文研究了在政治改革威胁下的最优动态税收政策。如果有足够的公民联盟支持改革，政策将在事后得到改革；因此，可持续的政策是那些在未来能够持续获得足够政治支持的政策。我们发现，最优的边际资本税要么是累进的，要么是U形的，这样既能为贫困和/或中产阶级提供储蓄补贴，又能对富人征税。当个人的政治行为完全由经济动机决定时，U形资本税总是会出现。（JEL D12, D14, D31, D72, H21, H25）

abstract.text: We study a contract change for tea pluckers on an Indian plantation, with a higher government-stipulated baseline wage. Incentive piece rates were lowered or kept unchanged. Yet, in the following month, output increased by 20 to 80 percent. This response contradicts the standard model and several variants, is only partly explicable by greater supervision, and appears to be “behavioral.” But in subsequent months, the increase is comprehensively reversed. Though not an unequivocal indictment of “behavioral” models, these findings suggest that nonstandard responses may be ephemeral, and should ideally be tracked over an extended period of time. (JEL D82, D86, J33, J41, J43, O13, Q12)

10.1257/aer.20141122.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个印度种植园中采摘茶叶工人的合同变更情况，政府规定的基准工资有所提高。激励性计件工资被降低或保持不变。然而，在接下来的一个月里，产量增加了20%到80%。这种反应与标准模型及多个变体相矛盾，部分原因无法用更严格的监管来解释，且似乎属于“行为性”反应。但在随后的几个月里，这种增长被完全逆转了。虽然这些发现并不能明确否定“行为性”模型，但它们表明非标准反应可能是短暂的，理想情况下应该通过较长时间的研究来追踪这些现象。（JEL D82, D86, J33, J41, J43, O13, Q12）

abstract.text: When an agent chooses between prospects, noise in information processing generates an effect akin to the winner's curse. Statistically unbiased perception systematically overvalues the chosen action because it fails to account for the possibility that noise is responsible for making the preferred action appear to be optimal. The optimal perception pattern exhibits a key feature of prospect theory, namely, overweighting of small probability events (and corresponding underweighting of high probability events). This bias arises to correct for the winner's curse effect. (JEL D11, D81, D82, D83)

10.1257/aer.20141141.abstractZh: 当代理人需要在不同前景之间进行选择时，信息处理中的噪声会产生一种类似于“赢家诅咒”的效果。统计上无偏见的认知会系统性地高估所选行动的价值，因为这种认知没有考虑到噪声可能导致所选行动看起来是最优的选择。最优的认知模式体现了前景理论的一个关键特征，即过度重视小概率事件（并相应低估高概率事件）。这种偏差是为了纠正“赢家诅咒”效应而产生的。（JEL D11, D81, D82, D83）

abstract.text: We model an online display advertising environment in which “performance” advertisers can measure the value of individual impressions, whereas “brand” advertisers cannot. If advertiser values for ad opportunities are positively correlated, second-price auctions for impressions can be inefficient and expose brand advertisers to adverse selection. Bayesian-optimal auctions have other drawbacks: they are complex, introduce incentives for false-name bidding, and do not resolve adverse selection. We introduce “modified second bid” auctions as the unique auctions that overcome these disadvantages. When advertiser match values are drawn independently from heavy-tailed distributions, a modified second bid auction captures at least 94.8 percent of the first-best expected value. In that setting and similar ones, the benefits of switching from an ordinary second-price auction to the modified second bid auction may be large, and the cost of defending against shill bidding and adverse selection may be low. (JEL D44, D82, L86, M37)

10.1257/aer.20141198.abstractZh: 我们模拟了一个在线展示广告环境，在该环境中，“表现型”广告商能够衡量单个展示的价值，而“品牌型”广告商则无法做到这一点。如果广告商对广告机会的价值存在正相关关系，那么基于第二价格的展示拍卖可能会效率低下，并导致品牌广告商面临逆向选择的问题。贝叶斯最优拍卖还有其他缺点：它们结构复杂，会引入虚假竞价的动机，并且无法解决逆向选择问题。我们提出了“改良第二价格拍卖”作为唯一能够克服这些缺点的拍卖方式。当广告商匹配价值从重尾分布中独立抽取时，改良第二价格拍卖至少能捕捉到第一最佳期望值的94.8%。在这种情境下，以及类似的情境下，从普通第二价格拍卖转向改良第二价格拍卖的好处可能很大，而防范虚假竞价和逆向选择的成本则可能较低。（JEL D44, D82, L86, M37）

abstract.text: The combinatorial clock auction has become popular for large-scale spectrum awards and other uses, replacing more traditional ascending or clock auctions. We describe some surprising properties of the auction, including a wide range of ex post equilibria with demand expansion, demand reduction, and predation. Our results obtain in a standard homogeneous good setting where bidders have well-behaved linear demand curves, and suggest some practical difficulties with dynamic implementations of the Vickrey auction. (JEL D44, D47, H82, L13)

10.1257/aer.20141212.abstractZh: 组合时钟拍卖在大规模频谱分配等应用中变得流行，取代了传统的升序拍卖或时钟拍卖方式。我们描述了该拍卖的一些令人惊讶的特性，包括多种事后均衡情况，这些均衡包括需求增加、需求减少以及掠夺行为。我们的研究结果适用于标准的同质商品拍卖场景，其中竞拍者的需求曲线具有线性特征。同时，研究结果也指出了在动态实施Vickrey拍卖时可能遇到的实际困难。（JEL D44, D47, H82, L13）

abstract.text: I study a dynamic relationship where a principal delegates experimentation to an agent. Experimentation is modeled as a one-armed bandit that yields successes following a Poisson process. Its unknown intensity is high or low. The agent has private information, his type being his prior belief that the intensity is high. The agent values successes more than the principal does, so prefers more experimentation. The optimal mechanism is a cutoff rule in the belief space: the cutoff gives pessimistic types total freedom but curtails optimistic types’ behavior. Pessimistic types overexperiment while the most optimistic ones underexperiment. This delegation rule is time consistent. (JEL D23, D82, D83, O30)

10.1257/aer.20141215.abstractZh: 我研究了一种动态关系，其中委托人将实验任务委托给一个代理人。实验被建模为一个单臂老虎机，其成功结果遵循泊松过程。实验的强度是未知的，可能是高或低。代理人拥有私人信息，他的类型代表他对实验强度为高的先验信念。代理人对成功的重视程度高于委托人，因此更倾向于进行更多的实验。最优机制是在信念空间中的一个截止规则：该规则让悲观型代理人完全自由地选择实验，但限制了乐观型代理人的行为。悲观型代理人会过度实验，而最乐观的代理人则会减少实验。这种委托规则是时间一致的。（JEL D23, D82, D83, O30）

abstract.text: In 2005, as the result of a World Trade Organization mandate, India implemented a patent reform for pharmaceuticals that was intended to comply with the 1995 Trade-Related Aspects of Intellectual Property Rights (TRIPS). Exploiting variation in the timing of patent decisions, we estimate that a molecule receiving a patent experienced an average price increase of just 3–6 percent, with larger increases for more recently developed molecules and for those produced by just one firm when the patent system began. Our results also show little impact on quantities sold or on the number of pharmaceutical firms operating in the market. (JEL K33, L11, L13, L65, O14, O34, O38)

10.1257/aer.20141301.abstractZh: 2005年，根据世界贸易组织的要求，印度实施了药品专利改革，以符合1995年《与贸易有关的知识产权协议》的规定。通过分析专利决策的时间差异，我们估计获得专利的药品平均价格仅上涨3-6%，而最近开发的药品以及最初由单一公司生产的药品价格涨幅更大。我们的研究还显示，这一改革对药品销售量或市场上制药公司的数量几乎没有影响。（JEL K33, L11, L13, L65, O14, O34, O38）

abstract.text: Antipoverty programs in developing countries are often difficult to implement; in particular, many governments lack the capacity to deliver payments securely to targeted beneficiaries. We evaluate the impact of biometrically authenticated payments infrastructure (“Smartcards”) on beneficiaries of employment (NREGS) and pen sion (SSP) programs in the Indian state of Andhra Pradesh, using a large-scale experiment that randomized the rollout of Smartcards over 157 subdistricts and 19 million people. We find that, while incompletely implemented, the new system delivered a faster, more predictable, and less corrupt NREGS payments process without adversely affecting program access. For each of these outcomes, treatment group distributions first-order stochastically dominated those of the control group. The investment was cost-effective, as time savings to NREGS beneficiaries alone were equal to the cost of the intervention, and there was also a significant reduction in the “leakage” of funds between the government and beneficiaries in both NREGS and SSP programs. Beneficiaries overwhelmingly preferred the new system for both programs. Overall, our results suggest that investing in secure payments infrastructure can significantly enhance “state capacity” to implement welfare programs in developing countries. (JEL H53, H55, I32, I38, J65)

10.1257/aer.20141346.abstractZh: 在发展中国家，反贫困项目的实施往往十分困难；尤其是，许多政府缺乏将资金安全交付给目标受益人的能力。我们评估了生物识别认证支付基础设施（“智能卡”）对印度安得拉邦就业福利计划（NREGS）和养老金计划（SSP）受益人的影响，通过一项大规模实验来随机分配智能卡的推广，涉及157个子区域和1900万人口。研究发现，尽管该新系统实施不完全，但它使NREGS支付的流程更加快速、可预测且减少腐败现象，同时并未对项目的实施产生负面影响。对于上述各项结果，实验组的分布与对照组的分布具有一阶随机优势。该投资具有成本效益，因为仅NREGS受益人所节省的时间就相当于干预的成本，同时NREGS和SSP项目中的资金“流失”也显著减少。受益人对新系统在两个项目中的满意度都很高。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，投资于安全支付基础设施可以显著提升发展中国家实施福利项目的“国家能力”。（JEL H53, H55, I32, I38, J65）

abstract.text: This paper proposes to evaluate tax reforms by aggregating money metric losses and gains of different individuals using “generalized social marginal welfare weights.” Optimum tax formulas take the same form as standard welfarist tax formulas by simply substituting standard marginal social welfare weights with those generalized weights. Weights directly capture society's concerns for fairness without being necessarily tied to individual utilities. Suitable weights can help reconcile discrepancies between the welfarist approach and actual tax practice, as well as unify in an operational way the most prominent alternatives to utilitarianism such as Libertarianism, equality of opportunity, or poverty alleviation. (JEL D60, D63, H21, H23, I38)

10.1257/aer.20141362.abstractZh: 本文提出通过采用“广义社会边际福利权重”来汇总不同个体的金钱指标损失和收益，以评估税收改革的效果。最优税收公式的形式与标准的福利主义税收公式相同，只需将标准边际社会福利权重替换为广义权重即可。这些权重直接反映了社会对公平性的关注，而不必与个体效用挂钩。合适的权重有助于协调福利主义方法与实际税收实践之间的差异，同时以操作性的方式统一了功利主义最突出的替代方案，如自由意志主义、机会平等或减贫理念。（JEL D60, D63, H21, H23, I38）

abstract.text: Because of scale effects, idea-based growth models imply that larger countries should be much richer than smaller ones. New trade models share the same counterfactual feature. In fact, new trade models exhibit other counterfactual implications associated with scale effects: import shares decrease and relative income levels increase too steeply with country size. We argue that these implications are largely a result of the standard assumption that countries are fully integrated domestically. We depart from this assumption by treating countries as collections of regions that face positive costs to trade among themselves. The resulting model is largely consistent with the data. (JEL F11, F14, F43, O47, R12)

10.1257/aer.20141449.abstractZh: 由于规模效应，基于理念的增长模型表明，较大的国家应该比较小的国家更富裕。新的贸易模型也具有相同的反事实特征。实际上，新的贸易模型还表现出与规模效应相关的其他反事实影响：进口份额随着国家规模的增加而减少，而相对收入水平则上升得过于陡峭。我们认为，这些影响主要源于一个标准假设，即各国在国内是完全整合的。我们通过将国家视为面临相互贸易正成本的地区集合来偏离这一假设。由此得出的模型与数据大体一致。（JEL F11, F14, F43, O47, R12）

abstract.text: We study the role of communication within a cartel. Our analysis is carried out in Stigler’s (1964) model of repeated oligopoly with secret price cuts. Firms observe neither the prices nor the sales of their rivals. For a fixed discount factor, we identify conditions under which there are equilibria with “cheap talk” that result in near-perfect collusion, whereas all equilibria without such communication are bounded away from this outcome. In our model, communication improves monitoring and leads to higher prices and profits. (JEL C73, D43, D83, L12, L13, L25)

10.1257/aer.20141469.abstractZh: 我们研究了通信在卡特尔中的作用。我们的分析基于Stigler在1964年提出的重复寡头垄断模型，该模型包含秘密价格削减行为。企业既不会观察到竞争对手的价格，也不会了解他们的销售情况。在固定的折扣因子下，我们确定了存在“廉价谈话”均衡的条件，这些均衡会导致近乎完美的勾结，而所有没有这种通信的均衡则无法达到这种结果。在我们的模型中，通信能够改善监控效果，从而提高价格和利润。（JEL C73, D43, D83, L12, L13, L25）

abstract.text: Analysis of the timing of launches of 642 new drugs in 76 countries during 1983–2002 shows that patent and price regulation regimes strongly affect how quickly new drugs become commercially available in different countries. Price regulation delays launch, while longer and more extensive patent rights accelerate it. Health policy institutions and economic and demographic factors that make markets more profitable also speed up diffusion. The estimated effects are generally robust to controlling for endogeneity of policy regimes with country fixed effects and instrumental variables. The results highlight the important role of policy choices in driving the diffusion of new innovations.

10.1257/aer.20141482.abstractZh: 对1983年至2002年间76个国家中642种新药的上市时机进行分析后发现，专利和价格管制制度显著影响了新药在不同国家中的上市速度。价格管制会延迟新药的上市时间，而更长期且更全面的专利权利则会加速其上市。旨在提高市场盈利能力的卫生政策机构以及经济与人口因素也会加快新药的普及速度。通过控制政策制度的内生性、采用国家固定效应和工具变量，所估计的效应总体上是稳健的。这些结果凸显了政策选择在推动新创新普及方面的重要作用。

abstract.text: We develop a framework to characterize strategic behavior in sequential markets under imperfect competition and restricted entry in arbitrage. Our theory predicts that these two elements can generate a systematic price premium. We test the model predictions using microdata from the Iberian electricity market. We show that the observed price differences and firm behavior are consistent with the model. Finally, we quantify the welfare effects of arbitrage using a structural model. In the presence of market power, we show that full arbitrage is not necessarily welfare-enhancing, reducing consumer costs but increasing deadweight loss. (JEL D42, D43, L12, L13, L94, Q41)

10.1257/aer.20141529.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个框架，用于描述在不完全竞争和有限进入的套利市场中战略行为。我们的理论预测，这两个因素可以产生系统性的价格溢价。我们使用伊比利亚电力市场的微观数据来检验模型的预测结果。我们发现，观察到的价格差异和企业行为与模型预测一致。最后，我们使用结构模型来量化套利的福利效应。在市场力量存在的情况下，我们表明完全套利并不一定会提高福利，虽然可以降低消费者成本，但会增加无谓损失。（JEL D42, D43, L12, L13, L94, Q41）

abstract.text: We estimate that unemployment insurance (UI) extensions reduce reemployment wages using sharp age discontinuities in UI eligibility in Germany. We show this effect combines two key policy parameters: the effect of UI on reservation wages and the effect of nonemployment durations on wage offers. Our framework implies if UI extensions do not affect wages conditional on duration, then reservation wages do not bind. We derive resulting instrumental variable estimates for the effect of nonemployment durations on wage offers and bounds for reservation wage effects. The effect of UI on wages we find arises mainly from substantial negative nonemployment duration effects. (JEL J31, J64, J65)

10.1257/aer.20141566.abstractZh: 我们估计，德国的失业保险扩展通过显著的年龄差异来降低重新就业的工资。我们表明，这种效应结合了两个关键政策参数：失业保险对保留工资的效应，以及非就业时长对工资报价的影响。我们的框架表明，如果失业保险扩展在时长条件上不影响工资，那么保留工资就不会具有约束力。我们推导出了非就业时长对工资报价影响的工具变量估计结果，并确定了保留工资效应的界限。我们发现，失业保险对工资的影响主要源于显著的负面非就业时长效应。（JEL J31, J64, J65）

abstract.text: This paper estimates the incidence of state corporate taxes on the welfare of workers, landowners, and firm owners using variation in state corporate tax rates and apportionment rules. We develop a spatial equilibrium model with imperfectly mobile firms and workers. Firm owners may earn profits and be inframarginal in their location choices due to differences in location-specific productivities. We use the reduced-form effects of tax changes to identify and estimate incidence as well as the structural parameters governing these impacts. In contrast to standard open economy models, firm owners bear roughly 40 percent of the incidence, while workers and landowners bear 30–35 percent and 25–30 percent, respectively. (JEL H22, H25, H32, H71, R23, R51)

10.1257/aer.20141702.abstractZh: 本文通过研究不同州的企业税税率和分配规则的变化，估算了企业税对工人、土地所有者和企业主福利的影响。我们建立了一个具有不完全流动性的企业和工人的空间均衡模型。由于特定地点的生产率差异，企业主可能会获得利润，但在选址选择上处于次边缘地位。我们利用税收变化的简化形式效应来识别和估算影响程度以及控制这些影响的结构性参数。与标准的开放经济模型不同，企业主承担了大约40%的影响，而工人和土地所有者分别承担30-35%和25-30%的影响。（JEL H22, H25, H32, H71, R23, R51）

abstract.text: Many salient rules to allocate private goods are not only strategy-proof, but also group strategy-proof, in appropriate domains of definition, hence diminishing the traditional conflict between incentives and efficiency. That is so for solutions to matching, division, cost sharing, house allocation, and auctions, in spite of the substantive disparity between these cases. In a general framework encompassing all of them, we prove that the equivalence between the two forms of strategy-proofness is due to an underlying common structure that transcends the many differences between the contexts and the mechanisms for which it holds. (JEL C78, D44, D63, D71, D82)

10.1257/aer.20141727.abstractZh: 在许多分配私人物品的显著规则中，这些规则不仅具有策略防御性，而且在适当的定义范围内也具有群体策略防御性，从而减少了传统上激励与效率之间的冲突。这一点在解决匹配、分配、成本分担、房屋分配和拍卖等问题时同样适用，尽管这些案例之间存在实质性差异。在一个涵盖所有这些情况的通用框架中，我们证明了两种策略防御性的等价性，这是由于一种超越各种情境和机制之间差异的潜在共同结构所决定的。（JEL C78, D44, D63, D71, D82）

abstract.text: We study employers' perceptions of the value of postsecondary degrees using a field experiment. We randomly assign the sector and selectivity of institutions to fictitious resumes and apply to real vacancy postings for business and health jobs on a large online job board. We find that a business bachelor's degree from a for-profit online institution is 22 percent less likely to receive a callback than one from a nonselective public institution. In applications to health jobs, we find that for-profit credentials receive fewer callbacks unless the job requires an external quality indicator such as an occupational license. (JEL I23, I26, J24, J44, J63, M51)

10.1257/aer.20141757.abstractZh: 我们通过一项实地实验，研究雇主对高等教育学位价值的看法。我们随机为虚构的简历指定机构行业和选择性，并将这些简历提交到大型在线招聘网站上的真实职位空缺信息中，涉及商业和医疗行业的工作岗位。研究发现，来自营利性在线机构的商业学士学位，获得回电机会的可能性比来自非选择性公立机构的学位低22%。在医疗行业的职位申请中，我们发现，除非职位要求具备外部资质指标，如职业执照，否则营利性机构的学位获得的回电机会较少。（JEL I23, I26, J24, J44, J63, M51）

abstract.text: We use a natural experiment in Indonesia to provide causal evidence on the role of location-specific human capital and skill transferability in shaping the spatial distribution of productivity. From 1979–1988, the Transmigration Program relocated two million migrants from rural Java and Bali to new rural settlements in the Outer Islands. Villages assigned migrants from regions with more similar agroclimatic endowments exhibit higher rice productivity and nighttime light intensity one to two decades later. We find some evidence of migrants' adaptation to agroclimatic change. Overall, our results suggest that regional productivity differences may overstate the potential gains from migration. (JEL J24, J43, J61, O13, O15, Q13, R23)

10.1257/aer.20141781.abstractZh: 我们通过印度尼西亚的自然实验，提供了关于特定地点的人力资本和技能可转移性在塑造生产力空间分布中的作用的因果证据。在1979年至1988年间，迁移计划将来自爪哇和巴厘岛农村地区的两百万移民迁移到外岛的新农村定居点。那些来自具有相似农业气候条件的地区的移民所居住的村庄，在十年到二十年后，水稻产量和夜间光照强度都更高。我们发现，移民在一定程度上适应了农业气候的变化。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，地区间生产力的差异可能夸大了迁移带来的潜在收益。（JEL J24, J43, J61, O13, O15, Q13, R23）

abstract.text: This research explores the origins of observed differences in time preference across countries and regions. Exploiting a natural experiment associated with the expansion of suitable crops for cultivation in the course of the Columbian Exchange, the research establishes that pre-industrial agro-climatic characteristics that were conducive to higher return to agricultural investment, triggered selection, adaptation and learning processes that generated a persistent positive effect on the prevalence of long-term orientation in the contemporary era. Furthermore, the research establishes that these agro-climatic characteristics have had a culturally embodied impact on economic behavior such as technological adoption, education, saving, and smoking.

10.1257/aer.20150020.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了不同国家和地区在时间偏好差异方面的起源。通过利用与哥伦布大交换过程中适宜作物种植扩展相关的自然实验，研究发现，前工业时代的农业气候特征有利于提高农业投资的回报，从而引发了选择、适应和学习过程，这些因素在当代产生了持续积极的影响，使得长期导向的价值观得以盛行。此外，研究还发现，这些农业气候特征对经济行为产生了文化上的影响，例如技术采纳、教育、储蓄和吸烟等方面。

abstract.text: In recent years, central banks have increasingly turned to forward guidance as a central tool of monetary policy. Standard monetary models imply that far future forward guidance has huge effects on current outcomes, and these effects grow with the horizon of the forward guidance. We present a model in which the power of forward guidance is highly sensitive to the assumption of complete markets. When agents face uninsurable income risk and borrowing constraints, a precautionary savings effect tempers their responses to changes in future interest rates. As a consequence, forward guidance has substantially less power to stimulate the economy. (JEL E21, E40, E50)

10.1257/aer.20150063.abstractZh: 近年来，中央银行越来越多地采用前瞻性指导作为货币政策的核心工具。传统的货币模型表明，远期前瞻性指导对当前结果有着巨大的影响，而且这种影响随着前瞻性指导的时间范围而增强。我们提出了一个模型，该模型表明前瞻性指导的力量对完全市场的假设非常敏感。当代理人面临不可保险的收入风险和借贷限制时，预防性储蓄效应会削弱他们对未来利率变化的反应。因此，前瞻性指导刺激经济的力量大大减弱。（JEL E21, E40, E50）

abstract.text: We study decentralized mechanisms for allocating firms into search pools. The pools are created in response to noisy preference signals provided by consumers, who then browse the pools via costly random sequential search. Surplus-maximizing search pools are implementable in symmetric Nash equilibrium. Full extraction of the maximal surplus is implementable if and only if the distribution of consumer types satisfies a set of simple inequalities, which involve the relative fractions of consumers who like different products and the Bhattacharyya coefficient of similarity between their conditional signal distributions. The optimal mechanism can be simulated by a keyword auction with broad matching. (JEL C78, D44, D82)

10.1257/aer.20150076.abstractZh: 我们研究了将企业分配到搜索池中的去中心化机制。这些搜索池是根据消费者提供的带有噪声的偏好信号而创建的，消费者随后通过昂贵的随机顺序搜索来浏览这些搜索池。在对称纳什均衡中可以实现最大化剩余收益的搜索池。只有当消费者类型的分布满足一组简单的不等式时，才能完全提取最大剩余收益，这些不等式涉及喜欢不同产品的消费者的相对比例以及他们条件信号分布之间的Bhattacharyya相似系数。最优机制可以通过具有广泛匹配的关键词拍卖来模拟。（JEL C78, D44, D82）

abstract.text: Regulations governing the energy efficiency of new buildings have become a cornerstone of US environmental policy. California enacted the first such codes in 1978 and has tightened them every few years since. I evaluate the resulting energy savings three ways: comparing energy used by houses constructed under different standards, controlling for building and occupant characteristics; examining how energy use varies with outdoor temperatures; and comparing energy used by houses of different vintages in California to that same difference in other states. All three approaches yield estimated energy savings significantly short of those projected when the regulations were enacted. (JEL Q48, Q51, Q52)

10.1257/aer.20150102.abstractZh: 关于新建筑能源效率的法规已成为美国环境政策的基石。加利福尼亚州于1978年首次制定了此类规范，并此后每隔几年就对其进行修订。我通过三种方式评估由此带来的能源节约效果：比较按照不同标准建造的房屋的能源使用情况，同时考虑建筑和使用者的特征；研究能源使用如何随室外温度的变化而变化；比较加利福尼亚州不同年份建造的房屋的能源使用情况与其他州相同年份的对比情况。这三种方法的估计能源节约效果都远低于法规制定时的预期。（JEL Q48, Q51, Q52）

abstract.text: A common view is that bailouts of firms by governments are needed to cure inefficiencies in private markets. We propose an alternative view: even when private markets are efficient, costly bankruptcies will occur and benevolent governments without commitment will bail out firms to avoid bankruptcy costs. Bailouts then introduce inefficiencies where none had existed. Although granting the government orderly resolution powers which allow it to rewrite private contracts improves on bailout outcomes, regulating leverage and taxing size is needed to achieve the relevant constrained efficient outcome, the sustainably efficient outcome. This outcome respects governments' incentives to intervene when they lack commitment. (JEL D86, E32, G33, H81, L51)

10.1257/aer.20150157.abstractZh: 一种常见的观点认为，政府需要救助企业以弥补私人市场的效率不足。我们提出了另一种观点：即使私人市场是高效的，昂贵的破产仍会发生，而缺乏承诺的仁慈政府会救助企业以避免破产成本。这样，救助行为反而引入了原本不存在的低效现象。虽然赋予政府有序解决私法纠纷的权力可以改善救助结果，但还需要对杠杆进行监管并对企业规模征税，以实现相关约束下的高效结果，即可持续的高效结果。这一结果尊重了政府在缺乏承诺时干预的动机。（JEL D86, E32, G33, H81, L51）

abstract.text: We introduce a new method to measure the temporal discounting of money. Unlike preceding methods, our method requires neither knowledge nor measurement of utility. It is easier to implement, clearer to subjects, and requires fewer measurements than existing methods. (JEL C91, D11, D12, D91)

10.1257/aer.20150208.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种新的方法来衡量货币的时间折现效应。与以往的方法不同，我们的方法既不需要对效用进行了解释，也不需要对其进行测量。该方法实施起来更为简单，对受试者来说也更为直观，并且所需的测量次数比现有方法要少得多。（JEL C91, D11, D12, D91）

abstract.text: We study the effect of top tax rates on “superstar” inventors' international mobility since 1977, using panel data on inventors from the US and European Patent Offices. We exploit the differential impact of changes in top tax rates on inventors of different qualities. Superstar inventors' location choices are significantly affected by top tax rates. In our preferred specification, the elasticity to the net-of-tax rate of the number of domestic superstar inventors is around 0.03, while that of foreign superstar inventors is around 1. These elasticities are larger for inventors in multinational companies. An inventor is less sensitive to taxes in a country if his company performs a higher share of its research there. (JEL F22, F23, H24, H31, J61, O31, O34)

10.1257/aer.20150237.abstractZh: 我们研究了自1977年以来，最高税率对“超级明星”发明家国际流动性的影响，使用了来自美国和欧洲专利局的发明家面板数据。我们利用了不同质量发明家对最高税率变化的差异影响。超级明星发明家的选址选择显著受到最高税率的影响。在我们优选的模型中，国内超级明星发明家数量对净税率的弹性约为0.03，而国外超级明星发明家则约为1。这些弹性对于在跨国公司工作的发明家来说更大。如果一个发明家的公司在该国承担了更多的研究任务，那么该发明家对该国的税收敏感度就会降低。（JEL F22, F23, H24, H31, J61, O31, O34）

abstract.text: We characterize the optimal dynamic contract for a long-term basic service when an uncertain add-on is required later on. Introducing firm risk aversion has two impacts. Profits for the basic service can be backloaded to induce cheaper information revelation for this service: an Income Effect which reduces output distortions. The firm must also bear some risk to induce information revelation for the add-on. This Risk Effect reduces the level of the add-on but hardens information revelation for the basic service. The interaction between these effects has important implications for the dynamics of distortions, contract renegotiation, and the value of incomplete contracts. (JEL D47, D81, D86)

10.1257/aer.20150275.abstractZh: 我们描述了在后期需要不确定附加服务时，长期基础服务的最优动态契约。引入企业风险厌恶行为会产生两种影响：基础服务的利润可以推迟发放，从而促使企业更积极地提供信息，这种效应被称为“收入效应”，可以减少产出扭曲。企业还必须承担一定的风险以促使企业提供附加服务的信息，这种效应被称为“风险效应”，虽然会降低附加服务的水平，但会增强基础服务信息的透明度。这两种效应之间的相互作用对扭曲的动态、契约重新谈判以及不完全契约的价值具有重要影响。（JEL D47, D81, D86）

abstract.text: This paper exploits quasi-experimental variation in tariffs in southern Africa to estimate trade elasticities. Traded quantities respond only weakly to a 30 percent reduction in the average nominal tariff rate. Trade flow data combined with primary data on firm behavior and bribe payments suggest that corruption is a potential explanation for the observed low elasticities. In contexts of pervasive corruption, even small bribes can significantly reduce tariffs, making tariff liberalization schemes less likely to affect the extensive and the intensive margins of firms' import behavior. The tariff liberalization scheme is, however, still associated with improved incentives to accurately report quantities of imported goods, and with a significant reduction in bribe transfers from importers to public officials. (JEL D22, D73, F13, H83, O17, O19, O24)

10.1257/aer.20150313.abstractZh: 本文利用南部非洲关税的准实验性变化来估算贸易弹性。贸易量对平均名义关税率降低30%的反应较弱。结合企业行为和贿赂支付方面的原始数据，表明腐败可能是导致观察到的低弹性的潜在原因。在腐败普遍存在的环境下，即使是小额贿赂也能显著降低关税，使得关税自由化方案不太可能显著影响企业进口行为的广泛性和集约性边际。然而，关税自由化方案仍然与提高企业准确报告进口商品数量的积极性有关，并且进口商向公职人员转移贿赂的行为也显著减少。（JEL D22, D73, F13, H83, O17, O19, O24）

abstract.text: In this paper we analyze the relationship between turnover-driven growth and subjective wellbeing. Our model of innovation-led growth and unemployment predicts that: ( i ) the effect of creative destruction on expected individual welfare should be unambiguously positive if we control for unemployment, less so if we do not; ( ii ) job creation has a positive and job destruction has a negative impact on wellbeing; ( iii ) job destruction has a less negative impact in US Metropolitan Statistical Areas (MSA) within states with more generous unemployment insurance policies; ( iv ) job creation has a more positive effect on individuals that are more forward-looking. The empirical analysis using cross-sectional MSA-level and individual-level data provide empirical support to these predictions.

10.1257/aer.20150338.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们分析了 turnover-driven growth与主观幸福感之间的关系。我们的创新驱动增长与失业模型预测：(i) 如果控制失业因素，创造性破坏对个体预期福利的影响应该是明确的积极效应；如果不考虑失业因素，这种影响则会减弱；(ii) 就业创造对幸福感有积极影响，而失业造成对幸福感有负面影响；(iii) 在失业保险政策较为宽松的州内，失业造成对幸福感的影响较小；(iv) 对更具前瞻性的人来说，就业创造对个体幸福感的影响更为积极。使用横截面MSA-level和个体层面的数据进行的实证分析为这些预测提供了支持。

abstract.text: We consider a problem where an uninformed principal makes a timing decision interacting with an informed but biased agent. Because time is irreversible, the direction of the bias crucially affects the agent's ability to credibly communicate information. When the agent favors late decision making, full information revelation often occurs. In this case, centralized decision making, where the principal retains authority and communicates with the agent, implements the optimal decision-making rule. When the agent favors early decision making, communication is partial, and the optimal decision-making rule is not implemented. Delegation adds value when the bias is for early decision making, but not for late decision making. (JEL D21, D23, D82, D83)

10.1257/aer.20150416.abstractZh: 我们考虑了一个问题，其中无信息的主体在与有信息但存在偏见的代理人互动时做出时间决策。由于时间是不可逆的，偏见的指向对代理人可信地传递信息的能力有着至关重要的影响。当代理人倾向于延迟决策时，通常会发生信息的完全披露。在这种情况下，集中式的决策方式——即主体保留决策权并与代理人沟通——能够实现最优的决策规则。而当代理人倾向于提前决策时，沟通就会变得不全面，最优的决策规则也就无法得到实施。在偏见倾向于提前决策的情况下，委托机制能够增加价值，但在偏见倾向于延迟决策的情况下则不然。（JEL D21, D23, D82, D83）

abstract.text: We use a randomized experiment in India to show that improved technology enhances agricultural productivity by crowding in modern inputs and cultivation practices. Specifically, we show that a new rice variety that reduces downside risk by providing flood tolerance has positive effects on adoption of a more labor-intensive planting method, area cultivated, fertilizer usage, and credit utilization. We find that a large share of the expected gains from the technology comes from crowding in of other investments. Therefore, improved technologies that reduce risk by protecting production in bad years have the potential to increase agricultural productivity in normal years. (JEL O13, O33, Q14, Q15, Q16)

10.1257/aer.20150474.abstractZh: 我们在印度通过随机实验表明，改进的技术通过引入现代投入和耕作方式，提升了农业生产力。具体来说，我们发现一种能够降低风险的新水稻品种，通过提供耐淹性，对采用更劳动密集型的种植方式、耕种面积、肥料使用量和信贷利用产生了积极影响。我们发现，该技术带来的收益很大一部分来自于其他投资的引入。因此，那些通过保护生产在不利年份的风险而降低风险的改进技术，有潜力在正常年份提高农业生产力。（JEL O13, O33, Q14, Q15, Q16）

abstract.text: Charter takeovers are traditional public schools restarted as charter schools. We develop a grandfathering instrument for takeover attendance that compares students at schools designated for takeover with a matched sample of students attending similar schools not yet taken over. Grandfathering estimates from New Orleans show substantial gains from takeover enrollment. In Boston, grandfathered students see achievement gains at least as large as the gains for students assigned charter seats in lotteries. A non-charter Boston turnaround intervention that had much in common with the takeover strategy generated gains as large as those seen for takeovers, while other more modest turnaround interventions yielded smaller effects. (JEL D44, H75, I21, I28)

10.1257/aer.20150479.abstractZh: 特许学校接管是指传统公立学校被重新设立为特许学校的过程。我们开发了一种针对接管事件的豁免工具，用于比较被指定接受接管的学校的学生与另一组参加类似但尚未被接管的学校的学生。来自新奥尔良的初步数据显示，通过接管策略增加入学人数带来了显著的效果。在波士顿，被豁免的学生在学业成绩上的提升幅度至少与通过抽签获得特许学校学位的学生相当。一项非特许学校但具有类似接管策略的转型干预措施也取得了与接管策略相当的效果，而其他较为温和的转型措施则产生了较小的效果。（JEL D44, H75, I21, I28）

abstract.text: We evaluate a tracking program in a large urban district where schools with at least one gifted fourth grader create a separate “gifted/high achiever” classroom. Most seats are filled by non-gifted high achievers, ranked by previous-year test scores. We study the program's effects on the high achievers using (i) a rank-based regres sion discontinuity design, and (ii) a between-school/cohort analysis. We find significant effects that are concentrated among black and Hispanic participants. Minorities gain 0.5 standard deviation units in fourth-grade reading and math scores, with persistent gains through sixth grade. We find no evidence of negative or positive spillovers on nonparticipants. (JEL I21, J21, J24)

10.1257/aer.20150484.abstractZh: 我们评估了一个大型城市区域的跟踪项目，该项目要求至少有一名资优四年级学生的学校设立一个专门的“资优/高成就学生”教室。大多数座位由非资优但高成就的学生占据，这些学生的排名基于前一年的测试成绩。我们使用（i）基于排名的回归不连续设计，以及（ii）校际/群体分析来研究该项目对高成就学生的影响。我们发现，这种影响主要集中在黑人和西班牙裔参与者身上。少数族裔在四年级的阅读和数学成绩上提高了0.5个标准差单位，并且这种提升一直持续到六年级。我们没有发现对非参与者产生负面或正面影响的证据。（JEL I21, J21, J24）

abstract.text: The Moving to Opportunity (MTO) experiment offered randomly selected families housing vouchers to move from high-poverty housing projects to lower-poverty neighborhoods. We analyze MTO's impacts on children's long-term outcomes using tax data. We find that moving to a lower-poverty neighborhood when young (before age 13) increases college attendance and earnings and reduces single parenthood rates. Moving as an adolescent has slightly negative impacts, perhaps because of disruption effects. The decline in the gains from moving with the age when children move suggests that the duration of exposure to better environments during childhood is an important determinant of children’s long-term outcomes.

10.1257/aer.20150572.abstractZh: “机会转移”实验向随机选定的家庭提供了住房券，使他们能够从高贫困住宅区搬至低贫困社区。我们利用税务数据分析了该实验对儿童长期发展的影响。研究发现，在年幼时期（13岁之前）搬至低贫困社区能够提升儿童上大学的比例和收入，并降低单亲家庭的比例。而在青少年时期进行迁移则会产生轻微的负面影响，这可能是由于迁移带来的生活中断效应。随着儿童迁移年龄的增长，迁移带来的收益逐渐下降，这表明在童年时期接触更好环境的时间长短是儿童长期发展的一个重要决定因素。

abstract.text: We study an investor who is unsure of the dynamics of the economy. Not only are parameters unknown, but the investor does not even know what order model to estimate. She estimates her consumption process nonparametrically—allowing potentially infinite-order dynamics—and prices assets using a pessimistic model that minimizes lifetime utility subject to a constraint on statistical plausibility. The equilibrium is exactly solvable and the pricing model always includes long-run risks. With risk aversion of 4.7, the model matches major facts about asset prices, consumption, and dividends. The paper provides a novel link between ambiguity aversion and nonparametric estimation. (JEL D11, D12, D81, G11, G12)

10.1257/aer.20150585.abstractZh: 我们研究了一位对经济动态不确定的投资者。不仅参数未知，这位投资者甚至不知道应该采用哪种阶数模型来进行估计。她采用非参数方法估计自己的消费过程——允许潜在的无限阶动态——并使用一种悲观模型来定价资产，该模型在统计合理性约束下最小化终身效用。均衡状态是可以精确求解的，而定价模型始终包含长期风险。在风险厌恶度为4.7的情况下，该模型与资产价格、消费和股息的主要事实相符。本文提出了一种将模糊厌恶与非参数估计相结合的新方法。（JEL D11, D12, D81, G11, G12）

abstract.text: Analyzing 474 cases of firms going public in the German capital between 1892 and 1913, we show that innovative firms could rely on the Berlin stock market as a source of financing. Our data also reveal that initial public offerings (IPO) of innovative firms were characterized by particularly low underpricing, comparatively high first trading prices, and no long-run underperformance. We interpret these empirical results as evidence for the surprising fact that in the period of the Second Industrial Revolution the Berlin stock exchange was already a well-functioning market for new technology. (JEL G14, N23)

10.1257/aer.20150626.abstractZh: 通过对1892年至1913年间在德国首都上市的474家公司的分析，我们发现创新型企业可以依赖柏林股市作为融资来源。我们的数据还显示，这些创新型企业的首次公开募股（IPO）具有较低的定价过低现象、相对较高的首次交易价格，并且长期来看并未出现表现不佳的情况。我们将这些实证结果解释为证据，表明在第二次工业革命时期，柏林证券交易所已经是一个运作良好的新技术市场。（JEL G14, N23）

abstract.text: We propose and operationalize normative principles to guide social decisions when individuals potentially have imprecise and heterogeneous beliefs, in addition to conflicting tastes or interests. To do so, we adapt the standard Pareto principle to those preference comparisons that are robust to belief imprecision and characterize social preferences that respect this robust principle. We also characterize a suitable restriction of this principle. The former principle provides stronger guidance when it can be satisfied; when it cannot, the latter always provides minimal guidance. (JEL D71, D81)

10.1257/aer.20150678.abstractZh: 我们提出了并具体化了规范性原则，以指导在个体持有不精确且异质的信念、以及存在冲突的偏好或利益时做出的社会决策。为此，我们将标准的帕累托原则适用于那些能够容忍信念不精确性的偏好比较，并描述了遵循这一原则的社交偏好。我们还提出了对这一原则的适当限制。当前者原则能够得到满足时，它能提供更强的指导；而当它无法得到满足时，后者原则始终能提供最少的指导。（JEL D71, D81）

abstract.text: We combine a theoretical discrete-choice model of vehicle purchases, an econometric analysis of electricity emissions, and the AP2 air pollution model to estimate the geographic variation in the environmental benefits from driving electric vehicles. The second-best electric vehicle purchase subsidy ranges from $2,785 in California to −$4,964 in North Dakota, with a mean of −$1,095. Ninety percent of local environmental externalities from driving electric vehicles in one state are exported to others, implying they may be subsidized locally, even when the environmental benefits are negative overall. Geographically differentiated subsidies can reduce deadweight loss, but only modestly. (JEL D12, D62, H23, L62, Q53, Q54, R11)

10.1257/aer.20150897.abstractZh: 我们结合了一个关于车辆购买的理论离散选择模型、对电力排放的经济计量分析，以及AP2空气污染模型，来估算驾驶电动汽车所带来的环境效益的地理差异。在加利福尼亚州，购买电动汽车的第二最佳补贴为2,785美元，而在北达科他州则为负4,964美元，平均值为-1,095美元。在一个州驾驶电动汽车所带来的90%的地方性环境外部性会被转移到其他州，这意味着即使整体环境效益为负，这些外部性也可能在当地得到补贴。地理差异化的补贴可以减少无谓损失，但效果有限。（JEL D12, D62, H23, L62, Q53, Q54, R11）

abstract.text: Regional shocks are an important feature of the US economy. Households' ability to self-insure against these shocks depends on how they affect local interest rates. In the United States, most borrowing occurs through the mortgage market and is influenced by the presence of government-sponsored enterprises (GSE). We establish that despite large regional variation in predictable default risk, GSE mortgage rates for otherwise identical loans do not vary spatially. In contrast, the private market does set interest rates which vary with local risk. We use a spatial model of collateralized borrowing to show that the national interest rate policy substantially affects welfare by redistributing resources across regions. (JEL E32, E43, G21, G28, L32, R11, R31)

10.1257/aer.20151052.abstractZh: 地区性冲击是美国经济的一个重要特征。家庭抵御这些冲击的自我保险能力取决于这些冲击对当地利率的影响。在美国，大多数借款是通过抵押贷款市场进行的，而这一市场受到政府资助企业的影响。我们发现，尽管可预测违约风险存在较大的地区差异，但政府资助企业提供的抵押贷款利率对于其他条件相同的贷款来说，在空间上并没有差异。相比之下，私人市场确实会设定利率，这些利率会随着当地风险的变化而波动。我们通过一个抵押借款的空间模型表明，国家利率政策通过在不同地区之间重新分配资源，对福利产生了显著影响。（JEL E32, E43, G21, G28, L32, R11, R31）

abstract.text: The conventional wisdom for the healthcare sector is that idiosyncratic features leave little scope for market forces to allocate consumers to higher performance producers. However, we find robust evidence - across several different conditions and performance measures - that higher quality hospitals have higher market shares and grow more over time. The relationship between performance and allocation is stronger among patients who have greater scope for hospital choice, suggesting that patient demand plays an important role in allocation. Our findings suggest that healthcare may have more in common with "traditional" sectors subject to market forces than often assumed.

10.1257/aer.20151080.abstractZh: 在医疗保健领域，传统观点认为，独特的特性使得市场力量在将消费者分配给性能更高的医疗机构方面几乎没有作用。然而，我们发现，在多种不同的条件和绩效指标下，高质量的医院拥有更高的市场份额，并且随着时间的推移而持续增长。对于那些有更大选择医院空间的患者来说，绩效与分配之间的关系更为紧密，这表明患者需求在分配过程中起着重要作用。我们的研究结果表明，医疗保健行业可能与那些受市场力量影响的“传统”行业有更多的共同点，而不仅仅是人们通常认为的那样。

abstract.text: We use a firm-CEO assignment framework to model the market for CEO effective labor. In the model’s equilibrium, more talented CEOs match with and supply more effort to larger firms. Taxation of CEO incomes affects the equilibrium pricing of CEO effective labor and, hence, spills over and affects firm profits. Absent the ability to tax profits or a direct concern for firm owners, a standard prescription for high marginal income taxes emerges. However, given such an ability or concern, the optimal marginal tax rates are much lower. (JEL D31, H21, M12)

10.1257/aer.20151093.abstractZh: 我们采用企业-首席执行官分配框架来模拟首席执行官有效劳动力的市场。在模型的均衡状态下，更有才华的首席执行官会与更大的企业进行匹配，并为这些企业提供更优质的服务。对首席执行官收入征税会影响首席执行官有效劳动力的均衡定价，进而波及企业利润。如果无法对利润征税，或者没有直接关注企业所有者的情况，那么高边际所得税的标准方案就会成为解决方案。然而，如果具备这样的能力或关注企业所有者的情况，那么最优的边际税率会低得多。（JEL D31, H21, M12）

abstract.text: I estimate the effects of removing low-income youth with disabilities from Supplemental Security Income (SSI) on their earnings and income in adulthood. Using a regression discontinuity design based on a 1996 policy change in age 18 medical reviews, I find that youth who are removed from SSI at age 18 recover one-third of the lost SSI cash income in earnings. SSI youth who are removed and stay off SSI earn on average $4,400 annually, and they lose $76,000 in present discounted observed income over the 16 years following removal relative to those who do not receive a review.

10.1257/aer.20151129.abstractZh: 我研究了将低收入残疾青少年从补充保障金计划中移除对其成年后的收入和收益的影响。基于1996年对18岁时进行医疗评估的政策调整，采用回归断点设计进行研究。结果发现，在18岁时被移除补充保障金的青少年，其收入损失的三分之一可以通过其他收入来源弥补。被移除且不再领取补充保障金的青少年，在移除后的16年内，年均收入仅为4,400美元，与未接受评估的青少年相比，其实际观察到的收入损失为76,000美元。

abstract.text: We present unique audit-study evidence on health care quality in rural India, and find that most private providers lacked medical qualifications, but completed more checklist items than public providers and recommended correct treatments equally often. Among doctors with public and private practices, all quality metrics were higher in their private clinics. Market prices are positively correlated with checklist completion and correct treatment, but also with unnecessary treatments. However, public sector salaries are uncorrelated with quality. A simple model helps interpret our findings: Where public-sector effort is low, the benefits of higher diagnostic effort among private providers may outweigh costs of potential overtreatment.

10.1257/aer.20151138.abstractZh: 我们提供了关于印度农村医疗保健质量的独特审计研究证据，发现大多数私人医疗服务提供者缺乏医学资格，但完成的检查项目数量比公共医疗服务提供者更多，并且同样经常推荐正确的治疗方法。在拥有公共和私人诊所的医生中，所有质量指标在私人诊所中均更高。市场价格与检查项目的完成情况和正确的治疗方法呈正相关，但也与不必要的治疗有关。然而，公共部门的薪资与质量并无相关性。一个简单的模型有助于解释我们的发现：在公共部门投入较低的情况下，私人医疗服务提供者增加诊断投入的好处可能超过潜在过度治疗的成本。

abstract.text: We study the optimal incentive scheme for a multistage project in which the agent privately observes intermediate progress. The optimal contract involves a soft deadline wherein the principal guarantees funding up to a certain date—if the agent reports progress at that date, then the principal gives him a relatively short hard deadline to complete the project—if progress is not reported at that date, then a probationary phase begins in which the project is randomly terminated at a constant rate until progress is reported. We explore several variants of the model with implications for optimal project design. In particular, we show that the principal benefits by imposing a small cost on the agent for submitting a progress report or by making the first stage of the project somewhat “harder” than the second. (JEL D82, D86, G32)

10.1257/aer.20151181.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个多阶段项目的最优激励方案，其中代理人可以私下了解项目的进展。最优合同包含一个软截止日期，即委托人在某个日期之前保证提供资金——如果代理人在该日期之前报告了进展，那么委托人会给他一个相对较短的硬性截止日期来完成项目；如果在该日期之前没有报告进展，则开始一个试用期，在此期间项目会以恒定的速率被随机终止，直到有进展报告为止。我们探讨了该模型的几种变体，这些变体对最优项目设计具有重要意义。特别地，我们表明，委托人可以通过对代理人提交进展报告施加较小的成本，或者使项目的第一阶段比第二阶段“更难”来获益。（JEL D82, D86, G32）

abstract.text: We endogenize entry to a security-bid auction, where participation is costly and bidders must decide given their private valuations whether to participate. We first consider any minimum reserve security-bid of a fixed expected value that weakly exceeds the asset's value when retained by the seller. DeMarzo, Kremer, and Skrzypacz (2005) establish that with a fixed number of bidders, auctions with steeper securities yield the seller more revenues. Counterintuitively, we find that auctions with steeper securities also attract more entry, further enhancing the revenues from such auctions. We then establish that with optimal reserve securities, auctions with steeper securities always yield higher expected revenues. (JEL D44)

10.1257/aer.20151538.abstractZh: 我们探讨了进入证券竞拍的门槛问题，参与竞拍的成本很高，竞拍者必须根据自身的私人估值来决定是否参与。我们首先考虑了任何固定预期价值的最低储备证券竞拍，这种竞拍在卖方保留该证券时，其价值会略微超过资产本身的价值。DeMarzo、Kremer和Skrzypacz（2005年）的研究表明，在固定数量的竞拍者参与下，证券收益率较高的竞拍能为卖方带来更多收入。与直觉相反，我们发现证券收益率较高的竞拍反而会吸引更多的参与者，从而进一步增加此类竞拍的收入。随后，我们证明了在最优储备证券的情况下，证券收益率较高的竞拍总能带来更高的预期收入。（JEL D44）

abstract.text: This paper shows that an income effect can drive expenditure switching between domestic and imported goods. We use a unique Latvian scanner-level dataset, covering the 2008–2009 crisis, to document several empirical findings. First, expenditure switching accounted for one-third of the fall in imports, and took place within narrowly defined product groups. Second, there was no corresponding within-group change in relative prices. Third, consumers substituted from expensive imports to cheaper domestic alternatives. These findings motivate us to estimate a model of nonhomothetic consumer demand, which explains two-thirds of the observed expenditure switching. Estimated switching is driven by income, not changes in relative prices. (JEL E21, F14, F31, F32, I11, L81)

10.1257/aer.20160251.abstractZh: 本文表明，收入效应可以驱动消费者在国产商品和进口商品之间的支出选择。我们使用了一份独特的拉脱维亚级扫描数据集合，该数据集涵盖了2008-2009年的经济危机时期，以验证若干实证发现。首先，支出选择占进口下降幅度的三分之一，且主要发生在特定产品组内。其次，组内相对价格并未发生相应的变化。第三，消费者从昂贵的进口商品转向更便宜的国产商品。这些发现促使我们构建一个非齐次消费者需求模型，该模型能够解释观察到的支出选择变化中的三分之二。估计的支出选择变化是由收入驱动的，而非相对价格的变化所致。（JEL E21, F14, F31, F32, I11, L81）

abstract.text: "Big data" and statistical techniques to score potential transactions have transformed insurance and credit markets. In this paper, we observe that these widely-used statistical scores summarize a much richer heterogeneity, and may be endogenous to the context in which they get applied. We demonstrate this point empirically using data from Medicare Part D, showing that risk scores confound underlying health and endogenous spending response to insurance. We then illustrate theoretically that when individuals have heterogeneous behavioral responses to contracts, strategic incentives for cream skimming can still exist, even in the presence of "perfect" risk scoring under a given contract.

10.1257/app.20150131.abstractZh: “大数据”和统计技术被用于评估潜在交易，这已经改变了保险和信贷市场。在本文中，我们观察到这些广泛使用的统计评分能够概括出更为丰富的异质性，并且这些评分可能受到其应用环境的内部影响。我们通过Medicare Part D的数据进行了实证验证，发现风险评分会混淆了个体的基本健康状况以及对保险的内生消费反应。我们还从理论上说明，当个体对合同有异质性的行为反应时，即使在给定的合同下实现了“完美”的风险评分，仍然存在通过策略性行为获取额外收益的可能性。

abstract.text: We investigate the impact of limited network insurance plans in the context of the Massachusetts Group Insurance Commission (GIC), the insurance plan for state employees. Our quasi-experimental analysis examines the introduction of a major financial incentive to choose limited network plans that affected a subset of GIC enrollees. We find that enrollees are very price sensitive in their decision to enroll in limited network plans. Those who switched spent almost 40 percent less on medical care. This reflects reductions in the quantity of services and prices paid per service. The spending reductions came from specialist and hospital care, while spending on primary care rose. (JEL G22, H75, I11, I13, J45)

10.1257/pol.20140335.abstractZh: 我们研究了在马萨诸塞州团体保险委员会（GIC）的框架下，有限网络保险计划的影响。该委员会为州政府雇员提供保险计划。我们的准实验分析考察了引入一项重大经济激励措施以促使人们选择有限网络保险计划的情况，这一措施影响了部分GIC参保者。我们发现，参保者在决定是否选择有限网络保险计划时非常关注价格因素。那些更换保险计划的人，在医疗护理方面的支出减少了近40%。这反映出服务数量以及每项服务支付的价格都有所下降。支出减少主要体现在专科医疗和医院护理上，而初级医疗服务的支出则有所上升。（JEL G22, H75, I11, I13, J45）

abstract.text: This paper contributes to the literature on the labor market consequences of obesity by using a novel instrument: genetic risk score, which reflects the predisposition to higher body mass index (BMI) across many genetic loci. We estimate instrumental variable models of the effect of BMI on labor market outcomes using Finnish data that have many strengths, for example, BMI that is measured rather than self-reported, and data on earnings and social income transfers that are from administrative tax records and are thus free of the problems associated with nonresponse, reporting error or top coding. The empirical results are sensitive to whether we use a narrower or broader genetic risk score, and to model specification. For example, models using the narrower genetic risk score as an instrument imply that a one-unit increase in BMI is associated with 6.9% lower wages, 1.8% fewer years employed, and a 3 percentage point higher probability of receiving any social income transfers. However, when we use a newer, broader genetic risk score, we cannot reject the null hypothesis of no effect. Future research using genetic risk scores should examine the sensitivity of their results to the risk score used.

10.2139/ssrn.2776912.abstractZh: 本文通过引入一种新颖的工具变量——遗传风险评分，为关于肥胖对劳动力市场影响的文献做出了贡献。遗传风险评分能够反映多个遗传位点对较高体重指数（BMI）的倾向性。我们使用芬兰的数据来估计BMI对劳动力市场结果的影响，这些数据具有许多优势，例如BMI是通过测量而非自我报告获得的，以及关于收入和社会收入转移的数据来自行政税务记录，因此不存在无应答、报告错误或最高编码等问题。实证结果对我们使用的遗传风险评分的狭窄或宽泛程度，以及模型设定方式非常敏感。例如，使用较窄的遗传风险评分作为工具变量时，BMI每增加1单位，工资会降低6.9%，就业年限会减少1.8%，接受社会收入转移的概率则会增加3个百分点。然而，当我们使用较新的、更宽泛的遗传风险评分时，我们无法拒绝无效应的零假设。未来使用遗传风险评分的研究应考察结果对所使用的风险评分的敏感性。

abstract.text: Informal care may substitute for formal long-term care that is often publicly funded or subsidized. The costs of informal caregiving are borne by the caregiver and may consist of worse health outcomes and, if the caregiver has not retired, worse labor market outcomes. We estimate the impact of providing informal care to one's partner on the caregiver's health using data from the Survey of Health, Ageing, and Retirement in Europe. We use statistical matching to deal with selection bias and endogeneity. We find that in the short run caregiving has a substantial effect on the health of caregivers and, for female caregivers, on their health care use. These effects should be taken into account when comparing the costs and benefits of formal and informal care provision. The health effects may, however, be short-lived, as we do not find any evidence that they persist after 4 or 7 years.

10.2139/ssrn.2880395.abstractZh: 非正式护理可以替代通常由公共资金或补贴支持的正式长期护理。非正式护理的成本由护理者承担，这可能导致护理者的健康状况恶化，如果护理者尚未退休，还可能导致其劳动力市场表现不佳。我们利用《欧洲健康、老龄化与退休调查》的数据，评估为伴侣提供非正式护理对护理者健康的影响。我们通过统计匹配方法来处理选择偏差和内生性问题。研究发现，短期内，护理对护理者的健康有显著影响，对于女性护理者来说，还影响了她们的医疗使用情况。在比较正式与非正式护理提供的成本和收益时，应考虑到这些影响。然而，这些健康影响可能是短暂的，因为我们没有发现它们在4年或7年后仍然持续存在的证据。

abstract.text: The decline in the physical stature of the American population for more than a generation beginning with the birth cohorts of the early 1830s was brought about by a diminution in nutritional intake in spite of robust growth in average incomes. This occurred at the onset of modern economic growth on account of rising inequality and an increase in food prices, which brought about dietary changes through the substitution away from edibles toward non-edibles. In a recent working paper, Bodenhorn, Guinnane, and Mroz question this consensus view, suggesting that a decline in heights in a military sample may not be representative of the population at large. They argue that increasing wages in the civilian labor market may well induce an increased proportion of shorter men to volunteer for military service thereby driving down the mean height of soldiers even if the height of the population remains unchanged. However, they neglected to examine whether labor market conditions did actually improve during the Civil War in such a way as to induce shorter men to enlist. Had they done so they would have found just the opposite: during the course of the war real compensation in the military increased by some 39% to 66% relative to civilian earnings. This should have led to an increase in military heights if the logic of their model were accurate, when in fact they declined. Both the historical evidence and an assessment of the model indicate that failing to consider patriotism as a powerful motive for enlisting was another serious error. A thorough analysis of the Union Army height data, considering recruiting periods as short as 90 days during which labor market conditions could not have changed markedly indicates that there can be no doubt at all that the decline in the height of soldiers beginning with the birth cohorts of the early 1830s is representative of the trend in the physical stature of the male population at large. The implication is that there was a widespread diminution in nutritional status of the population in the antebellum period.

10.3386/w21845.abstractZh: 自19世纪30年代初出生的一代开始，美国人口的身体身高持续下降了一代以上。尽管平均收入有所增长，但营养摄入却减少了。这一现象出现在现代经济增长初期，由于不平等加剧和食品价格上涨，人们的饮食方式发生了改变，从食用食物转向食用非食物。在最近的一篇工作论文中，Bodenhorn、Guinnane和Mroz对这一普遍观点提出了质疑，他们认为军事样本中的身高下降可能并不代表整个人口的情况。他们指出，民用劳动力市场的工资上涨可能会促使更多较矮的男性自愿参军，从而降低士兵的平均身高，即使整个人口的高度保持不变。然而，他们忽略了在内战期间劳动力市场状况是否确实有所改善，从而促使较矮的男性参军。如果他们进行了这样的研究，就会发现实际情况恰恰相反：在战争期间，军队中的实际报酬相对于平民收入增加了39%到66%。如果他们的模型逻辑正确，这本应该导致军队中身高增加，但实际上却出现了下降。历史证据和对模型的评估都表明，没有将爱国主义作为参军的强大动机来考虑，是另一个严重的错误。对联邦军队身高数据的深入分析表明，考虑到招募期仅为90天，而在此期间劳动力市场状况几乎没有显著变化，士兵身高从19世纪30年代初出生的一代开始下降，这一现象无疑代表了整个男性人口身体尺度的变化趋势。这意味着，在内战前的时期，人口的营养状况普遍有所下降。

abstract.text: The dependent care mandate is one of the most popular provisions of the 2010 Affordable Care Act (ACA). This provision requires that employer-based insurance plans cover health care expenditures for workers with children 26 years old or younger. While there has been considerable scholarly and policy interest in the effects of this mandate on health insurance coverage among young adults, there has been little scholarly work measuring the costs and incidence of this mandate and who pays the costs of it. In our empirical work, we exploit the fact that some states had dependent care mandates in years prior to the passage of the ACA. Using data from the Survey of Income and Program Participation (SIPP), we find that workers at firms with employer-based coverage – whether or not they have dependent children – experience an annual reduction in wages of approximately $1,200. Our results imply that the marginal costs of mandated employer-based coverage expansions are not entirely borne only by the people whose coverage is expanded by the mandate.

10.3386/w21846.abstractZh: 依赖护理强制规定是2010年《平价医疗法案》中最受欢迎的条款之一。该条款要求雇主提供的保险计划为26岁或以下的子女提供医疗保健服务。尽管学术界和政策界对这项强制规定对年轻成年人医疗保险覆盖的影响进行了大量研究，但关于该强制规定带来的成本和影响以及谁来承担这些成本的研究却很少。在我们的实证研究中，我们利用了一些州在《平价医疗法案》通过之前就已经实施了依赖护理强制规定的事实。通过《收入与计划参与调查》的数据，我们发现，在拥有雇主提供保险的公司工作的员工——无论他们是否有依赖子女——每年工资都会减少约1,200美元。我们的研究结果表明，强制实施雇主提供保险扩展所带来的边际成本并不完全由那些因强制规定而获得保险扩展的人承担。

abstract.text: Worldwide, extreme poverty is often concentrated in spaces where people and property are not safe enough to sustain effective markets, and where development assistance is dangerous – and might even induce violence. Expanding governance by coercively taking control of territory may enable markets and development programs, but costs to local residents may exceed benefits, especially if that expansion is violent. We estimate for the first time whether a large counterinsurgency program improves welfare. We exploit the staggered roll-out of the Philippine “Peace and Development Teams” counterinsurgency program, which treated 12% of the population between 2002 and 2010. Though treatment temporarily increased violence, the program progressively reduced child malnutrition: by 10% in the first year, and by 30% from year three onwards. Improved nutritional status was not due to increased health and welfare expenditures, but instead to improved governance. Treatment effects are comparable to those of conventional child health interventions, though conventional programs are likely infeasible in this setting. Rebels apparently react to treatment by shifting to neighboring municipalities, as malnutrition worsens there – with statistically significant 'treatment' effects of similar size. Thus overall program effects are close to zero. These findings invite an evidence-based discussion of governance expansion, an extensive margin of development.

10.3386/w21849.abstractZh: 在全球范围内，极端贫困往往集中在人们和财产都不够安全、无法维持有效市场的地区，而发展援助在这些地区可能带来危险，甚至可能引发暴力。通过强制控制领土来扩大治理可能有助于市场和发展项目的实施，但当地居民可能付出的代价超过收益，尤其是当这种扩张以暴力手段进行时。我们首次估算了大型反叛乱计划是否能够提高福利水平。我们利用了菲律宾“和平与发展团队”反叛乱计划的逐步实施情况，该计划在2002年至2010年间覆盖了12%的人口。尽管该计划暂时增加了暴力行为，但逐渐减少了儿童营养不良的情况：第一年减少了10%，从第三年开始则减少了30%。营养状况的改善并非由于增加了健康和福利支出，而是由于治理的改善。该计划的效果与传统儿童健康干预措施相当，尽管在这种环境下，传统项目可能难以实施。反叛分子显然会转向邻近的市镇，因为那里的营养不良情况更加严重——“治疗”效果同样显著。因此，整个项目的效果接近于零。这些发现促使我们基于证据来讨论治理的扩展问题，这是一个广泛的发展领域。

abstract.text: A crucial issue in studying social insurance programs is whether they affect work decisions through income or substitution effects. We examine this in the context of U.S. Social Security Disability Insurance (DI), one of the largest social insurance programs in the U.S. The formula linking DI payments to past earnings has discontinuous changes in the marginal replacement rate that allow us to use a regression kink design to estimate the effect of payment size on earnings. Using Social Security Administration data on all new DI beneficiaries from 2001 to 2007, we document a robust income effect of DI payments on earnings. Our preferred estimate is that an increase in DI payments of one dollar causes an average decrease in beneficiaries’ earnings of twenty cents. This suggests that the income effect represents an important factor in driving DI-induced reductions in earnings.

10.3386/w21851.abstractZh: 在研究社会保险计划时，一个关键问题是这些计划是通过收入效应还是替代效应来影响工作决策的。我们在美国社会保障残疾保险（DI）的背景下进行了这项研究，该保险是美国最大的社会保险计划之一。将DI支付与过去收入联系起来的公式在边际替代率上存在不连续变化，这使我们能够使用回归拐点设计来估计支付规模对收入的影响。利用社会保障管理局2001年至2007年所有新DI受益人的数据，我们发现DI支付对收入有显著的收入效应。我们更倾向于认为，DI支付增加一美元会导致受益人的平均收入减少二十美分。这表明收入效应是驱动DI导致的收入减少的一个重要因素。

abstract.text: Substantial practice variation across physicians for seemingly similar patients remains an unresolved puzzle. This paper studies physicians in training to explore the behavioral foundations of practice variation. A discontinuity in the formation of teams reveals a large contribution of relative experience in the size of practice variation. Among the same physician trainees, convergence towards a common practice differs by practice environment, with more convergence in specialist-driven services. Rich trainee characteristics and training histories, including the practice styles of prior supervising physicians, explain little if any variation. These findings suggest a major role for informational frictions in the origins of practice variation.

10.3386/w21855.abstractZh: 不同医生在处理看似相似的患者时，其实践方式存在显著差异，这一现象至今仍是一个未解之谜。本文研究的是培训中的医生，旨在探讨实践差异的行为基础。团队组建过程中存在的不连续性表明，相对经验在实践规模差异中起着重要作用。在同一医生培训群体中，不同实践环境的医生在形成共同实践方式方面的趋同性程度不同，而在由专家主导的服务中，这种趋同性更为明显。丰富的培训背景和经历，包括前任指导医生的工作风格，对实践差异的变异几乎没有影响。这些发现表明，信息摩擦在实践差异的成因中起着重要作用。

abstract.text: Moral hazard and adverse selection create inefficiencies in private health insurance markets and understanding the relative importance of each factor is critical for policy. We use claims data from a large firm to isolate moral hazard from plan selection. Previous studies have attempted to estimate moral hazard in private health insurance by assuming that individuals respond only to the spot price, end-of-year price, expected price, or a related metric. The nonlinear budget constraints generated by health insurance plans make these assumptions especially poor and we statistically reject their appropriateness. We study the differential impact of the health insurance plans offered by the firm on the entire distribution of medical expenditures without assuming that individuals only respond to a parameterized price. Our empirical strategy exploits the introduction of new plans during the sample period as a shock to plan generosity, and we account for sample attrition over time. We use an instrumental variable quantile estimation technique that provides quantile treatment effects for each plan, while conditioning on a set of covariates for identification purposes. This technique allows us to map the resulting estimated medical expenditure distributions to the nonlinear budget sets generated by each plan. We estimate that 53% of the additional medical spending observed in the most generous plan in our data relative to the least generous is due to moral hazard. The remainder can be attributed to adverse selection. A policy which resulted in each person enrolling in the least generous plan would cause the annual premium of that plan to rise by $1,000.

10.3386/w21858.abstractZh: 道德风险与逆向选择导致了私人健康保险市场的效率低下，了解这两个因素的相对重要性对于政策制定至关重要。我们利用一家大型公司的理赔数据，将道德风险与计划选择分离开来。以往的研究试图通过假设个体仅对即时价格、年末价格、预期价格或相关指标作出反应来估算私人健康保险中的道德风险。然而，健康保险计划产生的非线性预算约束使得这些假设尤其不合理，我们在统计上否定了这些假设的有效性。我们研究了公司提供的健康保险计划对整个医疗支出分布的不同影响，而没有假设个体仅对参数化价格作出反应。我们的实证策略利用了样本期间新计划的引入作为对计划慷慨程度的冲击，并考虑了随时间变化的样本流失情况。我们采用了一种工具变量分位数估计技术，该技术为每种计划提供了分位数处理效应，同时基于一组协变量进行识别。这一技术使我们能够将估计出的医疗支出分布与每种计划产生的非线性预算集联系起来。我们的估计显示，在数据中，最慷慨的计划与最不慷慨的计划相比，额外医疗支出的53%是由于道德风险造成的。其余部分则归因于逆向选择。如果实施一项政策，使得每个人都选择最不慷慨的计划，那么该计划的年保费将增加1000美元。

abstract.text: Japan has experienced pronounced population aging, and now has the highest proportion of elderly adults in the world. Yet few projections of Japan’s future demography go beyond estimating population by age and sex to forecast the complex evolution of the health and functioning of the future elderly. This study adapts to the Japanese population the Future Elderly Model (FEM), a demographic and economic state-transition microsimulation model that projects the health conditions and functional status of Japan’s elderly population in order to estimate disability, health, and need for long term care. Our FEM simulation suggests that by 2040, over 27 percent of Japan’s elderly will exhibit 3 or more limitations in IADLs and social functioning; almost one in 4 will experience difficulties with 3 or more ADLs; and approximately one in 5 will suffer limitations in cognitive or intellectual functioning. Since the majority of the increase in disability arises from the aging of the Japanese population, prevention efforts that reduce age-specific disability (or future compression of morbidity among middle-aged Japanese) may have only a limited impact on reducing the overall prevalence of disability among Japanese elderly.

10.3386/w21870.abstractZh: 日本正经历着显著的人口老龄化，目前老年人口比例位居世界最高。然而，对于日本未来人口结构的预测，大多仅停留在按年龄和性别划分人口的基础上，难以预测未来老年人口在健康与功能方面的复杂变化。本研究将“未来老年模型”（FEM）应用于日本人口，该模型是一种人口与经济状态转移微模拟模型，用于预测日本老年人口的健康状况和功能状态，从而评估残疾、健康状况以及长期护理需求。我们的FEM模拟结果显示，到2040年，超过27%的日本老年人将在日常生活活动和社会功能方面存在3项或更多限制；几乎四分之一的人会在3项或更多日常生活活动方面遇到困难；大约五分之一的人会在认知或智力功能方面存在限制。由于残疾人数的增加主要源于日本人口的老龄化，因此旨在减少特定年龄段的残疾的预防措施（或降低中年日本人的未来发病率）对降低日本老年人口的整体残疾率可能只有有限的效果。

abstract.text: Medicaid is a government program that provides health insurance to the old who are sick and have little assets and income compared to their medical needs. Thus, it explicitly tests for income, assets, and health or medical needs to determine eligibility. We ask how these rules map into the reality of Medicaid recipiency and what observable characteristics are important to determine who ends up on Medicaid. The data show that both singles and couples with high retirement income can end up on Medicaid at very advanced ages. We find that, conditioning on a large number of observable characteristics, including those that directly relate to Medicaid eligibility criteria, single women are more likely to end up on Medicaid. So are non-whites, but, surprisingly, their higher recipiency is concentrated above the lower income percentiles. We also find that low-income people with a high school diploma or higher are much less likely to end up on Medicaid than their more educated counterparts. All of these effects are large and depend on retirement income in a very non-linear way.

10.3386/w21873.abstractZh: 医疗补助是一项政府计划，为那些年老、患病且资产与收入不足以满足医疗需求的人群提供健康保险。因此，该计划会明确审查收入、资产以及健康或医疗需求状况，以确定是否符合资格。我们探讨了这些规则在医疗补助资格认定中的实际体现，以及哪些可观测特征对确定谁能够获得医疗补助至关重要。数据显示，拥有高退休收入的单身人士和已婚夫妇即使在高龄时也可能获得医疗补助。研究发现，在考虑大量可观测特征的情况下，包括那些直接与医疗补助资格标准相关的特征，单身女性更有可能获得医疗补助。非白人人群也是如此，但令人惊讶的是，他们的较高资格获得率集中在较低收入人群之上。此外，拥有高中文凭或更高学历的低收入人群，比受教育程度较高的群体更不可能获得医疗补助。所有这些影响都相当显著，并且与退休收入的关系呈现出非常非线性的特征。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the effects of environmental conditions during pregnancy on later life outcomes using quasi-experimental variation created by the immigration of Ethiopian Jews to Israel in May 24th 1991. Children in utero prior to immigration faced dramatic differences in medical care technologies, prenatal conditions, and prenatal care at the move from Ethiopia to Israel. One of the major differences was adequacy of micronutrient supplements, particularly iodine, iron and folic acid. We find that children exposed in an earlier stage of the pregnancy to better environmental conditions in utero have two decades later higher educational attainment (lower repetition and dropout rates and higher Baccalaureate rate) and higher education quality (achieve a higher proficiency level in their Baccalaureate diploma). The average treatment effect we estimate is driven mainly by a strong effect on girls. We find however, no effect on birth weight or mortality for girls.

10.3386/w21894.abstractZh: 本文通过1991年5月24日埃塞俄比亚犹太人移民到以色列这一事件所创造的准实验变量，研究了孕期环境条件对后期生活结果的影响。在移民之前，胎儿在医疗技术、产前条件以及从埃塞俄比亚到以色列的过渡期间所面临的状况存在显著差异。其中一个主要差异在于微量营养素补充剂的充足性，尤其是碘、铁和叶酸。我们发现，在孕期早期就处于较佳环境条件下的胎儿，在二十年后受教育程度更高（重复率和辍学率更低，学士学位率更高），且教育质量也更好（在学士学位考试中取得更高的成绩）。我们估计的平均处理效应主要对女孩有显著影响。然而，我们发现这对女孩的出生体重或死亡率没有显著影响。
