abstract.text: A longstanding literature explores how altruism affects the way physicians respond to incentives and provide care. We analyze how patient socioeconomic status mediates these responses. We show theoretically that patient socioeconomic status systematically influences the way physicians respond to reimbursement changes, and we identify the channels through which these effects operate. We use two Medicare reimbursement changes to investigate these insights empirically. We confirm that a given physician facing an increase in reimbursement boosts utilization by more when treating richer patients. We show that average supply price elasticities vary from 0.02 to 0.18 for a given physician, depending on the patient’s socioeconomic status. Finally, we show that the Medicare reforms we study led to overall reimbursement increases that raised healthcare utilization by 10% more for high-income patients compared to their low-income peers.

10.3386/w21930.abstractZh: 已有大量文献探讨了利他主义如何影响医生对激励措施的响应以及提供医疗服务的方式。我们分析了患者社会经济地位如何中介这些响应。从理论上讲，患者社会经济地位系统性地影响着医生对报销政策变化的反应，并且我们确定了这些效应作用的渠道。我们通过两个医疗保险报销政策的变动来实证研究这些发现。我们确认，面对报销增加的情况，某位医生在治疗富裕患者时，其服务利用率会相应提高。我们还发现，对于同一位医生而言，平均供应价格弹性从0.02到0.18不等，这取决于患者所处的社会经济地位。最后，我们指出，我们所研究的医疗保险改革导致整体报销金额增加，使得高收入患者的医疗服务利用率比低收入患者高出10%。

abstract.text: This paper aims to identify the causal effect of smoking on body mass index (BMI) using data from the Lung Health Study, a randomized trial of smoking cessation treatments. Since nicotine is a metabolic stimulant and appetite suppressant, quitting or reducing smoking could lead to weight gain. Using randomized treatment assignment to instrument for smoking, we estimate that quitting smoking leads to an average long- run weight gain of 1.8-1.9 BMI units, or 11-12 pounds at the average height. These results imply that the drop in smoking in recent decades explains 14% of the concurrent rise in obesity. Semi-parametric models provide evidence of a diminishing marginal effect of smoking on BMI, while subsample regressions show that the impact is largest for younger individuals, females, those with no college degree, and those in the lowest quartile of baseline BMI.

10.3386/w21937.abstractZh: 本文旨在利用“肺健康研究”的数据，分析吸烟对体重指数（BMI）的因果效应。该研究是一项关于戒烟治疗的随机对照试验。由于尼古丁具有刺激代谢和抑制食欲的作用，戒烟或减少吸烟量可能会导致体重增加。通过随机处理分配方法对吸烟的影响进行估计，我们发现戒烟会导致平均长期体重增加1.8-1.9个BMI单位，相当于平均身高下增加11-12磅。这些结果表明，近几十年来吸烟率的下降解释了肥胖率同期上升的14%。半参数模型表明，吸烟对BMI的边际影响逐渐减弱，而子样本回归分析显示，这种影响在较年轻的人群、女性、没有大学学位的人群以及BMI基线处于最低四分位的人群中最为显著。

abstract.text: To what extent is the length of our lives determined by pre-birth factors? And to what extent is it affected by parental resources during our upbringing that can be influenced by public policy? We study the formation of adult health and mortality using data on about 21,000 adoptees born between 1940 and 1967. The data include detailed information on both biological and adopting parents. We find that the health of the biological parents affects the health of their adopted children. Thus, we confirm that genes and conditions in utero are important intergenerational transmission channels for long-term health. However, we also find strong evidence that the educational attainment of the adopting mother has a significant impact on the health of her adoptive children, suggesting that family environment and resources in the post-birth years have long-term consequences for children’s health.

10.3386/w21946.abstractZh: 我们的寿命在多大程度上由出生前的因素决定？而在多大程度上又受到父母在养育过程中的资源影响，而这些资源又可能受到公共政策的干预？我们通过约21,000名1940至1967年间出生的被收养者的数据来研究成年后的健康和死亡率。这些数据包含了被收养者及其亲生父母的详细信息。我们发现，亲生父母的健康状况对其被收养子女的健康状况有着重要影响。因此，我们确认基因和子宫内的环境是长期健康的重要传递途径。然而，我们还发现，收养母亲的受教育程度对其被收养子女的健康状况有着显著的影响，这表明家庭环境和出生后的资源对子女的健康有着长期的影響。

abstract.text: In a world with limited PAYGO financing possibilities this paper explores whether older Spanish individuals have the health capacity to work longer. For that purpose we use Milligan-Wise and Cutler-Meara Cutler-Meara- Richards-Shubik simulation methods. Our results suggest that Spanish workers have significant additional capacities to extend their working careers.

10.3386/w21973.abstractZh: 在一个资金有限的背景下，本文探讨了西班牙老年人群体是否具备更长时间工作的健康能力。为此，我们采用了Milligan-Wise和Cutler-Meara-Cutler-Meara-Richards-Shubik模拟方法。研究结果表明，西班牙工人拥有显著的额外能力，可以延长其工作生涯。

abstract.text: Over the last two decades policy reforms in the Netherlands have increased work incentives, resulting in rising employment rates at older ages. Over the same period health of the population has increased as well. A natural question is how much people could work taking into account their health status. As the other chapters in this volume, we use two approaches to answering this question. The first approach takes the relation between mortality and employment in 1981 as a base and then estimates what employment rates could be in 2010 if the relation between mortality and employment were the same in 1981 and 2010. The estimated additional work capacity based on this approach is about 50 percentage points for males at age 65. A second approach estimates the relation between health and employment in the age interval 50-54 and then predicts employment at later ages using health at these later ages. This leads to an estimated additional work capacity in 2010 of more than 75 percentage points for males aged 65-74. When including mortality as an additional health indicator to control for unobserved health differences in the latter approach, the estimated work capacities are more in line with those from the former approach: about 53 percentage points for males aged 65-69 and 44 percentage points for males aged 70-74.

10.3386/w21976.abstractZh: 在过去二十年里，荷兰的政策改革增加了工作激励措施，导致老年人口的就业率上升。同一时期，人口的健康状况也有所改善。一个自然的问题是，考虑到人们的健康状况，他们能够工作多少时间。如同本卷其他章节一样，我们采用两种方法来回答这个问题。第一种方法以1981年的死亡率与就业率的关系为基础，然后估计如果1981年和2010年的死亡率与就业率关系保持不变，那么2010年的就业率会是多少。根据这种方法估算的男性65岁时的额外工作能力约为50个百分点。第二种方法估计了50-54岁年龄段的健康状况与就业率之间的关系，然后利用这些年龄段的健康状况来预测以后的就业情况。这种方法得出的结果显示，65-74岁男性在2010年的额外工作能力超过75个百分点。当在第二种方法中加入死亡率作为额外的健康指标以控制未观察到的健康差异时，估算出的工作能力与第一种方法的结果更为一致：65-69岁男性的额外工作能力约为53个百分点，70-74岁男性的额外工作能力约为44个百分点。

abstract.text: It is well known that a substantial part of income and education is passed on from parents to children, generating substantial persistence in socio-economic status across generations. In this paper, we examine whether another form of human capital, health, is also largely transmitted from generation to generation, contributing to limited socio-economic mobility. Using data from the NLSY, we first present new evidence on intergenerational transmission of health outcomes in the U.S., including weight, height, the body mass index (BMI), asthma and depression for both natives and immigrants. We show that both native and immigrant children inherit a prominent fraction of their health status from their parents, and that, on average, immigrants experience higher persistence than natives in weight and BMI. We also find that mothers’ education decreases children’s weight and BMI for natives, while single motherhood increases weight and BMI for both native and immigrant children. Finally, we find that the longer immigrants remain in the U.S., the less intergenerational persistence there is and the more immigrants look like native children. Unfortunately, the more generations immigrant families remain in the U.S., the more children of immigrants resemble natives’ higher weights, higher BMI and increased propensity to suffer from asthma.

10.3386/w21987.abstractZh: 众所周知，相当一部分收入和教育资源是从父母传递给子女的，这导致社会经济地位在代际间得以持续保持。本文探讨了另一种形式的人力资本——健康，是否同样在代际间传递，从而影响了社会经济流动性的有限性。利用NLSY的数据，我们首先提供了关于美国健康结果代际传递的新证据，包括体重、身高、体质指数（BMI）、哮喘和抑郁等健康指标，这些数据涵盖了本土居民和移民。我们发现，无论是本土居民还是移民儿童，都继承了其父母相当一部分的健康状况，并且平均而言，移民在体重和BMI方面的持续性高于本土居民。我们还发现，对于本土居民来说，母亲的教育水平会降低子女的体重和BMI；而对于移民儿童来说，单亲家庭则会增加他们的体重和BMI。最后，我们发现，移民在美国停留的时间越长，代际间的持续性就越低，而移民子女则越接近本土居民的体重、BMI以及患哮喘的倾向。不幸的是，移民家庭在美国停留的世代越久，移民子女就越具有本土居民的较高体重、较高BMI以及更高的哮喘患病风险。

abstract.text: We develop and implement what we believe is the first conceptually valid health-inclusive poverty measure (HIPM)—a measure that includes health care or insurance in the poverty needs threshold and health insurance benefits in family resources—and we discuss its limitations. Building on the Census Bureau’s Supplemental Poverty Measure, we construct a pilot HIPM for the under-65 population under ACA-like health reform in Massachusetts. This pilot is intended to demonstrate the practicality, face validity and value of a HIPM. Results suggest that public health insurance benefits and premium subsidies accounted for a substantial, one-third reduction in the poverty rate. Among low-income families who purchased individual insurance, premium subsidies reduced poverty by 9.4 percentage points.

10.3386/w21990.abstractZh: 我们开发并实施了我们认为首个概念上有效的健康包容型贫困衡量指标——该指标将医疗保健或保险纳入贫困需求阈值中，并将健康保险福利纳入家庭资源中。同时，我们讨论了该指标的局限性。基于人口普查局的补充贫困衡量指标，我们为马萨诸塞州类似《平价医疗法案》的健康改革下的65岁以下人群构建了一个试点健康包容型贫困衡量指标。该试点旨在展示该指标的实际应用价值、表面效度和价值。结果表明，公共健康保险福利和保费补贴使贫困率降低了三分之一。在购买了个人保险的低收入家庭中，保费补贴使贫困率降低了9.4个百分点。

abstract.text: This study uses county-level variation in implementation of calorie labeling laws in the US to identify the effects of such laws on body mass. Using the 2003 to 2012 waves of the Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System, we find a statistically insignificant average treatment effect for women and a small, statistically significant and negative average treatment effect for men, indicating a decrease in BMI after implementation of calorie-labeling laws. We estimate finite mixture models and discover that the average treatment effects mask substantial heterogeneity in the effects across three classes of women and men. For both women and men, the three classes, determined within the model, can be described as a subpopulation with normal weight, a second one that is overweight on average and a third one that is obese on average. Estimates from finite mixture models show that the effect is largely concentrated among a class of women with BMI distributions centered on overweight. The effects for men are statistically significant for each of the three classes and large for men in the overweight and obese classes. These results suggest that overweight and obese individuals are especially sensitive to relevant information.

10.3386/w21992.abstractZh: 本研究利用美国各县级地区实施卡路里标签法律的情况，来研究此类法律对体重的影响。通过2003年至2012年的行为风险因素监测系统数据，我们发现女性实施卡路里标签法律后的平均处理效应并不显著，而男性则表现出统计学上显著的负平均处理效应，这表明实施卡路里标签法律后，男性的BMI有所下降。我们采用有限混合模型进行估计，发现平均处理效应掩盖了三类男女在效果上的显著差异。对于女性和男性而言，模型内确定的三类人群可以分别描述为正常体重的亚群体、平均超重亚群体以及平均肥胖亚群体。有限混合模型的估计结果显示，效果主要集中在那些BMI分布集中在超重区间的女性群体中。对于男性而言，三类群体的效果均具有统计学意义，且超重和肥胖群体的效果更为显著。这些结果表明，超重和肥胖人群对相关信息特别敏感。

abstract.text: As scientists’ careers unfold, mobility can allow researchers to find environments where they are more productive and more effectively contribute to the generation of new knowledge. In this paper, we examine the determinants of mobility of elite academics within the life sciences, including individual productivity measures and for the first time, measures of the peer environment and family factors. Using a unique data set compiled from the career histories of 10,004 elite life scientists in the U.S., we paint a nuanced picture of mobility. Prolific scientists are more likely to move, but this impulse is constrained by recent NIH funding. The quality of peer environments both near and far is an additional factor that influences mobility decisions. Interestingly, we also identify a significant role for family structure. Scientists appear to be unwilling to move when their children are between the ages of 14-17, which is when US children are typically enrolled in middle school or high school. This suggests that even elite scientists find it costly to disrupt the social networks of their children and take these costs into account when making career decisions.

10.3386/w21995.abstractZh: 随着科学家职业生涯的发展，流动性可以帮助研究人员找到更高效、更有效地创造新知识的环境。在本文中，我们研究了生命科学领域精英学者流动性的决定因素，包括个人生产力指标，以及首次对同行环境和家庭因素的考量。通过利用从10,004名美国生命科学领域精英学者职业生涯中收集到的独特数据集，我们对流动性进行了细致的分析。高产科学家更有可能进行流动，但这种冲动受到最近获得的NIH资金的限制。近处和远处的同行环境质量也是影响流动性决策的另一个因素。有趣的是，我们还发现家庭结构在流动决策中起着重要作用。当科学家子女处于14至17岁之间时，他们似乎不愿意搬家，而这一年龄通常是美国儿童进入中学的阶段。这表明，即使是精英科学家也认为打破子女的社会网络会带来高昂的成本，因此在做出职业决策时会考虑这些成本。

abstract.text: Children from low-income families face persistent barriers to accessing high-quality health care services. Previous research studies have examined the importance of expanding children's health insurance coverage, but there is little prior evidence concerning the impacts of directly expanding primary health care access to this population. We address this gap in the literature by exploring whether teenagers' access to primary health care influences their fertility and educational attainment. We study how the significant expansion of school-based health centers (SBHCs) in the United States since the early 1990's has affected teen fertility and high school dropout rates. Our results indicate that school-based health centers have a negative effect on teen birth rates: adding services equivalent to the average SBHC reduces the 15-18 year old birth rate by 5%. The effects are largest among younger teens and among African Americans and Hispanics. However, primary care health services do not reduce high school dropout rates by very much despite the sizable reductions in teen birth rates

10.3386/w22030.abstractZh: 来自低收入家庭的儿童在获得高质量医疗服务方面面临持续性的障碍。先前的研究已经探讨了扩大儿童健康保险覆盖范围的重要性，但关于直接扩大这一群体初级医疗服务覆盖面的影响，目前缺乏足够的证据。我们通过研究青少年获得初级医疗服务是否会影响他们的生育能力和教育成就，来填补这一文献空白。我们研究了自20世纪90年代初以来，美国学校型健康中心的大规模扩展对青少年生育率和高中辍学率的影响。研究结果表明，学校型健康中心对青少年生育率有负面影响：增加相当于平均学校型健康中心的服务量，可使15-18岁青少年的生育率降低5%。这种影响在较年轻的青少年以及非裔美国人和西班牙裔人群中最为明显。然而，尽管青少年生育率显著下降，初级医疗服务对高中辍学率的影响却并不显著。

abstract.text: When faced with financial uncertainty, rational agents have incentives to take steps ex ante to reduce the probability (self-protection) or size (self-insurance) of a loss. However, in the case of liability risk, especially physician responses to malpractice risk, most empirical analyses have focused exclusively on measuring self-protection. This paper studies whether physicians invest in self-insurance by exploring how they respond to policies that allow them to lower the financial cost of malpractice liability. Specifically, we test whether physicians exploit provisions of bankruptcy laws and adjust the value of their home purchases to protect assets from liability claims exceeding their malpractice policy limits. We find that in states with unlimited “homestead” exceptions—provisions of state law that protect home equity when individuals file for bankruptcy—physicians invest 13% more in the value of their homes compared to what they would have invested in the absence of an exemption, whereas no such effect is true for other professionals of similar family income, family size, demographics, and city of residence. Additionally, the response of physicians to unlimited homestead exemptions is larger in areas with higher liability risk, where physicians would have greater incentive to insure against financial risks. Our findings suggest that physicians take financially costly decisions to protect themselves from uninsured malpractice risk, implying more generally that individuals self-insure against liability risk when insurance markets are incomplete.

10.3386/w22031.abstractZh: 面对财务不确定性时，理性个体有动机在事前采取措施来降低损失的概率或规模（自我保险）。然而，在责任风险方面，尤其是医生对医疗事故风险的应对，大多数实证分析仅关注于衡量自我保护行为。本文研究医生是否通过投资自我保险来应对医疗事故责任风险，具体探讨他们如何响应允许降低医疗事故责任财务成本的保险政策。我们测试了医生是否利用破产法中的相关规定，并调整房屋购买价值以保护资产免受超出医疗事故保险限额的责任索赔的影响。研究发现，在拥有无限“家庭财产保护”例外规定的州——即州法律允许个人在申请破产时保护房屋净值——医生在房屋购买价值上的投资比没有该例外规定时多出13%。而对于其他具有类似家庭收入、家庭规模、人口统计特征和居住城市的专业人士来说，则不存在这种效应。此外，在责任风险较高的地区，医生对无限家庭财产保护例外的响应更为强烈，这表明医生有更大的动机为财务风险投保。我们的研究结果表明，医生会做出财务上代价高昂的决策来保护自己免受未投保的医疗事故风险，这进一步表明，在保险市场不完善的情况下，个体会自我保险以应对责任风险。

abstract.text: The hospital industry is one of the most important industries in the U.S., and industry structure can have profound effects on the functioning of markets. Using county-level panel data, we study the effect of public subsidies from the Hospital Survey and Construction Act of 1946, known as the Hill-Burton program, on hospital capacity, organization of the hospital industry, and utilization. We find that the program generated substantial increases in capacity and these changes were highly persistent, lasting well beyond twenty years. However the increases in capacity at non-profit and public hospitals were partially offset by reductions in capacity at for-profit hospitals. Nonetheless, we estimate that the Hill-Burton program accounted for a net increase of over 70,000 beds nationwide, which is roughly 17 percent of the total growth in hospital beds in the U.S. from 1948 to 1975. We also show that differences across counties in the number of hospital beds per capita were greatly reduced over this period. Differences between high and low income counties, rural and urban counties, and the South and the rest of the country fell substantially. We conclude that the program largely achieved its goals, and had substantial and long lasting effects on the hospital industry in the U.S..

10.3386/w22037.abstractZh: 医院行业是美国最重要的行业之一，行业结构对市场运作有着深远的影响。我们利用县级面板数据，研究了1946年《医院调查与建设法》所设立的希尔-伯顿计划对医院容量、医院行业组织结构和利用率的影响。研究发现，该计划显著增加了医院容量，且这些变化持续了二十多年。然而，非营利性和公立医院的容量增加被营利性医院容量的减少部分抵消了。尽管如此，我们估计希尔-伯顿计划使全国医院床位总数增加了超过7万张，这一数字约占1948年至1975年间美国医院床位总增长量的17%。我们还发现，在此期间，各县人均医院床位数量之间的差异显著缩小。高收入县与低收入县、农村县与城市县、南方与全国其他地区的差异也大幅减少。我们得出结论，该计划在很大程度上实现了其目标，并对美国医院行业产生了重大而持久的影响。

abstract.text: Using a detailed dataset of hospitals' purchase orders, we find that information on purchasing by peer hospitals leads to reductions in the prices hospitals negotiate for supplies. Identification is based on staggered access to information across hospitals over time. Within coronary stents, reductions are concentrated among hospitals previously paying relatively high prices and for brands purchased in large volumes, and are consistent with resolving asymmetric information problems. Estimates across a large number of other important product categories indicate that the effects of information are largest in both absolute and relative terms for physician preference items (PPIs). Among PPIs, high-price, high-quantity hospital-brand combinations average 3.9 percent savings, versus 1.6 percent for commodities.

10.3386/w22039.abstractZh: 通过详细的数据集，我们发现，获取同行医院采购信息能够降低医院在采购物资时协商的价格。这种信息的获取是随时间在不同医院之间分阶段进行的。在冠状动脉支架领域，价格降低主要体现在那些过去支付较高价格或大量采购特定品牌产品的医院身上，这一结果符合信息不对称问题的解决。对于其他重要产品类别而言，大量数据表明，信息对医生偏好物品的影响在绝对和相对层面上最为显著。在医生偏好物品中，高价、大批量采购的医院品牌组合平均可节省3.9%的成本，而普通商品则仅能节省1.6%的成本。

abstract.text: We provide the first analysis of the relationship between economic conditions and the use of illicit drugs other than marijuana. Drawing on US data from 2002-2013, we find mixed evidence with regard to the cyclicality of illicit drug use. However, there is strong evidence that economic downturns lead to increases in substance use disorders involving hallucinogens and prescription pain relievers. These effects are robust to a variety of specification choices and are concentrated among prime-age white males with low educational attainment. We conclude that the returns to spending on the treatment of substance use disorders are particularly high during economic downturns.

10.3386/w22051.abstractZh: 我们首次分析了经济状况与除大麻以外的非法药物使用之间的关系。基于2002至2013年的美国数据，我们发现关于非法药物使用的周期性变化，研究结果并不一致。然而，有强有力的证据表明，经济衰退会导致涉及致幻剂和处方止痛药的物质使用障碍增加。这些效应在多种假设条件下仍然成立，并且主要出现在教育程度较低的白人壮年男性中。我们得出结论，在经济衰退期间，对物质使用障碍治疗的投入回报率尤其高。

abstract.text: Voting is an important form of civic participation in democratic societies but a fundamental right that many citizens do not exercise. This study investigates the effects of welfare reform in the U.S. in the 1990s on voting of low income women. Using the November Current Population Surveys with the added Voting and Registration Supplement for the years 1990 through 2004 and exploiting changes in welfare policy across states and over time, we estimate the causal effects of welfare reform on women’s voting registration and voting participation during the period during which welfare reform unfolded. We find robust evidence that welfare reform increased the likelihood of voting by about 4 percentage points, which translates to about a 10% increase relative to the baseline mean. The effects were largely confined to Presidential elections, were stronger in Democratic than Republican states, were stronger in states with stronger work incentive policies, and appeared to operate through employment, education, and income.

10.3386/w22052.abstractZh: 投票是民主社会中公民参与的重要形式，但许多公民并未行使这一基本权利。本研究探讨了20世纪90年代美国福利改革对低收入女性投票行为的影响。通过1990年至2004年的《当前人口调查》以及《投票与登记补充调查》，并分析各州及不同时期的福利政策变化，我们估算了福利改革在改革实施期间对女性投票登记和投票参与行为的因果效应。研究发现，福利改革使女性投票的可能性增加了约4个百分点，相对于基线平均水平而言，这一增幅约为10%。这些效应主要局限于总统选举期间，在民主党控制的州更为显著，在实施更强工作激励政策的州更为明显，并且这些效应似乎通过就业、教育和收入等因素发挥作用。

abstract.text: A small but rapidly growing percentage of the U.S. population uses e-cigarettes. Policymakers, especially the FDA, are concerned about their public health impact and thus are contemplating regulations. We provide empirical evidence to inform such policy choices. Specifically, we examine how the demand for e-cigarettes would vary across policy-relevant attributes: 1) health impact, 2) effectiveness in helping smokers quit, 3) bans in public places, and 4) price. We conduct an online discrete choice experiment of 1,669 adult smokers who select among combustible cigarettes and two types of e-cigarettes as attributes are varied. Using a conditional logit model we estimate smokers’ preferences across attributes. Then, using a latent class model, we identify types of smokers and conduct policy simulations separately by these types and for the full sample. In general, smokers value the attributes in the predicted directions and the demand for e-cigarettes tends to be motivated more by smokers’ health concerns than by price or smoking bans. The latent class model identifies three types of smokers, those who prefer combustible cigarettes (‘smokers’), e-cigarettes (‘vapers’), and using both (‘dual users’). We conclude that varying these policy-relevant attributes will have small, significant impacts on average, but with substantial heterogeneity by smoker type.

10.3386/w22079.abstractZh: 在美国，使用电子香烟的人口比例虽小但增长迅速。政策制定者，尤其是美国食品药品监督管理局，对电子香烟对公共健康的潜在影响感到担忧，因此正在考虑制定相应的法规。我们提供了实证证据来支持这些政策选择。具体来说，我们研究了政策相关因素对电子香烟需求的影响：1）健康影响；2）帮助吸烟者戒烟的有效性；3）在公共场所的禁令；4）价格。我们进行了一项在线离散选择实验，涉及1,669名成年吸烟者，他们在不同属性条件下选择可燃香烟和两种类型的电子香烟。通过条件逻辑模型，我们估计了吸烟者对不同属性的偏好。然后，利用潜在类别模型，我们识别出不同类型的吸烟者，并针对这些类型以及整个样本群体进行了政策模拟。总体而言，吸烟者倾向于支持这些属性，而电子香烟的需求更多是由健康担忧所驱动，而非价格或禁烟政策。潜在类别模型识别出三种类型的吸烟者：偏好可燃香烟的“传统吸烟者”、使用电子香烟的“电子烟使用者”以及两者兼具的“双用途使用者”。我们得出结论，改变这些政策相关因素会对平均需求产生较小但显著的影响，但不同类型吸烟者的反应存在显著差异。

abstract.text: Medicare overbilling refers to the phenomenon that providers report more and/or higher-intensity service codes than actually delivered to receive higher Medicare reimbursement. We propose a novel and easy-to-implement approach to detect potential overbilling based on the hours worked implied by the service codes physicians submit to Medicare. Using the Medicare Part B Fee-for-Service (FFS) Physician Utilization and Payment Data in 2012 and 2013 released by the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS), we first construct estimates for physicians' hours spent on Medicare Part B FFS beneficiaries. Despite our deliberately conservative estimation procedure, we find that about 2,300 physicians, or 3% of those with a significant fraction of Medicare Part B FFS services, have billed Medicare over 100 hours per week. We consider this implausibly long hours. As a benchmark, the maximum hours spent on Medicare patients by physicians in National Ambulatory Medical Care Survey data are 50 hours in a week. Interestingly, we also find suggestive evidence that the coding patterns of the flagged physicians seem to be responsive to financial incentives: within code clusters with different levels of service intensity, they tend to submit more higher intensity service codes than unflagged physicians; moreover, they are more likely to do so if the marginal revenue gain from submitting mid- or high-intensity codes is relatively high.

10.3386/w22084.abstractZh: Medicare过度计费现象指的是医疗服务提供者报告的服务代码数量或服务强度高于实际提供的服务，从而获得更高的Medicare报销金额。我们提出了一种新颖且易于实施的方法，通过医生向Medicare提交的服務代码所暗示的工作小时数来检测潜在的过度计费行为。利用美国医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心（CMS）发布的2012年和2013年Medicare Part B按服务收费（FFS）医生使用及支付数据，我们首先对医生在Medicare Part B FFS受益人身上花费的工作小时数进行了估算。尽管我们的估算方法较为保守，但我们发现约有2,300名医生，即占提供Medicare Part B FFS服务医生的3%，每周向Medicare报告的计费时间超过100小时。我们认为这种长时间计费行为并不合理。作为参考，根据全国门诊医疗调查数据，医生在Medicare患者身上花费的最大小时数为每周50小时。有趣的是，我们还发现，被标记为异常医生的编码模式似乎对财务激励有反应：在具有不同服务强度级别的代码群组中，他们倾向于提交更多高强度的服务代码；此外，如果提交中等或高强度代码的边际收益相对较高，他们更有可能这样做。

abstract.text: There is longstanding debate in population policy about the relationship between modern contraception and abortion. Although theory predicts that they should be substitutes, the existing body of empirical evidence is difficult to interpret. What is required is a large-scale intervention that alters the supply (or full price) of one or the other – and importantly, does so in isolation (reproductive health programs often bundle primary health care and family planning – and in some instances, abortion services). In this paper, we study Nepal’s 2004 legalization of abortion provision and subsequent expansion of abortion services, an unusual and rapidly-implemented policy meeting these requirements. Using four waves of rich individual-level data representative of fertile-age Nepalese women, we find robust evidence of substitution between modern contraception and abortion. This finding has important implications for public policy and foreign aid, suggesting that an effective strategy for reducing expensive and potentially unsafe abortions may be to expand the supply of modern contraceptives.

10.3386/w22085.abstractZh: 在人口政策领域，关于现代避孕措施与堕胎之间的关系一直存在长期争论。尽管理论预测这两种措施应该是可以替代的，但现有的实证证据却难以解释这一现象。我们需要一种大规模的干预措施，改变其中一种服务的供应或价格——重要的是，这种干预应该是独立的（因为生殖健康项目通常将初级医疗保健和计划生育结合在一起，在某些情况下，还会包含堕胎服务）。在本文中，我们研究了尼泊尔在2004年合法化堕胎政策以及随后堕胎服务扩展的情况，这一政策具有特殊性，且实施速度较快，符合上述要求。通过利用四波关于尼泊尔育龄妇女的丰富个体数据，我们发现现代避孕措施与堕胎之间存在明显的替代关系。这一发现对公共政策和外援政策具有重要意义，表明减少昂贵且可能存在风险的堕胎行为的有效策略可能是扩大现代避孕措施的供应。

abstract.text: We consider the effect of mergers between firms whose products are not viewed as direct substitutes for the same good or service, but are bundled by a common intermediary. Focusing on hospital mergers across distinct geographic markets, we show that such combinations can reduce competition among merging hospitals for inclusion in insurers' networks, leading to higher prices (or lower-quality care). Using data on hospital mergers from 1996-2012, we find support that this mechanism operates within state boundaries: cross-market, within-state hospital mergers yield price increases of 7-9 percent for acquiring hospitals, whereas out of state acquisitions do not yield significant increases.

10.3386/w22106.abstractZh: 我们研究了那些产品并非直接替代品、而是由同一中介机构联合起来的企业之间的合并效应。以不同地理市场中的医院合并为例，我们发现这种合并可以减少合并医院在保险公司网络中的竞争，从而导致价格上升（或服务质量下降）。通过1996年至2012年的医院合并数据，我们发现这种机制在州界内是有效的：跨州合并的医院合并会导致被收购医院的价格上涨7-9%，而跨州合并则不会带来显著的价格上涨。

abstract.text: We examine whether greater Medicaid generosity encourages mobility towards riskier but better jobs in higher paid occupations and industries. We use Current Population Survey Data and exploit variation in Medicaid thresholds across states and over time through the 1990s and 2000s. We find that moving from a state in the 10th to the 90th percentile in terms of Medicaid income thresholds increases occupational and industrial mobility by 7.6% and 7.8%. We also find that higher income Medicaid thresholds increase mobility towards occupations and industries with greater wage spreads and higher separation probabilities, but with higher wages and higher educational requirements.

10.3386/w22118.abstractZh: 我们研究的是，更大的医疗补助福利是否有助于人们向风险更高但收入更高的职业和行业流动。我们利用了当前人口调查数据，并通过1990年代和2000年代各州医疗补助门槛的变化来进行分析。研究发现，从医疗补助收入门槛处于第10百分位的状态转变为第90百分位的状态，职业和行业流动性分别增加了7.6%和7.8%。我们还发现，更高的医疗补助收入门槛会促使人们向工资差距更大、离职概率更高的职业和行业流动，但这些职业和行业的工资水平更高，对教育的要求也更高。

abstract.text: Iron deficiency anemia is frequent among the poor worldwide. While it can be prevented with the appropriate supplement or food fortification, these programs often do not consistently reach the poorest. This paper reports on the impact of a potential strategy to address iron deficiency anemia in rural areas: double fortified salt (DFS) - salt fortified with iron and iodine. We conducted a large-scale experiment in rural Bihar. In 200 villages, randomly selected out of 400, DFS was introduced at a price that was half the regular retail price for DFS. After two years, we find no evidence that either selling DFS in villages or providing it for free directly to households has an economically meaningful or statistically significant impact on hemoglobin, anemia, physical health, cognition or mental health. For the sales experiment, we can reject at the 95% level a reduction of 2.5 percentage points in the fraction anemic in the entire sample, and 3.7 percentage points among those who were previously anemic. Using an IV strategy, we find a statistically significant, though relatively small, increase in hemoglobin and reduction in the fraction anemic for adolescents, a subgroup that has responded well to supplements and fortification in earlier studies. These disappointing results are explained both by relatively low take up and by low impact of DFS even when consumed more regularly for the majority of the population.

10.3386/w22121.abstractZh: 缺铁性贫血在全世界贫困人群中十分常见。虽然通过适当的补充剂或食品强化措施可以预防这种情况，但这些项目往往无法持续覆盖最贫困的人群。本文报道了一种针对农村地区缺铁性贫血的潜在策略的效果：双强化盐——一种同时添加了铁和碘的盐。我们在比哈尔邦的农村地区进行了一项大规模实验。在400个村庄中，随机选取了200个村庄，以低于常规零售价格一半的价格推广双强化盐。两年后，我们发现无论是在村庄内销售双强化盐，还是免费提供给家庭，都没有对血红蛋白水平、贫血状况、身体健康、认知能力和心理健康产生显著的经济或统计影响。对于销售实验，我们可以在95%的置信水平下拒绝整个样本中贫血比例减少2.5个百分点的假设，对于之前就患有贫血的人群，这一减少幅度为3.7个百分点。通过自变量策略，我们发现青少年的血红蛋白水平有显著但相对较小的提升，贫血比例也有所减少。这一亚群体在之前的研究中表现出对补充剂和强化措施的良好反应。这些令人失望的结果，既与双强化盐的接受率相对较低有关，也与大多数人群即使定期食用双强化盐，其效果仍然有限有关。

abstract.text: The purpose of this essay is to discuss two approaches to inference, and how "human capital" can provide a way to combine them. The first approach, ubiquitous in economics, is based upon the Rubin/Holland potential outcomes model and relies upon randomized treatment to measure the causal effect of choice. The second approach, widely used in the pattern recognition and machine learning literatures, assumes that choice conditional upon current information is optimal (or at least high quality), and then provides techniques to generalize observed choice to new cases. The "human capital" approach combines these methods by using observed decisions by experts to reduce the demensionality of the feature space and allow the categorization of decisions by their propensity score. The fact that the human capital of experts is heterogeneous implies that errors in decision making are inevitable. Moreover, under the appropriate conditions, these decisions are random conditional upon the propensity score. This in turn allows us to identify the conditional average treatment effect for a wider class of situations than would be possible with randomized control trials. This point is illustrated with data from medical decision making in the context of treating depression, heart disease, and adverse childbirth events.

10.3386/w22123.abstractZh: 本文旨在探讨两种推断方法，以及“人力资本”如何提供一种将它们结合的方式。第一种方法在经济学中非常常见，基于Rubin/Holland潜在结果模型，并依靠随机处理来测量选择的因果效应。第二种方法在模式识别和机器学习领域被广泛使用，假设基于当前信息的选择是最优的（或至少是高质量的），然后提供技术来将观察到的选择推广到新的情况。“人力资本”方法通过利用专家的观察决策来减少特征空间的维度性，并允许根据倾向得分对决策进行分类。专家的人力资本具有异质性，这意味着决策错误是不可避免的。此外，在适当的条件下，这些决策在倾向得分的条件下是随机的。这反过来使我们能够识别更广泛情况下的条件平均处理效应，而这是随机对照试验所无法实现的。这一观点通过医疗决策的数据进行了说明，这些数据涉及治疗抑郁症、心脏病和不良分娩事件的情况。

abstract.text: Estimates of the long-term annual cost of global warming lie in the range of 0.2-2% of global income. This high cost has generated widespread political concern and commitment as manifested in the Paris agreements of December, 2015. Analyses in this paper suggest that the expected annual cost of pandemic influenza falls in the same range as does that of climate change although toward the low end. In any given year a small likelihood exists that the world will again suffer a very severe flu pandemic akin to the one of 1918. Even a moderately severe pandemic, of which at least 6 have occurred since 1700, could lead to 2 million or more excess deaths. World Bank and other work has assessed the probable income loss from a severe pandemic at 4-5% of global GNI. The economics literature points to a very high intrinsic value of mortality risk, a value that GNI fails to capture. In this paper we use findings from that literature to generate an estimate of pandemic cost that is inclusive of both income loss and the cost of elevated mortality. We present results on an expected annual basis using reasonable (although highly uncertain) estimates of the annual probabilities of pandemics in two bands of severity. We find: 1. Expected pandemic deaths exceed 700,000 per year worldwide with an associated annual mortality cost of estimated at $490 billion. We use published figures to estimate expected income loss at $80 billion per year and hence the inclusive cost to be $570 billion per year or 0.7% of global income (range: 0.4-1.0%). 2. For moderately severe pandemics about 40% of inclusive cost results from income loss. For severe pandemics this fraction declines to 12%: the intrinsic cost of elevated mortality becomes completely dominant. 3. The estimates of mortality cost as a % of GNI range from around 1.6% in lower-middle income countries down to 0.3% in high-income countries, mostly as a result of much higher pandemic death rates in lower-income environments. 4. The distribution of pandemic severity has an exceptionally fat tail: about 95% of the expected cost results from pandemics that would be expected to kill over 7 million people worldwide.

10.3386/w22137.abstractZh: 关于全球变暖长期年度成本的估计，其范围在全球收入的0.2%到2%之间。这一高昂的成本引发了广泛的政治关注和承诺，这体现在2015年12月的巴黎协定中。本文分析表明，大流行性流感的预期年度成本与气候变化的成本大致处于同一范围，但数值较低。在任何一年，世界再次遭受类似于1918年那样严重流感大流行的可能性很小。即使是最轻微的大流行，自1700年以来至少发生了6次，也可能导致200万或更多额外死亡。世界银行和其他研究评估了严重大流行可能导致的收入损失为全球国民总收入的4-5%。经济学文献指出，死亡风险具有非常高的内在价值，而国民总收入无法完全反映这一价值。在本文中，我们利用这些文献的研究成果，估算了包括收入损失和死亡风险成本在内的大流行成本。我们基于两个严重程度区间，使用合理但高度不确定的大流行概率估计，得出以下结果：1. 全球每年预期的大流行死亡人数超过70万，相关的年度死亡成本估计为4900亿美元。根据已发表的数据，预期的收入损失为每年800亿美元，因此总成本为每年5700亿美元，占全球收入的0.7%（范围：0.4%-1.0%）。2. 对于较轻微的大流行，约40%的成本来自收入损失。对于严重的大流行，这一比例下降到12%，即死亡风险的成本变得完全主导。死亡率成本占国民总收入的百分比估计值，从中等低收入国家的约1.6%降至高收入国家的0.3%，这主要是由于低收入环境下大流行病的死亡率要高得多。4. 大流行病的严重程度分布呈现出异常大的尾部：约95%的预期成本来自那些预计将导致全球超过700万人死亡的大流行病。

abstract.text: A modern, decision-theoretic framework can help clarify important practical questions of experimental design. Building on our recent work, this chapter begins by summarizing our framework for understanding the goals of experimenters, and applying this to re-randomization. We then use this framework to shed light on questions related to experimental registries, pre-analysis plans, and most importantly, external validity. Our framework implies that even when large samples can be collected, external decision-making remains inherently subjective. We embrace this conclusion, and argue that in order to improve external validity, experimental research needs to create a space for structured speculation.

10.3386/w22167.abstractZh: 一个现代的决策理论框架有助于阐明实验设计中的重要实际问题。基于我们最近的工作，本章首先总结了我们理解实验者目标的框架，并将其应用于重新随机化过程。然后，我们利用这一框架来探讨与实验登记、预分析计划以及最重要的外部有效性相关的问题。我们的框架表明，即使能够收集到大量样本，外部决策仍然本质上是主观的。我们接受这一结论，并认为为了提高外部有效性，实验研究需要为结构化推测创造空间。

abstract.text: Little is known about the relationship between family income and children’s non-cognitive (or socio-emotional) skill formation. This is an important gap, as these skills have been hypothesized to be a critical link between early outcomes and adult socioeconomic status. This paper presents new evidence of the importance of family income in the formation and evolution of children’s non-cognitive skills using a recent US panel dataset that tracks children between grades K-5. Findings suggest an important divergence in non-cognitive skills based on family income that accumulates over time and does not seem to be explained by children’s health status differences.

10.3386/w22168.abstractZh: 关于家庭收入与儿童非认知（或社会情感）技能形成之间的关系，目前了解甚少。这是一个重要的空白，因为这些技能被认为是早期结果与成人社会经济地位之间的关键纽带。本文利用美国最近的一个面板数据集，该数据集追踪了K至5年级儿童的发展情况，提出了关于家庭收入在儿童非认知技能形成和演变中的重要性的新证据。研究结果表明，基于家庭收入的非认知技能存在显著的差异，这种差异是随着时间累积的，并且似乎并非由儿童健康状况的差异所解释。

abstract.text: We examine the effect of the Medicaid expansions under the 2010 Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act (ACA) on consumer financial outcomes using data from a major credit reporting agency for a large, national sample of adults. We employ the synthetic control method to compare individuals living in states that expanded Medicaid to those that did not. We find that the Medicaid expansions significantly reduced the number of unpaid bills and the amount of debt sent to third-party collection agencies among those residing in zip codes with the highest share of low-income, uninsured individuals. Our estimates imply a reduction in collection balances of approximately $1,140 among those who gain Medicaid coverage due to the ACA. Our findings suggest that the ACA Medicaid expansions had important financial impacts beyond health care use.

10.3386/w22170.abstractZh: 我们研究了2010年《患者保护与平价医疗法案》下医疗补助扩展对消费者财务结果的影响，使用了一家主要信用报告机构的数据，样本涵盖了大量全国范围的成年人。我们采用合成控制方法，比较了那些获得医疗补助扩展的州与未获得该扩展的州居民的情况。研究发现，在那些低收入、无保险人口比例较高的邮政编码区，由于医疗补助的扩展，未付账单的数量以及被送往第三方收账机构的债务金额都显著减少。我们的估计表明，由于《平价医疗法案》的实施，获得医疗补助的人的收账余额减少了约1,140美元。我们的研究结果表明，《平价医疗法案》下的医疗补助扩展在财务方面产生了重要的影响，这些影响不仅限于医疗保健领域。

abstract.text: Physicians, acting in their role as experts, are often faced with situations where they must trade off personal and patient welfare. Physicians’ incentives vary based on the organizational environment in which they practice. We use the publication of a major clinical trial, which found that a common knee operation does not improve outcomes for patients with osteoarthritis, as an “informational shock” to gauge the impact of physicians’ agency relationships on treatment decisions. Using a 100% sample of procedures in Florida from 1998 to 2010, we find that publication of the trial reduced procedure volume, but the magnitude of the decline was smaller in physician-owned surgery centers. Incentives affected physicians’ reactions to evidence.

10.3386/w22171.abstractZh: 作为专家，医生常常面临必须权衡个人利益与患者福祉的情况。医生的激励因素取决于他们执业的组织环境。我们通过一项重大临床试验的公布来探讨医生与医疗机构之间的代理关系对治疗决策的影响。该试验发现，常见的膝关节手术并不能改善骨关节炎患者的治疗效果。我们以1998年至2010年间佛罗里达州所有手术项目的样本数据为基础，发现该试验的公布减少了手术数量，但医生拥有的手术中心中这一下降幅度较小。激励因素影响了医生对证据的反应。

abstract.text: Nutrition is a key input in the health production function, and a better understanding of how we eat can aid in guiding effective policy change towards better population health. This study documents prevalence rates, trends in, and potential correlates of nutrient intake for panels of countries, categorized by geographical regions and levels of development. We assemble data from 209 countries, spanning 51 years (1961-2011), based on original data compilations using 960 country-years for BMI, 370 country-years for glucose, and 321 country-years for cholesterol. Our estimates inform the nature and scope of nutrient intake on a global scale, and contribute towards an understanding of the drivers of the general upward trend in food intake and obesity. The cross-national trends, across countries spanning the spectrum of economic development and geographic regions, suggest that simply analyzing aggregate caloric intake masks the heterogeneity in trends for the various food groups. Food groups analyzed include cereals, sugars and sweeteners, vegetable oils, meat, starch, milk, fruits, animal fats, alcoholic beverages, oil crops, pulses, vegetables, fish, and eggs. Fixed effects regression analyses reveal that caloric intake is strongly associated with hunger depth, body mass index, cholesterol levels, and glucose levels. Moreover, changes in real GDP per capita, labor force participation, and health care measures in a nation can partly explain the increase in caloric intake. We note that substantial heterogeneity remains. While these associations should not be interpreted as causal, they provide a first step towards understanding shifts in aggregate eating patterns across the globe and levels of economic activity.

10.3386/w22179.abstractZh: 营养是健康生产函数中的关键要素，更好地理解我们的饮食方式有助于指导有效的政策变革，从而改善人群健康。本研究记录了不同国家群体的营养摄入率、趋势及其潜在相关因素，这些国家按地理区域和发展水平进行分类。我们收集了209个国家在51年（1961-2011年）内的数据，基于原始数据汇编，涉及BMI、葡萄糖和胆固醇的年度数据，分别为960个、370个和321个。我们的估计结果揭示了全球范围内营养摄入的特性和范围，并有助于理解食物摄入和肥胖普遍上升趋势的驱动因素。跨国家的趋势表明，仅分析总体热量摄入无法掩盖不同食物类别的趋势差异。分析的食物类别包括谷物、糖和甜味剂、植物油、肉类、淀粉、牛奶、水果、动物脂肪、酒精饮料、油料作物、豆类、蔬菜、鱼类和鸡蛋。固定效应回归分析显示，热量摄入与饥饿程度、体重指数、胆固醇水平和葡萄糖水平有强烈关联。此外，一个国家实际人均GDP、劳动力参与率和医疗保健指标的变化可以部分解释热量摄入的增加。我们注意到，仍然存在显著的异质性。虽然这些关联不应被解释为因果关系，但它们为理解全球范围内总体饮食模式的变化以及经济活动的水平提供了第一步的启示。

abstract.text: Identifying the effect of climate on societies is central to understanding historical economic development, designing modern policies that react to climatic events, and managing future global climate change. Here, I review, synthesize, and interpret recent advances in methods used to measure effects of climate on social and economic outcomes. Because weather variation plays a large role in recent progress, I formalize the relationship between climate and weather from an econometric perspective and discuss their use as identifying variation, highlighting tradeoffs between key assumptions in different research designs and deriving conditions when weather variation exactly identifies the effects of climate. I then describe advances in recent years, such as parameterization of climate variables from a social perspective, nonlinear models with spatial and temporal displacement, characterizing uncertainty, measurement of adaptation, cross-study comparison, and use of empirical estimates to project the impact of future climate change. I conclude by discussing remaining methodological challenges.

10.3386/w22181.abstractZh: 识别气候对社会的影响对于理解历史经济发展、设计应对气候事件的现代政策以及管理未来的全球气候变化至关重要。本文回顾、综合并解读了用于衡量气候对社会和经济结果影响的最新方法。由于天气变化在近期进展中起着重要作用，我从计量经济学的角度阐述了气候与天气之间的关系，并讨论了将它们作为识别变化的工具的应用，同时强调了不同研究设计中关键假设之间的权衡，以及天气变化能够准确识别气候影响的条件。随后，本文描述了近年来取得的进展，例如从社会角度对气候变量进行参数化处理、具有空间和时间位移的非线性模型、不确定性表征、适应性的测量、跨研究比较，以及利用实证估计来预测未来气候变化的影响。最后，本文讨论了剩余的方法学挑战。

abstract.text: The Affordable Care Act (ACA) aimed to achieve nearly universal health insurance coverage in the United States through a combination of insurance market reforms, mandates, subsidies, health insurance exchanges, and Medicaid expansions, most of which took effect in 2014. This paper estimates the causal effects of the ACA on health insurance coverage using data from the American Community Survey. We utilize difference-in-difference-in-differences models that exploit cross-sectional variation in the intensity of treatment arising from state participation in the Medicaid expansion and local area pre-ACA uninsured rates. This strategy allows us to identify the effects of the ACA in both Medicaid expansion and non-expansion states. Our preferred specification suggests that, at the average pre-treatment uninsured rate, the full ACA increased the proportion of residents with insurance by 5.9 percentage points compared to 3.0 percentage points in states that did not expand Medicaid. Private insurance expansions from the ACA were due to increases in both employer-provided and non-group coverage. The coverage gains from the full ACA were largest for those with incomes below the Medicaid eligibility threshold, non-whites, young adults, and unmarried individuals. We find some evidence that the Medicaid expansion partially crowded out private coverage among low-income individuals.

10.3386/w22182.abstractZh: 《平价医疗法案》旨在通过一系列保险市场改革、强制规定、补贴、健康保险交易以及医疗补助扩展等措施，实现美国几乎全民的健康保险覆盖，其中大部分措施于2014年生效。本文利用美国社区调查数据，估算了《平价医疗法案》对健康保险覆盖的因果效应。我们采用了差异-差异-差异模型，利用各州参与医疗补助扩展的情况以及《平价医疗法案》实施前的当地无保险率，来捕捉治疗强度的横截面差异。这一策略使我们能够识别《平价医疗法案》在医疗补助扩展州和非扩展州中的影响。我们的分析表明，在平均无保险率水平下，全面实施《平价医疗法案》使有保险的居民比例增加了5.9个百分点，而非扩展州的这一比例仅增加了3.0个百分点。《平价医疗法案》推动的私人保险扩展主要源于雇主提供的保险和非团体保险的增加。全面实施《平价医疗法案》带来的保险覆盖增加最为显著的是收入低于医疗补助资格门槛的人群、非白人、年轻成年人以及未婚人士。我们发现了一些证据表明，医疗补助扩展在一定程度上挤占了低收入人群中的私人保险选择。

abstract.text: The use of “pay-for-delay” settlements in patent litigation – in which a branded manufacturer and generic entrant settle a Paragraph IV patent challenge and agree to forestall entry – has come under considerable scrutiny in recent years. Critics argue that these settlements are collusive and lower consumer welfare by maintaining monopoly prices after patents should have expired, while proponents argue they reinforce incentives for innovation. We estimate the impact of settlements to Paragraph IV challenges on generic entry and evaluate the implications for drug prices and quantity. To address the potential endogeneity of Paragraph IV challenges and settlements we estimate the model using instrumental variables. Our instruments include standard measures of patent strength and a measure of settlement legality based on a split between several Circuit Courts of Appeal. We find that Paragraph IV challenges increase generic entry, lower drug prices and increase quantity, while settlements effectively reverse the effect. These effects persist over time, inflating price and depressing quantity for up to 5 years after the challenge. We also find that eliminating settlements would result in a relatively small reduction in research and development (R&D) expenditures.

10.3386/w22194.abstractZh: 近年来，专利诉讼中使用“支付违约金”的解决方案受到了广泛关注。在这种解决方案中，品牌制造商和通用药品进入者会协商解决第四款专利争议，并同意在专利到期后继续维持垄断价格。批评者认为这种解决方案属于勾结行为，会降低消费者福利，因为专利到期后垄断价格仍然存在；而支持者则认为这种解决方案能够激励创新。我们估算了第四款专利争议中的违约金解决方案对通用药品进入市场的影响，并评估了其对药品价格和产量的影响。为了处理第四款专利争议和违约金解决方案之间的潜在内生性问题，我们使用工具变量模型进行了估计。我们的工具变量包括专利强度的标准指标，以及基于多个巡回上诉法院划分的违约金合法性指标。研究发现，第四款专利争议会增加通用药品进入市场的机会，降低药品价格并提高产量，而违约金解决方案则有效地抵消了这些效应。这些效应会持续一段时间，在争议结束后长达5年内，药品价格会上涨，产量则会下降。我们还发现，取消违约金解决方案仅会导致研发支出相对较小的减少。

abstract.text: The increase in the prevalence of obesity worldwide has led to great interest in the economic consequences of obesity, but valid and powerful instruments for obesity, which are needed to estimate its causal effects, are rare. This paper contributes to the literature by using a novel instrument: genetic risk score, which reflects the predisposition to higher body mass index across many genetic loci. We estimate IV models of the effect of BMI on labor market outcomes using Finnish data that have many strengths: genetic information, measured body mass index, and administrative earnings records that are free of the problems associated with non-response, self-reporting error or top-coding. The first stage of the IV models indicate that genetic risk score is a powerful instrument, and the available evidence from the genetics literature is consistent with instrument validity. The results of the IV models indicate weight reduces earnings and employment and increases social income transfers, although we caution that the results are based on small samples, and are sensitive to specification and subsample.

10.3386/w22200.abstractZh: 全球肥胖现象的日益普遍引发了对肥胖经济后果的高度关注，但用于评估肥胖因果效应的有效且可靠的工具却十分稀缺。本文采用了一种新颖的工具——遗传风险评分，该工具能够反映多个遗传位点对较高体重指数的倾向性。我们利用芬兰的数据进行了IV模型分析，这些数据具有诸多优势：包含遗传信息、测量出的体重指数，以及无非响应、自我报告误差或最高编码问题影响的行政收入记录。IV模型的第一阶段结果表明，遗传风险评分是一种非常有效的工具，而来自遗传学文献的现有证据也支持这一工具的有效性。模型的结果表明，体重会减少收入和就业，但会增加社会收入转移。不过需要提醒的是，这些结果基于的样本规模较小，且对模型设定和子样本的选择非常敏感。

abstract.text: Using premium subsidies for private coverage, an individual mandate, and Medicaid expansion, the Affordable Care Act (ACA) has increased insurance coverage. We provide the first comprehensive assessment of these provisions’ effects, using the 2012-2015 American Community Survey and a triple-difference estimation strategy that exploits variation by income, geography, and time. Overall, our model explains 60% of the coverage gains in 2014-2015. We find that coverage was moderately responsive to price subsidies, with larger gains in state-based insurance exchanges than the federal exchange. The individual mandate’s exemptions and penalties had little impact on coverage rates. The law increased Medicaid among individuals gaining eligibility under the ACA and among previously-eligible populations (“woodwork effect”) even in non-expansion states, with essentially no crowd-out of private insurance. Overall, exchange premium subsidies produced 40% of the coverage gains explained by our ACA policy measures, and Medicaid the other 60%, of which 1/2 occurred among previously-eligible individuals.

10.3386/w22213.abstractZh: 通过使用保费补贴促进私人保险覆盖、实施个人强制保险政策以及扩大医疗补助计划，平价医疗法案增加了保险覆盖范围。我们首次对这些措施的影响进行了全面评估，使用了2012-2015年的美国社区调查数据，并采用了一种三重差异估计策略，该策略考虑了收入、地理位置和时间的差异。总体而言，我们的模型能够解释2014-2015年间保险覆盖率的60%增长。我们发现，价格补贴对保险覆盖率的提升有显著作用，州级保险交易所的覆盖率提升幅度大于联邦交易所。个人强制保险政策中的豁免和处罚对保险覆盖率的影响较小。该法案使得在符合法案资格的人群中，以及之前就有资格的人群中，医疗补助的覆盖率有所增加，即使在非扩展州也是如此，且几乎没有导致私人保险被替代的情况。总体而言，保险交易所的保费补贴解释了我们评估的平价医疗法案政策措施带来的40%的保险覆盖率增长，而医疗补助则解释了另外60%的增长，其中一半增长发生在之前就有资格的人群中。

abstract.text: This paper studies how in utero exposure to maternal stress from family ruptures affects later mental health. We find that prenatal exposure to the death of a maternal relative increases take-up of ADHD medications during childhood and anti-anxiety and depression medications in adulthood. Further, family ruptures during pregnancy depress birth outcomes and raise the risk of perinatal complications necessitating hospitalization. Our results suggest large welfare gains from preventing fetal stress from family ruptures and possibly from economically induced stressors such as unemployment. They further suggest that greater stress exposure among the poor may partially explain the intergenerational persistence of poverty.

10.3386/w22229.abstractZh: 本文研究了母体在怀孕期间因家庭破裂而承受的压力对后期心理健康的影响。研究发现，母亲在怀孕期间遭遇亲属死亡的情况，会增加儿童时期对ADHD药物的服用，以及成年后对抗焦虑药物和抗抑郁药物的依赖。此外，怀孕期间的家庭破裂会严重影响分娩结果，并增加围产期并发症的风险，导致需要住院治疗。我们的研究结果表明，预防胎儿因家庭破裂而承受的压力，以及可能由经济因素引起的压力（如失业），能够带来巨大的福利收益。研究还表明，贫困群体所承受的更大压力，可能部分解释了贫困现象的代际延续问题。

abstract.text: Improved health in low-income countries could considerably improve wellbeing and possibly promote economic growth. The last decade has seen a surge in field experiments designed to understand the barriers that households and governments face in investing in health and how these barriers can be overcome, and to assess the impacts of subsequent health gains. This chapter first discusses the methodological pitfalls that field experiments in the health sector are particularly susceptible to, then reviews the evidence that rigorous field experiments have generated so far. While the link from in utero and child health to later outcomes has increasingly been established, few experiments have estimated the impacts of health on contemporaneous productivity among adults, and few experiments have explored the potential for infrastructural programs to impact health outcomes. Many more studies have examined the determinants of individual health behavior, on the side of consumers as well as among providers of health products and services.

10.3386/w22235.abstractZh: 在低收入国家改善健康状况可以显著提升居民福祉，甚至可能促进经济增长。过去十年中，大量实地实验被开展，旨在了解家庭和政府在投资健康方面所面临的障碍以及如何克服这些障碍，同时评估后续健康改善所带来的影响。本章首先讨论了卫生领域实地实验特别容易出现的方法论问题，然后回顾了迄今为止通过严格实地实验所获得的证据。虽然越来越多的研究证实了胎儿期及儿童健康对后期结果的影响，但很少有实验评估健康对成年人当前生产力的影响，也很少有实验探讨基础设施项目对健康结果的潜在影响。此外，还有更多研究探讨了个体健康行为的决定因素，既包括消费者层面，也包括健康产品和服务提供者的行为。

abstract.text: In this paper, we conduct a theoretical analysis of why individuals provide care and attention to their elderly parents using a two-period overlapping generations model with endogenous saving and a “contest success function” and test this model using micro data from a Japanese household survey, the Osaka University Preference Parameter Study. To summarize our main findings, we find that the Japanese are more likely to live with (or near) their elderly parents and/or to provide care and attention to them if they expect to receive a bequest from them, which constitutes strong support for the selfish bequest motive or the exchange motive (much stronger than in the United States), but we find that their caregiving behavior is also heavily influenced by the strength of their altruism toward their parents and social norms.

10.3386/w22245.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们运用两期重叠世代模型，结合内生储蓄机制以及“竞争成功函数”，对个体为何会照顾和关心年迈的父母进行了理论分析。我们采用日本大阪大学偏好参数研究中的微观数据来验证这一模型。主要研究发现表明，如果日本人预期能够继承年迈父母的遗产，他们更有可能与年迈的父母同住或居住在附近，并对其进行照顾和关心。这一发现强烈支持了自私的遗产动机或交换动机，其重要性远超美国的情况。此外，我们的研究还发现，日本人的照顾行为也受到他们对父母无私的奉献程度以及社会规范的影响。

abstract.text: Research on informal and formal long-term care has centered almost solely on costs; to date, there has been very little attention paid to the benefits. This study exploits the randomization in the Cash and Counseling Demonstration and Evaluation program and instrumental variable techniques to gain causal estimates of the effect of family involvement in home-based care on health care utilization and health outcomes. We find that family involvement significantly decreases Medicaid utilization. Importantly, we find family involvement significantly lowers the likelihood of urinary tract infections, respiratory infections, and bedsores, suggesting that the lower utilization is due to better health outcomes.

10.3386/w22249.abstractZh: 关于非正式和正式长期护理的研究几乎完全集中在成本方面；迄今为止，对收益方面的关注却很少。本研究利用“现金与咨询示范与评估计划”中的随机化方法以及工具变量技术，来估算家庭参与家庭护理对医疗利用和健康结果的影响。我们发现，家庭参与显著降低了医疗补助的利用。重要的是，我们发现家庭参与显著降低了尿路感染、呼吸道感染和褥疮的发生几率，这表明较低的利用程度是由于更好的健康结果所导致的。

abstract.text: Numerous studies have examined the effect of cigarette prices on cigarette consumption. These studies either evaluate the price elasticity of demand for each observation and report the average price elasticity across all observations or report the price elasticity of demand at the mean of the price variable. Policy makers rely on these average price elasticity estimates for public health and revenue generation purposes. The use of an average price elasticity may yield misleading predictions given the substantial variation in cigarette prices between states. This research is the first econometric study to examine the price elasticity of cigarette demand at different price levels. We use aggregate state-level data for years 1991 – 2012 and employ generalized linear models with log link and gamma distribution to estimate cigarette demand equations. We find that the absolute value of the price elasticity of demand monotonically increases with price. The findings from this study will be valuable to policymakers contemplating the use of cigarette excise taxes to reduce cigarette consumption or to generate revenue.

10.3386/w22251.abstractZh: 许多研究探讨了香烟价格对香烟消费的影响。这些研究要么评估每个观测点的需求价格弹性，并报告所有观测点的平均价格弹性，要么报告价格变量均值处的需求价格弹性。政策制定者依赖这些平均价格弹性估计值来制定公共卫生政策和增加收入。然而，由于各州之间香烟价格存在显著差异，使用平均价格弹性可能会产生误导性的预测。本研究是首次采用计量经济学方法研究不同价格水平下香烟需求的价格弹性。我们使用了1991年至2012年的全州级数据，并采用对数链接函数和伽马分布的一般线性模型来估计香烟需求方程。研究发现，需求价格弹性的绝对值随价格的增加而单调上升。本研究的结果对于考虑使用香烟消费税来减少香烟消费或增加收入的政策制定者来说具有参考价值。

abstract.text: The U.S. population receives suboptimal levels of preventive care and has a high prevalence of risky health behaviors. One goal of the Affordable Care Act (ACA) was to increase preventive care and improve health behaviors by expanding access to health insurance. This paper estimates how the ACA-facilitated state-level expansions of Medicaid in 2014 affected these outcomes. Using data from the Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System, and a difference-in-differences model that compares states that did and did not expand Medicaid, we examine the impact of the expansions on preventive care (e.g. dental visits, immunizations, mammograms, cancer screenings), risky health behaviors (e.g. smoking, heavy drinking, lack of exercise, obesity), and self-assessed health. We find that the expansions increased insurance coverage and access to care among the targeted population of low-income childless adults. The expansions also increased use of certain forms of preventive care but there is no evidence that they increased ex ante moral hazard (i.e., there is no evidence that risky health behaviors increased in response to health insurance coverage). The Medicaid expansions also modestly improved self-assessed health.

10.3386/w22265.abstractZh: 美国人口获得的预防保健服务水平较低， risky健康行为的发病率较高。平价医疗法案的一个目标是通过扩大医疗保险的覆盖范围，增加预防保健服务并改善健康行为。本文估计了2014年平价医疗法案推动的州级医疗补助扩展对这些结果的影响。利用行为风险因素监测系统的数据，并通过差异-差异模型比较了实施和未实施医疗补助扩展的州，我们研究了这些扩展对预防保健服务（如牙科检查、免疫接种、乳腺X光检查、癌症筛查）、 risky健康行为（如吸烟、酗酒、缺乏运动、肥胖）以及自我评估的健康状况的影响。我们发现，这些扩展增加了低收入无子女成年人的保险覆盖率和就医机会。这些扩展还增加了某些形式的预防保健服务的使用，但没有证据表明它们增加了事前道德风险，即没有证据表明 risky健康行为因医疗保险覆盖而有所增加。医疗补助扩展还适度改善了自我评估的健康状况。

abstract.text: Standard theory suggests that optimal consumer cost-sharing in health insurance increases with the price elasticity of demand, yet publicly-provided drug coverage typically involves uniform cost-sharing across drugs. We investigate how private drug plans set cost-sharing in the context of Medicare Part D. We document substantial heterogeneity in the price elasticities of demand across more than 150 drugs and across more than 100 therapeutic classes, as well as substantial heterogeneity in the cost-sharing for different drugs within privately-provided plans. We find that private plans set higher consumer cost-sharing for drugs or classes with more elastic demand. Our findings suggest that benefit design may be more efficient in privately rather than publicly provided insurance.

10.3386/w22277.abstractZh: 标准理论认为，健康保险中消费者的最优成本分担应随着需求的价格弹性增加，然而，公共提供的药物保险通常对各类药物实行统一的成本分担。我们研究了私人药物计划在Medicare Part D框架下的成本分担方式。我们发现，超过150种药物以及超过100种治疗类别的需求价格弹性存在显著差异，同时，私人提供的保险计划中不同药物的成本分担方式也表现出显著的差异。研究发现，私人计划对需求弹性较大的药物或类别会设定更高的消费者成本分担比例。我们的研究结果表明，在私人而非公共提供的保险中，福利设计可能更为高效。

abstract.text: We examine some economic impacts of hospital admissions using an event study approach in two datasets: survey data from the Health and Retirement Study, and hospital admissions data linked to consumer credit reports. We report estimates of the impact of hospital admissions on out-of-pocket medical spending, unpaid medical bills, bankruptcy, earnings, income (and its components), access to credit, and consumer borrowing. The results point to three primary conclusions: non-elderly adults with health insurance still face considerable exposure to uninsured earnings risk; a large share of the incremental risk exposure for uninsured non-elderly adults is borne by third parties who absorb their unpaid medical bills; the elderly face very little economic risk from adverse health shocks.

10.3386/w22288.abstractZh: 我们通过事件研究法，在两个数据集中考察了医院住院的一些经济影响：一个是来自“健康与退休研究”的调查数据，另一个是与消费者信用报告相关的医院住院数据。我们报告了医院住院对自付医疗费用、未付医疗账单、破产、收入、收入组成部分、信用获取能力和消费者借款等经济指标的影响估计结果。研究得出了三个主要结论：拥有健康保险的非老年成年人仍然面临相当大的无保险收入风险；非老年成年人未保险所带来的风险，有很大一部分由第三方承担，这些第三方会承担他们的未付医疗账单；老年人在健康冲击带来的负面经济影响方面面临的风险非常小。

abstract.text: This paper estimates returns to education using a dynamic model of educational choice that synthesizes approaches in the structural dynamic discrete choice literature with approaches used in the reduced form treatment effect literature. It is an empirically robust middle ground between the two approaches which estimates economically interpretable and policy-relevant dynamic treatment effects that account for heterogeneity in cognitive and non-cognitive skills and the continuation values of educational choices. Graduating college is not a wise choice for all. Ability bias is a major component of observed educational differentials. For some, there are substantial causal effects of education at all stages of schooling.

10.3386/w22291.abstractZh: 本文采用动态教育选择模型来估算教育回报，该模型结合了结构动态离散选择文献中的方法和简化形式处理效应文献中的方法。这是一种在两种方法之间的实证稳健折中方案，能够估算出经济可解释且具有政策相关性的动态处理效应，同时考虑到认知和非认知技能的异质性以及教育选择的持续价值。对于所有人来说，从大学毕业并非明智之选。能力偏差是观察到的教育差异的主要组成部分。对于某些人来说，教育的效果在教育的各个阶段都存在显著的因果效应。

abstract.text: Households' insurance against shocks to income and asset values (that is, household risk management) is limited, especially for poor households. We argue that a trade-off between intertemporal financing needs and insurance across states explains this basic insurance pattern. In a model with limited enforcement, we show that household risk management is increasing in household net worth and income, incomplete, and precautionary. These results hold in economies with income risk, durable goods and collateral constraints, and durable goods price risk, under quite general conditions and, remarkably, risk aversion is sufficient and prudence is not required. In equilibrium, collateral scarcity lowers the interest rate, reduces insurance, and increases inequality.

10.3386/w22293.abstractZh: 家庭对收入和资产价值冲击的保险（即家庭风险管理）是有限的，尤其是对于贫困家庭而言。我们认为，跨时期融资需求与州际保险之间的权衡解释了这种基本的保险模式。在一个监管有限的模型中，我们发现家庭风险管理随着家庭净资产和收入的增加而增加，但这种风险管理是残缺的且具有预防性质。这些结果在存在收入风险、耐用商品及抵押品限制以及耐用商品价格风险的经济体中仍然成立，并且在相当普遍的条件下依然有效。值得注意的是，风险厌恶是足够的，而谨慎性则不是必需的。在均衡状态下，抵押品稀缺会降低利率，减少保险需求，并加剧不平等现象。

abstract.text: We use data from the Tobacco Use Supplements to the Current Population Survey from 2006-2015 to calculate cigarette price elasticities of demand using four alternative cigarette tax/price measures that compensate for the local tax environment to various extents. We use both state-level prices and local-level prices from 386 sub-state areas of the United States. We estimate a price elasticity of total demand of -0.38 using the price measure most strongly compensating for the local tax environment, and significantly lower elasticities for other popular cigarette price measures. We also find greater price responsiveness for adults that are younger, higher income, and higher educated.

10.3386/w22296.abstractZh: 我们使用2006-2015年《当前人口调查》中的烟草使用补充数据，通过四种不同的烟草税/价格衡量指标来计算需求的价格弹性，这些指标在不同程度上弥补了地方税收环境的影响。我们采用了美国386个子州地区的州级价格和地方级价格数据。使用最能弥补地方税收环境影响的衡量指标，我们估计总需求的价格弹性为-0.38，而其他常见的烟草价格衡量指标的弹性则明显较低。我们还发现，年龄较小、收入较高、受教育程度较高的成年人对价格的反应更为敏感。

abstract.text: Understanding how healthy lifespans are changing is essential for public policy. This paper explores changes in healthy lifespan in the U.S. over time and considers reasons for the changes. We reach three fundamental conclusions. First, we show that healthy life increased measurably in the US between 1992 and 2008. Years of healthy life expectancy at age 65 increased by 1.8 years over that time period, while disabled life expectancy fell by 0.5 years. Second, we identify the medical conditions that contribute the most to changes in healthy life expectancy. The largest improvements in healthy life expectancy come from reduced incidence and improved functioning for those with cardiovascular disease and vision problems. Together, these conditions account for 63 percent of the improvement in disability-free life expectancy. Third and more speculatively, we explore the role of medical treatments in the improvements for these two conditions. We estimate that improved medical care is likely responsible for a significant part of the cardiovascular and vision-related extension of healthy life.

10.3386/w22306.abstractZh: 了解健康寿命的变化对于公共政策至关重要。本文探讨了美国健康寿命随时间的变化情况，并分析了这些变化的原因。我们得出三个基本结论：首先，我们发现在1992年至2008年间，美国的健康寿命有显著增长。65岁时的健康预期寿命在此期间增加了1.8年，而残疾预期寿命则减少了0.5年。其次，我们确定了对健康寿命变化影响最大的疾病。健康寿命的最大改善来自于心血管疾病和视力问题患者的发病率降低和功能改善。这些疾病共同占无残疾预期寿命改善的63%。第三，更具推测性的结论是，我们探讨了医疗治疗在这些疾病改善中的作用。我们估计，改善的医疗条件可能是心血管和视力相关健康寿命延长的重要原因。

abstract.text: Ever since the seminal RAND Health insurance experiment (HIE) was conducted, most health care services, including pharmaceuticals, are deemed to be price inelastic with price elasticities of demand (PED) close to -0.20. However, most studies of PED exploit natural experiments that change demand prices for multiple components of health care. Consequently, these experiments usually do not produce estimates for the true own-price elasticities of demand but rather composite own-price elasticities that are driven by concomitant price changes to their substitutes and complements. Hence, an estimate of price elasticity is expected to vary based on the setting in which it was estimated, and likely not be applicable to other settings. In this work, exploiting a natural experiment of exogenous policy implementation of a value-based formulary (VBF) that was designed based on drug-specific incremental cost-effectiveness ratios, we estimate price elasticities of pharmaceuticals within a VBF design, formally accounting for the nature of composite elasticities that such a setting would generate. We also calculate welfare effects of such a policy using a consumer surplus approach. We show theoretically that VBF designs can increase dispersion of price elasticities of demand among pharmaceutical products compared to their true own-price elasticities and affect their magnitude based on direction of price change. Aligning these PEDs with value VBF is also likely to produce positive welfare effects. We estimate an overall PED for pharmaceuticals to be -0.16, close to the estimate of RAND HIE. However, we see substantial dispersion of PED across the VBF tiers ranging from -0.09 to -0.87 with trends aligned with the levels of value as reflected by the cost-effectiveness ratio (p<0.001). The net welfare increase was $147,000 for the cohort or $28 per member over the post-policy year. Further experimentations of VBF designs with alternative cost-effectiveness thresholds, copayment levels and value-definitions could be quite promising for improving welfare.

10.3386/w22308.abstractZh: 自RAND健康保险实验（HIE）开展以来，大多数医疗服务，包括药品，都被认为价格无弹性，需求的价格弹性接近-0.20。然而，大多数关于需求价格弹性的研究都利用了自然实验，这些实验改变了医疗服务的多个组成部分的需求价格。因此，这些实验通常无法得出真实的需求自身价格弹性的估计值，而是得到了由替代品和互补品价格变化共同驱动的复合自身价格弹性。因此，价格弹性的估计值可能会因估计的环境而有所不同，可能不适用于其他环境。在这项研究中，我们利用了一个基于药物特定增量成本效益比设计的外部政策实施的价值基础处方（VBF）自然实验，估计了VBF设计下药品的价格弹性，并正式考虑了这种设置产生的复合弹性的性质。我们还使用消费者剩余方法计算了这种政策的福利效应。我们从理论上表明，与真实自身价格弹性相比，VBF设计可以增加药品价格弹性的分散性，并且会根据价格变化的方向影响其大小。将这些需求价格弹性与价值基础处方对齐，也可能产生积极的福利效应。我们估计药品的整体需求价格弹性为-0.16，接近RAND HIE的估计值。然而，我们发现VBF层级之间的需求价格弹性有显著的分散性，范围从-0.09到-0.87，且趋势与成本效益比所反映的价值水平一致（p<0.001）。该群体的净福利增加为147,000美元，即每位成员在政策实施后的年度内增加了28美元。进一步对VBF设计进行实验，尝试不同的成本效益阈值、共付水平以及价值定义，可能会有助于提升福利水平。

abstract.text: Exposure to extreme events has been hypothesized to affect subsequent mortality because of mortality selection and scarring effects of the event itself. We examine survival at and in the five years after the 2004 Indian Ocean earthquake and tsunami for a population-representative sample of residents of Aceh, Indonesia who were differentially exposed to the disaster. For this population, the dynamics of selection and scarring are a complex function of the degree of tsunami impact in the community, the nature of individual exposures, age at exposure, and gender. Among individuals from tsunami-affected communities we find evidence for positive mortality selection among older individuals, with stronger effects for males than for females, and that this selection dominates any scarring impact of stressful exposures that elevate mortality. Among individuals from other communities, where mortality selection does not play a role, there is evidence of scarring with property loss associated with elevated mortality risks in the five years after the disaster among adults age 50 or older at the time of the disaster.

10.3386/w22317.abstractZh: 有研究假设极端事件的遭遇会影响后续的死亡率，这主要是由于死亡率的选择效应以及事件本身造成的创伤效应。本研究考察了2004年印度洋地震和海啸后五年内，印度尼西亚亚齐地区具有代表性样本居民的生存情况。这些居民在遭受灾难时的暴露程度各不相同。对于这一群体而言，死亡率的选择和创伤效应是多种因素共同作用的结果，包括社区遭受海啸影响的程度、个体暴露的性质、暴露时的年龄以及性别。在受海啸影响的社区中，我们发现年龄较大的个体存在正向的死亡率选择现象，且这种效应在男性中更为明显，这种选择效应超过了任何导致死亡率升高的压力性暴露所带来的创伤影响。而在其他社区中，由于死亡率选择效应并不显著，我们发现50岁及以上的成年人在灾难后的五年里，财产损失与更高的死亡风险之间存在关联。

abstract.text: Parallel reimbursement regimes, under which providers have some discretion over which payer gets billed for patient treatment, are a common feature of health care markets. In the U.S., the largest such system is under Workers’ Compensation (WC), where the treatment workers with injuries that are not definitively tied to a work accident may be billed either under group health insurance plans or under WC. We document that there is significant reclassification of injuries from group health plans into WC, or “claims shifting”, when the financial incentives to do so are strongest. In particular, we find that injuries to workers enrolled in capitated group health plans (such as HMOs) see a higher incidence of their claims for soft-tissue injuries under WC than under group health, relative to those in non-capitated plans. Such a pattern is not evident for workers with traumatic injuries, which are easier to classify specifically as work related. Moreover, we find that such reclassification is more common in states with higher WC fees, once again for soft tissue but not traumatic injuries. Our results imply that a significant shift towards capitated reimbursement, or reimbursement reductions, under GH could lead to a large rise in the cost of WC plans

10.3386/w22318.abstractZh: 并行报销制度是一种常见的情况，在这种制度下，医疗服务提供者在一定程度上可以自行决定将患者治疗的费用报给哪个支付方。在美国，这种制度最典型的例子就是工伤赔偿制度。在这种制度下，那些与工作事故没有明确关联的伤害，可以由团体健康保险计划或工伤赔偿制度来支付费用。我们发现，当经济激励措施最强时，团体健康保险计划中的伤害会被重新分类为工伤赔偿，即所谓的“索赔转移”。具体来说，与那些没有团体健康保险计划的工人相比，参加团体健康保险计划的工人，在工伤赔偿制度下，软组织损伤的索赔比例更高。然而，对于创伤性伤害，这种重新分类并不明显，因为创伤性伤害更容易被明确归类为与工作相关的伤害。此外，我们发现，在工伤赔偿费用较高的州，这种重新分类更为常见，同样适用于软组织损伤，而不适用于创伤性伤害。我们的研究结果表明，如果向团体健康保险制度转变，或者减少工伤赔偿费用，那么工伤赔偿计划的成本将会大幅上升。

abstract.text: While the fertility effects of improving teenagers’ access to contraception are theoretically ambiguous, most empirical work has shown that access decreases teen fertility. In this paper, we consider the fertility effects of access to condoms—a method of contraception not considered in prior work. We exploit variation across counties and across time in teenagers’ exposure to condom distribution programs in schools. We find that access to condoms in schools increases teen fertility by about 10 percent. These effects are driven by communities where condoms are provided without mandated counseling.

10.3386/w22322.abstractZh: 虽然提高青少年获得避孕手段的机会对生育率的影响在理论上存在争议，但大多数实证研究都表明，避孕手段的获取会降低青少年的生育率。在本文中，我们探讨了获得避孕套这一避孕方法的生育效应——这是之前的研究中未曾考虑过的避孕手段。我们利用了不同县以及不同时间点上青少年接触学校分发避孕套项目的差异来进行分析。研究发现，学校内提供避孕套会使青少年的生育率增加约10%。这些效应主要出现在那些提供避孕套而不强制提供咨询服务的社区中。

abstract.text: Are some management practices akin to a technology that can explain company and national productivity, or do they simply reflect contingent management styles? We collect data on core management practices from over 11,000 firms in 34 countries. We find large cross-country differences in the adoption of basic management practices, with the US having the highest size-weighted average management score. We present a formal model of “Management as a Technology", and structurally estimate it using panel data to recover parameters including the depreciation rate and adjustment costs of managerial capital (both found to be larger than for tangible non-managerial capital). Our model also predicts (i) a positive effect of management on firm performance; (ii) a positive relationship between product market competition and average management quality (part of which stems from the larger covariance between management with firm size as competition strengthens); and (iii) a rise (fall) in the level (dispersion) of management with firm age. We find strong empirical support for all of these predictions in our data. Finally, building on our model, we find that differences in management practices account for about 30% of cross-country total factor productivity differences.

10.3386/w22327.abstractZh: 某些管理实践是否类似于一种能够解释公司和国家生产力的技术，还是它们仅仅反映了不同的管理风格？我们收集了来自34个国家超过11,000家公司的核心管理实践数据。我们发现，不同国家之间在基本管理实践的采用上存在巨大差异，美国的规模加权平均管理得分最高。我们提出了一个“管理作为技术”的正式模型，并使用面板数据对其进行结构性估计，以恢复包括管理资本的折旧率和调整成本在内的参数（这些参数的大小都大于有形非管理资本）。我们的模型还预测：(i) 管理对公司绩效有积极影响；(ii) 产品市场竞争程度与平均管理质量之间存在正相关关系（其中一部分原因是由于随着市场竞争加剧，管理与公司规模之间的协方差增大）；以及(iii) 随着公司年龄的增长，管理的水平（离散度）会上升（或下降）。我们在数据中发现了所有这些预测的强烈实证支持。最后，基于我们的模型，我们发现管理实践的差异解释了约30%的国家全要素生产率差异。

abstract.text: We investigate the effect of pollution on worker productivity in the service sector by focusing on two call centers in China. Using precise measures of each worker’s daily output linked to daily measures of pollution and meteorology, we find that higher levels of air pollution decrease worker productivity by reducing the number of calls that workers complete each day. These results manifest themselves at commonly found levels of pollution in major cities throughout the developing and developed world, suggesting that these types of effects are likely to apply broadly. When decomposing these effects, we find that the decreases in productivity are explained by increases in time spent on breaks rather than the duration of phone calls. To our knowledge, this is the first study to demonstrate that the negative impacts of pollution on productivity extend beyond physically demanding tasks to indoor, white-collar work.

10.3386/w22328.abstractZh: 我们通过对中国两个呼叫中心的研究，探讨了污染对服务业工人生产力的影响。通过精确测量每位工人的每日产出，并与每日的污染和气象数据相结合，我们发现较高的空气污染水平会通过减少工人每日完成的呼叫数量来降低工人的生产力。这些结果在发展中国家和发达国家的主要城市中常见的污染水平下都得到了体现，这表明这类影响可能广泛存在。在分解这些影响时，我们发现生产力的下降是由于休息时间增加而非电话通话时间的延长所导致的。据我们所知，这是第一项研究表明污染对生产力的负面影响不仅限于体力要求较高的任务，也适用于室内白领工作。

abstract.text: The design of Medicare Part D causes most Medicare beneficiaries to receive fragmented health insurance, whereby prescription drugs and other medical care are covered by separate insurance plans. Fragmentation of insurance plans is potentially inefficient since separate insurers maximize profits over only one component of healthcare spending, despite many complementarities and substitutabilities between types of healthcare. Fragmentation of some plans but not others can also lead to market distortions due to differential adverse selection, as integrated plans may use drug formulary designs to induce enrollment by patients who are profitable under Parts A & B, while stand-alone drug plans have no such incentive. We study whether the design of insurance plans in Medicare Part D reflects these two differences in incentives using data on the universe of Part D plan formularies, drug prices, and Medicare claims data. We find evidence consistent with both hypotheses. Relative to fragmented plans, integrated plans systematically design their drug formularies to encourage enrollment by beneficiaries with medical conditions that are profitable under Parts A & B. However, integrated plans also more generously cover drugs that have the potential to causally reduce medical costs. These large differences in incentives and plan design between integrated and fragmented plans are likely the precursors of substantial differential selection of enrollees, and the basic design of Medicare Part D abets this covert selection.

10.3386/w22338.abstractZh: Medicare Part D的设计导致大多数Medicare受益人获得的是碎片化的健康保险，其中处方药和其他医疗服务由不同的保险计划覆盖。保险计划的碎片化可能效率低下，因为不同的保险公司只追求医疗保健支出的某个组成部分的利润最大化，尽管不同类型的医疗保健之间存在许多互补性和可替代性。某些计划碎片化而其他计划不碎片化的现象还可能导致市场扭曲，因为整合的保险计划可能会使用药物目录设计来吸引那些在A和B部分下能够盈利的患者的注册，而独立的药物计划则没有这样的激励。我们利用关于Medicare Part D计划目录、药物价格以及Medicare索赔数据的信息，研究保险计划在Medicare Part D中的设计是否反映了这两种不同的激励机制。我们发现的结果与两种假设都一致。与碎片化的计划相比，整合的保险计划系统地设计其药物目录，以鼓励那些在A和B部分下能够盈利的受益人的注册。然而，整合的保险计划也更慷慨地覆盖那些有可能降低医疗成本的药物。整合与碎片化计划之间这种巨大的激励和计划设计差异，很可能是导致注册受益人选择差异的重要原因，而Medicare Part D的基本设计也助长了这种隐蔽的选择行为。

abstract.text: There is concern that licensure requirements impede mobility of licensed professionals to areas of high demand. Nursing has not been immune to this criticism, especially in the context of perceived nurse shortages and large expected future demand. The Nurse Licensure Compact (NLC) was introduced to solve this problem by permitting registered nurses to practice across state lines without obtaining additional licensure. We exploit the staggered adoption of the NLC to examine whether a reduction in licensure-induced barriers alters the nurse labor market. Using data on over 1.8 million nurses and other health care workers we find no evidence that the labor supply or mobility of nurses increases following the adoption of the NLC, even among the residents of counties bordering other NLC states who are potentially most affected by the NLC. This suggests that nationalizing occupational licensing will not substantially reduce labor market frictions.

10.3386/w22344.abstractZh: 有担忧认为，执照要求阻碍了持证专业人士前往需求较高的地区执业。护理行业也不例外，尤其是在护士短缺和未来需求巨大的背景下。为了应对这一问题，美国引入了“护士执照协议”（NLC），该协议允许注册护士在跨州范围内执业，而无需额外获得执照。我们利用NLC的逐步实施情况，研究减少执照限制是否会影响护士劳动力市场的状况。通过对超过180万护士及其他医疗保健工作者的数据进行分析，我们发现，即使在可能受到NLC影响最大的邻近NLC州的居民中，NLC实施后，护士的劳动力供应和流动性并未增加。这表明，将职业执照制度全国化并不能显著减少劳动力市场的摩擦。

abstract.text: This study examines whether the effect of job loss on body mass index (BMI) at older ages is moderated by genotype using twenty years of socio-demographic and genome-wide data from the Health and Retirement Study (HRS). To avoid any potential confounding we interact layoffs due to a plant or business closure—a plausibly exogenous environmental exposure—with a polygenic risk score for BMI in a regression-adjusted semiparametric differences-in-differences matching framework that compares the BMI of those before and after an involuntary job loss with a control group that has not been laid off. Results indicate genetically-at-risk workers who lost their job before they were eligible for Social Security benefits, or before age 62, were more likely to gain weight. Further analysis reveals heterogeneous treatment effects by demographic, health, and socioeconomic characteristics. In particular, we find high risk individuals who gained weight after a job loss were more likely to be male, in worse health, single, and at the bottom half of the wealth distribution. Across the board, effects are concentrated among high-risk individuals who were not overweight prior to job loss, indicating unemployment at older ages may trigger weight gain in otherwise healthy or normal weight populations.

10.3386/w22348.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了在老年时期，失业对体重指数（BMI）的影响是否受到基因型的调节，研究采用了来自“健康与退休研究”的二十年的社会人口统计数据和全基因组数据。为了避免潜在的混淆因素，我们将因工厂或企业关闭而失业的情况——一种可能的外部环境暴露——与BMI的多基因风险评分进行了关联，并在一个回归调整的半参数差异匹配框架中进行了比较，比较了在被迫失业前后BMI的变化情况，以及未失业的对照组。研究结果表明，那些在达到社会保障福利资格之前，或在62岁之前失业的具有遗传风险的人群，更有可能体重增加。进一步分析显示，不同人口统计特征、健康状况和社会经济背景下的治疗效果存在差异。具体而言，我们发现，在失业后体重增加的高风险个体中，男性比例较高，健康状况较差，单身，且处于财富分布的下半部分。总体而言，这些影响主要集中在那些在失业前并不超重的高风险个体中，这表明在老年时期失业可能会触发其他健康或正常体重人群体重增加。

abstract.text: We examine an untested hypothesis that posits that null results in early studies examining the economic impacts of smoking bans were driven by sample selection. Early adopters could better absorb the shock of bans, but among worse selected late adopters bans would adversely impact bars and restaurants. We exploit variation in the timing of ban institution among Texas municipalities and track their impact over time. We find similar adjustments trajectories between late and early adopters, but late adopters appear unaffected by bans in the long-term. Consistent with earlier studies, bans do not significantly affect bar and restaurant sales or establishment level alcohol tax expenditures.

10.3386/w22352.abstractZh: 我们检验了一个未经验证的假设，即早期研究中关于禁烟令经济影响的零结果可能是由于样本选择造成的。早期采纳者能够更好地应对禁烟令带来的冲击，但那些选择较晚的采纳者则可能会受到禁烟令的负面影响，尤其是对酒吧和餐馆的影响。我们利用了德克萨斯州各城市禁烟令实施时间的差异，并跟踪其随时间的影响。我们发现，无论是早期采纳者还是晚期采纳者，其调整轨迹都相似，但晚期采纳者在长期内似乎并未受到禁烟令的影响。与早期的研究一致，禁烟令并未显著影响酒吧和餐馆的销售额，也未改变这些场所的酒精税收入。

abstract.text: We present a model in which prospective patients are liquidity constrained, and thus health insurance allows patients access to treatments and services that they otherwise would have been unable to afford. Consistent with large expansions of insurance in the U.S. (e.g., the Affordable Care Act), we assume that policies expand the set of services that must be covered by insurance. We show that the profit-maximizing price for an innovative treatment is greater in the presence of health insurance than it would be for an uninsured population. We also show that consumer surplus is less than it would be if the innovation was not covered. These results show that even in the absence of moral hazard, there are channels through which insurance can negatively affect consumer welfare. Our model also provides an economic rationale for the claim that pharmaceutical firms set prices that exceed the value their products create. We empirically examine our model's predictions by studying the pricing of oncology drugs following the 2003 passage of Medicare Part D. Prior to 2003, drugs covered under Medicare Part B had higher prices than those that would eventually be covered under Part D. In general, the trends in pricing across these categories were similar.
