However, after 2003 there was a far greater increase in prices for products covered under Part D, and as result, products covered by both programs were sold at similar prices. In addition, these prices were quite high compared to the value created by the products---suggesting that the forced bundle of Part D might have allowed firms to capture more value than their products created.

10.3386/w22353.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个模型，其中潜在患者面临流动性约束，因此健康保险使患者能够获得他们原本无法负担的治疗和服务。与美国大规模扩大保险政策（例如《平价医疗法案》）的情况一致，我们假设保险政策扩大了保险必须覆盖的服务范围。我们表明，在健康保险存在的情况下，创新疗法的利润最大化价格高于无保险人群的情况。我们还发现，消费者剩余低于创新疗法未被覆盖时的水平。这些结果表明，即使不存在道德风险，保险也可以通过某些渠道对消费者福利产生负面影响。我们的模型还为制药公司定价超过其产品创造价值的说法提供了经济依据。我们通过研究2003年《医疗保险法案》D部分实施后肿瘤药物的定价，来实证检验我们模型的预测结果。2003年之前，医疗保险B部分覆盖的药物价格高于最终由D部分覆盖的药物价格。总体而言，这些类别的价格趋势相似。然而，2003年之后，D部分覆盖的产品价格出现了更大的上涨，结果导致两个计划都覆盖的产品以相似的价格出售。此外，这些价格与产品创造的价值相比相当高，这表明强制性的D部分捆绑销售可能使制药公司获得比其产品创造的价值更多的收益。

abstract.text: I examine treatment effect heterogeneity within an experiment to inform external validity. The local average treatment effect (LATE) gives an average treatment effect for compliers. I bound and estimate average treatment effects for always takers and never takers by extending marginal treatment effect methods. I use these methods to separate selection from treatment effect heterogeneity, generalizing the comparison of OLS to LATE. Applying these methods to the Oregon Health Insurance Experiment, I find that the treatment effect of insurance on emergency room utilization decreases from always takers to compliers to never takers. Previous utilization explains a large share of the treatment effect heterogeneity. Extrapolations show that other expansions could increase or decrease utilization.

10.3386/w22363.abstractZh: 我研究了实验中处理效应异质性，以了解其外部有效性。局部平均处理效应（LATE）为遵守者提供了平均处理效应。我通过扩展边际处理效应方法，对始终参与者和从不参与者进行了平均处理效应的界定和估计。利用这些方法，我将选择效应与处理效应异质性分离开来，从而将OLS比较推广到LATE。将这些方法应用于俄勒冈健康保险实验，我发现保险对急诊室使用的影响，从始终参与者到遵守者，再到从不参与者，呈现出递减趋势。以往的使用情况解释了大部分处理效应异质性。通过外推分析，发现其他因素可能会增加或减少急诊室的使用。

abstract.text: We combine Danish data on individuals’ health with Danish matched worker-firm data, and find: One, within job spells, as firm sales increases, workers log longer hours and experience higher probabilities of stress and depression, and heart diseases and strokes; Two, the effects of firm sales on adverse health outcomes are more pronounced for high-risk groups: older workers, job-strained workers, and those with long initial work hours; Three, the worker cohorts who experience large sales increases develop higher risks of sickness in subsequent quarters. These novel results suggest that work demand increases individuals’ workplace stress and elevates their sickness risk. We then compute the marginal disutility of our sickness variables, and show that the average worker’s ex-ante welfare loss due to higher sickness rates accounts for nearly one quarter of her earnings gains from rising firm sales.

10.3386/w22365.abstractZh: 我们结合了丹麦关于个人健康的数据与丹麦的匹配工人-企业数据，发现：首先，在工作的不同阶段，随着企业销售额的增加，工人的工作时间会延长，他们面临的压力和抑郁风险也会增加，同时患心脏病和中风的概率也会上升；其次，企业销售额对不良健康结果的影响在高风险群体中更为明显：年龄较大的工人、工作压力较大的工人以及最初工作时间较长的工人；第三，那些经历销售额大幅增长的工人群体，在后续季度中患病的风险也会上升。这些新的结果表明，工作需求会增加个人的工作压力，并提高他们的患病风险。我们进一步计算了疾病变量的边际效用损失，结果显示，由于疾病率的上升，普通工人因企业销售额增加而获得的收益几乎被疾病风险带来的损失所抵消，这一损失占其收益的四分之一左右。

abstract.text: A large literature in empirical public finance relies on “bunching” to identify a behavioral response to non-linear incentives and to translate this response into an economic object to be used counterfactually. We conduct this type of analysis in the context of prescription drug insurance for the elderly in Medicare Part D, where a kink in the individual’s budget set generates substantial bunching in annual drug expenditure around the famous “donut hole.” We show that different alternative economic models can match the basic bunching pattern, but have very different quantitative implications for the counterfactual spending response to alternative insurance contracts. These findings illustrate the importance of modeling choices in mapping a compelling reduced form pattern into an economic object of interest.

10.3386/w22369.abstractZh: 在实证公共财政领域，大量文献依赖于“聚集效应”来识别对非线性激励的行为反应，并将这种反应转化为可用于反事实分析的经济对象。我们在Medicare Part D老年处方药保险的背景下进行了此类分析，其中个人预算集中的某个节点会导致年度药物支出出现显著的聚集现象，尤其是在所谓的“甜甜圈空洞”区域。我们发现，不同的经济模型可以描述基本的聚集模式，但对于不同保险合同的反事实支出反应，它们具有截然不同的定量影响。这些发现说明了在将引人注目的简化形式模式转化为感兴趣的经济对象时，对模型选择的重要性。

abstract.text: US policymakers place a high priority on tying Medicare payments to the value of care delivered. A critical part of this effort is the Hospital Value-based Purchasing Program (HVBP), which rewards or penalizes hospitals based on their quality and episode-based costs of care. Within HVBP, each patient affects hospital performance on a variety of quality and spending measures, and performance translates directly to changes in program points and ultimately dollars. In short, hospital revenue from a patient consists not only of the DRG payment, but also consists of that patient’s marginal future reimbursement. We estimate the magnitude of the marginal future reimbursement for individual patients across each type of quality and performance measure. We describe how those incentives differ across hospitals, including integrated and safety-net hospitals. We find some evidence that hospitals improved their performance over time in the areas where they have the highest marginal incentives to improve care.

10.3386/w22371.abstractZh: 美国政策制定者高度重视将医疗保险支付与所提供的医疗服务价值挂钩。这一举措的关键部分就是医院价值采购计划（HVBP），该计划根据医院的服务质量和每例病例的成本来给予奖励或惩罚。在HVBP中，每位患者都会对医院在多种质量和成本指标上的表现产生影响，而这些表现又会直接转化为计划积分的变化，最终体现在资金上的变化。简而言之，医院从每位患者那里获得的收入不仅包括DRG支付，还包括该患者未来的边际补偿。我们估算了各类质量和绩效指标下，每位患者未来边际补偿的幅度。我们还分析了这些激励措施在不同医院之间的差异，包括综合医院和福利性医院。我们发现，有证据表明，医院在那些边际激励措施最强的领域，随着时间的推移，其表现有所改善。

abstract.text: The minimum wage has increased in multiple states over the past three decades. We examine the impact of the state minimum wage on infant health. Using data on the universe of births in the US over 24 years, we find that an increase in the minimum wage is associated with an increase in birth weight driven by increased gestational length and fetal growth rate. The effect size is meaningful and plausible. We also find an increase in prenatal care use and a decline in smoking during pregnancy, which are some channels through which minimum wage can affect infant health.

10.3386/w22373.abstractZh: 在过去三十年中，多个州的最低工资水平有所提高。我们研究了州最低工资对婴儿健康的影响。通过对比美国24年间所有出生数据，我们发现最低工资的提高与出生体重的增加有关，这得益于妊娠期长度的延长和胎儿生长速率的提升。这种影响是显著且合理的。我们还发现，最低工资提高了产前护理的使用率，并减少了孕妇的吸烟行为，这些都是最低工资影响婴儿健康的途径之一。

abstract.text: This study examines whether draft-lottery estimates of the causal effect of Vietnam-era military service on schooling vary by genetic propensity toward educational attainment. To capture the complex genetic architecture that underlies the bio-developmental pathways behavioral traits and evoked environments associated with educational attainment, we construct a polygenic score (PGS) for the Vietnam-era cohort in the Health and Retirement Study (HRS) that aggregates thousands of individual loci across the human genome, weighted by effect sizes derived from a recent genome-wide association study (GWAS) for years of education. Our findings suggest veterans with below average PGSs for educational attainment completed fewer years of schooling than comparable non-veterans with the same PGS, primarily due to fewer years of college education. On the other hand, we do not find any difference in the educational attainment of veterans and non-veterans with above average PGSs. Results show that public policies and exogenous environments may induce heterogeneous treatment effects by genetic disposition.

10.3386/w22393.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了越南时期兵役对教育的因果效应在遗传倾向上的差异。为了捕捉与教育成就相关的行为特征及诱发环境的复杂遗传结构，我们为健康与退休研究中的越南时期队列构建了一个多基因评分系统，该系统整合了人类基因组中数千个基因位点，并根据最近一项关于教育年限的全基因组关联研究得出的效应大小进行加权。研究发现，具有低于平均教育多基因评分的退伍军人，其接受的教育年限少于具有相同评分的非退伍军人，这主要是由于他们接受大学教育年限较少。另一方面，对于具有高于平均教育多基因评分的退伍军人和非退伍军人来说，我们没有发现教育成就上的任何差异。结果表明，公共政策和外源环境可能会因遗传倾向的不同而引发不同的教育效果。

abstract.text: At the end of the U.S Civil War, veterans had to choose whether to return to their prewar communities or move to new areas. The late 19th Century was a time of sharp urban growth as workers sought out the economic opportunities offered by cities. By estimating discrete choice migration models, we quantify the tradeoffs that veterans faced. Veterans were less likely to move far from their origin and avoided urban immigrant areas and high mortality risk areas. They also avoided areas that opposed the Civil War. Veterans were more likely to move to a neighborhood or a county where men from their same war company lived. This co-location evidence highlights the existence of persistent social networks. Such social networks had long-term consequences: veterans living close to war time friends enjoyed a longer life.

10.3386/w22397.abstractZh: 在美国内战结束时，退伍军人必须选择是返回战前的社区还是迁移到新的地区。19世纪末是一个城市迅速发展的时期，工人们纷纷寻求城市所提供的经济机会。通过离散选择迁移模型的分析，我们量化了退伍军人所面临的权衡。退伍军人不太可能远离他们的原籍地，他们避免了城市移民区和高死亡率风险区域。他们还避免了那些与内战有矛盾的地区。退伍军人更有可能迁移到与他们同一部队的士兵居住的社区或县。这种共同居住的现象凸显了持久的社会网络的存在。这样的社会网络具有长期影响：与战争时期的战友居住相近的退伍军人享有更长的寿命。

abstract.text: A key component for estimating the optimal size and structure of disability insurance (DI) programs is the elasticity of DI claiming with respect to benefit generosity. Yet, in many countries, including the United States, all workers face identical benefit schedules, which are a function of one’s labor market history, making it difficult to separate the effect of the benefit level from the effect of unobserved preferences for work on individuals’ claiming decisions. To circumvent this problem, we exploit exogenous variation in DI benefits in Austria arising from several reforms to its DI and old age pension system in the 1990s and 2000s. We use comprehensive administrative social security records data on the universe of Austrian workers to compute benefit levels under six different regimes, allowing us to identify and precisely estimate the elasticity of DI claiming with respect to benefit generosity. We find that, over this time period, a one percent increase in potential DI benefits was associated with a 1.2 percent increase in DI claiming.

10.3386/w22419.abstractZh: 估算残疾保险计划的最佳规模和结构的一个关键因素是残疾保险索赔对福利慷慨程度的弹性。然而，在包括美国在内的许多国家，所有工人的福利计划都是相同的，这主要取决于个人的劳动力市场经历，因此很难将福利水平的影响与个体对工作的未观测偏好对索赔决策的影响区分开来。为了规避这个问题，我们利用了奥地利在1990年代和2000年代对其残疾保险和老年养老金体系进行多项改革所带来的残疾保险福利的外生变化。我们利用了奥地利工人全面的社会保障记录数据，在六种不同制度下计算福利水平，从而能够识别并精确估算残疾保险索赔对福利慷慨程度的弹性。研究发现，在这段时间内，潜在残疾保险福利每增加1%，残疾保险索赔就会增加1.2%。

abstract.text: The patient-centered medical home (PCMH) is a model for restructuring primary care with a focus on improved access to care and clinical excellence. However, to date, the evidence on its effect on healthcare utilization and expenditures has been quite mixed. One possible reason for this may lie in the flexibility with which a practice can meet the thresholds for PCMH recognition, adopting practice reforms in vastly different domains. Hence, practices with the same recognition level may in fact demonstrate divergent capabilities, and subsequently have different leverage over the achievement of the PCMH goals. We study this idea by using previously unavailable data that spans all PCMH recognition domains. The richness of our data allows us to group practices into clusters based on their choice of attributes during the recognition process, and then examine the performance of individual clusters in reducing healthcare utilization and expenditures. We find that treating the PCMH model as an undifferentiated intervention obscures meaningful variation in implementation across practices. In particular, clusters emphasizing practice improvements like use of decision support, enhanced access to care and population management tools have demonstrated some success in impacting utilization and expenditures patterns after PCMH recognition.

10.3386/w22429.abstractZh: 以患者为中心的医疗之家（PCMH）是一种重构初级保健的模式，重点在于改善就医渠道和临床质量。然而，迄今为止，关于其对医疗使用和支出影响的证据仍然存在较大差异。其中一个可能的原因在于，不同医疗机构在达到PCMH认定标准时，能够灵活采取不同的实践改革措施。因此，即使认定标准相同，不同医疗机构也可能表现出不同的能力，从而在实现PCMH目标方面具有不同的影响力。我们通过使用此前未公开的数据来研究这一现象，这些数据涵盖了所有PCMH认定领域。数据的丰富性使我们能够根据认定过程中所选的属性将医疗机构分组，然后考察各个分组在减少医疗使用和支出方面的表现。我们发现，将PCMH模型视为一种无差别的干预措施，会掩盖不同医疗机构在实施过程中的显著差异。特别是，那些强调实践改进（如使用决策支持工具、改善就医渠道以及运用人群管理工具）的分组，在获得PCMH认定后，在影响医疗使用和支出模式方面取得了一定的成功。

abstract.text: In this study we quantify the life-cycle effects of human and health capital on the wage distribution of females, with a focus on health measured by body mass. We use NLSY79 data on women followed annually up to twenty years during the time of their lives when average annual weight gain is greatest. We allow body mass to explain variation in wages contemporaneously conditional on observed measures of human capital and productivity histories (namely, education, employment experience, marital status, and family size) and dynamically over the life cycle through its impact on the endogenous histories of behaviors that determine wages. We find significant differences in the contemporaneous effect and the dynamic effect of body mass on wages, both across females of different races and over the distribution of wages.

10.3386/w22430.abstractZh: 本研究量化了人类健康资本对女性工资分布的生命周期影响，重点关注以体重衡量的健康状况。我们使用了NLSY79数据，这些数据记录了女性二十年的年度变化，时间跨度正值她们年均体重增长最显著的时候。我们假设体重能够解释在观察到的人力资本和生产力历史（即教育水平、就业经验、婚姻状况和家庭规模）条件下的工资变化，并通过其对决定工资的行为动态影响，在生命周期内动态地解释这种变化。我们发现，无论女性种族如何，体重对工资的同时效应和动态效应都存在显著差异，且这种差异在工资分布上也有体现。

abstract.text: In many markets insurers are barred from price discrimination based on consumer characteristics like age, gender, and medical history. In this paper, I build on a recent literature to show why such policies are inefficient if consumers differ in their willingness-to-pay for insurance conditional on the insured losses they generate. Using administrative claims data, I then show that this type of demand heterogeneity is empirically relevant in a consumer health plan setting. Younger and older consumers and men and women reveal strikingly different demand for health insurance, conditional on their objective medical spending risk. This implies that these groups must face different prices in order to sort themselves efficiently across insurance contracts. The theoretical and empirical analysis highlights a fundamental tradeoff between equity and efficiency that is unique to selection markets.

10.3386/w22440.abstractZh: 在许多市场中，保险公司被禁止根据消费者的年龄、性别和医疗历史等特征进行价格歧视。在本文中，我基于近期的相关研究，探讨了为何这种政策会效率低下——因为消费者在支付保险费用方面的意愿会因他们所承担的保险损失而有所不同。通过利用行政索赔数据，我证明了这种需求异质性在消费者健康计划领域具有实际意义。年轻和年长的消费者，以及男性和女性，在面临客观医疗支出风险的情况下，对健康保险的需求存在显著差异。这意味着这些群体必须面对不同的价格，才能有效地在保险合同中进行选择。理论和实证分析揭示了选择市场中公平与效率之间存在的根本权衡。

abstract.text: This paper first uses data from three large international surveys – the Gallup World Poll, the World Values Survey and the European Social Survey – to estimate income-equivalent values for social trust, with a likely lower bound equivalent to a doubling of household income. Second, the more detailed and precisely measured trust data in the European Social Survey (ESS) show that social trust is only a part of the overall climate of trust. While social trust and trust in police are the most important elements, there are significant additional benefits from trust in three aspects of the institutional environment: the legal system, parliament and politicians. Thus estimates of the total well-being value of a trustworthy environment are larger than those based on social trust alone. Third, the ESS data show that living in a high-trust environment makes people more resilient to adversity. Being subject to discrimination, ill-health or unemployment, although always damaging to subjective well-being, is much less damaging to those living in trustworthy environments. These results suggest a fresh set of links between trust and inequality. Individuals who are subject to discrimination, ill-health or unemployment are typically concentrated towards the lower end of any national distribution of happiness. Thus the resilience-increasing feature of social trust reduces well-being inequality by channeling the largest benefits to those at the low end of the well-being distribution.

10.3386/w22450.abstractZh: 本文首先利用三项大型国际调查的数据——盖洛普世界民意调查、世界价值观调查和欧洲社会调查——来估算社会信任的等价收入值，其可能的下限相当于家庭收入翻倍。其次，欧洲社会调查中的详细且精确的信任数据表明，社会信任只是整体信任氛围的一部分。虽然社会信任和对警察的信任是最重要的因素，但在制度环境的三个方面——法律体系、议会和政治人物——信任还能带来显著的额外好处。因此，基于信任的总福祉价值估计值比仅基于社会信任的估计值要高。第三，欧洲社会调查的数据表明，生活在高信任环境中的人更能抵御逆境。尽管遭受歧视、健康不佳或失业总是会对主观幸福感造成负面影响，但在信任环境中生活的人受到的损害要小得多。这些结果揭示了信任与不平等之间新的联系。遭受歧视、健康不佳或失业的人通常集中在任何国家幸福感分布的较低端。因此，社会信任的增强韧性特征通过将最大的好处分配给幸福感分布较低端的人群，从而减少了福祉不平等。

abstract.text: Occupational licensing is intended to protect consumers. Whether it does so is an important, but unanswered, question. Exploiting variation across states and municipalities in the timing and details of midwifery laws introduced during the period 1900-1940, and using a rich data set that we assembled from primary sources, we find that requiring midwives to be licensed reduced maternal mortality by 6 to 7 percent. In addition, we find that requiring midwives to be licensed may have had led to modest reductions in nonwhite infant mortality and mortality among children under the age of 2 from diarrhea. These estimates provide the first econometric evidence of which we are aware on the relationship between licensure and consumer safety, and are directly relevant to ongoing policy debates both in the United States and in the developing world surrounding the merits of licensing midwives.

10.3386/w22456.abstractZh: 职业许可的目的是为了保护消费者。其是否真的起到了保护作用，是一个重要但尚未解答的问题。通过研究1900至1940年间各州和市在助产士法律实施时间和细节上的差异，并利用我们从原始资料中整理出的丰富数据，我们发现要求助产士获得许可可以将孕产妇死亡率降低6%到7%。此外，我们还发现，要求助产士获得许可可能有助于适度降低非白人婴儿死亡率以及2岁以下儿童因腹泻导致的死亡率。这些估计为我们所知的关于许可与消费者安全之间关系的首个计量经济学证据，并且直接涉及美国和发展中国家关于助产士许可制度的政策讨论。

abstract.text: Research linking economic conditions and health largely ignores children’s mental health problems, which are the most common and consequential health issues for children and adolescents. We examine the effects of unemployment rates and housing prices on child and adolescent mental health and use of special education services for emotional problems in the 2001-2013 National Health Interview Survey. Mental health status declines as economic conditions deteriorate, and this result is pervasive across nearly every subgroup we examine, including families least likely to experience job loss. The use of special education services for emotional problems also rises when economic conditions worsen.

10.3386/w22459.abstractZh: 关于经济状况与健康状况之间关系的研究，大多忽视了儿童心理健康问题，而这些问题正是儿童和青少年中最常见且最为严重的健康问题。本研究通过2001-2013年的全国健康访谈调查，探讨了失业率与房价对儿童及青少年心理健康以及针对情绪问题的特殊教育服务使用情况的影响。研究发现，随着经济状况的恶化，心理健康状况会下降，这一结果在我们研究的几乎所有子群体中均普遍存在，包括那些最不可能遭遇失业的家庭。此外，当经济状况恶化时，针对情绪问题的特殊教育服务使用率也会上升。

abstract.text: Childhood vaccinations are an important input to disease prevention, but vaccination rates have declined over the last decade due largely to parental fears about vaccine dangers. Education campaigns on the safety of vaccines seem to have little impact. Anecdotal evidence on disease outbreaks suggests that they may prompt vaccination behavior. I use newly compiled data on vaccinations and outbreaks to estimate whether vaccinations respond to disease outbreaks. I find that the pertussis vaccination rate increases among children at school entry following an outbreak in the year prior. A large outbreak in the county can decrease the share of unvaccinated children by 28% (1.2 percentage points). These responses do not reflect true changes in the future disease risk. I argue these facts may be explained by a model in which perceived risk of disease is influenced by whether a household is aware of any cases of disease. This suggests better “promotion” of outbreaks could enhance the response. I use survey data from health departments to show that states which directly coordinate outbreak responses have substantially larger vaccination increases in the wake of an outbreak, suggesting centralized management may better take advantage of this opportunity.

10.3386/w22464.abstractZh: 儿童疫苗接种是预防疾病的重要手段，但过去十年中，由于家长对疫苗风险的担忧，疫苗接种率有所下降。关于疫苗安全性的宣传教育似乎效果有限。一些关于疾病爆发的案例表明，这些宣传可能会促使人们接种疫苗。我利用新收集的数据来估算疫苗接种是否会对疾病爆发产生反应。研究发现，在上一年的疾病爆发之后，儿童入学时的百日咳疫苗接种率会上升。一个县内发生大规模疾病爆发时，未接种疫苗的儿童比例可减少28%（即1.2个百分点）。这些反应并不反映未来疾病风险的真实变化。我认为，这些现象可以通过一个模型来解释，即家庭是否了解任何疾病病例会影响他们对疾病风险的感知。这表明，更好地宣传疾病爆发情况可能会增强疫苗接种的响应。我利用卫生部门的调查数据表明，那些直接协调疫情应对措施的州在疫情过后疫苗接种率的增长幅度更大，这表明集中式管理可能更好地利用这一机会。

abstract.text: This paper examines the sources of differences in social mobility between the U.S. and Denmark. Measured by income mobility, Denmark is a more mobile society, but not when measured by educational mobility. There are pronounced nonlinearities in income and educational mobility in both countries. Greater Danish income mobility is largely a consequence of redistributional tax, transfer, and wage compression policies. While Danish social policies for children produce more favorable cognitive test scores for disadvantaged children, these do not translate into more favorable educational outcomes, partly because of disincentives to acquire education arising from the redistributional policies that increase income mobility.

10.3386/w22465.abstractZh: 本文探讨了美国与丹麦在社会流动性方面的差异来源。从收入流动性的角度来看，丹麦是一个流动性较高的社会，但从教育流动性的角度来看则并非如此。两国在收入和教育流动性方面都存在显著的非线性关系。丹麦较高的收入流动性主要得益于再分配性税收、转移支付和工资压缩政策。虽然丹麦针对儿童的社会政策能够提升弱势儿童的认知测试成绩，但这些成绩并未转化为更优的教育成果，部分原因是再分配性政策增加了收入流动性，从而降低了人们接受教育的积极性。

abstract.text: Recent tobacco regulations proposed by the Food and Drug Administration have raised a thorny question: how should the cost-benefit analysis accompanying such policies value foregone consumer surplus associated with regulation-induced reductions in smoking? In a model with rational and fully informed consumers, this question is straightforward. There is disagreement, however, about whether consumers are rational and fully informed, and the literature offers little practical guidance about what approach the FDA should use if they are not. In this paper, we outline the history of the FDA’s recent attempts to regulate cigarettes and other tobacco products and how they have valued foregone consumer surplus in cost-benefit analyses. We discuss the evidence on whether consumers are fully informed about the risks of smoking and whether their choices are rational, reviewing the competing arguments made by different authors about these questions. We describe the appropriate approach to welfare analysis under different assumptions about consumer information and rationality. Based on our reading of the theoretical and empirical literatures, we advocate using a behavioral public finance framework borrowed from the literature on environmental regulation. This approach applies standard tools of welfare analysis while allowing consumer behavior to deviate from rationality and full information without requiring specific assumptions about the reason for the deviation. The use of this approach would substantially reduce the confusion currently surrounding welfare analysis of tobacco regulation.

10.3386/w22471.abstractZh: 美国食品药品监督管理局最近提出的烟草法规引发了一个棘手的问题：这种政策所带来的成本效益分析应如何评估因限制吸烟而错失的消费者剩余？在一个具有理性且完全信息的消费者的模型中，这个问题相对简单。然而，关于消费者是否具备理性和完全信息的问题存在分歧，相关文献对于FDA在不具备这些信息的条件下应采用何种方法也提供了很少的实用指导。在本文中，我们概述了FDA最近试图对香烟和其他烟草产品进行监管的历史，以及他们在成本效益分析中如何评估错失的消费者剩余。我们讨论了关于消费者是否完全了解吸烟风险以及他们的选择是否理性的证据，并回顾了不同学者对此问题的不同观点。我们描述了在不同消费者信息和理性假设下进行福利分析的方法。基于我们对理论和实证文献的研读，我们主张采用从环境监管领域借鉴的行为性公共财政框架。这种方法运用标准的福利分析工具，同时允许消费者行为偏离理性和完全信息状态，而无需对偏离的原因做出特定假设。采用这种方法将大大减少目前围绕烟草法规福利分析所存在的困惑。

abstract.text: Physician treatment choices for observably similar patients vary dramatically across regions. This paper exploits cardiologist migration to disentangle the role of physician- specific factors such as preferences and learned behavior versus environment-level factors such as hospital capacity and productivity spillovers on physician behavior. Physicians starting in the same region and subsequently moving to dissimilar regions practice similarly before the move. After the move, physician behavior in the first year changes by 0.6-0.8 percentage points for each percentage point change in practice environment, with no further changes over time. This suggests environment factors explain between 60-80 percent of regional disparities in physician behavior.

10.3386/w22478.abstractZh: 不同地区的医生在治疗方案选择上存在显著差异。本文通过分析心脏病专家的迁移现象，试图揭示医生行为中的特定因素（如偏好和习得行为）与环境层面的因素（如医院容量和生产力溢出效应）之间的相互作用。最初在同一地区执业的医生在迁移到不同地区后，其治疗方案在迁移前和迁移后表现出相似的特征。迁移后，医生在第一年的治疗方案变化幅度为每变化1个百分点，医生行为随之变化0.6-0.8个百分点，之后变化幅度逐渐减小。这表明环境因素可以解释60-80%的地区间医生行为差异。

abstract.text: India started the implementation of a rural public works program in 2006, covering all districts of the country within three years. The program quarantees 100 days of employment per year at minimum wage to each rural household on demand, with the goal of reducing joblessness and poverty. We exploit the design and implementation of this program to investigate its employment impact on various types of crimes, ranging from burglary to kidnapping to riots. We show that the program acts as an insurance scheme because an increase in rainfall, which is negatively correlated with agricultural production, lowers the demand for jobs under the program. Controlling for rainfall, we find that employment generated by the program has a negative impact on both property and violent crime. Although crime elasticities with respect to employment are small, this finding represents another dimension of the social benefit generated by the program.

10.3386/w22499.abstractZh: 印度于2006年开始实施农村公共工程计划，并在三年内覆盖了全国所有地区。该计划承诺每年为每个农村家庭提供至少100天的就业机会，工资按照最低标准支付，旨在减少失业和贫困。我们通过研究该计划的设计和实施情况，来探讨其对各类犯罪行为的就业影响，包括入室盗窃、绑架和骚乱等。我们发现，该计划实际上起到了一种“保险机制”的作用，因为降雨量的增加与农业生产呈负相关，这导致在该计划下对就业的需求降低。在控制降雨量的前提下，我们发现该计划产生的就业机会对财产犯罪和暴力犯罪都有负面影响。尽管就业对犯罪行为的弹性较小，但这一发现代表了该计划所带来的社会效益的另一个方面。

abstract.text: This analysis utilizes death certificate data from the Multiple Cause of Death (MCOD) files to better measure the specific drugs involved in drug poisoning fatalities. Statistical adjustment procedures are used to provide more accurate estimates, accounting for the understatement in death certificate reports resulting because no drug is specified in between one-fifth and one-quarter of cases. The adjustment procedures typically raise the estimates of specific types of drug involvement by 30% to 50% and emphasize the importance of the simultaneous use of multiple categories of drugs. Using these adjusted estimates, an analysis is next provided of drugs accounting for the rapid increase over time in fatal overdoses. The frequency of combination drug use introduces uncertainty into these estimates and so a distinction is made between any versus exclusive involvement of specific drug types. Many of the results are sensitive to the starting and ending years chosen for examination, with a key role of prescription opioids for analysis windows starting in 1999 but with other drugs, particularly heroin deaths, becoming more significant in more recent years and, again, with confirmatory evidence of the importance of simultaneous drug use.

10.3386/w22504.abstractZh: 该分析利用多死因死亡登记文件中的死亡证明数据，以更准确地衡量药物中毒致死事件中涉及的具体药物。通过统计调整方法，可以更准确地估算这些药物的使用情况，因为五分之一到四分之一的病例中并未明确列出具体药物。调整方法通常能将特定类型药物的使用比例提高30%至50%，并强调了同时使用多种药物的重要性。利用这些调整后的估算数据，进一步分析了导致致命药物过量事件随时间迅速增加的原因。组合用药的频率增加了估算的不确定性，因此区分了特定药物类型的单独使用与同时使用的情况。许多结果对选择的研究起始和结束年份非常敏感，对于以1999年开始的分析窗口，处方类阿片类药物起着关键作用，但近年来其他药物，尤其是海洛因的致死案例变得更加重要。此外，有确凿证据表明同时使用多种药物的重要性不容忽视。

abstract.text: As hospitals are increasingly held accountable for patients' post-discharge outcomes under new payment models, hospitals may choose to acquire skilled nursing facilities (SNFs) to better manage these outcomes. This raises the question of whether patients discharged to hospital-based SNFs have better outcomes. In unadjusted comparisons, hospital-based SNF patients have much lower Medicare utilization in the 180 days following discharge relative to freestanding SNF patients. We solved the problem of differential selection into hospital-based and freestanding SNFs by using differential distance from home to the nearest hospital with a SNF relative to the distance from home to the nearest hospital without a SNF as an instrument. We found that hospital-based SNF patients spent roughly 5 more days in the community and 6 fewer days in the SNF in the 180 days following their original hospital discharge with no significant effect on mortality or hospital readmission.

10.3386/w22515.abstractZh: 随着新的支付模式要求医院对患者的出院后结果负责，医院可能会选择收购专业护理机构，以更好地管理这些结果。这引发了这样一个问题：被转至医院专业护理机构的患者是否会有更好的康复效果？在未经调整的对比中，与独立专业护理机构的患者相比，转至医院专业护理机构的患者在出院后的180天内，Medicare的医疗费用要低得多。我们通过使用患者从家中到最近有护理机构的距离与没有护理机构时到最近医院的距离的差异作为指标，解决了患者选择医院专业护理机构与独立护理机构的问题。研究发现，转至医院专业护理机构的患者在出院后的180天内，在社区中度过的天数大约多了5天，而在专业护理机构中的天数减少了6天，但这对死亡率或再次住院率没有显著影响。

abstract.text: Two of the three elements of the ACA’s “premium stabilization program,” reinsurance and risk corridors, are set to expire in 2017, leaving risk adjustment alone to protect plans against risk of high-cost cases. This paper considers potential modifications of the HHS risk adjustment methodology to maintain plan protection against risk from high-cost cases within the current regulatory framework. We show analytically that modifications of the transfer formula and of the risk adjustment model itself are mathematically equivalent to a conventional actuarially fair reinsurance policy. Furthermore, closely related modifications of the transfer formula or the risk adjustment model can improve on conventional reinsurance by figuring transfers or estimating risk adjustment model weights recognizing the presence of a reinsurance function. In the empirical section, we estimate risk adjustment models with an updated and selected version of the data used to calibrate the federal payment models, and show, using simulation methods, that proposed modifications improve fit at the person level and protect small insurers against high-cost risk better than conventional reinsurance. We simulate various “attachment points” for the reinsurance equivalent policies and quantify the tradeoffs of higher and lower attachment points.

10.3386/w22519.abstractZh: 美国健康保险法案中“保费稳定计划”的三个要素中的两个——再保险和风险调整——将于2017年到期，届时仅剩下风险调整机制来保护计划免受高成本病例的风险影响。本文探讨了在现行监管框架内，对HHS风险调整方法的潜在修改，以维护计划对高成本病例风险的防护能力。我们通过分析表明，对转移公式和风险调整模型本身的修改，在数学上等同于传统的精算公平再保险政策。此外，对转移公式或风险调整模型的密切相关修改，可以通过计算转移金额或估计风险调整模型权重来改进传统再保险的效果，同时考虑到再保险功能的存在。在实证部分，我们使用更新后的数据版本来估计风险调整模型，并通过模拟方法表明，所提出的修改在个人层面上的拟合度更高，并且比传统再保险更能保护小型保险公司免受高成本风险的影响。我们还模拟了各种“附加点”对再保险等效政策的影响，并量化了较高和较低附加点的权衡。

abstract.text: The objective is to review the evidence on (a) ageing and health and (b) the demand for health- and social services among the elderly. Issues are: does health status of the elderly improve over time, and how do the trends in health status of the elderly affect the demand for health- and elderly care? It is not a complete review, but it covers most of recent empirical studies. The reviewed literature provides strong evidence that the prevalence of chronic disease among the elderly has increased over time. There is also fairly strong evidence that the consequences of disease have become less problematic due to medical progress: decreased mortality risk, milder and slower development over time, making the time with disease (and health-care treatment) longer but less troublesome than before. Evidence also suggests the postponement of functional limitations and disability. Some of the reduction in disability can be attributed to improvements in treatments of chronic diseases, but it is also due to the increased use of assistive technology, accessibility of buildings, etc. The results indicate that the ageing individual is expected to need health care for a longer period of time than previous generations but elderly care for a shorter.

10.3386/w22521.abstractZh: 本文旨在综述关于以下方面的研究：（a）老龄化与健康状况；（b）老年人对医疗和社会服务的需求。研究问题包括：老年人的健康状况是否随时间改善，以及老年人健康状况的变化如何影响他们对医疗和养老服务的需求。本文并非全面综述，但涵盖了大多数近期实证研究。文献表明，老年人中慢性疾病的患病率随时间增加。此外，由于医学进步，疾病的后果变得不那么严重：死亡风险降低，病情发展更为缓慢，因此患病期间需要医疗护理的时间更长，但痛苦程度比以往减轻。研究还表明，功能限制和残疾的延迟出现。部分残疾的减少可以归因于慢性疾病的治疗改进，但也得益于辅助技术的使用增加、建筑的可达性改善等因素。研究结果表明，与以往几代人相比，老龄化个体需要更长时间接受医疗护理，但养老服务的需求则相对较短。

abstract.text: There has been a widespread displacement of coal by natural gas as space heating and cooking technology in Turkey in the last two decades, triggered by the deployment of natural gas networks. In this paper, we examine the impact of this development on mortality among adults and the elderly. Our research design exploits the variation in the timing of the deployment and the intensity of expansion of natural gas networks at the provincial level using data from 2001 to 2014. The results indicate that the expansion of natural gas services has caused significant reductions in both the adult and the elderly mortality rates. According to our point estimates, a one-percentage point increase in the rate of subscriptions to natural gas services would lower the overall mortality rate by 1.4 percent, the adult mortality rate by 1.9 percent, and the elderly mortality rate by 1.2 percent. These findings are supported by our auxiliary analysis, which demonstrates that the expansion of natural gas networks has indeed led to a significant improvement in air quality. Furthermore, we show that the mortality gains for both the adult and the elderly populations are primarily driven by reductions in cardio-respiratory deaths, which are more likely to be due to conditions caused or exacerbated by air pollution. Finally, our analysis does not reveal any important gender differences in the estimated relationship between the deployment of natural gas networks and mortality.

10.3386/w22522.abstractZh: 在过去二十年里，由于天然气网络的部署，土耳其的供暖和烹饪技术中煤炭的使用比例大幅下降。本文研究了这一发展对成年人和老年人死亡率的影响。我们的研究利用2001至2014年的数据，分析了天然气网络在省级层面的部署时间和扩展强度差异。研究结果表明，天然气服务的扩展显著降低了成年人和老年人的死亡率。根据我们的点估计，天然气服务使用率每提高一个百分点，整体死亡率将降低1.4%，成年死亡率降低1.9%，老年人死亡率降低1.2%。这些发现得到了辅助分析的支持，该分析表明天然气网络的扩展确实显著改善了空气质量。此外，我们发现成年人和老年人死亡率的降低主要归因于心血管呼吸系统疾病的减少，而这些疾病很可能是由空气污染引起的或加重的。最后，我们的分析并未发现天然气网络部署与死亡率之间存在显著的性别差异。

abstract.text: Immunization can cause moral hazard by reducing the cost of risky behaviors. In this study, we examine the effect of HPV vaccination for cervical cancer on participation in the Pap test, which is a diagnostic screening test to detect potentially precancerous and cancerous process. It is strongly recommended for women between 21-65 years old even after taking the HPV vaccine. A reduction in willingness to have a Pap test as a result of HPV vaccination would signal the need for public health intervention. The HPV vaccination is recommended for women age eleven to twelve for regular vaccination or for women up to age 26 not vaccinated previously. We present evidence that probability of vaccination changes around this threshold. We identify the effect of vaccination using a fuzzy regression discontinuity design, centered on the recommended vaccination threshold age. The results show no evidence of ex ante moral hazard in the short-run. Sensitivity analyses using alternative specifications and subsamples are in general agreement. The estimates show that women who have been vaccinated are actually more likely to have a Pap test in the short-run, possibly due to increased awareness of its benefits.

10.3386/w22523.abstractZh: 免疫接种可能会因降低风险行为的成本而引发道德风险。本研究探讨了HPV疫苗接种对宫颈癌预防中参与巴氏涂片检查的影响，巴氏涂片检查是一种用于检测潜在癌前病变和癌症的诊断筛查方法。即使接种了HPV疫苗，21至65岁的女性仍被强烈建议进行该检查。由于HPV疫苗接种导致女性不愿进行巴氏涂片检查的情况，表明需要公共卫生干预。建议11至12岁的女性进行常规疫苗接种，或之前未接种过疫苗的26岁以下女性接种。我们的研究证明，疫苗接种的概率在这一临界年龄附近发生变化。我们使用模糊回归不连续设计来识别疫苗接种的影响，该设计以推荐的疫苗接种临界年龄为中心。结果显示，短期内不存在事前道德风险的迹象。使用不同模型和子样本进行的敏感性分析结果总体一致。估计结果显示，接种过疫苗的女性在短期内更有可能进行巴氏涂片检查，这可能是由于对疫苗益处的认识增加所致。

abstract.text: This paper provides an analytical framework and uses data from the US and Germany to test for the existence of contagious presenteeism and negative externalities in sickness insurance schemes. The first part exploits high-frequency Google Flu data and the staggered implementation of U.S. sick leave reforms to show in a reduced-from framework that population-level influenza-like disease rates decrease after employees gain access to paid sick leave. Next, a simple theoretical framework provides evidence on the underlying behavioral mechanisms. The model theoretically decomposes overall behavioral labor supply adjustments ('moral hazard') into contagious presenteeism and noncontagious absenteeism behavior and derives testable conditions. The last part illustrates how to implement the model exploiting German sick pay reforms and administrative industry-level data on certified sick leave by diagnoses. It finds that the labor supply elasticity for contagious diseases is significantly smaller than for noncontagious diseases. Under the identifying assumptions of the model, in addition to the evidence from the U.S., this finding provides indirect evidence for the existence of contagious presenteeism.

10.3386/w22530.abstractZh: 本文提供了一个分析框架，并利用美国和德国的数据来检验传染性缺勤现象以及疾病保险计划中的负面外部性是否存在。第一部分通过高频谷歌流感数据以及美国病假改革的逐步实施，以简化模型的方式表明，当员工能够获得带薪病假后，人口层面的类似流感的疾病发生率会下降。接下来，一个简单的理论框架为这些行为机制提供了证据。该模型将整体劳动供应调整（“道德风险”）分解为传染性缺勤和非传染性缺勤行为，并推导出可检验的条件。最后一部分展示了如何利用德国的病假改革以及按诊断分类的行政行业级数据来实施该模型。研究发现，传染性疾病的劳动供应弹性明显小于非传染性疾病。在模型的识别假设下，除了来自美国的证据外，这一发现还间接证明了传染性缺勤现象的存在。

abstract.text: We test whether early Affordable Care Act (ACA) Medicaid expansions in Connecticut (CT), Minnesota (MN), California (CA), and the District of Columbia (DC) affected SSI applications, SSI and DI awards, and the number of SSI and DI beneficiaries. We use a difference-in-difference (DD) approach, comparing SSI/DI outcomes pre and post each early Medicaid expansion (“Early Expanders”) to SSI/DI outcomes in states that expanded Medicaid in January 2014 (“Later Expanders”). We also use a synthetic control approach, in which we examine SSI/DI outcomes before and after the Medicaid expansion in each Early Expander state, utilizing a weighted combination of Later Expanders as a comparison group. In CT, the Medicaid expansion is associated a statistically significant, 7 percent reduction in SSI beneficiaries; this finding is consistent across the DD and synthetic control methods. For DC, MN and CA, we do not find consistent evidence that the Medicaid expansions affected disability-related outcomes.

10.3386/w22531.abstractZh: 我们测试了康涅狄格州、明尼苏达州、加利福尼亚州和哥伦比亚特区在《平价医疗法案》早期实施医疗补助计划后，是否对Supplemental Security Income（SSI）的申请、SSI和残疾相关福利的发放，以及SSI和残疾相关福利的受益人数量产生了影响。我们采用差异分解法，比较了各早期实施医疗补助计划的州在计划实施前后的SSI/DI结果，以及2014年1月开始实施医疗补助计划的州在计划实施前后的SSI/DI结果。我们还采用了合成控制法，在每一个早期实施医疗补助计划的州，利用后期实施医疗补助计划的州作为比较组，来考察医疗补助计划实施前后的SSI/DI结果。在康涅狄格州，医疗补助计划的实施导致SSI受益人数量减少了7%，这一发现通过差异分解法和合成控制法得到了支持。对于哥伦比亚特区、明尼苏达州和加利福尼亚州，我们没有发现医疗补助计划的实施对残疾相关结果产生了显著影响。

abstract.text: There is continuing controversy about the extent to which publicly insured children are treated differently than privately insured children, and whether differences in treatment matter. We show that on average, hospitals are less likely to admit publicly insured children than privately insured children who present at the ER and the gap grows during high flu weeks, when hospital beds are in high demand. This pattern is present even after controlling for detailed diagnostic categories and hospital fixed effects, but does not appear to have any effect on measurable health outcomes such as repeat ER visits and future hospitalizations. Hence, our results raise the possibility that instead of too few publicly insured children being admitted during high flu weeks, there are too many publicly and privately insured children being admitted most of the time.

10.3386/w22542.abstractZh: 关于公共保险儿童与私人保险儿童在待遇上的差异程度以及这种差异是否重要，一直存在争议。我们的研究表明，平均而言，医院更不愿意收治公共保险儿童，而私人保险儿童在急诊时则更容易被收治。在流感高发期间，这种差异会进一步加剧，因为此时医院床位的需求很高。即使控制了详细的诊断类别和医院固定效应后，这种现象仍然存在，但似乎对可测量的健康结果，如急诊就诊次数和未来的住院次数，并没有任何影响。因此，我们的研究结果表明，并非公共保险儿童在流感高发期间被收治的数量不足，而是公共保险和私人保险儿童被收治的数量在大多数时候都过高。

abstract.text: Nearly 40% of England’s privately built waterworks were municipalised in the late 19th century. We examine how this affected public health by pairing annual mortality data for over 600 registration districts, spanning 1869 to 1910, with detailed waterworks information. Identification is aided by both institutional hurdles and idiosyncratic delays in the municipalisation process. Municipalisation lowered deaths from typhoid fever, a waterborne disease, by nearly 20% but deaths from non-waterborne causes were unaffected. Results are also robust to the adoption of several strategies that control for the possibility of mean reversion and other potential confounds.

10.3386/w22553.abstractZh: 在19世纪末，英格兰近40%的私人建造的水厂被收归国有。我们通过将1869年至1910年间超过600个登记区的年度死亡数据与水厂详细信息进行比对，来研究这一变化对公共健康的影响。在国有化过程中，既有制度上的障碍，也有特有的延迟现象，这些因素有助于更准确地识别影响。国有化使由水传播疾病引起的伤寒死亡人数减少了近20%，但非水传播疾病的死亡人数并未受到影响。研究结果还表明，即使采用多种策略来控制均值回归和其他潜在混杂因素的影响，结果依然稳定。

abstract.text: The public health costs of tobacco consumption have been documented to be substantially larger than those of marijuana use. This study is the first to investigate the impact of medical marijuana laws (MMLs) on tobacco cigarette consumption. First, using data from the National Survey of Drug Use and Health (NSDUH), we establish that MMLs induce a 2 to 3 percentage-point increase in adult marijuana consumption, likely for both recreational and medicinal purposes. Then, using data from the NSDUH, the Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System (BRFSS), and the Current Population Survey Tobacco Use Supplements (CPS-TUS), we find that the enactment of MMLs leads to a 1 to 1.5 percentage-point reduction in adult cigarette smoking. We also find that MMLs reduce the number of cigarettes consumed by smokers, suggesting effects on both the cessation and intensive margins of cigarette use. Our estimated effect sizes imply substantial MML-induced tobacco-related healthcare cost savings, ranging from $4.6 to $6.9 billion per year.

10.3386/w22554.abstractZh: 已有研究指出，烟草消费对公共健康的危害远大于大麻使用。本研究首次探讨了医用大麻法律对烟草消费的影响。首先，通过美国国家药物使用与健康调查的数据，我们发现医用大麻法律使成人大麻消费量增加了2到3个百分点，这一变化可能既用于娱乐目的，也用于医疗用途。其次，利用美国国家药物使用与健康调查、行为风险因素监测系统以及当前人口调查中的烟草使用补充数据，我们发现医用大麻法律的实施使成人烟草吸烟量减少了1到1.5个百分点。此外，研究还发现医用大麻法律减少了吸烟者的烟草消费数量，这表明该法律对烟草使用的停止和强度都有影响。根据我们的估计，医用大麻法律每年可大幅减少与烟草相关的医疗费用，具体金额在46亿至69亿美元之间。

abstract.text: We construct a unique individual-level longitudinal dataset linking preschool blood lead levels with third grade test scores for eight birth cohorts of Rhode Island children born between 1997 and 2005. Using these data, we show that reductions of lead from even historically low levels have significant positive effects on children's reading test scores in third grade. Our preferred estimates use the introduction of a lead remediation program as an instrument in order to control for the possibility of confounding and for considerable error in measured lead exposures. The estimates suggest that a one unit decrease in average blood lead levels reduces the probability of being substantially below proficient in reading by 3.1 percentage points (on a baseline of 12 percent). Moreover, as we show, poor and minority children are more likely to be exposed to lead, suggesting that lead poisoning may be one of the causes of continuing gaps in test scores between disadvantaged and other children.

10.3386/w22558.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个独特的个体级纵向数据集，将罗德岛地区1997年至2005年间出生的八个出生队列的学龄前血液铅含量与三年级测试成绩联系起来。利用这些数据，我们发现，即使是从历史上较低的铅含量水平开始减少，也会对三年级儿童的阅读测试成绩产生显著的积极影响。我们采用引入铅污染治理计划作为工具变量，以控制混杂因素和测量铅暴露的误差。估计结果显示，平均血液铅含量每降低一个单位，儿童在阅读能力上达到熟练水平的概率就会降低3.1个百分点（基准值为12%）。此外，我们的研究还表明，贫困儿童和少数族裔儿童更容易接触铅，这表明铅中毒可能是导致弱势儿童与其他儿童在测试成绩上持续存在差距的原因之一。

abstract.text: The purposes of this paper are to describe some conceptual and empirical foundations of "healthy-time" measures of health outcomes or healthcare quality, and to explore how to expand the empirical opportunities for measuring such outcomes using U.S. national survey data. To these ends, the paper provides an overview of Grossman's seminal health production framework, surveys some of the healthy-time outcome/quality measures in use across a variety of contexts and applications, explores how data from the U.S. Medical Expenditure Panel Survey (MEPS) might be used to develop ongoing healthy-time measures for U.S. samples, describes an econometric strategy for studying such outcomes, and presents estimates of regression models describing two sets of healthy-time outcome measures obtained from 2011 and 2012 MEPS data.

10.3386/w22562.abstractZh: 本文旨在阐述“健康时间”健康结果或医疗质量衡量标准的一些概念性和实证基础，并探讨如何利用美国全国调查数据来扩展此类结果的测量方法。为此，本文概述了格罗斯曼提出的健康生产框架，回顾了在不同情境和应用中使用的健康时间结果/质量衡量标准，探讨了如何利用美国医疗支出调查数据来开发针对美国样本的持续健康时间衡量方法，描述了一种用于研究此类结果的计量经济学策略，并提供了基于2011年和2012年医疗支出调查数据得出的两组健康时间结果衡量标准的回归模型估计结果。

abstract.text: Academic experts frequently recommend policies and treatments. But how well do they anticipate the impact of different treatments? And how do their predictions compare to the predictions of non-experts? We analyze how 208 experts forecast the results of 15 treatments involving monetary and non-monetary motivators in a real-effort task. We compare these forecasts to those made by PhD students and non-experts: undergraduates, MBAs, and an online sample. We document seven main results. First, the average forecast of experts predicts quite well the experimental results. Second, there is a strong wisdom-of-crowds effect: the average forecast outperforms 96 percent of individual forecasts. Third, correlates of expertise---citations, academic rank, field, and contextual experience--do not improve forecasting accuracy. Fourth, experts as a group do better than non-experts, but not if accuracy is defined as rank ordering treatments. Fifth, measures of effort, confidence, and revealed ability are predictive of forecast accuracy to some extent, especially for non-experts. Sixth, using these measures we identify `superforecasters' among the non-experts who outperform the experts out of sample. Seventh, we document that these results on forecasting accuracy surprise the forecasters themselves. We present a simple model that organizes several of these results and we stress the implications for the collection of forecasts of future experimental results.

10.3386/w22566.abstractZh: 学术专家经常提出政策和治疗方案的建议。但是，他们对于不同治疗方案的影响预测有多准确呢？他们的预测与非专家的预测相比如何呢？我们分析了208位专家如何预测15种涉及货币和非货币激励因素的治疗方案的结果。我们将这些预测与博士生和非专家的预测进行了比较：包括本科生、MBA以及在线样本。我们发现了七个主要结果。首先，专家的平均预测结果与实验结果非常吻合。其次，存在强烈的群体智慧效应：平均预测结果优于96%的个人预测。第三，与专业知识相关的因素——引用次数、学术地位、研究领域以及背景经验——并不能提高预测的准确性。第四，作为整体的专家表现优于非专家，但如果以排名来定义准确性，则情况并非如此。第五，努力程度、信心以及显露出的能力在某种程度上可以预测预测的准确性，尤其是对于非专家而言。第六，通过这些指标，我们在非专家中识别出一些“超级预测者”，他们在样本中的表现优于专家。第七，我们发现这些关于预测准确性的结果让专家自己都感到惊讶。我们提出了一个简单的模型，该模型整合了上述多个结果，并强调了这对未来实验结果预测收集的重要性。

abstract.text: Previous research has found strong evidence that legal access to alcohol is associated with sizable increases in criminality. We revisit this relationship using the census of judicial records on criminal charges filed in Oregon Courts, the ability to separately track crimes involving firearms, and to track individuals over time. We find that crime increases at age 21, with increases mostly due to assaults lacking in premeditation, and alcohol-related nuisance crimes. We find no evident increases in rape or robbery. Among those with no prior criminal records, increases in crime are 50 percent larger; still larger for the most socially costly crimes of assault and drunk driving. This suggests that deterring criminality through increased punishments would likely prove difficult.

10.3386/w22568.abstractZh: 先前的研究发现，法律对酒精的获取与犯罪行为的显著增加存在密切关联。我们利用俄勒冈州法院提交的刑事指控的司法记录数据，能够单独追踪与枪支相关的犯罪，并随时间跟踪个体情况，重新研究了这种关系。研究发现，犯罪率在21岁时开始上升，这种上升主要源于缺乏预谋的袭击行为以及与酒精相关的滋扰犯罪。而强奸或抢劫行为的增加并不明显。对于没有犯罪记录的人来说，犯罪率的上升幅度为50%；对于社会成本最高的袭击和酒驾等犯罪来说，这一增幅更为显著。这表明，通过加强刑罚来遏制犯罪行为可能非常困难。

abstract.text: We analyze data about cigarette tax compliance from the first national scale littered cigarette packs collection. We code each pack based on whether an appropriate tax had been paid at the location where it was found. Noncompliance across our 132 sample communities ranges from zero to one hundred percent with an appropriately weighted mean of 21 percent. We provide evidence that noncompliance is due to both cross-border shopping and cigarette trafficking. OLS and binomial logit regressions demonstrate that the financial incentive for non-compliance is the most important explanatory variable and has a statistically and quantitatively significant impact on noncompliance.

10.3386/w22577.abstractZh: 我们分析了首次全国范围内对香烟包装进行征税时收集的数据。我们根据每个包装在发现时是否支付了相应的税款对其进行编码。在我们选取的132个样本社区中，不合规的比例从0%到100%不等，平均不合规率为21%。我们的研究表明，不合规行为既源于跨境购物，也源于香烟的非法交易。OLS回归和二项逻辑回归分析表明，经济激励是导致不合规行为的最重要因素，并且对这一行为具有统计上和数量上的显著影响。

abstract.text: This study investigates whether minimum wage increases in the United States affect an important non-market outcome: worker health. To study this question, we use data on lesser-skilled workers from the 1993-2014 Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance Surveys coupled with differences-in-differences and triple-difference models. We find little evidence that minimum wage increases lead to improvements in overall worker health. In fact, we find some evidence that minimum wage increases may decrease some aspects of health, especially among unemployed male workers. We also find evidence that increases reduce mental strain among employed workers.

10.3386/w22578.abstractZh: 本研究探讨美国最低工资的提高是否会影响一个重要的非市场结果：工人健康。为了研究这个问题，我们使用了1993年至2014年行为风险因素监测调查中关于低技能工人的数据，并结合差异差异模型和三重差异模型进行分析。我们发现，最低工资的提高对工人整体健康的改善作用不大。实际上，我们发现最低工资的提高可能会降低某些健康方面的指标，尤其是在失业的男性工人中。此外，我们还发现最低工资的提高能够减轻就业工人的心理压力。

abstract.text: The welfare associated with public insurance is often difficult to quantify because the demand for coverage is unobserved and thus cannot be used to analyze welfare. However, in many settings, individuals can purchase private insurance to supplement public coverage. This paper outlines an approach to use data and variation from private complementary insurance to quantify welfare associated with counterfactuals related to compulsory public insurance. We then apply this approach using administrative data on disability insurance. Our findings suggests that public disability insurance generates substantial surplus for the sample population, and there may be gains to increasing the generosity of coverage.

10.3386/w22583.abstractZh: 公共保险所带来的福利往往难以量化，因为保险需求是未观察到的，因此无法用于分析福利状况。然而，在许多情况下，个人可以购买私人保险来补充公共保险。本文提出了一种方法，利用私人补充保险的数据和差异来量化与强制性公共保险相关的反事实福利。我们随后使用残疾保险的管理数据来应用这种方法。我们的研究结果表明，公共残疾保险为样本人群带来了显著的收益，并且提高保险覆盖范围的慷慨程度可能会带来更多好处。

abstract.text: RCTs would be more useful if there were more realistic expectations of them and if their pitfalls were better recognized. For example, and contrary to many claims in the applied literature, randomization does not equalize everything but the treatment across treatments and controls, it does not automatically deliver a precise estimate of the average treatment effect (ATE), and it does not relieve us of the need to think about (observed or unobserved) confounders. Estimates apply to the trial sample only, sometimes a convenience sample, and usually selected; justification is required to extend them to other groups, including any population to which the trial sample belongs. Demanding “external validity” is unhelpful because it expects too much of an RCT while undervaluing its contribution. Statistical inference on ATEs involves hazards that are not always recognized. RCTs do indeed require minimal assumptions and can operate with little prior knowledge. This is an advantage when persuading distrustful audiences, but it is a disadvantage for cumulative scientific progress, where prior knowledge should be built upon and not discarded. RCTs can play a role in building scientific knowledge and useful predictions but they can only do so as part of a cumulative program, combining with other methods, including conceptual and theoretical development, to discover not “what works,” but “why things work”.

10.3386/w22595.abstractZh: 如果人们对随机对照试验有更现实的期望，并且能更好地认识到其潜在问题，那么这些试验将更有用。例如，与应用文献中的许多说法相反，随机化并不能使处理组和对照组之间的所有因素都达到均衡，它也不能自动提供平均处理效应的精确估计，同时它也不能免除我们思考（观察到的或未观察到的）混杂因素的需要。这些估计仅适用于试验样本，有时是便利样本，并且通常是经过选择的；需要理由才能将其扩展到其他群体，包括试验样本所属的任何人群。要求“外部有效性”是没有帮助的，因为它对随机对照试验的期望过高，同时低估了它的贡献。对平均处理效应的统计推断涉及一些并不总是被认识到的风险。随机对照试验确实需要最少的假设，并且可以在几乎没有先验知识的情况下进行。这在说服不信任的受众时是一个优势，但对于累积性的科学进步来说却是一个劣势，因为累积性的科学进步应该建立在先验知识的基础上，而不是抛弃它。随机对照试验可以在构建科学知识和有用预测方面发挥作用，但它们只能作为累积性计划的一部分来发挥作用，与其他方法相结合，包括概念性和理论性发展，以发现“为什么事物会起作用”，而不是“什么方法有效”。

abstract.text: Medicare's prospective payment system for long-term acute-care hospitals (LTCHs) pro- vides modest reimbursements at the beginning of a patient's stay before jumping discontinuously to a large lump-sum payment after a pre-specified number of days. We show that LTCHs respond to financial incentives by disproportionately discharging patients after they cross the large-payment threshold, resulting in worse outcomes for patients. We find this occurs more often at for-profit facilities, facilities acquired by leading LTCH chains, and facilities co-located with other hospitals. Using a dynamic structural model, we evaluate counterfactual payment policies that would provide substantial savings for Medicare without adversely affecting patients.

10.3386/w22598.abstractZh: Medicare对长期急性护理医院实行的预期支付制度，在患者入住初期提供适度的报销金额，之后在达到预先指定的天数后，支付一笔较大的固定金额。我们发现，当患者超过大额支付门槛时，这些医院会不成比例地增加患者的出院数量，从而导致患者预后恶化。这一现象在营利性医院、由主要长期急性护理医院连锁企业收购的医院以及与其他医院共址的医疗机构中更为常见。通过动态结构模型，我们评估了那些能够为Medicare带来显著节省费用，同时不会对患者产生不利影响的替代支付政策。

abstract.text: Health insurers increasingly compete on their covered networks of medical providers. Using data from Massachusetts’ pioneer insurance exchange, I find substantial adverse selection against plans covering the most prestigious and expensive “star” hospitals. I highlight a theoretically distinct selection channel: these plans attract consumers loyal to the star hospitals and who tend to use their high-price care when sick. Using a structural model, I show that selection creates a strong incentive to exclude star hospitals but that standard policy solutions do not improve net welfare. A key reason is the connection between selection and moral hazard in star hospital use.

10.3386/w22600.abstractZh: 健康保险公司越来越多地在其覆盖的医疗提供者网络上进行竞争。通过利用马萨诸塞州领先的保险交易所的数据，我发现那些覆盖最著名、价格最高的“明星”医院的计划面临着严重的逆向选择问题。我指出了一个理论上的独特选择渠道：这些计划吸引了那些对明星医院有忠诚度的消费者，这些消费者在生病时往往会选择使用这些医院的高价医疗服务。通过结构模型分析，我发现选择行为会强烈促使保险公司排除明星医院，但标准的政策解决方案并不能改善净福利。其中一个关键原因是，选择行为与明星医院使用中的道德风险之间存在关联。

abstract.text: Alphabetical name order is the norm for joint publications in economics. However, alphabetical order confers greater benefits on the first author. In a two-author model, we introduce and study certified random order: the uniform randomization of names made universally known by a commonly understood symbol. Certified random order (a) distributes the gain from first authorship evenly over the alphabet, (b) allows either author to signal when contributions are extremely unequal, (c) will invade an environment where alphabetical order is dominant, (d) is robust to deviations, (e) may be ex-ante more efficient than alphabetical order, and (f) is no more complex than the existing alphabetical system modified by occasional reversal of name order.

10.3386/w22602.abstractZh: 在经济学领域的联合出版物中，按字母顺序排序是常规做法。然而，这种排序对第一作者更为有利。在双作者模型中，我们引入了“认证随机排序”的概念：通过一种普遍理解的符号来统一随机排列姓名。认证随机排序具有以下优点：(a) 将第一作者的收益均匀分配给字母顺序中的各个位置；(b) 允许任一作者在贡献差异巨大时做出提示；(c) 能够改变以字母顺序为主的排序方式；(d) 对偏差具有鲁棒性；(e) 可能比字母顺序在事前更为高效；(f) 其复杂性并不高于现有的字母顺序系统，只需偶尔对姓名顺序进行反转即可。

abstract.text: In this paper we estimate the effects of expanding access to substance-abuse treatment on local crime. We do so using an identification strategy that leverages variation driven by substance-abuse-treatment facility openings and closings measured at the county level. The results indicate that substance-abuse-treatment facilities reduce both violent and financially motivated crimes in an area, and that the effects are particularly pronounced for relatively serious crimes. The effects on homicides are documented across three sources of homicide data.

10.3386/w22610.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们估计了扩大物质滥用治疗服务的可及性对当地犯罪的影响。我们采用一种识别策略来进行分析，该策略利用了县级别物质滥用治疗机构开设和关闭所带来的变化。研究结果表明，物质滥用治疗机构能够减少某一地区的暴力犯罪和经济动机犯罪，且这种影响在较为严重的犯罪中尤为明显。关于凶杀案的影响，我们通过三种凶杀数据来源进行了验证。

abstract.text: Employing the universe of juvenile court decisions in a U.S. state between 1996 and 2012, we analyze the effects of emotional shocks associated with unexpected outcomes of football games played by a prominent college team in the state. We investigate the behavior of judges, the conduct of whom should, by law, be free of personal biases and emotions. We find that unexpected losses increase disposition (sentence) lengths assigned by judges during the week following the game. Unexpected wins, or losses that were expected to be close contests ex-ante, have no impact. The effects of these emotional shocks are asymmetrically borne by black defendants. We present evidence that the results are not influenced by defendant or attorney behavior or by defendants’ economic background. Importantly, the results are driven by judges who have received their bachelor’s degrees from the university with which the football team is affiliated. Different falsification tests and a number of auxiliary analyses demonstrate the robustness of the findings. These results provide evidence for the impact of emotions in one domain on a behavior in a completely unrelated domain among a uniformly highly-educated group of individuals (judges), with decisions involving high stakes (sentence lengths). They also point to the existence of a subtle and previously-unnoticed capricious application of sentencing.

10.3386/w22611.abstractZh: 我们分析了1996至2012年间美国某州少年法庭判决的统计数据，研究了由该州知名大学球队在比赛中遭遇意外结果所带来的情绪冲击对法官判决的影响。我们调查了法官的行为，根据法律规定，法官的行为应当不受个人偏见和情绪的影响。研究发现，意外失利会导致法官在比赛后的一周内判决的刑期延长。而意外胜利，或者原本预期为平局或接近平局的比赛结果，则对判决没有影响。这些情绪冲击对黑人被告的影响更为显著。我们的研究还表明，这些结果不受被告或律师的行为以及被告的经济背景的影响。重要的是，这些结果是由那些毕业于与足球队相关的大学的法官所做出的。不同的伪造测试以及一系列辅助分析都证明了这些发现的稳健性。这些结果表明，情绪在一个领域中的影响可以作用于另一个完全不相关的领域，且这种影响发生在受过高等教育的法官群体身上，他们的判决涉及高风险。这些结果还揭示了一种此前未被注意到的、微妙且不规则的量刑现象。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the impact of social health insurance on financial risk reduction by utilizing data from a natural experiment created by the phased roll out of a social health insurance program for the poor in India. We estimate the impact of insurance on the distribution of out-of-pocket costs, frequency and amount of money borrowed for health reasons, and the likelihood of incurring catastrophic health expenditures. We use a stylized expected utility model to compute the welfare effects associated with changes due to insurance in the distribution of out-of-pocket costs. We adjust the standard model to account for the unique conditions of a developing country by incorporating consumption floors, informal borrowing, and selling of assets. These adjustments allow us to estimate the value of financial risk reduction from both consumption smoothing and asset protection channels. Our results show that social insurance reduces out-of-pocket costs with larger effects in the higher quantiles of the out-of-pocket cost distribution. In addition, we find a reduction in the frequency and amount of money borrowed for health reasons. Finally, we find that the value of financial risk reduction outweighs the total per household cost of the social insurance program by two to five times.

10.3386/w22620.abstractZh: 本文利用印度为贫困人口逐步推行社会医疗保险计划所创造的自然实验数据，估算了社会医疗保险对降低财务风险的影响。我们评估了保险对自付费用分布、因健康原因借款的频率和金额，以及发生灾难性健康支出概率的影响。采用预期效用模型来计算保险变化对自付费用分布的福利效应。我们调整标准模型，以考虑发展中国家特有的条件，包括消费底线、非正式借贷和资产出售。这些调整使我们能够估算出从消费平滑和资产保护渠道获得的财务风险降低的价值。研究结果表明，社会医疗保险能够降低自付费用，尤其是在自付费用分布的高分位数上效果更为显著。此外，我们发现因健康原因借款的频率和金额也有所减少。最后，我们发现财务风险降低的价值是社会保障计划每户家庭总成本的2到5倍。

abstract.text: To estimate causal effects from observational data, an applied researcher must impose beliefs. The instrumental variables exclusion restriction, for example, represents the belief that the instrument has no direct effect on the outcome of interest. Yet beliefs about instrument validity do not exist in isolation. Applied researchers often discuss the likely direction of selection and the potential for measurement error in their papers but at present lack formal tools for incorporating this information into their analyses. As such they not only leave money on the table, by failing to use all relevant information, but more importantly run the risk of reasoning to a contradiction by expressing mutually incompatible beliefs. In this paper we characterize the sharp identified set relating instrument invalidity, treatment endogeneity, and measurement error in a workhorse linear model, showing how beliefs over these three dimensions are mutually constrained. We consider two cases: in the first the treatment is continuous and subject to classical measurement error; in the second it is binary and subject to non-differential measurement error. In each, we propose a formal Bayesian framework to help researchers elicit their beliefs, incorporate them into estimation, and ensure their mutual coherence. We conclude by illustrating the usefulness of our proposed methods on a variety of examples from the empirical microeconomics literature.

10.3386/w22621.abstractZh: 为了从观察数据中估计因果效应，应用研究人员必须提出假设。例如，工具变量排除限制就代表了工具对感兴趣结果没有直接影响的假设。然而，关于工具效用的信念并不是孤立存在的。应用研究人员在论文中经常讨论选择的可能方向以及测量误差的可能性，但目前缺乏将这些信息纳入分析的正式工具。因此，他们不仅因为未能利用所有相关信息而浪费了机会，更重要的是，他们可能会因表达相互矛盾的假设而陷入逻辑矛盾。在本文中，我们描述了工具无效性、处理内生性和测量误差之间的紧密关系，并展示了这三个维度上的信念是如何相互制约的。我们考虑了两种情况：第一种情况是处理是连续的，并受到经典测量误差的影响；第二种情况是处理是二元的，并受到非差分测量误差的影响。在每种情况下，我们都提出了一个正式的贝叶斯框架，以帮助研究人员提出他们的假设，将这些假设纳入估计过程，并确保它们之间的相互一致性。最后，我们通过实证微观经济学文献中的多个例子来说明我们提出的方法的实用性。

abstract.text: Societies prohibit many transactions considered morally repugnant, although potentially efficiency-enhancing. We conducted an online choice experiment to characterize preferences for the morality and efficiency of payments to kidney donors. Preferences were heterogeneous, ranging from deontological to strongly consequentialist; the median respondent would support payments by a public agency if they increased the annual kidney supply by six percentage points, and private transactions for a thirty percentage-point increase. Fairness concerns drive this difference. Our findings suggest that cost-benefit considerations affect the acceptance of morally controversial transactions, and imply that trial studies of the effects of payments would inform the public debate.

10.3386/w22632.abstractZh: 社会禁止了许多在道德上被认为不可接受的交易，尽管这些交易可能有助于提高效率。我们进行了在线选择实验，以了解人们对支付肾脏捐赠者报酬的道德性和效率性的偏好。受访者的偏好存在差异，从义务论型到强烈后果主义型不等；中位数受访者支持公共机构支付报酬，前提是这种支付能使每年肾脏供应量增加六个百分点，而私人交易则愿意支付三十个百分点的增加。公平问题导致了这种差异。我们的研究结果表明，成本效益的考虑影响了人们对道德上存在争议的交易的接受程度，并暗示对支付效果进行试验性研究有助于推动公众讨论。

abstract.text: Risk adjustment of payments to health plans is fundamental to regulated competition among private insurers, which serves as the basis of national health policy in many countries. To date, estimation and evaluation of a risk adjustment model has been a two-step process. In a first step, the risk-adjustment payment weights are estimated using statistical techniques, generally ordinary-least squares, to maximize some statistical objective such as the R-squared; then, in a second step, the risk adjustment model is evaluated, usually with simulation methods, but without an explicit framework describing the objective of the model. This paper first develops such a framework and then uses it to replace the two-step “estimate-then-evaluate” approach with a one-step “estimate-to-maximize-the-objective” approach. We assume that the objective of risk adjustment is to minimize the loss from service-level distortions due to adverse selection incentives, and we derive expressions for the service-level distortions as a linear function of the risk adjustment payment weights. We show that when the number of risk adjustor variables exceeds the number of decisions plans make about service allocations, incentives for service-level distortion can always be eliminated. Under these circumstances the welfare maximizing payment weights can be found with a constrained least-squares regression where the constraints are the conditions under which plan actions achieve efficiency. We illustrate this method with the data used to estimate risk adjustment payment weights in the Netherlands (N=16.5 million). When the number of “services” exceeds the number of available risk adjustors, however, it is not possible to eliminate incentives for service-level distortion. In this case, a regression on transformed data produces the (second-best) payment weights that minimize welfare loss.

10.3386/w22642.abstractZh: 对医疗保险计划支付的调整是私人保险公司之间竞争的基础，而竞争又是许多国家国家卫生政策的核心。迄今为止，风险调整模型的估计与评估一直是一个两步过程。第一步是使用统计技术（通常是普通最小二乘法）来估计风险调整支付权重，以最大化某些统计目标，如R平方值；第二步则是使用模拟方法评估风险调整模型，但并未明确描述模型的目标。本文首先建立了这样的框架，然后利用该框架将两步“估计-评估”方法替换为一步“估计-最大化目标”方法。我们假设风险调整的目标是最小化由于逆向选择激励导致的服务水平扭曲造成的损失，并推导出服务水平扭曲作为风险调整支付权重的线性函数的表达式。我们表明，当风险调整变量的数量超过关于服务分配的决策数量时，服务水平扭曲的激励总是可以被消除。在这种情况下，可以通过约束最小二乘回归来找到使福利最大化的支付权重，这些约束条件就是计划行动实现效率的条件。我们用荷兰用于估计风险调整支付权重的数据（N=1650万）来说明这种方法。然而，当“服务”的数量超过可用风险调整变量的数量时，就无法消除服务水平扭曲的激励。在这种情况下，对转换后的数据进行回归分析可以得到（第二优的）支付权重，这些权重能够最小化福利损失。

abstract.text: This paper studies the ecological inference problem that arises when clinicians seek to personalize patient care by making health risk assessments conditional on observed patient attributes. Let y be a patient outcome of interest and let (x = k, w = j) be patient attributes that a clinician observes. The clinician may want to choose a care option that maximizes the patient's expected utility conditional on the observed attributes. To accomplish this, the clinician needs to know the conditional probability distribution P(y|x = k, w = j). In practice, it is common to have a trustworthy evidence-based risk assessment that predicts y conditional on a subset of the observed attributes, say x, but not conditional on (x, w). Then the clinician knows P(y|x = k) but not P(y|x = k, w = j). Partial conclusions about P(y∣x = k, w = j) may be drawn if the clinician also knows P(w = j|x = k). Tighter conclusions may be possible if he combines knowledge of P(y|x) and P(w|x) with credible structural assumptions embodying some a priori knowledge of P(y|x, w). This is the ecological inference problem studied here. A substantial psychological literature comparing actuarial predictions and informal clinical judgments has concluded that clinicians should not attempt to subjectively predict patient outcomes conditional on attributes such as w that are not utilized in evidence-based risk assessments. The analysis in this paper suggests that formalizing clinical judgment through analysis of the inferential problem may enable clinicians to make more informative personalized risk assessments.

10.3386/w22643.abstractZh: 本文研究了当临床医生试图根据观察到的患者特征来个性化患者护理时出现的生态推理问题。设y为关注的患者结果，x = k, w = j为临床医生观察到的患者特征。临床医生可能希望选择一个能够最大化患者在观察到的特征条件下的预期效用的护理方案。为了实现这一目标，临床医生需要了解条件概率分布P(y|x = k, w = j)。在实践中，通常有一个可信的基于证据的风险评估，该评估可以根据观察到的部分特征（例如x）来预测y，但无法根据整个特征（x, w）来预测y。此时，临床医生只知道P(y|x = k)，而不知道P(y|x = k, w = j)。如果临床医生还知道P(w = j|x = k)，则可以得出关于P(y|x = k, w = j)的部分结论。如果他结合了对P(y|x)和P(w|x)的了解，并基于一些先验知识对P(y|x, w)进行了可信的结构性假设，那么可能会得出更精确的结论。这就是本文研究的生态推理问题。大量心理学文献比较了精算预测和非正式临床判断，认为临床医生不应试图根据那些在基于证据的风险评估中未使用的特征（如w）主观预测患者结果。本文的分析表明，通过分析这种推理问题来形式化临床判断，可能有助于临床医生做出更具信息性的个性化风险评估。

abstract.text: We provide novel estimates of the causal impact of physician-patient relationships on physicians’ decisions. Exploiting quasi-random assignment of patients to OBs at childbirth, we find OBs are 25% likelier to perform C-sections when delivering patients they have a preexisting clinical relationship with (their “own patients”). This effect is increasing in the relationship’s strength. OBs also curtail labor sooner, are less likely to employ other invasive procedures (e.g., vacuum or forceps), and avoid complications of long and difficult births for their own patients.

10.3386/w22666.abstractZh: 我们提出了关于医患关系对医生决策影响的新估计方法。通过利用分娩时患者被随机分配到产科医生手中的实验设计，我们发现，当产科医生与那些他们已有临床关系的患者（即“自己的患者”）进行接生时，他们进行剖宫产手术的可能性高出25%。这种效应随着医患关系的紧密程度而增强。此外，产科医生还会更早地结束分娩过程，较少使用其他侵入性手术方法（如真空吸引或产钳助产），并能够避免那些漫长而困难的分娩给患者带来的并发症。

abstract.text: We document four similarities between American human healthcare and American pet care: (i) rapid growth in spending as a share of GDP over the last two decades; (ii) strong income-spending gradient; (iii) rapid growth in the employment of healthcare providers; and (iv) similar propensity for high spending at the end of life. We speculate about possible implications of these similar patterns in two sectors that share many common features but differ markedly in institutional features, such as the prevalence of insurance and of public sector involvement.

10.3386/w22669.abstractZh: 我们发现了美国人类医疗保健与美国宠物护理之间的四个相似之处：(i) 过去二十年里，医疗保健支出占GDP的比例迅速增长；(ii) 收入与支出之间的梯度明显；(iii) 医疗保健提供者的就业人数快速增长；以及(iv) 在生命末期表现出相似的过度消费倾向。我们推测，这些相似模式在这两个具有许多共同特征但制度特征存在显著差异的行业中可能具有何种影响，例如保险制度的普及程度以及公共部门的参与程度。

abstract.text: Research shows that properly devised economic incentives increase the supply of blood without hampering its safety; similar effects may be expected also for other body parts such as bone marrow and organs. These positive effects alone, however, do not necessarily justify the introduction of payments for supplying body parts; these activities concern contested commodities or repugnant transactions, i.e. societies may want to prevent certain ways to regulate a transaction even if they increased supply, because of ethical concerns. When transactions concern contested commodities, therefore, societies often face trade-offs between the efficiency-enhancing effects of trades mediated by a monetary price, and the moral opposition to the provision of these payments. In this essay, I first describe and discuss the current debate on the role of moral repugnance in controversial markets, with a focus on markets for organs, tissues, blood and plasma. I then report on recent studies focused on understanding the trade-offs that individuals face when forming their opinions about how a society should organize certain transactions.

10.3386/w22673.abstractZh: 研究表明，合理设计的经济激励措施能够增加血液供应，同时不会影响其安全性；对于骨髓和器官等其他身体部位，也可能产生类似的效果。然而，这些积极效果本身并不足以证明引入支付制度来供应身体部位的合理性；因为这些活动涉及有争议的商品或令人反感的交易，即社会可能希望阻止某些交易方式，即使这些方式能够增加供应，因为存在道德方面的担忧。因此，当交易涉及有争议的商品时，社会往往需要在通过货币价格进行交易的效率提升效果与对提供这些支付的道德反对之间做出权衡。在本文中，我首先描述并讨论了关于道德反感在争议性市场中作用的当前争论，重点关注器官、组织、血液和血浆等市场的讨论。接着，我介绍了最近一些研究，这些研究旨在了解个人在形成关于社会应如何组织某些交易的意见时所面临的权衡。

abstract.text: The effects of the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) on obesity have been the focus of much debate. However, causal interpretation of estimates from previous studies, comparing participants to non-participants, is complicated by endogeneity and possible misreporting of participation in SNAP. In this paper, we take a novel approach to examine quasi-experimental variation in SNAP benefit amount on adult obesity. Children of SNAP households qualify for free in-school meals, thus freeing some additional benefits for the household. A greater proportion of school-age children eligible for free in-school meals proxies for an exogenous increase in the amount of SNAP benefits available per adult. Using data from the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth-1979 we show that school meals represent a non-trivial part of the food budget for SNAP households. We find that increases in SNAP benefits have no effect on obesity levels for the full sample of those who report SNAP participation. To better isolate the effects of additional benefits from other potential changes we restrict our analysis to adults living in households with at least one child under 5 years of age. In this setting, we find that additional SNAP benefits reduce BMI and the probability of being obese for SNAP adults.

10.3386/w22681.abstractZh: 补充营养援助计划（SNAP）对肥胖的影响一直是众多讨论的焦点。然而，对以往研究中比较参与者和未参与者结果的因果解释，由于内生性问题以及参与SNAP的误报，变得复杂。在本文中，我们采用了一种新颖的方法，来研究SNAP福利金额对成人肥胖的影响。SNAP家庭中的儿童可以享受免费校内餐食，这为家庭提供了额外的福利。有资格享受免费校内餐食的学龄儿童比例的增加，可以视为SNAP福利金额对每位成人而言的外生增加。利用1979年青年纵向调查的数据，我们发现校内餐食是SNAP家庭食物预算中不可或缺的一部分。我们发现，SNAP福利的增加对报告参与SNAP的全体人员的肥胖水平没有影响。为了更好地分离额外福利的影响与其他潜在变化，我们将分析范围限制在至少有一个5岁以下儿童的家庭中。在这种情况下，我们发现额外的SNAP福利能够降低SNAP成年人口的BMI和肥胖概率。

abstract.text: Older adults have the highest rates of many health conditions for which medical marijuana may be effective in moderating symptoms and are at elevated risk of reducing labor supply due to poor health. Surprisingly little is known about how this group responds to medical marijuana laws. We provide the first estimates of the effects of state medical marijuana laws on the health and labor supply of adults age 51 and older, focusing on those with medical conditions that may respond to medical marijuana. We use longitudinal data from the Health and Retirement Study to study these questions using differences-in-differences regression models. Three principle findings emerge from our analysis. First, we document that medical marijuana law passage leads to reductions in chronic pain and improvements in self-assessed health among older adults. Second, we show that passage of a state medical marijuana law leads to increases in older adult labor supply, with effects concentrated on the intensive margin. Third, effects are largest among older adults with a health condition that would qualify for legal medical marijuana use under current state laws. Findings highlight the role of health policy in supporting work among older adults.

10.3386/w22688.abstractZh: 老年人是许多健康状况的高发人群，对于这些疾病，医用大麻可能有助于缓解症状。然而，由于健康状况不佳，老年人的劳动力供应也面临更高的风险。令人惊讶的是，关于这一群体对医用大麻法律的反应，我们知之甚少。我们首次估算了州级医用大麻法律对51岁及以上成年人健康和劳动力供应的影响，重点关注那些可能对医用大麻有反应的疾病患者。我们利用《健康与退休研究》的纵向数据，通过差异-差异回归模型来研究这些问题。我们的分析得出三个主要结论：首先，医用大麻法律的通过有助于减轻老年人的慢性疼痛，并改善他们的自我评估健康状况；其次，州级医用大麻法律的通过会增加老年人的劳动力供应，这种影响主要集中在劳动密集型行业；第三，对于符合当前州法律规定的合法医用大麻使用条件的老年人来说，这种影响最为显著。这些发现强调了健康政策在支持老年人就业方面的作用。

abstract.text: Using data covering over 100 birth-cohorts in 32 countries, we examine the short- and long-term effects of economic conditions on mortality. We find that small, but not large, booms increase contemporary mortality. Yet booms from birth to age 25, particularly those during adolescence, lower adult mortality. A simple model can rationalize these findings if economic conditions differentially affect the level and trajectory of both good and bad inputs into health. Indeed, air pollution and alcohol consumption increase in booms. In contrast, booms in adolescence raise adult incomes and improve social relations and mental health, suggesting these mechanisms dominate in the long run.

10.3386/w22690.abstractZh: 我们使用了涵盖32个国家超过100个出生队列的数据，研究了经济条件对死亡率的短期和长期影响。研究发现，虽然小型经济繁荣不会显著增加当代死亡率，但出生至25岁期间的繁荣，尤其是青少年时期的繁荣，能够降低成人死亡率。一个简单的模型可以解释这些现象：经济条件对健康相关的良好与不良因素的影响程度及轨迹有所不同。事实上，经济繁荣时期，空气污染和酒精消费会增加。相比之下，青少年时期的繁荣则能提升成人收入，改善社会关系与心理健康，这表明这些机制在长期内起着主导作用。

abstract.text: We study the impact of preschool targeted at children from low-income families over the life cycle and across generations, and examine its interaction with an infant health intervention. Using Danish administrative data with variation in the timing of program implementation over 1933-1960, we find lasting benefits of access to preschool on adult educational attainment, earnings, and survival beyond age 65. We also show that children of women exposed to preschool obtain more education by age 25. However, exposure to nurse home visiting in infancy reduces the added value of preschool. This result implies that the programs serve as partial substitutes.

10.3386/w22700.abstractZh: 我们研究了针对低收入家庭儿童的学前教育在生命周期内以及跨代际的影响，并考察其与婴儿健康干预措施的相互作用。利用1933年至1960年间丹麦的行政数据，这些数据记录了项目实施时间的差异，我们发现接受学前教育对成人教育水平、收入以及65岁以后的生存能力具有长期积极影响。我们还发现，接受学前教育的女性子女在25岁时所接受的教育程度更高。然而，婴儿期接受家庭护士访视会降低学前教育的附加价值。这一结果表明，这些项目起到了部分替代作用。

abstract.text: One of the key terms in contracts between hospitals and insurers is how the parties apportion the financial risk of treating unexpectedly costly patients. “Prospective” payment contracts give hospitals a lump-sum amount, depending on the medical condition of the patient, with limited adjustment for the level of services provided. We use data from the Medicare Prospective Payment System and commercial insurance plans covering the nonelderly through the Health Care Cost Institute to measure the extent of prospective payment in 303 metropolitan statistical areas during 2008-12. We report three key findings. First, commercial insurance payments are less prospective than Medicare payments. Second, the extent of prospective payment in commercial insurance varies more than in Medicare, both across hospitals and geographic areas. Third, differences in prospective payment across hospitals are positively associated with the extent of hospital competition, the share of the hospital’s commercially insured patients covered by managed-care insurance, and the share of the hospital’s patients covered by Medicare’s Prospective Payment System.

10.3386/w22709.abstractZh: 在医院与保险公司之间的合同中，一个关键条款是各方如何分配治疗费用高昂患者的财务风险。“预期支付”合同为医院提供了一笔固定金额，该金额取决于患者的医疗状况，对于所提供的服务水平则调整幅度有限。我们利用医疗保险预期支付系统以及涵盖非老年人群体的商业保险计划的数据，通过医疗保健成本研究所的数据，在2008-12年间对303个大都市统计区中的预期支付程度进行了研究。我们得出了三个主要发现：首先，商业保险支付的金额不如医疗保险支付的多；其次，商业保险中的预期支付程度在不同医院和地理区域之间的差异更大；第三，医院之间的预期支付差异与医院竞争程度、医院商业保险患者中被管理式保险覆盖的比例，以及医院患者中被医疗保险预期支付系统覆盖的比例呈正相关。

abstract.text: The U.S. 2009 Tobacco Control Act opened the door for new anti-smoking policies by giving the Food and Drug Administration broad regulatory authority over the tobacco industry. We develop a behavioral welfare economics approach to conduct cost-benefit analysis of FDA tobacco regulations. We use a simple two-period model to develop expressions for the impact of tobacco control policies on social welfare. Our model includes: nudge and paternalistic regulations; an excise tax on cigarettes; internalities created by period 1 versus period 2 consumption; and externalities from cigarette consumption. Our analytical expressions show that in the presence of uncorrected externalities and internalities, a tax or a nudge to reduce cigarette consumption improves social welfare. In sharp contrast, a paternalistic regulation might either improve or worsen social welfare. Another important result is that the social welfare gains from new policies do not only depend on the size of the internalities and externalities, but also depend on the extent to which current policies already correct the problems. We link our analytical expressions to the graphical approach used in most previous studies and discuss the information needed to complete cost-benefit analysis of tobacco regulations. Finally, we use our model as a framework to re-examine the evidence base regarding the size of the relevant internalities.

10.3386/w22718.abstractZh: 美国2009年《烟草控制法案》为新的反吸烟政策打开了大门，该法案赋予食品药品监督管理局对烟草行业的广泛监管权力。我们采用行为福利经济学方法，对FDA的烟草监管政策进行成本效益分析。我们使用一个简单的双期模型来推导烟草控制政策对社会福利的影响。我们的模型包括：激励性监管和家长式监管；香烟消费税；由第一期与第二期消费产生的内部性；以及香烟消费产生的外部性。我们的分析结果表明，在外部性和内部性未被纠正的情况下，征收税收或实施激励措施以减少香烟消费能够改善社会福利。相反，家长式监管可能会改善或恶化社会福利。另一个重要结论是，新政策带来的社会福利收益不仅取决于内部性和外部性的大小，还取决于现有政策在多大程度上解决了这些问题。我们将分析表达式与大多数先前研究中使用的图形方法相结合，并讨论了完成烟草监管政策成本效益分析所需的信息。最后，我们使用我们的模型作为框架，重新审视有关相关内部性大小的证据基础。

abstract.text: This paper examines trends in the aggregate productivity of the pharmaceutical sector over the past three decades. We incorporate Ricardo’s insight about demand-driven productivity in settings of variable scarce resources, and estimate the industry’s responsiveness to changes in demand over this timeframe using therapeutic class-specific data. In contrast to many analyses, our empirical estimates indicate that the industry has “met demand” with remarkable consistency since the late-1980s. The growth in total R&D spending, and therefore R&D costs per new drug, appear to have been profitable and productive investments. While we identify a significant increase in the industry’s fixed costs - the intercept of the production function - we find no decline in the marginal productivity of industry investments that might suggest significant supply-side frictions. While we cannot diagnose in detail why average, but not marginal, productivity declined, the data suggests that firms have finally begun to compete down returns from the supranormal levels of decades past.
