abstract.text: An endogenous growth model is developed where each period firms invest in researching and developing new ideas. An idea increases a firm's productivity. By how much depends on how central the idea is to a firm's activity. Ideas can be bought and sold on a market for patents. A firm can sell an idea that is not relevant to its business or buy one if it fails to innovate. The developed model is matched up with stylized facts about the market for patents in the U.S. The analysis attempts to gauge how efficiency in the patent market affects growth.

10.3982/ecta12144.abstractZh: 本文构建了一个内生增长模型，其中每个时期的企业都会投资于研究和开发新想法。一个想法能够提升企业的生产力，提升的程度取决于该想法对企业活动的核心性。想法可以在专利市场上进行买卖。企业可以出售与其业务无关的想法，或者在缺乏创新的情况下购买相关想法。该模型与关于美国专利市场的典型事实进行了对比分析，试图评估专利市场的效率如何影响企业的增长。

abstract.text: We propose a semiparametric two-step inference procedure for a finite-dimensional parameter based on moment conditions constructed from high-frequency data. The population moment conditions take the form of temporally integrated functionals of state-variable processes that include the latent stochastic volatility process of an asset. In the first step, we nonparametrically recover the volatility path from high-frequency asset returns. The nonparametric volatility estimator is then used to form sample moment functions in the second-step GMM estimation, which requires the correction of a high-order nonlinearity bias from the first step. We show that the proposed estimator is consistent and asymptotically mixed Gaussian and propose a consistent estimator for the conditional asymptotic variance. We also construct a Bierens-type consistent specification test. These infill asymptotic results are based on a novel empirical-process-type theory for general integrated functionals of noisy semimartingale processes.

10.3982/ecta12306.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种基于高频数据构建的矩条件，用于有限维参数的半参数两步推断方法。总体矩条件以状态变量过程的时积分泛函形式出现，其中包含了资产的潜在随机波动性过程。在第一步中，我们通过非参数方法从高频资产回报中恢复波动性路径。然后，使用非参数波动性估计量在第二步的GMM估计中形成样本矩函数，这需要修正第一步中出现的高阶非线性偏差。我们证明所提出的估计量是一致的，并且是渐近混合高斯的，同时提出了条件渐近方差的一致估计量。我们还构造了一个Bierens型一致规格检验。这些填充性渐近结果基于一种新颖的经验过程理论，用于一般噪声半鞅过程的积分泛函。

abstract.text: Liabilities ceded by life insurers to shadow reinsurers (i.e., less regulated and unrated off-balance-sheet entities) grew from $11 billion in 2002 to $364 billion in 2012. Life insurers using shadow insurance, which capture half of the market share, ceded 25 cents of every dollar insured to shadow reinsurers in 2012, up from 2 cents in 2002. Our adjustment for shadow insurance reduces risk-based capital by 53 percentage points (or 3 rating notches) and increases default probabilities by a factor of 3.5. We develop a structural model of the life insurance industry and estimate the impact of current policy proposals to limit or eliminate shadow insurance. In the counterfactual without shadow insurance, the average company using shadow insurance would raise prices by 10 to 21 percent, and annual life insurance underwritten would fall by 7 to 16 percent for the industry.

10.3982/ecta12401.abstractZh: 人寿保险公司向影子再保险商（即监管较少且未评级的表外实体）转移的责任金额从2002年的110亿美元增加到2012年的3640亿美元。使用影子保险的人寿保险公司占据了市场的一半份额，在2012年，每承保一美元，有25美分转移给了影子再保险商，而2002年这一比例为2美分。我们对影子保险的调整导致基于风险的资本减少了53个百分点（或降低了3个评级等级），同时违约概率增加了3.5倍。我们建立了一个人寿保险行业的结构模型，并估算了目前限制或消除影子保险的政策提案的影响。在没有影子保险的情况下，使用影子保险的平均公司会将价格提高10%至21%，而整个行业的年度人寿保险承保量将减少7%至16%。

abstract.text: We introduce the class of conditional linear combination tests, which reject null hypotheses concerning model parameters when a data-dependent convex combination of two identification-robust statistics is large. These tests control size under weak identification and have a number of optimality properties in a conditional problem. We show that the conditional likelihood ratio test of Moreira, 2003 is a conditional linear combination test in models with one endogenous regressor, and that the class of conditional linear combination tests is equivalent to a class of quasi-conditional likelihood ratio tests. We suggest using minimax regret conditional linear combination tests and propose a computationally tractable class of tests that plug in an estimator for a nuisance parameter. These plug-in tests perform well in simulation and have optimal power in many strongly identified models, thus allowing powerful identification-robust inference in a wide range of linear and nonlinear models without sacrificing efficiency if identification is strong.

10.3982/ecta12407.abstractZh: 我们介绍了条件线性组合检验类，这类检验在当两个识别稳健统计量的数据依赖凸组合较大时，会拒绝关于模型参数的零假设。这些检验在弱识别条件下能够控制样本量，并且在条件问题中具有一系列最优性质。我们证明了Moreira在2003年提出的条件似然比检验，在具有一个内生回归量的模型中属于条件线性组合检验，并且条件线性组合检验类等价于一类准条件似然比检验。我们建议使用极小化遗憾条件线性组合检验，并提出了一种计算上可行的检验方法，该方法通过插入一个干扰参数的估计量来进行检验。这些插入式检验在模拟实验中表现良好，并且在许多强识别模型中具有最优功效，因此可以在广泛的线性和非线性模型中实现强大的识别稳健推断，而不会因识别强度过高而牺牲效率。

abstract.text: We develop an equilibrium framework that relaxes the standard assumption that people have a correctly-specified view of their environment. Each player is characterized by a (possibly misspecified) subjective model, which describes the set of feasible beliefs over payoff-relevant consequences as a function of actions. We introduce the notion of a Berk-Nash equilibrium: Each player follows a strategy that is optimal given her belief, and her belief is restricted to be the best fit among the set of beliefs she considers possible. The notion of best fit is formalized in terms of minimizing the Kullback-Leibler divergence, which is endogenous and depends on the equilibrium strategy profile. Standard solution concepts such as Nash equilibrium and self-confirming equilibrium constitute special cases where players have correctly-specified models. We provide a learning foundation for Berk-Nash equilibrium by extending and combining results from the statistics literature on misspecified learning and the economics literature on learning in games.

10.3982/ecta12609.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个均衡框架，该框架放宽了人们对其环境有正确描述的假设。每个参与者都由一个（可能描述不准确的）主观模型来表征，该模型描述了作为行动函数的、关于收益相关后果的可行信念集合。我们引入了Berk-Nash均衡的概念：每个参与者都会遵循一个在其信念下最优的策略，而她的信念则被限制在她可能考虑的所有信念中最为合适。最优信念的概念通过最小化Kullback-Leibler散度来形式化，这一指标是内生的，并且取决于均衡策略组合。标准的解概念，如Nash均衡和自确认均衡，是参与者拥有正确描述的模型时的特殊情况。我们通过扩展和结合统计学中关于错误描述的学习研究以及经济学中关于博弈中学习的研究结果，为Berk-Nash均衡提供了一个学习基础。

abstract.text: I highlight how reputational concerns provide a natural explanation for “deadline effects,” the high frequency of deals prior to a deadline in bargaining. Rational agents imitate the demands of obstinate behavioral types and engage in brinkmanship in the face of uncertainty about the deadline's arrival. I also identify how surplus is divided when the prior probability of behavioral types is vanishingly small. If behavioral types are committed to fixed demands, outcomes converge to the Nash bargaining solution regardless of agents' respective impatience. If behavioral types can adopt more complex demand strategies, outcomes converge to the solution of an alternating offers game without behavioral types for the deadline environment.

10.3982/ecta12628.abstractZh: 我强调了声誉问题如何为“截止日期效应”提供自然解释，即在截止日期之前频繁达成交易的现象。理性代理人会模仿那些固执的行为类型的要求，并在对截止日期的到达存在不确定性的情况下采取冒险策略。我还探讨了当行为类型的先验概率极低时，剩余利益如何分配的问题。如果行为类型坚持固定的要求，那么无论代理人各自的急躁程度如何，结果都会收敛到纳什谈判解决方案。如果行为类型能够采用更复杂的需求策略，那么结果将收敛到在没有行为类型的截止日期环境下的交替报价游戏解决方案。

abstract.text: This paper proposes a method for aggregating individual preferences in the context of uncertainty. Individuals are assumed to abide by Savage's model of Subjective Expected Utility, in which everyone has his/her own utility and subjective probability. Disagreement on probabilities among individuals gives rise to uncertainty at the societal level, and thus society may entertain a set of probabilities rather than only one. We assume that social preference admits a Maxmin Expected Utility representation. In this context, two Pareto-type conditions are shown to be equivalent to social utility being a weighted average of individual utilities and the social set of priors containing only weighted averages of individual priors. Thus, society respects consensus among individuals' beliefs and does not add ambiguity beyond disagreement on beliefs. We also deal with the case in which society does not rule out any individual belief.

10.3982/ecta12676.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种在不确定性背景下聚合个体偏好的方法。假设个体遵循Savage的主观期望效用模型，即每个人都有自己的效用和主观概率。个体之间对概率的分歧会导致社会层面的不确定性，因此社会可能会考虑一组概率而非仅一个。我们假设社会偏好可以表示成最大最小期望效用形式。在此背景下，证明了两个帕累托型条件等价于社会效用是个体效用的加权平均值，以及社会先验集仅包含个体先验的加权平均值。因此，社会尊重个体信念的共识，不会因信念分歧而增加模糊性。我们还考虑了社会不排除任何个体信念的情况。

abstract.text: We examine the role of stochastic feasibility in consumer choice using a random conditional choice set rule (RCCSR) and uniquely characterize the model from conditions on stochastic choice data. Feasibility is modeled to permit correlation in availability of alternatives. This provides a natural way to examine substitutability/complementarity. We show that an RCCSR generalizes the random consideration set rule of [Manzini and Mariotti, 2014]. We then relate this model to existing literature. In particular, an RCCSR is not a random utility model.

10.3982/ecta12694.abstractZh: 我们研究了随机可行性在消费者选择中的作用，采用了随机条件选择集规则（RCCSR），并从随机选择数据的条件出发，对模型进行了独特描述。可行性被建模为允许备选方案的可用性之间存在相关性。这提供了一种自然的方法来考察替代性/互补性。我们证明了RCCSR可以推广到[Manzini和Mariotti, 2014]提出的随机考虑集规则。然后，我们将这一模型与现有文献进行了关联。特别是，RCCSR并非随机效用模型。

abstract.text: We analyze money and credit as competing payment instruments in decentralized exchange.In natural environments, we show the economy does not need both: if credit is easy, money is irrelevant; if credit is tight, money is essential, but credit becomes irrelevant.Changes in credit conditions are neutral because real balances respond endogenously to keep total liquidity constant.This is true for both exogenous and endogenous debt limits and policy limits, secured and unsecured lending, and general pricing mechanisms.While we show how to overturn some of these results, the benchmark model suggests credit might matter less than people think.

10.3982/ecta12798.abstractZh: 我们分析了货币和信用作为去中心化交换中的竞争支付工具。在自然环境中，我们发现经济并不需要两者：如果信用容易获得，货币就变得无关紧要；如果信用紧张，货币就变得至关重要，但信用也会变得无关紧要。信用状况的变化是中立的，因为实际余额会内生地调整以保持总流动性不变。这一点适用于外生和内生债务限制、有担保和无担保贷款，以及一般的定价机制。虽然我们展示了如何推翻其中的一些结果，但基准模型表明，信用的重要性可能比人们想象的要小。

abstract.text: We consider an agent who chooses an option after receiving some private information. This information, however, is unobserved by an analyst, so from the latter's perspective, choice is probabilistic or random. We provide a theory in which information can be fully identified from random choice. In addition, the analyst can perform the following inferences even when information is unobservable: (1) directly compute ex ante valuations of menus from random choice and vice versa, (2) assess which agent has better information by using choice dispersion as a measure of informativeness, (3) determine if the agent's beliefs about information are dynamically consistent, and (4) test to see if these beliefs are well‐calibrated or rational.

10.3982/ecta12821.abstractZh: 我们考虑一个代理人，在获得一些私人信息后选择某个选项。然而，这些信息分析师无法观察到，因此从后者的角度来看，选择是概率性的或随机的。我们提出了一个理论，该理论能够从随机选择中完全识别信息。此外，即使信息无法观察到，分析师也可以进行以下推断：(1) 直接计算随机选择的选项在事前估值，反之亦然；(2) 通过选择分散度作为信息量的衡量标准，评估哪个代理人的信息更丰富；(3) 判断代理人对信息的信念是否动态一致；(4) 测试这些信念是否经过良好校准或具有理性特征。

abstract.text: This paper shows that the problem of testing hypotheses in moment condition models without any assumptions about identification may be considered as a problem of testing with an infinite-dimensional nuisance parameter.We introduce a sufficient statistic for this nuisance parameter and propose conditional tests.These conditional tests have uniformly correct asymptotic size for a large class of models and test statistics.We apply our approach to construct tests based on quasi-likelihood ratio statistics, which we show are efficient in strongly identified models and perform well relative to existing alternatives in two examples.

10.3982/ecta12868.abstractZh: 本文指出，在无需假设识别性的情况下，对时刻条件模型中的假设进行检验的问题，可以被视为一个涉及无限维干扰参数的检验问题。我们为这个干扰参数引入了一个充分统计量，并提出了相应的条件检验。这些条件检验在大量模型和检验统计量上都具有一致正确的渐近功效。我们应用这种方法构建了基于拟似然比统计量的检验，并证明在强识别模型中，这些检验在效率上优于现有的替代方法，并在两个示例中得到了验证。

abstract.text: In a number of interesting environments, dynamic screening involves positive selection: in contrast with Coasian dynamics, only the most motivated remain over time. The paper provides conditions under which the principal's commitment optimum is time consistent and uses this result to derive testable predictions under permanent or transient shocks. It also identifies environments in which time consistency does not hold despite positive selection, and yet simple equilibrium characterizations can be obtained.

10.3982/ecta12961.abstractZh: 在一些有趣的环境中，动态筛选涉及正向选择：与科亚斯动态不同，只有最具有动机的个体能够长期存活。本文提出了主方的承诺最优值具有时间一致性的条件，并利用这一结果推导出在永久性或暂时性冲击下的可检验预测。同时，本文还指出了尽管存在正向选择，时间一致性并不成立的环境，但依然可以获得简单的均衡特征描述。

abstract.text: The farm household model has played a central role in improving the understanding of small-scale agricultural households and non-farm enterprises. Under the assumptions that all current and future markets exist and that farmers treat all prices as given, the model simplifies households' simultaneous production and consumption decisions into a recursive form in which production can be treated as independent of preferences of household members. These assumptions, which are the foundation of a large literature in labor and development, have been tested and not rejected in several important studies including Benjamin (1992). Using multiple waves of longitudinal survey data from Central Java, Indonesia, this paper tests a key prediction of the recursive model: demand for farm labor is unrelated to the demographic composition of the farm household. The prediction is unambiguously rejected. The rejection cannot be explained by contamination due to unobserved heterogeneity that is fixed at the farm level, local area shocks or farm-specific shocks that affect changes in household composition and farm labor demand. We conclude that the recursive form of the farm household model is not consistent with the data. Developing empirically tractable models of farm households when markets are incomplete remains an important challenge.

10.3982/ecta12987.abstractZh: 农场家庭模型在理解小规模农业家庭和非农业企业方面发挥了核心作用。在假设所有当前和未来的市场都存在，且农民认为所有价格都是既定不变的条件下，该模型将家庭的同时生产和消费决策简化为递归形式，其中生产可以被视为与家庭成员的偏好无关。这些假设是劳动与发展领域大量研究的基石，在包括Benjamin（1992）在内的多项重要研究中得到了验证，并未被否定。本文利用印度尼西亚中爪哇省的多轮纵向调查数据，检验了递归模型的一个关键预测：对农场劳动力的需求与农场家庭的人口构成无关。这一预测被明确否定。这一否定不能由农场层面固定的未观测异质性、局部冲击或影响家庭构成和农场劳动力需求的农场特定冲击来解释。我们得出结论，农场家庭模型的递归形式与数据不符。在 markets 不完整的情况下，发展出具有实证可行性的农场家庭模型仍然是一个重要挑战。

abstract.text: We study two types of robust contracting problem under hidden action in continuous time. In type I problem, the principal is ambiguous about the project cash flows, while he is ambiguous about the agent’s beliefs in type II problem. The principal designs a robust contract that maximizes his utility under the worst-case scenario subject to the agent’s incentive and participation constraints. We implement the optimal contract by cash reserves, debt and equity. In addition to receiving ordinary dividends when cash reserves reach a threshold, outside equity holders also receive special dividends or inject cash in the cash reserves to hedge against model uncertainty. Ambiguity aversion lowers outside securities value and raises the credit yield spread. It generates equity premium for type I problem, but not for type II problem. The equity premium and the credit yield spread are state dependent and high for distressed firms with low cash reserves.

10.3982/ecta13127.abstractZh: 我们研究了连续时间下存在隐藏行动时的两种稳健契约问题。在类型I问题中，委托人对于项目的现金流存在不确定性，而在类型II问题中，委托人对代理人的信念也存在不确定性。委托人设计了一种稳健契约，旨在在代理人激励和参与约束的前提下，最大化其在最坏情况下的效用。我们通过现金储备、债务和股权来实现最优契约。除了在现金储备达到阈值时获得普通股息外，外部股权持有者还可以获得特殊股息，或者向现金储备中注入资金以对冲模型不确定性。不确定性厌恶会降低外部证券的价值并增加信用收益率差。这种机制为类型I问题产生了股权溢价，但类型II问题则没有。股权溢价和信用收益率差取决于状态，对于现金储备较低且处于困境的公司来说，这些数值较高。

abstract.text: We present a noncooperative game model of coalitional bargaining, closely based on that of Gul (1989) but solvable by backward induction. In this game, Gul's condition of “value additivity” does not suffice to ensure the existence of a subgame perfect Nash equilibrium that supports the Shapley value, but a related condition—“no positive value-externalities”—does. Multiple equilibria can arise only in the event of ties, and with a mild restriction on tie-break rules these equilibria all support the Shapley value.

10.3982/ecta13191.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个非合作博弈模型，用于描述联盟谈判过程，该模型基于Gul（1989）的研究，但可以通过逆向归纳法求解。在这个博弈中，Gul提出的“价值可加性”条件并不足以确保存在一个支持Shapley值的子博弈完美纳什均衡，但一个相关的条件——“没有正的外部性价值”——则足以确保均衡的存在。只有在存在平局的情况下，才会出现多个均衡，而在对平局规则进行适度限制的情况下，这些均衡都支持Shapley值。

abstract.text: Consider a group of individuals with unobservable perspectives (subjective prior beliefs) about a sequence of states. In each period, each individual receives private information about the current state and forms an opinion (a posterior belief). She also chooses a target individual and observes the target's opinion. This choice involves a trade-off between well-informed targets, whose signals are precise, and well-understood targets, whose perspectives are well known. Opinions are informative about the target's perspective, so observed individuals become better understood over time. We identify a simple condition under which long-run behavior is history independent. When this fails, each individual restricts attention to a small set of experts and observes the most informed among these. A broad range of observational patterns can arise with positive probability, including opinion leadership and information segregation. In an application to areas of expertise, we show how these mechanisms generate own-field bias and large field dominance.

10.3982/ecta13320.abstractZh: 设想有一群个体，他们对一系列状态持有不可观测的观点（主观先验信念）。在每个时期，每个个体都会获得关于当前状态的私人信息，并形成一个观点（后验信念）。个体还会选择一个目标个体，并观察该目标的观点。这一选择涉及权衡：那些信息精确的目标个体，以及那些观点广为人知的目标个体。观点能够反映目标个体的视角，因此被观察的个体会随着时间变得更加清晰。我们确定了一个简单条件，在该条件下，长期行为与历史无关。当这一条件不成立时，每个个体会只关注一小部分专家，并观察其中最了解情况的专家。多种观察模式以正概率出现，包括观点领导和信息隔离。在应用于专业领域时，我们展示了这些机制如何产生自身领域的偏见以及领域内的主导地位。

abstract.text: Two fundamental axioms in social choice theory are consistency with respect to a variable electorate and consistency with respect to components of similar alternatives. In the context of traditional non-probabilistic social choice, these axioms are incompatible with each other. We show that in the context of probabilistic social choice, these axioms uniquely characterize a function proposed by Fishburn (Rev. Econ. Stud., 51(4), 683--692, 1984). Fishburn's function returns so-called maximal lotteries, i.e., lotteries that correspond to optimal mixed strategies of the underlying plurality game. Maximal lotteries are guaranteed to exist due to von Neumann's Minimax Theorem, are almost always unique, and can be efficiently computed using linear programming.

10.3982/ecta13337.abstractZh: 在社会选择理论中，有两个基本公理：一是在不同选民群体之间的一致性；二是对于相似备选方案成分之间的一致性。在传统的非概率社会选择背景下，这些公理彼此不兼容。我们证明了在概率社会选择的背景下，这些公理唯一地刻画了Fishburn提出的一个函数。Fishburn的函数能够返回所谓的最大彩票，即对应于底层多数游戏的最优混合策略的彩票。根据冯·诺伊曼的极小极大定理，最大彩票的存在是必然的，它们几乎总是唯一的，并且可以通过线性规划高效计算得到。

abstract.text: Call an economic model incomplete if it does not generate a probabilistic prediction even given knowledge of all parameter values.We propose a method of inference about unknown parameters for such models that is robust to heterogeneity and dependence of unknown form.The key is a Central Limit Theorem for belief functions; robust con…dence regions are then constructed in a fashion paralleling the classical approach.Monte Carlo simulations support tractability of the method and demonstrate its enhanced robustness relative to existing methods.

10.3982/ecta13394.abstractZh: 如果一个经济模型在知晓所有参数值的情况下仍然无法生成概率预测，那么可以称该模型为不完整的模型。我们提出了一种针对此类模型的未知参数推断方法，该方法能够稳健地处理参数的异质性和未知形式的依赖性。该方法的核心是利用信念函数的中心极限定理；随后以类似于经典方法的方式构建稳健的置信区域。蒙特卡洛模拟支持了该方法的可行性，并证明了其相对于现有方法的增强的稳健性。

abstract.text: We test for the existence of housing bubbles associated with a failure of the transversality condition that requires the present value of payments occurring infinitely far in the future to be zero. The most prominent such bubble is the classic rational bubble. We study housing markets in the U.K. and Singapore, where residential property ownership takes the form of either leaseholds or freeholds. Leaseholds are finitematurity, pre-paid, and tradable ownership contracts with maturities often exceeding 700 years. Freeholds are infinite-maturity ownership contracts. The price difference between leaseholds with extremely-long maturities and freeholds reflects the present value of a claim to the freehold after leasehold expiry, and is thus a direct empirical measure of the transversality condition. We estimate this price difference, and find no evidence for failures of the transversality condition in housing markets in the U.K. and Singapore, even during periods when a sizeable bubble was regularly thought to be present.

10.3982/ecta13447.abstractZh: 我们检验了是否存在与“横向条件”失效相关的房地产泡沫，该条件要求未来无限期发生的支付款的现值为零。最典型的此类泡沫就是经典的理性泡沫。我们研究了英国和新加坡的房地产市场，在这些市场中，住宅财产所有权采取租赁权或永久产权的形式。租赁权是一种有限期限、预付且可交易的产权合同，其期限通常超过700年。永久产权则是无限期限的所有权合同。具有极长期限的租赁权和永久产权之间的价格差异，反映了租赁权到期后对永久产权的要求权现值，因此直接体现了横向条件的有效性。我们估算了这一价格差异，发现在英国和新加坡的房地产市场中，即使在人们普遍认为存在较大泡沫的时期，也没有证据表明横向条件失效。

abstract.text: This paper studies how the abolition of an elite recruitment system—China's civil exam system that lasted over 1,300 years—affects political stability. Employing a panel data set across 262 prefectures and exploring the variations in the quotas on the entry-level exam candidates, we find that higher quotas per capita were associated with a higher probability of revolution participation after the abolition and a higher incidence of uprisings in 1911 that marked the end of the 2,000 years of imperial rule. This finding is robust to various checks including using the number of small rivers and short-run exam performance before the quota system as instruments. The patterns in the data appear most consistent with the interpretation that in regions with higher quotas per capita under the exam system, more would-be elites were negatively affected by the abolition. In addition, we document that modern human capital in the form of those studying in Japan also contributed to the revolution and that social capital strengthened the effect of quotas on revolution participation.

10.3982/ecta13448.abstractZh: 本文研究了中国延续了1300多年的科举制度废除对政治稳定的影响。通过利用262个 prefectures的面板数据，并分析初考资格的配额变化，我们发现，人均配额较高的地区在科举制度废除后参与革命的概率更高，1911年标志着2000年帝国统治的终结，该年的起义事件也更为频繁。这一发现经得起各种检验，包括使用小河流数量和初考成绩作为工具变量。数据中的模式似乎表明，在科举制度下人均配额较高的地区，更多潜在的精英因废除科举制度而受到负面影响。此外，我们还发现，以在日本学习的形式存在的现代人力资本也促进了革命，而社会资本则增强了配额对革命参与的影响。

abstract.text: The past forty years have seen a rapid rise in top income inequality in the United States. While there is a large number of existing theories of the Pareto tail of the long-run income distributions, almost none of these address the fast rise in top inequality observed in the data. We show that standard theories, which build on a random growth mechanism, generate transition dynamics that are too slow relative to those observed in the data. We then suggest two parsimonious deviations from the canonical model that can explain such changes: “scale dependence” that may arise from changes in skill prices, and “type dependence,” that is, the presence of some “high-growth types.” These deviations are consistent with theories in which the increase in top income inequality is driven by the rise of “superstar” entrepreneurs or managers.

10.3982/ecta13569.abstractZh: 过去四十年间，美国顶尖收入不平等现象迅速加剧。尽管存在许多关于长期收入分布帕累托尾部的理论，但几乎没有一种理论能够解释数据中观察到的顶尖收入不平等的快速增长。我们发现，基于随机增长机制的标准理论所预测的转型动态，与数据中的实际情况相比过于缓慢。因此，我们提出了两种对经典模型的简略修正，以解释这种变化：“规模依赖性”，这可能源于技能价格的变化，以及“类型依赖性”，即某些“高成长类型”的存在。这些修正与那些认为顶尖收入不平等的加剧是由“超级明星”企业家或管理者崛起所驱动的理论相一致。

abstract.text: We study families of normal-form games with fixed preferences over pure action profiles but varied preferences over lotteries. That is, we subject players' utilities to monotone but nonlinear transformations and examine changes in the rationalizable set and set of equilibria. Among our results: The rationalizable set always grows under concave transformations (risk aversion) and shrinks under convex transformations (risk love). The rationalizable set reaches an upper bound under extreme risk aversion, and lower bound under risk love, and both of these bounds are characterized by elimination processes. For generic two-player games, under extreme risk love or aversion, all Nash equilibria are close to pure and the limiting set of equilibria can be described using preferences over pure action profiles. [web URL: http://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.3982/ECTA13948/abstract]

10.3982/ecta13948.abstractZh: 我们研究了具有固定偏好对纯行动配置文件的正常形式博弈家族，但对彩票的偏好则有所不同。也就是说，我们对玩家的效用进行了单调但非线性的变换，并考察了可理性化集合和均衡集合的变化。我们的研究结果包括：在凹性变换下（风险厌恶），可理性化集合总是会增长；在凸性变换下（风险偏好），可理性化集合则会缩小。在极端风险厌恶下，可理性化集合达到一个上限；在风险偏好下，则达到一个下限，这两个界限都可以通过消除过程来表征。对于一般的双人博弈，在极端风险偏好或厌恶下，所有纳什均衡都接近于纯策略均衡，而均衡的极限集合可以用对纯行动配置文件的偏好来描述。[网络链接: http://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.3982/ECTA13948/abstract]

abstract.text: Confidence intervals are commonly used to describe parameter uncertainty. In nonstandard problems, however, their frequentist coverage property does not guarantee that they do so in a reasonable fashion. For instance, confidence intervals may be empty or extremely short with positive probability, even if they are based on inverting powerful tests. We apply a betting framework to formalize the “reasonableness ” of confidence intervals as descriptions of parameter uncertainty, and use it for two purposes. First, we quantify the degree of unreasonableness of previously suggested confidence intervals in nonstandard problems. Second, we derive alternative confidence sets that are reasonable by construction. We apply our framework to inference about a parameter near a boundary and a local-to-unity autoregressive root. We find that previously suggested confidence intervals are not reasonable, and numerically determine alternative confidence sets that satisfy our criteria.

10.3982/ecta14023.abstractZh: 置信区间通常用于描述参数不确定性。然而，在非标准问题中，它们的频率主义覆盖性质并不能保证其具有合理的表现。例如，即使基于强大的检验方法，置信区间也可能为空或极短，且这种可能性是存在的。我们采用一种赌注框架来形式化置信区间作为参数不确定性的描述，并将其用于两个目的。首先，我们量化了在非标准问题中先前提出的置信区间的不合理性程度。其次，我们通过构造方法推导出合理的替代置信集。我们将这一框架应用于对边界附近参数以及局部至单位自回归根的推断，发现先前提出的置信区间并不合理，并通过数值方法确定了满足我们标准的替代置信集。

abstract.text: We consider a decision maker who ranks actions according to the smooth ambiguity criterion of Klibanos et al. (2005). An action is justifiable if it is a best reply to some belief over probabilistic models. We show that higher ambiguity aversion expands the set of justifiable actions. In turn, this implies that higher ambiguity aversion expands the set of rationalizable actions of a game. Our results follow from a generalization of the duality lemma of Wald (1949) and Pearce (1984).

10.3982/ecta14429.abstractZh: 我们考虑一个决策者，该决策者根据Klibanos等人（2005年）提出的平滑模糊性标准对行动进行排序。如果一个行动是对某些概率模型的信念的最佳回应，那么这个行动就是合理的。我们表明，更高的模糊性厌恶会扩大合理行动的集合。这反过来意味着，更高的模糊性厌恶会扩大博弈中合理行动的集合。我们的结果源于Wald（1949年）和Pearce（1984年）提出的对偶引理的推广。

abstract.text: We analyze the implications of household-level adjustment costs for the dynamics of aggregate consumption. We show that an economy in which agents have “consumption commitments” is approximately equivalent to a habit formation model in which the habit stock is a weighted average of past consumption if idiosyncratic risk is large relative to aggregate risk. Consumption commitments can thus explain the empirical regularity that consumption is excessively sensitive and excessively smooth, findings that are typically attributed to habit formation. Unlike habit formation and other theories, but consistent with empirical evidence, the consumption commitments model also predicts that excess sensitivity and smoothness vanish for large shocks. These results suggest that behavior previously attributed to habit formation may be better explained by adjustment costs. We develop additional testable predictions to further distinguish the commitment and habit models and show that the two models have different welfare implications.

10.3982/ecta9390.abstractZh: 我们分析了家庭层面调整成本对总体消费动态的影响。我们发现，在一个代理人具有“消费承诺”的经济体中，该经济与一种习惯形成模型大致相当，在这种模型中，习惯存量是过去消费的加权平均值，前提是特异性风险相对于总体风险较大。因此，消费承诺可以解释消费过度敏感和过度平滑的实证规律，这些发现通常归因于习惯形成。与习惯形成和其他理论不同，但与实证证据一致，消费承诺模型还预测，在重大冲击下，这种过度敏感和过度平滑的现象会消失。这些结果表明，以前被归因于习惯形成的行为，可能更好地由调整成本来解释。我们提出了额外的可检验的预测，以进一步区分承诺模型和习惯模型，并表明这两种模型对福利的影响是不同的。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes a search model with asymmetric information of the common values variety. The basic features of this environment resemble those of a common values (procurement) auction, except that the searcher in our model, who is the counterpart of the auctioneer in the auction model, encounters trading partners through costly sequential search. The main objective is to understand how the combination of search activity and information asymmetry affects prices and welfare. We specifically inquire about the extent of information aggregation by the price –how close the equilibrium prices are to the full information prices–when the search frictions are small. Roughly speaking, we conclude that information is aggregated less well in the search environment than it is in the corresponding auction environment. We trace this to a stronger form of winner’s curse that is present in the search scenario. This understanding is a central qualitative insight of this paper, which is likely to have implications beyond the narrow confines of our model. We also look at the efficiency perspective and examine the relations between total surplus and the informativenss of the signal technology available to the uninformed. We conclude that total surplus is not monotone in the quality of the signals.

10.3982/ecta9969.abstractZh: 本文分析了一种具有信息不对称的常见价值类型的搜索模型。该环境的基本特征与常见价值拍卖类似，不同之处在于，我们模型中的搜索者作为拍卖模型的拍卖师对应角色，需要通过昂贵的顺序搜索来寻找交易伙伴。主要目标是了解搜索活动与信息不对称如何影响价格和福利。我们特别探讨了在搜索摩擦较小时，价格对信息聚合的程度——均衡价格与完全信息价格之间的接近程度——具体来说，我们得出结论：在搜索环境中，信息的聚合效果不如相应的拍卖环境。这一结论源于搜索场景中更为严重的“赢家诅咒”现象。这一理解是本文的核心定性见解，其影响可能超出我们模型的狭隘范围。我们还从效率的角度出发，研究了总 surplus 与信息不灵者所拥有的信号技术信息量之间的关系。我们得出结论：总 surplus 并不随信号质量的提高而单调增加。

abstract.text: Many U.S. nursing homes have serious quality problems, in part, because of inadequate levels of nurse staffing. This commentary focuses on two issues. First, there is a need for higher minimum nurse staffing standards for U.S. nursing homes based on multiple research studies showing a positive relationship between nursing home quality and staffing and the benefits of implementing higher minimum staffing standards. Studies have identified the minimum staffing levels necessary to provide care consistent with the federal regulations, but many U.S. facilities have dangerously low staffing. Second, the barriers to staffing reform are discussed. These include economic concerns about costs and a focus on financial incentives. The enforcement of existing staffing standards has been weak, and strong nursing home industry political opposition has limited efforts to establish higher standards. Researchers should study the ways to improve staffing standards and new payment, regulatory, and political strategies to improve nursing home staffing and quality.

10.4137/hsi.s38994.abstractZh: 许多美国的养老院存在严重的问题，部分原因是护士人员配备不足。本文重点讨论两个问题。首先，根据多项研究，美国养老院需要更高的护士人员配备标准，因为护士人员配备与养老院的服务质量之间存在正相关关系，实施更高的人员配备标准会带来诸多好处。研究已经确定了符合联邦法规要求的最低人员配备标准，但许多美国养老院的人员配备水平仍然非常低，存在安全隐患。其次，本文还探讨了人员配备改革所面临的障碍。这些障碍包括经济方面的成本问题以及对财务激励措施的重视。现有人员配备标准的执行力度不足，而强大的养老院行业政治反对意见也限制了提高标准的努力。研究人员应研究如何改进人员配备标准，并探索新的支付、监管和政治策略，以提升养老院的人员配备和服务质量。
